title: Wholemeal Bagels with Smoked Salmon, Avocado & Tomato
ingredients_json: ["120 g wholemeal bagel", "80 g smoked salmon", "80 g avocado, raw", "120 g tomato, fresh", "20 g low-fat Greek yoghurt", "10 g lemon juice", "5 g olive oil", "1 g black pepper", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Slice the wholemeal bagel in half and toast it in a toaster or under a grill for 2–3 minutes until the cut sides are lightly crisp and golden. Mash the avocado in a bowl and stir in the lemon juice and Greek yoghurt until creamy. Chop the tomato and drain any excess juices if it looks watery. Spread the avocado mixture generously on the toasted bagel halves. Top with smoked salmon, add the chopped tomato, then drizzle with the olive oil and finish with black pepper and a little salt. Serve immediately while the bagel is still warm.

title: Wholegrain Bagels with Avocado, Smoked Salmon & Poached Egg
ingredients_json: ["2 wholegrain bagels", "1 piece avocado, raw", "120 g smoked salmon", "2 piece eggs", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp lemon juice", "1 g dill, fresh", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g sea salt"]
instructions: Slice the avocado and mash the flesh in a bowl with lemon juice, half the dill, black pepper, and a pinch of the sea salt. Fill a small saucepan with water and bring it to a gentle simmer, then crack the eggs into separate cups and slide them into the water one at a time. Poach for about 3–4 minutes until the whites are set but the yolks are still runny. Toast the wholegrain bagels until they are golden. Brush the cut sides lightly with olive oil, then spread with the avocado mixture. Top each bagel with smoked salmon and a poached egg, and finish with the remaining dill and a tiny bit of sea salt.

title: Whole-Grain Bagels with Smoked Salmon, Greek Yogurt Dill Spread & Cucumber
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces whole-grain bagel", "120 g smoked salmon", "150 g Greek yogurt, low-fat (5% fat)", "1 tbsp olive oil, extra virgin", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tbsp fresh dill", "150 g cucumber", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Toast the whole-grain bagels until they are golden and crisp, then cut them in half. In a bowl, mix the low-fat Greek yogurt with lemon juice and chopped fresh dill, then season with the ground black pepper. Spread the dill yogurt generously over the toasted bagels. Layer the smoked salmon on top, then slice the cucumber thinly and pile it on for crunch. Drizzle the olive oil lightly over the top and serve immediately while the bagels are still warm.

title: Whole-Grain Bagel Halves with Avocado, Smoked Salmon and Poached Egg
ingredients_json: ["2 wholegrain bagels", "80 g smoked salmon", "1 medium egg", "160 g avocado, raw", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tbsp low-fat plain Greek yogurt", "10 g fresh dill", "1 g sea salt", "0.5 g black pepper"]
instructions: Halve the whole-grain bagels and toast them in a toaster or dry pan over medium heat until the cut sides are golden and crisp. While the bagels toast, bring a small saucepan of water to a gentle simmer and add a splash of lemon juice. Crack the egg into a cup, then slide it into the simmering water and poach for about 3 to 4 minutes until the white is set and the yolk is still soft. Mash the avocado with the lemon juice, Greek yogurt, half the dill, sea salt, and black pepper until creamy. Spread the avocado mixture over the toasted bagel halves, top with smoked salmon, and place the poached egg on top. Finish with the remaining dill and serve immediately while the bagels are still warm.

title: Whole-Grain Bagels with Smoked Salmon, Avocado & Dill
ingredients_json: ["2 medium bagels, whole-grain, unsweetened", "120 g smoked salmon", "1 medium avocado", "120 g low-fat Greek yogurt (2% fat)", "10 g fresh dill", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tsp capers, rinsed", "1 tsp olive oil", "2 pinches sea salt", "1 pinch black pepper"]
instructions: Halve the whole-grain bagels and toast them until they are golden and crisp at the edges. Mash the avocado in a bowl with the lemon juice, black pepper, and half of the chopped dill. In a second bowl, stir the Greek yogurt with the remaining dill, capers, a small drizzle of olive oil, and a little sea salt. Spread the avocado mixture over the toasted bagels, top with the smoked salmon, and finish with a spoonful of the herbed yogurt sauce. Serve immediately while the bagels are still warm, and you should see lightly crisp edges and a creamy, well-combined topping.

title: Wholegrain Banana Oat Bread with Walnuts and Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["300 g bananas, ripe, mashed", "150 g rolled oats", "120 g whole wheat flour", "60 g plain Greek yogurt, low fat 2%", "60 ml rapeseed oil", "2 large eggs, raw", "80 g walnuts, chopped", "10 g baking powder", "3 g ground cinnamon", "2 g fine salt", "30 g honey"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Line a loaf tin (about 900 g capacity) with baking paper. In a large bowl, mash the bananas until mostly smooth, then whisk in the eggs, Greek yogurt and rapeseed oil until well combined. Stir in the honey and cinnamon. Add the oats, whole wheat flour, baking powder and salt, then mix until you have a thick batter. Fold in the chopped walnuts and scrape the batter into the tin. Bake for 45–55 minutes, until the top is golden and a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean or with only a few moist crumbs. Let the bread cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool fully before slicing.

title: Whole-Grain Banana Oat Breads with Walnuts and Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["260 g ripe bananas, mashed", "180 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "80 g whole rolled oats", "120 g whole wheat flour", "60 g walnuts, chopped", "2 pieces eggs, whole", "60 ml rapeseed oil", "10 g baking powder", "5 g ground cinnamon", "2 g fine salt", "30 g honey", "5 ml vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C and line a loaf pan with baking paper. In a large bowl, mash the bananas until mostly smooth, then whisk in the eggs, Greek yogurt, rapeseed oil, honey, and vanilla until the mixture looks creamy and evenly combined. Stir in the oats, whole wheat flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt, mixing just until no dry flour remains. Fold in the chopped walnuts, then pour the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top. Bake for 45–55 minutes, until the loaf is golden and a skewer inserted in the center comes out clean or with only a few moist crumbs. Let it cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool further before slicing.

title: Wholewheat Banana Oat Bread with Cinnamon and Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["2 large bananas, ripe, mashed", "180 g rolled oats", "120 g wholewheat flour", "2 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "80 g plain Greek yogurt, non-fat", "2 large eggs, raw", "60 ml rapeseed oil", "50 g walnuts, chopped", "1 pinch salt", "1 tbsp honey"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a loaf tin with baking paper. In a large bowl, mash the ripe bananas until mostly smooth, then stir in the Greek yogurt, eggs, oil, and honey until well combined. In a second bowl, mix the oats, wholewheat flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture and stir just until no dry flour remains. Fold in the chopped walnuts, then scrape the batter into the prepared tin and smooth the top. Bake for 45–55 minutes, until the bread is deep golden and a skewer inserted into the center comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs. Let it cool in the tin for 10 minutes before lifting it out to cool fully on a rack, then slice.

title: Wholegrain Banana Oat Bread with Walnuts and Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["3 piece Banana, ripe", "200 g Rolled oats", "120 g Whole wheat flour", "80 g Walnuts, chopped", "2 piece Egg, whole, raw", "120 ml Plain low-fat yogurt", "60 ml Rapeseed oil", "3 g Baking powder", "2 g Baking soda", "4 g Ground cinnamon", "2 g Fine salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 180°C and line a loaf tin with baking paper. Mash the bananas in a large bowl until mostly smooth, then whisk in the eggs, yogurt, and rapeseed oil. Stir in the oats, whole wheat flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt, mixing until you have a thick batter. Fold in the chopped walnuts, then spoon the batter into the tin and smooth the top. Bake for about 45–55 minutes, until the loaf is deep golden and a skewer inserted in the center comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs. Let the banana bread cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool further before slicing.

title: Whole-Grain Banana Bread with Walnuts and Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["220 g ripe bananas, mashed", "140 g whole wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "120 g nonfat Greek yogurt", "2 piece eggs, raw", "30 g walnuts, chopped", "60 g honey", "60 ml olive oil", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp baking soda", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "2 g fine salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C and line a loaf pan with baking paper. Mash the bananas thoroughly until mostly smooth. In a large bowl, whisk the eggs, honey, olive oil, and Greek yogurt until the mixture looks glossy. Stir in the mashed bananas. Add the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt, then mix just until no dry flour pockets remain. Fold in the chopped walnuts. Pour the batter into the pan and bake for 45–55 minutes, until the top is golden and a skewer inserted into the center comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs. Let the banana bread cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely before slicing.

title: Wholewheat Oat Biscuits with Greek Yogurt and Blueberries
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "120 g plain Greek yogurt, non-fat", "2 pieces eggs, raw", "50 g blueberries, fresh", "20 g ground flaxseed", "8 g baking powder", "2 g fine salt", "30 g honey", "10 ml olive oil"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a large bowl, mix the oats, ground flaxseed, baking powder and salt. In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs, Greek yogurt, honey and olive oil until smooth. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir until you get a thick dough. Fold in the blueberries gently so they don’t burst too much. Scoop the dough into 8–10 mounds on the tray and flatten them slightly. Bake for 14–18 minutes, until the biscuits are golden at the edges and set in the center. Let them cool on the tray for 5 minutes before transferring to a rack to cool a little more.

title: Wholemeal Oat & Banana Breakfast Biscuits with Cinnamon and Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["200 g wholemeal wheat flour", "100 g rolled oats", "120 g plain Greek yogurt, 2% fat", "1 large egg, raw", "120 g ripe banana, mashed", "60 ml honey", "50 ml sunflower oil", "8 g baking powder", "3 g ground cinnamon", "3 g fine salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a large bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, rolled oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. In a separate bowl, whisk the egg with the Greek yogurt, mashed banana, honey, and sunflower oil until smooth. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir until you have a thick, slightly sticky dough. Shape the dough into 10–12 small biscuits and place them on the tray, leaving space between each. Bake for 12–15 minutes, until the biscuits are lightly golden at the edges and firm to the touch. Let them cool on the tray for 5 minutes before moving to a rack so they finish setting.

title: Whole-Oat Banana Biscuits with Greek Yogurt and Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "1 piece medium banana, ripe, mashed", "120 g plain Greek yogurt, nonfat", "2 pieces large egg", "10 g baking powder", "5 g ground cinnamon", "3 g fine salt", "30 g almond butter", "20 g chia seeds"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 180°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a large bowl, mix the rolled oats, baking powder, cinnamon, salt, and chia seeds. In a second bowl, whisk the eggs, then stir in the mashed banana and Greek yogurt until smooth. Pour the wet mixture into the dry mixture and fold until you get a thick batter; fold in the almond butter as well. Scoop 10–12 mounds onto the tray, flatten slightly, and bake for 15–18 minutes until the biscuits are set and lightly golden at the edges. Let them cool on the tray for 5 minutes before transferring to a rack to cool further so they firm up.

title: Whole-Oat Cottage Cheese Biscuits with Herby Garlic
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "200 g cottage cheese, low-fat", "1 piece egg, raw", "25 g ground almonds", "8 g baking powder", "5 g dried oregano", "3 g garlic powder", "3 g fine salt", "10 ml olive oil", "80 g blueberries, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a bowl, mix the rolled oats, ground almonds, baking powder, oregano, garlic powder, and salt. In a second bowl, whisk the cottage cheese and egg until smooth, then stir in the olive oil. Combine the wet and dry ingredients and mix until you get a thick, sticky dough. Fold in the blueberries gently so they don’t break too much. Scoop the dough into small mounds, placing them spaced out on the tray, and gently flatten each one with a spoon. Bake for 14–18 minutes until the biscuits are lightly golden around the edges and set in the middle. Let them cool on the tray for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Greek Yogurt Oat Biscuits with Cinnamon and Blueberries
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "120 g plain Greek yogurt, low-fat", "2 large eggs, raw", "60 g blueberries, fresh", "10 g baking powder", "5 g ground cinnamon", "15 g honey", "20 g rapeseed oil", "2 g fine salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C and line a baking tray with parchment. In a large bowl, mix the rolled oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. In another bowl, whisk the Greek yogurt, eggs, honey, and rapeseed oil until smooth. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir until you get a thick dough; fold in the blueberries gently so they don’t break. Scoop 10–12 portions onto the tray and lightly flatten each one into a biscuit shape. Bake for 12–15 minutes, until the biscuits are golden at the edges and set in the middle. Let them cool on the tray for 5 minutes before moving to a rack to cool further.

title: Whole-Grain Cottage Cheese Blintzes with Berry Compote
ingredients_json: ["120 g whole-grain wheat flour", "2 pieces eggs, raw", "3 dl semi-skimmed milk", "1 tbsp sunflower oil", "200 g low-fat cottage cheese", "150 g plain Greek yogurt, low-fat", "60 g honey", "250 g mixed berries, frozen", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 g ground cinnamon", "2 g fine sea salt"]
instructions:
Whisk the whole-grain flour, eggs, semi-skimmed milk, 1 tbsp sunflower oil, 1 g salt, and the cinnamon in a bowl until you have a smooth batter. Rest the batter for 10 minutes, then heat a non-stick frying pan over medium heat and lightly grease it if needed. Ladle in a thin layer of batter and swirl to coat the pan; cook for about 1–2 minutes until the edges look set and lightly golden, then flip and cook for another 30–60 seconds. Repeat with the remaining batter.

Stir together the cottage cheese, Greek yogurt, and half of the honey until smooth. Spoon a line of filling onto each blintz and fold in the sides, then roll up tightly. For the berry compote, warm the mixed berries with the lemon juice and remaining honey in a saucepan over medium heat for 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the berries break down and thicken slightly.

Serve the blintzes warm with the berry compote on top. If you want a lightly crisp finish, briefly toast the assembled blintzes in the same pan over medium-low heat for 1–2 minutes per side until golden, then serve.

title: Whole-Grain Cottage Cheese Blintzes with Berry Compote
ingredients_json: ["120 g whole-grain wheat flour", "2 pieces eggs, raw", "400 ml low-fat milk", "1 tsp rapeseed oil", "250 g low-fat cottage cheese", "30 g Greek yogurt, plain 2%", "40 g honey", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "200 g frozen mixed berries", "1 tbsp water", "10 g cornstarch", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Whisk the whole-grain wheat flour, eggs, milk, rapeseed oil, and 1 g of salt in a bowl until smooth and lump-free, then let the batter rest for 10 minutes. Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat and lightly grease it with a small amount of oil. Pour in about 80 ml batter per blintz and swirl the pan so the surface is evenly coated; cook until the edges look set and the underside is lightly golden, then flip and cook for 30–60 seconds more. Transfer the blintzes to a plate and cover with a clean towel so they stay warm. Mix cottage cheese, Greek yogurt, honey, vanilla extract, and lemon juice until creamy. Spoon the filling into the center of each blintz, fold the sides in, and roll into neat parcels. For the berry compote, simmer the frozen mixed berries with 1 tbsp water and the cornstarch slurry (mix cornstarch with 1 tbsp water) for 3–5 minutes until glossy and thickened. Serve the blintzes warm with the berry compote spooned over the top.

title: Whole-Grain Berry Ricotta Blintzes with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["120 g whole-grain wheat flour", "2 piece eggs, raw", "350 ml low-fat milk (1.5%)", "10 g olive oil", "200 g low-fat ricotta", "150 g plain Greek yogurt, nonfat", "120 g mixed berries (blueberries and raspberries), fresh or frozen", "30 g honey", "5 g vanilla sugar", "2 g salt", "20 g butter, unsalted", "10 g powdered erythritol"]
instructions: Whisk the flour, eggs, milk, olive oil, and 1 g of the salt until you have a smooth batter with no lumps. Rest the batter for 10 minutes. Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat and lightly rub with a little butter. Pour a ladle of batter into the pan and swirl to coat; cook for about 45–60 seconds until the edges look set, then flip and cook another 20–30 seconds. Keep the finished blintzes covered with a clean towel while you repeat with the remaining batter. Stir the ricotta, Greek yogurt, honey, vanilla sugar, powdered erythritol, the remaining 1 g salt, and the berries together gently. Spoon the filling onto each crepe and fold into neat parcels. Warm a skillet with the remaining butter over medium-low heat and sear the folded blintzes for 2–3 minutes per side until lightly golden and heated through. Serve immediately with any extra berries or a spoon of Greek yogurt.

title: Whole-Wheat Ricotta Blintzes with Berries and Vanilla
ingredients_json: ["120 g whole-wheat flour", "2 pieces eggs, whole, raw", "400 ml low-fat milk (1.5% fat)", "10 g granulated sugar", "1 g salt", "10 g butter, unsalted", "200 g ricotta cheese, part-skim", "150 g plain low-fat Greek yogurt", "30 g honey", "5 g vanilla extract", "250 g mixed berries, fresh or frozen", "10 g powdered sugar"]
instructions: Whisk the whole-wheat flour, sugar, and salt in a bowl. Add the eggs and milk gradually, whisking until you have a smooth, pourable batter. Let the batter rest for 10 minutes. Heat a lightly buttered nonstick pan over medium heat and pour in about 60 ml batter per blintz, swirling to coat. Cook for about 1 minute until the edges look set, flip, and cook another 30–45 seconds. Repeat with the remaining batter, keeping the blintzes warm under a clean kitchen towel. Stir ricotta, Greek yogurt, honey, and vanilla until smooth, then spoon a line of filling into each blintz and fold in the sides, rolling into neat parcels. Heat the remaining butter in the pan over medium heat and sear the blintzes for 1–2 minutes per side until lightly golden. Serve warm with the berries warmed briefly in the pan for 2–3 minutes and a dusting of powdered sugar.

title: Whole-Grain Cottage Cheese Blintzes with Berry Compote
ingredients_json: ["120 g wheat flour, whole grain", "2 pieces eggs, raw", "250 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "1 tbsp olive oil", "200 g cottage cheese, low-fat", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "60 g honey", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 g ground cinnamon", "150 g blueberries, fresh or frozen", "30 g maple syrup", "10 g butter, unsalted", "2 g salt, table"]
instructions:
Whisk the whole-grain flour, eggs, milk, olive oil, and 1 g of the salt until you have a smooth batter with no lumps. Let the batter rest for 10 minutes. Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat and lightly butter it with a thin smear of the unsalted butter. Pour a small ladle of batter into the pan and swirl to coat, then cook for 1–2 minutes until the surface looks set and the edges lift easily. Flip and cook for another 30–60 seconds, then transfer to a plate and repeat until all blintz wrappers are done.

Mix the cottage cheese, Greek yogurt, honey, vanilla extract, cinnamon, and the remaining 1 g of salt to make a thick filling. Warm the blueberries in a small saucepan over medium heat with the maple syrup for 5–7 minutes until they burst and thicken slightly. Spoon the filling onto each blintz, fold into a tight packet, and place seam-side down. Warm the folded blintzes in the same pan over medium-low heat for 2–3 minutes per side until lightly golden and hot throughout. Serve immediately with the warm berry compote on top.

title: Spinach & Black Bean Breakfast Burritos with Salsa Verde and Scrambled Egg
ingredients_json: ["3 large eggs, whole, raw", "200 g potatoes, diced, raw", "150 g spinach, fresh", "120 g black beans, cooked, no added salt", "60 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2%", "120 g reduced-fat cheese, cheddar, shredded", "30 ml olive oil", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp fine salt", "0.25 tsp black pepper, ground", "240 g salsa verde, jarred", "4 large tortillas, whole wheat, 25 cm"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat. Add the diced potatoes and cook for 10–12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until tender and lightly golden. Add the cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, then stir well. Crack in the eggs and scramble with the potatoes until the eggs are just set. Stir in the spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes until wilted. Fold in the black beans and warm through for 1 minute. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30–60 seconds per side. Spread a thin layer of salsa verde and Greek yogurt on each tortilla, add the hot egg and bean mixture, sprinkle with the shredded reduced-fat cheese, then roll tightly. Serve immediately with additional salsa verde on the side.

title: Chicken & Veggie Breakfast Burritos with Spinach and Avocado Lime Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["160 g chicken breast, raw, cubed", "2 tbsp olive oil", "200 g bell pepper, red, diced", "120 g onion, yellow, diced", "120 g spinach, fresh", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1/2 tsp fine salt", "1/4 tsp black pepper, ground", "300 g eggs, whole, raw (about 6 large eggs)", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "60 g avocado, raw, mashed", "30 ml lime juice", "2 cloves garlic, fresh, minced", "6 pieces whole wheat tortillas, 25 cm"]
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of the olive oil in a large nonstick pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken, season with cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring often, until the chicken is no longer pink. Transfer the chicken to a plate and set aside. In the same pan, add the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil, then cook the onion and bell pepper for 5 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the spinach and cook until wilted, about 1 minute. Whisk the eggs and pour them into the pan, scrambling gently until just set, about 3 to 4 minutes. Return the chicken to the pan and mix everything together. In a bowl, stir the Greek yogurt with the mashed avocado and lime juice. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 20 to 30 seconds per side, then fill each tortilla with the egg and chicken mixture and top with the avocado lime yogurt. Fold tightly and serve warm.

title: Smoky Black Bean and Veggie Breakfast Burritos with Salsa Verde
ingredients_json: ["4 large tortillas, whole wheat", "250 g eggs", "200 g egg whites", "200 g black beans, canned, drained and rinsed", "180 g red bell pepper, diced", "120 g red onion, diced", "180 g baby spinach", "20 g olive oil", "10 g ground cumin", "5 g smoked paprika", "3 g garlic powder", "8 g salt", "5 g black pepper", "120 g salsa verde", "80 g reduced-fat cheddar cheese, grated", "30 g Greek yogurt, plain 2%"]
instructions: Heat 10 g of olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add the red onion and bell pepper and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened. Stir in the smoked paprika, ground cumin, and garlic powder, then add the black beans and cook for 2 minutes to warm through. Add the baby spinach and cook until wilted, about 1–2 minutes. In a bowl, whisk the whole eggs and egg whites with black pepper and a portion of the salt. Push the veggie mixture to the edges of the pan, pour in the egg mixture, and gently scramble until softly set, about 4–6 minutes. Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet for 15–20 seconds per side so they roll easily. Divide the egg and bean filling among the tortillas, top each with salsa verde and grated cheddar, then roll tightly. Serve with a spoonful of Greek yogurt on top or on the side.

title: Veggie and Turkey Breakfast Burritos with Cheddar-Lime Yogurt Sauce
ingredients_json: ["6 pieces Eggs, whole, raw", "250 g Turkey breast, ground, 93% lean", "200 g Bell pepper, red", "150 g Onion, yellow", "200 g Black beans, canned, drained and rinsed", "30 ml Olive oil", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp Salt, table salt", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "6 pieces Flour tortilla, whole wheat, 20 cm", "100 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat 2%", "50 g Cheddar cheese, reduced fat", "1 piece Lime, juice"]
instructions: Heat 15 ml of olive oil in a large nonstick pan over medium heat. Add the diced onion and bell pepper and cook for 6–8 minutes until softened and lightly browned. Stir in the ground turkey and cook for 8–10 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until no pink remains. Add cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, then fold in the black beans and warm through for 2–3 minutes. In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs and pour them into the pan. Cook, stirring gently, for 3–5 minutes until the eggs are set but still tender. Mix the Greek yogurt with the lime juice and fold in the reduced-fat cheddar until smooth. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 20–30 seconds per side. Divide the turkey-egg filling evenly between tortillas, spoon the yogurt-cheddar sauce over the top, and roll up tightly before serving.

title: Spinach & Feta Egg Breakfast Casserole with Roasted Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["500 g cherry tomatoes", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp dried oregano", "250 g eggs, raw", "200 g egg whites, pasteurized", "200 g low-fat cottage cheese", "120 g feta cheese, reduced fat", "180 g baby spinach", "1 clove garlic", "30 g wholegrain bread, wholemeal, dried cubes", "1 tsp sea salt", "1/2 tsp black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 190°C. Place the cherry tomatoes in a baking dish, drizzle with olive oil, add oregano, and roast for 15 minutes until they begin to burst and caramelize at the edges. In a bowl, whisk the eggs, egg whites, cottage cheese, and minced garlic until smooth. Stir in the spinach and fold in the feta. Toss the wholemeal bread cubes into the egg mixture so they soak slightly. Pour everything over the roasted tomatoes, season with sea salt and black pepper, and bake for 28–32 minutes until the center is set and the top is lightly golden. Let the casserole rest for 5 minutes before slicing so it holds together.

title: Spinach & Feta Breakfast Casserole with Roasted Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["6 piece Egg, raw", "250 g Egg whites, liquid", "200 g Feta cheese, reduced-fat", "300 g Baby spinach, raw", "250 g Cherry tomatoes", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1 tsp Garlic powder", "120 g Rolled oats", "350 ml Skimmed milk", "10 g Chia seeds", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 190°C. Toss the cherry tomatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil, oregano, and half the garlic powder, then spread them on a baking tray and roast for 12 minutes until they blister. Meanwhile, wilt the baby spinach in a nonstick pan over medium heat for 2–3 minutes, then remove from the heat and cool slightly. In a large bowl, whisk the eggs and egg whites with the skimmed milk, remaining garlic powder, and pepper. Stir in the oats and chia seeds and let the mixture sit for 5 minutes to thicken. Fold in the wilted spinach and crumble the feta into the mixture. Pour the casserole base into a greased baking dish, spoon the roasted tomatoes on top, and bake for 30–35 minutes until the center is set and the top is lightly golden. Rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving so the casserole holds together.

title: Veggie & Smoked Salmon Breakfast Casserole with Creamy Egg and Dill
ingredients_json: ["8 piece Egg, whole, raw", "250 g Smoked salmon", "200 g Courgette, raw", "150 g Baby spinach", "120 g Low-fat cottage cheese, 2% fat", "100 g Red bell pepper, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Dried dill", "1 g Ground black pepper", "2 g Salt", "60 ml Semi-skimmed milk, 2%"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C. Dice the courgette and red bell pepper, then lightly sauté them in olive oil for 6–8 minutes until they soften and any excess moisture starts to cook off. Wilt the spinach in the pan for 1 minute, then stir in the dried dill and let the vegetables cool slightly. In a large bowl, whisk the eggs with the semi-skimmed milk, salt, and black pepper, then mix in the cottage cheese until smooth. Fold in the smoked salmon and the sautéed vegetables. Pour everything into a greased baking dish and bake for 28–34 minutes, until the casserole is set in the center and the top looks lightly golden. Let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Smoky Turkey, Spinach & Feta Breakfast Casserole with Oats
ingredients_json: ["250 g egg, whole, raw", "400 g turkey mince, lean", "300 g rolled oats", "300 g low-fat milk, 1.5% fat", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "200 g spinach, fresh", "150 g bell pepper, red", "120 g onion, yellow", "120 g feta cheese, reduced fat", "20 g olive oil", "2 tsp ground cumin", "2 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp garlic powder", "3 g fine salt", "2 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 190°C. Dice the onion and bell pepper, and chop the spinach. Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat and cook the turkey mince for 7–9 minutes until it is browned and fully cooked, breaking it up into small pieces. Stir in the onion and bell pepper and cook for 4 minutes, then add the cumin, smoked paprika, oregano and garlic powder and cook for 30 seconds more. In a bowl, mix the eggs, milk and Greek yogurt, then fold in the oats. Stir the turkey mixture and chopped spinach through the oat mixture, and season with salt and black pepper. Spread everything into a lightly greased baking dish (about 30×20 cm) and crumble the feta on top. Bake for 35–40 minutes until set in the center and lightly golden. Rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Spinach & Turkey Breakfast Casserole with Feta and Oats
ingredients_json: ["500 g turkey mince, lean (5-8% fat)", "200 g oats, rolled", "250 ml milk, semi-skimmed (1.5% fat)", "6 piece eggs, whole", "200 g spinach, fresh", "150 g feta cheese, reduced-fat", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp ground black pepper", "10 g olive oil", "5 g salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 190°C. Dice the onion and mince the garlic, then sauté them in the olive oil over medium heat for 4–5 minutes until softened. Stir in the turkey mince and cook for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon until no pink remains. Wilt the spinach in the pan for 1–2 minutes, then remove from the heat. In a mixing bowl, whisk the eggs with the semi-skimmed milk, oregano, black pepper, and salt. Combine the oats with the cooked turkey mixture and pour in the egg-and-milk mixture, mixing until the oats are evenly distributed. Crumble the feta over the top. Transfer everything to a greased baking dish and bake for 30–35 minutes, until the center is set and the casserole is lightly golden. Let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Crispy Skillet Breakfast Potatoes with Spinach, Feta & Smoked Paprika
ingredients_json: ["450 g potatoes, raw, scrubbed", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, yellow, raw", "1 clove garlic, raw", "150 g spinach, raw", "80 g feta cheese, reduced-fat", "2 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp ground black pepper", "0.5 tsp fine salt", "2 tbsp plain Greek yogurt, low-fat"]
instructions: Dice the potatoes into 1 cm cubes and pat them dry. Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, then add the potatoes and spread them out in an even layer. Cook for 12–15 minutes, stirring every 3–4 minutes, until the edges turn golden and you can easily pierce a cube with a fork. Add the diced onion and cook for 5 minutes, then stir in the garlic and smoked paprika for 30 seconds, until fragrant. Lower the heat to medium and add the spinach; cook for 2–3 minutes until wilted. Crumble the feta over the potatoes and cook for 1 minute to soften it. Season with black pepper and fine salt. Serve warm with a spoon of low-fat Greek yogurt on top.

title: Crispy Oven Breakfast Potatoes with Spinach, Feta & Chives
ingredients_json: ["700 g potatoes, raw, white", "15 ml olive oil, extra virgin", "1 piece onion, white", "150 g spinach, fresh", "120 g feta cheese, reduced-fat", "2 piece eggs, whole, raw", "10 g chives, fresh", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 tsp smoked paprika, ground"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C. Cut the potatoes into small, even cubes and place them on a baking tray. Toss with the olive oil, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, then spread into a single layer. Roast for 25 minutes, stirring once halfway through, until the edges look golden and crisp. Meanwhile, thinly slice the onion and quickly wilt it in a hot pan for 3–4 minutes with a splash of water; add the spinach and cook until just wilted. In a bowl, whisk the eggs. Stir the wilted onion-spinach mixture into the roasted potatoes, then crumble the feta over the top and pour the whisked eggs evenly across. Return to the oven for 8–10 minutes, until the eggs are set but still slightly soft. Finish with chopped chives and serve hot.

title: Crispy Sheet-Pan Breakfast Potatoes with Smoked Paprika and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["600 g potatoes, all-purpose, raw", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "200 g spinach, fresh", "30 g olive oil", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp ground black pepper", "1 tsp dried oregano", "2 g fine salt", "60 g feta cheese, crumbled", "2 tbsp plain Greek yogurt, 2% fat"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C. Cut the potatoes into small 1 cm cubes, then peel the onion and dice it finely. Toss the potatoes and onion with the olive oil, smoked paprika, black pepper, dried oregano, and salt, and spread them on a large baking tray in a single layer. Roast for 25 minutes, stirring once halfway through, until the edges look crisp and golden. Meanwhile, mince the garlic and wilt the spinach in a hot pan for about 2 minutes, just until it collapses. Stir the garlic into the roasted potatoes for the last 2 minutes, then add the spinach and fold everything together. Serve topped with crumbled feta and a spoonful of Greek yogurt, so the potatoes stay crisp while the cheese softens.

title: Crispy Oven Breakfast Potatoes with Smoked Paprika and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["400 g potatoes, white, scrubbed, diced 2 cm", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp garlic powder", "0.25 tsp fine salt", "0.25 tsp black pepper, ground", "150 g bell pepper, red, diced", "80 g onion, yellow, diced", "120 g spinach, fresh", "3 piece eggs, whole, raw", "30 g feta cheese, crumbled"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C. In a large bowl, toss the diced potatoes with the olive oil, smoked paprika, oregano, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper until well coated. Spread the potatoes on a baking tray in a single layer and roast for 25 minutes, turning once halfway, until the edges look golden and the potatoes are tender. Add the onion and bell pepper to the tray, then roast for another 10 minutes until the vegetables soften. Stir the spinach into the hot potatoes and vegetables just until wilted, about 1–2 minutes, then make three small wells. Crack the eggs into the wells, sprinkle the feta over the top, and return to the oven for 8–10 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks are just cooked to your liking. Rest for 2 minutes before serving.

title: Whole Wheat Cinnamon Rolls with Greek Yogurt Glaze
ingredients_json: ["250 g whole wheat flour", "7 g instant yeast", "30 g light brown sugar", "5 g ground cinnamon", "1 g fine salt", "60 g unsalted butter", "240 ml milk, low-fat (1.5%)", "1 piece egg, raw", "30 g raisins", "80 g Greek yogurt, plain (2%)", "10 g icing sugar", "1 g vanilla extract"]
instructions: Warm the milk to about 35–38°C so it feels comfortably warm, not hot. In a bowl, mix the whole wheat flour, instant yeast, light brown sugar, cinnamon, and salt. Add the melted butter and the egg, then pour in the warm milk and mix until you have a soft, slightly sticky dough. Knead for 8–10 minutes on a lightly floured surface until smooth and elastic, then cover and let it rise for 45–60 minutes, or until doubled in size. Roll the dough into a rectangle about 30x40 cm, spread raisins evenly, and sprinkle a thin layer of extra cinnamon across the surface. Roll up tightly from the long side and cut into 8 evenly sized rolls. Place the rolls in a lightly greased baking dish and cover again, letting them rise for 20 minutes while you heat the oven to 190°C. Bake for 18–22 minutes until golden and cooked through; the centers should no longer look doughy. Stir Greek yogurt with icing sugar and vanilla extract, then drizzle over the slightly cooled rolls for a tangy glaze.

title: Whole-Grain Cinnamon Rolls with Greek Yogurt Vanilla Glaze
ingredients_json: ["250 g plain wheat flour, wholegrain", "50 g plain wheat flour, white", "7 g dry yeast", "30 g erythritol", "5 g ground cinnamon", "3 g fine salt", "200 ml milk, low-fat", "60 g unsalted butter", "1 piece egg, raw", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "80 g brown sugar", "20 g ground cinnamon", "30 g butter, melted", "1 ml vanilla extract"]
instructions: Warm the low-fat milk until it feels lukewarm (about body temperature), then whisk in the dry yeast and 10 g of the erythritol until foamy begins to form after 5 minutes. In a mixing bowl, combine the wholegrain flour, white flour, remaining erythritol, ground cinnamon, and salt. Add the egg and melted butter to the yeast mixture, then pour everything into the dry ingredients and knead for 8–10 minutes until the dough is smooth and elastic. Cover and let the dough rise in a warm place for 45–60 minutes, until doubled in size. Roll the dough into a rectangle about 30x40 cm, brush with the melted butter, and sprinkle evenly with brown sugar and the 20 g ground cinnamon. Roll up tightly and slice into 10 rolls. Place the rolls in a lined baking dish, cover, and let them rise again for 15–20 minutes. Bake at 180°C for 18–22 minutes until golden and cooked through. While baking, stir the Greek yogurt with vanilla extract and a small spoon of the remaining cinnamon for a tangy glaze. Let the cinnamon rolls cool for 5 minutes, then spoon the yogurt glaze over the warm rolls and serve.

title: Whole-Wheat Cinnamon Rolls with Greek Yogurt Filling
ingredients_json: ["280 g whole wheat flour", "7 g instant yeast", "60 g unsalted butter", "200 ml low-fat milk (2%)", "1 piece egg, whole", "50 g plain Greek yogurt, low-fat", "40 g brown sugar", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "2 g salt", "30 g raisins", "120 g cream cheese, reduced-fat", "1 tbsp milk, low-fat (2%)"]
instructions: Warm the low-fat milk until it is lukewarm (about 35–38°C), then stir in the instant yeast and 10 g of the brown sugar. In a bowl, combine the whole wheat flour and salt, add the yeast mixture, the egg, the Greek yogurt, and melted (but not hot) butter. Knead until smooth and elastic, about 8–10 minutes, then cover and let rise in a warm place for 45–60 minutes, until doubled in size. Roll the dough into a rectangle about 30 x 40 cm. Spread the reduced-fat cream cheese over the dough, sprinkle with cinnamon and the remaining brown sugar, and scatter the raisins evenly. Roll up tightly from the long side, then cut into 8 equal slices. Place the slices in a lightly greased baking dish and cover, letting them rise for 20 minutes. Bake at 190°C for 18–22 minutes, until the rolls are golden and the centers look set. For a softer top, brush with 1 tbsp low-fat milk right after baking, then cool for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Whole-Wheat Cinnamon Rolls with Greek Yogurt Glaze
ingredients_json: ["300 g whole-wheat flour", "10 g instant yeast", "50 g granulated sugar", "1 g salt", "60 g unsalted butter", "200 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "1 large egg, raw", "80 g brown sugar", "15 g ground cinnamon", "250 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "20 g honey", "5 g vanilla extract"]
instructions: Warm the milk to about 35–38°C and stir in the instant yeast until it looks slightly foamy. In a large bowl, mix the whole-wheat flour, granulated sugar, and salt, then add the egg and melted butter. Pour in the warm milk and mix until a soft dough forms, then knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover and let the dough rise in a warm place for 45–60 minutes, until it has doubled in size. Roll the dough out on a lightly floured surface into a rectangle about 5 mm thick. Spread the softened butter over the dough, then sprinkle evenly with the brown sugar and ground cinnamon. Roll up tightly, slice into 8–10 rolls, and place them in a greased baking dish. Cover and let them rise for 20–25 minutes while you preheat the oven to 190°C. Bake for 18–22 minutes, until golden and cooked through; the centers should not look doughy. While they bake, whisk the Greek yogurt with honey and vanilla extract until smooth. Let the rolls cool for 5 minutes, then drizzle with the yogurt glaze and serve warm.

title: Whole Wheat Cinnamon Rolls with Greek Yogurt Vanilla Glaze
ingredients_json: ["300 g plain flour, whole wheat", "7 g instant yeast", "40 g light brown sugar", "5 g ground cinnamon", "2 g fine salt", "220 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "1 piece egg, raw", "30 g butter, unsalted", "170 g Greek yogurt, low fat", "20 g honey", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "30 g butter, unsalted (for filling)", "30 g brown sugar (for filling)", "8 g ground cinnamon (for filling)"]
instructions: Warm the semi-skimmed milk until lukewarm (about 35–38°C). In a large bowl, mix the whole wheat flour, instant yeast, 40 g light brown sugar, ground cinnamon, and salt. Add the egg and melted lukewarm butter, then pour in the milk and mix until a soft, slightly sticky dough forms. Knead for 8–10 minutes until the dough is smooth and elastic, then cover and let it rise in a warm place for 45–60 minutes, until doubled in size. Roll the dough out into a rectangle about 3–5 mm thick. Spread the 30 g butter for the filling evenly over the surface, then sprinkle over the 30 g brown sugar and 8 g cinnamon for filling. Roll the dough tightly from the long side, slice into 8 equal rolls, and place them cut-side up in a lightly greased baking dish. Let them proof for 20 minutes while you preheat the oven to 190°C. Bake for 18–22 minutes, until golden and cooked through. While the rolls bake, stir the low-fat Greek yogurt with honey and vanilla extract to make a thick glaze. Drizzle the glaze over the warm rolls right after baking and serve after 5 minutes so the glaze sets slightly.

title: Wholemeal Banana Oat Coffee Cakes with Cinnamon Swirl
ingredients_json: ["200 g rolled oats", "120 g wholemeal flour", "2 tsp baking powder", "0.5 tsp baking soda", "1.5 tsp ground cinnamon", "100 g brown sugar", "2 piece eggs, raw", "180 g mashed banana (ripe)", "120 ml milk, low-fat (1.5% fat)", "60 ml plain yogurt, low-fat", "60 ml rapeseed oil", "1 tbsp vanilla extract", "20 g walnuts, chopped"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 180°C and line a muffin tin (or a small loaf pan) with paper cases or parchment. In a large bowl, mix the rolled oats, wholemeal flour, baking powder, baking soda, 1 tsp of the cinnamon, and the brown sugar. In a second bowl, whisk the eggs, mashed banana, low-fat milk, low-fat yogurt, rapeseed oil, and vanilla extract until smooth. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir just until a thick batter forms; do not overmix. Fold in the chopped walnuts, then spoon the batter into the tin, filling each cup about two-thirds full. Combine the remaining cinnamon with a small amount of the brown sugar (from the listed amount) and sprinkle lightly over the top for a cinnamon swirl effect. Bake for 18–22 minutes for muffins (or 35–40 minutes for a loaf), until the tops are golden and a skewer inserted in the center comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs. Cool for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Whole-Grain Blueberry Coffee Cakes with Greek Yogurt and Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["220 g whole wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "60 g rolled almonds, finely chopped", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "120 g milk, semi-skimmed", "2 piece eggs, whole, raw", "80 g honey", "70 g unsalted butter", "10 g baking powder", "5 g ground cinnamon", "2 g fine salt", "250 g blueberries, fresh", "1 piece orange, zest"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a loaf pan (or an 8-inch baking dish) with baking paper. In a large bowl, mix the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, chopped almonds, baking powder, ground cinnamon, and salt. In a second bowl, whisk the eggs with the honey, then whisk in the Greek yogurt, milk, melted butter, and orange zest until smooth. Fold the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients just until no dry flour remains. Gently fold in the blueberries. Spread the batter evenly into the prepared pan and bake for 35–40 minutes, until the top is golden and a skewer inserted into the center comes out mostly clean with a few moist crumbs. Let the coffee cake cool for at least 10 minutes before slicing so it sets properly.

title: Whole-Grain Greek Yogurt Blueberry Coffee Cake with Cinnamon Streusel
ingredients_json: ["200 g plain Greek yogurt, low-fat", "2 piece eggs, whole, raw", "120 g whole wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "120 g mixed blueberries, fresh or frozen", "60 g honey", "80 ml rapeseed oil", "10 g baking powder", "5 g ground cinnamon", "2 g fine salt", "30 g almonds, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a small baking pan (about 20 x 20 cm) with baking paper. In a large bowl, whisk the Greek yogurt, eggs, honey, and rapeseed oil until smooth. Stir in the whole wheat flour, oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt, mixing just until the batter looks thick and evenly combined. Fold in the blueberries and spoon the batter into the prepared pan. Sprinkle the chopped almonds over the top. Bake for 30–35 minutes, until the cake is golden and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out mostly clean with a few moist crumbs. Let it cool for 10 minutes before slicing; it should be firm enough to hold its shape.

title: Greek Yogurt Banana Oat Coffee Cakes with Cinnamon Swirl
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "160 g banana, ripe, mashed", "2 piece egg, raw", "80 g honey", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp baking soda", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "60 g unsalted butter", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 180°C and line a muffin tin or a small loaf pan with baking paper. In a blender or food processor, pulse the rolled oats until they become a coarse oat flour. In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, honey, Greek yogurt, mashed banana, and melted butter until smooth. Stir in the oat flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt, mixing until you no longer see dry oat. Divide the batter into the pan, then bake for 18–22 minutes for muffins or 35–40 minutes for a loaf, until the tops are golden and a skewer comes out clean. Let cool for at least 10 minutes before serving so the coffee cakes set properly.

title: Skillet Cornbread with Greek Yogurt and Cheddar
ingredients_json: ["180 g cornmeal (polenta)", "60 g whole-wheat flour", "100 g plain Greek yogurt, nonfat", "2 pieces eggs, whole", "2 dl milk, skimmed", "50 g cheddar cheese, reduced-fat", "1 tbsp honey", "1 tsp baking powder", "0.5 tsp baking soda", "1 tsp salt", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp ground black pepper"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C. In a large bowl, whisk together the cornmeal, whole-wheat flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and ground black pepper. In a second bowl, whisk the eggs, skimmed milk, Greek yogurt and honey until smooth, then stir the wet mixture into the dry ingredients just until no dry flour remains. Fold in the reduced-fat cheddar and let the batter sit for 5 minutes so the cornmeal hydrates. Heat the olive oil in a small oven-safe skillet over medium heat, then pour in the batter and spread it evenly. Bake for 18–22 minutes, until the top is golden and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out mostly clean. Let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing so it sets.

title: Whole-Grain Cornbread Muffins with Greek Yogurt and Blueberries
ingredients_json: ["120 g cornmeal (fine)", "80 g whole-wheat flour", "60 g rolled oats", "2 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp baking soda", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "2 g fine salt", "2 large eggs", "200 g low-fat Greek yogurt", "120 ml milk, 1% fat", "60 ml maple syrup", "60 ml olive oil", "150 g blueberries, fresh", "20 g flaxseed, ground"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 190°C and line a muffin tin with paper cases. In a large bowl, mix the cornmeal, whole-wheat flour, oats, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon and salt. In a second bowl, whisk the eggs, Greek yogurt, milk, maple syrup and olive oil until smooth. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir just until no dry flour remains, then fold in the blueberries and ground flaxseed. Divide the batter between the muffin cups and bake for 16–20 minutes, until the tops are lightly golden and a toothpick comes out mostly clean with a few moist crumbs. Let the muffins cool for 5 minutes in the tin, then transfer to a rack to cool slightly before eating.

title: Whole-Grain Cornbread Skillet with Greek Yogurt and Honey
ingredients_json: ["160 g yellow cornmeal", "60 g whole wheat flour", "2 tsp baking powder", "0.5 tsp fine salt", "2 tbsp honey", "1 large egg", "240 g plain Greek yogurt, nonfat", "250 ml low-fat milk, 1%", "60 g unsalted butter, melted", "1 tbsp olive oil", "120 g blueberries, fresh"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C and lightly grease a small ovenproof skillet. In a large bowl, whisk together the cornmeal, whole wheat flour, baking powder, and salt. In another bowl, whisk the honey, egg, Greek yogurt, milk, melted butter, and olive oil until smooth. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir just until no large dry pockets remain; fold in the blueberries gently. Transfer the batter to the skillet and bake for 18–22 minutes, until the top is lightly golden and a toothpick in the center comes out mostly clean with a few moist crumbs. Let the cornbread cool in the pan for 5 minutes, then slice and serve warm.

title: Skillet Cornbread with Greek Yogurt, Berries & a Light Honey Drizzle
ingredients_json: ["120 g fine cornmeal", "80 g whole wheat flour", "10 g baking powder", "2 g fine salt", "2 g ground cinnamon", "120 g plain Greek yogurt, nonfat", "60 ml honey", "2 piece egg, raw", "200 ml buttermilk, low-fat", "30 ml olive oil", "150 g blueberries, fresh", "15 g chia seeds"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C and place an oven-safe skillet inside to warm. In a large bowl, whisk together the cornmeal, whole wheat flour, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon. In a second bowl, whisk the Greek yogurt, honey, eggs, buttermilk, and olive oil until smooth. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir just until no dry pockets remain; the batter should be thick. Gently fold in the blueberries and chia seeds. Carefully remove the hot skillet, lightly coat if needed, then pour in the batter. Bake for 20–25 minutes, or until the top is golden and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs. Let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving so it sets properly.

title: Whole-Grain Smoked Salmon & Dill Danish with Greek Yogurt Cream
ingredients_json: ["1 tbsp 7 g instant yeast", "250 g whole-grain wheat flour", "150 ml low-fat milk (1%)", "60 g Greek yogurt (0% fat)", "60 g unsalted butter", "1 piece egg", "60 ml water", "2 g fine salt", "2 g dried dill", "2 g black pepper", "120 g smoked salmon", "1 tbsp 15 ml lemon juice", "1 tbsp 10 g chia seeds"]
instructions: Warm the milk and water to lukewarm (about 30–35°C). In a bowl, mix the yeast with the milk mixture and let it stand for 2 minutes. Add the whole-grain wheat flour, salt, dried dill, black pepper, the egg, Greek yogurt, and 30 g of the butter. Knead until you have a smooth, elastic dough, then cover and let it rise for 45 minutes until puffy. Roll the dough out into a rectangle about 5 mm thick, spread the remaining 30 g butter in thin streaks, fold the dough in thirds, and roll again into a rectangle. Cut 8 small rectangles, then make a shallow score in the center and tuck the edges slightly to form a danish-like shape. Place them on a lined tray and proof for 15 minutes. Bake at 200°C for 12–15 minutes until golden. Meanwhile, mix smoked salmon with lemon juice and chia seeds. Let the danishes cool for 5 minutes, then top with the salmon mixture and serve warm.

title: Baked Wholegrain Doughnuts with Greek Yogurt and Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholegrain spelt flour", "120 g low-fat Greek yogurt", "2 pc eggs, raw", "60 g rapeseed oil", "80 g honey", "7 g baking powder", "3 g ground cinnamon", "1 g fine salt", "80 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "1 tsp vanilla extract"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 180°C and grease a doughnut tin well (or line it). In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the honey, milk, Greek yogurt, oil, vanilla extract, and cinnamon until smooth. In a second bowl, mix the wholegrain spelt flour, baking powder, and salt. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and stir just until you have a thick, spoonable batter with no dry pockets. Divide the batter into the doughnut moulds and bake for 10–12 minutes, until the doughnuts are lightly golden and spring back when gently pressed. Let them cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then move to a rack and cool completely before serving.

title: Baked Oat Doughnuts with Greek Yogurt Glaze and Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["150 g rolled oats", "2 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 pinch salt", "2 large eggs", "120 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "60 g honey", "60 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "30 ml sunflower oil", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "120 g Greek yogurt, low-fat (for glaze)", "30 g icing sugar (for glaze)", "1 tsp lemon juice (for glaze)"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 190°C and grease a doughnut tin well. Blend the rolled oats into a fine flour, then mix it with baking powder, ground cinnamon and salt in a bowl. In another bowl whisk the eggs with the Greek yogurt, honey, milk, sunflower oil and vanilla extract until smooth. Fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir just until you have a thick batter. Spoon the batter into the doughnut moulds, filling each about two-thirds full, then bake for 10–13 minutes until the doughnuts are set and lightly golden at the edges and spring back when touched. Let them cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely. For the glaze, whisk the Greek yogurt with icing sugar and lemon juice until smooth. Drizzle over the cooled doughnuts and allow the glaze to set for about 5 minutes before serving.

title: Baked Oat-Carrot Doughnuts with Yogurt Vanilla Glaze
ingredients_json: ["200 g rolled oats, finely ground", "120 g whole-wheat pastry flour", "2 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "2 g fine salt", "2 large eggs", "150 g Greek yogurt, 2% fat", "120 g grated carrot, raw", "80 ml maple syrup", "60 ml rapeseed oil", "2 tsp vanilla extract", "80 g low-fat cream cheese", "30 g powdered sugar", "15 ml lemon juice"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and lightly grease a doughnut tray (or a muffin tin) with rapeseed oil. In a large bowl, mix the ground oats, whole-wheat pastry flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. In another bowl, whisk the eggs with the Greek yogurt, grated carrot, maple syrup, rapeseed oil, and vanilla extract until smooth. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir just until you have a thick batter with no dry pockets. Spoon the batter into the doughnut moulds, filling them about 3/4 full, then bake for 12–15 minutes until the doughnuts spring back when lightly pressed and a toothpick comes out mostly clean. Let them cool in the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely. Meanwhile, make the glaze by mixing the low-fat cream cheese with powdered sugar and lemon juice until smooth; add a tiny splash of water if needed for a pourable consistency. Drizzle the glaze over the cooled doughnuts and allow it to set for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Baked Oatmeal Doughnuts with Apple Cinnamon Glaze
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "2 tsp baking powder", "1 pinch salt", "2 large eggs", "120 g plain low-fat Greek yogurt", "80 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "60 ml rapeseed oil", "120 g unsweetened applesauce", "120 g plain wholemeal flour", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "2 tbsp honey", "1 tbsp lemon juice"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C and lightly oil a doughnut tray (or use a nonstick donut pan). Blend the rolled oats into a fine oat flour, then mix it in a bowl with the cinnamon, baking powder, salt, and wholemeal flour. In a second bowl, whisk the eggs with the Greek yogurt, semi-skimmed milk, rapeseed oil, applesauce, and vanilla extract until smooth. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir just until you no longer see dry flour. Spoon the batter into the doughnut cavities, filling each about two-thirds full. Bake for 10–12 minutes, until the doughnuts are lightly golden and spring back when touched. While they bake, stir the honey with lemon juice to make a quick glaze. Let the doughnuts cool for 5 minutes in the tin, then transfer to a rack and drizzle with the glaze once they’re warm but not hot.

title: Baked Oat and Banana Doughnuts with Cinnamon Glaze
ingredients_json: ["150 g rolled oats", "1 medium egg", "150 g plain low-fat Greek yogurt", "1 medium banana, ripe", "60 g unsweetened applesauce", "8 g baking powder", "2 g ground cinnamon", "40 g honey", "10 ml vanilla extract", "5 g fine salt", "30 g unsalted butter", "120 ml semi-skimmed milk", "20 g powdered sugar", "15 g lemon juice"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 180°C and lightly grease a doughnut tin. Blend the rolled oats into a flour and combine it in a bowl with baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. In another bowl, mash the banana thoroughly and whisk in the egg, Greek yogurt, applesauce, honey, vanilla, and melted butter, then stir in the milk until smooth. Fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients just until no dry flour remains, then spoon the batter into the doughnut cavities, filling each about two-thirds full. Bake for 12–15 minutes until the doughnuts spring back when lightly pressed and the edges are lightly golden. Let them cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then move to a rack to cool completely. For the glaze, stir powdered sugar with lemon juice until pourable, then drizzle over the cooled doughnuts and let set for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Wholegrain English Muffins with Smoked Salmon, Avocado & Poached Egg
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces English muffins, wholemeal", "120 g smoked salmon", "2 pieces egg, raw", "1 medium avocado, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "10 g fresh chives", "1 tsp lemon juice", "0.5 tsp black pepper", "2 g sea salt"]
instructions: Slice the English muffins in half and toast them in a dry pan over medium heat until golden, about 2–3 minutes per cut side. Heat a small non-stick pan with the olive oil over low heat for gently poaching the eggs. Crack the eggs into the pan, add a little sea salt and black pepper, and cook until the whites are set and the yolks are still slightly runny, about 3–4 minutes depending on your heat. Scoop the avocado flesh into a bowl and mash it with lemon juice and a pinch of salt until creamy. Spread the avocado on the toasted muffins, top with smoked salmon, then place the poached egg on top. Finish with chopped chives and a little extra black pepper.

title: Wholemeal English Muffins with Smoked Salmon, Cream Cheese & Spinach
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces English muffins, wholemeal", "180 g smoked salmon", "120 g cream cheese, low-fat", "60 g spinach, fresh", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 g black pepper, ground", "2 g sea salt"]
instructions: Toast the wholemeal English muffins until crisp and lightly browned. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat and wilt the spinach for 1–2 minutes, stirring until just soft. In the same pan, crack the egg and cook it gently until the white is set but the yolk is still runny, about 3–4 minutes. Spread the low-fat cream cheese over the toasted muffins, then layer on the warm spinach, smoked salmon, and the cooked egg. Finish with black pepper and serve immediately.

title: Wholemeal English Muffin Breakfast Sandwich with Avocado, Egg and Tomato
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces Wholemeal English muffins", "3 pieces Egg, whole, raw", "1 piece Avocado, raw", "150 g Tomato, raw", "20 g Low fat spread, type unspecified", "1 g Salt, table salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "20 g Reduced-fat cheese, hard, e.g., reduced-fat Cheddar"]
instructions: Halve the wholemeal English muffins and toast them in a toaster or under a grill until they are lightly browned. Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium heat and crack in the eggs. Cook for about 3 to 4 minutes, turning to your preference, until the whites are set and the yolks are cooked to your liking. While the eggs cook, mash the avocado with the black pepper in a bowl and spread it generously over the toasted muffin halves. Slice the tomato and place the slices on top of the avocado. Add the cooked eggs, then grate or layer the reduced-fat cheese over the hot eggs so it starts to soften. Finish by adding a small pinch of salt, then close the sandwiches and serve immediately.

title: Wholewheat English Muffins with Egg, Spinach and Tomato
ingredients_json: ["4 piece English muffin, wholemeal", "3 piece Egg, whole, raw", "150 g Low-fat Greek yogurt", "80 g Spinach, fresh", "120 g Tomato, fresh", "10 g Olive oil", "5 g Chia seeds, whole", "2 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Halve the wholemeal English muffins and toast them in a dry pan or toaster until lightly browned. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat, then add the spinach and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until wilted. Chop the tomato and add it to the pan for another 2 minutes, stirring so it softens slightly. Crack the eggs into the pan and scramble gently, keeping the heat medium so the eggs set without drying out. Stir in the chia seeds for about 30 seconds. Spread the low-fat Greek yogurt over the toasted muffins, spoon the egg and spinach mixture on top, and season with salt and black pepper. Serve while warm.

title: Whole-Grain English Muffins with Smoked Salmon, Avocado and Soft Scrambled Eggs
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces English muffins, whole grain", "4 pieces Egg, raw", "200 g Smoked salmon", "1 piece Avocado, raw", "30 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 g Salt", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Split the whole-grain English muffins and toast them in a toaster or in a dry pan over medium heat until lightly golden, about 2–3 minutes per side. Crack the eggs into a bowl, whisk with the Greek yogurt, salt, and black pepper, then heat the olive oil in a nonstick pan over low to medium heat. Pour in the egg mixture and stir gently with a spatula, keeping the heat moderate so the eggs stay soft and creamy, about 4–6 minutes, until just set. While the eggs cook, scoop the avocado flesh and mash it lightly with a fork. Assemble the breakfast by spreading avocado over the toasted muffin halves, topping with smoked salmon, and finishing with the soft scrambled eggs. Serve immediately while the eggs are still warm and glossy.

title: Whole-Grain French Toast with Cinnamon, Berries, and Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["4 slices whole-grain bread", "2 large eggs", "2 dl milk, semi-skimmed", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tbsp honey", "200 g mixed berries", "10 g unsalted butter", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Whisk the eggs, semi-skimmed milk, cinnamon, honey, and salt in a bowl until smooth. Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium heat and melt the butter. Dip each bread slice into the egg mixture for about 20–30 seconds per side so it soaks through but doesn’t fall apart. Cook the slices in the pan for 2–3 minutes per side, until golden-brown and set in the middle. Serve the French toast immediately topped with the mixed berries and a spoonful of Greek yogurt.

title: Wholegrain French Toast with Cinnamon Apple and Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["4 slices whole grain bread", "2 piece eggs, raw", "250 g low-fat milk", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "1 piece apple, with skin", "1 tbsp rapeseed oil", "1 tbsp honey", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Slice the apple into thin pieces and stir it with half the cinnamon. Whisk the eggs, milk, remaining cinnamon, and salt in a shallow bowl until smooth. Heat the rapeseed oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Dip each slice of wholegrain bread into the egg mixture for about 10–20 seconds per side so it absorbs without becoming mushy, then place it in the pan and cook for about 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. In the last minute, add the apple pieces to the pan and let them warm and soften, turning them once. Serve the French toast warm with a dollop of Greek yogurt and drizzle with honey.

title: Wholemeal Banana French Toast with Cinnamon and Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["4 slices wholemeal bread", "2 piece eggs, raw", "200 g 0% plain Greek yogurt", "1 piece banana, ripe", "150 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 g fine salt"]
instructions: Slice the bananas and mash them in a bowl until mostly smooth. Whisk the eggs, milk, Greek yogurt, cinnamon, vanilla extract, and salt together, then fold in the mashed banana. Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium heat and add the olive oil. Dip each slice of wholemeal bread into the banana-egg mixture for about 10–15 seconds per side so it absorbs but doesn’t fall apart, then place it in the pan. Cook for 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through in the middle. Serve warm with any remaining banana mixture from the bowl, and let it rest for 1 minute before eating so the custard sets.

title: Wholemeal French Toast with Greek Yogurt, Berries and Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["6 slices wholemeal bread", "3 large eggs, raw", "300 g low-fat Greek yogurt", "2 dl semi-skimmed milk", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "30 g honey", "200 g mixed berries", "10 g unsalted butter"]
instructions: Crack the eggs into a shallow bowl and whisk them with the milk, Greek yogurt, vanilla extract and cinnamon until smooth. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and melt the butter. Dip each slice of wholemeal bread into the egg mixture for about 20–30 seconds per side, letting the bread soak but not become soggy, then lay it in the pan. Cook for 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through in the middle. Serve the French toast warm with mixed berries and drizzle with honey.

title: Whole-Grain Cinnamon French Toast with Greek Yogurt and Berries
ingredients_json: ["120 g whole-grain bread, sliced", "2 piece egg, raw", "200 ml semi-skimmed milk", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tbsp maple syrup", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2% fat", "120 g mixed berries, fresh", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 tbsp unsalted butter"]
instructions: Whisk the eggs, semi-skimmed milk, ground cinnamon, vanilla extract, and maple syrup in a shallow bowl until smooth. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and melt the unsalted butter. Dip each slice of whole-grain bread into the egg mixture for about 20–30 seconds per side, letting it soak but not falling apart. Place the slices in the hot pan and cook for 2–3 minutes per side, until deep golden and just set in the middle. Serve immediately with a dollop of Greek yogurt and a generous handful of mixed berries on top.

title: Spinach and Feta Frittata with Roasted Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["8 piece Egg, raw", "200 g Cherry tomatoes", "120 g Spinach, raw", "80 g Feta cheese", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "2 g Salt (iodised)"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Halve the cherry tomatoes, toss them with the olive oil and spread them on an oven tray. Roast for 12 minutes until the tomatoes burst and start to caramelise. Meanwhile, whisk the eggs in a bowl with the oregano, black pepper and salt until the mixture is smooth. Stir the spinach into the hot roasted tomatoes so it wilts from the residual heat. Pour the egg mixture into a non-stick oven-safe skillet over the tomatoes and spinach, dot with crumbled feta, and gently shake the pan to distribute everything evenly. Cook on low heat for 3 minutes until the edges begin to set, then transfer to the oven and bake for 12–15 minutes, until the frittata is just set in the middle but still slightly tender. Let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Herby Spinach and Feta Frittata with Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["6 piece Egg, whole, raw", "200 g Egg whites, liquid", "200 g Spinach, fresh", "150 g Cherry tomatoes", "120 g Feta cheese, reduced fat", "10 g Olive oil", "1 tsp Salt, table", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground", "5 g Fresh basil"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a 24–26 cm oven-safe nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add the spinach and cook for 2–3 minutes until wilted and any moisture starts to evaporate. Stir in the cherry tomatoes and cook for 1–2 minutes, just until they begin to soften. In a bowl, whisk the whole eggs and egg whites with the salt and black pepper until smooth, then stir in the basil. Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and crumble the feta over the top. Cook for 4–6 minutes on the stovetop until the edges look set but the center still jiggles slightly. Transfer to a preheated oven at 200°C and bake for 10–12 minutes, until the center is fully set and the top is lightly golden. Rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Spinach and Feta Veggie Frittata with Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["8 piece Egg, raw", "150 g Cherry tomatoes, raw", "120 g Spinach, raw", "120 g Feta cheese, reduced fat", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "2 g Garlic, fresh", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "2 g Salt"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a 24 cm oven-safe nonstick frying pan over medium heat. Add the garlic and dried oregano and stir for 20 seconds until fragrant. Add the cherry tomatoes and cook for 4–5 minutes, until they start to soften and blister. Stir in the spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes just until wilted. Meanwhile, whisk the eggs with the salt and black pepper in a bowl, then pour the mixture into the pan. Crumble the feta evenly over the top. Cook on the stovetop for 3–4 minutes, then transfer to a preheated oven at 190°C and bake for 10–12 minutes, until the center is just set and no longer jiggles. Let the frittata rest for 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Spinach and Feta Turkey Frittata with Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["6 piece Eggs, raw", "200 g Turkey mince, lean", "150 g Fresh spinach", "120 g Cherry tomatoes", "80 g Feta cheese", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1/2 tsp Ground black pepper", "1/2 tsp Salt"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a non-stick oven-safe frying pan over medium heat. Add the turkey mince and cook for about 6–8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned and cooked through. Stir in the spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes until wilted. Slice the cherry tomatoes in half and scatter them into the pan. In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the dried oregano, black pepper, and salt, then pour evenly over the turkey and vegetables. Crumble the feta over the top. Cook on the stovetop for 2–3 minutes until the edges start to set, then transfer to the oven and bake at 190°C for 12–15 minutes, until the center is just set but still slightly soft. Let it rest for 3–5 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Spinach and Smoked Salmon Frittata with Dill
ingredients_json: ["8 piece Egg, raw", "150 g Smoked salmon", "120 g Baby spinach", "120 g Cottage cheese, low-fat", "1 medium Onion, raw", "2 cl Olive oil", "50 g Feta cheese, reduced-fat", "10 g Fresh dill", "3 g Salt, fine", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Finely chop the onion and sauté it in the olive oil over medium heat for 4–5 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Add the baby spinach and cook for 2 minutes, just until wilted. In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the cottage cheese, black pepper, and salt. Stir in the chopped dill and add the smoked salmon pieces. Pour the mixture into a lightly oiled oven-safe pan, crumble over the feta, and bake at 180°C for 18–22 minutes, until the edges are set and the center is just slightly soft but not runny. Let the frittata rest for 5 minutes, then slice and serve warm.

title: Toasted Oat Granola with Greek Yogurt, Berries, and Chia
ingredients_json: ["250 g rolled oats", "40 g chia seeds", "60 g sliced almonds", "60 g pumpkin seeds", "120 g honey", "120 ml extra-virgin olive oil", "200 g dried cranberries", "1 g ground cinnamon", "2 g fine salt", "300 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "200 g mixed berries, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 160°C and line a large baking tray with baking paper. In a large bowl, mix the rolled oats, chia seeds, sliced almonds, pumpkin seeds, ground cinnamon, and fine salt. In a small bowl, warm the honey with the extra-virgin olive oil until smooth, then pour it over the dry mixture and stir until everything is evenly coated. Spread the granola mixture in a thin, even layer on the tray and bake for 20 minutes, then stir and bake for another 10–15 minutes until deep golden and fragrant. Let the granola cool completely on the tray so it becomes crisp, then stir in the dried cranberries. Serve the granola with plain low-fat Greek yogurt and fresh mixed berries.

title: Toasted Oats Granola with Honey, Almonds and Dried Cherries
ingredients_json: ["200 g rolled oats", "60 g sliced almonds", "50 g pumpkin seeds", "60 g dried cherries, unsweetened", "30 g chia seeds", "80 g honey", "60 ml olive oil", "1 g ground cinnamon", "2 g fine sea salt"]
instructions: Heat your oven to 160°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a large bowl, mix the rolled oats, sliced almonds, pumpkin seeds, chia seeds and cinnamon until evenly combined. In a small bowl, stir the honey and olive oil together, then pour it over the dry ingredients and mix thoroughly until everything looks glossy and well coated. Spread the mixture in a single, even layer on the tray and toast in the oven for 20 minutes, stirring halfway through so it browns evenly. Remove the tray and let the granola cool completely, where it will crisp up further. Once cooled, fold in the dried cherries and store in an airtight container.

title: Toasted Oat Granola with Greek Yogurt, Berries & Chia
ingredients_json: ["200 g rolled oats", "60 g whole almonds", "40 g chia seeds", "80 g dried cranberries, unsweetened", "40 g pumpkin seeds", "80 g honey", "80 ml olive oil", "1 g ground cinnamon", "2 g fine salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 170°C (fan 150°C). Line a baking tray with baking paper. In a large bowl, mix the rolled oats, almonds, chia seeds, pumpkin seeds, dried cranberries, ground cinnamon, and salt. In a small bowl, warm the honey just enough that it loosens, then stir it together with the olive oil. Pour the honey-oil mixture over the dry ingredients and mix thoroughly until everything looks evenly coated. Spread the granola in an even layer on the tray and toast for 18 minutes, then stir and toast for another 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are golden and the mixture smells nutty. Let it cool completely on the tray so it crisps up. Store in an airtight container once cool.

title: Creamy Greek Yogurt Grits with Smoked Salmon and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["90 g stone-ground grits (corn grits)", "750 ml skimmed milk", "250 g water", "200 g smoked salmon", "100 g Greek yogurt, plain 0-2% fat", "80 g baby spinach", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp lemon zest", "1 g black pepper", "2 g fine salt"]
instructions: Bring the milk and water to a gentle simmer in a saucepan over medium heat. Whisk in the grits slowly so no lumps form, then reduce the heat to low and cook for 10–12 minutes, stirring frequently until the grits are thick and creamy. Stir in the olive oil, Greek yogurt, lemon zest, and black pepper, then fold in the spinach until just wilted. Remove from the heat and cover the pan for 1 minute so the mixture becomes extra smooth. Serve the grits immediately topped with smoked salmon, with a tiny extra grind of black pepper if you like.

title: Creamy Cheddar & Spinach Grits with Poached Eggs
ingredients_json: ["120 g grits (corn grits, dry)", "700 ml water", "200 ml low-fat milk (1.5% fat)", "150 g fresh spinach", "60 g cheddar cheese, reduced-fat", "20 g unsalted butter", "2 g fine salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "3 piece eggs, whole"]
instructions: Bring the water and low-fat milk to a gentle simmer in a saucepan. Whisk in the dry grits slowly, reduce the heat to low, and cook for about 8–10 minutes, stirring frequently, until thick and creamy. Stir in the butter, reduced-fat cheddar, salt, and black pepper until the cheese is melted and the texture is smooth. Add the spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes, stirring, just until wilted. Meanwhile, poach the eggs in a separate pot of barely simmering water for about 3–4 minutes each, until the whites are set but the yolks are still soft. Spoon the hot grits into bowls, top with the poached eggs, and serve immediately.

title: Cheesy White Grits with Black Beans, Corn & Avocado
ingredients_json: ["120 g coarse corn grits", "700 ml low-fat milk", "300 g canned black beans, drained and rinsed", "150 g canned sweetcorn kernels, drained", "60 g cheddar cheese, reduced-fat, grated", "1 piece avocado, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 g fine salt", "1 g ground black pepper"]
instructions: Bring the milk to a gentle simmer in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Whisk in the corn grits slowly to prevent lumps, then reduce the heat to low and stir frequently for about 12–15 minutes until thick and creamy. Stir in the black beans and sweetcorn and cook for 2–3 minutes more so everything is hot. Turn off the heat and fold in the grated reduced-fat cheddar until melted.
