Drizzle olive oil over the top, add avocado slices, and season with salt and black pepper to taste.

title: Creamy Parmesan-Garlic Grits with Spinach and Poached Eggs
ingredients_json: ["90 g dry grits (corn grits, stone-ground)", "600 ml water", "200 ml skim milk", "20 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "10 g unsalted butter", "2 clove garlic, fresh, minced", "80 g spinach, fresh", "2 piece egg, raw", "5 g olive oil", "1 g salt, fine", "0.5 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Bring the water to a gentle simmer in a saucepan. Whisk in the dry grits and cook on low heat for 10 minutes, stirring frequently so they don’t stick. Pour in the skim milk and add the minced garlic, then continue cooking for 8 to 10 minutes until the grits are thick and creamy. Stir in the butter and grated Parmesan until melted, then fold in the fresh spinach and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until wilted. Meanwhile, poach the eggs in a separate small pot of lightly simmering water for about 3 to 4 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks remain soft. Divide the creamy grits into two bowls, drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and black pepper, and top each portion with a poached egg.

title: Creamy Cheddar and Spinach Grits with Poached Eggs
ingredients_json: ["120 g stone-ground grits", "900 ml water", "250 ml low-fat milk, 1% fat", "20 g unsalted butter", "120 g cheddar cheese, reduced-fat", "100 g spinach, fresh", "2 piece eggs, whole", "1 tsp olive oil", "1/2 tsp salt, fine", "1/4 tsp black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Bring 900 ml water to a boil in a saucepan. Whisk in the grits slowly, reduce to a gentle simmer, and cook for about 10 minutes, stirring often so the grits don’t stick. Stir in the low-fat milk and butter, then cook for another 3–5 minutes until the texture is creamy and thick. Add the cheddar and stir until melted and smooth. Fold in the spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes until wilted. Poach the eggs in a separate small pot of gently simmering water for about 3–4 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks are still soft. Spoon the grits into bowls, top with the poached eggs, and finish with black pepper.

title: Whole-Wheat Sausage & Spinach Kolache with a Cheddar-Scallion Filling
ingredients_json: ["120 g plain wheat flour, whole-grain (whole wheat)", "120 g plain wheat flour, white", "6 g instant yeast", "30 g honey", "1 dl milk, 2% fat", "1 piece egg, raw", "40 g unsalted butter", "1 g salt, table", "200 g turkey breakfast sausage, cooked, crumbled", "150 g spinach, raw", "120 g cheddar cheese, reduced-fat", "40 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "20 g scallions, raw", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Warm the milk until it is lukewarm (about 37°C), then whisk it with the honey and the egg. In a mixing bowl, combine the whole-wheat flour, white flour, instant yeast, and salt, then pour in the milk mixture and mix until a soft dough forms. Melt the butter and mix it into the dough, then knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover and let the dough rise in a warm place for 45–60 minutes, until it has puffed up noticeably. While the dough rises, sauté the crumbled turkey sausage in a nonstick pan over medium heat for 5–6 minutes until lightly browned, then stir in the spinach until wilted and the moisture cooks off. Cool slightly, then mix in the reduced-fat cheddar, Greek yogurt, chopped scallions, and black pepper. Preheat the oven to 190°C and line a baking tray with parchment. Portion the dough into 12 equal pieces, flatten each into a disk, spoon in the filling, and pinch to enclose lightly while still leaving the top filled. Place on the tray, cover loosely, and let them rest for 10 minutes. Bake for 16–20 minutes, until golden on top and the filling is hot and bubbling. Let cool for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Whole-Wheat Sausage & Cheddar Kolache with Peppery Creamy Filling
ingredients_json: ["140 g whole-wheat flour, wholemeal", "20 g all-purpose flour", "5 g instant yeast", "25 g unsalted butter", "120 ml low-fat milk, 1.5%", "1 pc egg, raw", "25 g honey", "6 g salt", "300 g pork sausage, lean", "150 g cheddar cheese, reduced-fat", "30 g plain Greek yogurt, nonfat", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Warm the milk to about 35–38°C. In a bowl, mix the whole-wheat flour, all-purpose flour, instant yeast, and half of the salt. Add the honey, the warm milk, the egg, and the softened butter, then mix until a soft dough forms. Knead for 8–10 minutes until smooth and elastic, then cover and let it rise in a warm place for 45–60 minutes, or until doubled in size. While the dough rises, cook the lean pork sausage in a skillet over medium heat until browned and crumbly, then remove to a bowl to cool slightly. Stir the reduced-fat cheddar with the nonfat Greek yogurt and black pepper, then fold in the cooled sausage. Preheat the oven to 190°C. Portion the dough into 10 equal pieces, shape each into a small round, and place on a parchment-lined tray. Flatten each piece slightly, spoon in a generous filling, and pinch the edges lightly so the filling stays mostly covered. Proof for 10 minutes, then bake for 15–18 minutes until golden brown and the dough is cooked through. Let cool for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Whole-Wheat Sausage & Cheddar Kolache with Caramelized Onion
ingredients_json: ["120 g whole wheat flour", "80 g all-purpose flour", "7 g dry yeast", "40 g plain low-fat Greek yogurt", "1 large egg", "250 ml low-fat milk, 1.5% fat", "30 g unsalted butter", "30 g whole milk mozzarella, shredded", "60 g low-fat cheddar cheese, shredded", "200 g turkey breakfast sausage, crumbled", "120 g onion, finely chopped", "10 ml olive oil", "6 g salt", "2 g ground black pepper"]
instructions:
Warm the milk to about 37–40°C so it feels comfortably warm, not hot, then whisk in the yeast and let it sit for 5 minutes until slightly foamy. In a bowl, combine the whole wheat flour and all-purpose flour, then add the egg, yogurt, melted butter, the yeast mixture, and 2 g of salt and the black pepper. Mix until a soft dough forms, then knead for 8–10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover the dough and let it rise for 45–60 minutes, until doubled in size.

While the dough rises, heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook the chopped onion for 8–10 minutes until caramelized and golden. Add the crumbled turkey sausage and cook for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up until no pink remains and the mixture is well browned. Stir in the shredded cheddar and mozzarella just until the cheese starts to melt and everything looks glossy; remove from heat and cool slightly.

Preheat the oven to 200°C. Divide the risen dough into 8 equal portions, form each into a small round, and place on a parchment-lined baking tray. Spoon the sausage-onion filling into the center of each round, then pinch and seal lightly while leaving the filling visible in the middle. Cover and rest for 10 minutes so the dough puffs. Bake for 14–18 minutes until golden brown and cooked through. Let the kolache cool for 5 minutes before serving so the filling sets.

title: Whole-Wheat Sausage and Cheddar Kolache with Caramelized Onions
ingredients_json: ["240 g all-purpose flour, whole-wheat", "60 g milk, low-fat (2%)", "90 g Greek yogurt, plain, nonfat", "10 g olive oil", "10 g honey", "7 g instant dry yeast", "2 g salt (table salt, iodized)", "1 piece egg, raw", "320 g pork sausage, reduced-fat, cooked and crumbled", "120 g cheddar cheese, reduced-fat", "120 g onion, yellow", "10 g butter, salted", "5 g caraway seeds, ground"]
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk the whole-wheat flour, instant yeast, salt, and ground caraway seeds. In a separate bowl, mix the low-fat milk, Greek yogurt, olive oil, honey, and the raw egg until smooth. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir until a soft dough forms, then knead on a lightly floured surface for about 6–8 minutes until it feels elastic and slightly tacky. Cover and let the dough rise in a warm spot for 45–60 minutes, until puffed and airy. While the dough rises, sauté the onion in the salted butter over medium heat for 8–10 minutes until golden and caramelized. Stir in the cooked reduced-fat sausage and cook for 1–2 minutes to warm through. Divide the dough into 8 equal portions and roll each into a small oval. Place a spoonful of the sausage-onion mixture in the center of each oval and top with a little reduced-fat cheddar. Pinch and tuck the edges to form a kolache shape, then arrange on a parchment-lined baking tray. Let them rest for 15 minutes, then bake at 190°C for 15–18 minutes, until the tops are lightly browned and the filling is hot. Cool for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Whole-Grain Cinnamon Apple Monkey Bread with Greek Yogurt Glaze
ingredients_json: ["320 g whole-wheat flour", "50 g rolled oats", "70 g brown sugar", "7 g instant yeast", "2 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tsp fine salt", "200 ml semi-skimmed milk", "2 large eggs", "80 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "60 g unsalted butter", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "350 g apple, peeled, diced", "60 g raisins", "30 ml olive oil", "1 tbsp water"]
instructions: Warm the milk to lukewarm (about 35–38°C). In a large bowl, mix the whole-wheat flour, rolled oats, brown sugar, instant yeast, cinnamon, and salt. Whisk the eggs, Greek yogurt, melted butter, vanilla extract, and olive oil, then pour into the dry ingredients and stir until you have a soft, slightly sticky dough. Cover the bowl and let it rise in a warm place for 45 minutes, until puffy. Fold in the diced apple and raisins. Lightly grease a loaf pan or bundt pan. Tear off bite-sized pieces of dough, roll them into small balls, and arrange them in the pan. Cover and let rise for another 20 minutes while you preheat the oven to 175°C. Bake for 28–35 minutes, until deep golden and set in the middle. If the top browns too fast, loosely cover with foil. Cool for 10 minutes before serving so the monkey bread finishes setting.

title: Whole Wheat Apple-Cinnamon Monkey Bread with Greek Yogurt Glaze
ingredients_json: ["300 g whole wheat flour", "7 g instant yeast", "30 g light brown sugar", "250 ml low-fat milk", "1 large egg", "60 g unsalted butter", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "2 g fine salt", "300 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "200 g apple, peeled and diced", "20 g raisins", "30 ml maple syrup", "15 ml olive oil"]
instructions:
Warm the low-fat milk to about 38°C so it feels comfortably warm but not hot, then whisk it with the egg. In a large bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, instant yeast, light brown sugar, cinnamon, and salt. Pour in the milk-egg mixture and add the olive oil, then knead for 6–8 minutes until you have a soft, slightly tacky dough. Cover and let it rise for 45–60 minutes, until noticeably puffy.

While the dough rises, mix the Greek yogurt, vanilla extract, and maple syrup to make a thick glaze. Toss the diced apple and raisins with 1–2 teaspoons of cinnamon so the fruit stays aromatic.

Preheat the oven to 180°C. Grease a loaf or bundt pan lightly with a little of the butter. Cut the dough into small bite-size pieces, then toss each piece with the remaining melted butter so they’re coated. Layer the dough pieces with the apple-raisin mixture in the pan, pressing gently so everything fits. Bake for 28–35 minutes until the monkey bread is deep golden and the center looks set; if the top browns too quickly, loosely cover with foil for the last 10 minutes. Let it cool for 10 minutes, then drizzle the Greek yogurt glaze over the warm bread and serve.

title: Cinnamon-Apple Monkey Bread with Greek Yogurt Glaze
ingredients_json: ["250 g plain wholemeal flour", "7 g instant yeast", "50 g light brown sugar", "5 g fine salt", "2 tsp ground cinnamon", "300 ml low-fat milk, 2%", "1 large egg, raw", "60 g unsalted butter", "2 medium apples", "200 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 tbsp olive oil", "30 g raisins"]
instructions:
Warm the milk until it is lukewarm (about 35–40°C), then whisk in the egg. In a large bowl, combine the flour, instant yeast, light brown sugar, salt and 1 teaspoon of the cinnamon. Pour in the milk mixture and mix until a soft dough forms. Cover and let it rise in a warm place for about 30 minutes, until slightly puffy.

Meanwhile, peel and dice the apples into small cubes, then toss them with the remaining 1 teaspoon cinnamon and the raisins. Grease a ring pan or a small bundt-style baking dish with the olive oil. Cut the butter into small pieces and keep ready.

After rising, fold the apple-raisin mixture into the dough. Pinch off small pieces (about walnut size) and roll them lightly. Layer the dough pieces into the pan, dotting with small pieces of butter as you go. Cover loosely and let it rest for 15 minutes while the oven heats to 190°C. Bake for 22–28 minutes, until the top is golden and the center looks set.

Mix the low-fat Greek yogurt with the vanilla extract. Let the monkey bread cool for 10 minutes, then spoon the yogurt glaze over the warm bread so it melts slightly. Serve warm, ideally the same day.

title: Wholegrain Banana Oat Monkey Bread with Cinnamon and Greek Yogurt Glaze
ingredients_json: ["250 g plain wholegrain wheat flour", "120 g rolled oats", "2 tsp instant yeast", "30 g brown sugar", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "5 g fine salt", "2 large eggs", "200 ml low-fat milk", "120 g plain Greek yogurt, low-fat", "80 ml rapeseed oil", "1 medium banana", "60 g unsalted butter", "2 tbsp honey", "1 tsp vanilla extract"]
instructions: Warm the milk to about 35–38°C so the yeast activates. In a large bowl, mix the wholegrain wheat flour, rolled oats, instant yeast, brown sugar, ground cinnamon and salt. In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs, Greek yogurt, rapeseed oil, vanilla extract and the mashed banana until smooth, then pour in the warm milk and mix until a soft, slightly sticky dough forms. Cover and let the dough rise for 45 minutes in a warm place, until puffy. Heat the oven to 190°C and lightly grease a loaf pan. Cut the risen dough into small bite-size pieces, toss them in the cinnamon-sugar coating that forms as they separate, and scatter them into the prepared pan. Melt the butter with the honey and drizzle evenly over the dough pieces. Bake for 28–33 minutes, until the top is deeply golden and a skewer in the center comes out clean. Rest for 10 minutes before serving so the monkey bread sets and the glaze thickens.

title: Cinnamon-Oat Monkey Bread with Greek Yogurt Glaze
ingredients_json: ["300 g plain wheat flour", "50 g rolled oats", "7 g instant yeast", "30 g brown sugar", "200 ml low-fat milk", "2 piece eggs, raw", "80 g plain low-fat Greek yogurt", "60 g unsalted butter", "1 tsp fine salt", "2 tbsp ground cinnamon", "1 tbsp vanilla extract", "1 tbsp honey", "100 g raisins"]
instructions: Warm the milk to about lukewarm (around 35–40°C). In a large bowl, mix the flour, oats, instant yeast, brown sugar, salt, and ground cinnamon. Add the eggs, Greek yogurt, melted butter, and vanilla extract, then pour in the warm milk. Stir until a soft, slightly sticky dough forms, then knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Fold in the raisins. Cover the bowl and let the dough rise in a warm place for 45–60 minutes, or until it has roughly doubled in size. Heat the oven to 190°C and lightly grease a bundt pan or a baking dish. Pinch off small pieces of dough, roll them between your hands, and toss them in a cinnamon-sugar mixture made from the remaining cinnamon and honey (spoon the honey over and stir to coat). Arrange the coated dough pieces in the pan, filling it evenly. Bake for 25–30 minutes until deep golden and baked through; a skewer inserted in the center should come out clean. Let it rest for 10 minutes before serving so the center sets.

title: Banana Oat and Greek Yogurt Blueberry Muffins
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "120 g plain Greek yogurt, 2% fat", "2 pieces eggs, raw", "220 g ripe banana, mashed", "100 g blueberries, fresh", "60 ml honey", "6 g baking powder", "3 g ground cinnamon", "1 g fine salt", "45 ml olive oil"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°C and line a 12-cup muffin tray with paper liners. Blend the rolled oats until they resemble a coarse flour, then stir in the baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs with the Greek yogurt, honey, and olive oil until smooth. Fold in the mashed banana, then combine wet and dry ingredients and mix just until no dry streaks remain. Gently fold in the blueberries. Divide the batter between the cups, filling each about three-quarters full. Bake for 18 to 22 minutes, until the tops are set and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs. Let the muffins cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool slightly before eating.

title: Blueberry Oat Yogurt Muffins with Banana
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "150 g plain Greek yogurt, low-fat", "2 piece eggs, whole, raw", "1 piece banana, ripe (about 120 g edible portion)", "150 g blueberries, fresh", "60 g honey", "10 g baking powder", "5 g ground cinnamon", "3 g fine salt", "30 g olive oil"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C and line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners. In a blender or food processor, pulse the oats until they become a coarse oat flour, then transfer to a mixing bowl. Add baking powder, cinnamon, and salt and stir well. In another bowl, whisk the eggs with the Greek yogurt, honey, olive oil, and the mashed banana until smooth. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and mix just until you no longer see dry oat flour. Gently fold in the blueberries, trying not to crush them. Divide the batter evenly between the 12 cups and bake for 18 to 22 minutes, until the tops are lightly golden and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs. Let the muffins cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then move them to a rack to cool slightly before eating.

title: Zucchini-Oat Breakfast Muffins with Greek Yogurt and Blueberries
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "120 g whole wheat flour", "2 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "2 large eggs, raw", "250 g Greek yogurt, plain 2%", "140 ml rapeseed oil", "180 g zucchini, grated (with moisture)", "120 g blueberries, fresh or frozen", "60 g honey", "5 g fine salt", "1 tsp vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C and line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper cases. In a bowl, mix the rolled oats, whole wheat flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. In a second bowl, whisk the eggs with the Greek yogurt, rapeseed oil, honey, and vanilla until smooth. Stir the grated zucchini into the wet mixture, then pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and mix just until no dry flour remains. Fold in the blueberries gently so they don’t burst. Divide the batter between the cups, filling each about three-quarters full. Bake for 18–22 minutes, until the tops are golden and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs. Let the muffins cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool further before eating.

title: Banana-Oat Breakfast Muffins with Greek Yogurt and Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "180 g ripe banana, mashed", "200 g plain Greek yogurt, low-fat", "2 piece egg, raw", "60 g honey", "10 g baking powder", "5 g ground cinnamon", "80 g blueberries, fresh or frozen", "30 g unsalted butter, melted", "2 g fine salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C and line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners. Blend the rolled oats into a fine oat flour, then whisk oat flour with baking powder, cinnamon, and salt in a large bowl. In a second bowl, stir together the mashed banana, Greek yogurt, eggs, honey, and melted butter until smooth. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and fold gently just until no dry streaks remain. Fold in the blueberries, then divide the batter evenly among the muffin cups. Bake for 16–20 minutes, until the tops are lightly golden and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out mostly clean. Let the muffins cool in the tin for 5 minutes before transferring to a rack to cool further.

title: Oat, Banana and Blueberry Breakfast Muffins with Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["150 g rolled oats", "200 g ripe banana, mashed", "2 piece egg, raw", "120 g plain low-fat yogurt", "120 ml milk, 1.5% fat", "80 g blueberries, fresh or frozen", "60 g whole wheat flour", "2 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "20 g honey", "10 g olive oil"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a muffin tin with 10 paper cases. Blend the rolled oats into a fine oat flour, then mix it with the whole wheat flour, baking powder, and ground cinnamon. In a separate bowl whisk the eggs with the mashed banana, yogurt, milk, honey, and olive oil until smooth. Fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients just until no dry flour remains, then gently fold in the blueberries. Divide the batter between the muffin cups and bake for 18–22 minutes, until the tops are lightly golden and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs. Let the muffins cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool further before eating.

title: Creamy Cinnamon Apple Oatmeal with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["80 g rolled oats", "400 ml semi-skimmed milk", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "1 medium apple", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "20 g chia seeds", "10 g honey", "1 g fine salt"]
instructions: Add the milk and rolled oats to a saucepan and bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat. Stir frequently so the oats don’t stick, then cook for 5–7 minutes until the mixture thickens and looks creamy. Stir in the ground cinnamon and chia seeds and simmer for 1 more minute. While the oatmeal cooks, grate the apple or dice it very small, then fold it into the hot oatmeal. Turn off the heat, let it stand for 2 minutes to thicken further, then stir in the Greek yogurt. Drizzle with honey and serve warm; the texture should be thick but still spoonable.

title: Creamy Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal with Chia and Almonds
ingredients_json: ["80 g rolled oats", "4 dl semi-skimmed milk", "1 medium apple", "20 g chia seeds", "30 g almond butter", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "10 g honey", "1 g fine salt", "1 tsp vanilla extract"]
instructions: Add the milk to a saucepan and bring it to a gentle simmer over medium heat. Stir in the rolled oats, cinnamon, fine salt, and vanilla extract, then reduce the heat to low and cook for about 6–8 minutes, stirring regularly, until the oats are thick and creamy. While the oats cook, dice the apple very small and stir it in during the last 3 minutes so it softens but still holds its shape. Turn off the heat, mix in the chia seeds and honey, then let the oatmeal stand for 2 minutes to thicken further. Serve warm topped with almond butter, and expect a smooth, spoonable texture with visible apple pieces.

title: Creamy Banana–Cinnamon Oatmeal with Chia and Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["60 g rolled oats", "3 dl semi-skimmed milk", "1 medium banana", "10 g chia seeds", "10 g walnuts", "1 tbsp ground flaxseed", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "5 g honey", "1 g fine salt"]
instructions: Add the milk to a saucepan and bring it to a gentle simmer over medium heat. Stir in the rolled oats, chia seeds, flaxseed, cinnamon, and salt, then reduce the heat to low and cook for about 6–8 minutes, stirring often, until the oats are creamy and have thickened. Mash the banana with a fork and stir it into the oatmeal for the final 1–2 minutes so it warms through and blends smoothly. Remove from the heat, drizzle in the honey, and top with roughly chopped walnuts. Serve while hot, with an extra sprinkle of cinnamon if you like the aroma to be stronger.

title: Creamy Apple-Cinnamon Oatmeal with Chia and Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["80 g rolled oats", "300 ml semi-skimmed milk", "1 medium apple, cored and diced", "15 g chia seeds", "20 g walnuts, chopped", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tbsp maple syrup", "1 g fine salt"]
instructions: Add the milk to a saucepan and warm it over medium heat until it starts to steam. Stir in the rolled oats, diced apple, cinnamon, chia seeds, and fine salt. Bring to a gentle simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring often, until the oats are thick and the apple is tender. Remove from the heat, stir in the maple syrup, and fold through the chopped walnuts. Let it sit for 2 minutes to thicken slightly more before serving warm.

title: Creamy Cinnamon Apple Oatmeal with Chia & Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["80 g rolled oats", "400 ml semi-skimmed milk", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2% fat", "20 g chia seeds", "150 g apple, diced", "10 g honey", "2 g ground cinnamon", "5 g unsalted butter", "1 g vanilla extract"]
instructions: Add the milk to a saucepan and bring it to a gentle simmer over medium heat. Stir in the rolled oats, cinnamon, and vanilla, then reduce the heat to low and cook for about 5–7 minutes, stirring regularly, until the oats are creamy and have thickened. Fold in the diced apple and cook for another 3 minutes until the apple softens slightly but still holds its shape. Turn off the heat and stir in the chia seeds so they hydrate in the warm oatmeal. Let it stand for 2 minutes to thicken further, then serve with the Greek yogurt swirled on top and drizzle over the honey. Melt the butter briefly in a small pan and pour a little over the finished bowls if you want extra richness.

title: Spinach and Feta Veggie Omelet with Whole-Grain Toast
ingredients_json: ["3 piece Egg, raw", "60 g Spinach, raw", "80 g Feta cheese", "1 piece Tomato, raw", "1 piece Red bell pepper, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "2 slices Bread, wholemeal", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "1 g Salt, table"]
instructions: Whisk the eggs in a bowl with the salt and black pepper until the mixture looks uniform. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the diced tomato and red bell pepper and cook for about 2 minutes, stirring, until they start to soften. Add the spinach and cook for another 1–2 minutes, just until wilted. Pour in the egg mixture and cook for 2–3 minutes, shaking the pan gently so the omelet sets evenly. Crumble the feta over the top, fold the omelet in half, and cook for 1 minute more until the center is just set but still tender. Toast the wholemeal bread and serve alongside the omelet.

title: Spinach & Feta Vegetable Omelet with Whole-Grain Toast
ingredients_json: ["3 piece Egg, raw", "80 g Egg whites, liquid", "120 g Spinach, raw", "60 g Tomato, raw", "80 g Feta cheese, reduced-fat", "1 tsp Olive oil", "2 slices Bread, wholemeal", "5 g Onion, raw"]
instructions: Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Add the sliced onion and cook for about 1 minute until slightly softened. Add the spinach and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring, until it has wilted and any moisture has mostly cooked off. Dice the tomato and add it to the pan for 30 to 60 seconds. In a bowl, whisk the eggs and egg whites together, then pour into the pan. Sprinkle the reduced-fat feta over the omelet and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until the edges look set and the middle is still slightly soft. Fold the omelet in half and cook for another 1 minute. Toast the wholemeal bread slices while the omelet finishes, then serve immediately with the omelet.

title: Spinach & Feta Veggie Omelet with Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["3 piece Egg, whole, raw", "30 g Feta cheese, reduced fat", "120 g Spinach, fresh", "120 g Cherry tomatoes, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "30 g Onion, raw", "60 g Mushrooms, white, raw", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "1 g Salt (NaCl)"]
instructions: Whisk the eggs in a bowl with the salt and black pepper until the mixture looks uniform. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat, then add the onion and mushrooms and cook for about 4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the mushrooms release their moisture and start to brown. Add the spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes until wilted. Add the cherry tomatoes and cook for another 1 minute, just to warm them through. Pour in the beaten eggs and reduce the heat to low. Cook gently for 3–4 minutes, lifting the edges with a spatula so the uncooked egg flows underneath. Sprinkle the feta over one half of the omelet, fold it over, and cook for 30–60 seconds more until set but still tender.

title: Spinach and Feta Mediterranean Omelet with Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["3 piece Egg, whole, raw", "150 g Egg whites, pasteurized", "120 g Spinach, fresh", "100 g Cherry tomatoes, raw", "40 g Cheese, feta, reduced fat", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 g Salt, table", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the spinach and cook for 2–3 minutes until wilted, then add the cherry tomatoes and cook for 1 minute, just until they begin to soften. In a bowl, whisk the whole eggs and pasteurized egg whites with the salt and black pepper. Pour the egg mixture into the pan and cook gently for 3–4 minutes, lifting the edges so uncooked egg flows underneath. Sprinkle the feta over one half of the omelet, fold it in half, and cook for another 1–2 minutes until set but still tender. Slide onto a plate and serve right away.

title: Spinach and Feta Mediterranean Omelet with Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["4 piece Egg, whole, raw", "80 g Feta cheese, reduced fat", "120 g Spinach, fresh", "150 g Tomato, fresh", "1 tbsp Olive oil, extra virgin", "1 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Chop the tomatoes and roughly wilt the spinach. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Add the tomatoes and cook for about 3 minutes until they start to soften and release juices. Add the spinach and stir for 1–2 minutes until wilted. In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the salt and black pepper. Pour the eggs into the pan and cook for 2–3 minutes without stirring, until the edges are set but the center is still slightly runny. Sprinkle the feta evenly over one half of the omelet, then fold it over. Cook for another 1 minute until the feta softens and the eggs are fully set, then serve immediately.

title: Banana Oat Pancakes with Greek Yogurt and Berries
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "2 piece egg, raw", "180 g banana, ripe, mashed", "200 g low-fat plain Greek yogurt", "2 tbsp olive oil, light, for cooking", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "150 g blueberries, fresh", "1 tbsp honey"]
instructions: Blend the rolled oats until they resemble a coarse flour. In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the Greek yogurt, mashed banana, cinnamon, and honey until smooth. Stir in the oat flour and baking powder, then let the batter rest for 5 minutes so it thickens. Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium heat and lightly coat it with the olive oil. Pour about 2–3 tbsp batter per pancake and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until bubbles form on the surface and the edges look set. Flip carefully and cook for another 1 to 2 minutes until golden and cooked through. Serve warm with blueberries on top.

title: Wholegrain Oat & Banana Pancakes with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "200 g banana, ripe, mashed", "2 piece eggs, raw", "250 g skimmed milk", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "1 tbsp honey", "6 g baking powder", "1 g ground cinnamon", "2 g vanilla extract", "1 tbsp rapeseed oil", "2 g fine salt"]
instructions: Blend the oats into a fine oat flour. In a bowl, whisk the eggs, then stir in the mashed banana, milk, honey, vanilla extract, cinnamon, and salt. Fold in the oat flour and baking powder until you have a smooth batter with no dry patches. Let the batter rest for 5 minutes so it thickens slightly. Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium heat and lightly brush it with rapeseed oil. Pour about 1/4 of the batter into the pan and cook for 2–3 minutes until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges look set. Flip carefully and cook for another 1–2 minutes until golden and cooked through. Repeat with the remaining batter. Serve warm with a generous spoonful of Greek yogurt on top.

title: Whole-Grain Oat and Banana Pancakes with Greek Yogurt Swirl
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "2 piece egg, raw", "180 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "1 piece banana, ripe", "200 ml milk, low-fat", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tbsp honey", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 tbsp rapeseed oil", "0.5 tsp fine salt"]
instructions: Blend the rolled oats into a fine oat flour. In a bowl, mash the banana until smooth, then whisk in the eggs, milk, Greek yogurt, honey, vanilla extract, cinnamon, and salt. Stir in the oat flour and baking powder, and let the batter rest for 5 minutes so it thickens. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and lightly grease with the rapeseed oil. Pour about 60–70 g batter per pancake and cook for 2–3 minutes, until bubbles form on the surface and the edges look set. Flip and cook for another 1–2 minutes until golden and cooked through. Serve warm, with extra Greek yogurt if you like.

title: Banana Oat Pancakes with Greek Yogurt and Blueberries
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "1.5 tsp baking powder", "1 g ground cinnamon", "2 piece eggs, whole, raw", "150 g ripe banana, mashed", "200 g low-fat Greek yogurt", "1 tbsp olive oil", "120 g blueberries, fresh"]
instructions: Place the rolled oats in a blender and blend into a coarse flour. In a bowl, whisk the oat flour with the baking powder and cinnamon. In a second bowl, mash the banana, then whisk in the eggs and Greek yogurt until smooth. Add the wet mixture to the dry ingredients and stir until you have a thick batter; let it rest for 5 minutes so it thickens. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Spoon about 60–70 g batter per pancake into the pan and cook for 2–3 minutes, until bubbles rise on the surface and the edges look set. Flip carefully and cook for another 1–2 minutes until golden. Serve the pancakes topped with blueberries.

title: Wholegrain Oat Banana Pancakes with Greek Yogurt and Berries
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "1 medium piece banana, ripe", "2 piece eggs, whole", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "1 tsp baking powder", "10 g chia seeds", "1 tbsp honey", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "200 g mixed berries, fresh or frozen"]
instructions: Blend the rolled oats into a flour-like consistency, then mash the banana in a bowl. Add the eggs, Greek yogurt, baking powder, chia seeds, honey, and cinnamon, and stir until you get a thick, pourable batter. Let the batter rest for 5 minutes so the chia and oats soften. Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat and lightly grease it with a small amount of oil if needed. Pour about 60–70 g batter per pancake and cook for 2–3 minutes until bubbles form on top and the edges look set. Flip carefully and cook for another 1–2 minutes until golden. Serve warm with mixed berries on top.

title: Wholemeal Popovers with Greek Yogurt and Berries
ingredients_json: ["150 g wholemeal plain flour", "2 dl skimmed milk", "3 piece egg, whole", "40 g Greek yoghurt, plain, non-fat", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 pinch salt", "2 tbsp rapeseed oil", "150 g mixed berries, fresh"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C and place a popover or Yorkshire pudding tray inside so it gets very hot. Whisk the wholemeal flour, baking powder and salt in a bowl. In another bowl, whisk the milk, eggs and Greek yoghurt until smooth, then pour into the dry ingredients and whisk until you have a thick, lump-free batter. Carefully remove the hot tray, add 1/2 tbsp rapeseed oil to each cup, and pour in the batter, filling each about two-thirds full. Bake for 18–22 minutes until the popovers are well risen and deeply golden. Serve immediately with the mixed berries.

title: Wholemeal Spinach Feta Popovers with Light Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["150 g wholemeal plain flour", "2 g fine salt", "3 g baking powder", "4 piece egg, raw", "350 ml semi-skimmed milk", "150 g baby spinach, raw", "120 g feta cheese, reduced-fat", "30 g olive oil", "150 g plain yogurt, low-fat"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Whisk the wholemeal flour, salt and baking powder in a bowl. In a second bowl, whisk the eggs and milk until smooth, then pour into the dry ingredients and whisk until you have a thick, lump-free batter. Chop the spinach finely, crumble the feta, and stir both into the batter. Rest the batter for 10 minutes while the oven heats fully. Heat the olive oil in a muffin tin (or popover tin) and pour a little batter into each cup, filling about two-thirds full. Bake for 18–22 minutes without opening the door, until the popovers are puffed high and deep golden and sound hollow when tapped. Meanwhile, stir the yogurt until smooth and season it lightly with 1 g extra salt if you like. Serve the popovers warm with the light yogurt on the side.

title: Wholemeal Oat Popovers with Greek Yogurt and Berry Compote
ingredients_json: ["120 g plain wheat flour, wholemeal", "60 g rolled oats", "2.5 g fine salt", "5 g baking powder", "3 g ground cinnamon", "300 ml semi-skimmed milk", "2 piece eggs, whole, raw", "15 ml rapeseed oil", "250 g low-fat Greek yogurt, plain", "200 g mixed berries, frozen"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C. Place 6 popover cups or a muffin tin in the oven to preheat for about 5 minutes. Blend the wholemeal flour, oats, salt, baking powder, and cinnamon in a bowl. In a second bowl, whisk the milk and eggs until smooth, then whisk in the rapeseed oil. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and whisk just until the batter is evenly combined; let it rest for 5 minutes while the tin finishes heating. Carefully remove the hot tin, lightly coat the cups with a little extra oil, then fill each cup about two-thirds full. Bake for 18–22 minutes until the popovers are well risen and deeply golden, resisting when you gently tap the tops. While they bake, heat the frozen berries in a small pan over medium heat for 4–6 minutes until saucy, then stir in the Greek yogurt just before serving or serve the yogurt alongside. Serve the popovers immediately with the warm berry compote and yogurt.

title: Wholemeal Oat Popovers with Greek Yogurt and Blueberry Compote
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "200 ml skimmed milk", "2 piece eggs, whole", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "1 tbsp ground flaxseed", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp fine salt", "200 g blueberries, fresh or frozen", "30 g honey", "2 tsp rapeseed oil"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C and place a muffin tin inside for 5 minutes to preheat. Blend the oats into a fine oat flour. In a bowl whisk the oat flour, baking powder and salt, then whisk in the milk and eggs until smooth and slightly thick, and rest the batter for 5 minutes. Carefully remove the hot tin, brush each muffin cup with a little rapeseed oil, then pour in the batter until each cup is about two-thirds full. Bake for 16–18 minutes until the popovers are well puffed and deep golden, and they sound hollow when tapped. Meanwhile, warm the blueberries in a small saucepan with the honey over medium heat for 5–7 minutes until the mixture looks syrupy; allow it to cool slightly. Serve the popovers warm with a generous spoonful of Greek yogurt and a drizzle of blueberry compote.

title: Crispy Oven-Baked Potato Pancakes with Greek Yogurt Dill Sauce
ingredients_json: ["600 g potatoes, raw, peeled", "1 piece egg, raw", "60 g plain wholemeal flour", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 tbsp olive oil", "170 g Greek yogurt, plain, non-fat", "1 tbsp fresh dill, chopped", "1 tbsp lemon juice"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Grate the potatoes finely, then squeeze them in a clean kitchen towel until most of the liquid is removed. In a bowl, mix the grated potatoes with the egg, wholemeal flour, salt, and black pepper until the mixture holds together. Heat the olive oil in a small pan or warm it slightly in the bowl, then lightly coat the potato mixture. Form 8 small pancakes and place them on the baking tray with space between them. Bake for 18 minutes, flip carefully, and bake for another 10 minutes until they are golden and crisp at the edges. While the pancakes bake, stir the Greek yogurt with the chopped dill and lemon juice. Serve the potato pancakes hot with the dill yogurt on the side.

title: Crispy Oat–Potato Pancakes with Greek Yogurt and Chives
ingredients_json: ["350 g potatoes, raw, peeled, grated", "60 g oat flour", "2 piece eggs, raw", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "10 g fresh chives, chopped", "1 tsp salt", "1/2 tsp black pepper, ground", "2 tbsp olive oil"]
instructions: Grate the potatoes finely and squeeze them in a clean kitchen towel to remove excess moisture. In a bowl, mix the grated potatoes with oat flour, eggs, half the Greek yogurt, chives, salt, and black pepper until a thick batter forms. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat and add 2 tbsp olive oil. Spoon 8 small pancakes into the pan and press them slightly; cook for about 3–4 minutes per side until deep golden and crisp. If they brown too quickly, lower the heat a little and continue cooking until the center feels set. Serve hot with the remaining Greek yogurt and extra chives if desired.

title: Crispy Oven-Baked Potato Pancakes with Greek Yogurt Herb Dip
ingredients_json: ["350 g potatoes, raw, grated", "1 piece egg, raw", "60 g Greek yogurt, 2% fat", "30 g wholemeal flour", "1 tsp rapeseed oil", "5 g fresh chives, chopped", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "200 g Greek yogurt, 2% fat"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Squeeze the grated potatoes in a clean kitchen towel to remove excess moisture. In a bowl, mix the potatoes with the egg, 60 g Greek yogurt, wholemeal flour, chopped chives, salt, and black pepper until you get a thick batter. Shape 8 small pancakes on the tray and drizzle them lightly with rapeseed oil, then bake for 18 minutes until the edges turn golden. Carefully flip the pancakes and bake for another 10 minutes until crisp and cooked through. Stir the remaining 200 g Greek yogurt with a little chives and black pepper, and serve the potato pancakes hot with the yogurt dip.

title: Crispy Zucchini Potato Pancakes with Greek Yogurt Dill
ingredients_json: ["400 g potatoes, raw, peeled, grated", "200 g zucchini, raw, grated", "1 piece egg, raw, whole", "30 g wholemeal flour", "5 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "20 g olive oil", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "10 g fresh dill, chopped", "10 g lemon juice"]
instructions: Grate the potatoes and zucchini, then squeeze the mixture in a clean kitchen towel to remove as much water as possible. In a bowl, mix the squeezed vegetables with the egg, wholemeal flour, salt, and black pepper until you get a thick batter that holds together. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Form 8 small pancakes and cook them for 3 to 4 minutes per side until deep golden and crisp, adjusting the heat down if they brown too quickly. Mix the Greek yogurt with dill and lemon juice to make a quick sauce. Serve the pancakes hot with the yogurt sauce.

title: Crispy Oven-Supported Potato Pancakes with Greek Yogurt Dill
ingredients_json: ["500 g potato, raw, grated (peeled)", "1 piece egg, raw", "60 g whole wheat flour", "5 g olive oil", "180 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "10 g fresh dill", "10 g lemon juice", "3 g table salt", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Grate the potatoes finely, then squeeze them in a clean kitchen towel to remove excess liquid. In a bowl, mix the grated potato with the egg, whole wheat flour, salt, and black pepper until you get a thick, spoonable batter. Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium heat and add the olive oil. Form small pancakes (about 6–8 cm wide) and cook them for 4 minutes on the first side, until deep golden and crisp around the edges. Flip and cook for another 3–4 minutes. For the sauce, stir the Greek yogurt with chopped dill and lemon juice. Serve the hot potato pancakes with the dill yogurt on the side.

title: Spiced Pumpkin Oat Bread Loaves with Cinnamon and Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["300 g pumpkin puree", "200 g rolled oats", "120 g plain Greek yogurt, 2% fat", "2 large eggs", "80 ml rapeseed oil", "180 g whole wheat flour", "100 g light brown sugar", "10 g baking powder", "5 g ground cinnamon", "2 g ground nutmeg", "3 g fine salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a loaf tin (or two smaller tins) with baking paper. In a blender or food processor, blend the rolled oats into a coarse oat meal. In a large bowl, whisk the eggs with the Greek yogurt and rapeseed oil until smooth. Stir in the pumpkin puree, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt. Add the oat meal and whole wheat flour, then mix until just combined. In a small bowl, mix the baking powder with the brown sugar, then fold it into the batter and stir until no dry pockets remain. Pour the batter into the tin(s) and bake for 38–45 minutes, until the top is golden and a skewer inserted into the center comes out clean or with only a few moist crumbs. Let the bread cool in the tin for 10 minutes before transferring to a rack to cool fully; slice once cool for the best texture.

title: Whole-Grain Pumpkin Banana Breads with Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["200 g pumpkin purée", "2 medium eggs, raw", "120 g whole wheat flour", "60 g rolled oats", "120 g Greek yogurt, non-fat", "80 g banana, ripe", "50 g honey", "8 g baking powder", "4 g ground cinnamon", "2 g salt", "30 ml olive oil"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a small loaf tin with baking paper. In a bowl, mash the banana until smooth, then whisk in the eggs, pumpkin purée, Greek yogurt, honey, and olive oil until the mixture looks glossy and evenly combined. In another bowl, mix the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. Fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture just until no dry flour remains, being careful not to overmix. Pour the batter into the tin and bake for 35–45 minutes, until the top is set and a skewer inserted into the center comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs. Let the pumpkin bread cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool further before slicing.

title: Whole-Wheat Pumpkin Banana Breads with Cinnamon Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["180 g pumpkin purée", "2 piece eggs, raw", "180 g mashed banana (ripe)", "120 g whole wheat flour, wholemeal", "60 g rolled oats", "80 g plain low-fat Greek yogurt", "40 g maple syrup", "60 g sunflower oil", "10 g baking powder", "5 g ground cinnamon", "3 g fine sea salt", "2 g ground nutmeg", "80 g pumpkin seeds (pepitas)"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C and grease a loaf pan (or line it with baking paper). In a large bowl, whisk the eggs, pumpkin purée, mashed banana, Greek yogurt, maple syrup, and sunflower oil until smooth. Stir in the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg, and sea salt, mixing just until no dry flour remains. Fold in the pumpkin seeds. Pour the batter into the pan and bake for 45–55 minutes, until the top is set and a skewer inserted in the center comes out clean or with only a few moist crumbs. Let the pumpkin bread cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool further before slicing.

title: Whole-Wheat Pumpkin Banana Breads with Cinnamon Oats
ingredients_json: ["200 g pumpkin purée", "180 g ripe banana, mashed", "160 g whole wheat flour", "60 g rolled oats", "80 g plain low-fat yogurt", "2 pieces egg, raw", "40 g maple syrup", "30 g vegetable oil", "10 g baking powder", "6 g ground cinnamon", "2 g fine salt", "5 g pumpkin seeds"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a loaf pan (or a small loaf pan) with baking paper. In a large bowl, mix the pumpkin purée, mashed banana, yogurt, eggs, maple syrup, and vegetable oil until smooth. Stir in the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt, and mix just until no dry flour remains. Fold in the pumpkin seeds, then pour the batter into the pan and smooth the top. Bake for 35–45 minutes, until the bread is golden and a skewer inserted in the center comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs. Let it cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool before slicing.

title: Spinach and Salmon Quiche with Oat Crust and Dill
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats, gluten-free", "60 g low-fat cottage cheese", "2 piece eggs, raw", "300 g egg whites", "200 g smoked salmon", "200 g spinach, fresh", "1 piece red onion", "200 ml low-fat milk", "60 g grated low-fat mozzarella", "10 g olive oil", "2 g dried dill", "2 g ground black pepper", "3 g fine salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C and line a quiche tin (about 22 cm) with baking paper. Blend the oats until finely ground, then mix with the cottage cheese and 1 g of the salt to form a crumbly base. Press the oat-cottage mixture into the bottom of the tin and bake for 10 minutes until it looks lightly golden. While the crust bakes, sauté the sliced red onion in the olive oil on medium heat for 4–5 minutes until soft, then add the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted; let it cool slightly. In a bowl, whisk the eggs, egg whites, milk, black pepper, dill, and the remaining 2 g salt. Spread the cooked spinach-onion mixture over the crust, scatter the smoked salmon, and sprinkle over the mozzarella. Pour in the egg mixture and bake for 30–35 minutes, until the center is set but still slightly springy and the top is lightly browned. Let the quiche cool for 10 minutes before slicing so it holds together.

title: Broccoli and Smoked Salmon Mini Quiches with Low-Fat Swiss
ingredients_json: ["2 tbsp Olive oil", "300 g Broccoli florets", "150 g Smoked salmon", "200 g Low-fat Swiss cheese", "6 piece Eggs, whole", "300 ml Low-fat milk, 1.5%", "1 piece Red onion", "1 tsp Salt, table", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 tbsp Fresh dill"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 180°C. Grease a muffin tin well with olive oil. Blanch the broccoli in boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain thoroughly. Finely slice the red onion and soften it in a small pan with the remaining olive oil for 3–4 minutes until slightly translucent. In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the milk, salt, pepper, and chopped dill until smooth. Divide the broccoli, onion, and smoked salmon between the muffin cups, then sprinkle over the grated Swiss cheese. Pour in the egg mixture until each cup is about three-quarters full. Bake for 20–25 minutes, until the tops are lightly golden and the center of the quiches is just set but still slightly springy. Let them cool for 5 minutes before removing from the tin and serving warm.

title: Spinach and Feta Mini Quiches with Oat Crust and Herb Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["60 g rolled oats, gluten-free", "1 tsp olive oil", "2 piece eggs, whole, raw", "200 g low-fat milk", "150 g spinach, fresh", "120 g feta cheese, reduced-fat, crumbled", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1/2 tsp ground black pepper", "1/2 tsp fine salt", "1 clove garlic"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C and grease a muffin tin. Blend the oats into a coarse flour, then mix with the olive oil and press about 1 tablespoon into the bottom of each muffin cup to form a thin crust. Sauté the garlic in a non-stick pan for 30 seconds, add the spinach, and cook until wilted and most moisture has evaporated, about 3–4 minutes. In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the milk, oregano, black pepper, and salt. Stir in the cooked spinach and the feta. Divide the filling among the muffin cups, filling them about 3/4 full. Bake for 18–22 minutes, until the centres are set and the tops are lightly golden. Let the mini quiches cool for 5 minutes, then serve with a spoonful of the Greek yogurt on top.

title: Wholemeal Oat & Berry Scones with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal spelt flour", "60 g rolled oats", "20 g baking powder", "15 g coconut sugar", "80 g unsalted butter, chilled", "1 piece egg, raw", "250 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2% fat", "1 dl milk, low-fat", "150 g frozen mixed berries", "5 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°C and line a baking tray with parchment. In a large bowl, mix the wholemeal spelt flour, rolled oats, baking powder, coconut sugar, and salt. Cut the chilled butter into small cubes and rub it into the dry ingredients with your fingertips until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. In a separate bowl, whisk the egg with the Greek yogurt and milk, then pour into the bowl with the dry mix and stir just until a soft dough forms. Gently fold in the frozen mixed berries, being careful not to overmix. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat it into a circle about 2.5 cm thick. Cut into 8 wedges and place them on the tray with a little space between each piece. Bake for 12–15 minutes until the scones are risen and golden around the edges. Let them cool for 5 minutes on the tray before serving warm.

title: Wholemeal Oat & Blueberry Scones with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["200 g wholemeal spelt flour", "60 g rolled oats", "30 g ground almonds", "10 g baking powder", "5 g fine salt", "60 g erythritol", "120 g cold unsalted butter", "200 g plain low-fat Greek yogurt", "120 ml buttermilk", "1 piece egg, raw", "150 g blueberries, fresh", "10 ml lemon juice", "5 g lemon zest"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a large bowl, mix the wholemeal spelt flour, rolled oats, ground almonds, baking powder, salt, and erythritol. Cut the cold butter into small cubes and rub it into the dry ingredients with your fingertips until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. In a separate bowl, whisk the Greek yogurt, buttermilk, egg, lemon juice, and lemon zest together, then pour into the dry mixture. Fold until a thick, slightly sticky dough forms, then gently fold in the blueberries so they don’t burst. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat it into a 2.5 cm thick round. Cut into 8 wedges, place on the tray, and bake for 14–18 minutes until risen and lightly golden on the edges. Let the scones cool for 5 minutes before serving for the best texture.

title: Wholemeal Oat & Greek Yogurt Scones with Blueberries
ingredients_json: ["180 g plain wholemeal flour", "80 g rolled oats", "70 g Greek yoghurt, non-fat", "200 ml semi-skimmed milk, 1.5%", "60 g unsalted butter, cold", "12 g baking powder", "2 g fine salt", "40 g honey", "180 g blueberries, fresh", "1 piece egg, raw"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C and line a baking tray with parchment. In a large bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, rolled oats, baking powder and salt. Rub the cold butter into the dry mixture with your fingertips until it looks like coarse crumbs. In another bowl, whisk the egg with the Greek yoghurt and honey, then add the milk and mix to form a thick, pourable batter. Stir the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients just until a rough dough forms, then fold in the blueberries carefully so they don’t burst. Turn the dough onto the tray and gently pat it into a round about 2.5–3 cm thick. Cut into 8 wedges and bake for 14–18 minutes until risen and golden on top. Let the scones cool for 5 minutes before serving, and they should feel firm but still tender in the middle.

title: Wholemeal Oat & Blueberry Scones with Greek Yogurt Glaze
ingredients_json: ["200 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "10 g baking powder", "1 g fine salt", "60 g light brown sugar", "120 g cold unsalted butter", "1 piece egg, raw", "200 g Greek yogurt, low fat", "150 g blueberries, fresh", "60 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "10 g lemon zest", "1 tsp vanilla extract"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a large bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, rolled oats, baking powder, salt, and light brown sugar. Rub the cold butter into the dry ingredients until the mixture looks like coarse breadcrumbs. In a separate bowl, whisk the egg with the Greek yogurt, milk, lemon zest, and vanilla extract, then pour into the bowl with the dry ingredients and mix just until a soft dough forms. Fold in the blueberries gently so they don’t burst. Tip the dough onto the tray, pat into a round about 2.5–3 cm thick, and cut into 8 wedges. Bake for 12–15 minutes until risen and golden at the edges. Cool for 5 minutes before serving so the scones set properly.

title: Wholemeal Berry Yogurt Scones with Oats and Lemon Zest
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholemeal self-raising flour", "60 g rolled oats", "40 g light brown sugar", "6 g baking powder", "2 g fine salt", "120 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "70 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "1 piece egg, raw", "60 g unsalted butter, chilled", "150 g mixed berries, fresh or frozen", "5 ml lemon juice", "2 g lemon zest", "10 g honey"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a large bowl, mix the wholemeal self-raising flour, rolled oats, light brown sugar, baking powder, and salt. Rub in the chilled butter with your fingertips until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. In a jug, whisk the Greek yogurt, semi-skimmed milk, and egg, then stir in the lemon juice and lemon zest. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and mix just until a thick dough forms. Fold in the mixed berries gently so they don’t break up. Shape the dough into a round about 2.5 cm thick, cut into 8 wedges, and place them on the tray. Drizzle the honey lightly over the tops and bake for 12–15 minutes until the scones have risen and are golden with lightly browned edges. Let them cool for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Whole-Grain Oat Yogurt Waffles with Blueberries and Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["150 g rolled oats", "200 g low-fat plain yogurt", "2 piece egg", "30 g olive oil", "1 tbsp baking powder", "1 tbsp ground flaxseed", "150 g blueberries, fresh or frozen", "1 tbsp honey", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "2 g fine salt"]
instructions: Grind the rolled oats briefly in a blender until they resemble coarse flour, then transfer to a bowl. Whisk in the baking powder, ground flaxseed, cinnamon, and salt. In a second bowl, whisk the eggs, yogurt, honey, and olive oil until smooth. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir just until the batter is thick and mostly smooth; let it sit for 5 minutes so the oats and flax can hydrate. Preheat a waffle iron and lightly grease it if needed. Spoon the batter into the iron and cook according to your waffle maker’s timing, usually 3–5 minutes, until the waffles are golden and crisp at the edges. Fold half the blueberries into the batter during the last minute of cooking, or sprinkle them on top right after cooking. Serve warm with the remaining blueberries.

title: Whole-Grain Oat Waffles with Banana and Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["150 g rolled oats", "120 ml milk, low-fat 1.5%", "2 piece egg, whole, raw", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "80 g banana, ripe, mashed", "30 g olive oil", "10 g baking powder", "5 g ground cinnamon", "3 g salt, iodized"]
instructions: Blend the rolled oats into a fine oat flour. In a mixing bowl, whisk the eggs with the low-fat milk, Greek yogurt, mashed banana, olive oil, cinnamon, and salt until smooth. Stir in the oat flour and baking powder and mix just until the batter looks thick and slightly lumpy. Preheat the waffle iron and lightly grease it if your iron isn’t nonstick. Cook the waffles for 3–5 minutes, or until the steam subsides and the outside is golden brown with crisp edges. Serve immediately, or keep warm on a rack while you finish the rest.

title: Wholegrain Oat & Banana Waffles with Greek Yogurt and Berries
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "1 piece egg, whole, raw", "200 g mashed banana", "200 g low-fat Greek yoghurt", "1 tbsp milk, semi-skimmed", "10 g baking powder", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "15 g honey", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Put the rolled oats into a blender and pulse until you get a coarse oat flour. In a bowl, whisk the egg with the mashed banana, Greek yoghurt, milk, honey, cinnamon, olive oil, and salt until smooth. Stir in the oat flour and baking powder and let the batter rest for 5 minutes so it thickens slightly. Preheat a waffle iron and lightly brush it with a small amount of oil. Spoon batter onto the hot iron and close the lid, cooking until the waffles are deeply golden and crisp, usually 3 to 5 minutes depending on your machine. Serve the waffles warm with extra Greek yoghurt and berries if you like.

title: Wholegrain Oat and Banana Protein Waffles with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "60 g wholemeal wheat flour", "2 tsp baking powder", "2 g ground cinnamon", "2 piece eggs, raw", "200 g banana, ripe, mashed", "250 ml skim milk", "150 g 0% Greek yogurt", "30 g honey", "1 tbsp olive oil", "3 g fine salt"]
instructions: Put the rolled oats in a blender and grind into a coarse flour. In a large bowl, mix the oat flour, wholemeal wheat flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and 1 g of the salt. In another bowl, whisk the eggs with the mashed banana, skim milk, Greek yogurt, and honey until smooth. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir just until the batter is combined and slightly thick. Let it rest for 5 minutes so the oats hydrate. Preheat your waffle iron on medium-high and lightly brush with the olive oil. Cook the waffles in batches for about 3 to 4 minutes each, until they are golden and crisp at the edges. Serve warm with any extra yogurt and a light dusting of cinnamon if desired.

title: Whole-Grain Zucchini Bread with Greek Yogurt and Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["250 g zucchini, grated", "200 g whole wheat flour", "120 g rolled oats", "80 g Greek yogurt, non-fat", "120 g eggs, whole", "60 ml olive oil", "80 g honey", "1 tbsp ground flaxseed", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp baking soda", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 g fine salt", "60 g walnuts, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C and line a loaf tin (about 20–22 cm) with baking paper. Grate the zucchini and squeeze it firmly in a clean towel to remove excess moisture. In a large bowl, whisk the eggs with the Greek yogurt, honey, and olive oil until smooth. Stir in the grated zucchini. In a separate bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, ground flaxseed, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt. Fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture just until no dry flour remains, then fold in the chopped walnuts. Pour the batter into the tin and bake for 45–55 minutes, until the top is golden and a skewer inserted in the center comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs. Let the bread cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool before slicing.

title: Zucchini-Carrot Oat Zucchini Breads with Greek Yogurt and Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["250 g zucchini, grated, squeezed dry", "150 g rolled oats", "120 g wholewheat flour", "2 large eggs, raw", "200 g Greek yogurt, low fat", "60 ml rapeseed oil", "80 g honey", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp bicarbonate of soda", "2 tsp ground cinnamon", "120 g carrots, grated", "1 g fine salt", "50 g walnuts, chopped", "20 g flaxseed, ground", "1 tsp vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C (conventional) and line a loaf tin or a small muffin tray with baking paper. Grate the zucchini and squeeze it well so the batter doesn’t turn watery, then mix it with the grated carrot. In a large bowl, whisk the eggs with the Greek yogurt, rapeseed oil, honey, and vanilla extract. In another bowl, combine the oats, wholewheat flour, ground cinnamon, baking powder, bicarbonate of soda, ground flaxseed, and salt. Stir the dry mixture into the wet ingredients until you get a thick batter, then fold in the squeezed zucchini and grated carrot. Gently stir through the chopped walnuts. Pour the batter into the tin and bake for about 40–50 minutes for a loaf (or 20–25 minutes for muffins) until the top is golden and a toothpick in the center comes out clean or with only a few moist crumbs. Let the zucchini breads cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool further before slicing.

title: Tomato-Garlic Oven Baked Beans with Smoked Paprika
ingredients_json: ["500 g canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed", "250 g canned chopped tomatoes", "120 g red onion, finely chopped", "3 cloves garlic, minced", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1.5 tbsp tomato paste", "300 ml vegetable stock, low-salt", "1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, reduced sugar", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp ground cumin", "0.5 tsp dried thyme", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "2.0 g salt", "20 g cheddar cheese, reduced-fat, grated", "10 g fresh parsley, chopped"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 180°C. In a large ovenproof dish, warm the olive oil over medium heat and cook the onion for 6 to 8 minutes until soft and slightly golden. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then mix in the tomato paste, smoked paprika, cumin, and thyme until fragrant. Add the chopped tomatoes, vegetable stock, Worcestershire sauce, drained kidney beans, pepper, and salt, stirring well. Cover the dish and bake for 45 minutes, then uncover and bake for another 20 minutes until the sauce has thickened and the beans are tender. Sprinkle with the grated reduced-fat cheddar and chopped parsley, then bake for 5 minutes more so the cheese melts slightly. Let it stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Smoky Tomato Baked Beans with Lean Turkey and Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["400 g canned haricot beans, drained and rinsed", "200 g canned chopped tomatoes, no salt added", "120 g turkey mince, lean (5% fat)", "80 g onion, diced", "120 g bell pepper, diced", "2 cloves garlic, minced (6 g)", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp ground cumin", "0.5 tsp dried oregano", "300 ml vegetable stock, low salt", "10 g grated carrot"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C. In a deep ovenproof dish or casserole, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the onion and bell pepper for 6–8 minutes until softened. Add the turkey mince and cook for 6–7 minutes, breaking it up until no longer pink. Stir in the garlic, tomato paste, smoked paprika, cumin, and oregano, then cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the drained haricot beans, chopped tomatoes, grated carrot, and pour over the vegetable stock. Stir well, bring to a gentle simmer on the stove, then cover and bake in the oven for 35 minutes. Uncover and bake for a further 15 minutes to thicken, stirring once halfway through, and serve when the sauce is glossy and the beans are tender.

title: Smoky Tomato Baked Beans with Turkey, Onion and Bell Pepper
ingredients_json: ["420 g canned haricot beans, drained and rinsed", "150 g turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "1 unit onion, yellow (about 150 g), diced", "1 unit bell pepper, red (about 170 g), diced", "2 cloves garlic, minced (about 6 g)", "300 g passata (tomato purée)", "1 tbsp olive oil (15 ml)", "1 tsp smoked paprika (3 g)", "0.5 tsp dried oregano (1 g)", "2 g ground black pepper", "3 g table salt", "1.2 dl water (120 ml)"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a heavy oven-safe casserole dish over medium heat. Add the diced onion and bell pepper and cook for 6–8 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the turkey mince and cook for 6–7 minutes until browned. Sprinkle over the smoked paprika and oregano, then pour in the passata and add the rinsed haricot beans. Add the water, season with black pepper and salt, stir well, and bring to a gentle simmer. Cover and bake in the oven at 180°C for 35 minutes, then uncover and bake for another 15 minutes to thicken. Let it stand for 5 minutes before serving; the beans should look glossy and saucy, not watery.

title: Tomato & Smoked Paprika Baked Beans with Courgette and Lean Bacon
ingredients_json: ["400 g canned haricot beans, drained and rinsed", "150 g canned chopped tomatoes", "180 g courgette, diced", "120 g red onion, diced", "10 g olive oil", "80 g lean smoked bacon, diced", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "1.5 g smoked paprika", "2 g ground black pepper", "3 g fine salt", "300 ml vegetable stock, low salt", "15 g balsamic vinegar"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 170°C (fan 150°C). In a large ovenproof dish, warm the olive oil over medium heat and cook the diced bacon until lightly browned and the fat is starting to render. Add the onion and courgette and cook for 6–8 minutes until the onion softens. Stir in the garlic and smoked paprika and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the drained beans, chopped tomatoes, vegetable stock, black pepper and salt, then bring to a gentle simmer. Remove from the hob, stir through the balsamic vinegar, cover with a lid or foil and bake for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake for a further 15 minutes, stirring once, until the sauce thickens and the beans are tender. Let it stand for 5 minutes before serving so the sauce settles.

title: Smoky Tomato Baked Beans with Turkey and Roasted Peppers
ingredients_json: ["500 g canned baked beans, no added sugar, drained", "200 g canned chopped tomatoes, no added sugar", "150 g lean minced turkey", "1 medium onion, raw, chopped", "2 cloves garlic, raw, minced", "200 g red bell pepper, raw, diced", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp ground black pepper", "0.5 tsp fine salt", "300 ml vegetable stock, low salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe casserole over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 to 7 minutes until softened. Add the minced turkey and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until no longer pink. Stir in the garlic, smoked paprika and dried thyme, then add the diced red pepper and cook for 3 minutes. Pour in the chopped tomatoes and vegetable stock, add the drained baked beans, and season with fine salt and black pepper. Cover and bake for 45 minutes, then remove the lid and bake for another 15 minutes until the sauce is thick and the top looks slightly reduced. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Hearty Lean Beef and Barley Stew with Root Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["450 g beef stewing steak, lean", "60 g pearl barley, dry", "1 pc onion, yellow", "2 pc carrots", "250 g potato, white", "2 pc celery sticks", "2 clove garlic", "2 tbsp olive oil", "750 ml beef stock, low-salt", "400 g chopped tomatoes, canned", "10 g tomato paste", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 tsp salt", "10 ml Worcestershire sauce"]
instructions: Dice the beef into 2–3 cm pieces and pat it dry. Heat the olive oil in a large heavy pot over medium-high heat, then brown the beef in batches for about 5–7 minutes, turning occasionally, until the surface is deeply coloured. Add the diced onion, sliced carrots, chopped celery, and cook for 5 minutes until the vegetables begin to soften. Stir in the garlic, tomato paste, thyme, and smoked paprika, and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the pearl barley, chopped potato, chopped tomatoes, and low-salt beef stock, then bring to a gentle simmer. Cover and cook on low heat for 35–45 minutes, stirring once or twice so the barley doesn’t stick, until the barley is tender and the stew has thickened. Stir in the Worcestershire sauce and black pepper, taste, and adjust seasoning if needed before serving hot.

title: Red Wine & Rosemary Lean Beef Stew with Root Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["450 g lean beef stewing steak", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion", "2 cloves garlic", "2 piece carrots", "300 g potatoes", "200 g celeriac", "150 g mushrooms", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "5 dl red wine", "7 dl beef stock, low salt", "1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce", "1 tbsp dried rosemary", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 tsp salt"]
instructions: Cut the lean beef into 2 cm cubes. Heat the olive oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches until deeply coloured on the outside, then remove it to a plate. Add the chopped onion and carrots to the pot and cook for 5 minutes, stirring, until the onion softens. Stir in the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Return the beef to the pot, add the mushrooms, celeriac and potatoes, then pour in the red wine and simmer for 5 minutes to reduce slightly. Add the low-salt beef stock, Worcestershire sauce and dried rosemary, season with black pepper and salt, and bring everything to a steady simmer. Cover and cook gently for 70 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the beef is tender and the vegetables are soft. Uncover for the last 10 minutes if the stew looks too thin; serve hot with plenty of sauce.

title: Herby Lean Beef and Barley Stew with Carrots & Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["500 g lean beef chuck, trimmed", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion, yellow, chopped", "2 cloves garlic, crushed", "2 medium carrots, sliced", "200 g mushrooms, sliced", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "300 g chopped tomatoes (canned), with juice", "700 ml beef stock, reduced-salt", "150 g pearl barley, uncooked", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp dried rosemary", "1 bay leaf", "10 g fresh parsley, chopped", "5 g salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large heavy pot over medium-high heat. Add the beef and brown it in batches until well coloured on all sides, then transfer to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium, add the onion and cook for 5 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic, carrots, and mushrooms, cooking for another 5 minutes. Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then return the browned beef to the pot. Pour in the chopped tomatoes and reduced-salt beef stock, add the thyme, rosemary, and bay leaf, and bring the stew to a gentle simmer. Stir in the pearl barley, cover, and simmer on low for 45–55 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the barley is tender and the beef is fully cooked. Remove the bay leaf, check the seasoning, and stir in the chopped parsley right before serving.

title: Light Beef Stroganoff with Mushrooms and Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["450 g beef sirloin, lean, trimmed", "250 g cremini mushrooms", "1 medium onion", "2 cloves garlic", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 tbsp whole wheat flour", "400 ml low-sodium beef stock", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain 2%", "1 tsp Dijon mustard", "200 g egg noodles, whole-wheat (dry)", "20 g fresh parsley", "0.5 tsp salt", "0.25 tsp black pepper"]
instructions: Cut the beef into thin strips. Clean the mushrooms and slice them. Finely chop the onion and mince the garlic. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the beef for 2–3 minutes until it is lightly seared but not fully cooked through; remove it to a plate. In the same pan, sauté the onion and mushrooms for 6–8 minutes until the mushrooms release their moisture and turn golden. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Sprinkle over the whole wheat flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring to form a light roux. Pour in the beef stock and bring to a gentle simmer, cooking for 5 minutes until slightly thickened. Lower the heat to low and whisk the Greek yogurt with Dijon mustard, then stir it into the sauce slowly. Return the beef to the pan and warm through for 2–3 minutes, avoiding a rapid boil so the yogurt doesn’t split. Season with salt and black pepper. Meanwhile, cook the whole-wheat egg noodles according to package directions until tender, then drain. Serve the stroganoff over the noodles and finish with chopped parsley.

title: Creamy Beef Stroganoff with Mushrooms and Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["450 g lean beef sirloin, sliced", "250 g mushrooms, cremini, sliced", "1 medium onion, raw, diced", "2 cloves garlic, raw, minced", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 tbsp plain flour, whole wheat", "300 ml low-salt beef stock", "150 g 0% Greek yogurt", "1 tbsp Dijon mustard", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1/2 tsp black pepper, ground", "1/2 tsp salt", "250 g wholegrain egg noodles, dry", "1 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped"]
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet or sauté pan over medium-high heat. Add the sliced beef in a single layer and sear for 3–4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned; remove the beef to a plate. Add the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil, then cook the onion for 4–5 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic and mushrooms and cook for 6–8 minutes, until the mushrooms release their moisture and it mostly evaporates. Sprinkle in the whole wheat flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring to coat everything. Pour in the low-salt beef stock while stirring, then add Dijon mustard, tomato paste, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. Simmer gently for 4–6 minutes until the sauce thickens. Lower the heat to low and stir in the Greek yogurt, mixing until smooth; avoid boiling. Return the beef to the pan and warm through for 2 minutes. Meanwhile, cook the wholegrain egg noodles according to package instructions in salted water, then drain. Toss the noodles with the stroganoff sauce, garnish with chopped parsley, and serve hot.

title: Herb-Roasted Beef Tenderloin with Garlic-Lemon Green Beans and Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["500 g beef tenderloin, trimmed", "300 g brown rice, dry", "500 g green beans", "200 g cherry tomatoes", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 tbsp Dijon mustard", "2 cloves garlic", "1 pc lemon, whole", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "10 g sea salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C. Rinse the green beans and pat them dry, then halve the cherry tomatoes and mince the garlic. Mix the olive oil, Dijon mustard, minced garlic, lemon zest and juice, dried thyme, black pepper, and 6 g of the sea salt into a thick paste. Rub the beef tenderloin all over with the paste, then place it on a roasting tray and roast for 18–24 minutes, until the thickest part reaches your preferred doneness (about 54–58°C for medium-rare). While the beef roasts, cook the brown rice according to the package directions using 10 g of salt for the cooking water. Add the green beans and tomatoes to the rice for the final 6–8 minutes of cooking so they steam through and stay bright. Let the beef rest for 10 minutes, slice it, and serve with the garlic-lemon rice and vegetables. Taste and adjust seasoning with the remaining 4 g sea salt if needed.

title: Pepper-Crusted Beef Tenderloin with Garlic Herb Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["500 g beef tenderloin", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 tsp Dijon mustard", "2 tsp wholegrain mustard", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 tsp sea salt", "3 cloves garlic", "400 g carrots", "300 g zucchini", "250 g cherry tomatoes", "1 tbsp fresh thyme", "2 dl low-sodium beef stock", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "10 g cornstarch"]
instructions: Pat the beef tenderloin dry, then rub it all over with olive oil, Dijon mustard, wholegrain mustard, ground black pepper, and sea salt. Heat a heavy skillet over high heat until very hot, then sear the tenderloin for 2 minutes per side to form a dark crust. Turn the heat down to medium and continue cooking for about 6–10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the center reaches your preferred doneness. Remove the beef to a plate and let it rest while you cook the vegetables. In the same skillet, add the chopped garlic and sauté for 30–45 seconds until fragrant. Add carrots cut into sticks and cook for 6–7 minutes, then add zucchini and cook for another 4–5 minutes. Add cherry tomatoes, thyme, and low-sodium beef stock, and simmer for 3–4 minutes until the vegetables are glossy and tender. Stir lemon juice through the sauce, then whisk cornstarch with 1 tablespoon cold water and stir it into the simmering pan until the sauce lightly thickens. Slice the rested beef and serve with the garlic herb vegetables and the reduced pan sauce.
