title: Herb-Roasted Beef Tenderloin with Garlic Lemon Asparagus and Sweet Potato
ingredients_json: ["600 g beef tenderloin, trimmed", "250 g sweet potato, peeled and cut into 2 cm cubes", "300 g asparagus, trimmed", "20 g olive oil", "10 g fresh garlic, minced", "15 ml lemon juice", "5 g fresh rosemary, chopped", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g sea salt", "150 g low-fat Greek yogurt, plain 2%"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C. Toss the sweet potato cubes with 10 g olive oil, half the minced garlic, half the rosemary, 1 g of salt, and 1 g of black pepper, then spread on a baking tray and roast for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, heat a large oven-safe skillet over high heat and pat the beef tenderloin dry. Rub the tenderloin with the remaining rosemary, the remaining garlic, 1 g salt, and 1 g black pepper, then sear in the hot skillet for 2–3 minutes per side until browned. After the sweet potatoes have roasted for 20 minutes, add the tenderloin to the tray (or transfer the skillet to the oven) and roast until the thickest part reaches 54–56°C for medium-rare, about 10–14 minutes more. In the last 8 minutes of cooking, toss the asparagus with 10 ml lemon juice and 10 g olive oil, then place it on the tray to roast until bright green and tender-crisp. Stir the Greek yogurt with the remaining lemon juice, a pinch of salt (0.5 g), and black pepper. Rest the beef for 8 minutes, then slice and serve with the roasted sweet potato, asparagus, and a spoonful of lemon-herb yogurt on the side.

title: Herb-Crusted Beef Tenderloin with Garlic Lemon Greens
ingredients_json: ["600 g beef tenderloin, trimmed", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 g sea salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "10 g fresh rosemary, finely chopped", "8 g fresh thyme, finely chopped", "4 cloves garlic, fresh", "1 dl lemon juice", "20 g Dijon mustard", "500 g broccoli florets", "300 g baby spinach", "150 g cherry tomatoes", "15 ml balsamic vinegar"]
instructions: Pat the beef tenderloin dry and rub it with olive oil, sea salt, black pepper, rosemary, thyme, and crushed garlic. Mix the lemon juice with the Dijon mustard, then brush a thin layer over the meat. Sear the tenderloin in a hot pan over high heat for 2 minutes per side until nicely browned. Transfer to a preheated oven at 200°C and roast for about 15–20 minutes, until the center reaches your preferred doneness (for medium-rare, it should feel springy and be about 55–57°C in the thickest part). While the beef roasts, steam the broccoli for 5–7 minutes until bright green and tender-crisp. In the same pan, warm the balsamic vinegar, then sauté the cherry tomatoes for 2–3 minutes and fold in the spinach until just wilted. When the beef is done, rest it for 8–10 minutes, then slice and serve with the garlic lemon greens and any resting juices from the meat over the vegetables.

title: Herb-Roasted Beef Tenderloin with Lemon-Garlic Asparagus and Quinoa
ingredients_json: ["600 g beef tenderloin, trimmed", "2 tbsp olive oil", "300 g quinoa, dry", "600 ml vegetable stock, low salt", "300 g asparagus, trimmed", "250 g cherry tomatoes", "2 clove garlic", "1 pc lemon, zest and juice", "15 g fresh parsley, chopped", "5 g dried thyme", "6 g fine salt", "3 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C. Rinse the quinoa and then add it to a pot with the vegetable stock; bring to a boil, reduce to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes until the grains are tender and the liquid is absorbed. Meanwhile, pat the beef tenderloin dry and rub it with 1 tbsp olive oil, half the lemon zest, thyme, black pepper, and 2 g of the salt. Heat a hot skillet with the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil and sear the tenderloin for 2 minutes per side until browned, then transfer it to a roasting tray and roast for about 15–20 minutes, until the thickest part reaches your preferred doneness (aim for 55–60°C for medium-rare; check with a thermometer). Let the beef rest for 10 minutes while you roast the vegetables: toss asparagus and cherry tomatoes with garlic (minced), lemon juice, parsley, and 1 g salt, then roast for 12–15 minutes at 220°C until the asparagus is tender-crisp and the tomatoes burst. Stir the remaining lemon zest into the cooked quinoa and loosen with a splash of hot water if needed. Slice the beef and serve with quinoa and roasted asparagus and tomatoes.

title: Beetroot and Vegetable Borscht with Lentils and Dill
ingredients_json: ["1 tbsp Olive oil", "150 g Onion, yellow", "120 g Carrot", "120 g Celery stalk", "2 cloves Garlic", "300 g Beetroot, raw", "1 tbsp Tomato paste", "200 g White cabbage", "120 g Red lentils, dry", "900 ml Vegetable stock, low-salt", "200 g Potatoes, white", "200 g Canned tomatoes, chopped (in juice)", "1 tbsp Apple cider vinegar", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "1 tsp Ground black pepper", "1 tsp Salt", "10 g Fresh dill"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion, carrot, and celery and cook for 7 to 9 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute to deepen the flavor. Add the grated beetroot, cabbage, diced potatoes, lentils, thyme, black pepper, canned tomatoes, and vegetable stock. Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are tender and the soup has thickened slightly. Add the apple cider vinegar and salt, then simmer for 2 more minutes. Turn off the heat and stir in the fresh dill right before serving.

title: Beetroot and Vegetable Borscht with Lentils and Dill
ingredients_json: ["220 g raw beetroot, peeled", "130 g white cabbage, shredded", "180 g carrots, peeled", "120 g onion, peeled", "120 g red potatoes, unpeeled", "60 g red lentils, dry", "20 g tomato paste", "900 ml vegetable stock, low-salt", "500 ml water", "15 ml olive oil", "12 g garlic, minced", "10 g fresh dill, chopped", "10 ml apple cider vinegar", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "100 g plain Greek yogurt, 2%"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and carrots and cook for about 5 minutes until the onion softens. Stir in the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute to deepen the color. Add the beetroot, potatoes, shredded cabbage, and dry red lentils, then pour in the vegetable stock and water. Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook for 25–30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are tender and the vegetables are cooked through. Season with salt and black pepper, then stir in the apple cider vinegar and fresh dill. Serve hot with a spoon of Greek yogurt on top for creaminess.

title: Beetroot & Lentil Borscht with Carrot, Cabbage and Dill
ingredients_json: ["300 g beetroot, raw, peeled", "150 g red onion", "120 g carrot", "200 g red potatoes", "250 g white cabbage", "120 g dried red lentils, dry", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 cloves garlic", "1.2 l vegetable stock, low-salt", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "1 tsp dried bay leaves", "1 tbsp apple cider vinegar", "10 g fresh dill", "2 g ground black pepper", "4 g salt"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the red onion and carrot and cook for about 6–8 minutes, stirring, until the vegetables soften. Stir in the garlic, tomato paste, and chopped tomatoes, then cook for 2 minutes to deepen the flavour. Add the diced beetroot and potatoes, pour in the low-salt vegetable stock, and bring everything to a gentle boil. Stir in the dried red lentils and bay leaves, then reduce to a simmer and cook for 18–22 minutes until the lentils are tender and the soup starts to thicken slightly. Add the shredded cabbage and simmer for another 6–8 minutes until it is just tender. Turn off the heat, stir in the apple cider vinegar and chopped dill, and season with black pepper. Let the borscht stand for 5 minutes before serving so the flavours meld.

title: Tomato Basil Bruschetta with White Bean Mash and Mozzarella
ingredients_json: ["320 g cherry tomatoes", "2 cloves garlic", "3 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp balsamic vinegar", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp sea salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper", "400 g canned cannellini beans, drained and rinsed", "150 g low-fat mozzarella, grated", "150 g wholegrain bread, sliced", "25 g fresh basil", "1 tbsp lemon juice"]
instructions:
Preheat the oven to 220°C. Halve the cherry tomatoes and place them in a bowl. Finely grate the garlic and stir it through with 2 tbsp olive oil, balsamic vinegar, dried oregano, 1/2 tsp sea salt, and black pepper. Toss well and spread the tomatoes on a baking tray. Roast for 12–15 minutes until the tomatoes burst and lightly caramelize at the edges.
Meanwhile, mash the cannellini beans with a fork or potato masher with the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil, the lemon juice, and the remaining 1/2 tsp sea salt. Toast the wholegrain bread slices in the oven for 4–6 minutes until crisp and golden. Spoon a layer of the bean mash over the toast, top with the roasted tomatoes, and finish with grated mozzarella.
Return the bruschetta to the oven for 3–5 minutes until the mozzarella melts. Scatter with torn fresh basil and serve right away while warm.

title: Wholegrain Bruschetta with Garlic, Tomato-Basil Salsa and Grilled Halloumi
ingredients_json: ["4 slices Wholegrain bread", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 cloves Garlic", "300 g Tomatoes, ripe, chopped", "50 g Red onion, finely chopped", "1 tbsp Balsamic vinegar", "10 g Fresh basil, chopped", "1 piece Lemon, juice", "200 g Halloumi, grilled", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "0.5 tsp Salt"]
instructions: Preheat a grill pan or oven grill to medium-high. Brush the bread slices with 1 tbsp of the olive oil and toast them until golden and crisp, about 2–3 minutes per side, watching so they don’t burn. Heat the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil in a small pan, add the chopped onion, and cook for 3–4 minutes until softened. Add garlic and oregano and cook for 30 seconds, then stir in the tomatoes, balsamic vinegar, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper. Simmer gently for 6–8 minutes until the mixture is thick and glossy. While the salsa simmers, grill the halloumi for 1–2 minutes per side until browned. Top the toasted bread with the warm tomato-basil salsa and finish with grilled halloumi. Sprinkle with fresh basil and serve immediately while the bread is still crisp.

title: Whole-Grain Bruschetta with Herby Tomato, Mozzarella & White Beans
ingredients_json: ["240 g whole-grain bread, sliced", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 cloves garlic", "400 g tomatoes, chopped", "1 tsp balsamic vinegar", "120 g canned cannellini beans, drained and rinsed", "125 g mozzarella, part-skim, grated", "30 g fresh basil, chopped", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C. Toast the whole-grain bread slices on a baking tray for 8–10 minutes until crisp and lightly golden. While the bread toasts, heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a pan over medium heat and sauté the crushed garlic for 30–45 seconds until fragrant, being careful not to brown it. Add the chopped tomatoes, balsamic vinegar, oregano, black pepper, and 1 g of the salt. Simmer for 10 minutes until the mixture thickens slightly. Stir in the cannellini beans and cook for 2–3 minutes to warm through, then turn off the heat and fold in most of the basil. Rub the toasted bread with a little of the remaining garlic oil from the pan, spoon the tomato-bean topping over the slices, and sprinkle with grated mozzarella. Return to the oven for 3–4 minutes until the cheese melts. Finish with the remaining basil and serve immediately.

title: Tomato-Basil Bruschetta with White Bean Mash and Balsamic Glaze
ingredients_json: ["2 slices Whole-grain bread", "200 g Canned chickpeas, drained and rinsed", "1 clove Garlic", "2 tbsp Extra-virgin olive oil", "1 medium Tomato, ripe, diced", "1 tbsp Balsamic vinegar", "1 tbsp Fresh basil", "1 tsp Lemon juice", "0.5 tsp Sea salt", "0.25 tsp Black pepper"]
instructions: Toast the whole-grain bread in a skillet or oven at 200°C until golden and crisp, about 4–6 minutes, then rub the warm toast lightly with the garlic clove. In a bowl, mash the drained chickpeas with 1 tbsp olive oil and the lemon juice until mostly smooth but still slightly chunky. Stir in half the basil and half the diced tomato, then season with black pepper and a small portion of the salt. In a small pan, warm the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil and add the rest of the diced tomato for 2–3 minutes until glossy and slightly softened; turn off the heat and stir in the balsamic vinegar. Spread the chickpea mash over the toast, spoon over the tomato-balsamic topping, and finish with remaining basil and a final pinch of salt if needed.

title: Tomato-Basil Bruschetta with White Bean Purée, Olive Oil and Feta
ingredients_json: ["4 slices Wholegrain bread", "300 g Cherry tomatoes, halved", "60 g Cannellini beans, cooked and drained", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tbsp Balsamic vinegar", "1 clove Garlic, minced", "30 g Feta cheese, reduced-fat", "20 g Fresh basil, chopped", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "2 g Salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°C. Toast the wholegrain bread slices on a baking tray for 6–8 minutes, until crisp and lightly golden. Meanwhile, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a small pan, add the minced garlic and cook for 30–45 seconds until fragrant. Add the cannellini beans and mash with a fork, then stir in half of the chopped basil and black pepper. In a bowl, mix the cherry tomatoes with balsamic vinegar, the remaining basil, and 1 g of salt. Crumble the feta. Spread the warm white bean purée over the toasted bread, top with the tomato mixture, and finish with feta. Return to the oven for 2–3 minutes so the tomatoes warm through and the feta softens slightly. Serve immediately with any juices from the bowl.

title: Oven-Baked Buffalo Chicken Wings with Greek Yogurt Ranch Dip
ingredients_json: ["900 g chicken wings, skin-on", "10 g olive oil", "2 g fine salt", "2 g black pepper", "4 g garlic powder", "6 g smoked paprika", "120 g hot buffalo sauce", "30 g unsalted butter", "200 g plain Greek yogurt, low-fat", "15 g lime juice", "10 g apple cider vinegar", "6 g dried parsley", "1 g onion powder", "1 g garlic powder", "150 g carrots, sliced into sticks", "150 g celery, sliced into sticks"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Pat the chicken wings dry, then toss them with olive oil, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika. Arrange the wings in a single layer and bake for 35 minutes, then flip them and bake for another 15 minutes until the skin is crisp and the juices run clear when pierced. Meanwhile, warm the buffalo sauce and butter together in a small saucepan over low heat until glossy and fully combined. Toss the hot, baked wings in the buffalo sauce and return them to the oven for 5 minutes so the coating sets. Mix the Greek yogurt with lime juice, apple cider vinegar, dried parsley, onion powder, and garlic powder to make a thick ranch-style dip. Serve the buffalo wings with the yogurt dip and crunchy carrot and celery sticks.

title: Oven-Baked Buffalo Chicken Wings with Greek Yogurt Blue Cheese Dip
ingredients_json: ["900 g chicken wing pieces, skin-on", "30 g olive oil", "10 g smoked paprika", "5 g garlic powder", "6 g fine salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "80 ml hot sauce (buffalo-style)", "60 g unsalted butter", "250 g plain Greek yogurt, 2% fat", "60 g crumbled blue cheese", "15 g apple cider vinegar", "5 g Worcestershire sauce", "20 g celery, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°C. Pat the chicken wings dry with paper towels, then toss them with olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper until evenly coated. Arrange the wings in a single layer on a wire rack set over a baking tray, and bake for 25 minutes, until the underside is starting to brown. Flip the wings and bake for another 20–25 minutes, until the coating is crisp and the thickest part reaches 74°C. While the wings cook, melt the butter gently with the hot sauce in a small saucepan, just until glossy, then keep warm. Toss the baked wings in the buffalo sauce until fully coated, then return them to the rack for 5 minutes so the glaze sets. For the dip, stir Greek yogurt, crumbled blue cheese, apple cider vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, and chopped celery until smooth and tangy. Serve the wings hot with the dip on the side.

title: Oven-Baked Buffalo Chicken Wings with Greek Yogurt Blue Cheese Dip
ingredients_json: ["900 g chicken wings, raw, skin-on", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 tsp salt", "1 tsp black pepper", "2 tbsp baking powder", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "60 g blue cheese, reduced-fat", "2 tbsp buffalo hot sauce", "1 tbsp white wine vinegar", "400 g carrots, baby, whole", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp garlic powder"]
instructions: Heat your oven to 220°C and place a wire rack over a baking tray. Pat the chicken wings dry, then toss them with olive oil, salt, black pepper, and baking powder until evenly coated. Arrange the wings on the rack in a single layer and bake for 30 minutes until the edges are starting to crisp. Increase the heat to 240°C and bake for another 15 to 20 minutes until deeply golden and crisp. While the wings bake, mix the Greek yogurt, reduced-fat blue cheese, buffalo hot sauce, and white wine vinegar into a smooth dip. For the carrots, toss the baby carrots with olive oil, smoked paprika, and garlic powder, spread them on a second tray, and roast at 220°C for 20 to 25 minutes until tender and caramelized. Toss the crisp wings with a little extra buffalo hot sauce, serve immediately with the Greek yogurt blue cheese dip and the roasted carrots, and enjoy the classic tangy heat.

title: Oven-Baked Buffalo Chicken Wings with Greek Yogurt Ranch Dip
ingredients_json: ["900 g chicken wings, skin-on", "20 g olive oil", "10 g baking powder", "5 g fine salt", "3 g black pepper", "250 g buffalo hot sauce", "30 g unsalted butter", "200 g plain Greek yogurt, 2%", "15 g lime juice", "10 g apple cider vinegar", "6 g garlic, minced", "5 g fresh dill, chopped", "1 g smoked paprika", "300 g carrot sticks", "200 g celery sticks"]
instructions: Heat your oven to 220°C and place a wire rack over a baking tray. Pat the chicken wings dry, then toss them with olive oil, baking powder, salt, and black pepper. Spread the wings on the rack in a single layer and bake for 25 minutes, until the surfaces look drier and starting to brown. Melt the butter with the buffalo hot sauce, then brush or toss the wings thoroughly in the buffalo mixture. Return the wings to the oven and bake for another 15–18 minutes, until the wings are deep golden and the juices run clear when you cut into the thickest part. While the wings finish, mix the Greek yogurt with lime juice, apple cider vinegar, minced garlic, dill, and smoked paprika to make a cool dip. Serve the buffalo wings hot with the yogurt dip and crunchy carrot and celery sticks.

title: Oven-Baked Buffalo Chicken Wings with Greek Yogurt Ranch Dip
ingredients_json: ["800 g chicken wings, skin-on, raw", "2 tbsp cornstarch", "1 tsp fine salt", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 ml neutral cooking oil", "120 g buffalo hot sauce", "20 g unsalted butter", "250 g Greek yogurt, plain 2%", "1 tbsp apple cider vinegar", "1 tsp garlic powder", "1 tsp onion powder", "1 tsp dried dill", "40 g carrots, grated", "200 g celery, diced", "300 g baby potatoes"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C and line a large tray with baking paper. Pat the chicken wings dry, then toss them with cornstarch, salt, and smoked paprika until evenly coated. Spread the wings on the tray in a single layer, lightly drizzle with the cooking oil, and bake for 25 minutes. In a small pan, melt the butter with the buffalo hot sauce and keep it warm. Turn the wings, then bake for another 20 minutes until they look crisp and deeply browned. Toss the hot wings thoroughly in the buffalo mixture, return them to the tray, and bake for 5 minutes so the coating sets. While the wings finish, microwave or boil the baby potatoes until tender, then briefly cool and serve alongside. Stir the Greek yogurt with apple cider vinegar, garlic powder, onion powder, and dried dill for a tangy ranch-style dip. Serve the buffalo wings with the Greek yogurt dip and the grated carrot and diced celery for crunch.

title: Lean Beef Bulgogi with Sesame-Ginger Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["500 g lean beef sirloin, thinly sliced", "1 tbsp sesame oil", "30 g reduced-sodium soy sauce", "30 g Korean gochujang", "3 tbsp brown sugar", "3 cloves garlic, minced", "25 g fresh ginger, grated", "2 tbsp rice vinegar", "1 tsp toasted sesame seeds", "300 g broccoli florets", "200 g bell pepper, red, sliced", "200 g carrot, julienned", "1 tbsp cornstarch", "200 ml water"]
instructions: In a bowl, mix the soy sauce, gochujang, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and sesame seeds. Add the thinly sliced beef and stir until each piece is coated, then let it marinate while you prep the vegetables. Heat a large non-stick skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add the beef and marinade and cook for 4 to 6 minutes, stirring frequently, until the beef is browned and cooked through. Add the broccoli, bell pepper, and carrot, then pour in the water mixed with cornstarch and stir well. Cook for another 3 to 5 minutes until the vegetables are crisp-tender and the sauce lightly thickens and clings to the meat. Serve hot, with the sauce glossy and evenly coating the beef.

title: Lean Chicken Bulgogi with Brown Rice and Sesame-Ginger Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["500 g chicken breast, raw", "250 g brown rice, dry", "250 g red bell pepper", "200 g onion, yellow", "180 g carrot", "4 cloves garlic", "20 g fresh ginger", "80 ml soy sauce, reduced salt", "60 ml mirin", "25 g brown sugar", "15 ml sesame oil", "20 g sesame seeds", "10 ml rice vinegar", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to the package instructions until tender, then keep warm. Slice the chicken thinly and place it in a bowl with the grated garlic and ginger, reduced-salt soy sauce, mirin, brown sugar, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and ground black pepper. Marinate for 15 minutes while you prep the vegetables. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the marinated chicken, spreading it out so it sears rather than steams. Stir and cook for 5–7 minutes until the chicken is browned and cooked through. Add the onion, bell pepper, and carrot (cut into thin matchsticks) and stir-fry for 4–5 minutes until the vegetables are crisp-tender and glossy with the sauce. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and toss once more for 30 seconds. Serve the chicken bulgogi over the brown rice.

title: Lean Beef Bulgogi Lettuce-Wraps with Sesame and Lime
ingredients_json: ["450 g beef sirloin, lean, sliced", "180 g white onion, thinly sliced", "150 g carrot, julienned", "200 g shiitake mushrooms, sliced", "200 g red bell pepper, thinly sliced", "300 g cooked brown rice", "30 g soy sauce, reduced salt", "20 g soy sauce, reduced salt", "35 g low-sodium beef stock", "40 g pear, grated", "10 g garlic, minced", "15 g ginger, grated", "15 g sesame oil", "12 g gochujang", "10 g toasted sesame seeds", "10 g rice vinegar", "5 g lime juice", "5 g lime zest"]
instructions: Heat a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add 10 g of the sesame oil and sear the sliced beef in a single layer for 2–3 minutes, stirring only enough to brown the edges. Add onion, carrot, mushrooms, and red bell pepper, then cook for 6–8 minutes until the vegetables soften and the mushrooms release their moisture. In a bowl, mix the reduced-salt soy sauce, beef stock, grated pear, minced garlic, grated ginger, gochujang, rice vinegar, lime juice, and lime zest. Pour the sauce into the pan and simmer for 2–3 minutes until it turns glossy and clings to the beef and vegetables. Stir in the toasted sesame seeds, then serve the bulgogi hot over the cooked brown rice.

title: Turkey & Oat Burgers with Smoky Tomato Chutney and Roasted Veg
ingredients_json: ["500 g turkey mince, 5% fat", "40 g rolled oats", "1 piece egg, whole, raw", "1 g garlic, fresh", "1 g onion powder", "5 g smoked paprika", "3 g ground black pepper", "3 g fine salt", "1 tbsp olive oil", "4 pieces wholegrain burger buns", "250 g cherry tomatoes", "150 g red bell pepper", "200 g courgette", "1 tbsp olive oil", "15 ml balsamic vinegar", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "10 g fresh coriander, chopped"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C and line a tray with baking paper. Dice the courgette and red bell pepper and halve the cherry tomatoes. Toss the vegetables with 1 tbsp olive oil, then spread them on the tray and roast for 18–22 minutes until the edges are nicely browned. While the vegetables roast, mix the turkey mince, rolled oats, egg, garlic, onion powder, smoked paprika, black pepper, and salt in a bowl until evenly combined. Shape into 4 burgers and place on a lightly oiled baking sheet. Bake the burgers for 14–18 minutes until cooked through and no longer pink in the center, turning once halfway through for even browning. For the smoky tomato chutney, simmer the roasted vegetables’ juices in a pan with tomato paste and balsamic vinegar for 3–4 minutes, then stir through the chopped coriander and let it thicken slightly. Toast the burger buns lightly, then build the burgers with the smoky tomato chutney and roasted vegetables on top.

title: Turkey Burgers with Herby Yogurt Sauce, Roasted Sweet Potato Wedges
ingredients_json: ["500 g turkey mince, 5% fat", "2 tsp olive oil", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 g salt", "0.5 g black pepper", "200 g wholegrain burger buns", "250 g Greek yogurt, low fat", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "20 g fresh parsley", "1 clove garlic", "400 g sweet potato", "150 g mixed salad leaves", "1 medium tomato", "1 small red onion", "1 tbsp wholegrain mustard"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°C. Cut the sweet potato into wedges, toss with 2 tsp olive oil, and spread on a tray. Roast for 20 minutes, then turn the wedges and roast for another 10–15 minutes until golden and tender. While the sweet potato cooks, mix the turkey mince with cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, salt, and black pepper. Shape into 4 burgers and place on a hot nonstick pan over medium-high heat. Cook for about 4–5 minutes on the first side, then flip and cook for another 3–4 minutes until the burgers are cooked through with no pink inside. In a bowl, stir the low-fat Greek yogurt with lemon juice, finely chopped parsley, grated garlic, and wholegrain mustard to make a herby yogurt sauce. Slice the tomato and red onion, then lightly warm the burger buns in the oven for the last 3–4 minutes of roasting. Assemble the burgers with salad leaves, tomato and red onion, and a generous spoon of the herby yogurt sauce, serving with the roasted sweet potato wedges on the side.

title: Turkey & Chickpea Burgers with Wholewheat Buns, Spicy Slaw and Yoghurt Sauce
ingredients_json: ["400 g turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "120 g cooked chickpeas, drained", "1 piece egg, whole, raw", "60 g rolled oats", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion", "2 cloves garlic", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "4 pieces wholewheat burger buns", "250 g Greek yoghurt, low fat", "2 tbsp lemon juice", "200 g cabbage, white", "1 piece carrot", "1 tbsp apple cider vinegar", "1 tsp honey", "1 tsp Dijon mustard"]
instructions: Finely chop the onion and garlic. In a bowl, mash the chickpeas with a fork and mix in the turkey mince, egg, oats, onion, garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, salt and black pepper. Shape into 4 burgers and press them to an even thickness so they cook through at the same rate. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the burgers for 4–5 minutes per side until browned and cooked through, with clear juices and an internal temperature of about 70°C. Meanwhile, make the yoghurt sauce by stirring the Greek yoghurt with lemon juice and Dijon mustard until smooth. For the slaw, shred the cabbage and grate the carrot, then toss with apple cider vinegar and honey. Lightly toast the wholewheat buns, then spread with yoghurt sauce, top with turkey burgers and finish with the spicy slaw.

title: Turkey and Black Bean Burgers with Smoky Tomato–Yogurt Slaw
ingredients_json: ["500 g turkey mince, lean (5–7% fat)", "200 g cooked black beans, drained", "1 piece egg, whole, raw", "60 g wholemeal breadcrumbs", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, red", "2 cloves garlic", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 tsp salt", "200 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "150 g cabbage, white", "100 g carrot", "2 tbsp tomato passata", "1 tbsp apple cider vinegar", "4 pieces burger buns, wholegrain"]
instructions: Finely chop the red onion and mince the garlic. In a bowl, mash the black beans with a fork until mostly broken down, then mix in the turkey mince, egg, wholemeal breadcrumbs, onion, garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, black pepper, and 0.5 tsp of the salt. Form four patties and press them firmly so they hold together. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat and cook the burgers for 4 to 5 minutes per side, reducing to medium if they brown too fast. They’re done when the center is no longer pink and reaches at least 70°C. Meanwhile, shred the cabbage and grate the carrot. Stir Greek yogurt with tomato passata and apple cider vinegar, then fold in the cabbage and carrot and season with the remaining 0.5 tsp salt. Toast the wholegrain buns briefly in the pan for about 1 minute. Serve the burgers in the buns with the smoky tomato–yogurt slaw on top.

title: Lean Turkey Burgers with Herby Greek Yogurt Mayo and Roasted Tomato Salad
ingredients_json: ["350 g turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "1 piece egg, raw", "15 g rolled oats", "1 tsp olive oil", "60 g wholemeal burger buns", "1 g garlic, fresh", "10 g onion, raw", "200 g tomatoes, cherry", "120 g cucumber, raw", "50 g red onion, raw", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C. Mix the turkey mince with the egg, rolled oats, finely grated garlic, finely chopped onion, dried oregano, smoked paprika, black pepper, and 1 g of the salt until well combined. Shape into 4 patties and place them on a lightly oiled tray. Roast for 16–18 minutes until the patties are cooked through and the juices run clear. While the burgers cook, roast the cherry tomatoes in the oven for 10 minutes until they blister and slightly char at the edges. Stir the low-fat Greek yogurt with lemon juice, 1 g salt, and a little pepper to make a herby yogurt sauce. Slice the cucumber and red onion and toss with the roasted tomatoes. Toast the burger buns lightly, then assemble the burgers with the yogurt sauce and the tomato-cucumber salad.

title: Chicken and Black Bean Burritos with Roasted Peppers, Lime Yogurt and Avocado
ingredients_json: ["2 tbsp Olive oil", "350 g Chicken breast, raw", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "2 tsp Smoked paprika", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "300 g Bell peppers, red, raw", "1 medium Onion, yellow, raw", "2 clove Garlic", "1 can Black beans, canned, drained", "150 g Wholegrain tortillas", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "1 tbsp Lime juice", "1 piece Avocado, raw", "40 g Cheddar cheese, reduced-fat", "150 ml Water", "1 tsp Salt, table", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the diced chicken breast and cook for about 6–8 minutes until it turns lightly golden and no longer looks pink. Stir in cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, half of the salt, and black pepper, then cook for 1 minute. Add the sliced onion and sliced bell peppers and cook for 5–7 minutes until the vegetables soften. Stir in the minced garlic, then add the drained black beans and 150 ml water. Simmer for 5 minutes so the mixture thickens and the flavors blend. Meanwhile, warm the tortillas in a dry pan or microwave until flexible. Mix the low-fat Greek yogurt with lime juice and a pinch of salt. Spoon the chicken-bean filling into the tortillas, add a few slices of avocado, sprinkle with reduced-fat cheddar, and finish with a drizzle of lime yogurt. Fold into burritos and serve hot.

title: Chicken, Black Bean & Corn Burritos with Avocado-Lime Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["320 g chicken breast, raw", "240 g canned black beans, drained and rinsed", "200 g canned sweet corn, drained", "180 g low-fat plain Greek yogurt", "120 g avocado, raw", "1 medium lime, juice and zest (about 2 tbsp juice)", "1.2 g ground cumin", "2 g smoked paprika", "4 g garlic, fresh, minced", "1 medium red onion, raw, diced (about 120 g)", "150 g bell pepper, red, diced", "240 g cooked brown rice", "8 pieces whole wheat tortillas (about 50 g each)", "15 ml olive oil", "8 g sea salt", "2 g black pepper, ground", "60 g reduced-fat cheese, shredded"]
instructions: Heat 10 ml olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the diced red onion and bell pepper and cook for 5 minutes until softened. Add the minced garlic, ground cumin, and smoked paprika, then stir for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the chicken breast cut into small pieces and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring often, until no longer pink. Stir in the black beans, corn, and cooked brown rice, then season with 3 g salt and 2 g black pepper. Cook for 2–3 minutes so everything is hot and lightly coated with spices. In a bowl, mash the avocado and mix it with the Greek yogurt, lime juice and zest, and a further 2 g salt until smooth and creamy. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or microwave for 20–30 seconds each, then fill each tortilla with the chicken-bean mixture and sprinkle with the shredded reduced-fat cheese. Roll tightly, place seam-side down on a baking tray, drizzle with the remaining 5 ml olive oil, and bake at 200°C for 10 minutes until the tortillas are lightly toasted and the filling is heated through. Serve hot with the avocado-lime yogurt on the side.

title: Chicken & Black Bean Burritos with Roasted Peppers and Lime Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["2 tbsp  Olive oil", "300 g Chicken breast, raw", "1 tsp  Ground cumin", "1 tsp  Smoked paprika", "1 tsp  Dried oregano", "300 g Red bell pepper, raw", "200 g Red onion, raw", "240 g Black beans, cooked, drained", "150 g Corn kernels, canned, drained", "200 g Wholewheat tortillas", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain 2%", "30 ml Lime juice", "1 g  Salt", "1 g  Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken breast cut into small pieces and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring, until browned and cooked through. Stir in cumin, smoked paprika, and dried oregano, then cook for 30 seconds to bloom the spices. Add the sliced red onion and bell pepper and cook for 6–7 minutes until softened. Stir in black beans and corn, and warm everything for 3–4 minutes so the mixture is hot and lightly thickened. Meanwhile, mix the Greek yogurt with the lime juice, black pepper, and salt. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 20–30 seconds per side, then spoon the chicken-bean filling into the center of each tortilla and roll up tightly. Serve with a generous drizzle of lime yogurt on top.

title: Chicken, Black Bean & Roasted Pepper Burritos with Lime Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["450 g chicken breast, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "200 g red bell pepper, sliced", "180 g red onion, sliced", "2 cloves garlic", "280 g cooked black beans, drained and rinsed", "2 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "10 g tomato paste", "120 g reduced-fat Greek yogurt", "1 piece lime, zest and juice", "120 g low-fat grated cheese", "4 pieces wholemeal tortillas (wraps)"]
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken breast pieces and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through. Transfer to a plate. In the same pan, add the red bell pepper and red onion and cook for 5–6 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, oregano and tomato paste, cooking for 30 seconds until fragrant. Return the chicken to the pan, add the black beans and cook for 3–4 minutes until everything is hot and slightly saucy. Mix the Greek yogurt with lime zest and juice. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30–45 seconds per side. Spoon the chicken-bean filling into the tortillas, top with a little grated cheese and add a dollop of lime yogurt. Roll up tightly and serve immediately.

title: Creamy Roasted Butternut Squash Soup with Ginger, Coconut and Lime
ingredients_json: ["900 g butternut squash, peeled and cubed", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "20 g fresh ginger, peeled", "750 ml vegetable stock, low-salt", "200 ml coconut milk, light", "1 tbsp olive oil", "10 g fresh lime juice", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp ground coriander", "0.5 tsp fine salt", "0.25 tsp black pepper, ground", "10 g pumpkin seeds, hulled"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the butternut squash cubes with the olive oil, spread them on a baking tray and roast for 25 minutes until tender and lightly caramelised. Meanwhile, finely chop the onion, mince the garlic and grate the ginger. In a large pot, sauté the onion for 6–8 minutes until soft, then stir in the garlic, ginger, cumin and ground coriander and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the roasted squash to the pot, pour in the low-salt vegetable stock and simmer for 10 minutes so the flavours meld. Blend the soup until completely smooth, then return it to low heat and stir in the light coconut milk. Add the lime juice, black pepper and salt, and warm gently for 2–3 minutes without boiling. Serve hot, topped with pumpkin seeds.

title: Creamy Roasted Butternut Squash Soup with Coconut and Ginger
ingredients_json: ["900 g butternut squash, peeled and cubed", "200 g carrots, sliced", "120 g onion, chopped", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "30 g fresh ginger, grated", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1.2 l vegetable stock, low-salt", "200 g canned coconut milk, light", "10 g fresh lime juice", "5 g ground cumin", "2 g smoked paprika", "2 g fine sea salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the butternut squash, carrots, onion, garlic, and ginger with the olive oil, spread on a baking tray, and roast for 25–30 minutes until the vegetables are tender and lightly caramelised at the edges. Transfer the roasted vegetables to a pot, add the vegetable stock, cumin, smoked paprika, and salt, then bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 10 minutes to blend the flavours. Stir in the light coconut milk and simmer for 3–4 minutes, then turn off the heat and blend until completely smooth using a hand blender. Add lime juice and black pepper, taste and adjust if needed, and serve hot with a drizzle of coconut milk on top.

title: Creamy Roasted Butternut Squash Soup with Ginger and Lentils
ingredients_json: ["800 g butternut squash, peeled", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "30 g red lentils, dry", "800 ml vegetable stock", "15 ml olive oil", "10 g fresh ginger", "250 ml unsweetened soy milk", "5 g ground cumin", "2 g ground black pepper", "3 g salt", "15 g pumpkin seeds"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook for 5 minutes until softened, then stir in the grated ginger and minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the cubed butternut squash, cumin, black pepper, and salt, then pour in the vegetable stock. Bring to a simmer and cook for 15 minutes, until the squash is tender. Stir in the dry red lentils and simmer for another 10 minutes, until the lentils are cooked and the soup has thickened. Use a hand blender to puree until smooth, then stir in the soy milk and heat gently for 2–3 minutes without boiling. Toast the pumpkin seeds in a dry pan for 2 minutes and sprinkle on top when serving.

title: Creamy Butternut Squash Soup with Coconut Milk and Roasted Garlic
ingredients_json: ["900 g butternut squash, peeled and diced", "250 g carrots, peeled and chopped", "1 piece onion, yellow, diced", "3 cloves garlic, peeled", "50 g olive oil", "900 ml vegetable stock, unsalted", "400 ml coconut milk, light, canned", "10 g fresh ginger, grated", "5 g smoked paprika", "2 g ground black pepper", "2 g fine salt", "30 g pumpkin seeds, hulled"]
instructions: Heat 35 g of the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute, then stir in the smoked paprika and black pepper. Add the butternut squash and carrots and cook for 3 minutes, stirring to coat the vegetables in the spices. Pour in the vegetable stock and bring to a gentle simmer. Cook for 18–22 minutes, until the squash is very tender. Blend the soup until completely smooth using an immersion blender, then stir in the coconut milk and simmer for 3 minutes to warm through. Toast the pumpkin seeds in a dry pan for 2–3 minutes until they smell nutty. Drizzle the remaining olive oil over the soup just before serving and top with the toasted pumpkin seeds.

title: Creamy Roasted Butternut Squash Soup with Thyme and Greek Yogurt Swirl
ingredients_json: ["900 g butternut squash, peeled and cubed", "1 large onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "700 ml vegetable stock, low-salt", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp dried thyme", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "30 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "10 g fresh parsley, chopped", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the butternut squash cubes with the olive oil, cumin, dried thyme, black pepper, and 1 g of the salt, then spread on a baking tray and roast for 25–30 minutes until tender and slightly caramelised at the edges. Meanwhile, finely chop the onion and mince the garlic. Sauté the onion in a small non-stick pan for 5–7 minutes until soft, then add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Transfer the roasted squash to a pot, add the sautéed onion and garlic, pour in the vegetable stock, and simmer for 8–10 minutes so the flavours blend. Blend the soup until completely smooth, then taste and adjust seasoning with the remaining 2 g salt if needed. Stir in the Parmesan. When serving, let the soup cool for 2 minutes, then swirl 1–2 tablespoons of Greek yogurt into each bowl and finish with chopped parsley.

title: Turkey and Brown Rice Cabbage Rolls in Tomato-Herb Sauce
ingredients_json: ["10 g Olive oil", "1 medium head Cabbage, green", "350 g Turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "200 g Cooked brown rice", "1 piece Egg, raw", "1 piece Onion", "2 cloves Garlic", "2 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "1 g Dried oregano", "600 g Crushed tomatoes, canned (no added salt)", "250 ml Vegetable stock, low-salt", "15 g Tomato paste", "15 g Fresh parsley"]
instructions: Remove the core from the cabbage and blanch the whole head in simmering water for 3 to 4 minutes until the leaves loosen. Peel off 12 to 14 large leaves and pat them dry. Finely chop the onion and garlic, then sauté them in olive oil for 5 minutes until soft and lightly golden. In a bowl, mix the turkey mince, cooked brown rice, egg, sautéed onion mixture, oregano, black pepper, and half the salt until well combined. Lay the cabbage leaves flat, trim thick ribs if needed, and spoon a line of the filling near the stem end. Roll tightly and place seam-side down in a baking dish or deep pot. Stir crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, the remaining salt, and vegetable stock together, then pour over the rolls. Cover and bake at 180°C for 55 minutes, or simmer covered on the stove for about 50 minutes, until the turkey is cooked through and the cabbage is tender. Rest the rolls for 5 to 10 minutes, then finish with chopped parsley and serve with extra sauce from the dish.

title: Lean Turkey Cabbage Rolls with Tomato-Dill Sauce
ingredients_json: ["1 piece Green cabbage, whole", "400 g Turkey mince, lean", "150 g Cooked brown rice", "1 piece Onion", "2 clove Garlic", "2 piece Carrot", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "300 ml Passata, tomato", "400 ml Vegetable stock, low-salt", "1 tbsp Fresh dill, chopped", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "1 tsp Ground black pepper", "10 g Salt", "2 tbsp Lemon juice"]
instructions: Remove the core from the cabbage and blanch the whole head in boiling water for about 5–7 minutes, until the outer leaves soften. Let it cool slightly, then peel off 12–14 leaves and trim the thick central vein so they roll easily. Finely chop the onion and grate the carrot. Heat the olive oil in a pan and sauté onion and carrot for 5–6 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds, then remove from the heat and cool for a minute. In a bowl, mix the turkey mince, cooked brown rice, sautéed vegetables, dill, oregano, smoked paprika, black pepper, lemon juice, and 5 g of the salt. Lay a portion of the filling onto each cabbage leaf and roll tightly, tucking in the sides. Arrange the rolls seam-side down in a large pot. Mix the passata with the vegetable stock and remaining 5 g salt, then pour it over the rolls. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook for 35–45 minutes, until the turkey is fully cooked and the cabbage is tender. Rest for 5 minutes before serving so the sauce thickens slightly.

title: Oven-Baked Cabbage Rolls with Turkey, Tomato and Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["900 g green cabbage", "250 g turkey mince, 5% fat", "120 g cooked brown rice", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 clove garlic, raw", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "500 g passata, tomato", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp ground black pepper", "1.5 tsp fine salt", "1 piece egg, raw", "80 g reduced-fat feta cheese", "200 ml chicken stock, low salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C. Bring a large pot of water to a simmer and cook the whole cabbage for 3–4 minutes, just until the outer leaves soften. Carefully peel off 10–12 leaves, return them to the simmering water for 1 more minute, then drain and let them cool. Slice off the thick center vein of each leaf so they roll easily. Finely chop the onion and garlic. Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic for 30 seconds. In a bowl, mix the turkey mince, cooked brown rice, sautéed onion and garlic, tomato paste, egg, chopped feta, oregano, black pepper, and salt until well combined. Lay a cabbage leaf on a board, add about 2–3 tablespoons of filling at the base, fold in the sides, and roll tightly. Repeat with the remaining leaves. Spread the passata in the bottom of an ovenproof dish and mix in the chicken stock. Arrange the cabbage rolls seam-side down, spoon a little extra sauce over the top, cover with foil, and bake for 40 minutes. Remove the foil and bake for 10 minutes more until the rolls are hot throughout and the sauce is bubbling.

title: Hearty Turkey Cabbage Rolls in Tomato-Dill Sauce
ingredients_json: ["12 leaves Green cabbage", "500 g Turkey mince, 5% fat", "180 g Cooked brown rice", "1 piece Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic", "1 piece Carrot, raw", "200 g Crushed tomatoes", "300 ml Vegetable stock", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tbsp Tomato paste", "2 tsp Dried dill", "1 tsp Ground black pepper", "1 tsp Salt"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Carefully separate 12 cabbage leaves, then blanch them for 2 minutes until just tender and pliable. Drain and set aside. In a skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat, then sauté the chopped onion and grated carrot for 6–7 minutes until softened. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds. In a bowl, combine the turkey mince, cooked brown rice, sautéed vegetables, crushed tomatoes, half of the dried dill, black pepper, and 1/2 tsp of the salt. Mix well. Lay a cabbage leaf flat, trim any thick stem if needed, and add a portion of the filling near the base; roll tightly and place seam-side down in a baking dish. Stir the tomato paste into the vegetable stock with the remaining dill and salt, then pour around the rolls. Cover with foil and bake at 180°C for 55 minutes, then uncover and bake for 10 minutes to lightly thicken the sauce. The rolls are ready when the turkey is cooked through and the sauce is bubbling and slightly reduced.

title: Turkey-and-Quinoa Cabbage Rolls in Tomato Herb Sauce
ingredients_json: ["1 piece Cabbage, green", "300 g Lean turkey mince", "120 g Quinoa, dry", "1 piece Onion", "2 cloves Garlic", "2 dl Tomato passata", "500 ml Vegetable stock, low-salt", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "1 tsp Ground black pepper", "1 tsp Salt", "1 piece Egg, raw", "150 g Carrots", "60 g Celery stalk", "50 g Feta cheese, reduced-fat"]
instructions: Cook the quinoa according to the package instructions using 240 ml of the vegetable stock, then let it cool slightly. Shred the cabbage leaves by removing the core and then blanch the whole cabbage in simmering water for 3–4 minutes until the outer leaves are flexible; drain and peel off 10–12 large leaves, trimming thick stems so they roll easily. Heat the olive oil in a skillet and cook the finely chopped onion, carrots, and celery for 6–8 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the turkey mince and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon. Mix the cooked turkey mixture with the cooled quinoa, oregano, smoked paprika, black pepper, the egg, and crumbled reduced-fat feta. Spoon the filling onto each cabbage leaf, roll tightly, and place seam-side down in a baking dish. Pour the tomato passata and the remaining vegetable stock into the dish and cover with foil. Bake at 180°C for 35 minutes, then remove the foil and bake for another 10 minutes until the sauce is slightly thickened and the rolls are hot throughout. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Wholewheat Spinach & Chicken Calzones with Mozzarella and Tomato
ingredients_json: ["220 g wholewheat pizza dough", "300 g chicken breast, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion", "2 cloves garlic", "250 g canned chopped tomatoes, no added sugar", "150 g spinach, fresh", "150 g low-fat mozzarella, shredded", "15 g parmesan, grated", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp dried basil", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat, then add the chopped onion and cook for 5 minutes until softened. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the diced chicken breast and cook for 6–8 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and no longer pink. Add the canned chopped tomatoes, oregano and basil, then simmer for 5 minutes to thicken slightly. Fold in the spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes until wilted, then remove from the heat and cool for 5 minutes so it doesn’t soak the dough. Divide the pizza dough into 2 equal portions and roll each into a round. Spoon the filling onto one half of each round, leaving a border around the edge, then scatter over the mozzarella and parmesan. Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon and press the edges firmly to seal. Cut a couple of small steam vents on top, then bake for 15–18 minutes until golden. Let the calzones rest for 3 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Spinach & Chicken Calzones with Wholemeal Dough and Mozzarella
ingredients_json: ["220 g wholemeal wheat flour", "130 ml water, lukewarm", "7 g dried yeast", "10 g olive oil, extra virgin", "5 g fine salt", "1 piece egg, raw", "250 g chicken breast, raw, diced", "200 g spinach, fresh", "200 g low-fat ricotta cheese", "120 g low-fat mozzarella cheese, grated", "1 piece onion, yellow, diced", "2 cloves garlic, fresh, minced", "100 g passata di pomodoro", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tbsp tomato puree"]
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the lukewarm water with the dried yeast and let it stand for 5 minutes until foamy. Stir in the wholemeal flour, 5 g of the salt, the egg, and 5 g of the olive oil, then knead for 7 to 9 minutes until you have a smooth, elastic dough. Cover and let it rise for 45 minutes in a warm place, until roughly doubled in size. Meanwhile, heat the remaining 5 g olive oil in a pan and sauté the onion for 4 to 5 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the diced chicken, smoked paprika, and oregano; cook for 8 to 10 minutes until the chicken is no longer pink. Stir in the passata and tomato puree and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes. Add the spinach and cook until wilted, then let the filling cool for 10 minutes so it won’t soak the dough. Preheat the oven to 220°C and line a baking tray with parchment. Divide the risen dough into 4 equal portions and roll each into a rough 20 cm circle. Spread a layer of low-fat ricotta over each circle, spoon the chicken-spinach filling on one half, and sprinkle with grated mozzarella. Fold the other half over the filling and crimp the edges firmly to seal. Cut a couple of small steam vents on top of each calzone and bake for 18 to 22 minutes, until deeply golden. Let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Wholemeal Spinach & Chicken Calzones with Mozzarella and Tomato
ingredients_json: ["200 g plain wholemeal flour", "120 ml water, lukewarm", "7 g dried yeast", "10 g olive oil", "6 g salt", "1 piece egg", "250 g chicken breast, raw", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic", "200 g spinach, fresh", "300 g passata di pomodoro", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp dried basil", "200 g mozzarella, part-skim", "20 g grated parmesan"]
instructions: Mix the wholemeal flour, dried yeast, and 4 g of the salt in a bowl. Add the lukewarm water, egg, and 5 g of the olive oil, then stir until you get a shaggy dough. Knead for 8–10 minutes until smooth and elastic, then cover and let it rise for 45 minutes in a warm place, until doubled in size. Meanwhile, dice the onion and mince the garlic. Sauté the onion in the remaining 5 g olive oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then add the garlic for 30 seconds. Add diced chicken breast and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring often, until no longer pink. Stir in the spinach and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes, then season with oregano, basil, and the remaining 2 g salt. Add the passata and simmer gently for 8–10 minutes until the filling is thick; let it cool slightly so it doesn’t melt the cheese. Preheat the oven to 220°C. Divide the risen dough into 4 equal portions, roll each into a large oval, and spoon the chicken-spinach tomato filling over one half. Scatter mozzarella and parmesan on top, fold the dough over, and crimp the edges with a fork to seal. Place the calzones on a baking tray lined with baking paper, cut 2–3 small steam slits on top, and bake for 18–22 minutes until deep golden and crisp. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Spinach & Lean Chicken Calzones with Mozzarella and Roasted Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["250 g wheat flour, wholemeal", "1 dl water, lukewarm", "10 g olive oil, extra virgin", "7 g yeast, dry", "5 g salt", "250 g chicken breast, raw, diced", "1 piece onion, yellow", "250 g spinach, frozen, chopped, thawed and squeezed", "200 g tomato, canned, chopped, no salt added", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "200 g mozzarella cheese, part-skim", "1 piece egg, raw", "10 g parmesan cheese, hard"]
instructions:
In a bowl, mix the lukewarm water with the dry yeast and let it stand for 5 minutes until it looks slightly foamy. Stir in the wholemeal flour, olive oil, and 3 g of the salt, then knead for about 6–8 minutes until you have a smooth, elastic dough. Cover and let it rise for 30 minutes in a warm place.

Heat a large pan over medium heat and sauté the finely chopped onion in a little olive oil until soft and translucent. Add the diced chicken breast, remaining salt, dried oregano, and smoked paprika, and cook for 8–10 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and no longer pink. Stir in the tomato paste and the chopped canned tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes. Fold in the squeezed spinach and cook for another 2 minutes, then remove from the heat and let the filling cool slightly.

Preheat the oven to 220°C. Divide the risen dough into 4 equal portions and roll each into an oval about 5–6 mm thick. Spoon the filling onto one half, leaving a border. Add torn mozzarella over the filling, then fold the dough over to form a calzone and seal the edges by pressing firmly with a fork. Whisk the egg with a splash of water and brush over the calzones. Sprinkle with the parmesan.

Bake for 18–22 minutes until golden and puffed, and the bottom sounds a little hollow when tapped. Let them rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Lime-Marinated Salmon Ceviche with Avocado, Cucumber and Red Onion
ingredients_json: ["350 g salmon fillet, raw, skinless", "40 ml fresh lime juice", "20 ml fresh lemon juice", "120 g cucumber, diced", "90 g red onion, finely chopped", "1 piece avocado, flesh diced", "10 g fresh cilantro, chopped", "1 g sea salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "15 ml extra virgin olive oil", "5 g chili flakes"]
instructions: Cut the salmon fillet into 1 cm cubes and place them in a non-reactive bowl. Mix the lime juice and lemon juice, then pour over the salmon and stir gently to coat every piece. Leave the bowl in the refrigerator for 20 minutes, stirring once halfway through; the fish should turn opaque around the edges but remain tender in the center. Add the cucumber, red onion, and chopped cilantro, then fold everything together. Stir in the avocado, olive oil, sea salt, black pepper, and chili flakes, and serve immediately with extra lime wedges if desired.

title: Lime & Coriander Salmon Ceviche with Avocado and Red Onion
ingredients_json: ["250 g salmon fillet, raw", "30 ml fresh lime juice", "15 g red onion, finely diced", "10 g coriander leaves, chopped", "100 g avocado, diced", "120 g cucumber, diced", "10 ml olive oil, extra virgin", "3 g sea salt", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Cut the salmon fillet into 1 cm cubes and place them in a glass bowl. Add the lime juice, add the sea salt and black pepper, then toss gently so all surfaces are coated. Refrigerate for 12 minutes, stirring once halfway through, until the salmon turns opaque and flaky but still looks tender. Fold in the red onion, cucumber, avocado, and chopped coriander, then drizzle with olive oil and mix carefully so the avocado stays in chunks. Let the ceviche sit for 3 minutes in the fridge to let the flavors mingle, and serve chilled.

title: Lime & Cilantro Salmon Ceviche with Avocado and Cucumber
ingredients_json: ["300 g salmon fillet, raw, skinless", "120 g lime juice, fresh", "10 g lime zest", "150 g red onion, finely diced", "200 g cucumber, deseeded, diced", "1 medium avocado, diced (about 200 g)", "30 g fresh cilantro, chopped", "10 ml olive oil", "2 g fine salt", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Slice the salmon into small 8–10 mm cubes. Put the salmon in a non-reactive bowl and pour over the lime juice, then add the lime zest and salt. Toss gently to ensure every piece is coated, then leave to marinate in the refrigerator for 15 minutes, stirring once halfway through, until the salmon turns opaque around the edges while still looking slightly translucent in the center. Fold in the diced red onion and cucumber and return to the fridge for another 10 minutes so the onion softens. Stir in the avocado just before serving to keep it creamy, then add cilantro, olive oil, and black pepper. Serve cold with any extra lime juice from the bowl, making sure the ceviche tastes bright and fresh rather than overly acidic.

title: Lime & Cilantro Salmon Ceviche with Avocado and Red Onion
ingredients_json: ["250 g salmon fillet, raw, skinless", "80 ml fresh lime juice", "20 ml olive oil, extra virgin", "120 g red onion", "10 g fresh cilantro", "1 piece lime, zest", "1 piece avocado, ripe", "1 g fine sea salt", "2 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Cube the salmon into 1–1.5 cm pieces and place them in a glass bowl. Add the lime juice and ensure every piece is well coated, then cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes, stirring once halfway through. The fish should turn opaque and slightly firmer, but still look tender. Meanwhile, finely slice the red onion and soak it in cold water for 5 minutes, then drain well. Dice the avocado and chop the cilantro. When the salmon is ready, add the drained red onion, avocado, cilantro, olive oil, lime zest, salt, and black pepper. Gently fold everything together so the avocado stays intact, then serve immediately while it is cold and fresh.

title: Lime & Coriander Salmon Ceviche with Avocado and Sweet Potato
ingredients_json: ["300 g salmon fillet, raw, skin removed", "120 ml fresh lime juice", "10 g fresh coriander", "180 g tomato, chopped", "100 g red onion, finely diced", "1 piece jalapeño pepper, seeded and finely chopped", "1 piece avocado, peeled and diced", "220 g sweet potato, cooked and diced", "8 g olive oil", "2 g sea salt", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Chill a glass or stainless-steel bowl. Cut the salmon into 1 cm cubes and place them in the bowl with the lime juice, so the fish is fully submerged. Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes, stirring once halfway through, until the salmon turns opaque and firm but still looks moist. Meanwhile, chop the tomato and red onion finely and mince the coriander; deseed the jalapeño for a medium heat level. When the salmon is ready, drain off any excess liquid only if there is pooling, then gently fold in the tomato, red onion, jalapeño, sweet potato, avocado, coriander, olive oil, sea salt, and black pepper. Let the ceviche sit in the fridge for 5 more minutes so the flavors meld, then taste and adjust seasoning before serving cold.

title: Classic Chicken Adobo with Garlic, Vinegar & Bay Leaves (Healthy Weeknight Version)
ingredients_json: ["600 g chicken breast, skinless, boneless", "2 tbsp soy sauce (light)", "120 ml rice vinegar", "2 tbsp cane sugar", "6 cloves garlic, minced", "1 large onion, sliced", "250 ml chicken stock, low sodium", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 bay leaves, dried", "1 tsp black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into 2–3 cm pieces and pat them dry. Heat the olive oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat, then brown the chicken in batches until lightly golden, about 3–4 minutes per batch. Add the onion and cook for 2 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the rice vinegar, low-sodium chicken stock, soy sauce, and add the bay leaves and ground black pepper. Bring to a gentle simmer, reduce the heat to low, and cook uncovered for 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is tender and the sauce reduces and thickens. If the sauce becomes too thick early, add 2–3 tbsp water or stock. Serve hot over steamed rice or with cooked vegetables.

title: Healthy Filipino Chicken Adobo with Garlic, Vinegar, and Bay Leaf
ingredients_json: ["600 g chicken breast, skinless, raw", "250 ml low-sodium soy sauce", "120 ml distilled white vinegar", "6 clove garlic, raw", "30 g brown sugar", "2 piece bay leaf, dried", "6 g black pepper, ground", "15 g olive oil", "300 g jasmine rice, dry", "400 g broccoli florets, fresh"]
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces. In a bowl, mix the soy sauce, vinegar, brown sugar, and ground black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and add the garlic (lightly smashed) and bay leaves for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the chicken and cook, stirring, for 5 minutes until the outside turns slightly opaque. Pour in the soy-vinegar mixture, bring to a gentle simmer, and cook on low for 25–30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is tender and the sauce reduces to a glossy coating. While the adobo simmers, cook the jasmine rice according to the package instructions, then steam the broccoli for 4–5 minutes until bright green and tender-crisp. Serve the chicken adobo over the rice with the steamed broccoli on the side.

title: Lighter Chicken Adobo with Garlic, Vinegar and Bay Leaf
ingredients_json: ["800 g chicken breast, boneless skinless", "220 ml coconut milk, light", "180 ml low-sodium soy sauce", "120 ml rice vinegar", "3 tbsp brown sugar", "6 cloves garlic, crushed", "30 g fresh ginger, peeled and grated", "2 piece bay leaf", "1 tsp whole black peppercorns", "300 g cooked brown rice", "200 g green beans, trimmed", "15 g olive oil", "1 medium lime, juice"]
instructions: Pat the chicken dry and cut it into bite-size pieces. In a heavy pot, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat and sear the chicken until lightly browned on the outside, about 5–7 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger, bay leaves, and peppercorns, then stir for 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the soy sauce and rice vinegar, bring to a gentle simmer, and cook for 10 minutes so the flavors meld. Stir in the light coconut milk and brown sugar and simmer for another 10–12 minutes, until the chicken is tender and the sauce has slightly thickened. While the adobo finishes, steam the green beans for 4–5 minutes until crisp-tender. Squeeze in the lime juice and taste the sauce, then serve the adobo over the cooked brown rice with the green beans on the side.

title: Lighter Filipino Chicken Adobo with Vinegar, Garlic and Black Pepper
ingredients_json: ["700 g chicken thigh, skinless", "120 ml soy sauce, reduced-sodium", "120 ml vinegar, cane vinegar", "70 g onion, yellow", "30 g garlic", "25 g brown sugar", "20 g ginger, fresh", "12 g whole black pepper", "2 ml bay leaf, dried", "20 ml olive oil", "250 g cooked jasmine rice", "200 g broccoli florets"]
instructions: Pat the chicken thighs dry and cut them into bite-size pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown the chicken for about 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lightly golden. Add the onion and cook for 2 minutes, then stir in the garlic and ginger and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the reduced-sodium soy sauce and cane vinegar, add the brown sugar, bay leaf, and black pepper, and bring to a simmer. Reduce the heat to medium-low and cook for 25–30 minutes, stirring now and then, until the chicken is tender and the sauce has thickened slightly. Meanwhile, steam the broccoli for 4–5 minutes until bright green and tender-crisp. Serve the chicken adobo over the cooked jasmine rice with the broccoli on the side, spooning some of the sauce over everything.

title: Classic Chicken Adobo with Tangy Vinegar and Garlic
ingredients_json: ["600 g chicken breast, skinless, boneless", "200 ml low-sodium soy sauce", "120 ml distilled white vinegar", "60 g white onion", "6 cloves garlic", "20 g fresh ginger", "2 pc bay leaf, dried", "10 g black pepper, ground", "10 g brown sugar", "300 g cooked jasmine rice", "250 g green beans, trimmed", "10 ml olive oil"]
instructions: Pat the chicken breast dry and cut into bite-sized pieces. Peel and slice the onion, mince the garlic, and grate the ginger. In a heavy pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat and brown the chicken for about 5–6 minutes, stirring until the surface turns lightly golden. Add the onion, garlic, and ginger and cook for 1–2 minutes until fragrant. Stir in the soy sauce, vinegar, bay leaves, ground black pepper, and brown sugar, then bring to a gentle simmer. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce slightly thickens. While the adobo simmers, steam or quickly sauté the green beans until bright green and tender-crisp. Serve the chicken adobo over the cooked rice and spoon over the sauce, topping with the green beans.

title: Creamy Herb Chicken and Dumplings with Carrot and Celery
ingredients_json: ["500 g chicken breast, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 large onion, raw", "2 medium carrots, raw", "2 celery sticks, raw", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "1.2 kg chicken stock, low sodium", "300 ml semi-skimmed milk", "150 g plain flour, wheat", "1.5 tsp baking powder", "2 tsp fresh thyme, leaves", "2 tsp fresh parsley, chopped", "1 tsp fine salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tbsp butter, unsalted"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil and butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add the sliced onion, carrots, and celery and cook for about 8–10 minutes, stirring now and then, until the vegetables soften. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then stir in the thyme, oregano, black pepper, and salt. Pour in the low-sodium chicken stock and bring it to a gentle simmer. Add the chicken breast and simmer for 15–18 minutes until the chicken is cooked through. Remove the chicken to a plate, shred it with two forks, and return it to the pot. In a bowl, whisk the flour with the baking powder and a pinch of salt. Stir in the semi-skimmed milk gradually into the flour mixture to form a thick, spoonable dumpling dough. Reduce the heat to low so the broth stays at a steady simmer, then drop spoonfuls of dumpling dough onto the surface. Cover and cook for 12–15 minutes without lifting the lid, until the dumplings are fluffy and cooked in the center. Turn off the heat, fold in the chopped parsley, and let the dish stand for 2 minutes before serving.

title: Creamy Herbed Chicken and Whole-Wheat Dumplings
ingredients_json: ["500 g chicken breast, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, brown", "2 cloves garlic", "3 carrots", "2 stalks celery", "850 ml chicken stock, low-salt", "200 g peas, frozen", "150 g plain yogurt, low-fat", "150 g whole-wheat flour", "120 g all-purpose flour", "10 g baking powder", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp dried parsley", "1 tsp salt, table", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground"]
instructions:
Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized chunks. Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat, then cook the chicken for about 6–8 minutes until lightly browned on the outside. Add the diced onion, sliced carrots, and celery and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in the minced garlic for 30 seconds, then pour in the low-salt chicken stock. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 12 minutes, until the vegetables are tender. Add the frozen peas and simmer for 2 minutes.

Meanwhile, mix the whole-wheat flour, all-purpose flour, baking powder, dried thyme, dried parsley, salt, and black pepper in a bowl. Stir in the low-fat yogurt with 150 ml of water to form a thick dough; it should be soft but hold its shape. Drop small spoonfuls of the dumpling dough onto the simmering stew, spacing them apart, then cover and cook for 15 minutes without lifting the lid. When the dumplings look puffed and cooked through, gently stir once to combine and serve hot.

title: Creamy Herb Chicken and Dumplings with Carrot and Peas
ingredients_json: ["500 g chicken breast, raw, skinless", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion", "2 medium carrots", "150 g frozen peas", "2 cloves garlic", "700 ml chicken stock, low sodium", "200 ml semi-skimmed milk", "120 g plain wheat flour", "2 tbsp fresh parsley", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp dried sage", "2 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper"]
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and cook the chicken for 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned and cooked through. Add the chopped onion and carrots (diced small) and cook for 5 minutes until the onion is soft. Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the chicken stock, thyme, and sage. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 10 minutes until the carrots are tender. Add the peas and parsley and simmer for 2 minutes. In a bowl, mix the flour, baking powder, salt, and black pepper, then stir in the semi-skimmed milk to form a thick batter. Reduce the heat to low and drop spoonfuls of the dumpling batter on top of the simmering stew. Cover and cook for 12–15 minutes without lifting the lid, until the dumplings are cooked through and spring back when lightly pressed. Taste and adjust seasoning before serving hot.

title: Creamy Herb Chicken and Dumplings with Carrots & Celery
ingredients_json: ["500 g chicken breast, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, brown", "2 pieces carrot, raw", "2 sticks celery, raw", "3 cloves garlic", "700 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "200 ml semi-skimmed milk", "2 tbsp plain wheat flour", "1 tbsp fresh thyme, leaves", "1 tsp dried sage", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "150 g self-raising flour", "50 g wholemeal flour", "2 tsp baking powder", "2 tbsp butter, unsalted", "180 ml semi-skimmed milk"]
instructions: Pat the chicken breast dry, then cut into bite-size pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion, carrot, and celery, and cook for 6–8 minutes until the vegetables soften. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the chicken. Cook for 5–6 minutes until the chicken turns opaque. Sprinkle over the 2 tbsp plain flour and stir well so it coats everything. Pour in the low-sodium chicken stock and bring to a gentle simmer, stirring to prevent lumps. Add thyme, sage, black pepper, and the salt, then simmer for 10 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly. Stir in the semi-skimmed milk and keep the mixture at a low simmer while you prepare the dumplings. In a bowl, combine self-raising flour, wholemeal flour, and baking powder. Rub in the butter until the mixture looks like fine crumbs, then pour in 180 ml semi-skimmed milk and mix just until a soft dough forms. Drop spoonfuls of dumpling mixture onto the simmering stew, spacing them apart. Cover and simmer for 12–15 minutes until the dumplings are puffed and cooked through. Rest the pot uncovered for 2 minutes before serving so the sauce settles and thickens.

title: Chicken Cacciatore with Roasted Tomatoes, Peppers & Herby Olives
ingredients_json: ["600 g chicken thighs, skinless", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 large onion", "2 cloves garlic", "1 red bell pepper", "200 g mushrooms, cremini", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes", "150 g tomato passata", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "100 g green olives, pitted", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp dried basil", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 tsp salt, fine", "250 ml vegetable stock", "200 g cooked whole wheat pasta"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large deep pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken thighs and brown them for about 6–8 minutes, turning once, until they are golden on both sides. Lower the heat to medium, then stir in the onion (diced), bell pepper (sliced), and mushrooms (sliced) and cook for 5–6 minutes until the vegetables soften. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then stir in the tomato paste, oregano, and basil, cooking for 1 minute to deepen the flavours. Pour in the chopped tomatoes, passata, vegetable stock, and black pepper, and bring to a gentle simmer. Cover and simmer for 25–30 minutes, until the chicken is tender and the sauce has thickened slightly. Stir in the olives during the last 5 minutes so they stay bright and briny. Serve the cacciatore spooned over the cooked whole wheat pasta, with extra sauce from the pan.

title: Olive-Garlic Chicken Cacciatore with Tomatoes, Peppers & Mushrooms
ingredients_json: ["600 g chicken thigh, skinless, boneless", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion, yellow", "2 clove garlic", "200 g mushrooms, brown, sliced", "1 red bell pepper", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes", "150 ml chicken stock, low sodium", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "1 tbsp dried oregano", "1 tsp dried basil", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp salt", "0.25 tsp black pepper", "200 g whole-wheat pasta, dry", "30 g parmesan, hard"]
instructions: Pat the chicken thighs dry and cut them into bite-size pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large heavy pan over medium-high heat, then brown the chicken in batches for 4–5 minutes until lightly golden. Transfer the chicken to a plate. In the same pan, add the onion and cook for 3–4 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic for 30 seconds. Add the mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they release their moisture and start to brown. Add the bell pepper and cook for 2 minutes, then stir in the chopped tomatoes, tomato paste, chicken stock, oregano, basil, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. Return the chicken to the pan, bring to a gentle simmer, and cook for 20–25 minutes until the chicken is tender and the sauce has thickened. Meanwhile, cook the whole-wheat pasta in salted water until al dente, then drain. Toss the pasta with the cacciatore sauce, and serve with shaved or finely grated parmesan on top.

title: Tuscan-Style Chicken Cacciatore with Mushrooms, Peppers & Tomato
ingredients_json: ["600 g chicken breast, skinless, boneless", "1 tbsp olive oil", "200 g onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "250 g mushrooms, cremini or button", "150 g red bell pepper", "150 g green bell pepper", "400 g chopped tomatoes, canned, no added sugar", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp dried basil", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "0.5 tsp salt", "250 ml chicken stock, low salt", "100 g carrots, raw", "1 dl red wine, dry", "30 g fresh parsley"]
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large, heavy pan over medium-high heat and brown the chicken for 4–6 minutes, until lightly golden and no longer pink in the center. Remove the chicken to a plate. In the same pan, add the onion and carrots and cook for 5 minutes, stirring, until beginning to soften. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add mushrooms and bell peppers and cook for 6–8 minutes until the vegetables release moisture and start to brown. Stir in the tomato paste, oregano, basil, black pepper, and salt, then cook for 1 minute to coat the vegetables. Pour in the red wine and simmer for 2 minutes, scraping up any browned bits. Add chopped tomatoes and low-salt chicken stock, then return the chicken to the pan. Simmer gently for 20 minutes, uncovered, until the sauce thickens and the chicken is tender. Stir through chopped parsley right at the end and taste for seasoning before serving.

title: Tuscan-Style Chicken Cacciatore with Roasted Peppers and Olives
ingredients_json: ["600 g chicken thigh fillets, skinless", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 large onion", "2 cloves garlic", "1 red bell pepper", "1 yellow bell pepper", "200 g mushrooms, sliced", "250 g passata di pomodoro", "150 g canned chopped tomatoes, no added salt", "100 ml chicken stock, reduced salt", "30 g black olives, pitted", "10 g tomato paste", "10 g dried oregano", "5 g dried basil", "2 g smoked paprika", "1 g black pepper", "3 g salt"]
instructions: Pat the chicken thigh fillets dry and season them with black pepper and half the salt. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat, then brown the chicken in batches until golden on both sides, about 3–4 minutes per batch. Remove the chicken to a plate. In the same pan, sauté the onion for 4–5 minutes until softened, then add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the bell peppers and mushrooms and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring, until the vegetables start to caramelise. Stir in the tomato paste, oregano, basil, and smoked paprika, then add passata, chopped tomatoes, and reduced-salt chicken stock. Return the chicken to the sauce, bring to a gentle simmer, and cook covered for 20–25 minutes until the chicken is tender and the sauce has thickened.
