Stir in the black olives and simmer uncovered for 5 minutes so the flavours concentrate. Taste and adjust seasoning with the remaining salt if needed, then serve hot.

title: Herby Chicken Cacciatore with Roasted Peppers and Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["600 g chicken thigh, boneless, skinless", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "2 medium red bell pepper", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes", "150 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "30 g tomato paste", "10 g dried oregano", "5 g dried basil", "1 g black pepper, ground", "4 g salt", "10 g fresh parsley, leaves", "1 dl cooked whole-wheat pasta"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan or deep skillet over medium-high heat. Pat the chicken thigh dry, season with half the salt and black pepper, and sear for 6–8 minutes, turning until browned on both sides. Reduce the heat to medium, add the onion (sliced) and cook for 5 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic for 30 seconds. Add the bell pepper (chopped) and cook for 3–4 minutes. Stir in the tomato paste, oregano, and basil, and let it cook for 1 minute to coat the vegetables. Pour in the chopped tomatoes and chicken stock, scrape up any browned bits, and simmer gently for 20–25 minutes until the chicken is tender and the sauce thickens. Cook the whole-wheat pasta separately until just tender, then add it to the pan during the last 2 minutes so it picks up sauce. Turn off the heat, stir in the parsley, taste and adjust salt if needed, and serve hot.

title: Oven-Baked Chicken Cordon Bleu with Reduced-Fat Ham and Swiss
ingredients_json: ["520 g chicken breast fillets, skinless", "120 g reduced-fat cooked ham, thin slices", "120 g Swiss cheese, reduced-fat", "2 piece eggs, raw", "80 g panko breadcrumbs, wholegrain", "20 g Parmesan cheese, hard", "1 tbsp Dijon mustard", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 g fine salt", "1 g black pepper", "600 g broccoli florets", "1 dl low-sodium chicken stock", "20 g butter, light"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. Slice the chicken breasts horizontally to make 4 thin cutlets, then lightly pound them to an even thickness. Spread a small layer of Dijon mustard on each cutlet, then layer ham and reduced-fat Swiss cheese in the center and fold/roll to enclose the filling. Dip each roll into the beaten eggs, then coat thoroughly with a mixture of panko and Parmesan so you get an even, crunchy layer. Place the cordon bleu on a lined baking tray, drizzle with olive oil, and bake for 22 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the coating is golden. Meanwhile, steam the broccoli until tender-crisp, about 5–6 minutes, then transfer to a saucepan with the chicken stock and light butter and simmer for 2 minutes to create a light glaze. Season the broccoli lightly with black pepper, slice the cordon bleu to check the cheese is melted, and serve with the buttery broccoli and pan juices.

title: Oven-Baked Chicken Cordon Bleu with Low-Fat Ham and Swiss
ingredients_json: ["500 g chicken breast fillet, skinless", "120 g reduced-fat ham, sliced", "120 g low-fat Swiss cheese, sliced", "12 g Dijon mustard", "30 g wholegrain breadcrumbs", "1 dl milk, semi-skimmed", "1 piece egg, raw", "2 tbsp olive oil", "200 g potatoes, baby, halved", "250 g green beans, trimmed", "1 g garlic powder", "2 g dried thyme", "5 g salt", "3 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the baby potatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil, half the thyme, black pepper, and 1 g of the salt, then spread them on a baking tray cut-side down. Bake for 20 minutes until starting to soften. Meanwhile, slice the chicken breasts horizontally to create 4 thin cutlets, then pound them to an even thickness. Lay a slice of ham and a slice of low-fat Swiss on each cutlet, spread a thin layer of Dijon mustard over the cheese, then roll tightly and secure with toothpicks. Whisk the egg with the milk in a shallow bowl. Mix the breadcrumbs with the remaining thyme, garlic powder, and the remaining salt. Dip each chicken roll first into the egg-milk mixture, then coat with the breadcrumbs pressing gently so they adhere. Heat the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil in a small pan over medium-high heat and quickly sear the rolls for 1 minute per side for color, then place them on the tray with the potatoes. Add the green beans to the tray, drizzle with a little olive oil, and bake for 18–22 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the coating is golden. Rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Oven-Baked Chicken Cordon Bleu with Dijon Mustard and Swiss Cheese
ingredients_json: ["600 g chicken breast fillets", "120 g Swiss cheese", "100 g cooked ham, low-salt", "2 each eggs, raw", "120 g wholegrain breadcrumbs", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 tbsp Dijon mustard", "1 tbsp plain Greek yogurt, 2%", "1 tsp garlic powder", "1 tsp dried thyme", "200 g broccoli florets", "300 g baby potatoes", "1 g fine salt", "2 g black pepper"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°C. Line a baking tray with baking paper and lightly brush with the olive oil. Slice the chicken breasts horizontally to create thin cutlets, then gently pound them to an even thickness. Spread Dijon mustard over each cutlet. Layer ham and Swiss cheese inside, then fold the chicken over and press the edges firmly so the filling doesn’t leak. In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the Greek yogurt, then mix the breadcrumbs with garlic powder and dried thyme. Dip each stuffed chicken piece into the egg mixture, then coat thoroughly with the seasoned breadcrumbs. Place the cordon bleu on the prepared tray and bake for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the coating is crisp and golden. While the chicken bakes, parboil the baby potatoes in lightly salted water for 10 minutes, then add the broccoli for the last 4 minutes and drain well. Serve the cordon bleu with the roasted-style potatoes and broccoli straight from the tray, and check that the chicken reaches 74°C in the thickest part and the cheese is fully melted.

title: Oven-Baked Chicken Cordon Bleu with Lean Ham and Reduced-Fat Swiss
ingredients_json: ["500 g chicken breast fillet, skinless", "160 g low-fat ham, sliced", "150 g reduced-fat Swiss cheese, sliced", "20 g Dijon mustard", "10 g breadcrumbs, wholemeal", "20 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "5 g garlic powder", "2 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt", "15 ml olive oil", "200 ml chicken stock, low-salt", "300 g baby spinach", "250 g potatoes, baby, halved", "15 ml lemon juice"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. Toss the halved baby potatoes with 10 ml olive oil and 1 g salt, then spread them on a baking tray and roast for 20 minutes, until starting to turn golden. Meanwhile, slice each chicken breast horizontally to make a pocket (without cutting all the way through), then open it like a book and season lightly with black pepper and garlic powder. Spread 10 g Dijon mustard inside the chicken, layer with low-fat ham and reduced-fat Swiss cheese, then fold the chicken closed and secure with toothpicks if needed. Mix breadcrumbs with Parmesan and the remaining Dijon mustard, then press the mixture onto the top and sides of the chicken for a light crust. Place the stuffed chicken on the same tray as the potatoes, pour in the low-salt chicken stock, and bake for 20–25 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and the juices run clear. Add the baby spinach during the last 3–4 minutes of baking so it wilts in the tray juices; squeeze over the lemon juice and remove the toothpicks before serving. Let everything rest for 5 minutes so the cheese sets slightly and the filling stays neat.

title: Light Chicken Cordon Bleu with Reduced-Fat Ham, Gruyère & Dijon
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces Chicken breast fillet, skinless", "120 g reduced-fat ham, slices", "120 g low-fat Swiss cheese, slices", "1 piece Egg, raw", "60 g wholemeal breadcrumbs", "30 g grated Parmesan cheese", "30 ml Dijon mustard", "10 g olive oil", "400 g baby potatoes", "1 piece courgette", "1 piece red bell pepper", "200 g green beans", "15 g butter, unsalted", "10 g garlic, fresh", "5 g salt (table salt)", "2 g black pepper, ground", "1 g dried thyme"]
instructions:
Preheat the oven to 200°C. Halve the chicken breasts horizontally to make two thinner cutlets, then place them between sheets of baking paper and gently flatten to an even thickness. Spread Dijon mustard over the cutlets, then layer ham and low-fat Swiss cheese inside each one and roll or fold to enclose the filling. Lightly season with salt and black pepper. In one bowl beat the egg, and in another mix wholemeal breadcrumbs and grated Parmesan. Dip each chicken parcel in egg, then coat thoroughly with the breadcrumb mixture so the filling stays sealed.
Heat the olive oil and butter in an oven-safe frying pan over medium heat and brown the cordon bleu on both sides for about 2–3 minutes until golden. Transfer the pan to the oven and bake for 18–22 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and the coating is crisp. While the chicken cooks, parboil the baby potatoes for 8–10 minutes, then drain. Slice the courgette and red bell pepper and toss them with the garlic and dried thyme; roast on a separate tray at 200°C for 12–15 minutes. Steam or microwave the green beans until bright green and tender-crisp. Serve the chicken cordon bleu with the roasted vegetables, potatoes, and green beans.

title: Creamy Light Chicken Marsala with Mushrooms and Thyme
ingredients_json: ["600 g chicken breast, raw", "250 g mushrooms, cremini, sliced", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "300 ml Marsala wine", "300 ml chicken stock, low-salt", "200 ml cooking cream, low-fat (10%)", "30 g olive oil", "1 tbsp cornflour (cornstarch)", "10 g fresh thyme", "10 g fresh parsley, chopped", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "0.5 tsp salt, fine"]
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into cutlets and pat dry. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or deep frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken in a single layer and cook for about 4–5 minutes per side until browned and mostly cooked through; remove to a plate. In the same pan, lower the heat to medium and add the onion; cook for 3–4 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and mushrooms, then cook for 6–8 minutes until the mushrooms release their juices and the pan looks fairly dry. Stir in the thyme and black pepper, then pour in the Marsala wine and simmer for 4–5 minutes to reduce slightly. Whisk the cornflour with a splash of stock, stir it into the sauce, then add the remaining chicken stock and simmer for 3–4 minutes until thickened. Return the chicken to the pan, add the low-fat cooking cream, and simmer gently for 6–8 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce is glossy. Finish with chopped parsley and serve hot, with the sauce spooned over the chicken.

title: Creamy Chicken Marsala with Mushrooms and Thyme
ingredients_json: ["500 g chicken breast fillet, raw", "250 g mushrooms, cremini", "1 small onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "2 tbsp olive oil", "150 g Marsala wine", "300 ml chicken stock, low salt", "200 g reduced-fat cream, cooking", "20 g plain flour, wheat", "1 tbsp fresh thyme", "1 tsp Dijon mustard", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper"]
instructions: Pat the chicken breast dry and cut into thin cutlets. Lightly coat the chicken with the flour, then season with black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the chicken for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden and cooked through; transfer to a plate. In the same pan, reduce the heat to medium and sauté the onion for about 3 minutes until softened. Add the mushrooms and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring, until they release their liquid and start to brown. Stir in the garlic and thyme for 30 seconds, then pour in the Marsala wine to deglaze, scraping up browned bits from the pan. Add the chicken stock and simmer for 4 to 5 minutes until slightly reduced. Whisk in the reduced-fat cream and Dijon mustard and simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes until the sauce thickens. Return the chicken to the pan and simmer for 1 to 2 minutes to coat. Taste and adjust salt if needed, then serve hot.

title: Creamy Light Chicken Marsala with Mushrooms and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["600 g chicken breast, raw", "250 g mushrooms, cremini, sliced", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "2 tbsp olive oil", "200 ml Marsala wine", "350 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "200 ml light cooking cream, 15% fat", "250 g baby spinach", "2 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp ground black pepper", "5 g salt", "2 tbsp plain wheat flour"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken breast cut into bite-size pieces and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through. Move the chicken to one side of the pan, then add the onion and mushrooms and cook for 5–6 minutes until the mushrooms release their moisture and turn golden. Stir in the garlic and dried thyme for 30 seconds, then sprinkle over the flour and cook for 1 minute to remove the raw flour taste. Pour in the Marsala wine and let it simmer for 3–4 minutes, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom. Add the chicken stock and continue simmering for 8–10 minutes until the sauce thickens. Stir in the light cooking cream and add the spinach; cook for 2–3 minutes until the spinach wilts and the sauce is creamy. Season with black pepper and salt to balance the flavours, then serve hot.

title: Creamy Light Chicken Marsala with Mushrooms and Garlic
ingredients_json: ["500 g chicken breast, skinless", "10 g shallot, raw", "3 cl olive oil", "250 g mushrooms, cremini, sliced", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "120 ml Marsala wine", "300 ml chicken stock, low sodium", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "2 tbsp plain flour, wheat", "200 g low-fat Greek yogurt, plain", "10 g fresh parsley, chopped", "1 g dried thyme", "2 g black pepper", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into cutlets and pat dry. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, then cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until browned and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium, add the shallot and mushrooms, and cook for 6–8 minutes until the mushrooms release their moisture and start to brown. Stir in the garlic and thyme for 30 seconds, then sprinkle in the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly. Add the Marsala wine and scrape up any browned bits from the pan, then add the chicken stock and tomato paste. Simmer for 6–8 minutes until the sauce thickens to a glossy consistency. Lower the heat to low and whisk in the Greek yogurt until the sauce is smooth and creamy, but do not boil hard. Return the chicken to the skillet and simmer gently for 2–3 minutes so it warms through. Season with black pepper and parsley, then serve with the sauce over the chicken.

title: Creamy Lemon-Garlic Chicken Noodle Soup with Spinach
ingredients_json: ["300 g chicken breast, raw", "1.5 l chicken stock, low-salt", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic", "2 medium carrots", "2 sticks celery", "250 g egg noodles, dried", "120 g spinach, fresh", "150 ml skimmed milk", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece lemon, zest and juice", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "0.5 tsp salt", "2 tbsp fresh parsley"]
instructions: Dice the onion, carrots, and celery, and mince the garlic. Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat, then add the onion, carrots, and celery and cook for 6–8 minutes until slightly softened. Add the garlic and dried thyme and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Slice the chicken breast into thin strips, add to the pot, and cook for 4–5 minutes, stirring, until it turns opaque. Pour in the low-salt chicken stock and bring to a gentle simmer. Add the dried egg noodles and cook for 7–9 minutes, stirring occasionally, until tender. Stir in the skimmed milk and spinach and simmer for 2–3 minutes until the spinach wilts. Finish with lemon zest and juice, black pepper, chopped parsley, and the measured salt. Taste and adjust the seasoning with an extra squeeze of lemon if you want it brighter, then serve hot.

title: Garlic Lemon Chicken Noodle Soup with Spinach
ingredients_json: ["300 g chicken breast, raw", "1.5 L chicken stock, low sodium", "150 g carrot, raw", "120 g celery stalks, raw", "150 g leek, raw", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "30 g olive oil", "200 g whole wheat egg noodles, dry", "100 g baby spinach, raw", "1 tbsp fresh lemon juice", "2 g dried thyme", "2 g dried parsley", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the leek, carrot, and celery and cook for 8–10 minutes, stirring often, until the vegetables soften. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30–60 seconds until fragrant. Add the chicken stock, thyme, parsley, black pepper, and salt, then bring to a gentle simmer. Add the chicken breast and simmer for 12–15 minutes, until cooked through. Remove the chicken to a plate, shred it with two forks, and return it to the pot. Add the egg noodles and cook for 7–9 minutes until tender. Stir in the spinach for the last 1–2 minutes to wilt, then add the lemon juice and taste to adjust seasoning.

title: Lemon-Garlic Chicken Noodle Soup with Spinach and Carrots
ingredients_json: ["250 g chicken breast, raw", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 large onion, raw", "2 medium carrots, raw", "2 stalks celery, raw", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "1.5 l chicken stock, low sodium", "150 g egg noodles, dry", "100 g spinach, raw", "1 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped", "1 pc lemon, zest and juice", "1 tsp dried thyme", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 tsp salt"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the diced onion, carrots, and celery and cook for 6–8 minutes until the vegetables soften. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 30–45 seconds until fragrant. Add the chicken stock, thyme, black pepper, and salt, then bring to a gentle simmer. Add the chicken breast and simmer for 12–15 minutes until cooked through. Remove the chicken, shred it with two forks, and return it to the pot. Add the egg noodles and cook for 8–10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until tender. Stir in the spinach to wilt for about 1–2 minutes. Turn off the heat and finish with lemon zest and juice and chopped parsley for a fresh, bright flavour. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed before serving.

title: Oven-Baked Chicken Parmesan with Cherry Tomatoes and Basil
ingredients_json: ["500 g chicken breast fillet, raw", "60 g wholemeal breadcrumbs", "40 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "200 g mozzarella, part-skim, grated", "2 dl low-fat milk", "2 piece egg, raw", "400 g cherry tomatoes, halved", "2 dl passata, tomato", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 clove garlic, minced", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp dried basil", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "1.5 tsp salt, table", "1 bunch fresh basil leaves"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C. Slice the chicken breasts in half horizontally to get even thickness, then season with black pepper and half of the salt. In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the milk. In another bowl, mix the breadcrumbs with half the Parmesan and the oregano and dried basil. Dip each chicken piece into the egg-milk mixture, then press into the breadcrumb mixture so it is fully coated. Place the chicken on a lightly oiled baking tray and bake for 15 minutes until the coating looks golden and the chicken is almost cooked through. Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat and sauté the garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the cherry tomatoes, passata, remaining salt, and dried oregano, then simmer for 8–10 minutes until slightly thickened. Remove the chicken from the oven, spoon the tomato sauce over the pieces, and sprinkle mozzarella and the remaining Parmesan on top. Return to the oven for another 8–10 minutes until the cheese is melted and lightly browned. Finish with fresh basil leaves and serve immediately with any extra sauce from the tray.

title: Oven-Baked Chicken Parmesan with Mozzarella & Marinara
ingredients_json: ["500 g chicken breast, raw", "20 g wholewheat breadcrumbs", "30 g grated Parmesan cheese", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 tbsp olive oil, extra", "2 piece egg, raw", "2 tsp garlic powder", "1 tsp dried oregano", "600 g marinara sauce", "200 g mozzarella cheese, part-skim", "250 g zucchini, sliced", "300 g whole-wheat pasta, cooked"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C. Slice the chicken breasts horizontally to make thinner cutlets, then pat dry. In one bowl, whisk the eggs. In another bowl, mix wholewheat breadcrumbs, grated Parmesan, garlic powder, and dried oregano. Dip each chicken cutlet in egg, then coat evenly with the breadcrumb-Parmesan mixture, pressing lightly so the coating adheres. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat and sear the chicken for 2 minutes per side until lightly browned, then transfer the skillet to the oven. Bake for 18–22 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the coating is crisp and golden. While the chicken bakes, warm the marinara sauce in a saucepan over low heat and sauté the zucchini slices in 1 tbsp olive oil until tender-crisp, about 6–8 minutes. When the chicken is done, spoon marinara over each cutlet, add mozzarella on top, and return to the oven for 3–5 minutes until the mozzarella melts. Serve the chicken Parmesan with whole-wheat pasta and the sautéed zucchini, and let it sit for 2 minutes so the sauce and cheese set slightly.

title: Oven-Baked Chicken Parmesan with Tomato-Basil Sauce and Mozzarella
ingredients_json: ["400 g chicken breast, raw, skinless", "10 g parmesan cheese, grated", "60 g wholemeal breadcrumbs", "30 g panko breadcrumbs", "2 piece egg, raw", "2 tbsp olive oil", "800 g canned crushed tomatoes", "2 clove garlic, fresh", "10 g fresh basil", "200 g mozzarella, low-fat, grated", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp dried basil", "1 ml salt", "1 ml black pepper"]
instructions: Heat your oven to 200°C. Line a baking tray with parchment and lightly brush it with half of the olive oil. Pat the chicken breast dry, then cut each breast into 2 even cutlets. Beat the eggs in a shallow bowl. In another bowl, mix the wholemeal breadcrumbs and panko with the dried oregano and dried basil, plus the grated parmesan. Dip each cutlet into egg, press into the breadcrumb mixture, and arrange on the tray. Bake for 18–22 minutes until the coating is crisp and the chicken is cooked through. Meanwhile, warm the remaining olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat, sauté the crushed garlic for 30 seconds, then stir in the crushed tomatoes. Simmer for 10–12 minutes, then stir in the basil and check seasoning. When the chicken is done, spoon a little tomato-basil sauce over each cutlet, top with mozzarella, and return to the oven for 6–8 minutes until the cheese melts and turns lightly golden. Rest for 2–3 minutes before serving with extra sauce.

title: Lemon-Caper Chicken Piccata with Light White-Wine Pan Sauce
ingredients_json: ["500 g chicken breast fillet", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "60 g wheat flour, all-purpose", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 cloves garlic", "2 dl low-sodium chicken stock", "1 dl dry white wine", "4 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tbsp capers, drained", "150 g cherry tomatoes", "200 g baby spinach", "20 g unsalted butter", "1 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped", "1 tbsp lemon zest"]
instructions: Pat the chicken breast fillets dry and slice them horizontally to form cutlets. Season both sides with salt and black pepper, then lightly coat each cutlet in the wheat flour, shaking off any excess. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook for 3–4 minutes per side, until golden and cooked through; remove to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and add the garlic for about 30 seconds, just until fragrant. Pour in the white wine and scrape up the browned bits from the pan, then simmer for 2 minutes. Stir in the chicken stock, lemon juice, and lemon zest, and add the capers. Return the chicken to the pan and simmer gently for 3–4 minutes to finish heating through and to let the sauce coat the chicken. Add the cherry tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes until they blister, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Turn off the heat and whisk in the butter and parsley for a glossy sauce. Serve immediately, spooning the lemon-caper pan sauce over the chicken.

title: Lemon-Caper Chicken Piccata with Light Pan Sauce
ingredients_json: ["450 g chicken breast fillet, raw", "8 g salt (for seasoning and brining the chicken)", "1 g black pepper, ground", "60 g wheat flour, plain", "20 ml olive oil", "1 piece lemon, zest and juice", "30 g capers, rinsed", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "200 ml chicken stock, low salt", "150 ml low-fat milk", "80 g butter, reduced-fat", "200 g cherry tomatoes", "200 g green beans"]
instructions: Pat the chicken breast dry, then cut into 2 cm cutlets. Season the chicken with about half the salt and all the ground black pepper. Dredge each piece lightly in the wheat flour, shaking off any excess. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken in a single layer and cook 3–4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a plate and reduce the heat to medium. In the same pan, add the garlic and stir for 30 seconds, then add the chicken stock, lemon juice, lemon zest, and capers. Simmer for 3–4 minutes, scraping up the browned bits. Whisk the low-fat milk with the reduced-fat butter until smooth, then stir it into the sauce and simmer gently for 1–2 minutes until lightly thickened. Add the cherry tomatoes and green beans to the pan and cook for 3–4 minutes, just until the beans are tender-crisp and the tomatoes begin to burst. Return the chicken to the pan for 1 minute to warm through, and taste the sauce, adjusting with the remaining salt if needed. Serve immediately with extra lemon wedges if desired.

title: Lemon-Caper Chicken Piccata with Herby Spinach
ingredients_json: ["500 g chicken breast, raw", "10 g capers, drained", "80 ml chicken stock, low sodium", "200 ml lemon juice, fresh", "30 g butter, unsalted", "20 g all-purpose wheat flour", "1.5 tbsp olive oil", "120 g spinach, fresh", "1 piece lemon zest", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt, table"]
instructions: Slice the chicken breast horizontally to make 4 thinner cutlets, then lightly season both sides with salt, black pepper, and dried oregano. Heat the olive oil in a large nonstick pan over medium-high heat. Dredge the chicken in the wheat flour, shaking off any excess, and cook for 3–4 minutes per side until browned and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a plate and reduce the heat to medium. Add the butter to the pan and let it melt, then stir in the capers and lemon zest for about 30 seconds. Pour in the chicken stock and lemon juice, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Simmer for 3–5 minutes until the sauce is slightly reduced and glossy. Stir in the fresh spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes just until wilted. Return the chicken to the pan and spoon the sauce over it for 1 minute to rewarm and coat.

title: Lemon-Garlic Chicken Piccata with Capers and Light Pan Sauce
ingredients_json: ["500 g chicken breast fillet, raw", "20 g wheat flour, plain", "2 tbsp olive oil", "200 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "150 ml lemon juice, fresh", "1 tbsp capers, drained", "2 cloves garlic", "120 g white wine, dry", "200 g cherry tomatoes", "1 bunch parsley, fresh", "1 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt"]
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into 2 cm cutlets, then season with salt and black pepper. Lightly coat both sides with wheat flour, shaking off any excess. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, then cook the chicken for 2–3 minutes per side until browned and just cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and add the minced garlic and capers to the pan; stir for 30 seconds, then carefully pour in the white wine and let it simmer for 2 minutes to reduce slightly. Add the lemon juice and chicken stock, bring to a gentle simmer, and cook for 4–5 minutes until the sauce looks glossy. Halve the cherry tomatoes and add them to the sauce for the last 2 minutes. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm for 1 minute so it absorbs some of the sauce. Turn off the heat, stir in chopped parsley, and serve immediately with the pan sauce spooned over the chicken.

title: Lemon-Caper Chicken Piccata with Light White Wine Sauce
ingredients_json: ["500 g chicken breast fillet, raw", "20 g capers, drained", "1 pc lemon, whole", "250 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "150 ml dry white wine", "15 g olive oil", "1 pc egg", "40 g wheat flour, plain", "1 g garlic", "10 g butter, unsalted", "2 g black pepper", "3 g salt", "200 g wholewheat spaghetti, dry", "250 g green beans, trimmed"]
instructions: Cut the chicken breast fillet into 2–3 thinner cutlets so they cook evenly. Pat them dry, then season with half the salt and all the black pepper. Whisk the egg in a shallow bowl. Spread the flour on a plate and lightly coat each cutlet in flour first, then dip quickly in egg, and coat again with a thin layer of flour so the sauce can cling without thick breading. Heat 10 g olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for about 3–4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through; remove to a plate. Lower the heat to medium and add the remaining 5 g olive oil, the garlic, and the butter. Pour in the white wine and scrape up any browned bits, then simmer for 2 minutes. Stir in the chicken stock, capers, and the juice and zest of the lemon (save a little zest for finishing). Return the chicken to the pan and simmer for 2–3 minutes until the sauce looks lightly glossy. Meanwhile, cook the wholewheat spaghetti in salted water according to package directions. In the last 5–6 minutes of cooking, add the green beans to the same pot so they steam in the boiling water. Drain well, toss with a small splash of cooking water, and serve the chicken piccata with the lemon-caper sauce over the pasta. Finish with the reserved lemon zest.

title: Lemon-Herb Chicken & Quinoa Salad with Crunchy Cucumber
ingredients_json: ["300 g chicken breast, raw", "200 g quinoa, uncooked", "200 g cucumber", "150 g cherry tomatoes", "80 g red onion", "120 g plain yogurt, 2% fat", "30 ml olive oil", "15 ml lemon juice", "5 g Dijon mustard", "10 g honey", "20 g fresh parsley", "2 g garlic", "2 g black pepper", "4 g salt"]
instructions: Cook the quinoa according to package directions in salted water, then drain well and let it cool to room temperature. Cut the chicken breast into thin cutlets, then season with black pepper and half of the salt. Heat 15 ml of olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 3–4 minutes per side until it is cooked through and no longer pink in the center. Remove from the pan and rest for 5 minutes, then slice. In a bowl, whisk together the yogurt, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, honey, the remaining salt, minced garlic, and the remaining olive oil until smooth. Chop cucumber, halve the cherry tomatoes, and finely slice the red onion, then toss them with the cooled quinoa and parsley. Add the sliced chicken and pour over the lemon-herb yogurt dressing, mixing gently so the quinoa stays fluffy. Serve right away or chill for up to 1 hour for the flavors to meld.

title: Lemon Herb Chicken Salad with Greek Yogurt Dressing and Crunchy Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["300 g chicken breast, raw, skinless", "200 g romaine lettuce, chopped", "150 g cucumber, diced", "120 g cherry tomatoes, halved", "80 g red bell pepper, sliced", "60 g red onion, thinly sliced", "60 g cooked chickpeas, drained and rinsed", "170 g plain Greek yogurt, 2% fat", "20 ml olive oil", "20 ml lemon juice", "10 g Dijon mustard", "2 g garlic, fresh, minced", "3 g dried oregano", "2 g ground black pepper", "3 g salt", "10 g fresh parsley, chopped"]
instructions: Season the chicken breast with 1 g salt, 2 g ground black pepper and half of the dried oregano. Heat 10 ml olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6–8 minutes per side until it is cooked through and the juices run clear. Transfer to a plate and let it rest for 5 minutes, then slice thinly. In a bowl, whisk the Greek yogurt, Dijon mustard, lemon juice, minced garlic, remaining oregano, 1 g salt and the rest of the olive oil until smooth. Toss the lettuce, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, bell pepper and red onion with the chickpeas, then add the yogurt dressing and toss again until evenly coated. Fold in the sliced chicken, finish with chopped parsley and serve immediately while the vegetables are crisp.

title: Lemon-Herb Chicken Salad with Crunchy Cucumber and Avocado
ingredients_json: ["300 g chicken breast, raw", "250 g cucumber, with peel", "150 g cherry tomatoes", "100 g red onion", "120 g avocado, flesh", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat (2%)", "20 g olive oil", "30 ml lemon juice", "10 g Dijon mustard", "5 g fresh parsley, chopped", "2 g garlic, fresh", "3 g salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips and season with half of the salt and all of the black pepper. Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat and add the olive oil. Cook the chicken for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it is browned and cooked through with no pink inside. While the chicken cooks, dice the cucumber, halve the cherry tomatoes, finely slice the red onion, and chop the parsley. In a bowl, whisk the Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, grated garlic, the remaining salt, and half the parsley until smooth. Toss the cucumber, tomatoes, and red onion together, then fold in the warm chicken so it lightly wilts the vegetables. Add the avocado just before serving and finish with the remaining parsley and a little extra lemon juice if you want more brightness.

title: Lemon-Herb Chicken Quinoa Salad with Crunchy Cucumber
ingredients_json: ["250 g Chicken breast, raw", "80 g Quinoa, dry", "250 g Cucumber", "150 g Cherry tomatoes", "60 g Red onion", "60 g Feta cheese, reduced-fat", "20 g Olive oil", "15 ml Lemon juice", "10 g Dijon mustard", "10 g Honey", "5 g Fresh parsley", "2 g Salt, table salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Cook the quinoa in boiling water according to the package instructions, then drain and cool slightly so it stays fluffy. Slice the cucumber and halve the cherry tomatoes, then finely dice the red onion and chop the parsley. Cut the chicken breast into thin cutlets, season with black pepper and a small portion of the salt, and cook in a hot non-stick pan with 10 g of olive oil over medium-high heat for about 4–6 minutes per side until the center is no longer pink and the juices run clear. Let the chicken rest for 3 minutes, then slice it into strips. Whisk the lemon juice, Dijon mustard, honey, and the remaining 10 g olive oil with the rest of the salt until smooth, then combine quinoa, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, and parsley in a bowl. Add the sliced chicken and crumble over the reduced-fat feta, then toss everything with the dressing and serve immediately while the salad still has some crunch.

title: Lemon-Herb Chicken Salad with Quinoa, Cucumber and Feta
ingredients_json: ["350 g chicken breast, raw", "120 g quinoa, dry", "1 piece cucumber, raw", "200 g cherry tomatoes", "1 piece red onion", "150 g feta cheese, reduced-fat", "200 g Greek yogurt, 2% fat", "20 ml olive oil", "30 ml lemon juice", "10 g fresh parsley", "2 g garlic, fresh", "5 g Dijon mustard", "2 g black pepper", "3 g salt"]
instructions: Cook the quinoa in salted water according to the package instructions until tender, then drain and let it cool to room temperature. Heat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken breast for about 5–7 minutes per side until cooked through and no longer pink in the center. Remove the chicken, rest it for 5 minutes, then slice it thinly. Slice the cucumber and red onion, and halve the cherry tomatoes. In a bowl, whisk the Greek yogurt with olive oil, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, minced garlic, chopped parsley, black pepper, and salt until smooth. Combine quinoa, cucumber, tomatoes, and onion in a large bowl, then gently fold in the sliced chicken. Crumble the feta on top, drizzle over any remaining dressing, and toss lightly. Serve immediately, or refrigerate for up to 24 hours for a chilled salad.

title: Ginger-Garlic Chicken Teriyaki with Sesame and Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["500 g chicken breast, raw", "250 g brown rice, dry", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "25 g fresh ginger", "200 ml low-salt soy sauce", "60 ml mirin", "30 ml rice vinegar", "30 g honey", "1 tbsp sesame oil", "2 tbsp cornflour", "1 head broccoli, raw", "1 medium carrot, raw", "1 tbsp sesame seeds, toasted"]
instructions: Rinse the brown rice and cook it according to the package directions in simmering water until tender. While the rice cooks, cut the chicken breast into bite-size pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for about 6–8 minutes, stirring often, until browned and cooked through. Reduce the heat to medium and add the grated ginger and minced garlic; stir for 30–60 seconds until fragrant. In a bowl, mix the low-salt soy sauce, mirin, rice vinegar, and honey. Pour this teriyaki sauce into the pan and simmer for 2 minutes. Stir the cornflour with 2 tablespoons of water, add it to the pan, and cook for 1–2 minutes until the sauce thickens and coats the chicken. Steam the broccoli florets and slice the carrot thinly, then cook them for 4–5 minutes until bright and tender-crisp. Toss the vegetables with the sesame oil. Serve the chicken teriyaki over the brown rice and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds.

title: Ginger-Soy Chicken Teriyaki with Broccoli and Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["500 g chicken breast, raw, skinless", "300 g broccoli florets", "250 g cooked brown rice", "2 tbsp soy sauce, low-salt", "1 tbsp honey", "20 ml rice vinegar", "15 g fresh ginger, peeled", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 tbsp sesame oil", "1 tsp cornstarch", "1 dl water", "1 tbsp lime juice"]
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips. Heat a non-stick pan or wok over medium-high heat and add the sesame oil. Stir-fry the chicken for 6–8 minutes, until it turns golden and is cooked through with no pink remaining. In a small bowl, whisk together the low-salt soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, lime juice, minced ginger, grated garlic, cornstarch, and water until smooth. Add the broccoli to the pan with the chicken and pour in the teriyaki sauce. Stir well and cook for 3–4 minutes, until the broccoli is bright green and just tender and the sauce lightly thickens and clings to the chicken. Serve immediately over the cooked brown rice.

title: Ginger-Soy Chicken Teriyaki with Sesame Broccoli and Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["500 g chicken breast, raw", "250 g broccoli florets", "250 g brown rice, dry", "250 ml low-salt soy sauce", "120 ml water", "40 g honey", "20 g fresh ginger, peeled", "6 g garlic, raw", "20 ml rice vinegar", "10 ml sesame oil", "15 g cornstarch", "10 g sesame seeds, toasted"]
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to the package instructions until tender and set aside. Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces. In a bowl, stir together the low-salt soy sauce, water, honey, rice vinegar, grated ginger, and minced garlic. In a small cup, mix the cornstarch with 2 tbsp of cold water to make a smooth slurry. Heat the sesame oil in a large pan over medium-high heat, add the chicken, and stir-fry for 6–8 minutes until browned and cooked through. Add the broccoli and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes until bright green and just tender. Pour in the teriyaki sauce and bring to a gentle simmer. Stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook for 1–2 minutes until glossy and lightly thickened. Serve the chicken teriyaki over the brown rice and finish with the toasted sesame seeds.

title: Healthy Chicken Teriyaki with Sesame Ginger Veggie Rice
ingredients_json: ["550 g chicken breast fillet, raw", "250 g jasmine rice, dry", "500 g broccoli florets", "200 g carrots, raw", "1 piece garlic clove, raw", "25 g fresh ginger", "30 ml soy sauce, reduced-salt", "60 ml mirin", "30 ml rice vinegar", "15 g honey", "10 g sesame oil", "12 g cornflour", "400 ml water", "10 g sesame seeds, white", "1 piece lime, juice"]
instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to the package directions using the full amount of water; once cooked, keep it warm with the lid on. Cut the broccoli into small florets and slice the carrots into thin matchsticks. Pat the chicken breast dry and cut it into bite-sized strips. In a bowl, stir together the reduced-salt soy sauce, mirin, rice vinegar, honey, lime juice, and cornflour until smooth. Heat a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat and add half of the sesame oil. Add the chicken in a single layer and cook for about 4–6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is browned and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a plate. Add the remaining sesame oil to the pan, then add the garlic (finely minced) and ginger (grated) and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the carrots and broccoli and stir-fry for 4–5 minutes until the vegetables are crisp-tender. Return the chicken to the pan, pour in the teriyaki sauce mixture, and simmer for 2–3 minutes until the sauce turns glossy and thick enough to coat the chicken. Serve the teriyaki chicken over the rice and finish with sesame seeds.

title: Glazed Chicken Teriyaki with Sesame Ginger Rice and Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["500 g chicken breast, raw", "300 g broccoli florets", "300 g cooked brown rice", "2 tbsp soy sauce, reduced salt", "1 tbsp honey", "2 tbsp mirin", "1 tbsp rice vinegar", "1 tbsp sesame oil", "2 tsp grated fresh ginger", "2 cloves garlic", "1 tbsp cornflour", "60 ml water", "1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds", "1 tbsp olive oil"]
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat and sear the chicken for 5–7 minutes, stirring often, until lightly browned and cooked through. Add the broccoli and 2–3 tbsp water, then cover and steam for 3–4 minutes until the broccoli turns bright green and just tender. In a bowl, whisk reduced-salt soy sauce, honey, mirin, rice vinegar, grated ginger, crushed garlic, cornflour, and water until smooth. Pour the teriyaki sauce into the pan and simmer for 2–3 minutes, stirring, until glossy and thick enough to coat the chicken and broccoli. Turn off the heat, stir in half the sesame oil, and sprinkle over toasted sesame seeds. Serve the teriyaki chicken and broccoli over the cooked brown rice, and drizzle with the remaining sesame oil for extra aroma.

title: Chicken & Black Bean Chilaquiles with Roasted Tomatillo Salsa (Baked Tortilla Chips)
ingredients_json: ["300 g corn tortillas, cut into triangles", "1 tbsp olive oil", "450 g chicken breast, cooked and shredded", "1 can 200 g black beans, drained and rinsed", "500 g tomatillos, fresh, husked", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 clove garlic", "1 jalapeño, fresh", "2 tbsp cilantro, fresh", "1 tbsp lime juice", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp salt", "300 g Greek yogurt, plain 2%", "60 g cotija cheese, crumbled", "1 piece avocado, ripe"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°C. Toss the tortilla triangles with the olive oil and spread them on a baking tray. Bake for 12–15 minutes, until crisp and lightly golden. Meanwhile, blend the tomatillos, onion, garlic, jalapeño, cilantro, lime juice, cumin, oregano, and 0.5 tsp of the salt until mostly smooth; then simmer the salsa in a saucepan over medium heat for about 10 minutes until slightly thickened. Add the black beans and shredded chicken to the salsa and simmer for 5 minutes, then turn off the heat. In a large bowl, fold the baked tortilla chips into the hot salsa just until they look evenly coated but still retain some crunch, about 30–60 seconds. Serve immediately topped with cotija, a spoonful of yogurt, and fresh avocado slices. Taste and adjust with the remaining 0.5 tsp salt if needed.

title: Chicken & Black Bean Chilaquiles Verde with Baked Tortilla Strips
ingredients_json: ["300 g corn tortillas, cut into strips", "1 kg tomatillo, husked", "200 g white onion", "3 clove garlic", "100 g jalapeño pepper", "15 g cilantro leaves", "10 g olive oil", "500 g chicken breast, raw, diced", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp dried oregano", "5 g salt", "1 g black pepper", "220 g black beans, cooked and drained", "30 g queso fresco, crumbled", "60 g avocado, sliced", "10 ml lime juice", "250 ml low-sodium chicken broth"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the tortilla strips with 10 g olive oil and spread them on a baking tray in a single layer, then bake for 12–15 minutes until crisp and lightly golden. Meanwhile, blend tomatillos, onion, garlic, jalapeño, cilantro, and 250 ml chicken broth until you have a smooth green sauce. In a saucepan, simmer the sauce over medium heat for 10 minutes, then season with salt, black pepper, cumin, and oregano. In a skillet over medium-high heat, cook the diced chicken with a little of the sauce for about 8–10 minutes until no longer pink and the juices run clear. Stir the black beans into the green sauce and add the chicken to warm through for 2–3 minutes. Add the baked tortilla strips and gently toss for 30–60 seconds so they absorb the sauce but still retain some bite. Serve immediately with crumbled queso fresco, avocado slices, and a drizzle of lime juice.

title: Chicken Chilaquiles Rojos with Baked Corn Tortilla Strips, Avocado & Lime
ingredients_json: ["300 g corn tortillas, cut into strips and lightly baked", "400 g chicken breast, cooked and shredded", "500 g canned crushed tomatoes", "80 g onion, finely chopped", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "1 jalapeño chili, seeded and minced", "20 g corn oil", "10 g ground cumin", "12 g dried oregano", "3 g salt", "5 g black pepper", "10 ml lime juice", "120 g Mexican crema light", "80 g avocado, diced", "30 g queso fresco, crumbled", "20 g fresh cilantro, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 210°C and bake the tortilla strips on a tray until lightly crisp and golden, about 10 minutes. In a saucepan over medium heat, warm the corn oil and sauté the onion for 4 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and jalapeño and cook for 1 minute, then stir in the ground cumin and dried oregano. Pour in the crushed tomatoes and bring to a gentle simmer; cook for 8–10 minutes until slightly thickened. Season with salt and black pepper, then stir in the lime juice. Add the baked tortilla strips to the sauce and cook for 2–3 minutes, stirring gently so they absorb the sauce but remain some structure. Fold in the shredded chicken and warm through for 1 minute. Serve immediately topped with light crema, avocado, queso fresco, and cilantro.

title: Poblano Chiles Rellenos with Chicken, Black Beans and Oat-Filled Sauce
ingredients_json: ["3 pieces Poblano pepper, whole", "250 g chicken breast, raw, skinless", "120 g black beans, cooked, drained", "80 g onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "15 g fresh cilantro", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 g fine salt", "2 g black pepper, ground", "60 ml olive oil", "2 pieces egg, whole, raw", "200 g nonfat Greek yogurt", "30 g oat flakes", "200 g crushed tomatoes, canned"]
instructions: Char the poblanos over a hot grill or flame until the skins are blistered and dark in spots, then place them in a bowl covered with a plate for 10 minutes so they steam. Peel off the skins carefully, keeping the peppers mostly intact, and make a lengthwise slit in each one to remove seeds and ribs. Dice the onion and mince the garlic, then sauté them in 30 ml of olive oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft. Cut the chicken into small pieces and add to the pan with cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, 1 g salt, and black pepper; cook for 8–10 minutes until the chicken is no longer pink. Stir in the black beans and chopped cilantro and cook for 2 more minutes. For the filling, let it cool slightly, then whisk the egg and fold it into the mixture to help it bind. Stuff each poblano with the chicken-bean mixture. In a bowl, combine the crushed tomatoes and the oat flakes with the Greek yogurt and a little black pepper, then pour the sauce into an oven-safe dish. Add the stuffed chiles in a single layer, drizzle with the remaining 30 ml olive oil, and bake at 200°C for 25 minutes until the peppers are tender and the filling is set. Rest for 5 minutes before serving so the sauce thickens.

title: Oven-Roasted Poblanos Rellenos with Lean Turkey, Spinach & Oat Tomato Sauce
ingredients_json: ["3 pieces Poblano chili peppers", "250 g 5% fat turkey mince", "150 g canned black beans, drained and rinsed", "120 g fresh spinach", "80 g onion, diced", "2 cloves garlic", "30 g cornflour", "30 g rolled oats, finely ground", "120 g reduced-fat Mexican cheese, shredded", "1 piece egg, raw", "20 ml olive oil", "400 g canned crushed tomatoes", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "5 g salt", "2 g black pepper", "60 ml water"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°C. Roast the poblano peppers on a baking tray for 20–25 minutes, turning once, until the skins are blistered and charred. Transfer the peppers to a bowl, cover, and let them steam for 10 minutes, then peel off the skins carefully, keeping the peppers intact, and make a slit to remove the seeds while leaving the base intact. Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat and sauté the onion for 5 minutes until soft. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the turkey mince and cook for 8–10 minutes until browned. Stir in the spinach until wilted, then add the black beans, cumin, oregano, smoked paprika, black pepper, and 1 g of the salt. Cook for 2 minutes, then remove from heat and allow the filling to cool slightly. Mix the egg with the ground oats and cornflour in a bowl, then fold the mixture into the cooled filling along with half the shredded cheese. Stuff each poblano with the filling. In a separate saucepan, heat the remaining olive oil over medium heat, stir in the crushed tomatoes and the remaining salt, and simmer with 60 ml water for 8–10 minutes until slightly thickened. Place the stuffed chiles in a baking dish, spoon the tomato sauce around them, and sprinkle the remaining cheese on top. Bake for 18–22 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbling and the filling is hot throughout. Let the dish rest for 5 minutes before serving so the filling sets.

title: Oven-Baked Chiles Rellenos with Chicken, Black Beans, and Cotija
ingredients_json: ["4 piece Poblano peppers, fresh", "250 g chicken breast, raw", "150 g black beans, cooked, drained", "1 piece egg", "60 g cotija cheese", "40 g sour cream, reduced-fat", "2 cl olive oil", "2 piece garlic clove", "1 piece onion, white", "200 g crushed tomatoes, canned, no salt added", "5 g ground cumin", "3 g dried oregano", "2 g smoked paprika", "6 g salt, table salt", "4 g black pepper, ground", "1 dl water"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Char the poblano peppers directly over a gas flame or under a hot grill, turning until the skins are blistered and dark in spots. Transfer to a bowl, cover with a plate, and steam for 10 minutes, then peel the skins carefully. Slit each pepper lengthwise and remove seeds and membranes, leaving the peppers intact. In a skillet, heat 1 cl of the olive oil over medium heat and sauté the chopped onion for 5 minutes, then add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add diced chicken breast, cumin, oregano, smoked paprika, black pepper, and half the salt, and cook until the chicken is no longer pink, about 8–10 minutes. Stir in the black beans and cook for 2 minutes, then remove from heat. Cool the filling for 5 minutes, then mix in the egg and 40 g of the cotija so it holds together. Stuff each poblano with the chicken-bean mixture and place them in a baking dish seam-side down. Whisk the crushed tomatoes with the water and remaining salt, then pour around the peppers. Drizzle the remaining 1 cl olive oil over the tops and bake for 20 minutes, until the peppers are tender and the filling is hot. Serve with reduced-fat sour cream and the remaining cotija sprinkled on top.

title: Oven-Roasted Chiles Rellenos with Chicken, Spinach & Queso Fresco
ingredients_json: ["8 piece Poblano chiles, fresh", "250 g Chicken breast, raw, diced", "150 g Onion, diced", "2 clove Garlic, minced", "200 g Spinach, fresh", "200 g Queso fresco, crumbled (low-fat if available)", "2 piece Egg, raw", "60 g Breadcrumbs, whole wheat", "10 g Olive oil", "2 ml Lime juice", "3 g Ground cumin", "3 g Dried oregano", "4 g Fine salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Roast the poblano chiles under a hot grill (or directly on a flame, turning often) until the skins are blistered and charred all over, about 8–12 minutes. Transfer the chiles to a bowl, cover, and let them steam for 10 minutes, then peel off the skins carefully and slit each chile lengthwise. Remove seeds and white ribs, leaving a pocket shape. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat, then sauté the onion for 4–5 minutes until soft. Add the garlic, cumin, and oregano and cook for 30 seconds. Add the diced chicken and cook until no longer pink, about 8–10 minutes. Stir in the spinach and cook until wilted, about 2–3 minutes, then remove from heat and let the filling cool slightly. Mix the chicken-spinach mixture with the queso fresco and a beaten egg, then fold in the breadcrumbs so the filling holds together. Carefully fill each chile, then press closed with a toothpick or simply keep them seam-side down. Arrange the filled chiles in a baking dish, drizzle with the lime juice, and bake at 200°C for 18–22 minutes until hot throughout. Serve immediately, spooning any juices from the dish over the chiles.

title: Oven-Baked Chiles Rellenos with Lean Turkey and Queso Fresco
ingredients_json: ["6 pieces poblano chiles, fresh", "300 g turkey mince, lean", "1 piece egg, raw", "150 g queso fresco, low-fat", "1 piece onion, white", "2 cloves garlic", "10 g fresh cilantro", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes, no added salt", "2 tbsp olive oil", "5 g ground cumin", "5 g smoked paprika", "2 g dried oregano", "3 g salt", "1 g black pepper", "100 ml chicken stock, low-sodium", "150 g whole wheat breadcrumbs"]
instructions:
Char the poblano chiles directly over a gas flame or under a hot grill until the skins are blistered and dark in spots, turning so they roast evenly. Transfer to a bowl, cover, and steam for 10 minutes, then peel and slit each chile lengthwise. Remove most of the seeds while keeping the chile intact.

Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the chopped onion until softened, about 6 minutes. Stir in the garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, and a pinch of pepper, then add the turkey mince. Cook until the turkey is browned and no longer pink, about 8–10 minutes. Add the chopped tomatoes and chicken stock and simmer for 5 minutes until slightly thickened. Remove from heat and let the filling cool for 5 minutes, then stir in the egg and crumbled queso fresco and fold in the chopped cilantro.

Stuff each chile with the turkey-cheese filling and press gently to close. In a bowl, combine the breadcrumbs with the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil and a small pinch of salt and pepper, then coat the tops of the stuffed chiles lightly. Arrange the chiles in a baking dish and bake at 200°C for 25–30 minutes, until hot throughout and lightly crisped on top. Spoon a little of the tomato juices from the bottom of the dish over the chiles before serving.

title: Turkey and Bean Turkey Chili with Smoked Paprika and Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["500 g lean turkey mince", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 large onion", "2 cloves garlic", "200 g red kidney beans, canned, drained and rinsed", "200 g black beans, canned, drained and rinsed", "400 g chopped tomatoes, canned", "200 g tomato passata", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "2 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp ground cumin", "0.5 tsp ground coriander", "0.25 tsp cayenne pepper", "300 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "1 tsp salt", "1 tsp black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add the onion (finely chopped) and cook for 5–6 minutes until softened and lightly golden. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the turkey mince and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, for 7–9 minutes until browned. Mix in the tomato paste, smoked paprika, cumin, ground coriander, and cayenne pepper, then cook for 1 minute so the spices become fragrant. Add the chopped tomatoes, passata, beans, and the low-sodium chicken stock. Bring to a gentle simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook for 25–30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick and richly flavoured. Season with salt and black pepper. Taste and adjust the heat if you want it spicier before serving.

title: Turkey and Bean Chili with Smoked Paprika and Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["450 g turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "200 g onion, diced", "100 g green bell pepper, diced", "120 g carrots, diced", "3 cloves garlic, minced (9 g)", "30 ml olive oil", "30 g tomato paste", "800 g canned chopped tomatoes, no added salt", "400 g canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed", "200 g canned black beans, drained and rinsed", "250 ml vegetable stock, low-salt", "2 tsp ground cumin (6 g)", "2 tsp smoked paprika (6 g)", "1 tsp dried oregano (1.5 g)", "0.5 tsp chili flakes (0.9 g)", "15 g fresh coriander (cilantro), chopped", "8 g salt, reduced-sodium", "2 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat. Add the onion, bell pepper, and carrots and cook for 8–10 minutes, stirring now and then, until the vegetables soften. Stir in the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the turkey mince and cook for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until it is no longer pink. Sprinkle in the cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, chili flakes, black pepper, and reduced-sodium salt, then stir well. Pour in the chopped tomatoes and vegetable stock, then add the drained and rinsed kidney beans and black beans. Bring the chili to a gentle simmer, lower the heat to medium-low, and cook uncovered for 25–30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick and rich. Turn off the heat, stir in the chopped coriander, and let the chili stand for 5 minutes before serving. Serve hot and adjust the heat with extra chili flakes if you like it spicier.

title: Turkey and Black Bean Chipotle Chili with Bell Peppers and Lime
ingredients_json: ["500 g Turkey mince, lean (5% fat)", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, brown", "2 cloves Garlic", "1 piece Red bell pepper", "1 piece Green bell pepper", "2 tsp Ground cumin", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "2 tsp Chipotle in adobo, minced", "400 g Canned chopped tomatoes, no added salt", "400 g Canned black beans, drained and rinsed", "250 ml Vegetable stock, low salt", "1 tsp Salt", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 piece Lime"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and bell peppers and cook for about 8–10 minutes until softened and beginning to brown. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, and chipotle and cook for another 1 minute to bloom the spices. Add the turkey mince and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until no longer pink. Pour in the chopped tomatoes and vegetable stock, add the black beans, and bring everything to a gentle simmer. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chili thickens. Season with salt and black pepper, then squeeze in the lime juice and serve hot.

title: Smoky Salmon and Sweet Potato Chowder with Dill
ingredients_json: ["400 g salmon fillet, raw, skinless", "300 g sweet potato, peeled and diced", "250 g potatoes, peeled and diced", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "2 tbsp olive oil", "900 ml vegetable stock, low-salt", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes, no added salt", "150 ml evaporated skim milk", "200 g corn kernels, frozen", "1 tbsp fresh dill, chopped", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 g ground black pepper", "3 g salt"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft. Stir in the garlic and smoked paprika and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the diced sweet potato, diced potatoes, chopped tomatoes, and vegetable stock, then bring to a gentle simmer. Cook for 15–18 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender. Flake in the salmon, add the corn, and simmer for 6–8 minutes until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily. Stir in the evaporated skim milk and black pepper, then warm through for 1–2 minutes without boiling. Turn off the heat and fold in the dill before serving.

title: Smoky Salmon and Sweet Corn Chowder with Potatoes and Leeks
ingredients_json: ["300 g salmon fillet, raw", "900 g low-sodium fish stock", "250 g potatoes, peeled, diced", "200 g leek, sliced", "150 g sweet corn kernels, canned, drained", "120 g carrots, diced", "250 ml skimmed milk", "150 ml light cream, reduced fat", "20 g butter", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 clove garlic, minced", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried thyme", "10 g fresh parsley, chopped", "8 g salt", "2 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil and butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add the leek and carrots and cook for 6–8 minutes until softened, stirring occasionally. Stir in the garlic, smoked paprika, and thyme and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the diced potatoes and pour in the fish stock; bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 12–15 minutes until the potatoes are tender. Add the sweet corn and simmer for 3 minutes. Lower the heat to medium-low, add the skimmed milk and reduced-fat cream, then gently stir so the soup becomes creamy without boiling hard. Fold in the salmon and poach gently for 5–7 minutes, until the fish flakes easily. Season with black pepper and adjust salt if needed. Serve hot, topped with chopped parsley.

title: Smoky Salmon and Sweet Corn Chowder with Dill
ingredients_json: ["300 g salmon fillet, skinless", "200 g sweet corn kernels, canned, drained", "250 g potatoes, peeled and diced", "180 g carrots, diced", "120 g onion, diced", "3 cloves garlic, minced", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1.2 l vegetable stock, low-salt", "200 ml skimmed milk", "150 ml reduced-fat cooking cream", "2 tbsp fresh dill, chopped", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "0.5 tsp salt"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and carrots and cook for 6–8 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic and smoked paprika and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the diced potatoes and pour in the low-salt vegetable stock. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 12–15 minutes until the potatoes are tender. Add the drained sweet corn and let it simmer for 3–4 minutes. Lower the heat and stir in the skimmed milk and reduced-fat cooking cream; keep the chowder at a light simmer (do not boil hard) and cook for 5 minutes. Add the salmon pieces and cook for 4–6 minutes, until the fish flakes easily. Stir through the dill and black pepper, then taste and adjust seasoning with the remaining salt if needed. Serve hot.

title: Lemon-Dill Crab Cakes with Wholegrain Crunch and Quick Cucumber Salad
ingredients_json: ["300 g crab meat, cooked, drained", "120 g wholegrain breadcrumbs", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 dl Greek yogurt, non-fat", "1 tbsp Dijon mustard", "1 tbsp fresh dill, chopped", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 piece lemon, zest only", "1 clove garlic", "1/2 tsp sea salt", "1/4 tsp black pepper", "1 tbsp olive oil", "400 g cucumber", "1 tbsp red wine vinegar", "1 tbsp olive oil, for salad"]
instructions: In a bowl, mix the crab meat with the breadcrumbs, egg, Greek yogurt, Dijon mustard, dill, lemon juice, lemon zest, grated garlic, salt, and black pepper until the mixture holds together. Let it rest for 10 minutes so the crumbs absorb the moisture. Shape the mixture into 8 crab cakes, pressing gently to keep them compact. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat, then cook the crab cakes for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and hot in the center. While the cakes cook, make a quick cucumber salad by slicing the cucumber and tossing it with red wine vinegar and 1 tbsp olive oil, then set aside. Serve the crab cakes immediately with the cucumber salad on the side.

title: Lemon-Dill Crab Cakes with Spring Pea Salad
ingredients_json: ["250 g canned crab meat, drained", "120 g panko breadcrumbs", "1 piece egg, raw", "50 g Greek yogurt, 2%", "10 g Dijon mustard", "1 piece lemon, zest and juice", "15 g fresh dill, chopped", "1 clove garlic, minced", "1 tbsp olive oil", "450 g frozen peas", "200 g cherry tomatoes, halved", "1 g fine salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Mix the drained crab meat with the panko breadcrumbs, egg, Greek yogurt, Dijon mustard, lemon zest and juice, dill, garlic, salt, and black pepper in a bowl until just combined. Form the mixture into 8 crab cakes and chill them for 10 minutes so they hold together. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat, then cook the crab cakes for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and warmed through. In the last 4 minutes, warm the peas in a small pan with a splash of water, then drain well and toss with the cherry tomatoes. Serve the lemon-dill crab cakes with the pea-tomato salad on the side and finish with any remaining lemon juice.

title: Lemon-Dill Turkey Crab Cakes with Wholegrain Tartar
ingredients_json: ["300 g canned crab meat, drained", "200 g turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "1 large egg, raw", "80 g wholegrain breadcrumbs", "1 dl low-fat Greek yogurt", "1 tbsp Dijon mustard", "1 tbsp fresh lemon juice", "1 tbsp chopped fresh dill", "1 clove garlic", "2 tbsp capers, drained", "1 tbsp olive oil", "3 g fine salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine the drained crab meat, turkey mince, egg, breadcrumbs, Greek yogurt, Dijon mustard, lemon juice, dill, finely minced garlic, and capers. Season with salt and black pepper, then mix gently until the mixture holds together; if it feels too loose, rest it for 10 minutes so the breadcrumbs can absorb moisture. Shape the mixture into 8 evenly sized cakes. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat, then cook the crab cakes for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Serve warm with extra lemon wedges if desired, and watch for firmness: the cakes should hold their shape and feel springy in the middle.

title: Herbed Chicken and Spinach Dumplings in Light Tomato Broth
ingredients_json: ["300 g chicken breast, minced", "200 g spinach, raw", "160 g dumpling wrappers, wheat-based", "1 piece egg, raw", "120 g plain wheat flour", "1 dl water", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes, no salt added", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "2 dl vegetable stock, low salt", "15 g fresh parsley", "2 g ground black pepper", "3 g fine salt"]
instructions: Chop the onion and mince the garlic. Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then stir in the tomato paste. Pour in the chopped tomatoes and vegetable stock, bring to a gentle simmer, and let it cook for 10 minutes to thicken slightly. Meanwhile, squeeze the spinach if it’s wet and chop it finely. In a bowl, mix the minced chicken, egg, chopped spinach, parsley, 1 g salt, and black pepper. Dust a work surface with a little flour and lay out the dumpling wrappers. Add a spoonful of filling to the center of each wrapper, fold and seal firmly by pressing the edges; if needed, wet the rim with a little water. Drop the dumplings into the simmering tomato broth in batches and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, until the dumplings are tender and cooked through. Serve immediately with extra chopped parsley and spoon the tomato broth over the top.

title: Turkey and Spinach Dumplings in Light Tomato Herb Sauce
ingredients_json: ["300 g turkey mince, lean (5% fat)", "200 g spinach, fresh", "250 g wheat flour, white", "150 ml water, tap", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 clove garlic, fresh", "1 tbsp olive oil", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes", "200 g carrots, raw", "120 g onions, raw", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp salt, table", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground"]
instructions:
Finely chop the onion and grate the carrot. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat, then sauté the onion and carrot for 6–8 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cumin, cook for 30 seconds, then stir in the canned tomatoes and oregano. Simmer gently for 10 minutes, keeping the sauce at a steady low bubble.

Meanwhile, blanch the spinach in a small pot of boiling water for 30–60 seconds, then drain well and squeeze out excess water. Mix the turkey mince with the egg, chopped spinach, black pepper, and a little of the salt. Form small dumplings (about 20–22) from the turkey mixture.

For the dumpling wrappers, mix the flour with the remaining salt and gradually add water while bringing it together into a firm dough. Knead for 3–4 minutes, then roll out thinly and cut circles about 8–9 cm wide. Wrap each turkey dumpling with a dough circle, seal the edges firmly, and place on a lightly floured tray.

Bring the tomato sauce to a gentle simmer, add the dumplings in a single layer, and spoon some sauce over them. Cover and cook for 12–15 minutes, until the dough is tender and the dumplings are cooked through. Serve hot with extra sauce from the pan.

title: Chicken & Spinach Potstickers with Ginger-Soy Sauce
ingredients_json: ["300 g chicken mince, lean", "200 g spinach, fresh", "250 g dumpling wrappers, wheat-based", "1 piece egg, whole", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "15 g fresh ginger, peeled", "2 tbsp soy sauce, low-salt", "1 tbsp sesame oil", "1 tbsp rapeseed oil", "120 ml chicken stock, low-sodium", "1 tsp rice vinegar", "1 tsp cornstarch"]
instructions: Finely chop the garlic and ginger. Heat the rapeseed oil in a frying pan over medium heat and cook the chicken mince for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up until it is no longer pink and lightly browned. Stir in the chopped ginger and garlic for the last 30 seconds. Add the spinach and cook until wilted, then remove the pan from the heat and let the filling cool slightly. Mix the filling with the egg, cornstarch, soy sauce, and rice vinegar until the mixture holds together. Fill each dumpling wrapper with about 1 tablespoon of the chicken-spinach filling, fold, and crimp the edges firmly. Heat a nonstick pan over medium-high heat with a thin film of sesame oil, then arrange the dumplings flat-side down and cook for 2–3 minutes until the bottoms are golden. Pour in the chicken stock, cover, and steam for 6–7 minutes until the wrappers are tender and the filling is cooked through. Uncover to evaporate any remaining liquid, then serve the potstickers hot with any pan juices.

title: Turkey & Veggie Egg Rolls with Sesame-Soy Slaw
ingredients_json: ["350 g turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "2 cloves garlic, fresh", "30 g ginger, fresh", "250 g cabbage, green, shredded", "150 g carrot, grated", "100 g spring onion, sliced", "2 tsp soy sauce, reduced salt", "1 tsp sesame oil", "1 tsp cornstarch", "1 pinch black pepper", "1 package spring roll wrappers", "2 tbsp olive oil", "30 ml rice vinegar", "1 tbsp honey", "1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds"]
instructions:
Heat a large non-stick skillet over medium heat and add the olive oil. Add the turkey mince and cook for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until no longer pink. Stir in the garlic and ginger and cook for 30 seconds. Add cabbage, carrot, and spring onion, then cook for 4–6 minutes until the vegetables soften but still have bite. Mix in the reduced-salt soy sauce, sesame oil, cornstarch, and black pepper, and cook for another 1–2 minutes until the filling looks glossy and cohesive. Let the filling cool slightly so it won’t tear the wrappers.

To assemble, lay a spring roll wrapper flat with a corner facing you. Spoon about 2–3 tablespoons of filling onto the wrapper, fold in the sides, then roll tightly and seal the final edge with a little water. Arrange rolls seam-side down on a baking tray. Lightly brush the tops with a little oil and bake at 220°C for 14–18 minutes, turning once halfway, until golden and crisp.

While the egg rolls bake, mix rice vinegar, honey, and a splash of water to make a quick dipping slaw sauce. Serve the hot egg rolls with the sauce and sprinkle sesame seeds over the top.

title: Turkey and Veggie Egg Rolls with Sweet Soy-Ginger Dip
ingredients_json: ["12 sheets Egg roll wrappers (spring roll wrappers)", "250 g turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "1 medium Onion, yellow", "2 cloves Garlic", "150 g carrot, grated", "150 g cabbage, shredded", "80 g mushrooms, finely chopped", "2 tbsp soy sauce, reduced-salt", "1 tbsp low-sodium rice vinegar", "1 tsp sesame oil", "1 tbsp fresh ginger, grated", "1 piece Egg, raw", "1 tbsp cornflour", "1 tbsp olive oil", "600 ml vegetable stock, low-salt"]
instructions:
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 3 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic and ginger and cook for 30 seconds, then add the turkey mince and cook for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up until no longer pink. Add the carrots, cabbage, and mushrooms, and cook for 5–6 minutes until the vegetables are tender and any liquid has mostly cooked off. Mix the reduced-salt soy sauce and rice vinegar into the filling, then remove from the heat and cool for 5 minutes.

In a small bowl, whisk the egg with the cornflour and 2 tbsp of water to make a light sealing paste. Lay out the egg roll wrappers and place about 2–3 tbsp filling in the center of each. Fold the sides in, roll tightly, and seal the edge with the egg-cornflour paste. For best texture, lightly brush the rolls with a thin coating of oil.

Preheat the oven to 220°C. Arrange the egg rolls seam-side down on a baking tray lined with baking paper. Bake for 14 minutes, then turn them over and bake for another 10–12 minutes until crisp and golden. Serve hot with a quick spoonful of the pan juices or extra low-salt stock for dipping, if desired.

title: Lean Chicken and Veggie Egg Rolls with Sweet Chili-Lime Dip (Baked)
ingredients_json: ["300 g chicken breast, raw", "200 g carrot, grated", "200 g savoy cabbage, shredded", "150 g white onion, finely chopped", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "15 ml soy sauce, low-salt", "10 ml sesame oil", "5 g fresh ginger, grated", "1 tsp cornstarch", "12 piece egg roll wrappers, thin (wonton style)", "15 ml rapeseed oil", "200 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "30 g sweet chili sauce", "10 ml lime juice", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Finely chop or shred the chicken breast, then cook it in a large nonstick pan with 5 ml rapeseed oil over medium-high heat for 5–7 minutes until no longer pink. Add onion, garlic and ginger and stir for 2 minutes. Add carrot and cabbage, then cook for another 6–8 minutes until the vegetables are tender and any excess liquid reduces. Stir in low-salt soy sauce, sesame oil, cornstarch and black pepper, then remove from the heat and let the filling cool for 10 minutes so the wrappers don’t tear. Lay an egg roll wrapper on a clean surface, add about 2–3 tablespoons of filling to the center, fold the sides in and roll tightly, sealing the last edge with a small dab of water. Arrange the egg rolls seam-side down on the tray, brush lightly with the remaining rapeseed oil, and bake for 12 minutes, then turn and bake for 8–10 minutes more until crisp and golden. Mix the Greek yogurt with sweet chili sauce and lime juice for a quick dip, then serve the egg rolls hot.

title: Chicken and Vegetable Egg Rolls with Sweet Chili Lime Sauce (Baked)
ingredients_json: ["350 g Chicken breast, raw, minced", "200 g Cabbage, green, shredded", "120 g Carrot, raw, grated", "80 g Red bell pepper, raw, diced", "20 g Spring onion, raw, sliced", "15 g Sesame oil", "10 g Low-sodium soy sauce", "5 g Cornstarch", "2 g Garlic, raw, minced", "2 g Fresh ginger, raw, minced", "1 g Ground black pepper", "1 g Salt", "16 piece Egg roll wrappers, 20 cm", "10 ml Olive oil", "60 ml Sweet chili sauce, reduced sugar", "20 ml Lime juice, fresh", "5 g Honey"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a large bowl, mix the minced chicken with soy sauce, sesame oil, cornstarch, garlic, ginger, black pepper, and salt until evenly combined. Heat a nonstick pan over medium-high heat, add the chicken mixture, and cook for 5 to 7 minutes until it is no longer pink and crumbles easily. Stir in cabbage, grated carrot, diced bell pepper, and spring onion, then cook for another 3 minutes until the vegetables soften slightly and any excess moisture cooks off. Let the filling cool for about 5 minutes so the wrappers don’t turn soggy. Lay an egg roll wrapper flat, place about 2 heaped tablespoons of filling near one corner, fold in the sides, and roll tightly, sealing the last edge with a small amount of water. Brush the egg rolls lightly with olive oil and bake for 14 to 18 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crisp. For the sauce, stir sweet chili sauce, lime juice, and honey until smooth. Serve the baked egg rolls warm with the sweet chili lime sauce on the side.

title: Oven-Baked Eggplant Parmesan with Tomato Basil and Low-Fat Mozzarella
ingredients_json: ["1 medium Eggplant", "10 ml Olive oil", "200 g Crushed tomatoes", "150 g Passata", "2 cloves Garlic", "5 g Fresh basil", "60 g Wholemeal breadcrumbs", "40 g Parmesan cheese", "200 g Low-fat mozzarella, grated", "1 piece Egg, raw", "15 g Olive oil, for coating"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°C. Slice the eggplant into 1 cm thick rounds and pat them dry. Mix the egg with the breadcrumbs in a bowl. Lightly brush a baking tray with the 15 g olive oil, then coat the eggplant rounds in the breadcrumb-egg mixture and arrange them in a single layer. Bake for 18 minutes, turning once halfway through, until golden and tender. Meanwhile, warm the crushed tomatoes and passata in a saucepan with finely chopped garlic; simmer for 8–10 minutes until slightly thickened, then stir in the chopped basil. In a baking dish, spread a thin layer of tomato sauce, add a layer of baked eggplant, sprinkle with half the mozzarella and Parmesan, and repeat once more, finishing with sauce and the remaining cheeses. Bake for 15–18 minutes until bubbling and lightly browned. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Oven-Baked Eggplant Parmesan with Tomato Basil and Light Mozzarella
ingredients_json: ["2 medium Eggplants", "400 g canned crushed tomatoes", "200 g low-fat mozzarella, shredded", "80 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "30 g breadcrumbs, wholegrain", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp dried oregano", "2 cloves garlic", "15 g fresh basil", "300 ml no-salt vegetable broth", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°C. Slice the eggplants into 1 cm rounds, then pat them dry. In a bowl, mix the breadcrumbs, half the grated Parmesan, oregano, black pepper, and a drizzle of olive oil. In a baking dish, spread a thin layer of crushed tomatoes, then arrange a single layer of eggplant slices.
