Brush or drizzle lightly with olive oil and spoon over a little tomato sauce, then sprinkle with the breadcrumb-Parmesan mixture. Repeat with the remaining eggplant, finishing with tomato sauce and the rest of the cheeses. Pour the vegetable broth around the dish edges (not directly over the topping) so the base stays moist. Cover loosely with foil and bake for 25 minutes, then remove the foil and bake another 10–15 minutes until the eggplant is tender and the top is browned. Let it rest for 5 minutes, then scatter over chopped basil and serve.

title: Oven-Baked Eggplant Parmesan with Tomato Basil and Light Mozzarella
ingredients_json: ["500 g eggplant", "250 g canned crushed tomatoes", "150 g low-fat mozzarella, shredded", "60 g grated parmesan", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 cl extra virgin olive oil", "150 g whole wheat breadcrumbs", "2 cloves garlic", "10 g fresh basil", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp fine salt", "0.25 tsp black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C and line a baking tray with parchment. Slice the eggplant into 1 cm rounds, then spread them on the tray. Brush with the 1 tbsp olive oil and sprinkle with a little salt and black pepper. Roast for 20 minutes until the slices soften and start to brown at the edges, then flip and roast for another 10 minutes. While the eggplant roasts, heat 2 cl extra virgin olive oil in a saucepan and sauté the minced garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant. Stir in the crushed tomatoes, oregano, the remaining salt, and simmer for 8–10 minutes until slightly thickened. In a bowl, mix the breadcrumbs with half of the grated parmesan. Assemble in a baking dish by spooning a thin layer of tomato sauce on the bottom, adding a layer of roasted eggplant, then more sauce, then a sprinkle of the breadcrumb-parmesan mixture. Repeat once more, finishing with the remaining parmesan and the shredded mozzarella. Bake for 15–18 minutes until the mozzarella melts and bubbles and the top looks golden. Rest for 5 minutes, then scatter over chopped fresh basil and serve hot.

title: Oven-Baked Eggplant Parmesan with Tomato Basil Sauce and Part-Skim Mozzarella
ingredients_json: ["600 g eggplant", "15 ml olive oil", "1 tsp sea salt", "1 tsp black pepper", "200 g canned chopped tomatoes", "200 g passata", "2 cloves garlic", "10 g fresh basil", "30 g breadcrumbs, wholemeal", "40 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "200 g mozzarella, part-skim", "1 pc egg, raw", "120 g panko breadcrumbs"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°C. Slice the eggplant into 7–8 mm rounds and pat them dry. Toss the eggplant with 1 tbsp of olive oil, sea salt, and black pepper, then spread on a baking tray and roast for 18 minutes, flipping halfway, until lightly browned and tender. Meanwhile, heat a saucepan with the remaining olive oil, then sauté the sliced garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant. Stir in the chopped tomatoes and passata, simmer for 10 minutes, and season with black pepper; tear in the basil and keep warm. In a bowl, beat the egg. Mix the breadcrumbs (including the wholemeal breadcrumbs) and half the Parmesan. Dip each roasted eggplant slice into the beaten egg, then press into the breadcrumb-Parmesan mix. Arrange a layer of eggplant in a baking dish, spoon over some tomato sauce, scatter over a portion of mozzarella, and repeat until finished, ending with tomato sauce and mozzarella plus the remaining Parmesan. Bake for 20 minutes until bubbling and golden, then rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Wholewheat Turkey & Spinach Empanadas with Smoked Paprika
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholewheat flour", "2 tbsp olive oil", "180 ml water, lukewarm", "8 g table salt", "1 piece egg, raw", "400 g turkey mince, lean (5% fat)", "1 piece onion", "2 cloves garlic", "200 g spinach, fresh", "150 g canned chopped tomatoes, no added salt", "2 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp dried oregano", "20 g fresh parsley", "20 g olive oil, for frying", "1 piece lemon"]
instructions: In a bowl, mix the wholewheat flour, 1 egg, 2 tbsp olive oil, salt, and lukewarm water. Knead until you have a smooth dough, then cover and rest for 20 minutes. Finely chop the onion, garlic, parsley, and spinach. Heat a pan with 20 g olive oil over medium heat and cook the onion for 4–5 minutes until soft. Add the garlic and turkey mince and cook for 7–9 minutes, breaking it up until no pink remains. Stir in smoked paprika, cumin, oregano, tomatoes, and spinach. Cook for another 5 minutes until the filling is thick, then remove from heat and let it cool. Roll the dough thin on a lightly floured surface and cut out 8–10 circles. Spoon a small amount of filling into each circle, fold to form empanadas, and crimp the edges firmly with a fork. Preheat the oven to 200°C and place empanadas on a baking tray lined with baking paper. Bake for 18–22 minutes until golden and crisp, then serve with a squeeze of lemon.

title: Baked Chicken and Spinach Empanadas with Smoked Paprika
ingredients_json: ["220 g chicken breast, raw, minced", "180 g frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry", "1.0 piece onion, brown, diced", "2.0 clove garlic, minced", "1.0 tbsp olive oil", "1.0 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp ground cumin", "2.0 g salt", "1.0 g black pepper, ground", "240 g wheat flour, plain", "8.0 g baking powder", "110 g plain yogurt, low-fat", "60 ml water", "1.0 piece egg, raw", "40 g feta cheese, crumbled", "15 ml olive oil, for brushing"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C. In a skillet, heat 1 tbsp olive oil over medium heat and cook the diced onion for 5 minutes until soft. Add the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the minced chicken, smoked paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 8–10 minutes, stirring, until the chicken is fully cooked and no longer pink. Stir in the squeezed spinach and cook for 2 minutes, then turn off the heat and let the filling cool for 10 minutes. In a bowl, mix the wheat flour and baking powder, then stir in the yogurt and the egg. Add water gradually until you have a smooth, workable dough. Divide the dough into portions, roll each portion into thin circles, and place a spoonful of cooled chicken-spinach filling and crumbled feta in the center. Fold over to form empanadas and crimp the edges firmly with a fork. Arrange on a baking tray lined with baking paper, brush lightly with olive oil, and bake for 18–22 minutes until golden and cooked through. Let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Whole Wheat Chicken & Spinach Empanadas with Smoked Paprika Tomato Filling
ingredients_json: ["250 g whole wheat flour", "200 ml water, cold", "5 g olive oil", "4 g fine salt", "1 g ground black pepper", "1 g ground smoked paprika", "300 g chicken thigh, skinless, minced", "1 piece onion, yellow, finely chopped", "2 clove garlic, minced", "200 g spinach, fresh", "150 g canned crushed tomatoes, no added salt", "15 g olive oil", "60 g low-fat mozzarella, grated"]
instructions: Mix the whole wheat flour, 4 g salt, ground black pepper, and smoked paprika in a bowl. Stir in the 5 g olive oil and add the cold water gradually, then knead until you have a smooth, elastic dough. Cover and rest the dough for 15 minutes while you make the filling. Heat 15 g olive oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 6–7 minutes until soft. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the minced chicken and cook for 8–10 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink remains. Stir in the crushed tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes, then fold in the spinach until wilted. Remove from heat and let the filling cool slightly so it doesn’t tear the dough. Roll the dough out thinly on a floured surface and cut 18 circles. Spoon a small amount of filling onto each circle, add a little grated mozzarella, fold over, and crimp the edges firmly with a fork or your fingers. Bake on a parchment-lined tray at 200°C for 18–20 minutes until golden and crisp, then let cool for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Chicken and Black Bean Enchiladas with Roasted Corn Salsa
ingredients_json: ["350 g chicken breast, raw", "240 g black beans, canned, drained and rinsed", "1 piece red onion", "2 cloves garlic", "10 g ground cumin", "8 g smoked paprika", "4 g dried oregano", "6 g chili powder", "2 tbsp olive oil", "400 g tomato passata", "200 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "30 g tomato paste", "50 g corn tortillas", "150 g reduced-fat grated cheese", "1 piece lime", "300 g corn kernels, frozen", "1 piece red bell pepper", "1 tbsp chopped fresh coriander", "1 g salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. Slice the red onion and dice the red bell pepper, then mince the garlic. Warm the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat and sauté the onion and bell pepper for 6–8 minutes until softened. Add the garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, and chili powder and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the chicken breast cut into small cubes and cook for 6–8 minutes until lightly browned and almost cooked through. Stir in the black beans, then add the passata, tomato paste, and chicken stock. Simmer gently for 8–10 minutes until the sauce thickens; season with salt and black pepper. Meanwhile, make the roasted corn salsa: spread the frozen corn on a baking tray and roast in the oven for 12–15 minutes, then let it cool slightly. Mix the warm corn with the lime juice and chopped coriander. Warm the tortillas briefly in the oven or in a dry pan so they become pliable. Dip each tortilla in the enchilada sauce, fill with the chicken-bean mixture, roll tightly, and place seam-side down in a baking dish. Pour any remaining sauce over the top and sprinkle with reduced-fat grated cheese. Bake for 15–20 minutes until bubbling and lightly golden. Serve hot with the roasted corn salsa on the side.

title: Chicken & Black Bean Enchiladas with Spinach and Mild Roasted Red Pepper Sauce
ingredients_json: ["300 g chicken breast, raw", "1 can (400 g) black beans, drained and rinsed", "250 g spinach, fresh", "150 g corn kernels, frozen", "150 g onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "2 tbsp olive oil", "250 g tomato passata", "200 g roasted red pepper, jarred, drained", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "2 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp chili powder", "8 g salt", "1 dl water", "150 g corn tortillas", "200 g reduced-fat cheddar cheese, grated", "30 g sour cream, reduced-fat"]
instructions:
Heat 1 tbsp of the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the diced onion and cook for 4 minutes until softened, then add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the chicken breast cut into small pieces and cook for 6–8 minutes until no longer pink. Stir in the cumin, oregano, smoked paprika, chili powder, half the salt, and the tomato paste, then cook for 1 minute. Add the black beans, corn, and spinach and cook for 2–3 minutes until the spinach wilts.
In a blender or with a hand blender, blend the roasted red pepper with the passata and water until smooth. Pour the sauce into the skillet, bring to a gentle simmer, and cook for 5 minutes so it thickens slightly.
Heat the oven to 200°C. Lightly oil a baking dish. Warm the tortillas briefly in a dry pan for 15–20 seconds per side so they roll without cracking. Spoon the chicken-bean-spinach filling into each tortilla, roll tightly, and place seam-side down in the dish. Pour the remaining sauce over the top and sprinkle with the grated cheese.
Bake for 18–22 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbling. Let the enchiladas rest for 5 minutes, then finish with a small spoon of reduced-fat sour cream on top and serve hot.

title: Chicken and Black Bean Enchiladas with Roasted Pepper Salsa
ingredients_json: ["300 g chicken breast, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp dried oregano", "400 g black beans, cooked and drained", "150 g canned chopped tomatoes", "150 ml roasted red pepper sauce", "200 g corn tortillas", "120 g reduced-fat cheese, grated", "10 g fresh coriander leaves", "1 tbsp lime juice", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. Cut the chicken into small pieces and sauté it in olive oil in a pan for 6–8 minutes until browned and cooked through. Add the chopped onion and cook for 4 minutes, then stir in the garlic, cumin, and oregano and cook for 30 seconds. Add the black beans, chopped tomatoes, and roasted red pepper sauce and simmer for 6–8 minutes until slightly thickened. Warm the corn tortillas in a dry pan for about 20–30 seconds each so they become flexible. Spread a thin layer of the bean-chicken filling in a baking dish, then fill each tortilla with the mixture, roll tightly, and place seam-side down. Sprinkle the grated reduced-fat cheese over the top and bake for 15–20 minutes until bubbling and lightly golden. Finish with coriander and a drizzle of lime juice, then serve hot with extra salsa from the pan if you like.

title: Chicken & Black Bean Enchiladas with Roasted Pepper Salsa and Cheddar
ingredients_json: ["300 g chicken breast, raw, diced", "1 tbsp olive oil", "200 g onion, yellow, chopped", "2 cloves garlic, raw, minced", "220 g black beans, canned, drained and rinsed", "200 g canned tomatoes, chopped", "150 g red bell pepper, roasted, sliced", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "120 ml chicken stock, low sodium", "20 g corn flour", "15 ml lime juice", "2 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp chili powder", "10 g salt", "300 g corn tortillas", "160 g cheddar cheese, reduced-fat, grated", "30 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2%", "30 g fresh coriander, chopped"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the onion for 6–8 minutes until soft. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the diced chicken and cook until it turns white and is no longer pink, about 7–9 minutes. Stir in the black beans, tomatoes, roasted bell pepper, tomato paste, chicken stock, cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, and chili powder. Simmer for 10 minutes, then stir in the corn flour mixed with a small splash of water to thicken the sauce. Add the lime juice and cook for 1 minute more, then turn off the heat. Lightly warm the corn tortillas so they soften and don’t crack. Spoon a little filling into each tortilla, roll tightly, and place seam-side down in a baking dish. Pour the remaining sauce over the top and sprinkle with the reduced-fat cheddar. Bake for 18–22 minutes until bubbling and lightly golden. Rest for 5 minutes, then serve with a swirl of Greek yogurt and chopped coriander on top.

title: Turkey & Black Bean Enchiladas with Smoky Tomato-Chipotle Sauce
ingredients_json: ["12 piece Corn tortillas, 8 inch", "300 g Turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "200 g Black beans, cooked and drained", "180 g Onion, diced", "120 g Red bell pepper, diced", "2 clove Garlic", "200 g Tomato passata", "150 g Reduced-fat cheddar cheese, grated", "60 ml Water", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tbsp Tomato paste", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp Chipotle powder", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "0.75 tsp Salt", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground", "30 g Fresh coriander, chopped"]
instructions:
Preheat the oven to 200°C. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large pan over medium heat and cook the onion and red bell pepper for 7–8 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the turkey mince, breaking it up with a spoon, and cook for 8–10 minutes until browned. Stir in the black beans, cumin, smoked paprika, chipotle powder, oregano, salt, and black pepper. Mix in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then add the passata and 60 ml water and simmer for 8–10 minutes until the mixture thickens slightly.

Warm the tortillas so they don’t crack: heat the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil in a separate pan, then quickly warm each tortilla for 10–15 seconds per side. Spoon a line of filling down each tortilla, roll tightly, and place seam-side down in a baking dish. Pour any remaining sauce over the top and sprinkle the grated reduced-fat cheddar over the enchiladas. Bake for 15–18 minutes until hot and bubbling and the cheese is melted. Rest for 5 minutes, then finish with chopped coriander before serving.

title: Turkey and Shrimp Étouffée with Bell Pepper and Celery (Smoky Creole Style)
ingredients_json: ["30 g butter", "1 tbsp olive oil", "100 g onion, raw", "1 medium celery stalk, raw", "1 red bell pepper, raw", "2 garlic cloves, raw", "220 g turkey mince, lean 5% fat", "200 g shrimp, raw peeled deveined", "70 g long-grain rice, dry", "700 ml chicken stock, low-salt", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "0.5 tsp ground cayenne pepper", "2 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried thyme", "0.5 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp kosher salt", "2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce", "1 tbsp chopped parsley, fresh", "2 dl steamed green peas"]
instructions: Heat the butter and olive oil in a heavy pot over medium heat. Add the onion, celery, and bell pepper and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring often, until the vegetables are soft and the mixture starts to smell sweet. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the turkey mince and cook for 6–7 minutes, breaking it up until browned. Mix in the tomato paste, cayenne, smoked paprika, thyme, and oregano, and cook for 1 minute to toast the spices. Pour in the low-salt chicken stock and add the rice. Bring to a simmer, then cover and cook on low for 15–18 minutes, stirring once or twice so the rice cooks evenly. When the rice is tender, stir in the shrimp and Worcestershire sauce and simmer uncovered for 3–4 minutes until the shrimp turn pink and just cooked through. Fold in the green peas and parsley, then taste and adjust seasoning if needed. Serve hot, with a slightly thick, glossy sauce coating the rice.

title: Lighter Chicken Etouffee with Shrimp, Bell Pepper and Celery
ingredients_json: ["500 g chicken thigh, skinless, boneless", "200 g shrimp, raw, peeled and deveined", "60 g yellow onion", "70 g green bell pepper", "80 g celery", "2 tbsp olive oil", "3 cloves garlic", "30 g tomato paste", "250 ml chicken stock, low sodium", "300 ml water", "1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce", "1 tbsp Cajun seasoning", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp ground black pepper", "0.25 tsp cayenne pepper", "2 tbsp all-purpose flour", "1 tbsp butter", "250 g cooked white rice", "10 g fresh parsley", "1 tsp apple cider vinegar"]
instructions: Pat the chicken thighs dry and cut into bite-sized pieces. Heat the olive oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat, then brown the chicken in batches until lightly golden on the outside, about 6–8 minutes total, and transfer to a plate. In the same pot, add the onion, bell pepper, and celery and cook until softened, about 5–7 minutes. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Whisk the flour into the tomato paste with a splash of chicken stock, then stir it into the pot and cook for 1–2 minutes, scraping the bottom. Add the remaining chicken stock and water, Worcestershire sauce, Cajun seasoning, smoked paprika, black pepper, and cayenne; bring to a gentle simmer and cook until the sauce thickens, about 10 minutes. Stir the browned chicken back in and simmer for 8–10 minutes more. Add the shrimp and cook just until pink and curled, about 3–4 minutes. Finish with butter, apple cider vinegar, and chopped parsley. Serve the etouffee over the cooked white rice, making sure the sauce clings to the chicken and vegetables.

title: Chicken and Shrimp Etouffée with Whole-Grain Rice
ingredients_json: ["1 tbsp olive oil", "70 g onion, diced", "50 g celery, diced", "60 g red bell pepper, diced", "3 cloves garlic, minced", "40 g all-purpose wheat flour", "20 g tomato paste", "2 dl low-sodium chicken stock", "6 dl low-sodium chicken stock", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp dried thyme", "0.25 tsp cayenne pepper", "1 g black pepper, ground", "1 g fine salt", "300 g chicken breast, raw, diced", "200 g raw shrimp, peeled and deveined", "200 g long-grain brown rice, uncooked", "2 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped", "1 dl water"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a deep pot over medium heat. Add the onion, celery, and bell pepper and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring, until softened. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Reduce heat to medium-low and add the flour, stirring constantly to make a smooth roux. Cook the roux for 4–5 minutes until light golden, then mix in the tomato paste for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in 2 dl of chicken stock to remove any lumps, then pour in the remaining 6 dl stock. Add smoked paprika, thyme, cayenne pepper, black pepper, and salt. Simmer for 10 minutes until slightly thickened. Add the diced chicken and cook for 12–15 minutes, until cooked through. Stir in the shrimp and cook for 3–4 minutes until pink and just opaque. Meanwhile, cook the brown rice with 1 dl water according to package instructions. Fold half of the parsley into the etouffée, serve over the rice, and garnish with the remaining parsley.

title: Chicken & Turkey Etouffée with the Holy Trinity and Creole Tomato Sauce
ingredients_json: ["500 g chicken breast, raw", "250 g turkey mince, lean", "70 g onion, raw", "70 g bell pepper, red", "40 g celery stalks", "25 g garlic, raw", "120 g tomato passata", "2 tbsp olive oil", "60 g plain wheat flour", "1.2 l low-sodium chicken stock", "2 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried thyme", "2 bay leaves", "1 tsp cayenne pepper, ground", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "30 g fresh parsley, raw"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a heavy pot over medium heat. Add the onion, bell pepper, and celery and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring often, until softened. Sprinkle in the flour and cook for 2 minutes, stirring continuously to form a light roux. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then pour in the chicken stock gradually while stirring to avoid lumps. Stir in the tomato passata, thyme, smoked paprika, bay leaves, cayenne, salt, and black pepper. Add the chicken breast cut into small pieces and the turkey mince, then simmer gently for 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the meat is cooked through and the sauce thickens to a spoon-coating consistency. Remove the bay leaves and stir in chopped parsley right before serving.

title: Healthy Chicken Etouffee with Smoked Paprika and Cajun Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["2 tbsp (30 ml) olive oil", "120 g yellow onion, diced", "80 g green bell pepper, diced", "60 g celery, diced", "3 cloves garlic, minced", "30 g tomato paste", "180 g raw chicken breast, diced", "400 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "1 tbsp (15 g) all-purpose flour", "2 tsp (6 g) smoked paprika", "1 tsp (2 g) dried thyme", "0.5 tsp (1 g) cayenne pepper", "1.5 g fine salt", "400 g cooked brown rice", "20 g fresh parsley, chopped", "15 ml lemon juice"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a heavy pot over medium heat. Add the onion, bell pepper, and celery, and cook for 6–8 minutes until softened and lightly golden. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute to deepen the flavor. Sprinkle in the flour and smoked paprika, stirring well so the mixture becomes a thick roux, about 1–2 minutes. Add the diced chicken and cook for 4–5 minutes, stirring to coat it in the roux. Pour in the chicken stock gradually, stirring constantly to prevent lumps, then add thyme and cayenne. Simmer gently for 12–15 minutes until the sauce thickens and the chicken is cooked through. Season with fine salt to balance the flavors, then stir in the lemon juice and parsley. Serve the etouffee over the cooked brown rice.

title: Chicken & Black Bean Fajitas with Roasted Peppers and Lime
ingredients_json: ["300 g chicken breast, raw", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece lime, juice", "2 tsp ground cumin", "2 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp garlic powder", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "2 piece bell pepper, red", "1 piece bell pepper, green", "1 piece red onion", "200 g canned black beans, drained and rinsed", "120 g whole wheat wraps", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2%"]
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat, add the chicken, and cook for 6–8 minutes until browned and cooked through, stirring occasionally. Add the cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper, then cook for 1 minute so the spices become fragrant. Meanwhile, slice the bell peppers and red onion. Add the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil to the pan, add the peppers and onion, and sauté for 8–10 minutes until tender-crisp. Stir in the black beans and cook for 2 minutes to warm through. Squeeze in the lime juice and toss everything together. Warm the whole wheat wraps in a dry pan for 30–45 seconds per side. Serve the chicken and vegetable mixture in the wraps with a dollop of Greek yogurt on top.

title: Chicken & Veggie Fajitas with Lime-Cumin Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["300 g chicken breast", "220 g bell pepper, mixed colors", "180 g red onion", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 lime", "10 g garlic, fresh", "240 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "300 g whole wheat tortillas", "120 g black beans, cooked and drained", "40 g fresh coriander", "3 g salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions:
Slice the chicken breast into thin strips. Thinly slice the bell peppers and red onion. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, then add the chicken, ground cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, 2 g of salt, and black pepper. Cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring until the chicken is browned and cooked through. Add the onion and bell peppers and cook for another 6–7 minutes, until the vegetables are tender-crisp. Stir in the minced garlic for 30 seconds, then remove the skillet from the heat and squeeze in half the lime juice.

In a bowl, mix the Greek yogurt with the remaining lime juice, a small pinch of salt (using 1 g total remaining salt overall), and most of the chopped coriander. Warm the whole wheat tortillas in a dry pan for about 20–30 seconds per side, so they become pliable. Divide the chicken and vegetables and black beans among the tortillas, top with the yogurt sauce, and finish with the remaining coriander. Serve hot.

title: Crispy Oven-Baked Chickpea Falafel with Herby Yogurt and Tzatziki
ingredients_json: ["250 g canned chickpeas, drained", "40 g fresh parsley", "25 g fresh coriander", "1 piece garlic clove", "1 piece lemon, zest and juice", "1 piece onion, finely chopped", "2 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp ground coriander", "0.5 tsp ground black pepper", "1 tsp salt", "80 g whole-wheat breadcrumbs", "25 ml olive oil", "250 g plain Greek yogurt (2% fat)", "1 piece cucumber, grated and squeezed dry", "1 tsp dried mint", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tbsp tahini", "2 tsp apple cider vinegar"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a food processor, pulse the chickpeas with parsley, coriander, garlic, onion, lemon zest, lemon juice, cumin, ground coriander, black pepper and salt until it forms a thick, slightly coarse mixture; do not blend until fully smooth. Stir in the whole-wheat breadcrumbs and mix until the mixture holds together. Shape into small patties or balls, then lightly brush with olive oil and arrange on the tray with space between. Bake for 18–22 minutes, turning once halfway, until golden and crisp at the edges. Meanwhile, mix the Greek yogurt with grated cucumber, dried mint, apple cider vinegar and 1 tbsp olive oil; taste and adjust the lemon brightness with a little extra lemon juice if needed. Stir tahini into the remaining yogurt sauce until smooth, then serve falafel hot with the herby yogurt-tzatziki and a spoon of extra lemon if you like it sharper.

title: Crispy Baked Chickpea Falafel with Tahini-Lemon Sauce and Herby Salad
ingredients_json: ["250 g dried chickpeas, soaked and drained", "1 piece onion, raw", "3 piece garlic cloves, raw", "30 g fresh parsley", "15 g fresh coriander", "2 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp ground coriander", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp fine salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "2 tbsp lemon juice", "60 g chickpea flour", "10 g olive oil", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain 2% fat", "2 tbsp tahini", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece cucumber, raw", "1 piece tomato, raw", "1 piece lemon, zest and juice"]
instructions: Soak the dried chickpeas overnight in plenty of cold water, then drain well. Blend the soaked chickpeas with the onion, garlic, parsley, and coriander until you get a coarse paste, not a smooth puree. Mix in cumin, ground coriander, smoked paprika, salt, black pepper, lemon juice, and chickpea flour, then chill the mixture for 20 minutes so it firms up. Preheat the oven to 220°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Shape the mixture into small patties or balls, place them on the tray, and brush or mist them with 10 g olive oil for browning. Bake for 18–22 minutes, turning once halfway through, until the outside looks crisp and slightly darkened. While the falafel bakes, make the tahini-lemon sauce by stirring Greek yogurt, tahini, 1 tbsp olive oil, lemon zest, and lemon juice until smooth. Dice the cucumber and tomato and mix them with a little salt and any remaining lemon juice. Serve the baked falafel hot with the tahini sauce and a fresh cucumber-tomato salad on the side.

title: Crispy Baked Chickpea Falafel with Lemon-Tahini Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["250 g dried chickpeas", "30 g fresh parsley", "20 g fresh coriander", "1 piece onion, yellow", "3 cloves garlic", "2 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp ground coriander", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp salt", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "3 tbsp olive oil", "180 g Greek yogurt, plain 2%", "1 tbsp tahini (sesame seed paste)", "1 piece lemon, zest and juice", "200 g cucumber", "200 g cherry tomatoes"]
instructions: Soak the dried chickpeas in plenty of cold water for 12 hours, then drain well. Add the chickpeas, parsley, coriander, onion, garlic, cumin, ground coriander, smoked paprika, baking powder, salt and black pepper to a food processor and blend until you get a thick, grainy mixture that holds together when pressed. Shape the falafel into small patties or balls. Heat the oven to 220°C and line a tray with baking paper. Brush the falafel with the olive oil and bake for 18 minutes, then turn and bake for another 12–15 minutes until crisp and lightly browned on the outside. While the falafel bakes, stir the yogurt with tahini, lemon zest and lemon juice, and add a little freshly ground black pepper if you like. Serve the warm falafel with a quick salad of chopped cucumber and halved cherry tomatoes, plus the lemon-tahini yogurt on the side.

title: Crispy Baked Chickpea Falafel with Herby Tahini Yogurt and Lemon
ingredients_json: ["250 g canned chickpeas, drained and rinsed", "40 g dry breadcrumbs, wholemeal", "1 piece egg, raw", "10 g fresh parsley, chopped", "8 g fresh coriander, chopped", "6 g garlic, crushed", "10 g ground cumin", "5 g ground coriander", "3 g smoked paprika", "2 g ground black pepper", "5 g fine salt", "30 ml olive oil", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain 2% fat", "30 g tahini", "30 ml lemon juice", "1 piece lemon zest, grated", "150 g cucumber, diced", "200 g cherry tomatoes, halved"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a food processor, add the chickpeas, breadcrumbs, egg, parsley, coriander, garlic, cumin, ground coriander, smoked paprika, black pepper, and 2 g of the salt. Pulse until the mixture is crumbly and well combined but not smooth; you should be able to shape it into small patties. Mix in 20 ml of the olive oil, then shape into about 18 small falafel, pressing lightly so they hold together. Place them on the tray and lightly brush or drizzle with the remaining 10 ml olive oil. Bake for 18 minutes, flip carefully, then bake for another 10 minutes until browned and crisp at the edges. Stir the Greek yogurt with tahini, lemon juice, lemon zest, and the remaining 3 g salt. Serve the falafel hot with the herby tahini yogurt and the cucumber and cherry tomatoes on the side. For best results, let the falafel rest for 2 minutes after baking so they firm up before eating.

title: Creamy Spinach Chicken Fettuccini with Lemon and Parmesan
ingredients_json: ["350 g fettuccine pasta, dried", "300 g chicken breast, raw", "300 g spinach, fresh", "200 g cherry tomatoes", "1 piece lemon, zest and juice", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 cloves garlic", "200 ml cooking cream, light (10% fat)", "60 g Parmesan cheese, hard", "20 g dried basil", "3 g salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the fettuccine according to the package until al dente. While the pasta cooks, cut the chicken breast into thin strips, heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat, and cook the chicken for about 6–8 minutes until browned and cooked through. Add the garlic and dried basil and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant, then add the cherry tomatoes and cook for 3–4 minutes until they begin to soften. Stir in the spinach and cook until wilted, then pour in the light cooking cream and simmer gently for 2–3 minutes to slightly thicken. Add the lemon zest and lemon juice, season with black pepper and salt, and toss in the cooked pasta with a splash of pasta water if needed to help coat everything. Finish by stirring in the Parmesan and serve immediately while hot.

title: Garlic Spinach Chicken Fettuccine with Lemon-Parmesan
ingredients_json: ["200 g fettuccine pasta, dried", "250 g chicken breast, raw", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "250 g cherry tomatoes", "150 g baby spinach", "120 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "150 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "1 pc lemon, zest and juice", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "0.5 tsp salt"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the fettuccine until al dente, then reserve about 150 ml of the pasta water and drain. While the pasta cooks, cut the chicken breast into thin strips and heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 6–8 minutes, stirring, until browned and cooked through. Add the garlic and dried oregano and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Stir in the cherry tomatoes and chicken stock, then simmer for 5–7 minutes until the tomatoes soften and the sauce looks glossy. Add the spinach and stir until wilted, then add the lemon zest and juice. Toss the drained fettuccine into the skillet with a splash of reserved pasta water to help coat the noodles, then turn off the heat and fold in the grated Parmesan. Season with black pepper and check saltiness; serve immediately while hot.

title: Creamy Spinach & Salmon Fettuccini with Lemon-Garlic
ingredients_json: ["300 g fettuccine, dried", "250 g salmon fillet, raw", "2 tbsp olive oil", "3 cloves garlic", "250 g baby spinach, fresh", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "100 g grated Parmesan", "1 piece lemon, zest and juice", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 tsp salt", "1 dl water"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the fettuccine according to the package directions until al dente. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat and add the minced garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant, being careful not to brown it. Add the salmon fillet to the pan, season with black pepper, and cook for about 6–8 minutes, flipping once, until it flakes easily with a fork. Stir in the baby spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes until wilted. In a bowl, mix the Greek yogurt with the lemon zest and juice. When the pasta is ready, reserve about 1 dl of cooking water, then drain the pasta and add it to the pan with the salmon and spinach. Turn the heat to low and pour in the yogurt mixture, adding a splash of reserved pasta water to loosen the sauce. Sprinkle in the grated Parmesan and toss everything for 1–2 minutes until the sauce is creamy and clings to the fettuccine. Taste and adjust with a little more lemon or salt if needed, then serve hot.

title: Creamy Sun-Dried Tomato Fettuccini with Spinach and Chicken
ingredients_json: ["320 g dry fettuccini", "350 g chicken breast, raw", "250 g passata di pomodoro", "60 g sun-dried tomatoes, in oil, drained", "120 g fresh spinach", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "200 ml cooking cream, light, 15% fat", "60 g Parmesan cheese", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "2.0 g salt"]
instructions: Cook the fettuccini in a large pot of well-salted boiling water until al dente, then reserve about 150 ml of the cooking water and drain. While the pasta cooks, slice the chicken breast into thin strips, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, and cook the chicken for 6–8 minutes until browned and cooked through. Add the garlic and dried oregano for the last 30 seconds, then stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and passata. Simmer the sauce for 5–7 minutes, and fold in the spinach until wilted. Reduce the heat to low, stir in the light cooking cream, and add a little reserved pasta water to loosen the sauce. Toss the cooked fettuccini into the skillet with the sauce, then shower with Parmesan and finish with black pepper. Taste and adjust salt if needed before serving hot.

title: Black Pepper Filet Mignon with Garlic Herb Mushrooms and Asparagus
ingredients_json: ["360 g beef filet mignon, trimmed", "15 ml olive oil", "2 g sea salt", "1 g black pepper, freshly ground", "300 g mushrooms, cremini, sliced", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "10 g butter, unsalted", "250 g asparagus, trimmed", "1 dl beef stock, low-sodium", "1 tbsp parsley, fresh, chopped", "1 tbsp lemon juice"]
instructions: Pat the filet mignon dry and season both sides with sea salt and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a heavy skillet over high heat until shimmering, then sear the steaks for 2 minutes per side to build a deep crust. Transfer the steaks to a plate and keep warm. Reduce the heat to medium and add the butter; sauté the sliced mushrooms for about 6–8 minutes until they are browned and their moisture cooks off. Stir in the minced garlic for 30 seconds, then pour in the low-sodium beef stock and let it simmer for 2–3 minutes to create a light sauce. In the same skillet, add the asparagus and cook for 3–4 minutes, turning once, until crisp-tender. Return the filet mignon to the pan for 1–2 minutes, just to rewarm and finish, then remove from heat. Scatter with chopped parsley and a squeeze of lemon juice before serving.

title: Herb-Seared Filet Mignon with Garlic Pepper Sauce and Sautéed Greens
ingredients_json: ["340 g beef filet mignon", "10 g olive oil", "15 g unsalted butter", "2 cloves garlic, fresh", "250 g mushrooms, cremini, sliced", "200 g spinach, fresh", "300 g broccoli, florets", "250 ml beef stock, low-salt", "120 ml red wine, dry", "5 g Dijon mustard", "2 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt, fine"]
instructions: Pat the filet mignon dry with paper towels and season both sides with salt and half of the black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a heavy skillet over medium-high heat until it shimmers. Sear the filets for about 3–4 minutes per side, until deeply browned, then remove to a plate and let rest. In the same pan, lower the heat to medium and melt the butter. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then stir in the sliced mushrooms and cook for 6–8 minutes until the mushrooms release their liquid and start to brown. Add the red wine and simmer for 2 minutes, then pour in the low-salt beef stock and Dijon mustard. Stir well and reduce the sauce for 5–7 minutes until slightly thickened. Meanwhile, steam the broccoli florets for 6–7 minutes until tender-crisp, then sauté the spinach in a separate pan over medium heat for 1–2 minutes until just wilted; keep warm. Slice the rested steaks, return them to the pan for 1 minute to warm through, and spoon the sauce over the top. Serve with the broccoli and sautéed spinach, finishing with the remaining black pepper.

title: Herb-Pan Seared Filet Mignon with Garlic-Butter Mushrooms and Roasted Asparagus
ingredients_json: ["450 g beef tenderloin (filet mignon), trimmed", "30 g olive oil", "250 g chestnut mushrooms, sliced", "2 clove garlic, minced", "300 g asparagus, trimmed", "1 medium onion, finely sliced (150 g)", "10 g fresh thyme leaves", "20 g unsalted butter", "10 g balsamic vinegar", "3 g fine sea salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Pat the filet mignon dry and season all over with salt and black pepper. Heat 20 g olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the beef for 2–3 minutes per side until browned, then transfer to a plate and keep warm. Reduce heat to medium and add the remaining 10 g olive oil and the sliced onion; cook for 5 minutes until softened. Add the mushrooms and thyme and cook for 8–10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the mushrooms release their liquid and it mostly evaporates. Stir in the minced garlic for 30 seconds, then add the balsamic vinegar and cook for 1 minute. Return the beef (and any juices) to the skillet and add the butter; cook for 2–4 minutes for medium-rare (time depends on thickness) until the center reaches your preferred doneness. Meanwhile, roast the asparagus: heat the oven to 220°C and roast on a tray for 10–12 minutes until tender-crisp with lightly browned tips. Serve the filet mignon topped with the garlic-mushroom pan sauce alongside the roasted asparagus.

title: Pepper-Crusted Filet Mignon with Garlic Herb Pan Sauce and Roasted Asparagus
ingredients_json: ["360 g beef filet mignon, trimmed", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 tsp wholegrain mustard", "1 tsp black pepper, coarsely ground", "1 g garlic", "400 g asparagus, trimmed", "250 g cherry tomatoes", "20 g shallot", "2 dl low-sodium beef stock", "10 g unsalted butter", "5 g fresh thyme", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Pat the filet mignon dry, then rub the surface with olive oil, wholegrain mustard, half of the black pepper, and half of the salt. Heat a heavy skillet over medium-high heat until hot, then sear the steaks for 2–3 minutes per side without moving them. Reduce the heat to medium and cook for another 2–4 minutes, turning once, until the center reaches your preferred doneness (for medium-rare, look for a pink center and an internal temperature around 54–56°C). Transfer the steaks to a plate, cover loosely, and rest while you roast the vegetables. Toss the asparagus and cherry tomatoes with the remaining salt, the rest of the pepper, finely chopped shallot, minced garlic, and thyme. Spread on a baking tray and roast at 220°C for 12–15 minutes until the asparagus is tender-crisp and the tomatoes blister. Return the skillet to medium heat and melt the butter; add the shallot and garlic remnants and cook for 30–60 seconds. Pour in the low-sodium beef stock and simmer for 3–4 minutes, scraping up browned bits, until slightly reduced and glossy. Slice the rested filet mignon, spoon over the pan sauce, and serve with the roasted asparagus and tomatoes.

title: Herb-Crusted Filet Mignon with Garlic-Butter Asparagus and Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["360 g beef tenderloin filet mignon, trimmed", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 tsp Dijon mustard", "2 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp garlic powder", "400 g asparagus, trimmed", "250 g cherry tomatoes", "2 tbsp unsalted butter", "1 lemon, zest and juice", "2 g fine salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Pat the filet mignon dry with paper towels. Rub the beef with olive oil, Dijon mustard, dried thyme, garlic powder, lemon zest, black pepper, and half the salt. Heat a heavy skillet over high heat until very hot, then sear the steaks for about 2 minutes per side without moving them. Reduce heat to medium and cook for another 2–4 minutes per side, depending on thickness, until the center reaches your preferred doneness; for best results, use a thermometer aiming for 55–60°C for medium-rare. Remove the steaks to a plate and rest while you cook the vegetables. In the same skillet, add the unsalted butter and the asparagus, then sauté on medium-high for 4–6 minutes until crisp-tender and lightly browned. Add the cherry tomatoes and a squeeze of lemon juice and cook for 2–3 minutes until the tomatoes blister. Sprinkle the vegetables with the remaining salt, slice the steak, and serve with the asparagus and tomatoes, spooning over any pan juices.

title: Garlic-Lime Flank Steak with Charred Peppers and Quinoa
ingredients_json: ["2 cm flank steak, trimmed", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "1 tbsp lime juice", "1 tsp lime zest", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "400 g red bell pepper, sliced", "250 g courgette, sliced", "200 g quinoa, dry", "500 ml vegetable stock", "2 tsp soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tbsp fresh coriander leaves"]
instructions: Pat the flank steak dry and slice it slightly against the grain, then set aside. In a bowl, mix olive oil, minced garlic, lime juice and zest, cumin, smoked paprika, and low-sodium soy sauce. Rub the mixture over the steak and let it marinate while you cook the quinoa. Rinse the quinoa, then combine it with the vegetable stock in a saucepan and bring to a gentle simmer. Cook for about 15 minutes until the quinoa is tender and the liquid is absorbed, then cover and rest for 5 minutes. Heat a large skillet or grill pan on high heat, add the steak slices in a single layer, and sear for 2–3 minutes per side until browned and cooked to your liking. Remove the steak and rest it briefly. In the same pan, char the bell pepper and courgette for 4–6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lightly blistered but still crisp. Fluff the quinoa with a fork, spoon it onto plates, top with the charred vegetables and steak, and finish with fresh coriander.

title: Garlic-Lime Flank Steak with Roasted Broccoli and Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["500 g flank steak, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 cloves garlic", "2 tbsp lime juice", "1 tbsp soy sauce, low salt", "1 tsp Dijon mustard", "400 g broccoli florets", "300 g carrots, whole peeled", "250 g brown rice, dry", "600 ml vegetable stock, low salt", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp black pepper", "1 tsp salt"]
instructions: Pat the flank steak dry and place it in a bowl. Mix olive oil, minced garlic, lime juice, low-salt soy sauce, Dijon mustard, smoked paprika, and black pepper, then rub the marinade over the steak. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 20 minutes while you prepare the vegetables and rice. Rinse the brown rice, then add it to a pot with the vegetable stock and bring to a simmer. Cover and cook for about 30–35 minutes, until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed. Meanwhile, cut broccoli into bite-size florets and slice carrots into thin sticks. Toss the vegetables with a small splash of water and spread them on a baking tray. Roast at 220°C for 15–18 minutes until the broccoli is browned at the edges and the carrots are tender. Heat a heavy pan or grill pan on high heat. Cook the flank steak for 3–4 minutes per side for medium-rare, then rest it on a board for 8 minutes before slicing thinly against the grain. Serve the steak with the roasted vegetables and brown rice.

title: Garlic-Lime Flank Steak with Charred Pepper Quinoa
ingredients_json: ["2 tbsp Olive oil", "500 g Flank steak", "1 tbsp Soy sauce (low salt)", "1 tbsp Lime juice", "2 clove Garlic", "1 tsp Honey", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "350 g Quinoa (dry)", "700 ml Water", "300 g Red bell pepper", "200 g Zucchini", "1 small Red onion", "30 g Fresh coriander"]
instructions: Pat the flank steak dry and rub it with olive oil, soy sauce, lime juice, minced garlic, honey, cumin, and smoked paprika. Marinate while you prepare the quinoa and vegetables, ideally for 20 minutes. Rinse the quinoa, then simmer it with 700 ml water until the grains are tender and the liquid is absorbed, about 15 minutes; fluff and keep warm. Heat a griddle or heavy pan until very hot, then char the sliced red bell pepper, zucchini, and red onion in batches if needed, cooking until you see browned edges and the vegetables are tender-crisp, about 6 to 8 minutes total. Sear the steak on the hot pan for 3 to 4 minutes per side for medium-rare, then rest it on a board for 5 minutes before slicing thinly against the grain. Serve the steak over quinoa and top with the charred vegetables and chopped coriander.

title: Garlic-Lime Flank Steak with Roasted Broccoli and Quinoa
ingredients_json: ["450 g flank steak", "1 tbsp olive oil", "3 cloves garlic", "1 pc lime", "400 g broccoli", "200 g quinoa, dry", "500 ml vegetable stock", "10 g soy sauce", "5 g honey", "3 g ground black pepper", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Pat the flank steak dry and slice it against the grain into 1 cm strips. In a bowl, mix the olive oil, finely grated garlic, the zest and juice of the lime, soy sauce, honey, black pepper, and half of the salt. Toss the steak with this marinade and let it sit while you prepare the rest. Rinse the quinoa, then simmer it in the vegetable stock with the remaining salt for 12–15 minutes until the liquid is absorbed and the grains are fluffy; cover and rest for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, roast the broccoli on a baking tray at 220°C for about 15–18 minutes until browned at the edges. Heat a large pan over high heat and cook the marinated steak in a single layer for 1–2 minutes per side (cook just until browned and still juicy). Serve the quinoa topped with broccoli and the hot steak, squeezing over any extra lime juice from the pan and finishing with a little extra black pepper if desired.

title: Garlic-Lime Flank Steak with Charred Pepper Quinoa Bowl
ingredients_json: ["500 g flank steak", "200 g dry quinoa", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 medium lime", "3 clove garlic", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp sea salt", "1/2 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 red bell pepper", "1 yellow bell pepper", "1 red onion", "200 g cherry tomatoes", "60 g baby spinach", "2 tbsp chopped fresh coriander"]
instructions: Pat the flank steak dry and slice it against the grain into thin strips. In a bowl, mix olive oil with the juice of the limes, minced garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper. Toss the steak strips in the marinade and let them sit while you cook the quinoa. Rinse the quinoa, then simmer it in 400 ml water for about 15 minutes until tender and the water is absorbed; fluff with a fork and cover to keep warm. Heat a large skillet or grill pan over high heat and add the steak strips in a single layer; cook for 2–3 minutes, turning once, until browned and cooked through but still juicy. Remove the steak and quickly char the sliced red and yellow peppers and red onion in the same pan for 4–6 minutes, then stir in the cherry tomatoes for 1–2 minutes until just blistered. Fold the spinach through to wilt for about 30 seconds, then stir in the cooked quinoa and half of the remaining lime juice. Serve the quinoa bowl topped with the steak strips and finish with chopped coriander and the remaining lime juice.

title: Pan-Seared Flat Iron Steak with Garlic Herb Vegetables and Lemon Pan Sauce
ingredients_json: ["450 g flat iron steak", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 clove garlic", "1 tsp dried oregano", "2 g black pepper", "6 g sea salt", "300 g baby potatoes", "250 g green beans", "1 medium red bell pepper", "200 g cherry tomatoes", "2 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tbsp Dijon mustard"]
instructions: Pat the flat iron steak dry and rub it with half the olive oil, minced garlic, oregano, black pepper, and 2 g of the salt. Heat a large frying pan over high heat until very hot, then sear the steak for 3–4 minutes per side until browned. Transfer to a plate and rest while you cook the vegetables. Halve the baby potatoes and add them to the same pan with a small splash of water; cook on medium-high for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they start to brown. Add the green beans and sliced bell pepper and cook for 6–7 minutes, then stir in the cherry tomatoes and remaining salt for the final 3 minutes. Whisk lemon juice and Dijon mustard with a tablespoon of water, pour into the pan, and simmer for 1 minute, scraping up the browned bits. Slice the steak across the grain and return it to the pan for 1–2 minutes to warm through. Serve immediately with the lemon herb vegetables and pan juices.

title: Pan-Seared Flat Iron Steak with Garlic Herb Butter and Roasted Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["320 g flat iron steak", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 cloves garlic", "1 tsp butter", "1 tsp fresh parsley", "300 g broccoli florets", "1 red bell pepper", "20 g red onion", "1 tbsp balsamic vinegar", "1 tsp Dijon mustard", "0.5 tsp salt", "0.25 tsp black pepper"]
instructions: Pat the flat iron steak dry, then season both sides with salt and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a heavy frying pan over high heat until it shimmers. Add the steak and sear for 3–4 minutes per side, then reduce the heat to medium and cook for another 2–3 minutes until the center reaches your preferred doneness. Transfer the steak to a plate and rest for 5 minutes. While the steak rests, roast the broccoli and vegetables: heat the oven to 220°C, then spread broccoli florets, sliced red bell pepper, and red onion on a tray and roast for 18–22 minutes until tender and lightly charred. Meanwhile, warm the butter in the same steak pan over low heat and add the minced garlic, Dijon mustard, balsamic vinegar, and parsley; stir until glossy and fragrant for about 30 seconds. Slice the steak across the grain, spoon over the garlic herb butter sauce, and serve with the roasted vegetables.

title: Flat Iron Steak with Garlic Herb Quinoa and Roasted Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["400 g flat iron steak", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 cloves garlic", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "300 g broccoli florets", "200 g cooked quinoa", "1 lemon", "1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Pat the flat iron steak dry, then rub it with olive oil, minced garlic, dried oregano, smoked paprika, and black pepper. Heat a heavy frying pan over high heat until very hot, then sear the steak for 3–4 minutes per side, depending on thickness, until browned and just cooked to your liking. Transfer the steak to a plate and rest for 5 minutes while you roast the broccoli. Roast the broccoli in a preheated oven at 220°C for 12–15 minutes until tender and lightly charred. Warm the cooked quinoa in a pan with the soy sauce and the juice of half a lemon, then stir in the remaining minced garlic if desired. Slice the rested steak across the grain, squeeze over fresh lemon juice, and serve with the roasted broccoli and garlic herb quinoa.

title: Pan-Seared Flat Iron Steak with Garlic Herb Mushrooms and Roasted Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["2 tbsp olive oil", "450 g flat iron steak", "1 tsp sea salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper", "250 g mushrooms, brown, sliced", "2 clove garlic, minced", "200 g broccoli florets", "1 tbsp balsamic vinegar", "200 g cherry tomatoes, halved"]
instructions: Pat the flat iron steak dry, then rub it with half the olive oil, the salt, and the black pepper. Heat a heavy frying pan over high heat until hot, then sear the steak for 3–4 minutes on the first side and 2–3 minutes on the second side for medium-rare to medium. Transfer the steak to a plate and rest while you cook the vegetables. In the same pan, lower the heat to medium and add the remaining olive oil. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook for 6–8 minutes until browned and their moisture has mostly evaporated, then stir in the minced garlic for 30 seconds. Add the broccoli florets and cook for 4–5 minutes, adding a small splash of water if the pan gets dry. Stir in the cherry tomatoes and balsamic vinegar and cook for 2–3 minutes until the tomatoes soften. Slice the rested steak across the grain, spoon the garlic mushrooms and vegetables over the top, and serve immediately.

title: Wholemeal Spinach and Chickpea Flatbreads with Lemon-Tahini Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["200 g wholemeal flour", "150 ml water", "7 g dry yeast", "1 tsp fine sea salt", "1 tbsp olive oil", "200 g chickpeas, cooked, drained", "150 g spinach, fresh", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1/2 tsp smoked paprika", "1 clove garlic", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "1 tbsp tahini", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1/2 tsp black pepper", "80 g feta cheese, reduced-fat"]
instructions: Mix the wholemeal flour, dry yeast, and sea salt in a bowl. Add the water and olive oil, then stir until you get a soft dough. Knead for about 6–8 minutes until smooth, cover, and leave to rise for 30–40 minutes until it looks slightly puffy. While the dough rises, warm a non-stick pan over medium heat with the minced garlic and chickpeas. Add cumin and smoked paprika, then cook for 4–5 minutes, mashing lightly so it becomes a thick filling. Stir in the spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes until wilted; remove from heat. When the dough has risen, divide it into 4 portions and roll each into a flatbread about 20–22 cm wide. Heat a dry frying pan or griddle over medium-high heat and cook the flatbreads for 2–3 minutes per side until you see golden-brown spots and they puff slightly. Crumble the feta over the warm flatbreads, spoon on the chickpea-spinach filling, then finish with a quick lemon-tahini yogurt made by stirring Greek yogurt, tahini, lemon juice, and black pepper until smooth.

title: Chickpea and Spinach Flatbreads with Lemon-Yogurt Garlic Sauce
ingredients_json: ["200 g chickpeas, cooked, drained", "250 g spinach, fresh", "180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "120 ml water", "5 g olive oil", "120 g low-fat Greek yogurt", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 clove garlic", "1 piece lemon, zest and juice", "1 g ground cumin", "1 g ground coriander", "3 g salt", "2 g black pepper"]
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the wholemeal wheat flour, 2 g salt, and black pepper. Stir in the egg and water, then knead until you have a smooth dough. Cover and rest for 10 minutes. Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat, then add the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the spinach and cook until wilted, then stir in the chickpeas, cumin, and ground coriander and cook for 3–4 minutes until hot. Divide the dough into 4 equal portions and roll each into a thin flatbread on a lightly floured surface. Cook the flatbreads in a dry hot skillet for 2–3 minutes per side, until browned and cooked through. Stir the Greek yogurt with lemon zest and juice and a pinch of salt. Serve the chickpea-spinach filling on top of the flatbreads with a generous spoon of lemon-yogurt sauce.

title: Chicken Tikka Flatbreads with Greek Yogurt Herb Sauce
ingredients_json: ["240 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "300 g chicken breast, raw", "2 tbsp olive oil", "200 g wholemeal flatbread", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 clove garlic", "200 g bell pepper, red", "250 g chopped tomatoes, canned", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp ground coriander", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp turmeric, ground", "1 tsp garam masala", "0.5 tsp chili powder", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "1 tbsp lemon juice, fresh", "10 g fresh coriander", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the diced onion and cook for 4–5 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the chicken breast cut into bite-size pieces and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring often, until the surface turns lightly golden. Add the bell pepper, cumin, coriander, smoked paprika, turmeric, garam masala and chili powder, and cook for 1 minute to toast the spices. Stir in the chopped tomatoes and tomato paste, reduce the heat to medium and simmer for 12–15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce thickens. While the chicken simmers, mix the low-fat Greek yogurt with the lemon juice and chopped coriander, season with half the black pepper and a little salt. Warm the wholemeal flatbreads in a dry pan or microwave until soft and pliable. Spoon the chicken tikka mixture onto the flatbreads, drizzle with the yogurt herb sauce, and serve immediately with any extra sauce on the side.

title: Wholewheat Chickpea Flatbreads with Spinach, Feta & Lemon-Garlic Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["220 g chickpea flour (besan)", "320 ml water", "1 tsp ground cumin", "0.5 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp fine salt", "1 tbsp olive oil", "250 g spinach, fresh", "150 g cherry tomatoes", "150 g feta cheese, reduced-fat", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2%", "1 clove garlic, minced", "1 lemon, zest and juice"]
instructions: Stir chickpea flour, water, cumin, smoked paprika and salt in a bowl until you have a smooth batter. Rest it for 10 minutes so it thickens slightly. Heat a non-stick pan with the olive oil over medium heat, then pour in enough batter to form a thin round. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes until the edges look set and the underside is golden, then flip and cook for another 2 to 3 minutes. Repeat with the remaining batter. In the same time, quickly wilt the spinach in a hot pan for 2 minutes, then halve the cherry tomatoes and warm them for 1 minute until they start to soften. Mix the Greek yogurt with minced garlic, lemon zest and lemon juice. Serve the flatbreads topped with the spinach and tomatoes, crumbled feta, and a generous spoon of lemon-garlic yogurt.

title: Mediterranean Chickpea and Spinach Flatbreads with Feta and Lemon
ingredients_json: ["200 g chickpeas, cooked, drained", "150 g baby spinach", "180 g wholemeal flatbreads", "120 g feta cheese, reduced fat", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion", "2 cloves garlic", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1/2 tsp dried oregano", "150 ml vegetable stock", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "10 g fresh parsley", "2 g sea salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Warm the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft. Stir in the minced garlic and tomato paste, then cook for 1 minute. Add the cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, and black pepper, followed by the chickpeas and vegetable stock. Simmer for 8–10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the mixture looks thick and cohesive. Stir in the baby spinach and cook for 2–3 minutes until wilted. Turn off the heat and mix in the lemon juice and chopped parsley. Warm the flatbreads in a dry pan or directly in the oven for 1–2 minutes per side until they are hot and lightly blistered. Spoon the chickpea-spinach filling over the flatbreads, crumble over the feta, and serve immediately while warm.

title: Lightened French Onion Soup with Thyme, Gruyère-Style Cheese, and Wholegrain Croutons
ingredients_json: ["900 g yellow onions, sliced", "30 g olive oil", "15 g butter, unsalted", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "1200 ml vegetable stock, low-salt", "250 ml dry white wine", "2 tsp fresh thyme leaves", "1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, reduced sugar", "1 tsp soy sauce, low-salt", "1 tbsp whole wheat flour", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "60 g wholegrain bread, cubed", "120 g cheese, Gruyère, grated"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil and butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add the sliced onions and cook for 30–35 minutes, stirring often, until they are deep golden and very soft. Lower the heat to medium-low, add the garlic, and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Sprinkle in the whole wheat flour and stir well so the onions are lightly coated. Pour in the white wine and let it simmer for 4–5 minutes, stirring and scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot. Add the vegetable stock, thyme, Worcestershire sauce, soy sauce, salt, and black pepper, then simmer gently for 20 minutes to develop a rich, slightly thick texture. Meanwhile, toast the wholegrain bread cubes in a dry pan or oven until crisp. Ladle the soup into bowls, top each with toasted croutons and a generous layer of grated Gruyère-style cheese, then broil under high heat for 2–3 minutes until bubbling and golden.

title: Light French Onion Soup with Thyme, White Wine and Gruyère-Style Topper
ingredients_json: ["700 g yellow onions, thinly sliced", "30 g olive oil", "10 g garlic, minced", "1000 ml vegetable stock, low-salt", "200 ml white wine, dry", "40 g wholegrain bread, sliced", "60 g cheese, reduced-fat gruyère style, grated", "1 tsp fresh thyme leaves", "1 bay leaf", "5 g salt", "2 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat. Add the onions and cook for about 35–45 minutes, stirring often, until they are deeply golden and very soft. Reduce the heat to medium-low if they start to brown too quickly, and stir in the minced garlic for the last 2 minutes. Pour in the white wine and simmer for 3–5 minutes to cook off the sharpness. Add the vegetable stock, thyme, and bay leaf, then simmer gently for 20 minutes so the flavors come together. Remove the bay leaf and season with black pepper and the salt if needed. While the soup simmers, toast the wholegrain bread slices until crisp. Ladle the hot soup into oven-safe bowls, top with bread, and sprinkle with the grated reduced-fat gruyère-style cheese. Broil under high heat for 2–3 minutes until the cheese is melted and lightly browned, then serve immediately.

title: Light French Onion Soup with Thyme and Gruyère-Style Cheese
ingredients_json: ["900 g yellow onions, sliced", "30 g olive oil", "500 ml vegetable stock, low sodium", "250 ml beef stock, low sodium", "50 g whole-wheat flour", "500 ml water", "20 ml dry white wine", "1 tsp dried thyme", "2 g black pepper, ground", "8 g salt", "2 clove garlic, minced", "120 g bread, wholegrain, sliced", "90 g cheese, gruyère, reduced-fat"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the sliced onions and cook for about 25–30 minutes, stirring often, until they turn deep golden and very soft. Stir in the minced garlic and thyme and cook for 1 minute. Sprinkle in the whole-wheat flour and stir well so the onions are lightly coated; cook for 2 minutes to remove the raw flour taste. Pour in the vegetable stock, beef stock, white wine, and water, then bring to a gentle simmer. Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the soup is slightly thickened. Season with ground black pepper and salt, tasting to balance the flavors. Toast the wholegrain bread slices and top each with reduced-fat gruyère-style cheese. Serve the hot soup with the cheesy toast on top or on the side.

title: Light French Onion Soup with Thyme, White Wine and Gruyère Croutons
ingredients_json: ["800 g Yellow onions, sliced", "30 g Olive oil", "25 g Butter, unsalted", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "250 ml White wine, dry", "1.5 L Vegetable stock, low-salt", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "1 bay leaf, dried", "15 g Wheat flour, plain", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "6 g Salt, table", "8 slices Baguette, wholegrain", "120 g Gruyère cheese, reduced-fat, grated"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil and butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add the sliced onions and cook for 25–30 minutes, stirring often, until they turn deep golden and soft. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, then sprinkle over the flour and stir well to coat the onions. Pour in the white wine and scrape the bottom of the pot, cooking for 2–3 minutes until slightly reduced. Add the low-salt vegetable stock, dried thyme, and bay leaf, then bring to a gentle simmer. Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the soup is lightly thickened; season with black pepper and adjust with the salt. Toast the wholegrain baguette slices and top each with grated Gruyère. Ladle the hot soup into bowls, place the cheesy croutons on top, and broil/grill for 2–3 minutes until the cheese is melted and lightly browned. Let stand for 2 minutes before serving.

title: Lightened French Onion Soup with Wholegrain Croutons and Gruyère
ingredients_json: ["900 g yellow onions, sliced", "20 g olive oil", "30 g butter", "3 g garlic, minced", "20 g plain flour", "1.2 L beef stock, low-salt", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes", "12 g soy sauce, low-sodium", "5 g dried thyme", "2 g black pepper, ground", "1.5 g salt", "100 g wholegrain bread, sliced", "20 g Gruyère cheese, grated"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil and butter in a large heavy pot over medium heat. Add the sliced onions and cook for 25–30 minutes, stirring often, until they turn deeply golden and very soft. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, then sprinkle over the flour and cook for 1–2 minutes to remove the raw flour taste. Pour in the low-salt beef stock and add the chopped tomatoes, soy sauce, thyme, and black pepper. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the soup thickens to a glossy consistency. Toast the wholegrain bread slices and top them with the grated Gruyère. Ladle the hot soup into bowls, float the cheesy croutons on top, and broil or cover under a hot grill for 2–4 minutes until the cheese melts and turns lightly bubbly. Taste and adjust only if needed, then serve immediately.

title: Crispy Oven-Fried Chicken with Lemon-Dill Yogurt and Sweet Potato Wedges
ingredients_json: ["600 g chicken breast, skinless", "200 g plain yoghurt, low-fat", "2 piece egg, raw", "120 g wholemeal breadcrumbs", "80 g cornflour", "2 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp garlic powder", "2 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp fine salt", "2 g black pepper", "30 g olive oil", "800 g sweet potato", "200 g carrot, raw", "300 g green beans, raw", "1 piece lemon, zest and juice"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C and line a large baking tray with baking paper. Cut the chicken breast into even-sized strips. In a bowl, mix the low-fat yoghurt with lemon zest, lemon juice, dried oregano, garlic powder, smoked paprika, black pepper and half of the salt; set aside. In a second bowl, whisk the eggs. In a third bowl, combine wholemeal breadcrumbs and cornflour with the remaining salt. Dip the chicken strips first in the egg, then coat evenly in the breadcrumb-cornflour mixture and place them on the tray in a single layer. Drizzle with the olive oil, then bake for 18 minutes, flip the pieces, and bake for another 10–12 minutes until deeply golden and cooked through with no pink in the center. While the chicken bakes, cut the sweet potato into wedges, slice the carrots into sticks, and trim the green beans. Toss the sweet potato with a little water and spread on a second tray; roast for 20 minutes, then add carrots and green beans and roast for a further 10 minutes until tender. Serve the crispy chicken with the lemon-dill yoghurt on the side and the roasted vegetables.

title: Crispy Oven-Fried Chicken Cutlets with Lemon Pepper & Crunchy Oats
ingredients_json: ["600 g chicken breast, skinless, boneless", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2%", "2 ml olive oil", "10 g fine salt", "3 g black pepper, ground", "3 g garlic powder", "2 g paprika, smoked", "60 g oats, rolled", "30 g wholemeal breadcrumbs", "1 piece egg, raw"]
instructions: Heat your oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Line a baking tray with baking paper and lightly brush it with the olive oil. Slice the chicken breast into cutlets and pat them dry so the coating sticks. In a bowl, mix the Greek yogurt with the salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika. Add the chicken and coat well, then let it marinate while the oven heats. In another bowl, beat the egg. Pulse the oats to a coarse crumb, then stir in the wholemeal breadcrumbs. Dip each marinated cutlet into the egg, press into the oat-breadcrumb mixture until evenly coated, and place on the tray with space between pieces. Bake for 18 minutes, then turn the pieces and bake for another 10 minutes, until the coating is deep golden and the chicken reaches 74°C in the thickest part. Rest for 3 minutes before serving for a crisper crust.

title: Oven-Crispy Buttermilk Fried Chicken with Oregano and Lemon
ingredients_json: ["800 g chicken breast, skinless", "250 ml buttermilk, low-fat", "1 tbsp Dijon mustard", "180 g plain wheat flour", "80 g wholegrain breadcrumbs", "2 tsp smoked paprika", "2 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp garlic powder", "1 tsp fine salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "60 ml olive oil", "400 g potato, raw, cut into wedges", "250 g broccoli florets"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C and place a wire rack over a baking tray. Cut the chicken breast into cutlets about 1.5–2 cm thick, then pat lightly to remove excess moisture. In a bowl, whisk the buttermilk with the Dijon mustard. In another bowl, mix the flour, breadcrumbs, smoked paprika, oregano, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Dip each chicken cutlet into the buttermilk, let the excess drip off, then coat thoroughly in the flour-breadcrumb mixture and press lightly so it adheres. Arrange the coated chicken on the rack and drizzle or brush with the olive oil to help it crisp. Bake for 18 minutes, then carefully turn the chicken and bake for another 10–12 minutes until the coating is deep golden and the chicken is cooked through. Toss the potato wedges with a little of the remaining coating mix, spread them on the same tray under or beside the chicken, and roast for 25 minutes total, stirring once halfway. Add the broccoli florets for the final 12 minutes of roasting so they stay bright green and tender-crisp. Serve the oven-crispy fried chicken hot with the roasted potatoes and broccoli.

title: Crispy Oven-Fried Chicken Thighs with Lemon-Herb Breadcrumbs
ingredients_json: ["600 g chicken thigh, skinless, boneless", "200 g wholegrain breadcrumbs", "80 g grated Parmesan cheese", "2 pc eggs, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 tbsp plain flour", "1 tbsp paprika, sweet", "1 tsp garlic powder", "1 tsp dried oregano", "10 g lemon zest", "300 ml buttermilk, low-fat", "5 g fine salt", "2 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C and place a wire rack over a baking tray. Cut the chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces so they cook evenly. In a bowl, mix the buttermilk with the lemon zest, salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and oregano. Add the chicken and stir until well coated, then let it marinate for 10 minutes while you prepare the coating. In another bowl, whisk the eggs. In a third bowl, mix the wholegrain breadcrumbs, Parmesan, and plain flour. Dip the marinated chicken pieces first into the egg, then press them firmly into the breadcrumb mixture so a thick, even crust forms. Arrange the coated chicken on the rack with a little space between pieces. Drizzle with olive oil and bake for 18–22 minutes, turning once halfway through, until the crust is deep golden and the chicken is cooked through with no pink in the center. Serve immediately with a simple side salad or steamed greens.

title: Chicken & Vegetable Kimchi Fried Rice with Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["180 g cooked brown rice, chilled", "220 g chicken breast, raw, diced", "2 tbsp olive oil", "150 g mixed bell peppers, diced", "120 g carrots, diced", "120 g broccoli florets", "1 small onion, raw", "120 g kimchi, chopped", "1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce", "1 tsp toasted sesame oil", "2 piece eggs, raw", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "1 tsp grated fresh ginger", "1 tbsp spring onions, sliced", "1 tbsp rice vinegar"]
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large non-stick pan or wok over medium-high heat. Add the diced chicken and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring often, until browned and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a plate. Add the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil, then sauté the onion, carrots, and bell peppers for 4–5 minutes until the vegetables begin to soften. Add the broccoli and cook for 2 minutes. Stir in the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the chopped kimchi and rice vinegar and cook for 1 minute, then return the chicken to the pan. Push everything to one side and add the beaten eggs to the empty space; scramble until just set, then mix through. Add the chilled brown rice, soy sauce, and sesame oil. Fry for 3–4 minutes, tossing well so the rice heats through and lightly toasts. Finish with spring onions and serve immediately, making sure the rice is hot and no longer clumps.

title: Chicken & Veggie Cauliflower Fried Rice with Garlic and Soy-Ginger
ingredients_json: ["250 g chicken breast, raw", "450 g cauliflower, raw (riced)", "200 g carrots, raw", "180 g bell pepper, red, raw", "120 g frozen peas", "2 tbsp olive oil", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "1 pc ginger, fresh (20 g)", "200 g long-grain rice, cooked and chilled", "2 pc eggs, whole, raw", "4 tbsp soy sauce, reduced salt", "1 tsp sesame oil", "1 tsp rice vinegar", "1/2 tsp black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of the olive oil in a large nonstick skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add the chicken breast cut into small cubes and stir-fry for 6–8 minutes until browned and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a plate. Add the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil, then add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 30–45 seconds until fragrant. Add carrots and bell pepper and cook for 3–4 minutes, then add the peas and cook for 2 minutes. Stir in the riced cauliflower and cook for 4–5 minutes, stirring often, until tender but still slightly firm and dry. Add the chilled cooked rice and the chicken back to the pan, then drizzle in the soy sauce, sesame oil, and rice vinegar. Push everything to one side and scramble the eggs on the empty side by pouring them into the pan and stirring quickly; once the eggs are set, mix through the fried rice. Season with black pepper and cook for another 1–2 minutes, until hot throughout and lightly glossy. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken & Veggie Brown Rice Fried Rice with Ginger-Soy
ingredients_json: ["180 g dry brown rice", "300 g chicken breast, raw", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion", "2 cloves garlic", "2 cm fresh ginger, grated", "2 medium carrots", "200 g frozen peas", "1 red bell pepper", "150 g cabbage, green", "3 piece eggs, raw", "60 ml soy sauce, low salt", "10 ml sesame oil", "20 ml rice vinegar", "2 g black pepper"]
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions, then spread it on a tray and let it cool completely so it fries instead of becoming mushy. Dice the chicken into small bite-size pieces. Heat half the olive oil in a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat and stir-fry the chicken for 5–7 minutes until browned and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a plate. Add the remaining olive oil to the pan, then sauté the onion until softened, about 3 minutes. Stir in the garlic and ginger and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add carrots, bell pepper, and cabbage, and stir-fry for 4–5 minutes, then add the frozen peas for 1 minute. Push the vegetables to one side, crack in the eggs, and scramble quickly until just set. Stir everything together, add the cooled brown rice, and toss well for 3–4 minutes. Add the low-salt soy sauce, sesame oil, and rice vinegar, along with black pepper, and toss again until the rice is evenly coated and hot. Serve immediately while the texture is still lightly crisp around the edges.

title: Chicken and Veggie Brown Rice Fried Rice with Sesame Soy Glaze
ingredients_json: ["220 g cooked brown rice", "200 g chicken breast, cooked and diced", "2 piece egg, whole, raw", "200 g mixed vegetables (carrot, peas, sweet corn), frozen", "1 small carrot, raw", "1 small white onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "15 ml sesame oil", "20 ml soy sauce, reduced salt", "10 ml rice vinegar", "5 g fresh ginger, raw", "1 g black pepper, ground", "1 g spring onion, fresh"]
instructions: Cook the rice ahead and let it cool so the grains stay separate. Finely dice the onion and carrot, mince the garlic and ginger, and keep the vegetables ready. Heat a large non-stick pan or wok over medium-high heat and add half the sesame oil. Add the onion and carrot and stir-fry for about 3 minutes until they start to soften, then add the garlic and ginger and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
