Add the mixed vegetables and stir-fry for 4–5 minutes until hot and lightly tender. Push the vegetables to the side, add the remaining sesame oil, and scramble the eggs in the empty space. Once the eggs are just set, stir everything together. Add the cooked chicken and the cooled brown rice, then stir-fry for 3–4 minutes, pressing gently to heat through and dry out any excess moisture. Stir in the reduced-salt soy sauce and rice vinegar, add black pepper, and toss for 30 seconds so the glaze coats the rice. Finish with the spring onion and serve hot, with the grains looking separate and lightly glossy rather than mushy.

title: Spinach & Salmon Gnocchi in Lemon-Garlic Cream Sauce
ingredients_json: ["500 g Potato gnocchi", "250 g Salmon fillet, raw", "200 g Spinach, fresh", "250 g Crème fraîche, low fat (10%)", "200 g Cherry tomatoes, whole", "2 cl Olive oil", "3 cloves Garlic", "1 piece Lemon, zest and juice", "5 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "1 g Sea salt", "1 g Black pepper"]
instructions: Cook the gnocchi in a large pot of lightly salted, gently boiling water until they rise to the surface, then cook for 1 more minute. While the gnocchi cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat, add the sliced garlic and warm it for about 30 seconds without browning. Stir in the cherry tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes until they start to soften and blister. Add the salmon to the skillet, break it into bite-sized chunks, and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until it turns opaque. Lower the heat and stir in the low-fat crème fraîche, lemon zest, and lemon juice, then simmer for 2 minutes. Add the spinach and cook until just wilted, then season with black pepper and a small amount of sea salt. Toss the drained gnocchi into the sauce and warm through for 1 to 2 minutes, until everything is glossy and well coated.

title: Spinach & Salmon Gnocchi in Creamy Lemon-Dill Sauce
ingredients_json: ["500 g Potato gnocchi, refrigerated", "250 g Salmon fillet, raw, skinless", "200 g Spinach, fresh", "300 ml Skimmed milk", "20 g Parmesan cheese, hard", "1 piece Egg, raw", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 clove Garlic, fresh", "1 piece Lemon, zest and juice", "10 g Fresh dill", "1 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the gnocchi until they rise to the surface, then simmer for 1–2 minutes more until tender. While the gnocchi cook, heat the olive oil in a deep pan over medium heat and sauté the minced garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant, not browned. Add the salmon pieces and cook for 3–4 minutes, turning gently, until mostly cooked through. Pour in the skimmed milk and whisk in the egg, stirring constantly to avoid scrambling; when the sauce thickens slightly, stir in the spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes until wilted. Add the lemon juice and zest, then stir through the dill and Parmesan until the sauce is smooth and glossy. Fold in the drained gnocchi and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute to coat. Serve hot, making sure the gnocchi are steaming and the salmon flakes easily.

title: Spinach & Garlic Pesto Gnocchi with Cherry Tomatoes and Parmesan
ingredients_json: ["500 g Potato gnocchi", "300 g Cherry tomatoes", "150 g Baby spinach", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "3 cloves Garlic", "50 g Grated Parmesan cheese", "150 ml Skimmed milk", "1 tsp Lemon zest", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "200 g Low-fat ricotta", "1.0 g Salt", "0.2 g Black pepper"]
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of the olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the garlic (thinly sliced) and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant, then add the cherry tomatoes and oregano. Cook for 8–10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the tomatoes start to burst and form a light sauce. Add the baby spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes until wilted. Stir in the ricotta, skimmed milk, lemon zest, and black pepper, then simmer gently for 2–3 minutes until the sauce turns creamy. In a separate pot, cook the gnocchi in lightly salted water according to the package instructions until they float and are tender, then drain well. Add the drained gnocchi to the sauce and toss gently for 1–2 minutes to coat. Turn off the heat, drizzle with the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil, and serve immediately with the grated Parmesan on top.

title: Spinach & Salmon Gnocchi in Creamy Dill Lemon Sauce
ingredients_json: ["500 g potato gnocchi", "250 g salmon fillet, skinless", "200 g fresh spinach", "200 g crème fraîche, low fat", "300 g cherry tomatoes", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 cloves garlic", "10 g fresh dill", "1 pc lemon, zest and juice", "10 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a gentle boil and cook the potato gnocchi according to the package instructions until they float and are tender. In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and sauté the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the cherry tomatoes and cook for 4–5 minutes until they start to burst and form a light sauce. Stir in the low-fat crème fraîche and lemon zest and juice, then add the fresh spinach and cook just until wilted. Fold in the cooked gnocchi and add the salmon pieces; cook for 4–6 minutes, turning gently, until the salmon is opaque and flakes easily. Finish with dill, black pepper, and grated Parmesan, then serve immediately with a little extra lemon juice if desired.

title: Turkey & Lentil Paprika Goulash with Bell Peppers
ingredients_json: ["400 g turkey mince, 5% fat", "200 g red lentils, dry", "1 onion", "2 cloves garlic", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 tbsp sweet paprika", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "600 ml vegetable stock, low salt", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes, no added salt", "1 red bell pepper", "1 yellow bell pepper", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 bay leaf", "10 g apple cider vinegar", "200 g low-fat plain yogurt", "1 tbsp fresh parsley"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add the onion (finely chopped) and cook for 5 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the turkey mince and cook for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up until browned. Add the sweet paprika, tomato paste, oregano, and cumin, and stir for 1 minute to bloom the spices. Add lentils, canned tomatoes, vegetable stock, bell peppers (diced), and the bay leaf. Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 25–30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are tender and the sauce is thick. Remove the bay leaf, stir in the apple cider vinegar, and season lightly if needed. Serve hot with a dollop of low-fat yogurt and a sprinkle of fresh parsley.

title: Lean Turkey and Lentil Goulash with Paprika and Bell Peppers
ingredients_json: ["450 g turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "200 g red lentils, dry", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "2 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp dried oregano", "500 g canned chopped tomatoes, no added salt", "800 ml vegetable stock, no added salt", "1 piece red bell pepper", "1 piece carrot", "150 g courgette", "1 tbsp apple cider vinegar", "6 g salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add the onion (finely chopped) and cook for 5 minutes until soft. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the turkey mince and cook for 7–9 minutes, breaking it up until it browns. Mix in the tomato paste, smoked paprika, cumin, and oregano, and cook for 1 minute to deepen the flavours. Add the chopped tomatoes, vegetable stock, red lentils, carrot (diced), and red bell pepper (diced), then bring to a gentle boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are tender and the sauce thickens. Add the courgette for the last 8 minutes so it stays intact. Stir in the apple cider vinegar, season with salt and black pepper, and cook for 2 more minutes. The goulash is ready when it has a rich, spoonable consistency without excess liquid.

title: Lean Turkey and Lentil Paprika Goulash with Bell Pepper
ingredients_json: ["2 tbsp Olive oil", "500 g Turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "1 piece Onion, yellow", "2 cloves Garlic", "2 tbsp Tomato paste", "2 tsp Smoked paprika", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "700 g Crushed tomatoes, canned", "500 ml Vegetable stock", "200 g Red lentils, dry", "1 piece Red bell pepper", "150 g Carrots", "10 g Apple cider vinegar", "8 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add the turkey mince and cook for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Stir in the finely chopped onion and cook for 4 minutes, then add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the tomato paste, smoked paprika, oregano, and cumin and stir well so the spices become fragrant. Pour in the crushed tomatoes and vegetable stock, then add the red lentils. Bring to a gentle boil, reduce the heat to low, and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are tender and the sauce has thickened. Add the diced bell pepper and sliced carrots and simmer for another 10 minutes. Finish by stirring in apple cider vinegar, and season with salt and black pepper. Serve hot with the sauce visibly thick and the vegetables still holding some bite.

title: Lean Turkey and Vegetable Goulash with Paprika and Wholegrain Pasta
ingredients_json: ["500 g turkey mince, 5% fat", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 large onion", "2 cloves garlic", "300 g red bell pepper", "200 g carrots", "150 g red kidney beans, cooked and drained", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes", "250 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "2 tbsp tomato purée", "2 tsp sweet paprika powder", "1 tsp smoked paprika powder", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp ground black pepper", "1 tsp salt", "200 g wholewheat pasta, dry"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add the onion and cook for 4–5 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the turkey mince and cook for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up until it is browned. Add the bell pepper and carrots and cook for 3–4 minutes. Stir in the tomato purée, sweet paprika, smoked paprika, oregano, black pepper, and salt, then cook for 1 minute to toast the spices. Add the chopped tomatoes, chicken stock, and kidney beans, bring to a gentle simmer, and cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Meanwhile cook the wholewheat pasta until just tender in a separate pot of salted water, then drain. Add the drained pasta to the goulash, mix well, and simmer for 2 minutes so everything is evenly coated. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed before serving hot.

title: Lemon-Garlic Ground Chicken Skillet with Spinach and Lentils
ingredients_json: ["500 g ground chicken", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "250 g canned chopped tomatoes, no added salt", "180 g cooked lentils, canned no added salt", "150 g spinach, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "200 ml chicken stock, low sodium", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp ground cumin", "0.5 lemon, juice", "1 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion and cook for 5 to 6 minutes until softened and lightly golden. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the ground chicken. Cook, breaking it up with a spoon, for 8 to 10 minutes until no longer pink. Add the oregano and cumin, followed by the chopped tomatoes and chicken stock. Simmer gently for 10 minutes, then stir in the cooked lentils and simmer for 5 minutes more to thicken slightly. Turn the heat down and stir in the spinach until wilted, then finish with lemon juice, black pepper, and salt. Serve hot, making sure the chicken is fully cooked and the sauce is bubbling and flavorful.

title: Spicy Tomato Basil Ground Chicken with Spinach and Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["500 g ground chicken breast", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion", "2 cloves garlic", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp chili flakes", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes", "150 g tomato passata", "200 g spinach", "1 dl chicken stock, low-salt", "1 tsp dried oregano", "250 g cooked brown rice", "10 g fresh basil", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion and cook for about 5 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic, cumin, smoked paprika and chili flakes, and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the ground chicken and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, for 8–10 minutes until no longer pink. Pour in the chopped tomatoes, passata, low-salt chicken stock and oregano, then simmer gently for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens. Fold in the spinach and cook for 2–3 minutes until wilted. Season with salt and black pepper. Serve the spicy tomato chicken over the cooked brown rice and top with torn fresh basil.

title: Skillet Ground Chicken with Spinach, Tomato and Whole-Wheat Couscous
ingredients_json: ["500 g ground chicken", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion, diced", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "2 dl low-salt chicken stock", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes, no added salt", "150 g baby spinach", "200 g whole-wheat couscous, dry", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the diced onion and cook for 4–5 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the ground chicken, break it up with a spoon, and cook for 8–10 minutes until no longer pink and lightly browned. Sprinkle in the cumin, smoked paprika, and dried oregano, then add the chopped tomatoes and low-salt chicken stock. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 6–8 minutes so the sauce thickens slightly. Stir in the baby spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes until wilted. Meanwhile, prepare the whole-wheat couscous according to the package instructions, then fluff with a fork. Serve the ground chicken skillet over the couscous and finish with black pepper.

title: Herby Garlic Ground Chicken Meatballs with Tomato-Lentil Sauce
ingredients_json: ["600 g ground chicken", "1 dl oats, rolled", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 dl milk, semi-skimmed", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "3 cloves garlic", "200 g carrots, raw", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes, no salt added", "200 g lentils, cooked", "2 dl chicken stock, reduced salt", "2 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "10 g fresh parsley, chopped", "8 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Mix the ground chicken, oats, egg, milk, oregano, cumin, smoked paprika, chopped parsley, salt and black pepper in a bowl until just combined. Shape into small meatballs, then heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat and brown the meatballs for about 6–8 minutes, turning until lightly golden. Remove the meatballs to a plate. In the same pan, sauté the finely chopped onion and grated carrots for 5 minutes, then add the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Stir in the chopped tomatoes, lentils and reduced-salt chicken stock and simmer for 10 minutes. Return the meatballs to the sauce and simmer gently for another 12–15 minutes until cooked through and the sauce thickens slightly. Taste and adjust seasoning only if needed, then serve hot.

title: Moroccan-Spiced Ground Chicken with Chickpeas, Spinach & Tomato
ingredients_json: ["500 g ground chicken", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp ground paprika", "0.5 tsp ground turmeric", "0.5 tsp ground cinnamon", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes, no salt added", "400 g canned chickpeas, drained", "200 g fresh spinach", "1 tsp lemon juice, bottled", "1 g fine salt", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the onion and cook for about 5 minutes until softened and lightly golden. Stir in the garlic and the ground spices (cumin, paprika, turmeric, and cinnamon) and cook for 30–60 seconds until fragrant. Add the ground chicken and cook for 8–10 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until no pink remains and it starts to brown. Pour in the chopped tomatoes and chickpeas, then simmer for 12–15 minutes so the sauce thickens slightly. Stir in the spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes until wilted. Finish with lemon juice, black pepper, and salt, then taste and serve hot.

title: Herby Ground Lamb and Tomato Lentil Skillet with Spinach
ingredients_json: ["500 g ground lamb", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion", "2 cloves garlic", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes", "200 g dry red lentils", "750 ml vegetable stock", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp dried oregano", "200 g spinach", "1 g salt", "2 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the onion and cook for 4–5 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the ground lamb and cook for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up until browned. Mix in the tomato paste, cumin, and oregano, and cook for 1 minute to deepen the flavor. Add the chopped tomatoes, red lentils, and vegetable stock, then bring to a simmer. Reduce the heat to medium-low and cook for 18–22 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are tender and the mixture has thickened. Stir in the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted. Season with salt and black pepper, then serve hot.

title: Moroccan-Style Lean Ground Lamb with Chickpeas, Spinach & Couscous
ingredients_json: ["450 g ground lamb, lean (5–10% fat)", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 large onion", "3 cloves garlic", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp ground coriander", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1/2 tsp ground cinnamon", "400 g canned chickpeas, drained and rinsed", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes", "150 g couscous, whole wheat", "300 g spinach, fresh", "500 ml vegetable stock, low salt", "20 g fresh parsley", "10 g lemon juice"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the diced onion and cook for 6–8 minutes until soft and lightly browned. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the ground lamb and break it up with a spoon, cooking for 8–10 minutes until no longer pink and the juices evaporate. Mix in the tomato paste, cumin, ground coriander, smoked paprika and cinnamon, and cook for 1–2 minutes to deepen the flavour. Add the chopped tomatoes, chickpeas and vegetable stock, then simmer for 15 minutes until the sauce thickens. Stir in the whole wheat couscous, cover, and remove from the heat for 5 minutes so it absorbs the liquid. Fold through the fresh spinach until wilted, and finish with lemon juice and chopped parsley. Serve hot, with extra parsley if desired.

title: Herby Ground Lamb with Tomato-Lentil Sauce and Roasted Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["500 g ground lamb", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion", "2 cloves garlic", "200 g canned chopped tomatoes", "200 g red lentils, dry", "600 ml vegetable stock, low salt", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "2 medium carrots", "1 medium bell pepper", "150 g baby spinach", "10 g fresh parsley"]
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook for 5–6 minutes until softened. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the ground lamb. Cook, breaking it up with a spoon, for 8–10 minutes until browned. Add the ground cumin, oregano, and smoked paprika, then pour in the chopped tomatoes and vegetable stock. Rinse the red lentils and add them to the pan, then bring to a simmer. Let it cook for 18–20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are tender and the sauce has thickened. Meanwhile, roast the sliced carrots and bell pepper in a preheated oven at 200°C for 15–18 minutes until lightly browned. Fold the roasted vegetables and baby spinach into the lamb sauce and cook for 2–3 minutes just until the spinach wilts. Finish with chopped parsley and serve hot.

title: Herby Ground Lamb and Lentil Skillet with Tomato and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["400 g ground lamb", "200 g dry red lentils", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion", "2 cloves garlic", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp ground coriander", "1/2 tsp smoked paprika", "1/2 tsp dried oregano", "700 g passata", "300 g chopped tomatoes, canned", "200 g spinach", "1/2 tsp fine salt", "1/4 tsp black pepper", "2 tbsp lemon juice"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion and cook for 5–6 minutes until softened and lightly golden. Stir in the garlic, cumin, ground coriander, smoked paprika, and dried oregano, and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the ground lamb and cook for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned all over. Rinse the red lentils briefly, then add them to the skillet together with the passata and chopped tomatoes. Bring to a gentle simmer, then cook for 15–18 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are tender and the mixture has thickened. Stir through the spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes until wilted. Season with salt, black pepper, and lemon juice, then serve hot.

title: Lean Ground Pork and Veggie Skillet with Tomato-Garlic Sauce
ingredients_json: ["500 g ground pork, lean", "1 medium onion", "2 cloves garlic", "1 medium carrot", "1 medium bell pepper, red", "200 g canned chopped tomatoes, no added salt", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 tsp salt", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "1 dl water", "200 g cooked brown rice"]
instructions: Finely chop the onion, grate the carrot, and dice the bell pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, then add the onion and carrot and cook for 4–5 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and bell pepper and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly so the garlic doesn’t brown. Add the ground pork, sprinkle with smoked paprika and oregano, and cook for 8–10 minutes, breaking it up until it is fully browned and no pink remains. Stir in the tomato paste, canned tomatoes, and water, then season with salt and black pepper. Simmer for 10 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly. Serve the pork mixture over the cooked brown rice.

title: Turkey-Style Ground Pork Lettuce Wraps with Ginger-Garlic and Peanut-Lime Sauce
ingredients_json: ["450 g ground pork, lean (5–10% fat)", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic", "20 g fresh ginger", "300 g carrots", "200 g bell pepper, red", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes, no added salt", "60 g peanuts, dry roasted, unsalted", "2 tbsp lime juice", "2 tbsp soy sauce, reduced salt", "1 tbsp rice vinegar", "1 tsp sesame oil", "8 leaves lettuce, romaine", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chopped onion and cook for 4 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic and grated ginger and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the ground pork and cook for 8–10 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and no longer pink. Stir in the carrots and bell pepper and cook for 5 minutes, then add the tomatoes, cumin, smoked paprika, black pepper, soy sauce, and rice vinegar. Simmer for 10–12 minutes until the vegetables are tender and the sauce thickens. Meanwhile, blend the peanuts with the lime juice and sesame oil until you get a coarse, drizzleable sauce. Serve the pork mixture in romaine leaves and finish with the peanut-lime sauce.

title: Herby Ground Pork & Lentil Skillet with Tomato and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["400 g ground pork", "150 g dry red lentils", "1 medium onion, diced", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "1 tbsp olive oil", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes", "600 ml low-salt chicken stock", "200 g spinach", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp black pepper", "5 g salt", "1 tbsp lemon juice"]
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the diced onion and cook for 4–5 minutes until softened. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the ground pork. Cook, breaking it up with a spoon, for 6–8 minutes until no longer pink. Add cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, black pepper, chopped tomatoes, lentils, and the low-salt chicken stock. Bring to a simmer, then reduce the heat to medium-low and cook for 18–22 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are tender and the sauce has thickened. Stir in the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted. Finish with lemon juice and adjust seasoning if needed before serving.

title: Smoky Ground Turkey and Roasted Veggie Skillet with Tomato-Lentil Sauce
ingredients_json: ["500 g Turkey mince, lean (5% fat)", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 large Onion, yellow", "2 cloves Garlic", "2 tsp Ground cumin", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "400 g Canned chopped tomatoes, no added salt", "120 g Red lentils, dry", "700 ml Vegetable stock, low salt", "2 medium Carrots", "1 medium Bell pepper, red", "150 g Spinach, fresh", "10 g Fresh parsley", "2 tsp Apple cider vinegar", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the onion (finely chopped) and cook for about 4 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic, cumin, and smoked paprika and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the turkey mince and cook for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until no pink remains and the mixture turns lightly browned. Stir in the chopped tomatoes, dry red lentils, and low-salt vegetable stock, then add the carrots (small diced) and bell pepper (small diced). Bring to a simmer, reduce the heat to medium-low, and cook for 18–22 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are tender and the sauce has thickened. Turn off the heat and stir through the spinach until wilted. Finish with apple cider vinegar and chopped parsley, then taste and adjust black pepper before serving.

title: Lean Ground Turkey Taco Bowl with Black Beans, Corn and Lime Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["500 g ground turkey, lean (5% fat)", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic", "300 g bell pepper, red", "200 g canned black beans, drained and rinsed", "150 g canned sweet corn, drained", "400 g chopped tomatoes, canned", "2 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp chilli powder", "10 g salt", "250 g natural yogurt, low-fat", "1 piece lime, zest and juice", "30 g coriander, fresh", "60 g brown rice, dry"]
instructions: Cook the brown rice in plenty of lightly salted water according to the package instructions until tender, then drain and keep warm. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat, then add the finely chopped onion and cook for 4–5 minutes until soft. Stir in the garlic and diced bell pepper and cook for another 3 minutes. Add the ground turkey and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, for 6–8 minutes until no longer pink. Tip in the chopped tomatoes, black beans, and sweet corn, then add cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, chilli powder, and salt. Simmer gently for 12–15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens and the flavors are well combined. Mix the low-fat yogurt with lime zest and juice and finely chopped coriander. Serve the turkey mixture over the brown rice and top with the lime yogurt.

title: Lean Ground Turkey Meatballs with Tomato-Lentil Sauce and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["500 g ground turkey, lean (5–10% fat)", "150 g chickpeas, cooked, drained", "200 g passata, no added sugar", "120 g red lentils, dry", "250 ml vegetable stock, low-salt", "1 medium onion", "2 cloves garlic", "300 g spinach, fresh", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper"]
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add cumin, oregano, and smoked paprika and cook for 15 seconds to bloom the spices. Add the tomato paste and passata, followed by the dry red lentils and low-salt vegetable stock. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 18 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are tender. Meanwhile, mash half of the chickpeas lightly with a fork, then mix them with the ground turkey, remaining chickpeas, and black pepper. Form small meatballs (about golf-ball size). Gently slide the meatballs into the simmering sauce, reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 15 minutes until the turkey is fully cooked through. Stir in the fresh spinach and cook uncovered for 2–3 minutes until wilted. Check seasoning and serve hot.

title: Herby Ground Turkey with Spinach, Roasted Peppers and Quinoa
ingredients_json: ["400 g Ground turkey, 93% lean", "180 g Quinoa, uncooked", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, yellow", "2 clove Garlic", "1 piece Red bell pepper", "200 g Passata, no added sugar", "200 g Spinach, fresh", "2 tsp Dried oregano", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "1 tsp Ground black pepper", "10 g Salt, table salt", "500 ml Vegetable stock, low salt"]
instructions: Rinse the quinoa under cold water, then add it to a saucepan with the low-salt vegetable stock. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook for about 15 minutes until the quinoa is tender and the liquid is absorbed. While the quinoa cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion and cook for 5 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the ground turkey, breaking it up with a wooden spoon. Cook for 8–10 minutes until the turkey is browned and no longer pink. Add the sliced red bell pepper, oregano, and smoked paprika, and cook for 3–4 minutes. Pour in the passata and simmer for 5 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Season with black pepper and salt, and combine the herby turkey mixture with the cooked quinoa. Serve hot, making sure the turkey is fully cooked through and the quinoa is fluffy rather than soggy.

title: Skillet Ground Turkey with Spinach, Cherry Tomatoes & Feta
ingredients_json: ["500 g ground turkey", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion", "2 cloves garlic", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "400 g cherry tomatoes", "200 g spinach", "150 g feta cheese, reduced fat", "200 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1/2 tsp black pepper", "1/2 tsp salt"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add the onion (finely chopped) and cook for 5 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the ground turkey, cumin, smoked paprika, and dried oregano. Cook for 8–10 minutes, breaking up the turkey with a spoon, until it is browned and cooked through with no pink remaining. Add the cherry tomatoes and low-sodium chicken stock, then simmer for 6–8 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly. Stir in the spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes just until wilted. Crumble in the reduced-fat feta, season with black pepper and salt, and cook for 1 minute so the cheese warms through. Serve hot with any remaining pan sauce.

title: Smoky Turkey and Okra Gumbo with Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["500 g turkey mince, 5% fat", "250 g okra, sliced", "130 g onion", "120 g green bell pepper", "80 g celery stalk", "30 g wholewheat flour", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 cloves garlic", "2 ml Worcestershire sauce", "15 g smoked paprika", "5 g dried thyme", "3 g dried oregano", "2 g cayenne pepper", "900 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "10 g salt", "1 dl long-grain brown rice", "10 g fresh parsley, chopped"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat. Add the onion, bell pepper, and celery, and cook for 7–9 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Sprinkle in the wholewheat flour and smoked paprika, then cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly, to form a light roux. Add the turkey mince and cook for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up until browned. Pour in the chicken stock and stir well, then add the thyme, oregano, cayenne pepper, Worcestershire sauce, and salt. Bring to a gentle simmer, then add the sliced okra and cook for 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the gumbo thickens slightly. Meanwhile, cook the brown rice according to the package instructions until tender. Spoon the gumbo over the cooked rice and finish with chopped parsley.

title: Chicken & Okra Gumbo with Brown Rice and Smoked Paprika
ingredients_json: ["600 g chicken thigh, skinless, boneless", "200 g okra, sliced", "120 g onion, diced", "80 g bell pepper, red, diced", "60 g celery stalks, diced", "3 cloves garlic, minced", "2 tbsp olive oil", "60 g wheat flour, wholemeal", "1.5 tsp smoked paprika", "1.0 tsp dried thyme", "0.5 tsp dried oregano", "2 bay leaves, dried", "900 ml chicken stock, low-salt", "150 g brown rice, uncooked", "12 g fresh parsley, chopped", "5 g salt"]
instructions: Pat the chicken thighs dry and cut into bite-sized pieces. Heat the olive oil in a heavy pot over medium heat, then whisk in the wholemeal flour to make a light roux, stirring constantly for about 6–8 minutes until it turns a caramel-brown colour and smells nutty. Add the onion, bell pepper, and celery and cook for 5 minutes, stirring so nothing sticks. Stir in the garlic, smoked paprika, thyme, oregano, and bay leaves for 30 seconds. Add the chicken stock gradually, scraping up any browned bits, then bring to a gentle simmer. Add the chicken and cook for 18–22 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the gumbo thickens. Stir in the sliced okra and simmer for another 10 minutes until the okra is tender but not mushy. Meanwhile, cook the brown rice in a separate pot according to the package instructions. Taste and adjust seasoning with the salt, then remove the bay leaves and stir in the parsley. Serve the gumbo over the hot brown rice.

title: Smoky Chicken and Quinoa Gumbo with Okra and Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["180 g chicken breast, raw", "200 g okra, frozen, sliced", "120 g onion, raw", "100 g bell pepper, red, raw", "80 g celery, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "3 tbsp olive oil", "90 g quinoa, dry", "300 g crushed tomatoes, canned", "700 ml chicken stock, reduced-salt", "2 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp ground black pepper", "1 tsp salt", "2 dl cooked brown rice, chilled"]
instructions: Pat the chicken breast dry and cut it into bite-sized cubes. Heat the olive oil in a large heavy pot over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes until lightly browned and mostly cooked through. Add the onion, bell pepper, and celery, then cook for 5 minutes, stirring often, until the vegetables soften. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the smoked paprika, thyme, oregano, and black pepper. Add the crushed tomatoes and chicken stock, bring to a gentle boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer. Add the quinoa and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally so it doesn’t stick. Stir in the okra and cook for another 10 minutes until the gumbo thickens and the okra is tender. Fold in the chilled cooked brown rice for a creamy, hearty texture and simmer for 3 minutes more. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, then serve hot.

title: Chicken and Quinoa Gumbo with Okra, Bell Pepper and Smoked Paprika
ingredients_json: ["2 tbsp olive oil", "500 g chicken thigh, skinless, diced", "1 large onion, yellow, diced", "1 green bell pepper, diced", "3 stalks celery, diced", "3 cloves garlic, minced", "200 g okra, sliced", "80 g quinoa, dry", "2 tbsp plain wheat flour", "1.5 l low-sodium chicken stock", "2 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried thyme", "2 bay leaves", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "2 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped", "30 ml lemon juice"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large heavy pot over medium-high heat. Add the diced chicken and cook for 6–8 minutes until browned. Stir in the onion, bell pepper, and celery, then cook for 5 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Sprinkle over the flour and stir constantly for 1 minute to make a light roux. Add the chicken stock gradually, stirring well to prevent lumps, then add smoked paprika, thyme, bay leaves, salt, and black pepper. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 20 minutes. Stir in the okra and quinoa and simmer for another 15–18 minutes, until the quinoa is tender and the gumbo has thickened. Remove the bay leaves, stir through the parsley and lemon juice, and serve hot.

title: Chicken Gyros with Tzatziki and Roasted Veg
ingredients_json: ["350 g chicken breast, raw", "20 g olive oil", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp garlic powder", "8 g salt, table salt", "2 g black pepper, ground", "1 large cucumber, raw", "200 g Greek yogurt, non-fat", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "2 tbsp lemon juice", "100 g red onion, raw", "1 red bell pepper, raw", "250 g cherry tomatoes, raw", "300 g potatoes, raw", "2 tbsp olive oil", "4 pieces wholemeal pitta bread"]
instructions:
Heat the oven to 220°C. Cut the potatoes into small wedges and toss them with 2 tbsp olive oil, half the salt, and half the black pepper, then spread on a baking tray. Roast for 20 minutes, then add the red onion and bell pepper cut into strips and the cherry tomatoes, and roast for another 15 minutes until the potatoes are crisp at the edges and the vegetables are lightly blistered.
Meanwhile, slice the chicken breast thinly and mix with the remaining salt, oregano, cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and the rest of the black pepper. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a non-stick pan or skillet over high heat and cook the chicken for 6–8 minutes, stirring often, until browned through and cooked to 75°C in the thickest piece.
For the tzatziki, grate the cucumber, then squeeze out excess water in a clean cloth or paper towels. Mix cucumber with Greek yogurt, grated garlic, and lemon juice until smooth. Taste and adjust consistency with a spoonful of extra yogurt if needed.
Warm the pitta breads. Assemble gyros by filling each pitta with roasted vegetables and chicken, then spoon over tzatziki. Serve immediately while the filling is hot and the pitta is soft.

title: Lemon-Garlic Chicken Gyros with Greek Yogurt Tzatziki and Crunchy Salad
ingredients_json: ["400 g chicken breast, raw", "2 tsp olive oil", "2 tsp Greek-style yogurt", "1 tsp lemon juice", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp ground cumin", "400 g Greek yogurt, low fat", "1 medium cucumber, raw", "10 g fresh dill", "1 tbsp white vinegar", "1/2 tsp salt", "1/2 tsp black pepper", "250 g cherry tomatoes", "150 g red onion", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 large whole-wheat pitas", "150 g reduced-fat feta"]
instructions: Pat the chicken breast dry and slice it thinly. Heat 2 tsp olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, add the chicken, and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through. Stir in the yogurt, lemon juice, minced garlic, oregano, and cumin, then cook for 1–2 minutes more until the chicken is glossy and fragrant. While the chicken cooks, grate the cucumber and squeeze it well in a clean cloth to remove excess water. Mix the low-fat Greek yogurt with the grated cucumber, chopped dill, vinegar, salt, and black pepper to make the tzatziki. Slice the cherry tomatoes and red onion. Lightly toss them with 1 tbsp olive oil and a small pinch of salt if needed. Warm the pitas in a dry pan for 30–60 seconds per side. Assemble the gyros by filling each pita with the chicken, adding a generous spoonful of tzatziki, and finishing with crumbled feta and the crunchy tomato-onion salad.

title: Chicken and Tzatziki Turkey Gyros with Wholewheat Pita and Tomato-Onion Salad
ingredients_json: ["360 g chicken breast, raw", "180 g turkey breast, raw", "200 g plain Greek yogurt, 2% fat", "1 piece cucumber", "2 cloves garlic", "1.5 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp ground coriander", "0.5 tsp fine salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "4 piece wholewheat pita bread", "1 piece red onion", "2 piece tomatoes", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tbsp fresh dill, chopped"]
instructions: Slice the chicken and turkey into thin strips. Heat 1.5 tbsp olive oil in a large non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat, then add the meat strips along with ground cumin, dried oregano, smoked paprika, ground coriander, fine salt, and black pepper. Cook for 8–10 minutes, stirring often, until browned and cooked through with no pink remaining. While the meat cooks, grate the cucumber and squeeze out excess water. Mix the Greek yogurt with the grated cucumber, minced garlic, lemon juice, and chopped dill, then season with a little extra black pepper if desired. Warm the wholewheat pitas in a dry pan for about 30–45 seconds per side. Slice the red onion and tomatoes and toss them together with a pinch of salt and black pepper. Assemble the gyros by filling each pita with the hot spiced meat, a generous spoonful of tzatziki, and the tomato-onion salad.

title: Chicken Gyros with Tzatziki, Tomato, and Crisp Onion
ingredients_json: ["450 g chicken thigh, skinless", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 tsp dried oregano", "2 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp sweet paprika", "1 tsp garlic powder", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper", "2 piece wholemeal pita bread", "250 g plain Greek yogurt, low fat", "150 g cucumber, raw", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tbsp fresh dill, chopped", "1 clove garlic", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece red onion", "1 piece tomato", "30 g feta cheese, reduced fat"]
instructions: Pat the chicken thigh dry and cut into thin slices. In a bowl, mix olive oil with oregano, cumin, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper, then toss the chicken until evenly coated. Heat a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for about 8–10 minutes, stirring often, until browned and cooked through. Warm the pita breads in the oven or in a dry pan for 30–60 seconds per side so they become pliable. Grate the cucumber, squeeze out excess water, then mix with Greek yogurt, lemon juice, dill, crushed garlic, and the reduced-fat feta. Slice the red onion thinly and chop the tomato. Assemble the gyros by spreading tzatziki inside the pitas, adding tomato and onion, and filling with the hot spiced chicken. Serve immediately while the chicken is still juicy and the pita is warm.

title: Turkey Chicken Gyros with Tzatziki and Wholemeal Pita
ingredients_json: ["500 g chicken breast, raw", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 tsp ground cumin", "1.5 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp garlic powder", "1 tsp onion powder", "1 g salt", "1 g black pepper", "250 g plain Greek yogurt, low fat", "1 clove garlic", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "200 g cucumber", "4 wholemeal pitta, medium", "1 large tomato", "150 g red onion", "100 g iceberg lettuce"]
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips. In a bowl, mix olive oil with cumin, oregano, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper, then toss the chicken until evenly coated. Heat a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 8–12 minutes, stirring often, until browned and cooked through with no pink. While the chicken cooks, grate the cucumber and squeeze it dry in a clean towel to prevent watery tzatziki. Stir the Greek yogurt with grated garlic, lemon juice, and the squeezed cucumber, then chill it until ready to serve. Warm the pitta in a dry pan for about 30–45 seconds per side. Slice the tomato and red onion thinly and shred the lettuce. Assemble gyros by filling each pita with chicken, tomato, red onion, and lettuce, then spoon over tzatziki and serve immediately.

title: Turkey and Shrimp Jambalaya with Brown Rice and Bell Peppers
ingredients_json: ["300 g skinless turkey breast, diced", "200 g raw shrimp, peeled and deveined", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, brown, chopped", "1 piece green bell pepper, chopped", "2 stalks celery, chopped", "4 clove garlic, minced", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp cayenne pepper", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes, no added salt", "700 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "250 g long-grain brown rice, uncooked", "1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, reduced salt", "1.5 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped", "1 tbsp green onion, sliced", "10 g kosher salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large heavy pot over medium-high heat. Add the diced turkey and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring, until lightly browned. Stir in the onion, bell pepper, and celery, then cook for 4–5 minutes until softened. Add the minced garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, just until fragrant. Sprinkle in the smoked paprika, thyme, oregano, and cayenne, and stir to coat the vegetables. Add the chopped tomatoes, chicken stock, Worcestershire sauce, brown rice, and black pepper, then bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 35–40 minutes, stirring once halfway through, until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed. Fold in the shrimp and cook uncovered for 6–8 minutes until the shrimp turn pink and are just cooked through. Off the heat, let the jambalaya rest for 5 minutes, then finish with parsley and sliced green onion and serve hot.

title: Chicken and Turkey Jambalaya with Smoked Paprika, Peppers and Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["250 g chicken breast, raw, diced", "200 g turkey breast, raw, diced", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 pc onion, yellow, raw", "2 pc bell pepper, red, raw", "2 ribs celery, raw", "3 clove garlic, raw", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "2 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp cayenne pepper", "350 g canned chopped tomatoes", "1.1 L chicken stock, low salt", "250 g brown rice, uncooked", "250 g kidney beans, canned, drained and rinsed", "2 tbsp fresh parsley, raw, chopped", "1.5 g salt", "0.5 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large heavy pot over medium-high heat. Add the diced chicken and turkey and cook for about 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned. Add the onion, bell pepper, and celery and cook for 5 minutes until the vegetables soften. Stir in the garlic, tomato paste, smoked paprika, thyme, oregano, and cayenne, and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the chopped tomatoes, kidney beans, brown rice, and low-salt chicken stock. Bring everything to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook for 35–40 minutes, stirring once halfway, until the rice is tender and the mixture has a thick, jambalaya-like texture. Uncover for the last 5 minutes if it looks too wet. Season with salt and black pepper to finish, then fold in the chopped parsley and serve hot.

title: Lean Chicken and Turkey Jambalaya with Brown Rice, Cajun Peppers, and Shrimp
ingredients_json: ["200 g chicken breast, raw", "200 g turkey mince, lean", "250 g raw king prawns, peeled and deveined", "70 g brown rice, dry", "1.2 l chicken stock, low-salt", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 piece celery stalk, raw", "1 piece red bell pepper, raw", "2 piece garlic clove, raw", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "400 g tinned chopped tomatoes, no added salt", "1.5 tbsp Cajun seasoning", "2 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp dried thyme", "200 g sliced okra, frozen", "10 g fresh parsley, chopped", "5 g salt"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large heavy pot over medium-high heat. Add the onion, celery, and red bell pepper and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring, until softened and lightly browned at the edges. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then stir in the tomato paste, Cajun seasoning, smoked paprika, and thyme until fragrant. Add the chicken breast cut into small cubes and cook for 5–6 minutes, stirring so the surface starts to brown. Add the turkey mince and cook for another 6–7 minutes, breaking it up until no longer pink. Stir in the chopped tomatoes, chicken stock, and brown rice, scraping the bottom of the pot. Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce to low heat, cover, and simmer for 30–35 minutes until the rice is tender and the mixture looks thick. Stir in the frozen okra and cook uncovered for 8 minutes to thicken further. Add the shrimp for the final 3–4 minutes, until they turn pink and curl. Turn off the heat, fold in the parsley, and let the jambalaya rest for 5 minutes before serving. Check seasoning and adjust if needed, aiming for a balanced Cajun heat rather than an overly salty result.

title: Chicken and Turkey Jambalaya with Brown Rice, Bell Pepper and Smoked Paprika
ingredients_json: ["250 g chicken breast, raw", "200 g turkey mince, 10% fat", "160 g brown rice, dry", "1 tbsp olive oil", "200 g onion, raw", "120 g bell pepper, red", "120 g celery stalks", "3 cloves garlic", "2 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp ground black pepper", "0.5 tsp cayenne pepper", "900 ml chicken stock, low salt", "200 g canned chopped tomatoes", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "300 g okra, frozen", "20 g fresh parsley", "8 g salt"]
instructions: Pat the chicken breast dry and cut it into bite-sized pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large heavy pot over medium-high heat, then add the onion, bell pepper, and celery with a pinch of salt and cook for 6–8 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Stir in the smoked paprika, thyme, black pepper, and cayenne, then add the turkey mince and chicken pieces. Cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring often, until the meat is browned. Add the brown rice, canned tomatoes, and tomato paste, then pour in the low-salt chicken stock. Bring everything to a gentle simmer, reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook for 35–40 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed. Stir in the frozen okra during the last 10 minutes of cooking, keeping the mixture at a simmer so it thickens without drying out. Finish with chopped parsley and a final check for seasoning before serving.

title: Lighter Korean Kalbi-Style Beef Bulgogi with Sesame Veg Stir-Fry
ingredients_json: ["450 g beef flank steak, lean, trimmed", "2 tbsp soy sauce, reduced-salt", "1 tbsp mirin", "1 tbsp rice vinegar", "1 tbsp sesame oil", "2 clove garlic", "20 g fresh ginger", "1 tbsp brown sugar", "1 tbsp gochujang", "1 piece spring onion", "300 g pak choi", "200 g button mushrooms", "200 g cooked short-grain rice", "10 g sesame seeds, toasted"]
instructions: Thinly slice the beef across the grain. In a bowl, stir together the reduced-salt soy sauce, mirin, rice vinegar, sesame oil, grated garlic and ginger, brown sugar, gochujang, and finely chopped spring onion. Add the beef and mix until evenly coated, then marinate while you prepare the vegetables. Heat a large nonstick skillet or wok over medium-high heat and spread the beef in one layer; cook for 2–3 minutes per side until browned and just cooked through, then transfer to a plate. In the same pan, quickly stir-fry the mushrooms and pak choi stems for 2 minutes, then add the leafy parts and cook for another 1–2 minutes until the leaves wilt but stay bright green. Return the beef to the pan for 30–60 seconds to reheat and let the flavors meld. Serve the kalbi-style beef with the cooked rice, top with toasted sesame seeds, and spoon any pan juices over the top.

title: Lean Turkey Kalbi-Style Beef Marinade with Sesame Rice and Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["400 g turkey mince, 5% fat", "30 g soy sauce, reduced salt", "20 g mirin", "15 g brown sugar", "2 tsp sesame oil", "2 cloves garlic", "15 g grated fresh ginger", "1 tbsp gochujang", "1 tbsp rice vinegar", "200 g broccoli florets", "220 g cooked jasmine rice", "1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds", "1 tbsp neutral cooking oil"]
instructions: Mix the reduced-salt soy sauce, mirin, brown sugar, sesame oil, grated ginger, minced garlic, gochujang, and rice vinegar in a bowl until the sugar dissolves. Add the turkey mince and fold well so the meat is evenly coated. Let it marinate in the fridge for 15 minutes while you heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the neutral cooking oil, then shape the turkey mixture into thick small patties and cook for 3–4 minutes per side until browned and cooked through. In the last 4 minutes of cooking, steam or pan-cook the broccoli until bright green and tender-crisp, then toss briefly with the remaining juices in the pan. Serve the kalbi-style turkey over the cooked jasmine rice, spoon over any pan glaze, and finish with toasted sesame seeds.

title: Lean Chicken Kalbi-Style with Sesame Soy Marinade and Charred Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["350 g chicken breast, trimmed", "25 g soy sauce, reduced-salt", "15 g mirin", "20 g brown sugar", "10 g sesame oil", "2 g garlic, minced", "15 g ginger, grated", "30 g spring onion, finely chopped", "10 g toasted sesame seeds", "400 g broccoli florets", "300 g cooked jasmine rice"]
instructions: Slice the chicken breast thinly across the grain. In a bowl, mix the reduced-salt soy sauce, mirin, brown sugar, sesame oil, garlic, grated ginger, and half of the spring onion. Add the chicken and toss well, then let it marinate while you prepare the vegetables. Heat a large nonstick skillet or grill pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken in a single layer, letting the surface char slightly and caramelize from the marinade, about 4–6 minutes per side depending on thickness. Transfer the chicken to a plate and keep warm. Add the broccoli to the same pan with a splash of water, cover, and steam for 2–3 minutes, then uncover and stir-fry for another 3–4 minutes until bright green and lightly charred. Serve the chicken kalbi-style over the cooked jasmine rice, spoon over any pan juices, and finish with sesame seeds and the remaining spring onion.

title: Vegetable & Lean Turkey Lasagna with Spinach and Low-Fat Mozzarella
ingredients_json: ["90 g dried lasagna sheets", "1 tbsp olive oil", "450 g turkey mince, lean", "1 large onion, diced", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "300 g carrots, diced", "200 g zucchini, diced", "400 g passata, no added sugar", "2 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp dried basil", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper", "250 g spinach, fresh", "250 g cottage cheese, low-fat", "200 g low-fat mozzarella, shredded", "30 g Parmesan cheese, grated"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the onion and carrots and cook for 6 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic and cook for 1 minute. Add the turkey mince and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, breaking it up until no longer pink. Stir in the zucchini, passata, oregano, basil, salt, and black pepper, then simmer for 10 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly. Stir in the spinach and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until wilted. In a bowl, mix the low-fat cottage cheese with half of the mozzarella and most of the Parmesan. Preheat the oven to 190°C. Spoon a thin layer of the meat sauce into a baking dish, add a layer of lasagna sheets, then add another layer of sauce and a layer of the cottage-cheese mixture. Repeat until you run out of ingredients, finishing with sauce and the remaining mozzarella and Parmesan. Cover with foil and bake for 35 minutes, then remove the foil and bake for a further 10 minutes until bubbling and lightly golden on top. Let the lasagna rest for 10 minutes before slicing so the layers set.

title: Turkey & Spinach Veggie Lasagna with Tomato Basil Sauce
ingredients_json: ["200 g lasagna sheets, wholewheat", "500 g turkey mince, lean (5% fat)", "1 pc onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes", "200 g tomato passata", "250 g spinach, fresh", "200 g low-fat ricotta", "150 g mozzarella, part-skim", "20 g olive oil", "10 g fresh basil", "10 g dried oregano", "2 g salt", "2 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat 15 g of the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion and cook for 5–6 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the turkey mince and cook for 8–10 minutes until browned and no longer pink. Add the chopped tomatoes, tomato passata, dried oregano, black pepper, and 1 g of the salt. Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens slightly. Stir in the fresh spinach and cook for 2–3 minutes until wilted. In a bowl, mix the ricotta with chopped basil. Preheat the oven to 190°C. In a baking dish, spread a thin layer of the turkey-tomato sauce, then lay in a layer of lasagna sheets. Add a layer of ricotta mixture and a layer of sauce, then repeat until you use everything, finishing with sauce. Tear the mozzarella over the top and drizzle over the remaining 5 g olive oil. Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and bake for another 12–15 minutes until bubbling and lightly browned. Let the lasagna rest for 10 minutes before slicing so it holds together.

title: Wholewheat Turkey Spinach Lasagna with Ricotta Tomato Sauce
ingredients_json: ["250 g lasagna sheets, wholewheat, dried", "400 g turkey mince, lean", "500 g crushed tomatoes, no added sugar", "250 g spinach, fresh", "200 g ricotta, low-fat", "100 g mozzarella, part-skim", "1 large onion", "2 cloves garlic", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "2 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp dried basil", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper"]
instructions:
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion and cook for 5 minutes until softened. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the turkey mince and cook for 8–10 minutes, breaking it up until no longer pink. Mix in the tomato paste, dried oregano, and dried basil, then pour in the crushed tomatoes. Simmer for 10 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly. Stir in the spinach and cook for 2–3 minutes until wilted.

Preheat the oven to 190°C. Spread a thin layer of tomato-turkey sauce in the bottom of a baking dish. Dollop over the ricotta and add a layer of wholewheat lasagna sheets. Repeat with sauce, ricotta, and lasagna sheets until you’ve used everything, finishing with a generous layer of sauce. Top with torn mozzarella. Cover with foil and bake for 35 minutes. Remove the foil and bake for a further 10–15 minutes until bubbling and lightly browned on top. Let the lasagna rest for 10 minutes before slicing so the layers set.

title: Vegetable Turkey Lasagna with Spinach and Tomato Basil
ingredients_json: ["10 dl Tomato passata", "250 g Lean turkey mince", "200 g Courgette, grated", "150 g Carrot, grated", "150 g Onion, diced", "60 g Spinach, fresh", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 cloves Garlic, crushed", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1 tsp Dried basil", "1.5 tsp Salt (table salt)", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "180 g Lasagna sheets, whole wheat (dry)", "250 g Low-fat ricotta", "120 g Part-skim mozzarella, grated", "30 g Parmesan, grated"]
instructions:
Preheat the oven to 190°C. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat and sauté the onion for 4–5 minutes until soft. Add the garlic, turkey mince, oregano, and basil, and cook for 7–8 minutes, breaking up the meat, until no longer pink. Stir in the grated courgette and carrot and cook for 5 minutes to reduce excess moisture. Add the tomato passata and simmer for 8–10 minutes; the sauce should look thick and glossy. Stir in the fresh spinach until wilted, then season with salt and black pepper.

In a bowl, mix the ricotta with half of the Parmesan. Spread a thin layer of the tomato-turkey sauce in a baking dish (about 30 x 22 cm). Layer dry whole-wheat lasagna sheets over the sauce, then add another layer of sauce, followed by dollops of ricotta and a sprinkle of mozzarella. Repeat until you run out of ingredients, finishing with sauce and mozzarella on top. Cover the dish with foil and bake for 35 minutes. Remove the foil and bake for 10–15 minutes more until the top is bubbling and lightly browned. Let the lasagna rest for 10 minutes before slicing so it holds together.

title: Vegetable & Turkey Bolognese Lasagna with Spinach and Low-Fat Mozzarella
ingredients_json: ["250 g lasagna sheets, wholegrain (dry)", "400 g turkey mince, lean (5% fat)", "350 g crushed tomatoes, no added sugar", "200 g passata, smooth", "150 g onion, diced", "120 g carrot, grated", "120 g zucchini, diced", "2 clove garlic, minced", "2 tbsp olive oil", "250 g spinach, fresh", "200 g low-fat mozzarella, grated", "150 g reduced-fat ricotta", "20 g parmesan cheese, grated", "2 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp ground black pepper", "1 tsp salt", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "1 dl water"]
instructions:
Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the onion and carrot and cook for 6–8 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic and zucchini and cook for 3 minutes more. Add the turkey mince and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until no longer pink. Stir in the tomato paste, oregano, crushed tomatoes, passata, water, and black pepper, then simmer for 15 minutes until the sauce thickens. Wilt the spinach into the sauce for 1–2 minutes and season lightly with salt if needed.

Preheat the oven to 190°C. In a baking dish, spread a thin layer of the turkey-tomato sauce, then add a layer of lasagna sheets. Continue layering sauce, lasagna sheets, and a mixture of ricotta and grated mozzarella until you finish with sauce on top. Sprinkle over the remaining mozzarella and parmesan. Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes, then uncover and bake for another 15 minutes until the top is bubbling and lightly golden. Rest the lasagna for 10 minutes before slicing so the layers set.

title: Spicy Turkey Lettuce Wraps with Peanut-Lime Sauce and Veggie Crunch
ingredients_json: ["300 g turkey mince, lean (5% fat)", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion, diced", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "1 tbsp grated fresh ginger", "200 g red bell pepper, diced", "150 g carrot, julienned", "2 tsp soy sauce (low salt)", "1 tbsp hoisin sauce", "1 tsp sriracha sauce", "1 lime, juice", "2 tbsp peanut butter, smooth", "3 tbsp water", "1 tsp sesame oil", "8 large lettuce leaves (romaine/butterhead)", "40 g roasted peanuts, chopped", "2 tbsp fresh coriander leaves, chopped"]
instructions:
Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the onion and cook for 4 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic and ginger and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the turkey mince and cook for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and no longer pink. Stir in the bell pepper and carrot and cook for 4 minutes, keeping some bite.

In a small bowl, mix the soy sauce, hoisin sauce, sriracha, lime juice, peanut butter, water, and sesame oil until smooth. Pour the sauce into the pan and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring, until the turkey and vegetables are well coated and glossy. Spoon the filling into lettuce leaves, top with chopped peanuts and coriander, and serve immediately while the lettuce is crisp.

title: Ginger-Lime Turkey Lettuce Wraps with Peanut Crunch
ingredients_json: ["400 g turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, red", "3 cloves garlic", "20 g ginger, fresh", "1 tbsp soy sauce, low salt", "1 tbsp lime juice", "1 tsp honey", "1 tsp rice vinegar", "200 g mushrooms, mixed", "80 g carrots, grated", "300 g romaine lettuce", "50 g peanuts, dry roasted, unsalted", "2 tsp sesame oil", "1 dl water", "1 tsp chili flakes"]
instructions:
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the finely chopped onion and cook for 4 minutes until softened. Stir in the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the turkey mince and cook for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and cooked through. Add sliced mushrooms and grated carrot, then cook for 4 minutes more until the vegetables soften.

Mix soy sauce, lime juice, honey, rice vinegar, chili flakes, sesame oil, and 1 dl water in a small bowl. Pour it into the pan and simmer for 2 minutes until the mixture becomes glossy and coats the turkey. Roughly chop the peanuts and toast them in a dry pan for 2 minutes, then stir half into the filling and reserve the rest for topping.

Separate the romaine leaves and spoon the hot turkey mixture into them. Top with the reserved peanuts and serve immediately.

title: Miso-Ginger Turkey Lettuce Wraps with Crunchy Veg and Cashew Lime
ingredients_json: ["1 tbsp  Olive oil", "350 g  Turkey mince, lean", "1  clove Garlic, raw", "20 g  Fresh ginger, peeled", "2 tbsp  Miso paste, white", "1 tbsp  Low-salt soy sauce", "1 tbsp  Rice vinegar", "1 tbsp  Sesame oil", "250 g  Carrots, raw", "150 g  Red bell pepper, raw", "200 g  Spring onions", "60 g  Cashews, unsalted", "1 tbsp  Lime juice, fresh", "1 tbsp  Water", "8  pieces Lettuce leaves, romaine"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the turkey mince and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring and breaking it up until browned and cooked through. Add the grated garlic and ginger and cook for 30 seconds, until fragrant. Stir in the miso paste, low-salt soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil, then add the 1 tbsp water and simmer for 1–2 minutes so the sauce coats the meat. Meanwhile, shred the carrots and slice the bell pepper and spring onions. Toast the cashews in the dry pan for 2 minutes, then chop them. Assemble the wraps by spooning the turkey mixture into romaine leaves, topping with the shredded vegetables, cashews, and a squeeze of lime juice, then serve immediately.

title: Linguine with Lemon-Garlic Salmon and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["320 g linguine, dry", "260 g salmon fillet, raw", "300 g spinach, fresh", "1 medium onion", "2 cloves garlic", "300 ml canned crushed tomatoes, no added salt", "200 ml low-fat cooking cream, 8% fat", "20 g olive oil", "1 pc lemon", "10 g parmesan cheese, grated", "2 g dried oregano", "1 g black pepper", "3 g salt"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the linguine until al dente according to the package timing. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a deep pan over medium heat, then add finely chopped onion and cook for 4–5 minutes until softened. Add the minced garlic and dried oregano and stir for 30 seconds. Pour in the crushed tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes, then stir in the low-fat cooking cream. Add the salmon fillet in bite-sized pieces and cook gently for 6–8 minutes, until it flakes easily and the sauce is thickened. Add the fresh spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes until wilted. Stir in the lemon zest and a squeeze of juice, then season with black pepper. Drain the pasta, add it directly to the sauce, and toss over low heat for 1 minute so the linguine is well coated. Serve immediately with grated parmesan on top.

title: Creamy Lemon-Garlic Linguine with Salmon and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["320 g linguine, dry", "260 g salmon fillet, raw", "200 g spinach, fresh", "1 whole lemon, zest and juice", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1.5 tbsp olive oil", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "150 g cherry tomatoes", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "0.5 tsp salt"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the linguine according to the package directions until al dente. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat and sauté the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the salmon to the pan, season with half the salt and black pepper, and cook for about 4–6 minutes, turning once, until the salmon flakes easily. Stir in the cherry tomatoes and cook for 3–4 minutes until they soften and release their juices. Lower the heat to low, add the spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes until wilted, then mix in the Greek yogurt, lemon zest, and lemon juice until the sauce looks creamy and smooth. Drain the linguine, reserve a small splash of pasta water, and toss the pasta into the sauce, adding a little pasta water if needed to loosen. Taste and adjust with the remaining salt and black pepper, then serve immediately with extra lemon zest if desired.

title: Creamy Salmon Linguine with Spinach, Lemon and Garlic
ingredients_json: ["320 g linguine (dry)", "300 g salmon fillet, skinless", "200 g spinach, fresh", "150 g low-fat plain Greek yogurt", "30 g olive oil", "2 clove garlic", "1 piece lemon, zest and juice", "1 medium onion", "120 ml vegetable stock (low-salt)", "5 g dried basil", "2 g black pepper", "4 g salt (optional)"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the linguine until al dente, then reserve about 120 ml of the pasta water and drain. While the pasta cooks, finely chop the onion and mince the garlic. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat, add the onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Cut the salmon into bite-size pieces and add to the pan, cooking for 3 to 4 minutes until it turns opaque. Stir in the vegetable stock, lemon zest and juice, dried basil, and black pepper, then fold in the spinach until wilted. Reduce the heat to low and mix in the Greek yogurt, stirring well to create a smooth sauce; loosen with reserved pasta water if needed. Add the drained linguine to the pan and toss until everything is evenly coated and glossy, then serve immediately.

title: Creamy Salmon and Spinach Linguine in Lemon-Garlic Sauce
ingredients_json: ["320 g linguine (durum wheat)", "200 g salmon fillet, raw, skinless", "300 g spinach, fresh", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 cloves garlic", "200 g cherry tomatoes", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain 2% fat", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "0.5 tsp fine salt", "0.25 tsp black pepper", "20 g Parmesan, grated"]
instructions: Cook the linguine in a large pot of well-salted boiling water according to the package instructions until al dente, then reserve a small cup of the cooking water and drain. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat, add the minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant, then add the cherry tomatoes and cook for 5 to 7 minutes until they soften and start to burst. Add the salmon pieces to the skillet and cook for 4 to 6 minutes, turning once, until the salmon is just opaque and flakes easily. Stir in the spinach and cook until wilted, about 1 to 2 minutes. Reduce the heat to low and mix in the Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Parmesan, salt, and black pepper, loosening with a splash of the reserved pasta water if needed to make a silky sauce. Toss the drained linguine into the skillet and cook for 1 minute so everything is coated; serve immediately with extra black pepper if you like.

title: Creamy Courgette & Salmon Linguine with Lemon Garlic
ingredients_json: ["360 g linguine pasta, dried", "250 g salmon fillet, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium courgette", "1 clove garlic", "200 ml low-fat cooking cream, 5% fat", "1 dl low-sodium vegetable stock", "50 g parmesan cheese, hard", "1 pc lemon, zest and juice", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "1.0 g salt"]
instructions: Cook the linguine in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente, then reserve 1 dl of the pasta water and drain. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat and sauté the diced courgette for about 5–6 minutes until it softens and turns lightly golden. Add the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant, then pour in the vegetable stock and simmer for 2 minutes. Stir in the low-fat cooking cream, then reduce the heat to low and add the salmon cut into bite-size pieces. Cook gently for 4–6 minutes until the salmon is just cooked through and flakes easily. Add the drained linguine to the pan with the reserved pasta water, toss well, and fold in the parmesan and lemon zest and juice. Season with black pepper and salt, then taste and adjust the consistency by adding a splash of pasta water if needed.

title: Creamy Wholewheat Macaroni and Cheese with Cauliflower and Leeks
ingredients_json: ["200 g macaroni, wholewheat (dry)", "250 g cauliflower florets", "150 g leeks, sliced", "20 g butter", "30 g wheat flour, plain", "500 ml semi-skimmed milk (2%)", "150 g cheddar cheese, reduced-fat", "100 g mozzarella cheese, part-skim", "20 g grated Parmesan cheese", "5 g salt", "2 g black pepper", "1 g garlic powder", "2 tbsp olive oil"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the wholewheat macaroni according to the packet instructions until al dente. Add the cauliflower florets to the pot for the last 5 minutes of cooking so they soften but still hold their shape, then drain and set aside. Heat the olive oil and butter in a large pan over medium heat, add the sliced leeks, and cook for 6–8 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute, then gradually whisk in the semi-skimmed milk and bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, stirring until it thickens. Reduce the heat to low and add the cheddar, mozzarella, and Parmesan, stirring until fully melted and smooth. Add the drained macaroni and cauliflower to the sauce, season with salt, black pepper, and garlic powder, and stir to coat everything well. Transfer to a baking dish, cover with foil, and bake at 190°C for 15 minutes, then uncover and bake for 5 minutes until bubbling around the edges and lightly browned on top.

title: Wholewheat Macaroni and Cheese with Cauliflower and Parmesan
ingredients_json: ["180 g macaroni, wholewheat, dry", "400 g cauliflower florets, raw", "300 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, non-fat", "80 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "30 g cheddar cheese, reduced-fat, grated", "1 piece garlic clove", "1 tbsp olive oil", "20 g wholemeal breadcrumbs", "200 g spinach, fresh", "1 tsp salt, iodized", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "0.5 tsp mustard powder", "1 tbsp lemon juice"]
instructions: Cook the wholewheat macaroni in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente, then drain. Meanwhile, simmer the cauliflower florets in a steamer or a small saucepan with enough water to cover the bottom until very tender, about 12 minutes. Blend the cauliflower with the milk and the garlic clove until smooth, then return it to the pot and stir in the mustard powder, lemon juice, Greek yogurt, Parmesan, and reduced-fat cheddar. Keep the heat on low and stir until the sauce is glossy and thick enough to coat the pasta without clumping. Wilt the spinach in a hot pan with the olive oil for 1 to 2 minutes, then mix it into the macaroni. Tip everything into a lightly greased baking dish, sprinkle with breadcrumbs, and bake at 200°C for 12 to 15 minutes until bubbling and lightly golden on top. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving so the sauce sets.

title: Creamy Wholemeal Macaroni & Cheese with Cauliflower and Gruyère
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholewheat macaroni", "350 g cauliflower florets", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 small onion (150 g), finely chopped", "2 cloves garlic (6 g), minced", "50 g unsalted butter", "60 g plain wholemeal wheat flour", "900 ml semi-skimmed milk", "150 g Gruyère cheese, grated", "100 g mature Cheddar cheese, grated", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2%", "1 tsp ground mustard", "0.5 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the wholewheat macaroni according to the packet instructions until al dente. In the last 5 minutes of cooking, add the cauliflower florets to the same pot so they soften without turning mushy, then drain everything well and set aside. Heat the olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat and cook the onion for 6–8 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Reduce the heat to medium-low, melt the butter, then whisk in the flour and keep stirring for 1–2 minutes to cook out the raw flour taste. Gradually pour in the semi-skimmed milk while whisking until smooth, then simmer for 3–5 minutes until the sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. Turn the heat off briefly and stir in the Gruyère, Cheddar, mustard, smoked paprika, black pepper, and salt until melted and glossy. Fold in the yogurt to make the sauce creamy, then combine the drained macaroni and cauliflower with the cheese sauce. Transfer to a baking dish, spread evenly, and bake at 200°C for 15–18 minutes until bubbling at the edges and lightly set in the center. Let it stand for 2 minutes before serving so the sauce thickens.

title: Creamy Wholewheat Macaroni and Cheese with Cauliflower and Gruyère
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholewheat macaroni", "400 g cauliflower florets", "300 ml low-fat milk, 1.5% fat", "120 g Gruyère cheese, reduced-fat", "60 g reduced-fat cheddar cheese", "20 g butter, unsalted", "30 g plain flour, wheat", "1 g ground black pepper", "4 g fine salt", "200 g cooked ham, lean"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the wholewheat macaroni according to the package until just al dente, then drain. Steam or boil the cauliflower florets for about 8–10 minutes until very tender, then drain and mash until mostly smooth. In a saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat, whisk in the flour, and cook for 1 minute while stirring. Gradually pour in the milk, whisking to keep the sauce smooth, then simmer for 3–4 minutes until it thickens. Stir in the Gruyère and cheddar until fully melted, then season with black pepper and salt. Fold in the mashed cauliflower and the cooked ham, then combine with the drained macaroni. Transfer to a baking dish and bake for 20–25 minutes until bubbling and lightly golden on top. Rest for 5 minutes before serving for the sauce to set.

title: Creamy High-Protein Greek Yogurt Macaroni and Cheese with Spinach
ingredients_json: ["180 g macaroni, wholewheat, dry", "250 g low-fat Greek yogurt, plain", "180 g cheddar cheese, reduced-fat, grated", "250 g cottage cheese, low-fat", "200 g spinach, fresh", "250 ml semi-skimmed milk", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 cloves garlic", "1 g smoked paprika", "2 g Dijon mustard", "2 g black pepper", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Cook the wholewheat macaroni in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente, then drain and set aside. In a large saucepan, warm the olive oil over medium heat and sauté the minced garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the spinach and cook for 2–3 minutes until wilted, then stir in the milk, smoked paprika, Dijon mustard, black pepper, and salt. Reduce the heat to low and add the reduced-fat cheddar, stirring until melted and smooth. Remove the pan from the heat briefly and stir in the low-fat Greek yogurt and low-fat cottage cheese until the sauce turns creamy and evenly combined. Fold the drained macaroni into the sauce, return to low heat for 1 minute, and serve while hot.

title: Turkey & Spinach Manicotti in Tomato Basil Sauce
ingredients_json: ["250 g manicotti pasta, dried", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes", "200 g low-fat ricotta cheese", "150 g turkey mince, 5% fat", "120 g spinach, frozen, thawed and squeezed dry", "120 g mozzarella cheese, part-skim", "30 g parmesan cheese, grated", "1 dl water", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "10 g fresh basil, chopped", "10 g olive oil, extra for baking", "5 g fine salt", "2 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 190°C. Cook the manicotti in a large pot of lightly salted water according to the package instructions until just tender, then drain and let cool slightly.
