In a pan, warm 1 tbsp olive oil over medium heat and sauté the minced garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the turkey mince and cook for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up until no longer pink. Stir in the squeezed spinach and cook for another 2 minutes, then remove from the heat. In a bowl, mix the turkey-spinach mixture with ricotta and half of the parmesan. Spread the chopped tomatoes into a baking dish, add water, basil, salt, and black pepper, then stir to combine. Spoon the ricotta filling into the manicotti and arrange them in the sauce. Sprinkle the remaining parmesan over the top and cover loosely with foil. Bake for 25 minutes covered, then remove the foil, scatter the mozzarella over the surface, and bake for another 10–12 minutes until the pasta is hot throughout and the cheese is lightly golden. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Turkey and Spinach Manicotti in Light Tomato Basil Sauce
ingredients_json: ["250 g lasagne sheets, dried (for manicotti)", "450 g turkey mince, lean (5–8% fat)", "300 g ricotta cheese, part-skim", "150 g mozzarella cheese, part-skim", "100 g spinach, frozen, thawed and squeezed dry", "1 pc egg, whole", "200 g canned chopped tomatoes, no added sugar", "200 g tomato passata", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 cl garlic, minced (about 6 cloves)", "10 g fresh basil, chopped", "5 g dried oregano", "3 g fine salt", "2 g black pepper"]
instructions: Cook the turkey mince in a large skillet with 1 tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat for about 8–10 minutes, breaking it up until no pink remains. Stir in the minced garlic, dried oregano, and frozen squeezed spinach, then cook for 1–2 minutes more and let the mixture cool slightly. Mix the ricotta, egg, and half of the mozzarella into the turkey mixture, then season well with black pepper and about 1 g of the salt. If using dried lasagne sheets, cut them into long strips, blanch in simmering salted water for 2–3 minutes until pliable, then drain and lay flat. Roll the filling into the manicotti strips and arrange them seam-side down in a baking dish. For the sauce, heat the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil in a saucepan and warm the chopped tomatoes, passata, basil, and the remaining salt (about 2 g) over medium heat for 8–10 minutes. Pour the tomato sauce over the manicotti, cover with foil, and bake at 190°C for 30 minutes. Uncover, sprinkle over the remaining mozzarella, and bake for another 10 minutes until bubbling and lightly golden at the edges. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving for cleaner portions.

title: Creamy Garlic-Parsley Mashed Potatoes with Greek Yogurt and Salmon
ingredients_json: ["900 g potatoes, white, peeled", "200 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "30 g butter, unsalted", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 tsp salt, iodized", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "20 ml olive oil", "250 g salmon fillet, raw", "30 g fresh parsley"]
instructions: Boil the peeled potatoes in a large pot of salted water until very tender, about 15 to 20 minutes after it comes to a simmer. While the potatoes cook, heat a nonstick pan with the olive oil over medium-high heat and season the salmon with black pepper. Sear the salmon for about 3 to 4 minutes per side until it flakes easily, then remove it and keep warm. Finely chop the garlic and parsley. Drain the potatoes well, then return them to the hot pot and mash until smooth. Warm the semi-skimmed milk and butter together until the butter melts, then gradually mix into the potatoes until you get a creamy consistency. Stir in the Greek yogurt, garlic, and half of the parsley, mixing gently so the mash stays fluffy. Flake the cooked salmon into large bite-size pieces and fold it through the mash, then serve hot with the remaining parsley on top.

title: Creamy Garlic-Leek Mashed Potatoes with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["900 g potatoes, white, peeled", "200 g leek, sliced", "30 g olive oil", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "250 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2% fat", "30 g butter", "300 ml vegetable stock, low salt", "5 g salt, fine", "1 g black pepper, ground", "10 g fresh parsley, chopped"]
instructions: Peel the potatoes and cut them into even chunks. Place the potatoes in a pot, cover with low-salt vegetable stock, and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce to a gentle simmer and cook for 15–20 minutes until the potatoes are very tender and break easily with a fork. While the potatoes cook, heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat and sauté the sliced leek for 8–10 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 30–60 seconds until fragrant, then remove from the heat. Drain the potatoes well, return them to the pot, and mash until smooth. Add butter and stir until melted. Gradually mix in the Greek yogurt and the leek-garlic mixture, loosening with a small splash of warm stock if needed, until creamy and lump-free. Season with salt and black pepper, stir in the chopped parsley, and serve hot.

title: Creamy Garlic Mashed Potatoes with Spinach and Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["900 g potatoes, white (peeled)", "300 ml water", "1 g salt, table salt", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "30 ml olive oil", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "150 g spinach, raw", "30 g butter, unsalted", "100 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Peel the potatoes and cut them into even 3–4 cm chunks. Add the potatoes to a pot with the water and 1 g salt, then bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Reduce to a steady simmer and cook for 15–20 minutes until the potatoes are very tender and break apart easily with a fork. While the potatoes cook, finely chop the garlic and wilt the spinach in a small pan with the olive oil over medium heat for 2–3 minutes, stirring until the leaves are just tender. Drain the potatoes well, return them to the pot, and let them steam off for 1 minute so the mash turns fluffy. Add the butter and milk and mash thoroughly until smooth. Stir in the wilted spinach and garlic, then fold in the Greek yogurt and black pepper. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, then serve hot.

title: Creamy Garlic Herb Mashed Potatoes with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["1.2 kg potatoes, white, peeled", "300 ml skimmed milk", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, nonfat", "30 g butter, unsalted", "2 cloves garlic", "10 g fresh chives", "5 g fresh parsley", "5 g salt, table salt", "2 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Boil the peeled potatoes in a large pot of salted water until completely tender, about 15–20 minutes, then drain well. Return the potatoes to the hot pot and let them steam dry for 1–2 minutes so the mash turns fluffy. In a small saucepan, warm the skimmed milk with the butter and gently stir until the butter is melted. Mash the potatoes until smooth, then add the warm milk mixture gradually and keep mashing. Stir in the Greek yogurt for a creamy texture, then mix in the finely minced garlic, chopped chives, and parsley. Season with black pepper and extra salt if needed. Serve hot, with a thick, spoonable consistency and no lumps.

title: Creamy Mashed Potatoes with Greek Yogurt, Garlic & Spinach
ingredients_json: ["1.2 kg potato, white, peeled", "250 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "200 ml vegetable stock, low-salt", "30 g butter, unsalted", "2 cloves garlic", "150 g spinach, fresh", "10 g olive oil", "5 g salt, table", "2 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Boil the peeled potatoes in a large pot of salted water until very tender, about 15–20 minutes after simmering. While the potatoes cook, warm the olive oil in a small pan and gently sauté the garlic for about 30 seconds, just until fragrant. Stir in the spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes until wilted. Drain the potatoes well and return them to the hot pot. Mash until smooth, then gradually add the warm vegetable stock, butter, and the spinach-garlic mixture, mashing again to reach a creamy texture. Remove from the heat and fold in the Greek yogurt to keep it fluffy; season with black pepper and check the salt level. Serve hot, with a spooned, creamy consistency without any lumps.

title: Turkey Meatballs in Tomato Herb Sauce with Wholewheat Pasta
ingredients_json: ["400 g turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "1 piece egg, raw", "80 g wholewheat breadcrumbs", "80 g onion, finely chopped", "2 clove garlic, minced", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp ground cumin", "2 tbsp olive oil", "500 g canned chopped tomatoes, no added salt", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "1 dl water", "1 tsp salt", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "250 g wholewheat spaghetti, dry", "40 g parmesan cheese, grated"]
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until soft and lightly golden, then stir in the garlic for 30 seconds. In a bowl, combine the turkey mince, egg, breadcrumbs, cooked onion-garlic, oregano, cumin, black pepper, and 1/2 tsp of the salt. Mix well until the mixture holds together. Shape into 18–22 meatballs and place them on a plate. Heat the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil in the same pan over medium-high heat and brown the meatballs in batches for 2 to 3 minutes per side, just until they are lightly coloured. Pour in the chopped tomatoes, tomato paste, water, and the remaining 1/2 tsp salt, then reduce the heat to low. Simmer for 12 to 15 minutes, turning the meatballs once, until cooked through with no pink centres. While the sauce simmers, cook the wholewheat spaghetti in salted water according to package instructions, then drain. Serve the spaghetti topped with the turkey meatballs and tomato herb sauce, and finish with grated parmesan.

title: Turkey Meatballs in Tomato Basil Sauce with Whole-Wheat Pasta
ingredients_json: ["500 g turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "1 piece egg, whole, raw", "80 g breadcrumbs, whole-wheat", "120 g onion, yellow, finely diced", "2 cloves garlic, raw, minced", "2 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp fine salt", "1 ml olive oil", "700 g passata (strained tomatoes)", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp balsamic vinegar", "200 g whole-wheat spaghetti, dry", "80 g mozzarella, part-skim, grated"]
instructions: Heat 1 ml olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat and cook the diced onion for 5 minutes until soft and translucent. Add the minced garlic and oregano and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant, then remove from the heat and let cool slightly. In a bowl, mix the turkey mince, egg, breadcrumbs, parsley, fine salt, and the onion-garlic mixture until well combined. Shape into about 18 meatballs and place them on a tray. Warm 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet or deep saucepan over medium heat, add the meatballs in a single layer, and cook for 6–8 minutes, turning gently, until browned on the outside. Pour in the passata and balsamic vinegar, reduce the heat to low, and simmer for 15 minutes, uncovered, until the meatballs are cooked through and the sauce thickens slightly. Meanwhile, cook the whole-wheat spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain. Spoon the tomato sauce with meatballs over the spaghetti and top with the grated mozzarella; cover for 2 minutes until the cheese melts, then serve hot.

title: Oven-Baked Turkey Meatballs with Herby Tomato Sauce and Whole-Wheat Spaghetti
ingredients_json: ["500 g turkey mince, lean", "1 piece egg, raw", "60 g whole-wheat breadcrumbs", "80 g onion, yellow, finely chopped", "2 cloves garlic, raw, minced", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp ground black pepper", "2 tsp salt, reduced-sodium", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes, no added sugar", "200 g spinach, fresh", "300 g whole-wheat spaghetti, dry", "40 g parmesan cheese, grated"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C. Mix the turkey mince, egg, breadcrumbs, chopped onion, minced garlic, dried oregano, black pepper, and reduced-sodium salt in a bowl until well combined, then shape into 24 small meatballs. Place the meatballs on a lined baking tray, drizzle over the olive oil, and bake for 16–18 minutes until they are browned and cooked through with no pink in the center. While the meatballs bake, cook the whole-wheat spaghetti in plenty of boiling salted water according to the packet instructions, then drain. Warm the canned tomatoes in a saucepan, stir in the spinach and simmer for 3–4 minutes until the spinach wilts. Add the baked meatballs to the tomato sauce and warm through for 2 minutes, then toss the cooked spaghetti with the sauce and serve hot with the grated parmesan on top.

title: Turkey Meatballs in Tomato Basil Sauce with Whole-Wheat Pasta
ingredients_json: ["450 g Turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "80 g Whole-wheat breadcrumbs", "1 piece Egg, raw", "120 g Onion, finely chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "20 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "10 g Fresh parsley, chopped", "2 tsp Olive oil", "700 g Passata, tomato", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1 tsp Dried basil", "1.5 tsp Salt, iodized", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "300 g Whole-wheat pasta (dry)"]
instructions: Start by cooking the whole-wheat pasta in a large pot of salted boiling water according to the package instructions until al dente. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the onion for 6–8 minutes until soft, then stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds more. In a bowl, combine the turkey mince, breadcrumbs, egg, sautéed onion and garlic, Parmesan, parsley, half of the salt, and the black pepper, mixing gently until just combined. Form the mixture into 18–20 meatballs and place them on a plate. Heat a nonstick pan over medium-high heat and brown the meatballs in batches for 3–4 minutes per side until lightly golden, then transfer them to a simmering pot of passata. Season the sauce with oregano, dried basil, and the remaining salt, then simmer the meatballs in the sauce on low for 15–18 minutes until cooked through and no longer pink in the center. Drain the pasta, toss it with a little of the tomato sauce, and serve the meatballs and sauce over the pasta, spooning extra sauce on top.

title: Turkey and Spinach Meatballs in Tomato Basil Sauce with Whole-Wheat Spaghetti
ingredients_json: ["450 g Turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "200 g Frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry", "120 g Whole-wheat breadcrumbs", "1 piece Egg, whole", "80 g Onion, finely chopped", "2 cloves Garlic", "15 g Olive oil", "600 g Chopped tomatoes, canned", "150 g Tomato passata (smooth)", "10 g Fresh basil, chopped", "10 g Parmesan cheese, finely grated", "1 tsp Salt (table salt)", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat and gently cook the onion for 4–5 minutes until soft. Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds, then turn off the heat and let it cool slightly. In a bowl, combine the turkey mince, cooked onion-garlic mixture, squeezed spinach, breadcrumbs, egg, grated Parmesan, salt, and black pepper. Mix until evenly combined, then shape into 20–22 small meatballs. Simmer the chopped tomatoes and passata in a saucepan over medium-low heat for 5 minutes. Add the meatballs to the sauce, cover, and cook for 18–22 minutes, turning the meatballs once halfway through, until cooked through and no longer pink in the center. Stir in the basil during the last 2 minutes of cooking. Serve hot with whole-wheat spaghetti or cooked grains, spooning extra sauce over the top.

title: Turkey and Lentil Meatloaf with Tomato Glaze
ingredients_json: ["500 g turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "150 g cooked red lentils, drained", "1 piece egg, whole", "80 g wholegrain breadcrumbs", "1 piece onion, yellow, finely chopped", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "100 g carrots, finely grated", "150 g tomato passata", "30 g ketchup, no added sugar", "1 tbsp olive oil", "10 g fresh parsley, finely chopped", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp ground black pepper", "1 tsp fine salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 190°C. Line a baking tray with baking paper. In a bowl, mix the turkey mince, lentils, egg, breadcrumbs, onion, garlic, grated carrot, parsley, oregano, black pepper, and salt until the mixture feels evenly combined. Shape it into a loaf on the prepared tray and spread a thin layer of tomato passata over the top. Bake for 35 minutes, then mix the remaining passata with the no-added-sugar ketchup and brush it over the loaf. Continue baking for 15–20 minutes until the loaf is browned and cooked through (it should reach about 74°C in the thickest part). Let it rest for 8 minutes before slicing so it holds together.

title: Lean Turkey Meatloaf with Lentil Oats and Tomato Glaze
ingredients_json: ["500 g turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "100 g cooked lentils, canned, drained", "60 g rolled oats", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried thyme", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "250 ml low-salt vegetable stock", "2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, reduced sugar", "60 g carrots, grated", "15 g olive oil", "200 g canned chopped tomatoes, no added salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 190°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Finely chop the onion and mince the garlic, then sauté them in the olive oil for 4 minutes until softened. In a bowl, mix the turkey mince, cooked lentils, rolled oats, egg, grated carrots, smoked paprika, dried thyme, tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, and 150 ml of the vegetable stock. Stir well until the mixture looks cohesive; if it seems very dry, add the remaining 100 ml of stock a little at a time. Shape the mixture into a loaf on the tray and spread the canned chopped tomatoes over the top. Bake for 45 minutes, then check that the center is cooked through and reaches 75°C on a thermometer. Let the meatloaf rest for 10 minutes before slicing so it holds together.

title: Lean Turkey Meatloaf with Oat-Lentil Crust and Tomato Glaze
ingredients_json: ["500 g turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "120 g cooked lentils, canned no-salt added, drained", "60 g rolled oats", "1 piece egg, whole, raw", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic", "100 g carrots, grated", "200 ml low-salt tomato passata", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp ground black pepper", "1 tsp salt", "2 tbsp balsamic vinegar"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 190°C. Line a baking tray or loaf pan with baking paper. Soak the rolled oats in 100 ml of the tomato passata for 5 minutes, then let it cool slightly. In a bowl, mix turkey mince, cooked lentils, the oat-tomato mixture, the egg, grated carrots, finely chopped onion, and minced garlic. Season with dried oregano, black pepper, and salt, then mix until evenly combined but not overworked. Shape the mixture into a loaf on the lined tray or press into the loaf pan. Stir the remaining tomato passata with balsamic vinegar and brush it over the top of the loaf. Bake for 35–45 minutes until the internal temperature reaches about 74°C and the edges look lightly browned. Let the meatloaf rest for 10 minutes before slicing so it holds together.

title: Turkey Meatloaf with Caramelized Onion, Oats & Tomato Glaze
ingredients_json: ["500 g turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "60 g rolled oats, quick-cooking", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 piece onion, yellow, finely chopped", "1 clove garlic, minced", "1 dl milk, low-fat (1.5%)", "2 tbsp olive oil", "200 g carrots, grated", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "150 g crushed tomatoes, no added sugar", "1 tsp dried oregano", "2 g fine salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "30 g ketchup, no added sugar"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 190°C. Spread the oats in a bowl and pour over the low-fat milk; let it sit for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens. Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the onion and garlic for about 6–8 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Stir in the grated carrots and cook for 2 minutes, then cool slightly. In a large bowl, combine the turkey mince, oat-milk mixture, egg, cooked onion-carrot mixture, tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, oregano, salt, and black pepper. Mix gently until evenly combined, then shape the mixture into a loaf in a lightly oiled baking dish. Mix the no-added-sugar ketchup with 1–2 tablespoons of the remaining tomato mixture and spread over the top. Bake for 35–45 minutes, until the centre reaches 72°C and the juices run clear. Let the meatloaf rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Oven-Baked Turkey Meatloaf with Oats, Spinach and Tomato Glaze
ingredients_json: ["500 g turkey mince, lean", "80 g rolled oats", "150 ml low-fat milk", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic", "200 g spinach, fresh", "1 tbsp olive oil", "400 g canned crushed tomatoes, no added sugar", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "10 g salt (0.4% of body weight), reduced-sodium", "1 tbsp balsamic vinegar"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C. Finely chop the onion and mince the garlic. Warm the olive oil in a pan over medium heat, then sauté the onion for 6 minutes until soft, add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Wilt the spinach in the pan for 2 minutes, then let the mixture cool slightly. Soak the rolled oats in the low-fat milk for 5 minutes, then stir in the turkey mince, egg, spinach mixture, oregano, smoked paprika and black pepper. Shape the mixture into a loaf on a lined baking tray and press it firmly so it holds together. Mix the crushed tomatoes, tomato paste and balsamic vinegar, then spread a thick layer of the sauce over the loaf. Bake for 35–45 minutes, until the center reaches 70°C and the surface is browned. Let the meatloaf rest for 10 minutes before slicing so it stays juicy.

title: Classic Hearty Lentil and Vegetable Minestrone with Spinach
ingredients_json: ["1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, yellow", "2 cloves Garlic", "1 large Carrot", "1 stalk Celery stalk", "1 can Crushed tomatoes", "1.2 kg Vegetable stock", "120 g Red lentils, dry", "160 g Cannellini beans, cooked, drained", "100 g Potatoes, raw", "120 g Zucchini", "80 g Pasta, ditalini", "60 g Baby spinach", "15 g Parmesan cheese, hard", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1 tsp Dried basil", "0.5 tsp Fine sea salt", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion, carrot and celery, and cook for about 8 minutes, stirring often, until the vegetables soften. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the crushed tomatoes, vegetable stock, lentils, cannellini beans and diced potatoes. Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook for 20 minutes, until the lentils are tender. Add the diced zucchini and the ditalini pasta, then simmer for 10 minutes more, until the pasta is cooked al dente. Stir in the spinach and oregano and basil, cooking for 2–3 minutes until the spinach wilts. Turn off the heat, season with sea salt and black pepper, and grate in the Parmesan before serving.

title: Hearty Chicken and Vegetable Minestrone with Cannellini Beans
ingredients_json: ["30 ml olive oil", "1 medium onion", "2 cloves garlic", "1 large carrot", "1 stalk celery", "150 g chicken breast", "200 g canned chopped tomatoes", "150 g canned cannellini beans, drained and rinsed", "70 g dried green lentils, uncooked", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "900 ml vegetable stock", "180 g zucchini", "100 g green beans", "50 g small pasta (ditalini or similar)", "10 g fresh basil", "5 g dried oregano", "1 g black pepper", "3 g salt"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion, carrot, and celery, and cook for 6–8 minutes until the vegetables soften. Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the diced chicken breast and cook until the chicken turns opaque. Mix in the tomato paste, oregano, black pepper, and tomatoes, and cook for 2 minutes to deepen the flavour. Add the lentils, cannellini beans, and vegetable stock, bring to a gentle boil, then reduce to a simmer. Cook for 20 minutes, then add the zucchini, green beans, and pasta and simmer for another 10–12 minutes until the pasta is tender and the lentils are cooked. Turn off the heat, stir through the shredded basil, and adjust the salt if needed before serving.

title: Hearty Lentil and Vegetable Minestrone with Tomato and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["30 g olive oil", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic", "2 carrots", "1 piece celery stalk", "200 g canned chopped tomatoes", "150 g green lentils, dry", "120 g red kidney beans, canned (drained)", "1.2 kg vegetable stock", "200 g zucchini", "150 g green beans", "60 g spinach, fresh", "80 g whole wheat pasta, dry", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp dried basil", "1 g black pepper", "3 g salt"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion, carrot (diced), and celery and cook for 8 minutes, stirring often, until softened. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the chopped tomatoes, dried oregano, and dried basil. Add the lentils, kidney beans, and vegetable stock, bring to a gentle boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook for 25 minutes. Add the zucchini and green beans and simmer for another 10 minutes until the lentils are tender. Stir in the whole wheat pasta and cook for 10 minutes, until al dente. Finally, fold in the fresh spinach for 2 minutes to wilt, and season with black pepper and salt to taste. Serve hot with extra black pepper if desired.

title: Tuscan Chickpea & Vegetable Minestrone with Spinach and Parmesan
ingredients_json: ["2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 medium Onion, yellow, diced", "2 medium Carrot, raw, diced", "2 celery stalks Celery, raw, diced", "3 cloves Garlic, raw, minced", "2 tbsp Tomato paste", "400 g Canned chopped tomatoes, no added salt", "1.2 liter Vegetable stock, low sodium", "250 g Cannellini beans, cooked, drained", "200 g Red kidney beans, cooked, drained", "120 g Ditalini pasta, dried", "200 g Zucchini, raw, diced", "100 g Green beans, raw, trimmed", "60 g Baby spinach", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1 tsp Dried basil", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "1 g Salt", "30 g Parmesan cheese, grated"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion, carrot, and celery and cook for about 7 minutes, stirring often, until the vegetables soften. Add the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then stir in the chopped tomatoes and vegetable stock. Bring the soup to a gentle simmer. Add the cannellini beans, kidney beans, red kidney beans mixture, ditalini pasta, zucchini, and green beans, and simmer for 12–15 minutes until the pasta is tender and the vegetables are cooked. Stir in the dried oregano and dried basil, then add the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted. Season with black pepper and salt, and serve hot with grated Parmesan on top.

title: Creamy Thyme Mushroom Soup with Lentils and Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["300 g mushrooms, cremini, sliced", "150 g mushrooms, shiitake, sliced", "1 medium onion, yellow, diced", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "2 tbsp olive oil", "150 g lentils, dry, red", "900 ml vegetable stock, low sodium", "300 ml milk, skimmed", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "1 tbsp soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "10 g fresh parsley, chopped"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the sliced cremini and shiitake mushrooms and cook for 8–10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they release their moisture and the liquid reduces. Stir in the dried red lentils, thyme, black pepper, and soy sauce, then pour in the vegetable stock and skimmed milk. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 18–22 minutes until the lentils are tender. Turn the heat to low and stir in the Greek yogurt carefully so it doesn’t boil. Blend the soup partially for a thicker, creamy texture, then taste and adjust with a little extra black pepper if needed. Serve hot, topped with chopped parsley.

title: Creamy Thyme Mushroom Soup with White Beans and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["250 g chestnut mushrooms, sliced", "200 g cremini mushrooms, sliced", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium yellow onion", "2 cloves garlic", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "900 ml vegetable stock", "1 tbsp soy sauce", "15 g fresh thyme leaves", "200 g canned white beans, drained and rinsed", "150 g baby spinach", "100 ml low-fat milk", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tsp black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5–6 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Stir in the garlic, tomato paste, and thyme, and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the mushrooms and cook for 8–10 minutes, stirring often, until they release their liquid and the mixture looks glossy. Pour in the vegetable stock and soy sauce, then bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 15 minutes. Blend about half the soup with the beans to thicken, then return it to the pot and stir in the spinach until wilted. Lower the heat to low, stir in the low-fat milk and lemon juice, and warm through for 2–3 minutes without boiling. Season with black pepper, taste, and serve hot.

title: Creamy Low-Fat Mushroom Soup with Thyme and White Beans
ingredients_json: ["300 g mushrooms, cremini, sliced", "150 g mushrooms, shiitake, sliced", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1.2 L vegetable stock, low sodium", "200 g canned white beans, drained and rinsed", "2 dl low-fat milk, 1.5% fat", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "10 g fresh thyme", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "10 g cornstarch", "6 g salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 6–8 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Stir in the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then add the sliced mushrooms, thyme, and oregano. Cook for 8–10 minutes, stirring now and then, until the mushrooms release their liquid and the mixture looks glossy. Add the vegetable stock and white beans, then bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 15 minutes. In a small bowl, mix the cornstarch with the milk until smooth, then pour it into the soup while stirring. Simmer for 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened and creamy. Stir in the lemon juice, season with salt and black pepper, and serve hot.

title: Creamy Thyme Mushroom Soup with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["300 g mushrooms, cremini, sliced", "150 g mushrooms, shiitake, sliced", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "750 ml vegetable stock, low salt", "300 ml water", "2 sprigs thyme, fresh", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "10 g cornstarch", "30 g carrots, diced", "10 g parsley, fresh, chopped", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and carrots and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring, until softened. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then stir in both types of sliced mushrooms and cook for 10–12 minutes until they release their juices and start to brown. Sprinkle in the thyme, pour in the vegetable stock and water, and bring to a gentle simmer. Simmer for 15 minutes, then remove the thyme sprigs. In a bowl, mix the Greek yogurt with the cornstarch until smooth, then stir a ladle of hot soup into the yogurt mixture to temper it. Pour the tempered yogurt back into the pot while stirring, and warm on low heat for 2–3 minutes until slightly thickened. Season with salt and black pepper, and finish with chopped parsley before serving.

title: Creamy Thyme Mushroom Soup with Spinach and Barley
ingredients_json: ["300 g mushrooms, cremini, sliced", "150 g mushrooms, shiitake, sliced", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion, diced (about 150 g)", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "2 medium carrots, diced (about 120 g)", "80 g pearl barley, uncooked", "1.2 liter vegetable stock, low salt", "300 ml semi-skimmed milk", "200 g spinach, fresh", "10 g fresh thyme, leaves", "10 g soy sauce, low sodium", "1 g black pepper, ground", "10 g lemon juice"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and carrots and cook for 6–8 minutes until they soften and start to turn lightly golden. Stir in the garlic and thyme for 30 seconds, then add both types of mushrooms. Cook for 8–10 minutes, stirring often, until the mushrooms release their juices and the liquid reduces slightly. Add the pearl barley and stir to coat the grains, then pour in the vegetable stock and bring to a gentle simmer. Cook for 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the barley is tender. Add the soy sauce, then blend about one-third of the soup until creamy, and return it to the pot. Stir in the milk and warm through for 3–5 minutes without boiling. Fold in the spinach for 1–2 minutes until wilted, then finish with black pepper and lemon juice. Serve hot.

title: Healthy Chicken & Black Bean Nachos with Salsa Verde and Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["200 g tortilla chips, baked, unsalted", "250 g chicken breast, raw", "200 g canned black beans, drained and rinsed", "200 g canned crushed tomatoes", "100 g red onion", "200 g bell pepper, red", "20 g olive oil", "10 g ground cumin", "5 g smoked paprika", "3 g garlic powder", "150 g low-fat shredded cheese", "250 g salsa verde", "150 g Greek yogurt, 2%", "5 g lime juice", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions:
Preheat the oven to 200°C. Slice the red onion and bell pepper, then cube the chicken breast. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat, add the chicken, and cook for 6–8 minutes until browned and cooked through. Stir in the onion and bell pepper and cook for 3–4 minutes until slightly softened. Add the black beans, crushed tomatoes, cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper, then simmer for 8–10 minutes until the mixture is thick and fragrant.
Spread the baked tortilla chips in a single layer on a baking tray. Spoon the chicken and bean mixture over the chips, then sprinkle with the shredded low-fat cheese. Bake for 8–10 minutes until the cheese is melted and lightly bubbling. Warm the salsa verde briefly in a small saucepan, then mix the Greek yogurt with lime juice.
Serve the nachos straight from the oven topped with salsa verde and a drizzle of lime-yogurt. Keep an eye on the oven so the chips stay crisp rather than browning too much.

title: Black Bean and Chicken Sheet-Pan Nachos with Avocado Lime Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["300 g tortilla chips, baked or reduced-fat", "250 g chicken breast, raw", "200 g canned black beans, drained and rinsed", "150 g canned diced tomatoes, no added salt", "100 g red onion", "80 g bell pepper", "2 g ground cumin", "3 g smoked paprika", "4 g chili powder", "5 g garlic powder", "6 g salt", "400 g reduced-fat grated cheese", "150 g plain low-fat Greek yogurt", "80 g avocado", "1 lime, juice", "10 g fresh coriander"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. Dice the onion and bell pepper. Cut the chicken breast into small bite-size pieces and toss with cumin, smoked paprika, chili powder, garlic powder, and 1 g of salt. Spread the tortilla chips over a large sheet pan. In a skillet, cook the spiced chicken with the remaining vegetables over medium-high heat for 6 to 8 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and lightly browned. Stir in the black beans and diced tomatoes and simmer for 3 minutes so the mixture thickens slightly. Spoon the hot bean-chicken mixture evenly over the chips. Sprinkle the reduced-fat grated cheese generously on top, then bake for 8 to 10 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbling. While the nachos bake, mash the avocado and mix it with the Greek yogurt, lime juice, the remaining 5 g of salt (adjusting to taste), and the chopped coriander. Let the nachos rest for 2 minutes, then serve with the avocado lime yogurt on the side.

title: Chicken & Black Bean Veggie Nachos with Greek Yogurt Lime Sauce
ingredients_json: ["300 g corn tortilla chips, baked", "250 g chicken breast, cooked and sliced", "200 g black beans, cooked and drained", "150 g red bell pepper, diced", "120 g red onion, diced", "200 g cherry tomatoes, halved", "120 g corn kernels, cooked", "160 g reduced-fat cheddar cheese, grated", "250 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "10 g lime juice", "5 g ground cumin", "3 g smoked paprika", "4 g garlic powder", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat your oven to 220°C. Spread the baked corn tortilla chips on a baking tray in an even layer. Toss the chicken, black beans, bell pepper, red onion, cherry tomatoes, and corn with cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, black pepper, and 1 g of the salt. Spoon the mixture over the chips and sprinkle with the grated cheddar. Bake for 8–10 minutes, until the cheese is melted and lightly bubbling. While the nachos bake, stir the Greek yogurt with lime juice and the remaining 1 g salt. Let the nachos cool for 2 minutes so they stay crisp, then serve with the lime yogurt sauce on top.

title: Healthy Chicken and Black Bean Nachos with Salsa Verde and Feta
ingredients_json: ["220 g tortilla chips, baked", "250 g chicken breast, cooked and shredded", "200 g black beans, canned, drained and rinsed", "150 g canned chopped tomatoes", "120 g bell pepper, red, diced", "80 g red onion, diced", "20 g olive oil", "10 g ground cumin", "5 g smoked paprika", "4 g garlic powder", "3 g salt", "2 g black pepper, ground", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain 2%", "60 g feta cheese, reduced-fat", "100 g corn kernels, cooked"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C and set a large baking tray inside while it warms. In a bowl, toss the diced red onion and bell pepper with 10 g olive oil, then spread them on the hot tray and roast for 8 minutes until slightly softened. Add the canned chopped tomatoes, black beans, corn kernels, cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, 2 g salt, and black pepper, then stir and simmer in the tray for 6–8 minutes until the mixture looks thick and glossy. Spread the baked tortilla chips in a single layer on the tray and scatter the chicken over them, then spoon the bean-tomato mixture evenly across the top. Crumble the feta over the nachos and bake for 6–8 minutes until the chips are hot and lightly crisp again. Mix the Greek yogurt with the remaining olive oil and a pinch of salt (about 1 g) for a creamy drizzle. Serve the nachos straight from the oven with the yogurt sauce on top and any extra roasted topping alongside.

title: Black Bean & Chicken Veggie Nachos with Greek Yogurt Lime Sauce
ingredients_json: ["200 g tortilla chips, baked, unsalted", "250 g chicken breast, cooked and diced", "200 g black beans, cooked and drained", "180 g red bell pepper, diced", "120 g onion, diced", "150 g cherry tomatoes, halved", "120 g corn kernels, canned, drained", "60 g reduced-fat cheddar cheese, grated", "20 g olive oil", "2 tsp ground cumin", "2 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1.5 g garlic powder", "2 g salt", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2%", "1 tbsp lime juice", "10 g fresh coriander, chopped"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. Toss the diced bell pepper, onion, cherry tomatoes and corn with olive oil, cumin, smoked paprika, oregano and garlic powder, then spread them on a baking tray and roast for 12 minutes until the vegetables soften and start to char at the edges. In a large bowl, mix the roasted vegetables with the black beans and cooked chicken, then season with salt and stir until well combined. Spread the tortilla chips on a baking tray and scatter over the chicken-bean mixture. Sprinkle the reduced-fat cheddar evenly across the top. Bake for 8–10 minutes until the cheese is melted and lightly bubbling. Meanwhile, stir the Greek yogurt with lime juice and chopped coriander. Let the nachos cool for 2 minutes so the toppings set, then serve with the lime yogurt sauce on the side.

title: Creamy Chicken & Spinach Noodle Casserole with Mozzarella
ingredients_json: ["300 g dry wholewheat pasta", "350 g chicken breast, raw, diced", "250 g cottage cheese, low-fat", "200 g Greek yoghurt, low-fat", "200 g spinach, fresh", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "250 g mushrooms, sliced", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp ground black pepper", "2 g salt", "150 g mozzarella, part-skim, shredded", "150 ml chicken stock, low-salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. Cook the wholewheat pasta in a large pot of boiling water until just tender, then drain and set aside. In a large skillet, heat the olive oil and sauté the diced chicken over medium-high heat for 6–8 minutes until no longer pink. Add the chopped onion, sliced mushrooms and garlic, then cook for another 4–5 minutes until the vegetables soften and the mushrooms release their moisture. Stir in the spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes until wilted. In a bowl, mix the cottage cheese and Greek yoghurt with oregano, black pepper, and salt, then stir in the chicken stock to loosen the sauce. Fold the cooked pasta into the chicken and vegetable mixture, pour in the creamy sauce, and mix until everything is evenly coated. Transfer to a baking dish, sprinkle with mozzarella, and bake for 20–25 minutes until bubbling and lightly golden on top. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Creamy Spinach & Turkey Noodle Casserole with Wholewheat Pasta
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholewheat penne pasta, dry", "350 g turkey mince, lean", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "300 g spinach, fresh", "250 g low-fat natural yoghurt", "150 g cottage cheese, low-fat", "1 tbsp olive oil", "200 g passata di pomodoro", "20 g grated Parmesan cheese", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp ground black pepper", "1 tsp salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 190°C. Cook the wholewheat penne in a large pan of salted boiling water until just al dente, then drain. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a skillet and fry the onion for 5 minutes until softened. Add the turkey mince and cook for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up, until no longer pink. Stir in the garlic and dried oregano for 30 seconds, then add the passata and simmer for 5 minutes to thicken. Stir the spinach into the hot turkey sauce until wilted, then turn off the heat. In a bowl, mix the low-fat natural yoghurt and low-fat cottage cheese until smooth. Fold the cooked pasta and turkey-spinach sauce together, then stir in the yoghurt mixture and half the Parmesan. Tip into a baking dish and sprinkle the remaining Parmesan over the top. Bake for 25–30 minutes until bubbling and lightly golden. Rest for 5 minutes before serving so the casserole sets and slices up neatly.

title: Creamy Chicken & Spinach Noodle Casserole with Wholewheat Penne
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholewheat penne pasta, dry", "300 g chicken breast, raw", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion", "2 cloves garlic", "300 g mushrooms, sliced", "300 g baby spinach, fresh", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "1.5 tsp salt", "400 g passata", "250 ml low-fat milk, 1.5%", "100 g Greek yogurt, non-fat", "80 g mozzarella, part-skim", "20 g Parmesan cheese, hard"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C. Cook the wholewheat penne in a large pot of salted water until just al dente, then drain and set aside. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat and sauté the onion for 4 to 5 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and mushrooms and cook for another 5 to 6 minutes, until the mushrooms release their moisture and start to brown. Add the chicken breast pieces, oregano, and black pepper, then cook for 8 to 10 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and no longer pink. Stir in the spinach until wilted, then mix in the passata. In a bowl, whisk the low-fat milk and Greek yogurt together, then pour it into the pan and stir until the sauce looks smooth and creamy. Fold the drained pasta into the sauce, transfer everything to a casserole dish, and sprinkle mozzarella and Parmesan on top. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling at the edges and lightly golden on top. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving so the casserole sets slightly.

title: Broccoli & Turkey Penne Bake with Wholewheat and Light Cheese
ingredients_json: ["250 g dry wholewheat penne", "300 g turkey mince, lean", "250 g broccoli florets", "1 medium carrot, grated", "1 medium onion, finely chopped", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes", "200 g low-fat cottage cheese", "60 g hard cheese, reduced-fat", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. Cook the penne in salted water according to the packet instructions until al dente, then drain well. In a large pan, heat the olive oil and sauté the onion and carrot for 5 to 7 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the turkey mince and cook until browned all over. Stir in the oregano and smoked paprika, then add the chopped tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes. Steam or microwave the broccoli until just tender, about 3 to 4 minutes, then stir it through the turkey sauce. Mix the cottage cheese with half of the reduced-fat cheese, then combine with the drained pasta until everything is evenly coated. Tip the mixture into a baking dish, sprinkle over the remaining cheese, and bake for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling and lightly golden on top. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving so the casserole sets and slices cleanly.

title: Lean Chicken Pad Thai with Tamarind-Lime and Crisp Veg
ingredients_json: ["100 g rice noodles, flat", "250 g chicken breast, raw, trimmed", "200 g prawns, raw, peeled", "1 tbsp rice oil", "1 small onion", "2 cloves garlic", "1 tbsp tamarind paste", "2 tbsp fish sauce", "1 tbsp soy sauce, reduced salt", "2 tbsp maple syrup", "1 tbsp lime juice", "150 g carrot, grated", "200 g bell pepper, red, sliced", "120 g bean sprouts", "50 g roasted peanuts, chopped", "60 g spring onions, sliced", "2 g dried red chilli flakes", "1 g ground black pepper"]
instructions: Soak the rice noodles in room-temperature water for 20 minutes until pliable, then drain well. Cut the chicken breast into thin strips and pat dry. In a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat, add the rice oil and stir-fry the chicken for 4–6 minutes until it turns lightly golden and is mostly cooked through. Add the prawns and cook for 2–3 minutes until they turn pink and opaque. Add the onion and bell pepper and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes until slightly softened. Reduce the heat to medium, add the garlic, and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Stir in the tamarind paste, fish sauce, reduced-salt soy sauce, maple syrup, and lime juice, then add the drained noodles and grated carrot. Toss continuously for 2–3 minutes until the noodles are glossy and tender and the sauce coats everything. Fold in the bean sprouts and spring onions for the final 30–60 seconds so they stay crisp. Turn off the heat, season with chilli flakes and black pepper, and top with chopped peanuts before serving.

title: Lean Chicken and Prawn Pad Thai with Tamarind-Lime Sauce and Crunchy Veg
ingredients_json: ["120 g rice noodles, dried", "200 g chicken breast, raw", "150 g raw prawns, peeled and deveined", "30 g tamarind paste", "20 ml soy sauce, reduced salt", "15 ml fish sauce", "20 g brown sugar", "10 ml lime juice", "10 ml rice vinegar", "30 g palm sugar", "1 tbsp peanut oil", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "150 g red bell pepper, sliced", "120 g carrot, julienned", "100 g spring onions, chopped", "150 g bean sprouts", "40 g roasted peanuts, chopped", "2 large eggs, raw", "30 g fresh coriander, chopped", "1 tsp chili flakes"]
instructions: Soak the rice noodles in warm water for about 8–10 minutes until pliable, then drain well. Slice the chicken thinly and pat the prawns dry so they sear instead of steam. In a bowl, mix tamarind paste, reduced-salt soy sauce, fish sauce, brown sugar and palm sugar, then stir in lime juice and rice vinegar to make a smooth sauce. Heat a wok or large pan over high heat and add the peanut oil. Fry garlic and chili flakes for 20–30 seconds until fragrant, then add the chicken and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes until it is mostly cooked through. Add prawns and cook for 1–2 minutes until they turn pink. Push everything to the side, crack in the eggs and scramble quickly, then toss through the chicken and prawns. Add bell pepper and carrot and stir-fry for 2–3 minutes until just tender. Add drained noodles and pour in the tamarind-lime sauce; toss continuously for 2–3 minutes, adding a splash of water only if the noodles look dry, until glossy and cooked. Turn off the heat and fold in spring onions, bean sprouts and chopped coriander. Serve immediately, topped with roasted peanuts.

title: Zesty Chicken Pad Thai with Tamarind-Lime and Veg
ingredients_json: ["100 g rice noodles, dried (thin)", "250 g chicken breast, raw", "1 tbsp vegetable oil", "1 small onion", "2 clove garlic", "1 thumb ginger, fresh", "200 g carrot, grated", "200 g bell pepper, sliced", "150 g bean sprouts", "80 g low-fat tofu, firm", "2 tbsp tamarind paste", "1 tbsp soy sauce, low-salt", "1 tbsp rice vinegar", "1 tsp fish sauce, reduced-salt", "1 tbsp lime juice", "2 tbsp unsalted peanuts, chopped", "2 tbsp fresh coriander", "1 piece lime, for wedges", "1 piece egg, whole"]
instructions: Soak the rice noodles in room-temperature water for about 20 minutes until flexible but still firm, then drain well. Cut the chicken into thin strips and pat dry so it browns quickly. Heat the vegetable oil in a large wok over medium-high heat, then stir-fry the chicken for 4–6 minutes until no longer pink and lightly browned. Add the onion, garlic, and ginger and cook for 1–2 minutes until fragrant. Stir in the grated carrot and bell pepper and cook for another 3–4 minutes until slightly softened but still bright. Push the vegetables to one side of the wok, crack in the egg, and scramble it quickly, then mix through. Add the tofu, soaked noodles, tamarind paste, soy sauce, rice vinegar, fish sauce, and lime juice. Toss continuously for 2–3 minutes until the noodles are glossy and tender and the sauce clings evenly; if it looks dry, splash in 2–3 tablespoons of water. Turn off the heat, fold through the bean sprouts, sprinkle over the peanuts and coriander, and serve right away with lime wedges. Taste and adjust with a little extra lime if you want it punchier.

title: Chicken Pad Thai with Tamarind-Lime, Crunchy Vegetables & Lime Chilli
ingredients_json: ["100 g rice noodles, dried", "220 g chicken breast, raw", "1 tbsp vegetable oil", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic", "120 g carrot", "150 g bell pepper, red", "150 g bean sprouts", "80 g tamarind paste", "2 tbsp soy sauce, reduced salt", "1 tbsp fish sauce", "30 g brown sugar", "1 tbsp rice vinegar", "2 pieces lime, juice and zest", "2 tbsp crushed peanuts", "2 pieces eggs, raw", "2 tbsp fresh coriander, chopped", "2 g chili flakes"]
instructions: Soak the rice noodles in warm water for 6–8 minutes until flexible, then drain and set aside. Slice the chicken thinly, season lightly, and heat the vegetable oil in a large wok or frying pan on medium-high. Add the onion and cook for 2 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic for 30 seconds. Add the chicken and cook for 5–6 minutes, stirring often, until no longer pink in the middle. Add the carrot and bell pepper and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes until crisp-tender. In a small bowl, mix the tamarind paste, reduced-salt soy sauce, fish sauce, brown sugar, rice vinegar, lime juice, and zest, then pour it into the pan. Toss in the drained noodles and cook for 2–3 minutes, adding a splash of water if the sauce looks too thick. Push everything to one side, crack in the eggs, scramble quickly, then fold through the noodles. Remove from heat, then stir in the bean sprouts, peanuts, fresh coriander, and chili flakes. Taste and adjust with a little extra lime if needed, then serve hot.

title: Lean Chicken and Seafood Paella with Peas, Peppers, and Saffron
ingredients_json: ["300 g chicken breast, raw, diced", "250 g cod, raw, skinless, cut into chunks", "200 g raw tiger prawns, peeled and deveined", "320 g bomba rice", "900 ml vegetable stock, hot", "1.5 g saffron threads", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, yellow, chopped", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "1 piece red bell pepper, diced", "1 piece green bell pepper, diced", "200 g cherry tomatoes, halved", "120 g peas, frozen", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a wide paella pan or heavy skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chopped onion and cook for 3–4 minutes until softened, then stir in the minced garlic, diced red and green bell peppers, and smoked paprika. Cook for 4–5 minutes, stirring often, until the vegetables begin to brown slightly. Add the cherry tomatoes and oregano and cook for 2 minutes to thicken the base. Stir in the bomba rice and saffron threads, coating the rice well with the vegetable mixture. Pour in the hot vegetable stock, bring to a gentle simmer, and cook without stirring for about 15 minutes until most of the liquid is absorbed. Add the frozen peas, then nestle in the diced chicken breast and cod chunks so they cook evenly. Continue cooking for another 8–10 minutes, keeping the heat at a steady simmer. Add the prawns for the final 3–4 minutes, cooking until they turn pink and opaque. Rest the paella for 5 minutes off the heat before serving, and check that the chicken is cooked through and the rice is tender with a slight, caramelized crust at the bottom.

title: Seafood & Chicken Brown Paella with Roasted Peppers and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["220 g chicken breast, raw, skinless", "200 g king prawns, raw, peeled", "160 g salmon fillet, raw, skinless", "280 g bomba rice, uncooked", "900 ml low-salt chicken stock", "2 dl canned chopped tomatoes, no salt added", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 piece red bell pepper", "1 piece yellow bell pepper", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 g saffron threads", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried thyme", "200 g frozen peas", "120 g baby spinach", "10 g lemon juice", "2 g fine sea salt", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat. Sauté the onion for about 5 minutes until softened, then add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Stir in the smoked paprika, thyme, and saffron, and cook for another 20 seconds to bloom the spices. Add the chicken breast cut into bite-size pieces and cook for 6–8 minutes, turning occasionally, until the outside is lightly golden. Add the chopped bell peppers and tomatoes, then pour in the chicken stock and bring the mixture to a steady simmer. Stir in the bomba rice once, distribute it evenly, and simmer without stirring for about 15 minutes, keeping the heat at a gentle bubbling level. Add the peas and continue cooking for 5 minutes. Nestle the prawns and salmon into the rice and cook for 6–8 minutes more, until the rice is tender and the seafood is just cooked through. Turn off the heat, fold in the baby spinach to wilt, and finish with lemon juice, black pepper, and the sea salt if needed. Rest the paella for 3 minutes before serving so the liquid is fully absorbed.

title: Vegetable Chicken & Seafood Paella with Saffron Lemon
ingredients_json: ["300 g paella rice (Bomba or similar), dry", "320 g chicken breast, raw, diced", "250 g raw tiger prawns, peeled and deveined", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion, diced", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "1 red bell pepper, diced", "1 large carrot, diced", "150 g green beans, trimmed and cut", "200 g canned chopped tomatoes, drained", "1 tsp saffron threads", "1.2 L chicken stock, low-salt", "100 g green peas, frozen", "1 lemon, zest and juice"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a wide paella pan over medium-high heat. Add the diced onion and red bell pepper and cook for 5 minutes, stirring, until the onion turns translucent. Stir in the minced garlic and carrot and cook for 2 minutes. Add the diced chicken breast and cook for 6–8 minutes until the chicken is lightly browned and mostly cooked through. Add the chopped tomatoes, saffron, and green beans, then pour in the low-salt chicken stock and bring it to a steady simmer. Stir in the paella rice and spread it evenly across the pan; do not stir again. Simmer for about 16–18 minutes, keeping the heat at a level that maintains gentle bubbling across the surface. When the rice is almost tender, scatter over the prawns and green peas, then simmer for another 4–5 minutes until the prawns are pink and cooked and the rice is fully tender with a slightly toasted base. Finish with lemon zest and juice, rest the paella for 3 minutes, and serve hot.

title: Mediterranean Chicken and Pea Paella with Lemon and Herbs
ingredients_json: ["320 g chicken breast, raw, skinless, diced", "240 g paella rice (short-grain)", "1.2 l low-salt chicken stock", "1.5 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, yellow, diced", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "1 piece red bell pepper, diced", "120 g canned tomatoes, crushed (no added salt)", "200 g green peas, frozen", "80 g chorizo, cooking type, sliced", "0.5 g saffron threads", "0.8 g smoked paprika", "10 g fresh parsley, chopped", "1 piece lemon, zest and juice", "1.2 g salt", "1.0 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a wide paella pan over medium-high heat. Add the diced onion and bell pepper and cook for 5 to 6 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the chorizo slices and cook for 2 minutes to release flavour, followed by the diced chicken breast; cook for 6 to 7 minutes until the chicken is lightly browned. Stir in the crushed tomatoes, saffron, and smoked paprika, then add the paella rice and coat it well in the pan juices for 1 to 2 minutes. Pour in the hot chicken stock, bring to a gentle boil, and reduce to a steady simmer. Cook without stirring for about 15 minutes, then add the frozen peas and continue simmering for 5 to 7 minutes, until the rice is tender and the liquid is mostly absorbed. Turn off the heat, cover the pan for 2 minutes, then finish with lemon zest, lemon juice, and chopped parsley. Taste and adjust seasoning with a little black pepper if needed, and serve hot with extra lemon wedges.

title: Vegetable Chicken Pancit Bihon with Oyster Mushroom and Lime
ingredients_json: ["120 g dry rice noodles, bihon style", "250 g chicken breast, skinless, diced", "180 g oyster mushrooms, sliced", "120 g carrots, julienned", "120 g red bell pepper, thinly sliced", "120 g cabbage, shredded", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "1 pc white onion, small, thinly sliced", "20 g fresh ginger, grated", "3 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce", "1 tbsp oyster sauce, low-sodium", "500 ml chicken stock, low-sodium", "15 ml sesame oil, toasted", "2 tbsp lime juice", "1 tbsp neutral cooking oil, e.g., canola", "5 g chopped spring onion, for garnish"]
instructions: Soak the dry rice noodles in warm water for 20 minutes until pliable, then drain well. Heat the neutral cooking oil in a large wok over medium-high heat. Add the onion and cook for 2 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the diced chicken and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring often, until the pieces turn opaque and lightly browned. Add the mushrooms, carrots, bell pepper, and cabbage, and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes until the vegetables begin to soften but still look bright. Pour in the low-sodium soy sauce, low-sodium oyster sauce, and chicken stock, then bring to a gentle simmer. Add the drained noodles and toss well, cooking for 3–5 minutes until the noodles are fully tender and the sauce lightly clings to everything. Turn off the heat, drizzle in the toasted sesame oil and lime juice, and toss again. Serve hot and finish with chopped spring onion.

title: Chicken and Vegetable Pancit Bihon with Calamansi-Lime Dressing
ingredients_json: ["200 g dried rice vermicelli (bihon-style)", "250 g chicken breast, skinless, thinly sliced", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece yellow onion, chopped", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "1 piece medium carrot, julienned", "150 g cabbage, shredded", "100 g green beans, cut into 2 cm pieces", "200 g mushrooms, sliced", "2 tbsp soy sauce (low sodium)", "1 tbsp oyster sauce (reduced sodium)", "1.5 ml calamansi juice", "15 g fresh ginger, grated", "600 ml chicken stock, low sodium", "1 tbsp toasted sesame oil", "20 g green onions, sliced", "2 g ground black pepper"]
instructions: Soak the rice vermicelli in warm water for 20 minutes, then drain well. Heat the olive oil in a large wok over medium-high heat and sauté the onion until fragrant and slightly softened, about 2 minutes. Add the garlic and ginger and stir for 30 seconds. Add the chicken and cook until the exterior turns opaque and lightly browned, about 4 to 5 minutes. Stir in the carrot, cabbage, green beans, and mushrooms, then cook for 3 to 4 minutes until the vegetables are crisp-tender. Pour in the chicken stock, soy sauce, and oyster sauce, and let it simmer for 2 minutes. Add the drained vermicelli and toss continuously so the noodles separate and absorb the sauce; add a small splash of water only if the pan looks dry. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes until the vermicelli is tender but still springy, then turn off the heat and drizzle in sesame oil and calamansi juice. Top with green onions and black pepper, and serve hot.

title: Chicken and Vegetable Pancit Canton with Sesame-Lime Sauce
ingredients_json: ["200 g pancit canton noodles (wheat, dried)", "250 g chicken breast, raw, cut into thin strips", "30 g sunflower oil", "1 piece onion, yellow, medium, sliced", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "1 piece carrot, medium, julienned", "150 g green cabbage, shredded", "100 g snow peas, trimmed", "120 g bell pepper, red, sliced", "2 pieces spring onion, cut into 2 cm lengths", "2 tbsp soy sauce (light)", "1 tbsp oyster sauce (reduced-sodium)", "1 tbsp sesame oil", "1 tbsp lime juice", "8 g cornstarch", "250 ml water", "2 g black pepper, ground", "2 g chili flakes (optional)"]
instructions: Cook the pancit canton noodles according to package directions until just tender, then drain and rinse briefly under cool water to stop the cooking. In a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat, warm the sunflower oil until shimmering. Sauté the onion for about 2 minutes, then add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the chicken strips and stir-fry for 4 to 6 minutes until no longer pink. Toss in the carrot, cabbage, bell pepper, and snow peas, stir-frying for 3 to 4 minutes until the vegetables are crisp-tender. In a small bowl, mix the soy sauce, oyster sauce, sesame oil, lime juice, cornstarch, water, black pepper, and chili flakes if using, then pour into the wok. Add the drained noodles and toss continuously for 1 to 2 minutes, until the sauce lightly coats the noodles and looks glossy. Turn off the heat and finish with the spring onion. Serve immediately while the pancit is hot and springy.

title: Chicken and Vegetable Pancit Bihon with Sesame-Lime Soy Glaze
ingredients_json: ["120 g dried rice vermicelli (bihon-style), thin", "250 g chicken breast, skinless, diced", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion, raw, diced (150 g)", "3 cloves garlic, raw, minced (9 g)", "1 piece carrot, raw, julienned (100 g)", "1 cup green cabbage, shredded (100 g)", "100 g snow peas, trimmed", "200 g button mushrooms, sliced", "2 tbsp soy sauce, reduced-sodium", "1 tbsp sesame oil", "1 tbsp rice vinegar", "1 pc calamansi or lime, juice (20 ml)", "1.5 g ground black pepper"]
instructions: Soak the rice vermicelli in warm water for 10 minutes until pliable, then drain well. Heat the olive oil in a large wok over medium-high heat and cook the diced chicken for 5–7 minutes, stirring, until the pieces turn lightly golden and no longer look pink in the center. Add the onion and garlic and stir-fry for 2 minutes, until the onion softens. Add the carrot, cabbage, mushrooms, and snow peas, then stir-fry for 4–6 minutes until the vegetables are crisp-tender. Add the drained vermicelli and toss to combine. In a small bowl, mix the reduced-sodium soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and lime juice, then pour it into the wok and toss continuously for 1–2 minutes so the noodles absorb the glaze. Finish with ground black pepper and cook for another 30 seconds, then turn off the heat and serve immediately while the pancit is hot and lightly saucy.

title: Chicken and Vegetable Pancit Canton with Garlic-Lime Sauce
ingredients_json: ["200 g Pancit canton noodles (wheat, dried)", "250 g Chicken breast, skinless, cut into thin strips", "1 medium Onion, yellow, sliced (120 g)", "3 cloves Garlic, minced (15 g)", "150 g Carrot, julienned", "150 g Cabbage, shredded", "100 g Snow peas, trimmed", "120 g Green bell pepper, sliced", "200 ml Low-sodium chicken stock", "2 tbsp Soy sauce, low-sodium (30 ml)", "1 tbsp Oyster sauce, low-sodium (15 g)", "1 tbsp Sesame oil (15 ml)", "1 tbsp Vegetable oil (15 ml)", "1 pc Lime, zest and juice (30 ml)", "2 g Ground black pepper"]
instructions: Soak the pancit canton noodles in warm water for 10 minutes until pliable, then drain well. Heat the vegetable oil in a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat. Sauté the garlic and onion for 1–2 minutes until fragrant and the onion turns translucent. Add the chicken strips and stir-fry for 4–5 minutes until lightly golden and cooked through. Add the carrots, cabbage, snow peas, and green bell pepper, then stir-fry for 3–4 minutes until the vegetables are crisp-tender. Pour in the chicken stock and bring to a gentle simmer. Stir in the low-sodium soy sauce and low-sodium oyster sauce, then add the drained noodles and toss continuously for 2–3 minutes until the noodles loosen and absorb the sauce. Turn off the heat, drizzle in the sesame oil, and toss again. Finish with lime zest, lime juice, and ground black pepper, then serve hot while the noodles are springy.

title: Chicken and Spinach Panini with Mozzarella and Roasted Peppers
ingredients_json: ["240 g chicken breast, cooked, sliced", "120 g wholegrain bread, sliced", "60 g low-fat mozzarella, grated", "80 g spinach, fresh", "120 g roasted red peppers, jarred, drained", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 cloves garlic, raw, minced", "15 g parmesan cheese, finely grated", "5 g basil, fresh, chopped", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt"]
instructions: Heat a panini press or a heavy skillet over medium heat. Add the olive oil to a small pan and sauté the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant, then stir in the spinach and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until wilted. Lay the bread slices out and spread the roasted red peppers across the surface. Divide the cooked chicken, sautéed spinach mixture, and mozzarella between two halves of bread, then sprinkle over the parmesan and basil. Close the sandwiches and press them in the panini press for about 4 to 6 minutes, or cook in the skillet with a weight on top for about 5 minutes per side until the bread is crisp and the cheese is melted. Slice and serve immediately while hot.

title: Wholegrain Chicken & Spinach Panini with Mozzarella and Tomato
ingredients_json: ["160 g wholegrain bread slices", "200 g chicken breast, cooked, sliced", "120 g spinach, fresh", "150 g tomato, sliced", "30 g mozzarella cheese, part-skim, grated", "15 g parmesan cheese, grated", "10 g olive oil", "5 g garlic, fresh, minced", "5 g lemon juice", "3 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "20 g red onion, thinly sliced"]
instructions: Heat a panini press (or heavy skillet) over medium heat. In a bowl, mix olive oil with minced garlic, lemon juice, black pepper, and salt. Lightly brush one side of the bread slices with the garlic-lemon oil. On the unbrushed side, layer spinach, red onion, chicken slices, tomato, mozzarella, and parmesan. Close the sandwiches and press firmly. Cook for 3–5 minutes per side until the bread is crisp and deeply golden and the cheese has melted; if using a skillet, cook for 3–4 minutes per side and press with a spatula while cooking. Let them rest for 1 minute before slicing and serving.

title: Chicken & Spinach Panini with Mozzarella and Tomato
ingredients_json: ["200 g chicken breast, cooked and sliced", "60 g wholemeal bread", "120 g wholemeal bread", "80 g low-fat mozzarella, grated", "100 g spinach, fresh", "80 g tomato, sliced", "15 g olive oil", "10 g balsamic vinegar", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat a panini press or a heavy skillet over medium heat. Brush both sides of the bread with half the olive oil, then place one slice down and layer with mozzarella, spinach, tomato slices, and the cooked chicken. Drizzle with balsamic vinegar, season with salt and black pepper, and place the remaining bread slice on top. Brush the top with the remaining olive oil and press down firmly. Cook for 3–5 minutes until the bread is crisp and golden and the cheese has melted; if using a skillet, turn the sandwich once halfway and cook until heated through. Let it rest for 1 minute before cutting and serving.

title: Wholegrain Chicken & Spinach Panini with Mozzarella and Roasted Peppers
ingredients_json: ["4 slices Wholegrain bread", "250 g Chicken breast, cooked and sliced", "120 g Mozzarella cheese, part-skim", "80 g Baby spinach", "120 g Roasted red peppers, jarred, drained", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Balsamic vinegar", "1 clove Garlic, minced", "0.5 tsp Dried oregano", "0.5 tsp Sea salt", "0.25 tsp Black pepper"]
instructions: Heat a large non-stick skillet over medium heat and add the olive oil. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant, then add the spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes until wilted. Layer the bread slices with the chicken, roasted red peppers, and the wilted spinach, then add mozzarella, oregano, and black pepper. Drizzle the balsamic vinegar over the filling. Close the sandwiches and toast in the skillet for 3–4 minutes per side, pressing lightly with a spatula, until the bread is crisp and the cheese is melted. Serve immediately while hot.

title: Creamy Turkey Carbonara with Wholewheat Pasta and Peas
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholewheat spaghetti", "200 g turkey breast, diced", "100 g peas, frozen", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain 2%", "4 tablespoons Parmesan cheese, grated", "2 tablespoons Pecorino Romano cheese, grated", "3 large eggs, raw", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "1 tablespoon olive oil", "1 teaspoon black pepper, ground", "0.5 teaspoon salt"]
instructions: Cook the wholewheat spaghetti in a large pot of well-salted boiling water until al dente, then reserve about 150 ml of the cooking water and drain. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat and sauté the minced garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the diced turkey breast and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring, until browned and cooked through. Add the frozen peas for the last 2 minutes of cooking so they turn bright green and hot. In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the Greek yogurt, Parmesan, and Pecorino, then add the black pepper. Turn the heat off under the turkey and peas, add the drained pasta, and toss quickly. Pour in a little reserved pasta water, then stir in the egg-and-cheese mixture off the heat so it emulsifies into a glossy sauce; if it looks too thick, loosen with a splash more pasta water. Serve immediately, making sure the sauce is creamy rather than scrambled.

title: Light Turkey Carbonara with Wholewheat Spaghetti and Peas
ingredients_json: ["200 g wholewheat spaghetti, dry", "200 g turkey bacon, diced", "2 piece egg, whole", "40 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "1 clove garlic, minced", "200 g peas, frozen", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1.5 dl water", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "0.25 tsp salt"]
instructions: Cook the wholewheat spaghetti in a large pot of boiling salted water according to the package instructions until al dente, then reserve 1.5 dl of the cooking water and drain. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat and cook the turkey bacon until browned and slightly crisp, stirring occasionally. Add the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant, then stir in the frozen peas and splash in the reserved water. Simmer for 3 to 4 minutes until the peas are hot and tender. In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the grated Parmesan and a generous amount of black pepper until smooth. Reduce the heat under the bacon-pan to low, add the drained spaghetti, and toss quickly to coat. Remove the pan from the heat, pour in the egg-and-cheese mixture, and toss rapidly so the sauce turns creamy and clings to the pasta without scrambling the eggs. If the sauce feels too thick, add a little extra pasta water a spoonful at a time, then serve immediately.

title: Smoked Turkey Carbonara with Wholewheat Pasta, Peas & Parmesan
ingredients_json: ["200 g dry wholewheat spaghetti", "150 g turkey bacon, smoked", "2 piece egg, whole", "1 piece egg yolk, raw", "60 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "200 g peas, frozen", "2 cloves garlic", "15 ml olive oil", "120 ml water", "5 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the wholewheat spaghetti until al dente according to the package instructions. In the meantime, heat the olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat and cook the turkey bacon until lightly crisp, stirring often. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the frozen peas with the 120 ml water to the pan, cover, and steam for 3 to 4 minutes until tender. In a bowl, whisk the whole eggs and extra yolk with the grated Parmesan and black pepper until smooth. Drain the pasta, reserving a small splash of cooking water, then add the pasta to the pan with the peas and toss well. Remove the pan from the heat and pour in the egg-Parmesan mixture while tossing quickly so the eggs thicken into a creamy sauce without scrambling. If needed, add a teaspoon of reserved pasta water to loosen the sauce and keep it glossy. Serve immediately with an extra grind of black pepper.

title: Light Turkey Carbonara with Wholewheat Spaghetti and Peas
ingredients_json: ["350 g wholewheat spaghetti, dry", "200 g turkey breast, lean, diced", "150 g peas, frozen", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "2 piece egg, whole, raw", "200 ml low-fat milk, 1.5% fat", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 cloves garlic, fresh, minced", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "2 g salt", "1 tbsp parsley, fresh, chopped"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the wholewheat spaghetti until al dente, then reserve about 200 ml of the cooking water and drain. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium heat and sauté the minced garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the diced turkey breast and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring often, until browned and cooked through. Add the frozen peas for the last 2 minutes of cooking, just to heat through. In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the low-fat milk and half the Parmesan until smooth. Lower the heat under the turkey and peas to low, add the drained pasta and a splash of reserved pasta water, and toss to coat. Remove the pan from the heat and pour in the egg mixture while tossing continuously so it becomes a creamy sauce without scrambling. Add black pepper, the remaining Parmesan, and a little more reserved pasta water if needed to loosen the sauce. Serve immediately with chopped parsley on top.

title: Lemon-Garlic Chicken Pasta Primavera with Fresh Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["200 g dried wholewheat penne pasta", "250 g chicken breast fillet, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 cloves garlic", "1 pc red bell pepper", "1 pc courgette", "200 g broccoli florets", "250 g cherry tomatoes", "80 g frozen peas", "200 g low-fat creme fraiche (10% fat)", "1 pc lemon, zest and juice", "20 g parmesan, hard", "10 g fresh basil", "5 g salt", "2 g black pepper"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil and cook the wholewheat penne until al dente, then reserve about 200 ml of the cooking water and drain. While the pasta cooks, cut the chicken breast into bite-size pieces and heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 6–8 minutes, stirring often, until it is no longer pink in the centre. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the bell pepper, courgette, broccoli, and cherry tomatoes, plus 100 ml of pasta water, and simmer for 8–10 minutes until the vegetables are tender-crisp. Stir in the peas for the last 2 minutes. Reduce the heat to low and mix in the creme fraiche, lemon zest and juice, and half the parmesan, loosening with a splash of reserved pasta water if needed. Add the drained penne to the pan and toss thoroughly so everything is glossy and well coated. Season with black pepper and the remaining parmesan, then fold in the basil and serve hot.

title: Lemon-Garlic Chicken Pasta Primavera with Roasted Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["320 g dry wholewheat pasta", "300 g chicken breast fillet", "30 g olive oil", "1 large courgette (zucchini), 250 g", "200 g bell pepper, red", "180 g cherry tomatoes", "120 g broccoli florets", "1 large onion, yellow, 150 g", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "12 g lemon zest", "60 ml lemon juice", "100 g parmesan cheese, hard", "10 g dried oregano", "2 g black pepper, ground", "6 g salt, iodized"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the wholewheat pasta until al dente, then reserve about 200 ml of the pasta water and drain. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the chicken breast pieces; cook for about 6 to 8 minutes until browned and cooked through. Reduce the heat to medium, add the onion and bell pepper, and sauté for 5 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic, oregano, courgette, broccoli, and cherry tomatoes, then cook for 8 to 10 minutes until the vegetables are tender but still vibrant. Add the cooked pasta to the skillet with the lemon zest and lemon juice, and loosen everything with reserved pasta water until glossy and well coated. Turn off the heat, fold through the parmesan, and taste for balance; the sauce should be bright and lightly thickened without being dry.

title: Lemon-Garlic Chicken Pasta Primavera with Roasted Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["320 g pasta, whole wheat penne (dry)", "250 g chicken breast fillet", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic", "2 piece zucchini", "1 piece red bell pepper", "200 g cherry tomatoes", "150 g broccoli florets", "100 g peas, frozen", "150 g mozzarella cheese, part-skim", "1 piece lemon", "15 g parmesan cheese, grated", "10 g fresh parsley", "2 g salt, table", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the whole wheat penne until al dente, then drain and reserve a small splash of pasta water. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the sliced chicken breast and cook for 6–8 minutes until browned and cooked through, then remove to a plate. In the same pan, sauté the onion for 3 minutes, then add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add zucchini slices, bell pepper strips, broccoli florets, and cherry tomatoes; cook for 8–10 minutes until the vegetables are tender-crisp. Stir in the frozen peas for 2 minutes. Return the chicken to the pan, add the cooked pasta, and toss well. Mix in the mozzarella and parmesan, then add lemon zest and juice to taste, loosening with a little reserved pasta water if needed so the sauce lightly clings to the pasta. Finish with chopped parsley and black pepper, and serve hot.

title: Wholewheat Pasta Primavera with Lemon Herb Chicken and Roasted Vegetables
