ingredients_json: ["200 g wholewheat pasta (penne)", "250 g chicken breast fillet", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 large onion", "2 cloves garlic", "200 g zucchini", "1 red bell pepper", "150 g cherry tomatoes", "80 g broccoli florets", "150 g reduced-fat cream cheese", "2 dl vegetable stock", "1 pc lemon", "10 g fresh basil", "8 g fresh parsley", "4 g salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Cook the wholewheat pasta in a large pot of salted boiling water until al dente, then reserve about 2 dl of the cooking water and drain. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and sauté the onion for about 5 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the chicken breast cut into bite-sized pieces; cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring often, until browned and cooked through. Add zucchini, bell pepper, broccoli, and cherry tomatoes and cook for 8–10 minutes until the vegetables are tender-crisp. Stir in the reduced-fat cream cheese and loosen with the vegetable stock and a splash of reserved pasta water until you have a creamy, lightly thick sauce. Add the drained pasta, mix well, and finish with lemon zest and lemon juice, chopped basil, and parsley. Season with salt and black pepper, then serve immediately while hot.

title: Lemon-Garlic Pasta Primavera with Roasted Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["250 g whole wheat penne pasta, dry", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 whole zucchini, medium", "1 whole red bell pepper", "200 g cherry tomatoes", "1 whole red onion", "2 cloves garlic", "150 g broccoli florets", "100 g spinach, fresh", "150 g feta cheese, reduced-fat", "150 ml vegetable stock", "1 piece lemon, zest and juice", "10 g fresh basil", "2 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C. Chop the zucchini, bell pepper, red onion, and halve the cherry tomatoes into bite-size pieces, then toss them with 1 tbsp olive oil. Spread the vegetables on a baking tray and roast for 18–22 minutes, until the edges are lightly browned and the tomatoes look blistered. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil, cook the penne according to the package directions until al dente, then reserve about 150 ml of the cooking water and drain. While the pasta cooks, blanch the broccoli in the same pot for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach just until wilted. In a large pan, heat the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil and sauté the garlic for about 30 seconds, then add the roasted vegetables and vegetable stock. Stir in the drained pasta and loosen with reserved pasta water until glossy. Turn off the heat and mix in feta, lemon zest and juice, and chopped basil. Season with black pepper, taste, and adjust the lemon for brightness before serving.

title: Lemon-Dijon Chicken Pasta Salad with Roasted Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["200 g wholewheat pasta, dry", "250 g chicken breast, raw, skinless", "250 g cherry tomatoes", "200 g cucumber", "150 g red bell pepper", "150 g chickpeas, cooked and drained", "60 g feta cheese, reduced-fat", "30 g extra virgin olive oil", "20 ml lemon juice", "15 g Dijon mustard", "1 clove garlic, raw", "5 g dried oregano", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt"]
instructions: Cook the wholewheat pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water according to the packet instructions until al dente. Drain well and cool slightly under cold running water so it doesn’t keep cooking. While the pasta cooks, roast the chicken: heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat with 10 g of the olive oil, sear the chicken breast for 3–4 minutes per side until golden, then reduce to medium and cook until fully cooked through, about 6–8 minutes total depending on thickness. Let the chicken rest briefly, then slice it. Halve the cherry tomatoes, dice the cucumber and red bell pepper, and rinse and drain the chickpeas. For the dressing, whisk together the remaining olive oil (20 g), lemon juice, Dijon mustard, grated garlic, oregano, black pepper, and salt until smooth. In a large bowl, combine the pasta, vegetables, chickpeas, sliced chicken, and feta, then pour over the lemon-Dijon dressing and toss thoroughly. Chill for 10–20 minutes for the flavors to meld, then serve cold or slightly cool.

title: Lemon Herb Tuna Pasta Salad with Crunchy Cucumber
ingredients_json: ["320 g wholewheat pasta, dry", "240 g canned tuna in water, drained", "2 tbsp olive oil", "120 g Greek yoghurt, plain, 2% fat", "1 piece lemon, zest and juice", "1 g garlic, fresh", "150 g cucumber, raw", "120 g cherry tomatoes", "80 g red onion", "80 g cooked sweetcorn, canned, drained", "40 g black olives, pitted", "10 g fresh parsley", "5 g Dijon mustard", "8 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Cook the wholewheat pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente, then drain well and rinse briefly under cold water to cool it quickly. In a large bowl, whisk the olive oil, Greek yoghurt, lemon zest and juice, Dijon mustard, minced garlic, black pepper, and the salt until smooth. Add the cooled pasta, tuna, diced cucumber, halved cherry tomatoes, finely sliced red onion, sweetcorn, chopped olives, and chopped parsley, then toss thoroughly so everything is evenly coated. Cover and chill for at least 20 minutes to let the flavours meld, and serve cold, checking seasoning once more before eating.

title: Lemon-Garlic Tuna & White Bean Pasta Salad with Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["300 g whole wheat penne pasta, dry", "220 g canned tuna in water, drained", "200 g canned cannellini beans, drained and rinsed", "250 g cherry tomatoes, halved", "1 piece red bell pepper, diced", "150 g cucumber, diced", "80 g red onion, finely sliced", "60 g feta cheese, reduced-fat", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tbsp red wine vinegar", "2 clove garlic, minced", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "0.5 tsp salt"]
instructions: Cook the whole wheat penne in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente, then drain well and rinse quickly under cool water to stop the cooking. Let the pasta drain thoroughly and cool for 10 minutes. In a large bowl, mix olive oil, lemon juice, red wine vinegar, minced garlic, oregano, black pepper, and salt, then add the tuna, cannellini beans, cherry tomatoes, red bell pepper, cucumber, and red onion. Fold in the cooled pasta gently until everything is evenly coated. Crumble the reduced-fat feta over the top, toss once more, and serve chilled or at room temperature for the best texture.

title: Lemon-Garlic Tuna Chickpea Pasta Salad with Crunchy Veg
ingredients_json: ["220 g whole wheat pasta, dry", "240 g canned tuna in water, drained", "150 g chickpeas, cooked, drained", "1 piece red bell pepper", "150 g cherry tomatoes", "1 piece cucumber", "80 g red onion", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 tbsp capers, drained", "1 piece lemon, zest and juice", "2 cloves garlic", "2 tsp Dijon mustard", "1 tsp dried oregano", "10 g fresh parsley", "1 g fine salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Cook the whole wheat pasta in a large pot of salted water according to the package instructions until al dente. Drain well and rinse briefly under cold water to stop the cooking, then shake off excess water and transfer to a large bowl. Whisk olive oil, Dijon mustard, lemon zest and juice, minced garlic, oregano, black pepper, and salt together until smooth, then pour over the pasta and toss thoroughly while the pasta is still slightly warm so the dressing clings. Fold in the drained tuna, chickpeas, capers, and all the chopped vegetables. Let the salad rest in the refrigerator for 20 to 30 minutes to develop flavor, then stir once more and finish with chopped parsley before serving.

title: Chickpea Pesto Tuna Pasta Salad with Cherry Tomatoes and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholewheat pasta, dry", "1 can (120 g drained) tuna in water", "200 g chickpeas, cooked and drained", "250 g cherry tomatoes", "150 g cucumber", "80 g fresh spinach", "40 g basil", "20 g pine nuts", "10 g parmesan cheese, hard", "20 ml extra virgin olive oil", "30 ml lemon juice", "1 clove garlic", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Cook the wholewheat pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente, then drain and rinse briefly under cold water to cool it down. While the pasta cooks, blend the basil, pine nuts, parmesan, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and black pepper into a thick pesto. In a large bowl, combine the cooled pasta, drained tuna, chickpeas, halved cherry tomatoes, diced cucumber, and spinach. Pour the pesto over the mixture and toss gently until everything is evenly coated and the spinach wilts slightly from the warmth of the pasta. Taste and adjust with the remaining salt if needed, then chill for 10 minutes before serving for the best flavour and texture.

title: Wholemeal Chicken and Veggie Pasties with Mustard Herb Sauce
ingredients_json: ["250 g wheat flour, wholemeal", "120 g butter, unsalted", "5 ml cider vinegar", "8 g salt, table salt", "220 ml water, tap", "1 piece egg, raw", "300 g chicken breast, raw", "1 piece onion, raw", "1 piece carrot, raw", "200 g swede (rutabaga), raw", "200 g peas, green, frozen", "15 g olive oil", "5 g garlic, fresh", "10 g mustard, wholegrain", "200 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "10 g plain flour", "2 g black pepper, ground", "5 g dried thyme"]
instructions: In a bowl, mix the wholemeal flour with 6 g of the salt. Cut the cold butter into small cubes and rub it into the flour until the mixture looks like coarse breadcrumbs. Stir in the cider vinegar and 160 ml of water, then bring the dough together with the egg. Add the remaining water only if needed to make a firm, smooth dough, then wrap and rest it in the fridge for 20 minutes. Dice the chicken, onion, carrot, and swede into small pieces. Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat, add the onion and garlic, and cook for 3 minutes until softened. Add the chicken, carrot, and swede, season with pepper and thyme, and cook for 8–10 minutes until the chicken is no longer pink. Stir in the peas and cook for 2 minutes. Mix the mustard into the semi-skimmed milk. In a small pot, whisk the plain flour to make a smooth paste, then slowly pour in the milk and cook on low heat, stirring, until thickened, about 3–4 minutes. Fold the sauce into the chicken and vegetable filling and cool until just warm. Preheat the oven to 200°C. Roll the dough to about 3–4 mm thick and cut out circles or squares. Spoon filling onto each piece, leaving a border, then fold over and crimp the edges firmly. Brush the pasties with a little milk-water (or a touch of milk). Bake for 25–30 minutes until the pastry is golden and the filling is piping hot. Let the pasties stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Wholewheat Turkey and Spinach Pasties with Caramelised Onion
ingredients_json: ["300 g wholewheat wheat flour", "200 g plain water", "10 g olive oil", "5 g fine salt", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 clove garlic", "300 g turkey mince, 5% fat", "200 g baby leaf spinach", "1 piece carrot, raw", "150 g low-fat cottage cheese", "80 g hard cheese, reduced-fat", "5 g dried thyme", "2 g black pepper, ground", "10 ml lemon juice"]
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine the wholewheat flour and salt. Add the egg and olive oil, then gradually pour in the water while mixing until a firm dough forms. Knead for 5–7 minutes until smooth, wrap, and rest in the fridge while you make the filling. Finely chop the onion and grate the carrot. Heat a pan over medium heat with a splash of water, then cook the onion and carrot for 8–10 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the turkey mince, thyme, and black pepper. Cook for 8–10 minutes, breaking up the meat, until no pink remains and the mixture looks nicely browned. Stir in the spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes until wilted. Turn off the heat and mix in the cottage cheese, reduced-fat hard cheese, and lemon juice until the filling is creamy and holds together. Roll the dough out to about 3 mm thick and cut 4 circles (about 16–18 cm). Spoon a generous portion of filling onto one half of each circle, fold over, and crimp the edges firmly with a fork to seal. Place the pasties on a lined baking tray and bake at 200°C for 25–30 minutes, until deeply golden and cooked through. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Oven-Baked Turkey and Spinach Pasties with Tomato Herb Sauce
ingredients_json: ["300 g turkey mince, lean", "200 g spinach, fresh", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic", "1 tbsp olive oil", "400 g passata, no added sugar", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp ground cumin", "120 g carrots, grated", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "300 g wholemeal flour", "180 ml water, cold", "1 tsp salt", "1 tbsp olive oil", "100 g low-fat cheese, reduced-fat cheddar"]
instructions:
Heat the oven to 200°C. Finely dice the onion and grate the carrots, then sauté them in 1 tbsp olive oil for 5 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and turkey mince, breaking it up with a spoon, and cook for 8–10 minutes until the meat is browned. Stir in the grated carrots, cumin, smoked paprika, and dried oregano, then add the tomato paste and passata and simmer for 10 minutes until the mixture is thick. Stir in the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted. Let the filling cool slightly so it doesn’t melt the pastry.

For the dough, mix wholemeal flour and salt in a bowl. Add cold water and 1 tbsp olive oil, then knead until you get a smooth dough. Roll out the dough to about 3–4 mm thick and cut out 8 circles. Spoon a line of filling into the center of each circle, add a small sprinkle of reduced-fat cheddar, then fold over and crimp the edges with a fork to seal. Place the pasties on a lined baking tray and bake for 20–25 minutes until golden and cooked through. Rest for 5 minutes before serving with any extra tomato-herb sauce from the tray.

title: Chicken & Spinach Pasties with Wholewheat Crust and Creamy Dill Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["250 g plain wheat flour, wholemeal", "100 g butter", "1 piece egg, whole", "60 ml water", "1 tsp fine salt", "1 tsp ground black pepper", "1 tbsp olive oil", "300 g chicken breast, raw", "1 piece onion, yellow", "1 clove garlic", "200 g spinach, fresh", "150 g low-fat natural yogurt", "1 tbsp fresh dill", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "80 g reduced-fat hard cheese, low salt"]
instructions: Mix the wholemeal flour with the salt and black pepper in a bowl. Rub in the butter until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Beat the egg with the water, then add it to the bowl and bring the dough together. Wrap the dough and chill it for 20 minutes. Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the diced onion for 5–6 minutes until soft. Add the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the diced chicken breast and cook for 6–8 minutes until no longer pink. Stir in the spinach and cook for 2–3 minutes until wilted, then remove from the heat and let the filling cool slightly. Stir the yogurt with dill and lemon juice, and fold the cheese into the cooled filling. Roll the dough out on a lightly floured surface to about 3 mm thickness and cut out 4 circles (about 16 cm each). Spoon filling onto one half of each circle, fold over the other half, crimp the edges firmly with a fork, and place the pasties on a parchment-lined tray. Bake at 200°C for 22–26 minutes until golden brown and crisp. Rest the pasties for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Cottage Cheese and Potato Pierogies with Sautéed Cabbage and Dill
ingredients_json: ["300 g potato, peeled", "200 g cottage cheese, low-fat", "1 piece egg, raw", "2 g salt, fine", "150 g plain wheat flour", "60 ml water, lukewarm", "10 ml olive oil", "400 g white cabbage, shredded", "1 piece onion, brown, diced", "2 g garlic, minced", "15 g fresh dill, chopped", "10 g butter, unsalted"]
instructions: Boil the peeled potatoes in salted water until very tender, about 15–18 minutes. Drain well and mash until smooth, then let cool slightly. In a bowl, mix the mashed potato with cottage cheese, the egg, and half of the dill, and season with the remaining salt. To make the dough, combine the flour with the lukewarm water and mix until you get a soft dough, then knead for about 2–3 minutes until smooth. Roll the dough out thinly and cut out circles. Place a spoonful of the filling on each circle, fold over, and press the edges firmly to seal. Bring a large pot of salted water to a gentle simmer and cook the pierogies in batches until they float, then simmer 2 minutes more; remove with a slotted spoon. While they cook, heat the olive oil and butter in a large pan over medium heat, add the onion and sauté for 3–4 minutes, then add the cabbage and cook 8–10 minutes until tender and lightly golden. Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds, then toss the drained pierogies with the cabbage. Finish with fresh dill and serve hot.

title: Whole-Wheat Potato and Cottage Cheese Pierogies with Lemon Dill Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["300 g potato, raw", "250 g cottage cheese, low-fat", "1 piece egg, raw", "180 g plain wheat flour, whole-grain", "60 ml water, tap", "1 g salt, iodized", "1 g black pepper, ground", "15 g olive oil", "1 piece onion, yellow", "10 g fresh dill", "200 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "1 piece lemon, juice", "20 g butter, unsalted"]
instructions: Cook the potatoes in lightly salted water until tender, about 15 minutes, then drain well and mash. Finely chop the onion and sauté it in 10 g olive oil over medium heat until soft and lightly golden, about 6–8 minutes, then cool slightly. Stir the mashed potato, cottage cheese, egg, sautéed onion, half the dill, and black pepper together until evenly combined. Mix the whole-grain flour with 1 g salt and gradually add water while bringing it together into a soft dough; knead for 2–3 minutes, then roll out on a lightly floured surface. Cut out circles, place a spoonful of filling in the center, fold over, and crimp the edges firmly. Bring a pot of salted water to a gentle boil and cook the pierogies in batches until they float, then simmer 2–3 minutes more. Meanwhile, melt the butter with the remaining 5 g olive oil in a large pan and briefly sauté the cooked pierogies over medium-high heat until lightly browned. Serve with a quick sauce of Greek yogurt mixed with lemon juice and the remaining dill.

title: Buckwheat & Potato Pierogies with Caramelized Onions and Light Cabbage Slaw
ingredients_json: ["250 g potato, peeled, raw", "150 g quark, low-fat", "200 g buckwheat flour", "120 ml water", "1 piece egg, whole, raw", "30 g unsalted butter", "1 pc onion, yellow, raw", "300 g white cabbage, shredded", "15 g olive oil", "15 g sour cream, low-fat", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 tsp apple cider vinegar"]
instructions: Boil the peeled potatoes in salted water until very tender, about 15 minutes, then drain and mash until smooth. Let the mash cool for 5 minutes, then stir in the low-fat quark, 1 egg, a pinch of black pepper, and 1 tsp of salt (set filling aside). Mix the buckwheat flour with the remaining salt and gradually add water while bringing it together into a soft dough; knead for about 3 minutes until it’s elastic, then rest the dough 10 minutes. Roll the dough out thinly and cut circles; place a small spoonful of filling in the center, fold over, and crimp the edges firmly. Meanwhile, heat 10 g olive oil and sauté the onion gently until deep golden, then stir in the shredded cabbage, add the apple cider vinegar, and cook until slightly softened but still lively, about 8 minutes. Melt the butter in a large pan, add the pierogies in batches, and cook until golden on both sides, about 3–4 minutes per side. Serve the pierogies with the caramelized cabbage and a spoon of low-fat sour cream.

title: Wholemeal Veggie Pizza with Chicken, Spinach & Mozzarella
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal pizza dough", "150 g passata di pomodoro", "120 g cooked chicken breast, chopped", "150 g bell pepper, sliced", "120 g red onion, sliced", "100 g mushrooms, sliced", "80 g fresh spinach", "20 g olive oil", "180 g mozzarella, part-skim, shredded", "10 g grated Parmesan", "4 g dried oregano", "3 g garlic powder", "2 g fine salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 230°C. Roll out the wholemeal pizza dough on a baking tray lined with baking paper, then spread the passata evenly over the base, leaving a small border. Drizzle the olive oil over the surface and sprinkle over the oregano and garlic powder. Scatter the chicken, bell pepper, red onion and mushrooms over the pizza, then add the spinach in an even layer. Sprinkle over the mozzarella and Parmesan. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the crust is golden and the cheese is bubbling and lightly browned. Let the pizza rest for 2 minutes before slicing so the toppings settle.

title: Wholewheat Veggie Pizza with Mozzarella, Spinach and Roasted Peppers
ingredients_json: ["220 g wholewheat pizza dough", "120 g tomato passata", "2 tsp olive oil", "1 clove garlic, fresh", "150 g mozzarella, part-skim", "120 g roasted red peppers, jarred, drained", "80 g mushrooms, sliced", "70 g spinach, fresh", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp dried chili flakes", "1 tsp salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 240°C with a baking tray inside so the pizza base starts crisping quickly. Roll out the wholewheat dough on a sheet of baking paper and spread the tomato passata over the surface, leaving a small border. Mix the olive oil with the crushed garlic, oregano and chili flakes, then drizzle it over the sauce. Scatter over the sliced mushrooms, add the roasted peppers, and finally tear the mozzarella into pieces and distribute it evenly. Slide the pizza onto the hot tray and bake for 10–12 minutes, until the crust is golden and the cheese is bubbling. Remove from the oven, wilt the spinach over the hot pizza for 1–2 minutes, then slice and serve while hot.

title: Wholemeal Veggie Pizza with Chicken, Mozzarella & Basil
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal pizza dough", "90 g passata", "70 g chicken breast, cooked and shredded", "120 g low-fat mozzarella, shredded", "120 g mushrooms, sliced", "120 g red bell pepper, sliced", "80 g red onion, thinly sliced", "10 g olive oil", "2 g dried oregano", "2 g garlic powder", "3 g salt", "5 g fresh basil, chopped"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 230°C and place a baking tray inside to preheat. Roll out or press the wholemeal pizza dough on a piece of baking paper to a thin round. Spread the passata over the base, then sprinkle over the garlic powder and oregano. Scatter over the mushrooms, bell pepper and red onion, followed by the shredded chicken. Add the shredded mozzarella evenly and drizzle the olive oil over the top. Bake for 12–15 minutes until the crust is browned at the edges and the cheese is bubbling. Remove the pizza, let it rest for 2 minutes, then finish with chopped basil before slicing and serving.

title: Wholewheat Chicken & Veggie Pizza with Mozzarella and Basil
ingredients_json: ["240 g wholewheat pizza dough", "180 g tomato passata", "120 g chicken breast, cooked, diced", "150 g bell pepper, red, sliced", "120 g mushrooms, sliced", "60 g red onion, sliced", "10 g olive oil", "200 g mozzarella cheese, part-skim, grated", "15 g parmesan cheese, grated", "3 g dried oregano", "2 g garlic powder", "1 g fine salt", "2 g black pepper"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 230°C and place a baking tray or pizza stone inside so it gets hot. Roll out or stretch the wholewheat dough into a pizza base and spoon the passata evenly over the surface, leaving a small border for the crust. Drizzle the olive oil over the top and sprinkle with oregano and garlic powder, then add the diced chicken, bell pepper, mushrooms, and red onion. Scatter the mozzarella and parmesan over the toppings, then bake for 12–15 minutes until the crust is browned and the cheese is bubbling. Let the pizza rest for 2 minutes before slicing and serve with freshly ground black pepper.

title: Creamy Parmesan Polenta with Roasted Tomato and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["120 g Polenta (cornmeal), instant", "900 ml Water", "20 g Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, yellow", "2 cloves Garlic", "400 g Canned chopped tomatoes, no added salt", "200 g Spinach, fresh", "120 g Mozzarella, part-skim", "30 g Parmesan cheese, hard", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "2 g Salt"]
instructions: Bring 900 ml water to a steady boil in a saucepan over medium-high heat. Whisk in the polenta gradually so no lumps form, then reduce to low and cook for 3–5 minutes (or until creamy and thick), stirring frequently. Meanwhile, heat 20 g olive oil in a second pan over medium heat, then cook the finely chopped onion for 6–8 minutes until soft and translucent. Stir in the minced garlic and dried oregano for 30 seconds, then add the chopped tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly. Stir the spinach into the tomato sauce and cook for 2–3 minutes until wilted. Fold the mozzarella and Parmesan into the hot polenta, adding 1–2 tablespoons of the tomato sauce if needed for a smoother texture, then season with black pepper and salt. Serve the creamy polenta topped with the roasted tomato and spinach sauce.

title: Creamy Parmesan Polenta with Tomato-Lentil Ragù and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["80 g Polenta (coarse cornmeal)", "1.2 l Water", "30 g Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, yellow, raw", "2 clove Garlic, raw", "200 g Carrot, raw", "200 g Tomato passata", "180 g Lentils, cooked, canned, drained", "120 g Spinach, raw", "25 g Parmesan cheese, hard", "10 g Balsamic vinegar", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Bring the water to a steady simmer in a large saucepan, then gradually whisk in the polenta so it stays smooth. Cook on medium heat for about 20 minutes, stirring frequently, until thick and creamy. Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a separate pan and sauté the finely chopped onion with the grated carrot for 6–8 minutes until softened. Add the garlic for 1 minute, then stir in the tomato passata, balsamic vinegar, salt, and black pepper. Simmer for 8 minutes, then fold in the cooked lentils and cook for another 3 minutes to heat through. Stir the spinach into the ragù just until wilted. Stir the Parmesan into the polenta to make it extra creamy, then spoon the tomato-lentil ragù over the polenta and serve immediately while hot and thick.

title: Creamy Parmesan Polenta with Cherry Tomato & Spinach Chickpea Ragù
ingredients_json: ["90 g instant polenta", "1.6 l vegetable stock, low-salt", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "250 g canned chickpeas, drained and rinsed", "400 g cherry tomatoes", "120 g fresh spinach", "60 g Parmesan cheese, hard", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp ground black pepper", "0.5 tsp fine salt"]
instructions: Bring the low-salt vegetable stock to a steady simmer in a large saucepan. Whisk in the instant polenta slowly to avoid lumps, then reduce the heat to low and cook for about 4–5 minutes, stirring frequently, until thick and creamy. Stir in half of the Parmesan until melted, then cover to keep warm while you make the ragù. Heat the olive oil in a second pan over medium heat, then cook the chopped onion for 5–7 minutes until soft. Add the garlic and oregano and stir for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the cherry tomatoes and cook for 8–10 minutes, crushing some tomatoes with the back of a spoon, until the sauce is glossy. Stir in the chickpeas and simmer for 3–4 minutes, then fold in the spinach until wilted. Season the ragù with black pepper and the fine salt, then serve it over the creamy polenta. Finish with the remaining Parmesan and serve hot.

title: Creamy Parmesan Polenta with Spinach and Lentil Ragù
ingredients_json: ["120 g polenta (cornmeal), instant", "900 ml vegetable stock, low-salt", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion", "2 cloves garlic", "200 g cooked lentils, canned (drained)", "200 g passata (tomato purée)", "150 g baby spinach", "60 g Parmesan cheese", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp balsamic vinegar", "1 g fine salt", "2 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the vegetable stock in a saucepan until it reaches a gentle simmer. Stir the polenta into the hot stock in a steady stream, reduce to low heat, and cook for 2–3 minutes while stirring until it turns thick and creamy. Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a second pan over medium heat and cook the finely chopped onion for 6–8 minutes until soft and translucent. Add the minced garlic and dried oregano and cook for 30 seconds, then stir in the lentils, passata, and balsamic vinegar. Simmer for 6–10 minutes, until the sauce thickens slightly. Stir the spinach into the lentil ragù and cook just until wilted. Off the heat, fold in the Parmesan to the polenta, then season the polenta with black pepper. Serve the creamy polenta topped with the lentil-spinach ragù.

title: Creamy Parmesan Polenta with Turkey Ragù and Roasted Peppers
ingredients_json: ["120 g polenta (coarse cornmeal)", "1.2 l water", "400 g turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "2 medium carrots, raw", "250 g passata di pomodoro", "150 g roasted red peppers (jarred, drained)", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp smoked paprika", "12 g Parmesan cheese, hard", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Bring 1.2 l of water to a steady simmer in a saucepan. Whisk in the polenta slowly and keep stirring continuously for the first few minutes to prevent lumps. Reduce the heat to low and simmer gently for 25–30 minutes, stirring every few minutes until the polenta is thick and creamy. Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a separate pan over medium heat, then add the finely chopped onion and cook for 5–7 minutes until soft. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, followed by the turkey mince; cook until browned and no longer pink. Stir in the grated carrots, passata, roasted red peppers, oregano, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, then simmer for 12–15 minutes until the ragù is thick. Fold the Parmesan into the finished polenta, taste and adjust seasoning with a little more pepper if needed. Serve the creamy polenta topped with the turkey ragù and plenty of the pepper sauce.

title: Pan-Seared Pork Chops with Lemon Herb Sauce and Roasted Brussels Sprouts
ingredients_json: ["500 g pork loin chops, trimmed", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp sea salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "1 tbsp Dijon mustard", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "1 pc lemon, zest and juice", "400 g Brussels sprouts, halved", "1 medium red onion, sliced", "200 g cherry tomatoes", "200 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "10 g fresh parsley, chopped", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain 2%"]
instructions: Pat the pork chops dry, then season them with sea salt and ground black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the pork chops for about 3–4 minutes per side until browned. Lower the heat, stir in the garlic and Dijon mustard, and pour in the chicken stock and lemon juice. Simmer gently for 6–8 minutes, turning once, until the pork is cooked through and juices run clear. While the pork cooks, toss the Brussels sprouts, red onion, and cherry tomatoes with a small amount of the pan liquid, spread them on a baking tray, and roast at 200°C for 20–25 minutes until tender and lightly caramelised. Remove the pork from the pan and stir the Greek yogurt and lemon zest into the pan sauce off the heat, then return briefly to warm through without boiling. Serve the pork chops with the roasted vegetables and spoon over the lemon herb sauce, finishing with chopped parsley.

title: Herb-Dijon Pork Chops with Roasted Sweet Potatoes and Green Beans
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces pork loin chops, bone-in", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 tsp Dijon mustard", "1 tsp dried thyme", "2 cloves garlic, fresh", "1 tsp apple cider vinegar", "400 g sweet potato, peeled and cut into 2 cm cubes", "250 g green beans, trimmed", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "250 ml chicken stock, low salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt, fine"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C. Put the sweet potato cubes on a baking tray, drizzle with half the olive oil, add half the smoked paprika, and roast for 20 minutes until starting to brown and soften. Meanwhile, mix the remaining olive oil with Dijon mustard, dried thyme, minced garlic, apple cider vinegar, black pepper, and a small pinch of the salt. Pat the pork chops dry, rub them with the herb-Dijon mixture, and season with the remaining salt. Add the pork chops to the tray for the last 15 minutes of roasting, then add the green beans with the chicken stock and return to the oven for 8–10 minutes more, until the pork is cooked through and the vegetables are tender. Rest the pork chops for 5 minutes before serving, spooning the tray juices over the meat and vegetables.

title: Herb-Crusted Pork Chops with Roasted Sweet Potato and Green Beans
ingredients_json: ["500 g pork loin chops, boneless, trimmed", "1 tbsp olive oil", "20 g wholegrain mustard", "15 g fresh parsley", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp garlic powder", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "600 g sweet potato, peeled", "400 g green beans, trimmed", "2 dl low-sodium chicken stock", "1 tsp sea salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C. Pat the pork chops dry, then mix the wholegrain mustard with the chopped parsley, thyme, garlic powder, smoked paprika, black pepper, and half of the salt. Rub this herb-mustard mixture evenly over both sides of the pork. Cube the sweet potato into bite-sized pieces, toss with half of the olive oil and the remaining salt, and spread on a baking tray. Roast for 20 minutes, then add the green beans to the tray with the remaining olive oil and continue roasting for 10 minutes until the sweet potato is tender and the edges are lightly browned. While the vegetables roast, pan-sear the pork chops in a hot skillet over medium-high heat for 2–3 minutes per side until nicely browned. Transfer the pork to the baking tray for the last 8–10 minutes of roasting, so it finishes through without drying out. Pour the low-sodium chicken stock into the tray and let it reduce for 2–3 minutes, then rest the pork for 3 minutes before serving, spooning the pan juices over the chops and vegetables.

title: Herb-Mustard Pork Chops with Lemon Roasted Potatoes and Green Beans
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces Pork chops, trimmed, bone-in or boneless", "10 g Olive oil", "10 g Dijon mustard", "8 g Honey", "20 g Lemon juice", "2 g Dried thyme", "2 g Garlic, minced", "900 g Potatoes, baby, halved", "300 g Green beans, trimmed", "2 g Salt, table salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the halved baby potatoes with half of the olive oil, 1 g of salt, and black pepper, then spread them on a baking tray cut-side down. Roast for 20 minutes, until starting to brown. Meanwhile, mix Dijon mustard, honey, lemon juice, thyme, minced garlic, the remaining olive oil, and 1 g of salt into a thick glaze. Pat the pork chops dry, then coat both sides well with the mustard-lemon glaze. After the potatoes have roasted 20 minutes, push them aside on the tray, lay the pork chops among the potatoes, and return to the oven for another 15–18 minutes, until the pork is cooked through and the glaze is bubbling and lightly caramelised. Toss the green beans with a small splash of water and black pepper, then add them to the tray for the final 8–10 minutes, so they stay bright green and tender-crisp. Rest the pork chops for 3–5 minutes before serving, and spoon the pan glaze over the meat and vegetables.

title: Herb and Mustard Pork Chops with Lemon-Glazed Roasted Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["500 g pork loin chops, boneless, trimmed", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 tbsp Dijon mustard", "2 tsp honey", "2 clove garlic", "1 pc lemon, zest and juice", "300 g potatoes, baby, halved", "300 g carrots, sliced", "200 g red onion, wedges", "250 g broccoli florets", "1 tsp dried thyme", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 tsp salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C. In a bowl, mix the olive oil, Dijon mustard, honey, minced garlic, lemon zest and juice, thyme, black pepper, and salt. Rub this mixture all over the pork chops, then set them aside while you prepare the vegetables. Spread the potatoes, carrots, and red onion on a large baking tray and drizzle any remaining mustard mixture over them. Roast for 15 minutes, then add the broccoli florets and return to the oven for 10 minutes. Nestle the pork chops into the roasting tray during the last 15 minutes of cooking, so they can roast alongside the vegetables. Cook until the pork chops are browned and reach an internal temperature of 63°C, about 12–15 minutes more depending on thickness. Let the pork rest for 5 minutes before serving with the roasted vegetables and any pan juices.

title: Oven-Baked Pork Ribs with Honey-Mustard Glaze and Roasted Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["800 g pork ribs, lean, trimmed", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 cl garlic", "200 g red onion", "300 g carrots", "300 g bell pepper", "300 g potatoes, unpeeled", "2 tbsp apple cider vinegar", "2 tbsp Dijon mustard", "1 tbsp honey", "1 tbsp soy sauce (low-salt)", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 g black pepper", "6 g salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Pat the pork ribs dry, then rub them with half the smoked paprika, thyme, black pepper, and half the salt. Heat the olive oil in a small pan over medium heat, then sauté the garlic and sliced red onion for 2–3 minutes until fragrant. Arrange the potatoes, carrots, and bell pepper on a large baking tray, add the onion-garlic mixture, and toss to coat. Place the ribs on top of the vegetables. Mix the apple cider vinegar, Dijon mustard, honey, low-salt soy sauce, and the remaining smoked paprika and salt, then brush about half of the glaze over the ribs. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 60 minutes, then remove the foil and bake for another 25–30 minutes, brushing with the remaining glaze halfway through. The ribs should be tender and browned at the edges, and the vegetables should be cooked through and lightly caramelised.

title: Oven-Baked Honey-Garlic Pork Ribs with Roasted Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["900 g pork ribs, lean loin-style, trimmed", "30 g tomato paste", "15 ml olive oil", "250 ml low-salt chicken stock", "20 g honey", "25 g soy sauce, low-salt", "10 g garlic, minced", "10 g fresh ginger, grated", "10 g smoked paprika", "5 g black pepper", "1 piece red onion", "350 g carrot", "350 g bell pepper", "250 g zucchini", "10 g fresh parsley, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 160°C. Pat the pork ribs dry and place them in a roasting dish. In a bowl, mix the tomato paste, olive oil, chicken stock, honey, low-salt soy sauce, garlic, ginger, smoked paprika, and black pepper, then pour this mixture over the ribs. Cover the dish tightly with foil and bake for 1 hour 15 minutes, until the ribs start to pull away from the bone. Meanwhile, cut the red onion, carrots, bell pepper, and zucchini into bite-size pieces. Remove the foil, add the vegetables to the roasting dish around the ribs, and continue baking uncovered for 25–30 minutes until the ribs are tender and the glaze looks sticky and lightly browned. Sprinkle with chopped parsley and rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Oven-Baked Pork Ribs with Smoky Tomato-Spice Glaze and Roasted Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["800 g Pork ribs, lean and trimmed", "500 g Red bell pepper", "500 g Zucchini", "250 g Red onion", "250 ml Tomato passata", "80 g Honey", "20 g Apple cider vinegar", "10 g Smoked paprika", "5 g Garlic powder", "3 g Black pepper, ground", "2 g Sea salt", "10 ml Olive oil"]
instructions: Heat your oven to 180°C. Cut the bell pepper, zucchini, and red onion into bite-size pieces and spread them on a large baking tray. Drizzle with the olive oil and toss so the vegetables are lightly coated. Place the pork ribs on the tray and season with the salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, and garlic powder. In a bowl, mix the tomato passata with honey and apple cider vinegar until smooth, then brush about half of the glaze over the ribs. Roast for 35 minutes, then turn the ribs over, brush with the remaining glaze, and roast for another 25–30 minutes until the ribs are tender and the glaze is sticky and slightly caramelised. Serve hot straight from the oven with the roasted vegetables.

title: Slow-Braised Pork Shoulder with Apple Cider, Mustard and Roasted Root Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["1.2 kg pork shoulder, boneless", "20 g olive oil", "2 medium onion", "3 cloves garlic", "250 ml apple cider vinegar", "500 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "250 g carrots", "300 g parsnips", "400 g potatoes", "20 g Dijon mustard", "15 g fresh thyme", "10 g salt", "5 g black pepper"]
instructions: Pat the pork shoulder dry and season it all over with salt and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large heavy pot over medium-high heat, then brown the meat on all sides until deeply golden, about 8–10 minutes total. Reduce the heat to medium, add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes, then stir in the minced garlic for 30 seconds. Pour in the apple cider vinegar and let it bubble for 2 minutes to reduce slightly, then add the chicken stock, Dijon mustard, and thyme. Return the pork to the pot, bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook on low for 2 hours. Add the carrots, parsnips, and potatoes (cut into even bite-size pieces so they cook consistently), then cook covered until the vegetables are tender and the pork pulls apart easily, about 45–60 minutes more. If the sauce is too thin, uncover for the last 10 minutes to thicken; if it’s too thick, add a splash of stock or water. Rest the meat 10 minutes before shredding and serving with the vegetables and braising sauce.

title: Slow-Braised Pork Shoulder with Cabbage, Apples and Caraway
ingredients_json: ["900 g pork shoulder, boneless", "30 g olive oil", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "700 g red cabbage, shredded", "2 piece apple, tart (e.g., Granny Smith)", "400 ml vegetable stock, low-salt", "250 ml apple cider vinegar", "10 g caraway seeds", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1.5 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper"]
instructions: Pat the pork shoulder dry and season it with the smoked paprika, black pepper and half of the salt. Heat the olive oil in a large heavy pot over medium-high heat. Sear the pork on all sides until deeply browned, about 6–8 minutes total, then remove it to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and sauté the chopped onion for 4–5 minutes until soft. Add the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring to prevent burning. Return the pork to the pot, add the vegetable stock and apple cider vinegar, and sprinkle in the caraway seeds. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and braise at a low simmer for 75 minutes, turning the meat once halfway through. Meanwhile, core and dice the apples and shred the cabbage. After 75 minutes, add the cabbage and apples, stir well, and season with the remaining salt. Braise uncovered for another 25–30 minutes until the cabbage is tender and the pork pulls apart easily, then rest the meat in the pot for 5 minutes before serving with the braising juices.

title: Braised Pork Shoulder with Tomato, White Beans and Rosemary
ingredients_json: ["800 g pork shoulder, boneless", "15 g olive oil", "150 g onion, white", "2 cloves garlic", "300 g carrots", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes", "250 g canned cannellini beans, drained", "600 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "30 g tomato paste", "10 g fresh rosemary", "2 g fine salt", "2 g black pepper", "10 g apple cider vinegar"]
instructions: Pat the pork shoulder dry with kitchen paper, then season it all over with half the salt and all the black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork on all sides, about 8–10 minutes total, until you have deep golden color. Reduce the heat to medium, add the onion and carrots, and cook for 6–8 minutes until the vegetables soften. Stir in the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then pour in the chopped tomatoes, chicken stock, apple cider vinegar, and add the rosemary. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and braise in the oven at 160°C for 2 hours. Add the drained beans, then simmer uncovered on the stove for 20–25 minutes until the sauce thickens and the pork is very tender and shreds easily. Taste and adjust salt before serving, making sure there’s no excess watery liquid in the bottom of the pot.

title: Slow-Braised Pork Shoulder with Cider, Thyme & Root Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["1.2 kg pork shoulder, boneless", "200 ml apple cider", "300 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 medium onions, raw", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "2 medium carrots, raw", "250 g parsnips, raw", "150 g celeriac, raw", "20 g fresh thyme", "2 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp ground black pepper", "1.5 tsp sea salt", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "1 tbsp apple cider vinegar"]
instructions: Pat the pork shoulder dry and season it all over with the sea salt, smoked paprika, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a heavy oven-safe pot over medium-high heat, then brown the pork on all sides until deeply golden, about 8–10 minutes total. Remove the pork and lower the heat; add the sliced onions and cook for 4–5 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic for 30 seconds. Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then pour in the apple cider and scrape up any browned bits. Return the pork to the pot and add the chicken stock, thyme, carrots, parsnips, and celeriac. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover with a lid, and cook in the oven at 160°C for 2 hours 15 minutes, until the pork is very tender and easily pulls apart. Uncover the pot for the final 20 minutes to thicken the sauce, then stir in the apple cider vinegar. Let it rest for 10 minutes before serving with the braised vegetables and spooning over the reduced cider sauce.

title: Herb-Roasted Pork Tenderloin with Lemon-Garlic Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["450 g pork tenderloin", "300 g zucchini", "250 g bell pepper, red", "220 g cherry tomatoes", "1 medium lemon, zest and juice", "2 tbsp olive oil", "3 cloves garlic, minced", "2 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "200 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "1 tsp Dijon mustard", "1 g black pepper", "3 g fine salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C. Cut the zucchini and bell pepper into bite-size pieces and place them on a baking tray with the cherry tomatoes. Drizzle with 1 tbsp olive oil, add half the minced garlic, half the oregano, smoked paprika, and half the lemon juice, then toss to coat and roast for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, trim the pork tenderloin and pat it dry. Rub the pork with the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil, the remaining garlic, the remaining oregano, the lemon zest, Dijon mustard, black pepper, and the salt. Add the pork to the tray after the vegetables have roasted, then pour over the chicken stock and return to the oven for 15–18 minutes, until the pork is cooked through and reaches about 63°C in the center. Remove the tray from the oven and rest the pork for 5 minutes before slicing. Spoon the lemon-garlic pan juices over the sliced pork and serve with the roasted vegetables and any juices remaining on the tray.

title: Herb-Mustard Pork Tenderloin with Lemon-Garlic Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["450 g pork tenderloin", "200 g broccoli", "200 g carrot", "250 g zucchini", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tbsp Dijon mustard", "1 tbsp honey", "1 tsp dried thyme", "2 cloves garlic", "1 lemon, zest and juice", "1 g black pepper", "3 g sea salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. Cut the carrot and zucchini into bite-sized pieces and break the broccoli into small florets. Toss the vegetables with the olive oil, half the lemon juice, half the lemon zest, half the dried thyme, and 1 g black pepper. Place the vegetables on a baking tray and roast for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, mix the Dijon mustard, honey, remaining lemon juice and zest, remaining thyme, minced garlic, and sea salt to make a thick glaze. Pat the pork tenderloin dry, then coat it evenly with the mustard-honey glaze. Push the vegetables to one side of the tray, lay the pork next to them, and roast for another 15–18 minutes, until the pork is cooked through and the glaze is caramelized and bubbling. Rest the pork for 5 minutes before slicing, then serve with the roasted vegetables and any pan juices.

title: Herb-Roasted Pork Tenderloin with Lemon-Garlic Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["520 g pork tenderloin", "1 tbsp olive oil", "20 g Dijon mustard", "2 cloves garlic", "1 pc lemon", "1 tsp dried oregano", "500 g mixed vegetables (broccoli and carrots), cut", "150 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "1 tsp honey", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C. Pat the pork tenderloin dry and rub it with the olive oil, Dijon mustard, grated garlic, zest and juice from the lemon, dried oregano, honey, and black pepper. Place the mixed vegetables on a sheet pan, pour over the chicken stock, then nestle the pork on top of the vegetables. Roast for 18–22 minutes until the pork reaches 63°C in the thickest part and the vegetables are tender and lightly browned. Rest the pork for 5 minutes, then slice and serve with the roasted vegetables and pan juices.

title: Herb & Lemon Pork Tenderloin with Roasted Brussels Sprouts and Sweet Potato
ingredients_json: ["450 g pork tenderloin", "300 g sweet potato, peeled and cubed", "250 g Brussels sprouts, halved", "200 g red onion, sliced", "20 g olive oil", "15 g lemon juice", "10 g lemon zest", "2 g garlic, minced", "4 g fresh thyme, leaves", "2 g fresh rosemary, leaves", "4 g Dijon mustard", "3 g fine salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the sweet potato cubes, Brussels sprouts, and red onion with 10 g of olive oil, half of the thyme and rosemary, 1 g of salt, and black pepper, then spread everything on a baking tray and roast for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, mix the remaining 10 g olive oil, lemon juice, lemon zest, minced garlic, Dijon mustard, the rest of the herbs, and 2 g of salt. Pat the pork tenderloin dry, brush it generously with the lemon-herb mixture, and place it on the same tray after the vegetables have had their first roast. Roast for another 15–20 minutes, until the pork is cooked through and reaches about 63°C in the thickest part; the vegetables should be tender with browned edges. Let the pork rest for 5 minutes, then slice and serve with the roasted vegetables and any pan juices.

title: Herb-Roasted Pork Tenderloin with Lemon-Garlic Vegetables and Quinoa
ingredients_json: ["450 g pork tenderloin", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 cloves garlic", "1 lemon zest", "1 lemon juice", "15 g fresh parsley", "300 g bell pepper", "250 g zucchini", "200 g cherry tomatoes", "200 g quinoa, dry", "450 ml water", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. Pat the pork tenderloin dry and rub it with olive oil, minced garlic, lemon zest, lemon juice, dried oregano, black pepper, and half of the chopped parsley. Place the pork on a baking tray and roast for 18 minutes, until the internal temperature reaches about 63–65°C (it will keep cooking while resting). Meanwhile, rinse the quinoa, then bring 450 ml water to a boil with the salt. Stir in the quinoa, reduce to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes, then turn off the heat and let it stand for 5 minutes; fluff with a fork. On a second tray or in the same oven if space allows, toss bell pepper, zucchini, and cherry tomatoes with a small splash of lemon juice and the remaining parsley, then roast for 15–18 minutes until tender and lightly browned. Rest the pork for 5 minutes, slice it, and serve with the quinoa and roasted vegetables, spooning over any tray juices.

title: Chicken & Leek Pot Pies with Wholegrain Crust
ingredients_json: ["500 g chicken breast, raw", "300 g leeks, sliced", "200 g carrots, diced", "150 g celery sticks, diced", "200 g mushrooms, sliced", "1500 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "150 g plain Greek yogurt, 2% fat", "40 g olive oil", "60 g wholemeal wheat flour", "30 g butter, unsalted", "10 g fresh thyme, leaves", "5 g garlic, fresh, minced", "8 g salt, table", "2 g black pepper, ground", "1 pinch nutmeg, ground"]
instructions: Pat the chicken dry, then dice it into bite-sized pieces. Heat 2 tbsp of the olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring until it’s lightly golden and no longer pink. Transfer the chicken to a bowl, then add the remaining olive oil and the leeks, carrots, celery, and mushrooms to the pot. Cook for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables soften and the leeks look translucent. Stir in the garlic and thyme for 30 seconds, then sprinkle over the wholemeal flour and cook for 1 minute to remove the raw flour taste. Return the chicken to the pot, pour in the chicken stock, and bring to a gentle simmer. Cook for 15 to 18 minutes, until the filling thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. Turn off the heat and stir in the Greek yogurt for a creamy finish; taste and adjust pepper. Preheat the oven to 200°C. Spoon the hot filling into 4 oven-safe pie dishes. Roll out the crust from wholemeal wheat flour dough if desired, or cover with prepared wholegrain pastry; bake for 18 to 22 minutes until the crust is golden and crisp. Rest for 5 minutes before serving so the filling sets.

title: Turkey and Leek Pot Pies with Wholegrain Herb Pastry
ingredients_json: ["500 g turkey mince, lean", "250 g leeks, sliced", "200 g carrots, diced", "150 g celery, diced", "300 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "150 ml semi-skimmed milk", "30 g plain wheat flour", "20 g olive oil", "10 g fresh thyme, leaves", "5 g dried sage", "3 g black pepper, ground", "2 g fine salt", "180 g wholewheat puff pastry, uncooked", "1 piece egg, raw"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the leeks, carrots, and celery and cook for about 6 minutes until the vegetables start to soften and turn glossy. Stir in the turkey mince and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until no pink remains. Sprinkle over the flour, cook for 1 minute to remove the raw flour taste, then gradually whisk in the chicken stock and semi-skimmed milk. Simmer on low for 10 minutes until the mixture thickens to a spoonable consistency, then season with thyme, sage, black pepper, and salt. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 200°C and lightly grease 4 individual pie dishes. Roll out the wholewheat puff pastry and cut 4 rounds to fit the tops. Divide the turkey filling among the dishes, place pastry on top, and brush with beaten egg. Bake for 18 to 22 minutes until the pastry is deep golden and puffed, and serve hot.

title: Chicken and Leek Pot Pies with Wholegrain Herb Crust
ingredients_json: ["500 g chicken breast, raw", "300 g leek, sliced", "200 g carrots, diced", "200 g celery, diced", "250 g potatoes, peeled and diced", "50 g wholegrain wheat flour", "500 ml semi-skimmed milk", "300 ml chicken stock, low salt", "200 g frozen peas", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp dried parsley", "1 tsp black pepper", "5 g salt", "20 g butter", "1 egg, raw"]
instructions:
Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat, then sauté the leek, carrots and celery for 6–8 minutes until softened. Add the chicken and cook for about 6 minutes, stirring until the chicken is mostly opaque. Stir in the wholegrain flour and cook for 1 minute to remove any raw flour taste. Pour in the milk and low-salt chicken stock gradually, stirring constantly until the mixture thickens and looks smooth. Add the potatoes, thyme, parsley and black pepper, then simmer gently for 15–18 minutes until the potatoes are tender. Stir in the frozen peas for the final 3 minutes.

Heat the oven to 200°C. For a simple crust, whisk the egg with the melted butter, then mix it into the remaining wholegrain flour set aside from the dough portion if desired; otherwise, reserve 2 tbsp of the cooked filling to loosen and use the egg-butter glaze to create a thin top crust in ramekins. Spoon the hot filling into 4 ovenproof ramekins. Bake for 18–22 minutes until bubbling around the edges and lightly golden on top. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Turkey & Leek Pot Pies with Wholemeal Herb Pastry
ingredients_json: ["350 g turkey mince, 5% fat", "200 g leek, sliced", "150 g carrots, diced", "120 g celery, diced", "300 g potatoes, diced", "500 ml low-salt chicken stock", "200 g frozen peas", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 tbsp plain flour", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp dried rosemary", "0.5 tsp ground black pepper", "10 g sea salt", "200 g wholemeal wheat flour", "120 g cold unsalted butter", "1 egg, raw", "60 ml water"]
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the turkey mince and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring until browned. Tip in the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil, leek, carrots, and celery, then cook for 5 minutes until softened. Stir in the flour and tomato paste, then add the thyme and rosemary. Gradually pour in the chicken stock while stirring, followed by the potatoes. Simmer on low for 15–18 minutes, until the potatoes are tender and the mixture has thickened. Stir in the peas and cook for 2 minutes, then season with black pepper. Preheat the oven to 200°C. To make the pastry, rub cold butter into the wholemeal flour until it looks like fine crumbs. Beat the egg with the water, then bring the pastry together and roll it out to about 3 mm thick. Spoon the hot filling into 4 pie dishes and cover with pastry lids, crimping the edges. Cut a small steam vent in the top of each pie. Bake for 25–30 minutes until the pastry is golden and crisp. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Herb & Garlic Vegetable Pot Roast with Lean Beef and Root Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["700 g beef chuck roast, trimmed", "15 g olive oil", "1.5 medium yellow onion, chopped", "3 cloves garlic, minced", "2 medium carrots, sliced", "250 g parsnips, sliced", "300 g potatoes, diced", "250 g celery stalk, sliced", "500 ml beef stock, low sodium", "200 g crushed tomatoes, no added salt", "20 g tomato paste", "10 g fresh rosemary, chopped", "10 g fresh thyme, chopped", "5 g black pepper, ground", "4 g fine salt"]
instructions: Pat the beef chuck roast dry with paper towels and season it all over with the salt and half the black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large heavy pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat, then sear the roast on all sides until well browned, about 8–10 minutes total. Remove the beef to a plate. Lower the heat to medium and add the onion and celery, cooking for 4–5 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the carrots and parsnips and cook for 3–4 minutes. Return the beef to the pot and add the beef stock, crushed tomatoes, and tomato paste, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom. Add the rosemary and thyme, then bring everything to a gentle simmer. Cover and cook on low for 1 hour. Add the potatoes, re-cover, and continue cooking on low for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until the beef is very tender and the potatoes are soft. If the sauce is too thin, uncover and simmer for 8–10 minutes; if it’s too thick, add a splash of water or stock. Taste and adjust seasoning with the remaining black pepper before serving.

title: Herb-Glazed Lean Beef Pot Roast with Carrots, Celery & Pearl Onions
ingredients_json: ["750 g beef chuck roast, trimmed", "30 ml olive oil", "200 g onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic", "250 ml beef stock, low-salt", "150 ml water", "500 g carrots", "200 g celery sticks", "200 g pearl onions, frozen or fresh", "20 g tomato paste", "1 tsp dried thyme", "2 tsp dried rosemary", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "10 g sea salt"]
instructions: Pat the beef chuck roast dry and season it evenly with salt, black pepper, thyme, and rosemary. Heat the olive oil in a heavy pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat and sear the beef on all sides until well browned, about 8–10 minutes total. Remove the beef and lower the heat to medium. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes, stirring, then add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute to deepen the flavour. Return the beef to the pot, add the beef stock and water, then bring to a gentle simmer. Add the carrots, celery, and pearl onions, ensuring the vegetables are mostly covered by the cooking liquid. Cover and braise in the oven at 160°C for 2 hours, then remove the lid and braise for another 20 minutes to thicken slightly. The roast is ready when the beef is fork-tender and the carrots are soft; if the liquid looks too thin, simmer uncovered for 5–10 minutes on the stovetop. Rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serve with the vegetables and braising juices.

title: Creamy Leek and Potato Soup with White Beans and Dill
ingredients_json: ["600 g potatoes, peeled and diced", "150 g leek, sliced (white and light green parts)", "120 g carrots, diced", "80 g celery, diced", "400 g cannellini beans, cooked, drained and rinsed", "1.5 l vegetable stock, low-salt", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "200 ml oat cream, unsweetened", "10 g fresh dill, chopped", "5 g salt, reduced", "2 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the leek, carrots, and celery and cook for 8–10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables soften. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the diced potatoes and the low-salt vegetable stock. Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook for 15–20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender. Stir in the cannellini beans and simmer for 5 minutes to warm through. Blend about half of the soup until smooth, then mix it back into the pot for a creamy texture. Reduce the heat to low and stir in the oat cream, black pepper, and chopped dill. Taste and adjust seasoning, then serve hot.

title: Creamy Leek & Potato Soup with White Beans and Dill
ingredients_json: ["500 g potatoes, peeled and diced", "220 g leeks, sliced", "120 g carrots, diced", "60 g celery, diced", "400 g canned white beans, drained and rinsed", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1200 ml vegetable stock", "200 ml milk, semi-skimmed (2%)", "1 clove garlic, crushed", "10 g fresh dill, chopped", "5 g salt", "2 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the leeks, carrots, and celery, and cook for 8–10 minutes until the vegetables soften and the leeks turn translucent. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the diced potatoes and vegetable stock, bring to a gentle boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook for 15–20 minutes until the potatoes are tender. Add the white beans and simmer for 5 minutes. Use a blender to partially blend the soup until it is creamy but still slightly chunky. Stir in the semi-skimmed milk and dill, then season with salt and black pepper. Warm through for 2–3 minutes, taste, and serve hot.

title: Herb-Crusted Prime Rib with Roasted Garlic Potatoes and Green Beans
ingredients_json: ["1.2 kg beef prime rib roast, trimmed, boneless", "25 g olive oil", "12 g fine sea salt", "5 g black pepper, ground", "8 g fresh rosemary, minced", "10 g garlic, minced", "10 g Dijon mustard", "1.6 kg potatoes, baby potatoes", "20 ml olive oil", "6 g dried thyme", "1.2 kg green beans, trimmed", "10 ml lemon juice", "3 g lemon zest"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C. Pat the prime rib roast dry and rub it all over with olive oil, sea salt, black pepper, rosemary, minced garlic, and Dijon mustard. Place the roast on a rack in a roasting tray and roast at 220°C for 20 minutes to brown the surface, then reduce the oven to 160°C and continue roasting until the center reaches 52–54°C for medium-rare. Remove the roast and rest it loosely covered for 20 minutes while you finish the sides. Toss the baby potatoes with olive oil, dried thyme, and a small amount of salt and pepper, then roast them in the same oven during the roast time for about 35–45 minutes, turning once, until deeply golden and tender. Steam or sauté the green beans until crisp-tender, then toss with lemon juice and lemon zest and a little black pepper. Slice the prime rib against the grain and serve with the roasted potatoes and lemony green beans.

title: Herb-Roasted Prime Rib with Garlic, Lemon, and Roasted Asparagus
ingredients_json: ["1.0 kg prime rib roast (beef rib, bone-in), trimmed", "30 g olive oil", "12 g kosher salt", "4 g black pepper, ground", "8 g garlic, fresh, minced", "10 g fresh rosemary, chopped", "8 g fresh thyme, chopped", "20 ml lemon juice", "1.0 kg potatoes, baby, halved", "500 g asparagus, trimmed", "200 ml beef stock, low-salt", "15 g Dijon mustard"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 180°C (conventional). Pat the prime rib dry, then rub it all over with olive oil, salt, black pepper, minced garlic, rosemary, thyme, and lemon juice. Place the roast on a rack in a roasting tray and roast for 60 minutes, until the surface is deeply browned. Reduce the oven to 160°C, add the beef stock to the tray, and continue roasting for 25–40 minutes, depending on the roast size, until a meat thermometer reads 50–55°C in the thickest part for medium-rare. While the beef roasts, toss the halved baby potatoes with a little olive oil, salt, and pepper, then roast them on a baking tray at 200°C for about 35–40 minutes until crisp and golden. In the last 10 minutes of the potato roasting, place the asparagus on a second tray, toss with a little olive oil, salt, and pepper, and roast until just tender and bright green. Mix Dijon mustard with 2–3 tbsp of the roasting juices from the tray, then rest the prime rib loosely covered for 20 minutes before slicing. Serve the sliced prime rib with the roasted potatoes and asparagus, spooning over the pan juices and Dijon-lemon mixture.

title: Herb-Crusted Prime Rib with Roasted Garlic Potatoes and Sautéed Greens
ingredients_json: ["1.1 kg beef prime rib roast, bone-in", "2 tbsp olive oil", "20 g fresh rosemary", "12 g fresh thyme", "6 g garlic", "12 g kosher salt", "4 g black pepper", "800 g potatoes, baby", "250 g shallots", "300 g mixed green beans", "150 g spinach", "30 ml balsamic vinegar"]
instructions: Pat the prime rib roast dry with paper towels. Mix olive oil, finely chopped rosemary and thyme, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper into a paste, then rub it evenly over the roast. Preheat the oven to 220°C. Place the roast on a rack in a roasting tray and roast for 25 minutes, until the surface is well browned. Reduce the oven temperature to 160°C and continue roasting for about 75–105 minutes, checking the internal temperature with a probe; pull the roast when it reaches 52–54°C in the thickest part for medium-rare. While the roast cooks, halve the baby potatoes and toss them with 1 tbsp of the pan oil if there is any, then roast them at 200°C with sliced shallots for 35–45 minutes until golden and tender. In the last 10 minutes, sauté the green beans in a hot pan until blistered and crisp-tender, then add spinach to wilt for about 2 minutes. Let the prime rib rest for 20 minutes loosely tented with foil before slicing. Serve the slices with the roasted potatoes and shallots, and drizzle the greens with balsamic vinegar.

title: Smoky Chipotle Pulled Pork with Roasted Sweet Potato and Corn Slaw
ingredients_json: ["900 g pork shoulder, boneless", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "1 dl apple cider vinegar", "1 tbsp smoked paprika", "2 tsp ground cumin", "2 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp chipotle powder", "3 cloves garlic, minced", "1 pc onion, yellow, diced", "200 g passata (tomato sauce)", "150 g low-sodium chicken stock", "450 g sweet potato, peeled and cubed", "250 g red cabbage, shredded", "200 g corn kernels, canned, drained", "1 pc lime, juice only", "25 g Greek yogurt, plain 2%"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 160°C. Pat the pork shoulder dry, then rub it all over with smoked paprika, ground cumin, dried oregano, chipotle powder, and a little salt and black pepper. Heat olive oil in a large oven-safe pot over medium-high heat and sear the pork on all sides until browned, about 6–8 minutes. Remove the pork and sauté the onion and garlic for 3–4 minutes. Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then add passata, apple cider vinegar, and chicken stock. Return the pork to the pot, cover with a lid, and roast in the oven for 3 hours, until very tender and easily pulled apart with a fork. While the pork cooks, toss the cubed sweet potato with a little oil, spread on a baking tray, and roast for 25–30 minutes at 220°C until browned and soft. For the corn slaw, mix shredded red cabbage and corn with lime juice. When the pork is ready, shred it into pulled pieces, return it to the sauce, and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes so the sauce reduces and clings to the meat. Serve the pulled pork with roasted sweet potato and the corn slaw, and finish with a spoon of Greek yogurt on top.

title: Smoky Chipotle Pulled Pork with Apple Slaw
ingredients_json: ["800 g pork shoulder, boneless", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 large onion", "3 clove garlic", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "150 g apple cider vinegar", "200 ml water", "30 g brown sugar", "2 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp ground cumin", "2 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp ground black pepper", "1 tsp fine salt", "1 pc lime", "2 g chipotle chili powder", "400 g savoy cabbage", "150 g apple", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2%", "1 tsp Dijon mustard", "1 tsp honey"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large heavy pot over medium-high heat. Season the pork shoulder with the salt, then sear it on all sides until browned, about 6–8 minutes total. Reduce the heat to medium and add the onion; cook for 5 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic, tomato paste, smoked paprika, cumin, oregano, black pepper, and chipotle chili powder and cook for 1 minute to bloom the spices. Pour in the apple cider vinegar and water, add the brown sugar, squeeze in the lime juice, and bring to a gentle simmer. Cover with a lid and cook on low heat until the pork is extremely tender and easily pulls apart, about 2 hours, stirring every 30 minutes so it stays moist. Meanwhile, shred the savoy cabbage finely and grate the apple. Stir together Greek yogurt, Dijon mustard, honey, and a little lime juice, then toss the cabbage and apple with the dressing and chill until ready. Once the pork is done, remove it from the pot and shred it with two forks. Return the shredded pork to the sauce and simmer uncovered for 10–15 minutes to thicken slightly. Serve the pulled pork with the apple slaw on the side, spooning some of the smoky sauce over the meat.

title: Smoky Honey-Garlic Pulled Pork with Roasted Sweet Potato and Coleslaw
ingredients_json: ["1.2 kg pork shoulder, boneless, trimmed", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 tbsp smoked paprika", "2 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "1.5 tsp fine salt", "3 cloves garlic, fresh", "200 g onion", "250 ml tomato passata", "150 ml apple cider vinegar", "1 tbsp honey", "100 g carrot", "1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce", "800 g sweet potatoes", "1 tbsp olive oil", "300 g white cabbage, shredded", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain 2%", "1 tbsp Dijon mustard", "1 tbsp apple cider vinegar", "1 tbsp lime juice"]
instructions: Pat the pork shoulder dry and rub it all over with olive oil, smoked paprika, cumin, dried thyme, black pepper, and 1.5 tsp of fine salt. Heat a heavy pot or deep roasting pan over medium-high heat and brown the pork on all sides, about 8–10 minutes total. Remove the pork and sauté the onion and carrot in the same pot until soft and lightly golden, 5–6 minutes. Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds, then add tomato passata, apple cider vinegar, honey, and Worcestershire sauce. Return the pork, bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook in the oven at 150°C for 3 hours, turning the meat once halfway through, until very tender. For the sweet potatoes, heat the oven to 220°C, cube the sweet potatoes, toss with 1 tbsp olive oil and a little salt, and roast for 25–30 minutes until browned at the edges and tender through. To make the yogurt coleslaw, mix shredded cabbage with Greek yogurt, Dijon mustard, 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar, and lime juice, and season with a little black pepper. When the pork is tender, shred it with two forks directly in the pot, stir to coat with the smoky sauce, and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes to thicken slightly. Serve the pulled pork with roasted sweet potatoes and the yogurt coleslaw.

title: Smoky Pulled Pork with Apple Slaw and Wholegrain Buns
ingredients_json: ["900 g pork shoulder, boneless", "20 g smoked paprika", "10 g ground cumin", "6 g garlic powder", "5 g dried oregano", "8 g fine salt", "4 g black pepper", "250 ml apple cider vinegar", "150 ml apple juice", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "1 pc onion", "2 pc carrots", "1 pc apple", "250 g white cabbage", "120 g low-fat Greek yogurt, plain", "1 tbsp olive oil", "4 tbsp water", "4 pc wholegrain burger buns"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160°C. Pat the pork shoulder dry and rub it all over with smoked paprika, cumin, garlic powder, oregano, salt, and black pepper. Chop the onion and carrots, then place them in a roasting dish with the apple cider vinegar and apple juice, and stir in the tomato paste and 4 tbsp water until smooth. Nestle the pork into the liquid, cover tightly with a lid or foil, and roast for 3 hours, until the meat is very tender and pulls apart easily. Remove the lid and cook for a further 30 minutes so the juices reduce slightly and the outside gets a little more colour. While the pork cooks, make the apple slaw: finely shred the cabbage and grate the apple, then mix with low-fat Greek yogurt and a drizzle of olive oil until glossy and creamy. When the pork is ready, transfer it to a bowl and shred with two forks, then mix it back into the reduced cooking juices to keep it moist. Serve the pulled pork in wholegrain burger buns and top with the apple slaw.

title: Smoky Apple-Cider Pulled Pork with Wholegrain Slaw
ingredients_json: ["1.2 kg pork shoulder, boneless", "30 g onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic", "200 ml apple cider vinegar", "150 g ketchup, no added sugar", "1 tbsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "1.5 tsp fine salt", "500 g red cabbage, shredded", "250 g carrot, grated", "10 g fresh ginger, grated", "20 ml olive oil", "60 ml water"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160°C. Pat the pork shoulder dry and rub it with the smoked paprika, ground cumin, dried oregano, black pepper, and 1.5 tsp of the fine salt. Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat, then brown the pork on all sides until well caramelized, about 8–10 minutes total. Add the onion and cook for 3 minutes, then stir in the garlic and grated ginger for 30 seconds. Pour in the apple cider vinegar, add the ketchup and water, and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer. Cover tightly with a lid or foil and braise in the oven for 3 hours, until the pork is very tender and can be pulled apart easily with a fork. While the pork cooks, mix the shredded red cabbage and grated carrot in a bowl. When the pork is done, remove it from the braising liquid and pull it into strands using two forks, discarding any large pieces of fat. Return the pulled pork to the liquid to keep it moist, then pile it over the slaw. Spoon a little extra hot braising sauce over the top and serve immediately.

title: Chicken & Spinach Quesadillas with Black Beans and Lime Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["2 tbsp Olive oil", "300 g Chicken breast, raw", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "2 tsp Smoked paprika", "1/2 tsp Garlic powder", "250 g Spinach, fresh", "200 g Black beans, cooked and drained", "1/2 red bell pepper", "1 small onion", "1 tbsp Lime juice", "1/2 tsp Salt", "250 g Reduced-fat grated cheese", "6 piece Whole wheat tortillas (medium)", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "1 clove Garlic", "1 tsp Fresh coriander, chopped"]
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large nonstick pan over medium-high heat. Add the sliced onion and bell pepper and cook for 3 minutes until softened. Add the chicken breast cut into small pieces, cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and the salt, then stir-fry for 6–8 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and no longer pink. Add the spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes until wilted, then stir in the black beans and lime juice. Meanwhile, mix the Greek yogurt with finely grated garlic and chopped coriander. Wipe the pan lightly, warm the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil over medium heat, and lay down one tortilla. Sprinkle a generous amount of reduced-fat cheese over half the tortilla, add a few spoonfuls of the chicken-bean filling, fold the tortilla in half, and cook for 2–3 minutes per side until golden and crisp and the cheese has melted. Repeat with the remaining tortillas, then serve immediately with the lime yogurt sauce.

title: Chicken, Spinach & Black Bean Quesadillas with Lime-Yogurt Salsa
ingredients_json: ["2 tbsp Olive oil", "250 g Chicken breast, raw, diced", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "1 tsp Garlic powder", "200 g Black beans, cooked, drained", "150 g Spinach, fresh", "1 red bell pepper, raw, diced", "1 pc Onion, raw, chopped", "200 g Low-fat plain yogurt", "1 pc Lime, zest and juice", "1 tbsp Fresh coriander (cilantro), chopped", "4 pc Whole wheat tortillas, medium", "120 g Reduced-fat cheese, cheddar, grated", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions:
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large nonstick pan over medium-high heat. Add the diced chicken, cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, half the salt and black pepper, then stir-fry for 6–8 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and lightly browned. Add the onion and bell pepper and cook for 3–4 minutes, stirring, until softened. Stir in the black beans and spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes until the spinach wilts and everything is hot and cohesive.
In a bowl, mix the yogurt with lime zest and juice and chopped coriander, then add a little of the remaining salt to taste.
Wipe the pan and return it to medium heat. Brush both sides of each tortilla lightly with a little remaining olive oil. Sprinkle a quarter of the grated cheese over half of a tortilla, add a generous spoonful of the chicken-bean filling, then fold over. Cook 2–3 minutes per side until the tortillas are golden and the cheese has melted. Repeat with the remaining tortillas. Serve the quesadillas warm with the lime-yogurt salsa on the side.

title: Chicken and Black Bean Quesadillas with Peppers and Lime Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["2 medium wholemeal tortillas, 50 g each", "220 g chicken breast, raw, skinless", "120 g black beans, cooked and drained", "180 g bell pepper, mixed colors, chopped", "80 g red onion, chopped", "10 ml olive oil", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp garlic powder", "0.5 tsp chili powder", "120 g reduced-fat cheese, shredded", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2% fat", "10 ml lime juice", "1 g salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken breast pieces and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until no longer pink and lightly browned. Add the onion and bell pepper and cook for another 4–5 minutes until softened. Stir in cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and chili powder, then add the black beans and cook for 2 minutes so everything is well coated and hot.
