Spread some of the reduced-fat cheese over one half of each tortilla, then spoon the chicken-bean-pepper mixture on top and fold the tortillas in half. Cook in the same pan over medium heat for 2–3 minutes per side until the tortillas are crisp and the cheese melts. Mix the Greek yogurt with lime juice, salt, and black pepper, then serve the quesadillas immediately with the lime yogurt on the side.

title: Chicken & Spinach Wholewheat Quesadillas with Avocado Lime Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["250 g chicken breast, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 clove garlic, raw", "200 g spinach, fresh", "1 piece red bell pepper", "160 g black beans, canned, drained", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp salt", "0.25 tsp black pepper, ground", "4 pieces wholewheat tortillas", "120 g reduced-fat cheese, shredded", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain 2%", "1 piece avocado, ripe", "1 tbsp lime juice"]
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat, then add the chicken, garlic, cumin, and smoked paprika. Cook for 6 to 8 minutes until the chicken is browned and cooked through. Add the bell pepper and cook for 2 minutes, then stir in the spinach and black beans and cook for another 2 to 3 minutes until the spinach has wilted and the mixture is hot and saucy. Warm a second pan over medium heat and place one wholewheat tortilla in the pan. Sprinkle half of the shredded reduced-fat cheese over the tortilla, add half of the chicken and bean mixture, then add the remaining cheese and top with a second tortilla. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes per side, pressing gently, until both tortillas are golden and the cheese is melted. Repeat to make the second quesadilla. Meanwhile, mash the avocado and stir it into the Greek yogurt with lime juice, adding a little black pepper if you like. Serve the quesadillas hot with the avocado lime yogurt on the side.

title: Chicken & Spinach Quesadillas with Black Beans and Salsa Verde
ingredients_json: ["200 g chicken breast, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 small onion", "2 cloves garlic", "200 g spinach, fresh", "150 g black beans, cooked, drained", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp dried oregano", "1.5 g salt", "0.5 g black pepper", "250 g low-fat Greek yogurt", "150 g light cheddar cheese, grated", "4 pieces whole wheat tortillas, 20 cm"]
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, add the onion and cook for 3 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the chicken, cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, salt, and black pepper, then cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and no longer pink. Add the spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes until wilted, then stir in the black beans and heat through for 1 minute. Take the skillet off the heat. Lay two tortillas on a clean surface and sprinkle half of the cheddar over each tortilla, then spoon the chicken-spinach-black bean filling over the cheese. Sprinkle the remaining cheddar on top and cover with the remaining two tortillas. Wipe the skillet if needed, then toast the quesadillas over medium heat for 2–3 minutes per side until golden and the cheese melts. Let them rest for 1 minute, cut into wedges, and serve with Greek yogurt as a tangy dip.

title: Spinach & Lean Turkey Ravioli in Tomato Basil Sauce
ingredients_json: ["250 g Fresh lasagne sheets, egg pasta", "300 g Extra-lean turkey mince, 5% fat", "200 g Low-fat ricotta", "100 g Baby spinach, fresh", "1 piece Egg, raw", "40 g Grana Padano, hard cheese", "400 g Passata di pomodoro", "200 g Courgette, zucchini", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "2 cloves Garlic", "1 tbsp Tomato paste", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "10 g Fresh basil", "10 g Salted butter", "1 dl Water", "0.5 tsp Black pepper"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a gentle boil. Finely chop the spinach and cook it in a dry pan for 2 to 3 minutes until wilted, then cool slightly. Mix the turkey mince, ricotta, egg, cooked spinach, 30 g of the Grana Padano, dried oregano, and black pepper in a bowl until well combined. Place small dollops of filling onto the pasta sheets, brush the edges with a little water, and top with another sheet; press firmly around each ravioli to seal, then cut into individual ravioli. Heat olive oil and butter in a saucepan over medium heat and sauté sliced courgette for 5 to 6 minutes until lightly browned. Add minced garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then stir in the passata and water and simmer for 10 minutes, tasting and adjusting with black pepper if needed. Cook the ravioli in the simmering water for 3 to 4 minutes, until tender and floating. Serve the ravioli with the tomato basil sauce and scatter over chopped basil and the remaining Grana Padano.

title: Smoky Chipotle Refried Beans with Lime and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["300 g cooked pinto beans", "15 g olive oil", "120 g onion, raw", "2 clove garlic", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp chipotle powder", "1 g salt", "0.5 g black pepper, ground", "50 ml water", "100 g spinach, raw", "20 ml lime juice"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 6–8 minutes until soft and lightly golden, then stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the cumin, smoked paprika, chipotle powder, salt and black pepper, and cook for 20 seconds until fragrant. Tip in the cooked pinto beans and add the water. Mash the beans with a fork or potato masher and simmer for 8–10 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy. Add the spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes until wilted. Turn off the heat and stir in the lime juice. Serve hot with any extra lime wedge if desired.

title: Smoky Chipotle Refried Beans with Lime and Roasted Peppers
ingredients_json: ["400 g canned black beans, drained and rinsed", "200 g canned pinto beans, drained and rinsed", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 small onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp chipotle in adobo sauce", "2 dl vegetable stock, low salt", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "1 small red bell pepper, raw", "30 g coriander leaves, fresh", "1 lime, raw", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain 2%"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium heat. Finely dice the onion and red bell pepper, then cook them for 6–8 minutes until soft and lightly browned. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, stirring to prevent burning. Stir in the cumin, smoked paprika, and chipotle in adobo, then add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute. Tip in the drained beans and pour in the vegetable stock. Simmer for 12–15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the mixture thickens. Mash the beans with a potato masher or the back of a spoon to your preferred texture. Season with salt only if needed, then stir in the lime juice and chopped coriander. Serve warm with a dollop of Greek yogurt on top for creaminess.

title: Creamy Chipotle Refried Beans with Roasted Peppers and Lime
ingredients_json: ["300 g canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed", "120 g canned black beans, drained and rinsed", "15 ml olive oil", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic", "200 g roasted red pepper, jarred", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp chipotle chilli powder", "250 ml vegetable stock", "15 ml fresh lime juice", "8 g chopped fresh coriander", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion and cook for 6–8 minutes until soft and translucent. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant, then add cumin, smoked paprika, and chipotle chilli powder and stir for 20 seconds. Add the kidney beans, black beans, roasted red pepper, and vegetable stock. Simmer gently for 12–15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the liquid has reduced slightly. Mash the beans with a potato masher to your preferred creaminess, then simmer for another 3–5 minutes to thicken. Turn off the heat and stir in lime juice, chopped coriander, salt, and black pepper. Serve hot, with extra lime wedges if you like.

title: Smoky Chipotle Refried Beans with Tomato, Garlic & Lime
ingredients_json: ["300 g dried pinto beans", "30 ml olive oil", "1 piece onion, yellow", "3 cloves garlic", "2 ml ground cumin", "2 ml smoked paprika", "2 ml chipotle powder", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes", "10 g tomato paste", "1 piece lime, juice only", "5 g salt (table salt)", "600 ml vegetable stock"]
instructions: Rinse the dried pinto beans and soak them in plenty of water for at least 8 hours, then drain. In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the chopped onion for 6–8 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Add the garlic and stir for 30 seconds, then mix in the cumin, smoked paprika, and chipotle powder so the spices become fragrant. Stir in the soaked beans, chopped tomatoes, tomato paste, and vegetable stock, bring to a simmer, and cook for 60–75 minutes until the beans are tender. Mash the beans with a potato masher to your preferred texture, then simmer for another 10 minutes so the mixture thickens. Stir in lime juice and salt, taste and adjust thickness with a small splash of stock if needed, and serve hot.

title: Smoky Chipotle Refried Beans with Tomato and Lime
ingredients_json: ["250 g canned pinto beans, drained and rinsed", "30 g onion, diced", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "1 tbsp olive oil", "150 g passata, unsweetened", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp chipotle paste", "0.5 tsp dried oregano", "1 dl water", "15 g lime juice", "5 g salt", "20 g Greek yogurt, plain 2% fat"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 4–5 minutes until softened, stirring occasionally. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, just until fragrant. Add cumin, smoked paprika, chipotle paste, and oregano, then cook for 30 seconds to bloom the spices. Tip in the pinto beans and passata, and add the water. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 10 minutes, mashing some of the beans with the back of a spoon as it thickens. Season with salt and continue cooking for another 3–5 minutes until you reach a creamy refried consistency. Turn off the heat and stir in the lime juice. Serve warm with a dollop of Greek yogurt on top.

title: Oven-Braised Smoky Pork Ribs with Apple-Cider Slaw
ingredients_json: ["700 g pork ribs, lean trimmed", "30 ml olive oil", "1 large onion, yellow, raw", "2 clove garlic, raw", "250 ml apple cider vinegar", "150 ml tomato passata", "150 g carrots, raw", "150 g celery, raw", "400 g cabbage, white", "1 piece apple, raw", "20 g wholegrain mustard", "10 g smoked paprika", "5 g dried oregano", "3 g fine salt", "2 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 160°C. Pat the pork ribs dry, rub them with half the smoked paprika, oregano, and black pepper, then set aside. Slice the onion, chop the carrots and celery, and place everything in a deep roasting dish. Pour in the olive oil, apple cider vinegar, and tomato passata, then nestle the ribs into the liquid so they are partly submerged. Cover tightly with foil and braise for 2 hours, until the meat is tender and starting to pull from the bones. Increase the oven to 200°C, remove the foil, brush the ribs with the mustard mixed with the remaining smoked paprika, and bake uncovered for 20–25 minutes until the surface is lightly browned. While the ribs finish, shred the cabbage, grate the apple, and toss together with a small splash of braising liquid for a tangy slaw. Serve the ribs hot with the apple-cider slaw on the side.

title: Chicken, Spinach & Mushroom Brown Rice Casserole
ingredients_json: ["250 g brown rice, uncooked", "450 ml chicken stock, low-salt", "300 g chicken breast, raw", "250 g mushrooms, sliced", "200 g frozen spinach, thawed and drained", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "150 g low-fat Greek yogurt, plain", "150 g grated reduced-fat cheese", "2 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp ground black pepper", "1.5 tsp salt", "1 tbsp lemon juice"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Rinse the brown rice briefly, then spread it in a baking dish. Pour over the low-salt chicken stock and cover with foil. Bake for 25 minutes until the rice has absorbed some liquid and is starting to soften. While the rice bakes, heat olive oil in a pan and sauté the chopped onion and sliced mushrooms over medium heat for 6–8 minutes until the mushrooms release their moisture and start to brown. Add the garlic and oregano and cook for 30 seconds, then stir in the chicken breast cut into small cubes and cook until the chicken is mostly opaque and lightly browned, about 6–7 minutes. Stir the drained spinach into the chicken mixture and cook for 2 minutes. Mix the low-fat Greek yogurt with lemon juice and black pepper, then set aside. When the rice is ready, remove the foil and fold in the chicken, mushroom and spinach mixture. Spoon over the yogurt mixture, sprinkle the reduced-fat grated cheese on top, and bake uncovered for 15–20 minutes until bubbling and the top is golden. Let the casserole rest for 5 minutes before serving so it sets and slices nicely.

title: Chicken, Spinach & Tomato Rice Casserole with Mozzarella
ingredients_json: ["1 tbsp Olive oil", "400 g Chicken breast, raw, diced", "1 piece Onion, yellow, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "300 g Long-grain rice, uncooked", "800 ml Vegetable stock, reduced-salt", "250 g Passata (tomato purée)", "200 g Spinach, fresh", "150 g Mozzarella, part-skim", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 tsp Salt"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large ovenproof casserole dish over medium heat. Add the diced chicken and cook for 6–8 minutes until lightly browned and mostly cooked through. Stir in the chopped onion and cook for 3–4 minutes, then add the minced garlic and oregano and cook for 30 seconds. Add the uncooked rice, passata, and reduced-salt vegetable stock, stirring well to combine and scraping up any browned bits. Bring to a gentle simmer, then cover with a lid or tightly with foil and transfer to a preheated oven at 180°C for 30 minutes. Remove from the oven, stir in the spinach until wilted, and top with torn mozzarella. Return to the oven, uncovered, for 10–12 minutes until the rice is tender and the cheese is melted and lightly golden. Let the casserole rest for 5 minutes before serving so the liquid is absorbed and the texture is set.

title: Chicken and Veggie Brown Rice Casserole with Tomato and Herbs
ingredients_json: ["200 g brown rice, uncooked", "500 g chicken breast, raw", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "200 g carrots, raw", "200 g bell peppers, raw", "250 g passata (tomato purée)", "2 tbsp olive oil", "600 ml low-salt chicken stock", "2 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp ground cumin", "200 g reduced-fat natural yogurt", "100 g mozzarella, part-skim", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 190°C. Rinse the brown rice, then spread it in a baking dish and stir in the low-salt chicken stock and passata. Dice the onion, mince the garlic, and cut the carrots and bell peppers into small cubes. Toss the chicken breast with the olive oil, oregano, cumin, half the salt, and the black pepper, then nestle it into the rice mixture so it is covered by liquid. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 35 minutes, until the rice is mostly tender. Remove the foil, stir in the vegetables if any are exposed, and bake uncovered for 15 minutes to reduce the liquid and thicken the casserole. Mix the reduced-fat natural yogurt with a little warm cooking liquid from the dish, then spoon it over the top and scatter over the mozzarella. Bake for a final 8–10 minutes until the cheese is melted and lightly golden. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Creamy Chicken and Mushroom Rice Casserole with Spinach
ingredients_json: ["250 g basmati rice, uncooked", "400 g chicken breast, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "250 g mushrooms, sliced", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic", "300 g spinach, fresh", "500 ml low-fat milk, 1.5%", "200 g plain Greek yogurt, low-fat", "2 tbsp wholegrain mustard", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "600 ml chicken stock, reduced-salt", "10 g parmesan cheese, grated", "10 g cornflour", "2 g ground black pepper", "3 g salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 190°C. Rinse the basmati rice until the water runs fairly clear, then drain. Dice the chicken breast into bite-size pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large pan and sauté the onion for 4–5 minutes until soft, then add the mushrooms and cook for another 6–8 minutes until they release their moisture and start to brown. Stir in the garlic, thyme and smoked paprika for 30 seconds, then add the chicken and cook for 5–6 minutes until the surface turns opaque. Mix the milk, Greek yogurt and wholegrain mustard in a bowl, then whisk the cornflour in smoothly to avoid lumps. In a casserole dish, combine the rice, chicken mixture, spinach and reduced-salt stock. Pour over the creamy milk-yogurt mixture, season with black pepper and salt, then stir well and sprinkle the parmesan on top. Bake for 35–40 minutes, covering with foil for the first 25 minutes to prevent drying out. The casserole is ready when the rice is tender and the top is lightly golden; let it rest for 5 minutes before serving so it thickens slightly.

title: One-Pot Chicken & Vegetable Rice Pilaf with Lemon and Herbs
ingredients_json: ["220 g basmati rice (dry)", "320 g chicken breast (raw, skinless)", "1.2 dl olive oil", "1 piece onion, yellow (about 150 g)", "2 cloves garlic", "2 piece carrots (about 160 g)", "200 g red bell pepper", "200 g courgette", "300 g canned chickpeas (drained and rinsed)", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "1.5 L chicken stock (low salt)", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 piece lemon (zest and 2 tbsp juice)", "15 g fresh parsley (chopped)", "1 tsp fine salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper"]
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear, then drain. Cut the chicken breast into small bite-sized pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large heavy pot over medium-high heat, then sauté the onion and carrots for 5–7 minutes until the onion turns translucent and the carrots start to soften. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the chicken and cook for about 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is no longer pink. Add the bell pepper and courgette and cook for 3–4 minutes. Stir in the tomato paste, cumin, and oregano, and cook for 1 minute to coat everything. Add the rice, chickpeas, chicken stock, salt, and black pepper, then bring to a gentle boil. Cover and reduce the heat to low, simmering for 15 minutes. Turn off the heat and let the pot stand, covered, for 5 minutes to finish steaming. Fluff the pilaf with a fork, then stir in lemon zest, lemon juice, and parsley, and serve hot.

title: Lemon-Herb Chicken & Vegetable Rice Pilaf with Toasted Almonds
ingredients_json: ["300 g long-grain rice, uncooked", "550 ml chicken stock, low salt", "220 g chicken breast, raw", "120 g carrots, raw", "140 g bell pepper, red, raw", "120 g onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "70 g green peas, frozen", "15 g olive oil", "20 g almonds, sliced", "5 g dried oregano", "1 pc lemon, zest", "20 ml lemon juice", "5 g salt, table salt", "2 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat. Add the onion and carrot, and cook for 6–8 minutes until the vegetables soften. Stir in the garlic and bell pepper, then cook for 2 minutes. Add the chicken breast cut into small bite-size pieces and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring often, until the chicken is lightly browned and cooked through. Stir in the rice and oregano, then cook for 1 minute to toast the grains. Pour in the warm low-salt chicken stock, add the lemon zest, and bring to a gentle simmer. Cover and cook on low heat for 15 minutes. Stir in the peas and lemon juice, then cook covered for another 5 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed. Meanwhile toast the sliced almonds in a dry pan over medium heat for 2–3 minutes until golden. Fluff the pilaf with a fork, season with black pepper, and top with the toasted almonds before serving.

title: Lemony Chicken & Pea Brown Rice Pilaf with Caramelized Onion
ingredients_json: ["200 g brown rice, uncooked", "1.2 kg chicken breast, raw, skinless", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion", "2 cl garlic", "200 g frozen peas", "1 piece carrot", "1.5 dl plain low-fat yogurt", "5 dl chicken stock, low-salt", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tbsp lemon zest", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp ground turmeric", "0.5 tsp dried oregano", "1 g black pepper", "3 g salt"]
instructions: Rinse the brown rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear, then drain. Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and season with salt, black pepper, cumin, and turmeric. Heat the olive oil in a large deep pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6–8 minutes until browned on the outside and mostly cooked through. Lower the heat to medium, add the chopped onion and diced carrot, and cook for 5–6 minutes until softened and lightly caramelized. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant, then stir in the rinsed rice and coat it in the pan juices. Pour in the low-salt chicken stock, bring to a gentle boil, then reduce to low heat, cover, and simmer for about 35–40 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed. Stir in the peas for the final 5 minutes. Turn off the heat, then fold through the lemon juice and lemon zest. Serve warm with a spoonful of low-fat yogurt on top and a sprinkle of dried oregano.

title: Lemony Chicken and Vegetable Rice Pilaf with Herbs
ingredients_json: ["200 g basmati rice, uncooked", "300 g chicken breast, raw", "1.5 dl chicken stock, low salt", "5 dl water", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic", "1 piece carrot", "1 piece red bell pepper", "150 g peas, green, frozen", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "1 piece lemon, zest and juice", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 tsp salt", "15 g fresh parsley"]
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear, then drain. Slice the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat and sauté the onion for 4–5 minutes until soft. Stir in the garlic, carrot, and red bell pepper and cook for 3–4 minutes. Add the chicken and cook for about 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is no longer pink. Mix in the tomato paste, cumin, and oregano, then stir for 1 minute so the spices bloom. Add the rinsed rice and lemon zest, stir well, and pour in the stock and water. Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes. Add the peas and cook covered for another 5–7 minutes, until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed. Turn off the heat, rest the pilaf for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork and stir in lemon juice and chopped parsley. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed before serving.

title: Lemon-Herb Chicken Rice Pilaf with Peas and Carrots
ingredients_json: ["300 g long-grain white rice, uncooked", "550 ml chicken stock, low-salt", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion, diced (about 120 g)", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "2 medium carrots, diced (about 180 g)", "200 g chicken breast, raw, diced", "250 g frozen peas", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp ground cumin", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "0.5 tsp fine salt"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a heavy pot over medium heat. Add the onion and carrots and cook for 6–8 minutes until the onion turns translucent and the carrots begin to soften. Stir in the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then add the diced chicken. Cook for 5–6 minutes until the chicken is lightly browned. Add the rice and stir well so the grains are coated in the fat and tomato paste. Pour in the low-salt chicken stock, add oregano and cumin, and bring to a gentle simmer. Cover and cook on low heat for 15 minutes. Stir in the peas and lemon juice, re-cover, and cook for another 10 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed. Remove from the heat and let it stand, covered, for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork and season with black pepper before serving.

title: Lemon-Pea Chicken Risotto with Spinach and Parmesan
ingredients_json: ["300 g Arborio rice", "20 g Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, yellow, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "200 g Chicken breast, raw", "1.2 L Vegetable stock, low-salt", "300 g Peas, frozen", "100 g Spinach, fresh", "80 g Parmesan cheese, hard", "150 ml White wine, dry", "1 piece Lemon, zest", "30 ml Lemon juice", "10 g Butter", "2 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Warm the low-salt vegetable stock in a saucepan and keep it at a gentle simmer. Dice the onion and finely chop the garlic, then heat the olive oil in a large heavy-bottom pan over medium heat. Cook the onion for 4 to 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the garlic for 30 seconds. Cut the chicken breast into small cubes and add to the pan, cooking for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink. Stir in the Arborio rice and cook for 1 minute, coating each grain with the oil. Pour in the white wine and let it simmer until mostly absorbed. Add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring frequently; allow each addition to be absorbed before adding more. After about 18 to 20 minutes, when the rice is creamy and just tender, stir in the peas and cook for 3 minutes. Turn off the heat and fold in the fresh spinach, Parmesan, butter, lemon zest, and lemon juice until the risotto is glossy and thick. Season with black pepper and the measured salt, then serve immediately while hot.

title: Leek & Lemon Salmon Risotto with Peas and Herbs
ingredients_json: ["350 g Arborio rice", "700 ml Vegetable stock, low sodium", "200 g Salmon fillet, raw", "1 piece Leek, trimmed", "2 cl Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, yellow", "2 cl Dry white wine", "150 g Green peas, frozen", "1 piece Lemon, zest and juice", "40 g Parmesan cheese, hard", "300 g Cooked spinach", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a deep pan over medium heat. Finely chop the onion and leek and cook them for 6–8 minutes, stirring, until soft and lightly golden. Add the Arborio rice and stir for 1–2 minutes so the grains are well coated and start to smell toasted. Pour in the white wine and cook until mostly absorbed. Add the warm vegetable stock a ladle at a time, stirring frequently, allowing each addition to be absorbed before adding more. After about 15–18 minutes, stir in the peas and cooked spinach and continue cooking until the rice is creamy and al dente, about 5 minutes more. Meanwhile, cut the salmon into bite-size pieces, season with black pepper and a little of the salt, and gently fold it into the risotto for the final 3–4 minutes until just cooked and flaky. Turn off the heat, then stir in the lemon zest, lemon juice, and Parmesan. Check seasoning and serve immediately while the risotto is at its creamy peak.

title: Creamy Parmesan Courgette & Pea Risotto with Lemon Zest
ingredients_json: ["320 g Arborio rice", "900 ml Vegetable stock, hot", "1 piece Onion, yellow", "2 cloves Garlic", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "120 g Courgette", "150 g Peas, frozen", "150 g Mushrooms, chestnut", "60 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "250 g Greek yoghurt, low-fat", "1 piece Lemon, zest and juice", "1 g Ground black pepper", "4 g Salt"]
instructions: Finely chop the onion and mince the garlic. Dice the courgette and slice the mushrooms. Heat the olive oil in a wide pan over medium heat, then cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft and translucent. Add the garlic and stir for 30 seconds. Tip in the rice and toast for 2 minutes, stirring so the grains get glossy. Pour in hot vegetable stock a ladle at a time, stirring frequently, and let the rice absorb most of the liquid before adding more. After about 15 minutes, add the mushrooms and courgette. Continue cooking for another 8–10 minutes until the rice is tender but still creamy and slightly al dente, with a loose, flowing consistency. Stir in the peas for the final 3 minutes. Turn off the heat, then mix in the low-fat Greek yoghurt, Parmesan, lemon zest, and lemon juice; season with salt and black pepper. Serve immediately while the risotto is hot and creamy.

title: Creamy Lemon Pea & Spinach Risotto with Salmon
ingredients_json: ["300 g Salmon fillet, raw", "1.2 l Vegetable stock, low salt", "300 g Arborio rice", "1 piece Onion, yellow", "2 cloves Garlic", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "150 g Peas, frozen", "80 g Spinach, fresh", "100 ml White wine, dry", "1 piece Lemon", "50 g Parmesan cheese", "1 tbsp Butter", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "2 g Salt"]
instructions: Finely chop the onion and mince the garlic. Heat the olive oil in a deep pan over medium heat, then add the onion and cook for 4–5 minutes until soft and translucent. Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the Arborio rice and toast it for 1–2 minutes while stirring. Pour in the white wine and simmer until almost fully absorbed. Start adding the warm vegetable stock a ladle at a time, stirring frequently; keep the heat at a gentle simmer and add more stock as each addition is absorbed. After about 16–18 minutes the rice should be creamy and al dente. Meanwhile, cut the salmon into bite-size pieces and season with black pepper. In a separate pan, quickly sear the salmon in a small splash of olive oil over medium-high heat for 2–3 minutes until just cooked through. Stir the peas into the risotto for the final 3–4 minutes so they warm through, then fold in the spinach until wilted. Turn off the heat and stir in the butter, Parmesan, and the lemon zest plus the lemon juice to brighten the flavour. Add the cooked salmon at the end and gently mix. Taste and adjust with salt if needed, then serve immediately while the risotto is still glossy and creamy.

title: Lean Turkey Salisbury Steak with Onion-Gravy and Mashed Cauliflower
ingredients_json: ["500 g lean turkey mince", "150 g brown mushrooms, sliced", "1 piece onion, yellow", "1 clove garlic", "60 g wholemeal breadcrumbs", "1 piece egg, raw", "20 g Worcestershire sauce", "10 g Dijon mustard", "1 tsp ground black pepper", "1 tsp dried thyme", "300 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "200 ml semi-skimmed milk", "40 g plain flour", "1 tbsp olive oil", "600 g cauliflower florets", "30 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2%", "15 g butter, unsalted", "5 g salt"]
instructions: Finely chop the onion and garlic. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat, then cook the onion and mushrooms for 6–8 minutes until the mushrooms soften and their liquid reduces. Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds, then transfer the mixture to a bowl to cool slightly. In the same bowl, mix the turkey mince, wholemeal breadcrumbs, egg, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, black pepper, dried thyme, and 20 ml of the chicken stock, then fold in the onion-mushroom mixture until evenly combined. Divide into 4 patties and press them into even thickness. Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the patties for 3–4 minutes per side until browned and cooked through, then set aside. To make the gravy, whisk the flour into the remaining stock and milk, then pour into the pan juices and stir over medium heat until thickened and glossy, about 3–5 minutes. Season lightly with the salt and a little extra pepper if needed, then return the patties to the pan and simmer gently for 3 minutes so the flavors meld. Steam the cauliflower florets until very tender, about 10–12 minutes, then mash with the butter and Greek yogurt until smooth. Serve the Salisbury steaks with the onion-gravy and mashed cauliflower.

title: Turkey Salisbury Steak with Mushroom-Gravy and Roasted Carrots
ingredients_json: ["500 g turkey mince, lean (5% fat)", "1 piece egg, raw", "80 g wholemeal breadcrumbs", "1 piece onion, yellow", "30 g carrot, raw", "2 cloves garlic", "15 ml Worcestershire sauce", "10 g fresh parsley", "10 g Dijon mustard", "1 g dried thyme", "1.5 g black pepper", "3 g fine salt", "15 ml rapeseed oil", "300 g mushrooms, cremini", "500 ml low-sodium beef stock", "60 ml unsweetened plain yogurt, 2% fat", "20 g plain wholemeal flour", "600 g carrots, whole"]
instructions: Grate the onion and carrot, then mince the garlic and parsley. In a large bowl, mix the turkey mince, egg, wholemeal breadcrumbs, grated onion and carrot, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, thyme, black pepper, and 1.5 g of the salt until just combined. Shape into 4 evenly sized patties and place on a plate. Heat the rapeseed oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat, then cook the patties for 4–5 minutes per side until browned and cooked through. Transfer the patties to a warm plate. In the same pan, add the mushrooms and cook for 5–6 minutes until they release their moisture and turn golden. Sprinkle in the flour and stir well for 30–60 seconds to remove the raw flour taste. Slowly whisk in the low-sodium beef stock, scraping up any browned bits, and simmer for 5–7 minutes until the gravy thickens. Stir in the yogurt and remaining salt, then return the patties to the pan and simmer gently for 3 minutes so the flavors meld. While the steak cooks, roast the carrots at 220°C for 20–25 minutes until tender and caramelized, then serve with the Salisbury steak and mushroom gravy.

title: Turkey Salisbury Steak with Mushroom-Onion Gravy
ingredients_json: ["500 g turkey mince, 5% fat", "60 g wholemeal breadcrumbs", "120 g yellow onion", "1 piece egg, whole, raw", "2 g garlic, fresh", "10 g Worcestershire sauce", "8 g Dijon mustard", "6 g fine sea salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "10 g olive oil", "300 g mushrooms, chestnut, sliced", "150 ml beef-style stock, low salt", "200 ml unsweetened oat drink", "25 g plain flour", "20 g unsalted butter", "1 g dried thyme"]
instructions: Finely dice half of the onion and grate the garlic. In a large bowl, mix the turkey mince, breadcrumbs, diced onion, egg, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, salt, and black pepper until just combined. Shape the mixture into 4 evenly sized steaks and place them on a plate. Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat and sear the steaks for about 3–4 minutes per side until browned and cooked through. Transfer the steaks to a warm plate. In the same pan, lower the heat to medium and sauté the sliced mushrooms and the remaining onion for 6–8 minutes, stirring, until the mushrooms release their juices and the onions turn soft. Sprinkle in the flour and cook for 1 minute, then slowly whisk in the stock and oat drink until smooth. Stir in thyme and butter, and simmer the gravy for 3–5 minutes until thickened. Return the steaks to the pan and simmer gently for 2 minutes so the flavors meld. Serve hot with the gravy spooned over.

title: Turkey Salisbury Steak with Mushroom-Onion Gravy and Mashed Cauliflower
ingredients_json: ["450 g turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "60 g wholegrain breadcrumbs", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 piece onion, yellow", "250 g mushrooms, cremini", "2 cloves garlic", "30 g ketchup, no added sugar", "500 ml low-sodium beef stock", "10 g Worcestershire sauce, low sodium", "20 g olive oil", "600 g cauliflower florets", "60 ml milk, semi-skimmed (2–2.5%)", "20 g butter, unsalted", "12 g fresh parsley", "2 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Finely chop the onion and slice the mushrooms. Heat 10 g olive oil in a large pan over medium heat, then cook the onion until soft and translucent, about 6–8 minutes. Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown, about 8 minutes. Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds, then remove half the mushroom mixture from the pan and set aside for serving. In a bowl, combine the turkey mince, breadcrumbs, egg, ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, half of the cooked mushroom-onion mixture, and the black pepper and 1 g salt. Mix gently until just combined, then form 4 equal patties. Heat the remaining 10 g olive oil in the pan over medium-high heat and sear the patties for 3–4 minutes per side until browned. Pour in the low-sodium beef stock and scrape up any browned bits. Reduce the heat to low and simmer the patties in the gravy for 10–12 minutes, turning once, until cooked through and tender. Meanwhile, steam or boil the cauliflower florets until very soft, about 10–12 minutes, then drain well. Mash the cauliflower with milk and butter until smooth, adding a little extra milk if needed for a creamy texture. Stir the reserved mushroom mixture into the gravy to finish. Serve the Salisbury steak patties with the mushroom gravy and mashed cauliflower, garnished with chopped parsley.

title: Lean Turkey Salisbury Steak with Mushroom Gravy and Roasted Carrots
ingredients_json: ["450 g Turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "1 piece Egg, whole, raw", "80 g Oats, rolled", "2 dl Milk, semi-skimmed", "1 piece Onion, yellow", "200 g Mushrooms, chestnut", "2 cloves Garlic", "40 g Breadcrumbs, wholegrain", "2 tbsp Tomato paste", "1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce", "1 tsp Dijon mustard", "600 g Carrots, whole", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "500 ml Vegetable stock, low-sodium", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "1 tsp Black pepper, ground", "0.75 tsp Salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°C. Peel and cut the carrots into batons, toss them with 1 tbsp of olive oil and half of the thyme, then roast for 20–25 minutes until tender and lightly browned. While the carrots roast, finely dice the onion and mushrooms. Heat the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat, sauté the onion and mushrooms for 6–8 minutes until their moisture cooks off and they turn golden, then stir in the garlic for 30 seconds. In a bowl, mix the turkey mince with the egg, rolled oats, wholegrain breadcrumbs, Dijon mustard, Worcestershire sauce, half of the sautéed mushroom mixture, black pepper, and 0.5 tsp of the salt. Shape into 4 oval patties of similar thickness. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the patties for 3–4 minutes per side until browned; they should be cooked through with no pink in the center. Remove patties to a plate and pour in the vegetable stock, then add tomato paste, remaining thyme, and the rest of the mushrooms and onions from the pan. Simmer for 5–7 minutes until the gravy thickens; adjust seasoning with the remaining 0.25 tsp salt and a little pepper. Serve the Salisbury steak with the mushroom gravy and the roasted carrots.

title: Lemon-Herb Salmon with Roasted Broccoli and Quinoa
ingredients_json: ["400 g salmon fillet, skinless", "250 g quinoa, dry", "300 g broccoli, florets", "200 g cherry tomatoes", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 lemon, zest and juice", "2 cloves garlic", "2 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp Dijon mustard", "10 g fresh parsley", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°C. Rinse the quinoa under cold water, then cook it according to the package directions using 500 ml water; once cooked, keep it covered so it stays warm. While the quinoa cooks, toss the broccoli florets and cherry tomatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil, half the lemon juice, minced garlic, oregano, and half the salt. Spread the vegetables on a baking tray and roast for 18–22 minutes, until the broccoli is tender and the tomatoes are slightly blistered. Mix the remaining lemon juice with Dijon mustard, the lemon zest, the rest of the salt, and black pepper, then brush it over the salmon. Nest the salmon among the roasted vegetables for the final 10–12 minutes, cooking until the salmon flakes easily when pressed with a fork. Stir the roasted vegetables through the quinoa and finish with chopped parsley. Serve hot.

title: Herb-Lemon Baked Salmon with Roasted Broccoli and Quinoa
ingredients_json: ["320 g Salmon fillet, skinless", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "300 g Broccoli florets", "180 g Quinoa, uncooked", "500 ml Vegetable stock, low salt", "1 pc Lemon, zest and juice", "2 cloves Garlic", "10 g Fresh parsley", "5 g Dijon mustard", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "2 g Salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. Rinse the quinoa and cook it by simmering it in the low-salt vegetable stock for about 12–15 minutes, until the grains are tender and the liquid is absorbed; then remove from the heat and let it stand for 2 minutes. Toss the broccoli with half of the olive oil, a little black pepper, and 1 g salt, then roast on a tray for 12–15 minutes until the edges start to brown. Meanwhile, mix the remaining olive oil with the lemon zest and juice, minced garlic, Dijon mustard, and chopped parsley. Place the salmon on a lined baking tray, season with the remaining salt, and brush generously with the lemon-herb mixture. Roast the salmon for 10–14 minutes depending on thickness, until it flakes easily. Serve the salmon over the quinoa with the roasted broccoli on the side and spoon over any pan juices from the tray.

title: Lemon Dill Oven-Baked Salmon with Quinoa and Asparagus
ingredients_json: ["520 g Salmon fillet, skinless", "170 g Quinoa, uncooked", "300 g Asparagus, trimmed", "250 g Cherry tomatoes", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 pc Lemon, zest and juice", "2 g Dill, fresh", "1 g Garlic, fresh", "5 g Dijon mustard", "3 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. Rinse the quinoa under cold water, then cook it with 340 ml water in a covered saucepan for about 15 minutes, until the grains are fluffy and the liquid is absorbed. While the quinoa cooks, toss the asparagus and cherry tomatoes with the olive oil, half the lemon juice, Dijon mustard, minced garlic, dill, black pepper, and half the salt. Place the salmon in a baking dish, coat it with the remaining lemon juice, dill, and the remaining salt, then bake for 12–15 minutes until the salmon flakes easily and is just cooked through. Fold the roasted vegetables into the cooked quinoa and spoon the mixture onto plates. Serve the salmon on top and finish with extra lemon zest and a little more dill if you like.

title: Lemon-Dill Baked Salmon with Roasted Broccoli and Quinoa
ingredients_json: ["260 g salmon fillet, raw", "180 g broccoli florets", "140 g cooked quinoa", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2%", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 pc lemon, zest and juice", "10 g fresh dill", "2 cloves garlic", "1 tsp Dijon mustard", "1 g sea salt", "0.5 g black pepper"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C. Place the broccoli florets on a baking tray, drizzle with the olive oil, and season with half the salt and all the black pepper. Roast for 12 minutes until the florets start to brown at the edges. Meanwhile, mix the Greek yogurt with the lemon zest and juice, chopped dill, minced garlic, Dijon mustard, and the remaining salt. Add the salmon to the tray and spoon the yogurt mixture over the top. Return to the oven and bake for 10–14 minutes, depending on thickness, until the salmon flakes easily with a fork and reaches a gentle opaque color. Serve the salmon with the cooked quinoa alongside, and spoon any pan juices over the top.

title: Herby Baked Salmon with Lemon, Quinoa and Roasted Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["220 g salmon fillet, skinless", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 pc lemon, whole", "200 g broccoli florets", "120 g cooked quinoa", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "2 tsp Dijon mustard", "2 g dried dill", "1 g garlic powder", "0.8 g salt", "0.3 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. Line a baking tray and place the salmon on it. Drizzle the salmon with olive oil, then squeeze over half the lemon juice and sprinkle with dill, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Bake for 12–15 minutes until the salmon flakes easily with a fork and is just cooked through. Toss the broccoli florets on the same tray (or a second tray) with a little of the remaining olive oil and bake alongside the salmon for 12 minutes, until the broccoli is tender and lightly browned at the edges. While everything cooks, stir the Greek yogurt with Dijon mustard, the remaining lemon juice, and a little lemon zest if you like. Fluff the cooked quinoa with a fork and serve it topped with the roasted broccoli, then place the baked salmon on top and spoon the yogurt-Dijon sauce over the fish.

title: Smoky Salmon, Avocado & Wholegrain Cucumber Sandwiches
ingredients_json: ["160 g salmon fillet, raw", "1 tsp olive oil", "4 slices wholegrain bread", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tsp Dijon mustard", "1/2 tsp smoked paprika", "1/2 tsp dried dill", "1 small avocado, ripe (about 150g edible portion)", "1/2 medium cucumber", "1/2 red onion", "20 g rocket leaves", "1/4 tsp fine salt", "1/4 tsp black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add the salmon fillet and cook for 3 to 4 minutes per side until it flakes easily and turns opaque throughout. Remove from the pan and let it cool slightly, then flake it with a fork. Stir the Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, smoked paprika, dried dill, fine salt, and black pepper together in a bowl to make a creamy smoky sauce. Mash the avocado roughly with a fork. Slice the cucumber and red onion finely. Toast the wholegrain bread slices if you like extra crunch, then spread avocado on top of the bread. Add the cucumber, red onion, and rocket leaves. Drizzle over the yogurt sauce, then pile the salmon on each sandwich. Serve right away while the salmon is still warm and the vegetables stay crisp.

title: Tuna & White Bean Sandwiches with Lemon-Dill Mayo and Crunchy Cucumber
ingredients_json: ["120 g canned tuna in water, drained", "200 g canned cannellini beans, drained and rinsed", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp lemon juice", "1 tsp lemon zest", "80 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "1 tbsp mayonnaise", "1 clove garlic, minced", "1 tbsp fresh dill, chopped", "1 small cucumber, about 250 g, sliced", "4 slices wholegrain bread", "2 tbsp red onion, finely chopped", "0.5 tsp salt", "0.25 tsp black pepper"]
instructions: Drain the tuna and rinse the beans under cold water, then shake off excess moisture. In a bowl, mash the cannellini beans with a fork until you still have some whole beans for texture. Add the tuna, olive oil, lemon juice, lemon zest, Greek yogurt, mayonnaise, garlic, dill, chopped red onion, salt, and black pepper, then stir until everything is well combined and creamy. Toast the wholegrain bread slices lightly in a dry pan over medium heat until warm and crisp at the edges. Spread the tuna-bean mixture over the toasted bread, top with sliced cucumber, and finish with a little extra black pepper if you like. Serve right away while the bread is still crisp.

title: Smoked Salmon, Avocado & Spinach Wholemeal Sandwiches with Lemon-Dill Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["4 slices wholemeal bread", "200 g smoked salmon", "1 whole avocado", "120 g fresh baby spinach", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain 2%", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tsp dried dill", "1 tsp Dijon mustard", "1 g sea salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Toast the wholemeal bread until lightly crisp. In a bowl, mix the Greek yogurt, Dijon mustard, lemon juice, dried dill, sea salt, and black pepper. Slice the avocado and mash it lightly with a fork, then toss with a little lemon juice so it stays bright. Spread the lemon-dill yogurt on the toasted bread, layer with baby spinach, add the avocado, and top with the smoked salmon. Drizzle with olive oil and serve immediately while the bread is still warm.

title: Chickpea and Chicken Pita Sandwiches with Cucumber-Yogurt Sauce
ingredients_json: ["200 g chicken breast, cooked, sliced", "120 g chickpeas, cooked, drained", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1/2 tsp garlic powder", "1/2 tsp black pepper, ground", "1/2 tsp salt", "4 pieces wholemeal pitta bread", "250 g plain low-fat yogurt", "1 piece cucumber, fresh", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "20 g fresh parsley", "60 g red bell pepper, sliced", "30 g feta cheese, reduced-fat"]
instructions: Warm a large non-stick pan over medium heat and add the olive oil. Add the sliced chicken and chickpeas, then stir in cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, black pepper, and salt. Cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until hot and lightly coated with spices. While the filling cooks, prepare the cucumber-yogurt sauce by grating the cucumber, squeezing out excess moisture, and mixing it with the yogurt, lemon juice, and finely chopped parsley. Slice the bell pepper thinly. Warm the pitta breads for 1 minute per side in a dry pan, then open them to form pockets. Spoon the chicken-chickpea filling into each pita, add sliced bell pepper, and crumble reduced-fat feta on top. Serve immediately with the cucumber-yogurt sauce on the side or spooned into the sandwiches.

title: Tuna & Greek Yogurt Caper Sandwiches with Crunchy Cucumber
ingredients_json: ["160 g tuna, canned in water, drained", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "15 g capers, drained", "20 g Dijon mustard", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tsp olive oil", "2 medium tomatoes", "1 medium cucumber", "4 slices wholegrain bread", "40 g red onion", "30 g mixed salad leaves", "1 g black pepper", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Drain the tuna well and flake it into a bowl. Stir in the Greek yogurt, Dijon mustard, capers, lemon juice, black pepper, and 1 g of salt until you get a thick, creamy tuna mix. Slice the tomatoes thinly, slice the cucumber into thin rounds, and finely slice the red onion. Lightly toast the wholegrain bread in a dry pan over medium heat for 1–2 minutes per side until warm and lightly crisp. Spread the tuna mixture generously on the toasted bread, then layer tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, and salad leaves. Serve immediately so the vegetables stay crunchy.

title: Lean Chicken Sausage with Roasted Sweet Potato and Lentil-Carrot Tray Bake
ingredients_json: ["400 g chicken sausage, low-fat", "800 g sweet potato", "250 g red lentils, dry", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "250 g carrots", "2 tbsp olive oil", "500 ml vegetable stock, low-salt", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp ground black pepper", "1.5 tsp salt, iodised"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. Peel and cube the sweet potato and carrots, and chop the onion. Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe pan over medium heat and fry the onion for 4–5 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic, smoked paprika and thyme for 30 seconds, then add the lentils and stir to coat. Add the vegetable stock and bring to a gentle simmer, then nestle in the chicken sausages and scatter the sweet potato and carrots over the top. Cover and bake for 35 minutes, then uncover and bake for a further 15 minutes until the lentils are tender and the sweet potato is golden. Let the dish rest for 5 minutes before serving, and check that the sausages are cooked through and the lentils are not chalky.

title: Lemon-Herb Seitan with Roasted Vegetables and Light Tahini Sauce
ingredients_json: ["200 g seitan, plain", "1 tbsp olive oil", "300 g mixed bell peppers, sliced", "300 g zucchini, sliced", "200 g cherry tomatoes, halved", "1 medium red onion, sliced", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "200 ml vegetable stock", "2 tbsp soy sauce, reduced-salt", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp dried thyme", "50 g tahini", "120 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "10 g fresh parsley, chopped", "1 tsp wholegrain mustard"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan or skillet over medium-high heat. Add the sliced red onion and cook for 3 minutes until it starts to soften. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the bell peppers and zucchini and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender and lightly browned. Add the cherry tomatoes, oregano, thyme, and soy sauce, then pour in the vegetable stock and simmer for 5 minutes. Slice the seitan and add it to the pan, cooking for 3–4 minutes so it warms through and absorbs the sauce. Whisk together the tahini, low-fat Greek yogurt, lemon juice, mustard, and chopped parsley until smooth and pour in gradually, simmering for 1–2 minutes until glossy. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, then serve hot with extra lemon and herbs on top.

title: Herby Seitan Stir-Fry with Sesame-Ginger Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["250 g seitan, plain", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium yellow onion", "2 cloves garlic", "1 inch fresh ginger root", "300 g bell pepper, mixed colors", "250 g broccoli florets", "150 g carrots", "2 tbsp soy sauce, reduced salt", "1 tbsp sesame oil", "1 tbsp rice vinegar", "1 tsp honey", "1 tsp toasted sesame seeds", "1 tsp dried chili flakes", "10 g fresh parsley"]
instructions: Slice the seitan into thin strips and set aside. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat, then add the onion and cook for about 4 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic and ginger and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the bell pepper, broccoli, and carrots, then stir-fry for 6–8 minutes, until the vegetables are crisp-tender. Add the seitan and cook for 2–3 minutes, stirring so it browns lightly. In a small bowl, mix the reduced-salt soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, honey, and chili flakes, then pour it into the pan. Toss everything together for 1–2 minutes so the sauce coats the seitan and vegetables. Turn off the heat, sprinkle with sesame seeds and chopped parsley, and serve hot.

title: Crispy Pan-Seared Seitan with Lemon-Garlic Roasted Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["300 g seitan, plain", "500 g mixed vegetables, (broccoli, bell pepper, zucchini), raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 clove garlic", "200 g canned chickpeas, drained", "2 dl vegetable stock, low-salt", "1 pc lemon, juice and zest", "1 tsp soy sauce, reduced-salt", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 g black pepper, ground", "0.5 g salt"]
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add the seitan and cook for 4–5 minutes, turning occasionally, until browned and slightly crisp on the edges. Transfer the seitan to a plate and set aside. In the same pan, add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the mixed vegetables and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring frequently, until they are tender-crisp and starting to caramelize. Stir in the chickpeas, oregano, smoked paprika, black pepper, reduced-salt soy sauce, vegetable stock, and lemon juice and zest. Return the seitan to the pan and simmer for 3–4 minutes so everything is glossy and hot. Taste and adjust seasoning lightly, then serve immediately with any extra lemon zest over the top.

title: Crispy Lemon-Garlic Seitan with Roasted Broccoli and Tomato
ingredients_json: ["350 g seitan, plain", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 cloves garlic", "400 g broccoli", "1 medium onion", "300 g crushed tomatoes", "1 tbsp soy sauce", "1 lemon, juice", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "2 g black pepper"]
instructions: Pat the seitan dry and slice it into bite-sized strips. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and cook the seitan for 5–7 minutes, turning until the edges are lightly crisp. Add the onion (thinly sliced) and cook for another 3–4 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the crushed tomatoes, soy sauce, smoked paprika, oregano, black pepper, and lemon juice. Simmer gently for 8–10 minutes so the sauce thickens slightly. Meanwhile, roast or steam the broccoli until tender-crisp. Stir the broccoli into the pan for the last 2 minutes so it heats through, then taste and adjust the lemon intensity with extra lemon juice if needed. Serve hot with the saucy seitan and broccoli.

title: Lean Lamb and Vegetable Shepherd's Pie with Oat Mashed Potato
ingredients_json: ["1.2 kg potatoes, white, peeled", "120 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "30 g oats, rolled", "60 g butter, unsalted", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 medium carrots, raw", "250 g celery, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "500 g lamb mince, lean", "300 g frozen peas", "400 ml beef stock, low salt", "2 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "10 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C. Boil the peeled potatoes in salted water until very tender, about 15–20 minutes. Drain well, then mash with the semi-skimmed milk, butter and the rolled oats until smooth and fluffy; set aside. Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and sauté the onion, carrots and celery for 6–8 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the lamb mince and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon. Mix in the tomato paste, thyme and smoked paprika, then pour in the low-salt beef stock and simmer for 10 minutes until the mixture thickens. Fold in the frozen peas and season with black pepper. Spoon the lamb and vegetable filling into an ovenproof dish and spread the mashed potato on top, sealing the edges. Bake for 25 minutes until bubbling, then rest for 5 minutes before serving so it slices cleanly.

title: Lean Turkey Shepherd's Pie with Sweet Potato Mash and Garden Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["500 g lean turkey mince", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion", "2 medium carrots", "200 g frozen peas", "1 clove garlic", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "400 g chopped tomatoes", "300 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "800 g sweet potatoes", "150 g low-fat Greek yogurt", "2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp ground black pepper", "2 g fine salt"]
instructions:
Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the onion and carrots, cook for 6–8 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute. Add the turkey mince and cook for 8–10 minutes, breaking it up until browned. Stir in the chopped tomatoes, chicken stock, thyme, black pepper, and salt, then simmer gently for 10 minutes until slightly thickened. Fold in the peas and cook for 2–3 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel the sweet potatoes, cut them into chunks, and boil in salted water for 15–18 minutes until very tender. Drain and mash until smooth, then stir in the Greek yogurt for a creamy, lighter topping.
Spoon the turkey and vegetable filling into a baking dish and spread the sweet potato mash on top. Bake at 200°C for 20–25 minutes until hot throughout and lightly browned at the edges. Rest for 5 minutes, sprinkle over parsley, and serve.

title: Lean Turkey & Sweet Potato Shepherd's Pie with Garden Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["300 g potato, sweet", "300 g potato, white", "500 g turkey mince, lean (5-10% fat)", "150 g onion", "200 g carrots", "120 g peas, green (frozen)", "200 g mushrooms, chestnut", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 cl vegetable stock, low salt", "1 tbsp tomato purée", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp dried rosemary", "1 tsp ground black pepper", "8 g cornflour", "250 ml skimmed milk", "50 g cheddar cheese, reduced-fat"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C. Peel and chop the sweet potato and white potato into evenly sized chunks, then simmer in salted water until very tender, about 15 minutes. Drain well, then mash with the skimmed milk until smooth and creamy, adding a little black pepper if needed. While the potatoes cook, heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the onion, carrots, and mushrooms and cook for 6–7 minutes until softened and lightly browned. Add the turkey mince and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until no longer pink. Stir in the tomato purée, thyme, rosemary, and vegetable stock, then sprinkle in the cornflour and stir well; simmer for 3 minutes until the mixture thickens. Fold in the frozen peas and cook for 1 minute so they heat through. Transfer the turkey and vegetables to an ovenproof dish, spread the mash on top, and dot with the reduced-fat cheddar. Bake for 20 minutes until bubbling at the edges and lightly golden on top. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Lean Turkey and Sweet Potato Shepherd's Pie with Peas
ingredients_json: ["1 kg potatoes, white, peeled", "800 g sweet potatoes, peeled", "900 g turkey mince, 5–10% fat", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 large onion, raw", "2 carrots, raw", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "500 g mushrooms, brown, sliced", "200 g frozen peas", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "500 ml vegetable stock, low-salt", "150 ml semi-skimmed milk", "60 g butter", "2 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp dried rosemary", "2 tbsp plain flour", "1 tsp salt, fine", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C). Cook the potatoes and sweet potatoes in salted water until very tender, then drain well and mash with the milk and butter until smooth and fluffy. While the mash cooks, heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the onion and carrots and cook for 5–7 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic and mushrooms and cook for another 5 minutes until the mushrooms release their juices and start to brown. Add the turkey mince and cook until no longer pink, breaking it up as you go. Stir in the tomato paste, thyme, rosemary, flour, and black pepper, then pour in the vegetable stock. Simmer for 6–8 minutes until thickened, then fold in the peas. Transfer the filling to an ovenproof dish and spread the mash on top, smoothing it to the edges. Bake for 25–30 minutes until bubbling and lightly golden. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Garlic-Lemon Shrimp with Creamy Parmesan Grits and Peppers
ingredients_json: ["350 g shrimp, raw, peeled and deveined", "90 g grits, stone-ground, dry", "800 ml water", "300 ml milk, low-fat 2%", "30 g parmesan cheese, grated", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp garlic, minced", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 tsp sea salt", "1 pc red bell pepper, sliced", "1 pc green bell pepper, sliced", "2 pc spring onions, sliced", "1 pc lemon, zested and juiced"]
instructions: Bring the water to a boil in a medium saucepan. Whisk in the dry grits slowly, then reduce to a gentle simmer and cook for 10–12 minutes, stirring often so they don’t stick. Add the milk and continue cooking for 3–4 minutes until the grits are creamy; stir in the parmesan and half of the lemon zest, then season with a small amount of pepper. While the grits cook, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the bell peppers and cook for 4–5 minutes until slightly softened but still bright. Add the shrimp, garlic, smoked paprika, and the remaining lemon zest, then cook for 2–3 minutes per side until the shrimp turn pink and opaque. Stir in the spring onions for 30 seconds, then turn off the heat and squeeze in the lemon juice. Serve the shrimp and peppers over the creamy grits, spooning any pan juices on top.

title: Lemon-Garlic Shrimp and Creamy Parmesan Grits with Spinach
ingredients_json: ["280 g shrimp, raw, peeled, deveined", "90 g dry stone-ground grits", "1 L water", "400 ml low-fat milk, 1.5% fat", "20 g Parmesan cheese, hard", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 cloves garlic", "1 pc shallot", "180 g spinach, fresh", "15 g butter", "1 pc lemon, zest and juice", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 tsp sea salt"]
instructions: Bring 1 L water to a boil in a saucepan. Whisk in the grits and reduce to a gentle simmer, then cook for 12–15 minutes, stirring frequently, until creamy and tender. Stir in the low-fat milk, Parmesan, butter, smoked paprika, and half of the lemon juice and zest; keep warm while you cook the shrimp. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chopped shallot and cook for 2–3 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the shrimp in a single layer, season with salt and black pepper, and cook for 2–3 minutes per side until pink and just cooked through. Turn off the heat and stir in the remaining lemon juice and lemon zest. Fold the spinach into the grits until wilted, then spoon the creamy grits onto plates and top with lemon-garlic shrimp. Finish with a little extra black pepper if desired.

title: Smoky Paprika Shrimp with Creamy Parmesan Grits and Charred Corn
ingredients_json: ["500 g shrimp, raw, peeled, deveined", "90 g dry polenta-style grits, stone-ground", "1.2 L water", "200 ml low-fat milk, 1% fat", "35 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 small yellow onion, diced (150 g)", "2 clove garlic, minced", "1 tbsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp kosher salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper", "400 g corn kernels, frozen", "1 tbsp butter, salted", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "2 tbsp parsley, chopped"]
instructions: Bring 1.2 L water to a boil in a medium saucepan. Stir in the grits slowly, reduce the heat to low, and simmer for 12–15 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy. Whisk in the low-fat milk and Parmesan, then remove from heat and cover to keep warm. While the grits cook, heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 4–5 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic, smoked paprika, and thyme and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the shrimp, remaining 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 2–3 minutes per side until just pink and firm. Transfer shrimp to a plate. In the same skillet, melt the butter and add the corn; cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until some kernels are lightly charred. Return shrimp to the skillet, squeeze in the lemon juice, and toss for 30–60 seconds to coat and warm through. Serve shrimp and charred corn over creamy Parmesan grits and finish with parsley.

title: Creamy Cajun-Style Shrimp and Cheddar Grits with Peppers and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["60 g quick-cooking grits (corn grits)", "600 ml water", "200 ml low-fat milk (1.5%)", "40 g mature cheddar cheese", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 small red bell pepper (170 g), diced", "1 small red onion (110 g), finely chopped", "2 cloves garlic (6 g), minced", "1 tsp smoked paprika (2 g)", "0.5 tsp dried oregano (1 g)", "0.5 tsp fine sea salt (1 g)", "0.25 tsp black pepper (0.5 g)", "450 g shrimp, raw, peeled and deveined", "300 g baby spinach", "1 tbsp lemon juice (15 ml)", "1 tbsp chopped fresh parsley (5 g)"]
instructions: Bring the water to a gentle boil in a medium pot. Whisk in the grits and reduce to a low simmer, cooking for about 5–7 minutes until thick and creamy, stirring often so they don’t stick. Stir in the milk and cheddar until melted and smooth, then keep warm over very low heat. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and bell pepper and cook for 6–8 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic, smoked paprika, oregano, salt, and black pepper and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the shrimp to the skillet and cook for 2–3 minutes per side until pink and just cooked through; avoid overcooking. Stir in the spinach until wilted, then turn off the heat and squeeze in the lemon juice. Serve the shrimp and vegetables over the cheesy grits and finish with parsley.

title: Creamy Garlic-Lime Shrimp and White Cheddar Grits with Spinach
ingredients_json: ["300 g raw shrimp, peeled and deveined", "250 g water", "60 g stone-ground corn grits", "300 g low-fat milk (1.5%)", "40 g white cheddar cheese, reduced-fat", "10 g olive oil", "2 cloves garlic, fresh", "1 small shallot", "200 g cherry tomatoes", "60 g fresh spinach", "1 tbsp fresh lime juice", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "1.2 g fine salt"]
instructions: Bring the water to a simmer in a medium saucepan. Whisk in the corn grits and cook for 8–10 minutes until thick and creamy, stirring frequently to prevent sticking. Pour in the low-fat milk, add the cheddar, and continue cooking for 2–3 minutes until the grits are smooth and gently thickened. While the grits cook, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and sauté the diced shallot for 2 minutes. Add the minced garlic and smoked paprika and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the cherry tomatoes and cook for 4–5 minutes until they begin to burst and form a light sauce. Add the shrimp in a single layer and cook for 2–3 minutes per side until pink and just cooked through. Stir in the spinach until wilted, then finish with lime juice, black pepper, and the salt. Serve the shrimp and sauce over the creamy grits.

title: Garlic-Lemon Shrimp Scampi with Spinach and Whole-Wheat Pasta
ingredients_json: ["350 g raw shrimp, peeled and deveined", "250 g whole-wheat spaghetti, dry", "15 g olive oil", "3 cloves garlic, fresh", "1 dl dry white wine", "200 g cherry tomatoes", "120 g fresh spinach", "1 pc lemon, zest and juice", "5 g butter, salted", "3 g fine sea salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "1 g dried red chili flakes"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the whole-wheat spaghetti until al dente, then reserve about 2 dl of the pasta water and drain. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and add the butter. Sauté the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant, then add the shrimp and cook for 1–2 minutes per side until they turn pink and opaque. Stir in the white wine and let it simmer for 2–3 minutes to reduce slightly, then add the cherry tomatoes and cook until they start to burst, about 4–5 minutes. Add the spinach and toss until just wilted. Stir in the cooked spaghetti, lemon zest and juice, black pepper, and chili flakes, adding a splash of reserved pasta water to create a light, glossy sauce. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt if needed, then serve right away with extra lemon if desired.

title: Lemony Garlic Shrimp Scampi with Whole-Grain Pasta
ingredients_json: ["500 g raw shrimp, peeled and deveined", "250 g whole-grain spaghetti, dry", "30 g olive oil", "4 clove garlic", "1 pc lemon, zest and juice", "300 g cherry tomatoes", "200 g spinach, fresh", "15 g unsalted butter", "5 g fresh parsley", "2 g black pepper", "3 g sea salt"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the whole-grain spaghetti until al dente according to the package instructions. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil and butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the garlic and cook for about 30–45 seconds until fragrant, being careful not to brown it. Add the cherry tomatoes and cook for 4–6 minutes, until they start to burst and form a light sauce. Stir in the shrimp and cook for 2–3 minutes per side until pink and just cooked through. Add the spinach and cook until wilted, then add the lemon zest and lemon juice and toss well. Drain the pasta, add it to the skillet, and toss to coat in the garlicky sauce. Season with black pepper and a little extra salt if needed, then finish with chopped parsley and serve hot.

title: Garlic-Lemon Shrimp Scampi with Whole Wheat Spaghetti
ingredients_json: ["320 g shrimp, raw, peeled and deveined", "300 g whole wheat spaghetti, dry", "30 g olive oil", "4 clove garlic, fresh", "1 piece lemon, zest and juice", "250 g cherry tomatoes", "100 g spinach, fresh", "2 g red chili flakes, dried", "10 g parsley, fresh", "10 g grated parmesan cheese", "3 g salt, fine", "500 ml water"]
instructions: Bring 500 ml water to a boil in a large pot, add 3 g salt, and cook the whole wheat spaghetti according to package directions until al dente. While the pasta cooks, heat 30 g olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and add the garlic and red chili flakes; stir for about 30 seconds until fragrant, being careful not to brown the garlic. Add the cherry tomatoes and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they start to burst and form a light sauce. Add the shrimp to the skillet, season with the lemon juice and zest, and cook for 2 to 3 minutes per side until the shrimp turn pink and opaque. Stir in the spinach and cook for 1 minute until wilted, then fold in the drained spaghetti and toss well to coat. Finish with chopped parsley and parmesan, and serve immediately with extra lemon zest if desired.

title: Lemony Garlic Shrimp Scampi with Whole-Wheat Pasta and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["500 g shrimp, raw, peeled and deveined", "250 g whole-wheat spaghetti, dry", "2 tbsp olive oil", "4 cloves garlic", "200 g spinach, fresh", "250 ml vegetable stock, low-salt", "150 ml white wine, dry", "1 pc lemon, zest and juice", "2 tbsp parsley, fresh, chopped", "1 tsp red chili flakes", "1/2 tsp black pepper, ground", "1/2 tsp salt, fine"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the whole-wheat spaghetti according to package directions until al dente. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and chili flakes and cook for 30–60 seconds until fragrant, being careful not to brown the garlic. Add the shrimp in a single layer and cook for about 2–3 minutes per side until pink and just cooked through. Pour in the white wine and vegetable stock, then simmer for 3–4 minutes to reduce slightly. Stir in the spinach and lemon zest and juice, cooking until the spinach wilts. Add the drained pasta to the skillet and toss well so the sauce coats everything; if it looks dry, add a splash of cooking water. Season with black pepper and the salt, then turn off the heat and fold in the chopped parsley. Serve immediately with extra lemon if desired.

title: Turkey and Spinach Sliders with Tomato-Balsamic Glaze
ingredients_json: ["500 g turkey mince, lean (5% fat)", "150 g spinach, fresh", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic", "1 piece egg, whole", "60 g wholemeal breadcrumbs", "1 tsp olive oil", "500 g cherry tomatoes", "2 tbsp balsamic vinegar", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp salt, fine", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "8 slices wholegrain bread, thin (or slider buns)"]
instructions: Finely chop the onion and garlic. Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook the onion for 4–5 minutes until soft. Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the fresh spinach and cook until wilted. Remove from the heat and let it cool slightly. In a bowl, combine the turkey mince, cooked spinach mixture, egg, wholemeal breadcrumbs, oregano, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. Mix well until evenly combined, then shape into 8 small patties sized to fit your buns. Heat a nonstick pan over medium-high heat and cook the patties for 4–5 minutes per side until browned and cooked through. Meanwhile, simmer the cherry tomatoes with tomato paste and balsamic vinegar in a saucepan over medium heat for 10–12 minutes until the tomatoes break down into a thick glaze. Toast the bread lightly in the pan or under a grill for 1–2 minutes. Assemble each slider by placing a turkey patty on the bun and spooning over the tomato-balsamic glaze.

title: Turkey & Black Bean Taco Sliders with Avocado-Lime Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["500 g Turkey mince, lean", "220 g Black beans, cooked, drained", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, yellow, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 tbsp Tomato paste", "2 tsp Ground cumin", "2 tsp Smoked paprika", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1 tsp Chili powder", "200 g Peppers, bell, red, raw", "1 tbsp Lime juice", "1 tsp Salt", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "10 slices Wholegrain bread, thin (or small slider buns), sliced", "200 g Greek yogurt, low fat", "1 piece Avocado, raw", "1 tbsp Fresh coriander, chopped"]
instructions:
Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the diced onion and cook for 4 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic, tomato paste, cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, and chili powder, and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the turkey mince and cook for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until it is browned and cooked through. Add the chopped red bell pepper and black beans, then cook for 4 minutes more until the peppers are tender and the filling thickens slightly. Season with lime juice, salt, and black pepper.

Mix the low-fat Greek yogurt with the flesh of the avocado (mashed), chopped coriander, and a little black pepper. Toast the wholegrain bread slices or slider buns in a dry pan for 1–2 minutes per side so they hold up. Assemble the sliders by spooning the turkey-black bean filling onto the bread and topping with the avocado-lime yogurt. Serve warm.

title: Turkey & Black Bean Mini Sliders with Smoky Tomato Avocado Salsa
ingredients_json: ["400 g turkey mince, 5% fat", "1 pc onion, raw", "1 clove garlic, raw", "1 can black beans, drained and rinsed", "1 pc egg, raw", "60 g breadcrumbs, wholemeal", "2 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp fine salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "300 g tomatoes, chopped", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "1 tbsp lime juice", "1 pc avocado, raw", "2 tbsp olive oil", "8 pcs wholegrain slider buns", "60 g romaine lettuce, shredded", "40 g reduced-fat cheddar cheese, grated"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a tray with baking paper. Finely chop the onion and garlic, then heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 4 minutes until soft. Stir in the garlic and tomato paste, cook for 1 minute, then add the chopped tomatoes and simmer for 6–8 minutes until slightly thickened. Drain and rinse the black beans, then mash half of them and fold them into a bowl with the turkey mince, egg, breadcrumbs, smoked paprika, cumin, oregano, salt, and black pepper. Shape the mixture into small slider patties (about 8). Bake for 14–18 minutes until cooked through and lightly browned. While the patties bake, mash the avocado with lime juice and a spoon of the warm tomato mixture to make a creamy salsa. Split the slider buns and briefly warm them in the oven for 2 minutes. Assemble each slider with a romaine lettuce base, a turkey-black bean patty, a spoon of smoky tomato sauce, and a little avocado mixture, then finish with a small amount of grated cheddar and return to the oven for 2–3 minutes just to melt.

title: Turkey & Black Bean Southwest Sliders with Avocado Lime Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["450 g turkey mince, lean", "240 g black beans, canned, drained and rinsed", "1 piece red onion", "2 cloves garlic", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp fine salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "8 piece wholemeal slider buns", "200 g Greek yogurt, low fat", "1 piece lime", "1 piece avocado, ripe", "60 g tomato, chopped", "60 g lettuce, shredded", "1 tsp honey"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a nonstick frying pan over medium heat. Finely chop the red onion and add it to the pan with a pinch of salt; cook for 5–6 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then stir in the cumin, smoked paprika and oregano until fragrant. Add the turkey mince and cook for 8–10 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until no longer pink. Stir in the black beans, tomato paste, black pepper and the remaining salt, then cook for 2 minutes to thicken slightly. Mix the Greek yogurt with the juice of the lime, the honey and a pinch of pepper, then mash the avocado lightly and fold half into the yogurt sauce. Toast the slider buns lightly. Assemble the sliders with the turkey-bean filling, shredded lettuce, chopped tomato, and a generous spoon of avocado lime yogurt sauce. Finish with a little extra avocado on top and serve right away.

title: Turkey and Veggie Sliders with Smoky Tomato Yogurt Sauce
