ingredients_json: ["450 g turkey mince, lean", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "180 g bell pepper, red", "150 g mushrooms, white", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "1.5 g salt, table salt", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "200 g natural yogurt, low-fat", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "8 pieces wholegrain slider buns", "40 g baby spinach"]
instructions: Finely chop the onion, garlic, bell pepper, and mushrooms. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the vegetables for 6–8 minutes until they soften and any moisture evaporates. Add the turkey mince to the pan with the cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, black pepper, and salt, then cook for 8–10 minutes, breaking it up until browned and cooked through. Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then remove from the heat. Mix the low-fat yogurt with the lemon juice and a small spoon of the cooked turkey juices for a smoky, tangy sauce. Lightly warm the slider buns, then fill them with the turkey mixture. Add a handful of baby spinach to each slider so it wilts slightly from the hot filling, and spoon over the yogurt sauce. Serve immediately.

title: Turkey and Lentil Sloppy Joes with Tomato-Hot Sauce and Veggie Mash
ingredients_json: ["350 g lean ground turkey", "120 g dry brown lentils", "1 medium yellow onion", "1 medium carrot", "2 stalks celery", "2 cloves garlic", "1 tbsp olive oil", "400 g canned crushed tomatoes", "200 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "60 g ketchup", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce", "1 tbsp apple cider vinegar", "8 g kosher salt", "2 dl water", "6 pieces whole wheat burger buns"]
instructions: Rinse the lentils, then put them in a saucepan with 2 dl water and bring to a simmer. Cook for about 18–22 minutes until tender but not mushy, then drain well and set aside. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the finely diced onion, carrot, and celery and cook for 6–8 minutes until softened. Stir in the minced garlic, smoked paprika, and cumin and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the ground turkey and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, for 8–10 minutes until no longer pink. Stir in the crushed tomatoes, chicken stock, ketchup, tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, apple cider vinegar, and the salt, then simmer on low for 10 minutes. Fold in the cooked lentils and simmer for another 3–5 minutes until the mixture is thick and cohesive. Toast the whole wheat buns briefly in a dry pan and serve the sloppy joe filling hot with any extra sauce from the pan.

title: Turkey Sloppy Joes with Homemade Tomato-Chili Sauce and Whole-Grain Buns
ingredients_json: ["450 g turkey mince, lean", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic", "1 piece carrot, raw", "1 piece green bell pepper", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "400 g chopped tomatoes, canned", "120 g kidney beans, cooked, drained", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp ground black pepper", "1.5 tsp salt", "60 ml beef-style stock, low-salt", "300 g whole-grain burger buns", "60 g cheddar cheese, reduced-fat"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion, diced carrot, and green bell pepper and cook for 6–8 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant. Add the turkey mince and cook for 7–9 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and cooked through. Pour in the chopped tomatoes and low-salt stock, then add the kidney beans, smoked paprika, oregano, black pepper, and 1.5 tsp salt. Simmer on low for 10–12 minutes until the sauce thickens and looks glossy. Toast the whole-grain buns lightly, then spoon the turkey mixture onto the buns and top with reduced-fat cheddar. Serve hot.

title: Turkey Sloppy Joes with Tomato-Bean Sauce and Wholegrain Buns
ingredients_json: ["450 g turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "1 piece onion, yellow, diced", "1 piece carrot, grated", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes", "120 g canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed", "80 ml beef-style stock, low salt", "2 tbsp ketchup, no sugar added", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, low sugar", "1 tsp apple cider vinegar", "1/2 tsp salt", "200 g wholegrain buns", "1 piece green bell pepper, diced", "30 g cheddar cheese, reduced fat, grated"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the diced onion and green bell pepper and cook for 6–8 minutes until softened. Stir in the grated carrot and cook for 2 minutes, then add the minced garlic, smoked paprika, and dried oregano and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the turkey mince and cook for 8–10 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and no longer pink. Stir in the canned chopped tomatoes, drained kidney beans, low-salt stock, ketchup, tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, and apple cider vinegar. Simmer gently for 12–15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens; check seasoning and add the salt if needed. Meanwhile, toast the wholegrain buns lightly. Spoon the hot filling into the buns, top with reduced-fat cheddar, and serve immediately.

title: Lean Turkey Sloppy Joes with Smoky Tomato Sauce and Whole-Grain Mustard
ingredients_json: ["450 g Turkey mince, 10% fat", "1 medium Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 medium Red bell pepper, raw", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tbsp Tomato paste", "400 g Canned chopped tomatoes, no added salt", "150 g Kidney beans, canned, drained and rinsed", "80 ml Beef stock, low-salt", "2 tbsp Wholegrain mustard", "1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, reduced sugar", "1 tsp Smoked paprika, ground", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "0.5 tsp Salt", "6 slices Whole grain bread"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and diced red bell pepper and cook for 6–8 minutes, until softened. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the turkey mince. Cook for 8–10 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until no longer pink. Mix in the tomato paste, smoked paprika, and cumin, and cook for 1 minute to deepen the flavour. Add chopped tomatoes, kidney beans, low-salt beef stock, wholegrain mustard, Worcestershire sauce, and black pepper, then simmer for 12–15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens. Taste and adjust seasoning with the salt if needed. Serve the turkey mixture piled onto whole-grain bread slices while hot.

title: Wholewheat Spaghetti with Turkey Meatballs, Spinach & Tomato Basil Sauce
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholewheat spaghetti (dry)", "300 g turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "1 piece egg, raw", "60 g breadcrumbs, wholemeal", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "500 g passata (crushed tomatoes)", "200 g spinach, fresh", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp dried basil", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "50 g parmesan, hard"]
instructions: Cook the wholewheat spaghetti in a large pot of boiling salted water according to the package instructions until al dente. While it cooks, heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat and sauté the finely chopped onion for 5–7 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Add the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then stir in the passata, oregano, and dried basil. Simmer gently for 10–12 minutes, then fold in the spinach and cook until wilted, about 2–3 minutes. In a bowl, mix the turkey mince, egg, breadcrumbs, half of the parmesan, black pepper, and 0.5 tsp of the salt until well combined, then shape into small meatballs. Heat a separate pan over medium heat and cook the meatballs for 8–10 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are browned and cooked through. Add the meatballs to the tomato sauce and simmer for 3–4 minutes to coat. Drain the pasta and toss with the sauce, finishing with the remaining parmesan and the rest of the salt as needed. Serve hot and check that the turkey meatballs are fully cooked with no pink in the center.

title: Wholewheat Spaghetti with Lentil Bolognese and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["280 g wholewheat spaghetti, dry", "300 g lentils, cooked, drained", "400 g passata, no added sugar", "120 g carrot, raw", "120 g onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic", "1 tbsp olive oil", "30 g tomato paste, concentrated", "200 g spinach, fresh", "10 g olive oil, for serving", "5 g Italian herb blend, dried", "2 g black pepper, ground", "4 g salt"]
instructions: Cook the wholewheat spaghetti in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente, then drain and reserve a small splash of cooking water. While the pasta cooks, heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Finely chop the onion and carrot, sauté them for 6–8 minutes until softened, then add the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Stir in the tomato paste and dried Italian herb blend, and cook for 1 minute to deepen the flavor. Add the passata and cooked lentils, bring to a gentle simmer, and cook for 12–15 minutes, stirring occasionally; if the sauce thickens too much, loosen it with a little reserved pasta water. Fold in the spinach and let it wilt for 1–2 minutes. Toss the spaghetti with the lentil bolognese, add a little extra black pepper, and serve immediately with a final drizzle of olive oil.

title: Wholewheat Spaghetti with Turkey Meatballs, Tomato Basil Sauce
ingredients_json: ["320 g wholewheat spaghetti, dry", "500 g turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "1 piece egg, raw", "30 g breadcrumbs, wholemeal", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 onion, yellow", "2 clove garlic", "700 g passata di pomodoro", "200 g courgette", "150 g bell pepper, red", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp dried basil", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "50 g parmesan cheese, hard"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil and cook the wholewheat spaghetti until al dente, stirring occasionally. While it cooks, make the turkey meatballs by mixing turkey mince, the raw egg, breadcrumbs, half the oregano, half the dried basil, black pepper, and a little salt, then roll into small balls. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and brown the meatballs in batches for about 5–7 minutes, turning until golden; remove to a plate. In the same pan, sauté the finely chopped onion and garlic for 2–3 minutes, then add the courgette and bell pepper diced, and cook for another 4–5 minutes until slightly softened. Stir in the passata, remaining oregano and basil, and the rest of the salt, then simmer for 10–12 minutes. Return the meatballs to the sauce for the final 6–8 minutes to heat through and finish cooking. Drain the spaghetti, toss it briefly with some sauce, and serve topped with parmesan.

title: Wholewheat Spaghetti with Turkey Bolognese and Hidden Veg
ingredients_json: ["350 g wholewheat spaghetti, dry", "300 g turkey mince, lean (5% fat)", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion", "2 clove garlic", "1 piece carrot", "1 piece courgette", "400 g chopped tomatoes, canned", "200 g passata", "2 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp dried basil", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "30 g parmesan cheese, hard"]
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in a large pot of salted boiling water according to the package instructions until al dente. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat and add the onion and carrot, grated or finely diced. Cook for 5–7 minutes until softened, then add the garlic and stir for 30 seconds. Add the turkey mince and cook until it is browned and no longer pink, breaking it up with a spoon. Stir in the courgette, oregano, basil, and smoked paprika, then pour in the chopped tomatoes and passata. Simmer gently for 15–20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens slightly; add black pepper and adjust the salt if needed. Drain the spaghetti and toss it with the turkey bolognese. Serve hot with parmesan on top.

title: Wholewheat Spaghetti with Turkey Tomato-Basil Sauce and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["320 g wholewheat spaghetti (dry)", "300 g turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes", "200 g passata (tomato sauce)", "180 g spinach, fresh", "1 medium onion", "2 cloves garlic", "30 ml olive oil", "12 g parmesan, hard (grated)", "10 g dried basil", "5 g dried oregano", "3 g table salt", "2 g black pepper"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil and cook the wholewheat spaghetti until al dente according to the packet instructions. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat and sauté the finely chopped onion for 4–5 minutes until soft. Add the garlic and cook for about 30 seconds, then add the turkey mince and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring until browned. Stir in the chopped tomatoes, passata, dried basil, oregano, salt, and black pepper, then simmer gently for 12–15 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly. Add the spinach and stir until wilted, about 2 minutes. Drain the spaghetti, add it to the pan with the sauce, and toss well over low heat for 1 minute so everything is coated. Serve hot with grated parmesan on top.

title: Chicken and Roasted Pepper Spanish Rice with Peas and Smoked Paprika
ingredients_json: ["250 g long-grain rice", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion", "2 clove garlic", "1 medium red bell pepper", "1 medium carrot", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1/2 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp dried oregano", "600 ml chicken stock, low sodium", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes", "200 g chicken breast, raw", "150 g frozen peas", "10 g fresh parsley", "5 g table salt", "1/2 tsp black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion and cook for 5 minutes until softened, then stir in the grated garlic. Add the diced red bell pepper and carrot and cook for 6–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables begin to brown at the edges. Sprinkle in the smoked paprika, cumin, and oregano, then cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the rice and stir well so the grains are coated in the spices. Pour in the low-sodium chicken stock and canned chopped tomatoes, bring to a gentle boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes. Add the chicken breast cut into bite-sized cubes and continue simmering for 8 minutes, stirring once or twice so the rice cooks evenly. Stir in the frozen peas and cook for 3–4 minutes until tender. Turn off the heat, fold through the chopped parsley, and let the pan sit covered for 5 minutes. Serve hot, with black pepper if you like.

title: One-Pan Chicken and Roasted Red Pepper Spanish Rice
ingredients_json: ["320 g basmati rice, dry", "450 g chicken breast, raw, skinless", "1 medium onion", "2 cloves garlic", "1 red bell pepper", "250 g chopped canned tomatoes, no salt added", "700 ml chicken stock, low salt", "60 ml olive oil", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "2 tsp sweet paprika", "1 tsp ground cumin", "0.5 tsp dried oregano", "1 g saffron threads", "1.5 tsp salt, fine", "100 g frozen green peas"]
instructions:
Heat the olive oil in a large heavy pan over medium heat. Add the onion (finely chopped) and cook for 5–7 minutes until softened and lightly golden. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the chicken breast cut into bite-size pieces and cook for 6–8 minutes, turning occasionally, until no longer pink.
Add the red bell pepper (diced) and cook for 2 minutes. Mix in the tomato paste, paprika, cumin, oregano, and saffron, stirring well so the spices coat the chicken and vegetables. Pour in the chopped tomatoes and chicken stock, then bring to a gentle boil.
Stir in the rice, reduce the heat to low, and cover with a lid. Simmer for 15 minutes without stirring. Add the green peas, then cover and cook for another 10–12 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed. Rest the pan, still covered, for 5 minutes before serving, and check seasoning before eating.

title: Chicken and Vegetable Spanish Rice with Smoked Paprika
ingredients_json: ["250 g chicken breast, raw", "200 g long-grain rice, uncooked", "1 medium onion", "2 cloves garlic", "1 red bell pepper", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "5 dl chicken stock, low sodium", "2 dl canned chopped tomatoes", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1/2 tsp dried oregano", "1/2 tsp salt", "1/4 tsp black pepper", "80 g frozen peas", "40 g fresh parsley"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or deep pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and bell pepper and cook for about 6 minutes, stirring often, until softened. Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the diced chicken breast, smoked paprika, cumin, and oregano. Cook for 6–8 minutes until the chicken is lightly browned and mostly cooked through. Mix in the tomato paste, cook for 1 minute to deepen the flavour, then add the rice and stir to coat it. Pour in the chicken stock and chopped tomatoes, bring to a gentle boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes. After 15 minutes, stir in the peas, re-cover, and simmer for another 5–7 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed. Turn off the heat, let it rest covered for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork and finish with freshly chopped parsley.

title: Chicken and Smoky Vegetable Spanish Rice with Paprika
ingredients_json: ["300 g chicken breast, raw, boneless and skinless", "250 g long-grain rice, uncooked", "200 g canned chopped tomatoes, no added salt", "120 g red bell pepper", "140 g yellow onion", "20 g extra-virgin olive oil", "300 ml chicken stock, low-salt", "350 ml water", "40 g frozen peas", "30 g green olives, pitted", "2 g garlic, minced", "6 g sweet paprika", "1 g ground cumin", "2 g dried oregano", "1 g salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large heavy-bottomed pan over medium-high heat and brown the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes until lightly golden and cooked through. Lower the heat to medium and add the onion and bell pepper; cook for 6 to 8 minutes until the vegetables soften. Stir in the garlic, paprika, cumin, and oregano, and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the rice and stir well so the grains are coated with the spice mixture. Pour in the chicken stock and water, then add the chopped tomatoes; bring to a gentle simmer. Cook uncovered for 12 to 14 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the rice is almost tender. Fold in the peas and olives, then cover and cook for a further 6 to 8 minutes until the rice is tender and most of the liquid is absorbed. Taste and adjust with black pepper; serve hot.

title: Chicken and Veggie Spanish Rice with Smoked Paprika
ingredients_json: ["250 g chicken breast, raw", "180 g long-grain white rice, dry", "1 piece onion, raw", "1 piece red bell pepper, raw", "2 pieces garlic cloves, raw", "200 g canned chopped tomatoes, in tomato juice (drained)", "1.2 dl olive oil", "1.5 tbsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tbsp dried oregano", "1.6 l chicken stock, low salt", "200 g green peas, frozen", "80 g carrots, raw", "30 g grated hard cheese, Parmesan"]
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into small bite-size pieces. Dice the onion and carrots, slice the red bell pepper into thin strips, and mince the garlic. Heat the olive oil in a large deep pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook for about 6–8 minutes, stirring often, until lightly browned and mostly cooked through. Add the onion, carrot, and bell pepper and cook for 5 minutes until the vegetables soften. Stir in the garlic, smoked paprika, and oregano for 30 seconds, then add the rice and stir well so it’s coated with the spices. Pour in the hot chicken stock and add the chopped tomatoes; bring to a simmer. Cook uncovered on a gentle simmer for 15 minutes, then stir in the frozen peas and cook for another 5–7 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed. Turn off the heat and let it stand for 2 minutes, then fold through the Parmesan and serve hot.

title: Smoky Ham and Split Pea Soup with Carrots and Thyme
ingredients_json: ["250 g dried split peas (yellow or green)", "1.2 liters vegetable stock (low-salt)", "150 g smoked ham, diced", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion, diced (about 150 g)", "2 medium carrots, diced (about 160 g)", "2 celery stalks, diced (about 120 g)", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 bay leaf", "1/2 tsp black pepper, ground", "1/2 tsp salt"]
instructions: Rinse the split peas under cold water, then set aside. Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté the onion, carrots, and celery for about 8 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then add the smoked ham, thyme, and bay leaf. Add the rinsed split peas and pour in the vegetable stock. Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce to a steady simmer and cook for 35–45 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the peas have fully broken down and the soup is thick and creamy. Season with black pepper and salt, remove the bay leaf, and serve hot.

title: Smoky Split Pea Soup with Carrots, Celery & Bay Leaf
ingredients_json: ["300 g dry split peas, green", "1.2 l vegetable stock, low-salt", "150 g smoked turkey breast, lean, diced", "1 large onion, yellow, diced", "2 medium carrots, diced", "2 stalks celery, sliced", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 bay leaf", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "150 g spinach, fresh", "10 g lemon juice"]
instructions: Rinse the split peas under cold water and set aside. In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the diced onion, carrot, and celery for 6–8 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic, thyme, smoked paprika, and black pepper and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the diced smoked turkey and cook for 2 minutes, then pour in the low-salt vegetable stock and add the bay leaf. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat to a gentle simmer, and cook for 35–45 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the split peas are very tender and the soup has thickened. Add the spinach during the last 2 minutes to wilt it through. Turn off the heat and stir in the lemon juice to brighten the flavour. Taste and adjust consistency by simmering 3–5 minutes if you want it thicker.

title: Creamy Split Pea and Smoked Ham Soup with Carrots and Thyme
ingredients_json: ["300 g dried green split peas", "200 g smoked ham, lean, diced", "1 piece onion", "2 cloves garlic", "2 pieces carrots", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1.5 litre vegetable stock", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "2 tsp dried thyme", "1 piece bay leaf", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "2.5 g salt", "200 g kale, chopped"]
instructions: Rinse the split peas under cold water until the water runs mostly clear. Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat, then cook the diced onion and carrots for 8–10 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and tomato paste and stir for 1 minute until fragrant. Tip in the split peas, thyme, bay leaf, black pepper, and the diced smoked ham, then pour in the vegetable stock. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat to low, and simmer for 45–60 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the peas are very tender and the soup is thick and creamy. Add the chopped kale for the last 10 minutes of cooking, and adjust the consistency with a splash of water if it becomes too thick. Remove the bay leaf, taste for seasoning, and serve hot.

title: Ginger-Garlic Salmon & Veggie Stir-Fry with Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["180 g salmon fillet, raw", "220 g broccoli florets", "180 g bell pepper, red", "160 g carrots, raw", "120 g pak choi", "250 g cooked brown rice", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp sesame oil", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "15 g fresh ginger", "4 tbsp soy sauce, reduced salt", "2 tbsp rice vinegar", "1 tbsp honey", "1 tsp cornstarch", "1 tbsp water", "1 tsp sesame seeds, hulled"]
instructions: Cut the salmon into bite-sized pieces and pat dry. Heat the olive oil in a large wok or frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the salmon and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes until it turns opaque and flakes easily; remove to a plate. Add the ginger and garlic and stir for 30 seconds, then add the carrots and bell pepper and cook for about 3 minutes, stirring frequently. Add the broccoli and pak choi and stir-fry for another 4–5 minutes until the vegetables are crisp-tender. In a bowl, whisk the reduced-salt soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, cornstarch, and water until smooth, then pour it into the wok. Add the salmon back in and toss everything for 1–2 minutes until the sauce thickens and coats the ingredients. Serve the stir-fry over the cooked brown rice and finish with sesame seeds.

title: Ginger-Soy Salmon and Veggie Stir-Fry with Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["180 g salmon fillet, raw", "300 g broccoli florets", "200 g bell pepper, red", "180 g carrot, raw", "100 g onion, white", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "15 g fresh ginger", "30 ml low-sodium soy sauce", "15 ml rice vinegar", "10 ml sesame oil", "200 g cooked brown rice", "1 tbsp lime juice, fresh", "5 g sesame seeds"]
instructions: Cut the salmon into bite-sized pieces and pat them dry with kitchen paper. Chop the broccoli into small florets, slice the bell pepper, grate the carrot, and thinly slice the onion. Finely chop the garlic and ginger. Heat a large wok or heavy frying pan over medium-high heat and add the sesame oil. Stir-fry the onion for 1–2 minutes until it starts to soften, then add the garlic and ginger and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the carrots and bell pepper and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes, then add the broccoli and splash in 2–3 tablespoons of water; stir-fry for another 3–4 minutes until the vegetables are crisp-tender and bright in color. Add the salmon pieces and cook for 2–3 minutes, stirring gently, until just opaque. In a small bowl mix the low-sodium soy sauce and rice vinegar, then pour it into the wok and toss everything together for 30–60 seconds so the sauce lightly coats. Turn off the heat, squeeze in the lime juice, and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Serve immediately with the cooked brown rice.

title: Ginger-Lime Salmon & Veggie Stir-Fry with Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["220 g salmon fillet, raw", "220 g brown rice, dry", "250 g broccoli florets", "180 g bell pepper, red", "160 g carrot", "150 g sugar snap peas", "3 cloves garlic", "20 g fresh ginger", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce", "1 tbsp lime juice", "1 tsp toasted sesame oil", "2 tbsp water"]
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to the package instructions until tender, then keep warm. Cut the salmon into bite-sized cubes, slice the pepper, julienne the carrot, and cut the broccoli and snap peas into evenly sized pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large wok over high heat until shimmering, then add the garlic (minced) and ginger (finely grated) and stir for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the carrot and broccoli first and stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes, then add the bell pepper and snap peas and continue stir-frying for another 2 to 3 minutes until the vegetables are crisp-tender. Add the salmon and stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes, turning gently, until the salmon is just cooked and flakes easily. Stir together the soy sauce, lime juice, sesame oil, and water, pour it into the wok, and toss for 30 to 60 seconds to coat everything well. Serve the stir-fry over the warm brown rice.

title: Ginger-Soy Chicken and Vegetable Stir-Fry with Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["250 g chicken breast, raw", "250 g broccoli florets", "200 g bell pepper, red, sliced", "180 g carrots, sliced", "150 g mushrooms, sliced", "80 g brown rice, dry", "20 g fresh ginger, minced", "3 cloves garlic, minced", "2 tbsp olive oil", "3 tbsp low-salt soy sauce", "1 tbsp rice vinegar", "1 tbsp honey", "10 g sesame seeds, toasted", "200 ml vegetable stock, low-salt"]
instructions: Cook the brown rice in a saucepan with the vegetable stock according to the package instructions, until tender and the liquid is absorbed. Heat a large wok over high heat and add the olive oil. Add the chicken breast strips and stir-fry for 6–8 minutes, until browned and cooked through. Add the ginger and garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds, then add the carrots and cook for 2 minutes. Add the broccoli, bell pepper, and mushrooms and stir-fry for another 4–6 minutes, until the vegetables are crisp-tender. Stir together the low-salt soy sauce, rice vinegar, and honey, then pour it into the wok and toss well for 1 minute so the sauce lightly coats everything. Serve the stir-fry over the hot brown rice and finish with toasted sesame seeds.

title: Turkey and Quinoa Stuffed Peppers with Tomato-Lime Sauce
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces Bell peppers, red", "250 g Turkey mince, lean (5% fat)", "180 g Quinoa, uncooked", "400 g Tomato passata", "120 g Onion, yellow", "2 cloves Garlic", "200 g Mushrooms, white", "20 g Olive oil", "10 g Ground cumin", "8 g Smoked paprika", "5 g Dried oregano", "10 g Lime juice", "60 g Feta cheese", "200 ml Vegetable stock, low-salt", "4 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. Halve the bell peppers lengthwise and remove the seeds. Place the pepper halves in a baking dish, cut-side up. Rinse the quinoa, then simmer it in the low-salt vegetable stock for about 15 minutes until the grains are tender and the liquid is mostly absorbed. Meanwhile, heat 10 g of the olive oil in a pan and sauté the diced onion and sliced mushrooms for 6–8 minutes until they soften and any moisture cooks off. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then brown the turkey mince in the pan for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up until no pink remains. Stir in the cumin, smoked paprika and oregano, then mix in the tomato passata and lime juice and simmer for 3–4 minutes to thicken slightly. Combine the cooked quinoa with the turkey-tomato mixture, then crumble the feta into the filling. Spoon the filling evenly into the pepper halves and drizzle with the remaining 10 g olive oil. Cover the dish with foil and bake for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and bake another 10 minutes until the peppers are tender and the tops are lightly browned. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Turkey and Quinoa Stuffed Peppers with Tomato-Lime Sauce
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces Bell peppers, red", "300 g Turkey mince, lean (5-10% fat)", "160 g Quinoa, uncooked", "500 ml Vegetable stock, low salt", "1 piece Onion, yellow", "2 pieces Garlic cloves", "200 g Canned chopped tomatoes", "2 tbsp Tomato paste", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "10 g Fresh parsley", "1 piece Lime", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "3 g Salt", "80 g Feta cheese, reduced-fat"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. Halve the bell peppers and remove the seeds and white ribs. Place them in a baking dish and drizzle with half of the olive oil. Bake for 15 minutes until slightly softened. Meanwhile, rinse the quinoa and cook it in the vegetable stock for about 15 minutes, until the liquid is absorbed and the quinoa is fluffy. Dice the onion and mince the garlic, then sauté them in a pan with the remaining olive oil for 4 to 5 minutes until the onion is translucent. Add the turkey mince and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up until browned. Stir in the tomatoes, tomato paste, cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, black pepper, and 2 g of salt, then simmer for 5 minutes. Fold the cooked quinoa through the turkey mixture and finish with the lime zest and juice plus chopped parsley. Remove the peppers from the oven and fill them generously with the stuffing. Crumble the feta on top and bake for another 15 to 18 minutes, until the peppers are tender and the filling is hot throughout. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Turkey & Quinoa Stuffed Peppers with Tomato Herb Sauce
ingredients_json: ["4 piece Bell peppers, red", "350 g Lean turkey mince", "200 g Cooked quinoa", "1 piece Onion, yellow", "2 clove Garlic", "400 g Chopped tomatoes (canned)", "2 tbsp Tomato paste", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1 pinch Salt", "1 pinch Black pepper", "60 g Feta cheese, reduced-fat", "30 g Parmesan cheese, hard"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. Halve the bell peppers lengthwise and remove the seeds and membranes. Place the peppers cut-side up in a baking dish, drizzle with half the olive oil, and bake for 12 minutes until slightly softened. Meanwhile, finely chop the onion and mince the garlic. Heat the remaining olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes until translucent. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the turkey mince, cumin, smoked paprika, and oregano. Cook for 8–10 minutes, breaking it up, until browned and cooked through. Stir in the chopped tomatoes and tomato paste, then simmer for 5 minutes so the mixture thickens. Fold the cooked quinoa into the turkey sauce and season with salt and black pepper. Remove the peppers from the oven and fill each with the turkey-quinoa mixture. Crumble the reduced-fat feta on top and sprinkle with parmesan. Bake for 15–18 minutes until the peppers are tender and the filling is hot; finish with a quick 2 minutes under the grill if you want a lightly browned top.

title: Turkey and Quinoa Stuffed Peppers with Tomato-Herb Sauce
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces Bell peppers, red", "250 g Turkey mince, lean", "120 g Quinoa, dry", "400 ml Vegetable stock, low salt", "1 piece Onion, yellow", "2 cloves Garlic", "400 g Crushed tomatoes, no added salt", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "120 g Feta cheese, reduced fat", "30 g Parmesan cheese, hard", "10 g Fresh parsley", "1 pinch Black pepper"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Rinse the bell peppers, cut them in half lengthwise, remove the seeds, and place them cut-side up in a baking dish. Cook the quinoa in the vegetable stock according to the package instructions until fluffy, then let it cool slightly. In a pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and sauté the chopped onion for 5 minutes until soft. Add the garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, and oregano, and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the turkey mince and cook for 8–10 minutes until browned, breaking up the meat; it should no longer be pink. Stir in the crushed tomatoes and simmer for 3–4 minutes, then mix the turkey-tomato mixture with the cooked quinoa. Divide the filling among the pepper halves and sprinkle with reduced-fat feta and parmesan. Bake for 25–30 minutes until the peppers are tender and the filling is hot. Rest for 5 minutes, then top with chopped parsley before serving.

title: Lean Turkey and Quinoa Stuffed Bell Peppers with Tomato-Cumin Sauce
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces Bell peppers, red", "220 g Lean turkey mince (5% fat)", "160 g Quinoa, dry", "500 g Canned chopped tomatoes, no added salt", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 piece Onion", "2 cloves Garlic", "2 tsp Ground cumin", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "180 g Low-fat Greek yogurt", "60 g Cheddar cheese, reduced fat", "15 g Fresh parsley", "1.5 tsp Salt", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Rinse the quinoa, then cook it in 360 ml water until tender and the water is absorbed, about 15 minutes; let it cool slightly. Slice the tops off the bell peppers, remove seeds and membranes, and place the peppers in a baking dish. Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat, then sauté the finely chopped onion for 5 minutes until soft. Add minced garlic, ground cumin, smoked paprika, and oregano, and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the turkey mince and cook for 7–9 minutes, breaking it up, until no longer pink. Stir in the cooked quinoa and chopped tomatoes, then simmer for 3 minutes so the filling is juicy and well seasoned. Spoon the filling into the peppers and cover with a lid or foil. Bake for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and bake for another 10 minutes until peppers are tender. Mix the reduced-fat cheddar with the Greek yogurt and chopped parsley, then dollop over the peppers for the final 2–3 minutes of baking so it melts slightly. Serve hot with extra black pepper if you like.

title: Salmon Avocado Maki Sushi with Brown Rice and Cucumber
ingredients_json: ["200 g sushi rice, brown", "270 ml water", "30 ml rice vinegar", "10 g sugar", "5 g salt", "200 g salmon fillet, raw, sushi-grade", "120 g avocado, peeled and sliced", "150 g cucumber, thinly sliced", "40 g nori seaweed sheets", "1 tbsp soy sauce, low-sodium", "1 tsp sesame oil"]
instructions: Rinse the brown sushi rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear, then add it to a pot with 270 ml water. Bring to a gentle boil, cover, and simmer on low for 35 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the water is absorbed. In a small bowl, mix the rice vinegar, sugar, and 5 g salt until dissolved. Spread the cooked rice on a tray, drizzle over the vinegar mixture, and fan it to cool to room temperature; the rice should look glossy but not dry out. Slice the salmon into long, even strips. Lay a nori sheet shiny-side down on a bamboo mat or clean surface, then spread an even layer of rice over the nori, leaving about 2 cm clear at the top edge. Arrange salmon, avocado, and cucumber in a line across the middle, then roll tightly, pressing gently to keep the filling secure. Slice into 8 pieces with a very sharp, slightly damp knife. Serve immediately with low-sodium soy sauce and a light drizzle of sesame oil.

title: Salmon, Avocado & Cucumber Brown-Rice Sushi Rolls with Sesame Soy Dip
ingredients_json: ["180 g sushi rice, uncooked (or brown sushi rice), uncooked", "250 ml water", "30 ml rice vinegar", "15 g honey", "4 g salt", "200 g salmon fillet, raw", "200 g cooked shrimp, peeled and deveined", "1 unit avocado, raw", "1 unit cucumber, raw", "6 sheets nori seaweed", "10 ml low-sodium soy sauce", "10 g sesame seeds, toasted", "1 g fresh ginger, grated"]
instructions:
Rinse the sushi rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear. In a saucepan, bring the 250 ml water to a boil, add the rice, then reduce to a low simmer, cover, and cook until tender and the water is absorbed, about 35–40 minutes. Remove from heat and let it steam covered for 10 minutes. Mix rice vinegar, honey, and 2 g of salt, warm briefly just to dissolve the honey, then fold it gently into the hot rice and let the rice cool to room temperature.
Slice the salmon into thin strips and lightly cure it by mixing half the ginger with the remaining 2 g salt, then rubbing it over the salmon for 5 minutes and rinsing quickly under cold water; pat very dry. For safety and texture, use sushi-grade salmon. Cut the cucumber into long sticks and slice the avocado into thin strips.
Lay a sheet of nori on a sushi mat, shiny side down. Wet your hands, spread a thin even layer of rice over the nori, leaving a 2 cm border at the far edge. Arrange salmon, shrimp, cucumber, and avocado in a line across the middle, then roll tightly using the mat, pressing to seal. Slice the roll into 8 pieces with a very sharp, wet knife and repeat with the remaining nori and filling.
Stir the soy sauce with the remaining ginger and drizzle lightly over the sushi, then sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds. Serve immediately while the nori is crisp and the rice is cool.

title: Salmon & Avocado Maki Sushi with Brown Rice and Nori
ingredients_json: ["300 g cooked sushi rice (brown rice)", "30 ml rice vinegar", "15 g sugar", "6 g salt", "240 g salmon fillet, raw, skinless", "10 ml soy sauce, low-salt", "5 ml sesame oil", "1 piece avocado, ripe", "100 g cucumber", "4 sheets nori seaweed", "1 piece lime", "10 g pickled ginger", "10 g sesame seeds"]
instructions: Stir the cooked brown sushi rice with the rice vinegar, sugar, and salt until the grains are evenly coated, then spread it on a tray to cool to room temperature. Cut the salmon into thin, uniform strips and lightly brush with the soy sauce and sesame oil, then set it aside while you prep the fillings. Slice the avocado into thin long pieces and cut the cucumber into matchsticks. Lay a sheet of nori on a sushi mat, spread a thin even layer of rice over the nori, and leave a small border at the top. Arrange salmon, avocado, and cucumber in a line across the middle, then roll firmly and seal the edge with a little water. Sprinkle the finished rolls with sesame seeds and add pickled ginger alongside, then serve with extra lime juice over the top if desired. Refrigerate any uneaten sushi promptly.

title: Salmon Avocado Maki Sushi with Brown Rice and Edamame
ingredients_json: ["180 g sushi rice, uncooked (brown rice)", "330 ml water", "30 ml rice vinegar", "10 g sugar", "6 g salt", "200 g salmon fillet, raw sushi-grade", "120 g avocado, flesh", "120 g cucumber", "80 g shelled edamame, cooked", "20 sheets nori seaweed", "20 ml soy sauce, low-sodium", "1 tsp toasted sesame oil"]
instructions: Rinse the uncooked brown sushi rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear, then cook it with 330 ml water according to package directions. While the rice is cooking, warm the rice vinegar with the sugar and salt just until the sugar dissolves, then set it aside to cool slightly. When the rice is done, spread it out and gently fold in the seasoned vinegar mixture, then let the rice cool to room temperature so the rolls will form properly without becoming mushy. Slice the salmon into long thin strips and cut the avocado and cucumber into matching sticks. Lay a sheet of nori on a bamboo rolling mat (shiny side down), spread a thin, even layer of cooled rice over the nori, and leave a small border at the top. Add salmon, cucumber, avocado, and a few edamame beans in a line across the lower third of the sheet, then roll tightly, pressing gently to seal. Repeat with the remaining nori and fillings, then slice each roll into bite-size pieces with a sharp damp knife. Serve with low-sodium soy sauce and a few drops of toasted sesame oil over the top.

title: Salmon Avocado Maki Sushi with Edamame and Cucumber
ingredients_json: ["200 g sushi rice, uncooked", "260 ml water", "30 ml rice vinegar", "15 g granulated sugar", "6 g sea salt", "250 g salmon fillet, raw, skinless (for sushi)", "150 g shelled edamame, frozen", "150 g cucumber", "100 g avocado", "6 sheets nori seaweed", "1 tbsp soy sauce"]
instructions: Rinse the sushi rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear. Combine the rinsed rice with 260 ml water and cook according to your rice cooker or package instructions. When the rice is cooked, gently fold in the rice vinegar, sugar, and 6 g sea salt while the rice is still warm, then spread it on a tray and let it cool to room temperature. Steam the edamame for about 4–5 minutes until tender, then drain and cool. Cut the cucumber into thin long sticks and slice the avocado. Portion the salmon into thin strips suitable for rolling. Lay a sheet of nori on a sushi mat with the shiny side down, spread a thin even layer of sushi rice over the nori, leaving a small border at the top. Arrange edamame, cucumber, avocado, and salmon in a line across the lower third, then roll tightly, pressing lightly to seal. Slice each roll with a sharp wet knife into bite-sized pieces and serve with soy sauce for dipping.

title: Herbed Turkey Swiss Steak with Tomato Onion Gravy
ingredients_json: ["650 g beef chuck steak, lean, trimmed and cut into 3–4 cm pieces", "200 g onion, yellow, sliced", "250 g carrots, sliced", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "1 tbsp olive oil", "300 g passata (tomato purée)", "200 ml beef stock, low-salt", "2 tbsp wheat flour", "2 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp dried rosemary", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 tsp salt", "150 g mushrooms, sliced"]
instructions: Pat the beef dry, then lightly coat each piece with the flour. Heat the olive oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and sear the beef in batches until browned on all sides, about 3–4 minutes per batch; remove to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and sauté the onion and carrots for 6–8 minutes until the onion softens and starts to turn translucent. Stir in the garlic, mushrooms, thyme, rosemary, and smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Return the beef to the pot, add the passata and low-salt beef stock, and bring to a gentle simmer. Cover and cook on low heat for 70–80 minutes, stirring once or twice, until the beef is very tender. Season with black pepper and salt, then simmer uncovered for 5–10 minutes to thicken the sauce. Serve hot with a side of vegetables or whole grains.

title: Herbed Swiss Steak with Tomato-Mushroom Gravy
ingredients_json: ["600 g Beef chuck steak, lean, trimmed", "60 g Plain wheat flour", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "2 medium Onions, yellow", "3 cloves Garlic", "250 g Mushrooms, brown", "500 ml Tomato passata", "400 ml Beef stock, low salt", "2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, reduced sugar", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1 tsp Paprika, smoked", "1 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 tsp Salt", "2 tbsp Apple cider vinegar"]
instructions: Pat the beef dry and slice it against the grain into 4–5 cm pieces. Toss the meat with the flour until lightly coated. Heat the olive oil in a heavy pan or Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches for 2–3 minutes per side. Transfer the browned meat to a plate. In the same pan, cook the onions for 5 minutes until softened, then add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the mushrooms and cook for 4–5 minutes until they release their moisture and start to brown. Stir in the passata, beef stock, Worcestershire sauce, thyme, oregano, paprika, pepper, salt, and apple cider vinegar. Return the beef to the pan, bring to a simmer, then cover and cook on low heat for 75–90 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the beef is very tender and the sauce has thickened. If the gravy looks too thin, uncover for the last 10 minutes to reduce; if it seems too thick, add a splash of stock or water and simmer briefly. Serve hot with your preferred side and make sure the beef breaks easily when pressed.

title: Herb-and-Mushroom Swiss Steak with Tomato and Carrots
ingredients_json: ["600 g beef chuck steak, trimmed", "120 g whole-wheat flour", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion", "2 cloves garlic", "250 g mushrooms, button", "3 medium carrots", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes", "250 ml beef stock, low-salt", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "2 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp fine sea salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper"]
instructions: Cut the beef chuck into 4–6 thick portions and pat dry. Heat the olive oil in a deep pan or heavy pot over medium-high heat. Toss the flour with smoked paprika, thyme, and oregano, then lightly coat the beef. Brown the beef in the hot pan in batches for 2–3 minutes per side, until you get a deep golden crust, and transfer to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and sauté the onion for 4–5 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and mushrooms and cook for another 5 minutes, stirring, until the mushrooms release their moisture. Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute. Return the beef to the pan, add the chopped tomatoes and low-salt beef stock, and bring to a gentle simmer. Add carrots, sliced into thick rounds, then cover and simmer on low heat for 60–75 minutes, turning the pieces once, until the beef is very tender and the sauce has thickened. Season with salt and black pepper to taste, and simmer uncovered for 5 minutes if you want a thicker sauce. Serve hot with the pan sauce spooned over the steak.

title: Chicken Taco Salad Bowls with Lime, Black Beans and Avocado
ingredients_json: ["400 g chicken breast, raw", "260 g iceberg lettuce, shredded", "200 g red kidney beans, canned, drained and rinsed", "200 g cherry tomatoes, halved", "1 medium red bell pepper, raw", "1 medium red onion, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 tbsp tomato purée", "1.5 tsp ground cumin", "1.5 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp garlic powder", "1 tsp chili powder", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 dl water", "1 medium avocado, raw", "2 tbsp plain Greek yogurt, 2% fat"]
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips. Heat the olive oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring often, until it is browned and cooked through. Stir in the tomato purée, cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, chili powder, salt, and water, then add the rinsed kidney beans. Reduce the heat to medium and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes so the mixture thickens slightly and the chicken is well coated. Meanwhile, shred the lettuce, halve the cherry tomatoes, slice the red bell pepper and red onion, and dice the avocado. Build the taco salads by layering lettuce, vegetables, and spooning the hot chicken-bean topping over the top. Finish with avocado and a drizzle of Greek yogurt for a creamy, tangy finish.

title: Turkey Taco Salads with Black Beans, Corn and Lime Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["300 g turkey mince, lean (5% fat)", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "2 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "200 g black beans, canned, drained and rinsed", "150 g canned sweet corn, drained", "400 g chopped tomatoes (canned)", "10 g salt", "600 g romaine lettuce, chopped", "1 medium red bell pepper, raw", "1 medium avocado, raw", "200 g natural yogurt, low-fat", "1 lime, juice"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for about 5 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the turkey mince and cook for 7–9 minutes, breaking it up, until browned and cooked through. Stir in the cumin, smoked paprika, oregano and tomato paste, then add the black beans, corn and chopped tomatoes. Simmer for 10 minutes until the mixture thickens slightly and the flavors come together, then taste and adjust the seasoning if needed. Toss the romaine lettuce and sliced red bell pepper together in a large bowl. Spoon the warm turkey-bean mixture over the salad. Mix the low-fat yogurt with lime juice and a small pinch of salt, then drizzle over the top. Finish with sliced avocado and serve right away while the topping is hot.

title: Spiced Turkey Taco Salad Bowls with Greek Yogurt Lime Dressing
ingredients_json: ["250 g turkey mince, lean (5% fat)", "2 tbsp olive oil", "10 g taco seasoning, low-salt", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "400 g canned black beans, drained and rinsed", "200 g canned sweetcorn, drained", "1 piece red bell pepper", "250 g iceberg lettuce", "200 g cherry tomatoes", "150 g red onion", "170 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "30 ml lime juice", "10 ml olive oil (for dressing)", "5 g fresh coriander", "20 g reduced-fat cheddar cheese, grated"]
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add the turkey mince and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until it is browned and no longer pink. Stir in the taco seasoning, cumin, and smoked paprika, then cook for 1 minute to bloom the spices. Add the black beans and sweetcorn to the pan and warm through for 2 to 3 minutes, until everything is hot and lightly coated in the spices. Slice the red bell pepper and red onion thinly, halve the cherry tomatoes, and chop the coriander. In a bowl, mix the Greek yogurt with lime juice and 10 ml olive oil to make the dressing. Divide the lettuce between serving bowls and top with the turkey-bean mixture, bell pepper, onion, tomatoes, and a sprinkle of cheddar. Drizzle with the lime yogurt dressing and finish with fresh coriander. Serve immediately while the filling is still warm.

title: Spiced Chicken & Black Bean Tacos with Lime Yogurt Slaw
ingredients_json: ["400 g chicken breast, raw", "240 g canned black beans, drained and rinsed", "250 g canned chopped tomatoes", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 tsp ground cumin", "2 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp garlic powder", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper", "8 piece corn tortillas", "200 g plain Greek yogurt", "1 tbsp lime juice", "150 g shredded red cabbage", "1 piece carrot, raw", "1 tbsp chopped fresh coriander"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken breast cut into small pieces and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until lightly browned and cooked through. Stir in the cumin, smoked paprika, oregano and garlic powder, then add the chopped tomatoes and black beans. Simmer for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens slightly and the chicken is well coated. While the filling simmers, make the lime yogurt slaw by mixing the Greek yogurt with the lime juice, salt and black pepper, then fold in the shredded cabbage and grated carrot. Warm the corn tortillas in a dry skillet for about 30 to 45 seconds per side, just until flexible. Fill each tortilla with the chicken and bean mixture and top with a generous spoon of lime yogurt slaw and chopped coriander.

title: Turkey and Black Bean Tacos with Lime-Coriander Slaw
ingredients_json: ["350 g turkey mince, lean (5% fat)", "1 tbsp olive oil", "180 g canned black beans, drained and rinsed", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "150 g cherry tomatoes, halved", "20 g tomato paste", "1 tbsp chili powder", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp salt, table salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "300 g white cabbage, shredded", "1 medium lime, zest and juice", "15 g fresh coriander, chopped", "200 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "8 pieces corn tortillas, 6 inch"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the turkey mince and cook for 8–10 minutes, breaking it up, until browned and cooked through. Stir in the tomato paste, chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, black pepper, and salt, then add the black beans and cherry tomatoes. Cook for another 5 minutes until the mixture looks saucy and thick. In a bowl, combine the shredded cabbage with the lime juice and zest and the chopped coriander, then set aside. Warm the corn tortillas in a dry pan for about 30–45 seconds per side until pliable. Serve the turkey-black bean filling in the tortillas and top with lime-coriander slaw and a spoonful of low-fat Greek yogurt.

title: Turkey and Black Bean Tacos with Roasted Capsicum and Lime Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["400 g turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "150 g canned black beans, drained and rinsed", "220 g capsicum, red (bell pepper), sliced", "120 g red onion, sliced", "250 g low-fat natural yogurt", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "2 tsp ground cumin", "2 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp garlic powder", "1 g salt", "0.5 g black pepper, ground", "8 piece corn tortillas (small)", "1 piece lime, zest and juice", "30 g coriander (cilantro), fresh"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add the turkey mince and cook for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up until it is browned and cooked through. Stir in the onion and capsicum and cook for another 5–6 minutes until the vegetables soften. Add the tomato paste, cumin, smoked paprika, oregano and garlic powder, then cook for 1 minute to bloom the spices. Add the black beans and 50 ml water, simmer for 3–4 minutes until the mixture is glossy and thick. Meanwhile, warm the corn tortillas in a dry pan for 20–30 seconds per side so they become flexible. Mix the yogurt with lime zest and juice and season lightly with salt and black pepper. Fill each tortilla with the turkey-bean mixture, spoon over the lime yogurt, and finish with chopped coriander.

title: Crispy Turkey Taco Filling with Lime-Avocado Slaw
ingredients_json: ["350 g turkey mince, lean", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic", "2 tsp ground cumin", "2 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper", "200 g corn kernels, cooked", "8 piece taco shells, whole grain", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain 2%", "1 piece lime", "250 g cabbage, white", "1 piece carrot, raw"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add the finely chopped onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Stir in the garlic, cumin, smoked paprika and dried oregano, and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the turkey mince and cook for 8–10 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and cooked through. Pour in the chopped tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes until the mixture thickens. Stir in the cooked corn, then season with salt and black pepper and simmer for 2 more minutes. Meanwhile, finely shred the cabbage and grate the carrot; mix them together with the juice of the lime. In a bowl, stir the Greek yogurt with a little extra lime juice for tang. Warm the taco shells according to the package instructions. Fill the shells with the turkey-corn mixture, top with lime-avocado slaw and a spoon of lime yogurt, and serve hot.

title: Chicken and Roasted Corn Tamales with Green Tomatillo Sauce
ingredients_json: ["300 g masa harina (corn flour)", "900 ml chicken stock, low sodium", "200 g cooked shredded chicken breast", "150 g roasted corn kernels", "120 g tomatillo, raw", "60 g green onion", "60 g poblano pepper", "15 g fresh cilantro", "10 g garlic", "30 ml olive oil", "10 g sea salt", "5 g ground cumin", "3 g dried oregano", "2 g black pepper", "1 g baking powder", "12 pieces dried corn husks"]
instructions: Soak the corn husks in warm water for 30 minutes until pliable, then drain. In a bowl, mix the masa harina with 600 ml of the chicken stock, baking powder, salt, cumin, oregano, and black pepper until you have a smooth, spreadable dough; add the remaining 300 ml stock gradually if needed to reach a soft consistency. For the filling, warm the olive oil in a pan and sauté the green onion and garlic for 2 minutes, then add the poblano pepper and cook for another 4 minutes until fragrant and slightly softened. Stir in the shredded chicken and roasted corn, cooking for 3 minutes; remove from heat. Blend the tomatillo, cilantro, and a splash of water until mostly smooth, then pour into a small saucepan and simmer for 8–10 minutes, stirring, until the sauce thickens slightly. To assemble, spread a thin layer of masa on each soaked husk, add a spoonful of chicken-corn filling and a little tomatillo sauce, then fold and tie lightly. Steam the tamales in a steamer over simmering water for 60–75 minutes, checking that they hold their shape and pull away from the husk edges. Let them rest for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Chicken and Roasted Corn Tamales with Tomatillo-Chile Sauce
ingredients_json: ["250 g masa harina (corn flour)", "1.2 l chicken stock, low-salt", "120 g chicken breast, raw, trimmed", "200 g roasted corn kernels (canned, drained)", "1 tbsp lard", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 large onion", "3 clove garlic", "200 g tomatillo, raw", "150 g green chile (jalapeño or poblano), raw", "2 tbsp cilantro, fresh", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "10 g salt", "1 tbsp lime juice", "12 piece corn husks (for steaming)"]
instructions:
Soak the corn husks in warm water for at least 30 minutes until they soften and become flexible. In a medium pot, heat the olive oil and lard over medium heat, then sauté the onion for 5 to 7 minutes until translucent and lightly golden. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the chicken breast, cumin, oregano, and smoked paprika, stirring to coat. Pour in 400 ml of the chicken stock, cover, and simmer for 15 to 18 minutes until the chicken is cooked through; remove the chicken, shred it, and return it to the pot, adding the roasted corn. Simmer uncovered for 5 minutes to thicken slightly, then stir in the cilantro and set the filling aside.

For the masa, mix masa harina with the remaining 800 ml chicken stock, lime juice, and 10 g salt, whisking until smooth. Let it sit for 5 minutes, then test the texture: it should be spreadable like thick mashed potato. If it feels too stiff, add 50 ml more stock; if too loose, mix in 20 g extra masa harina. Blend the tomatillo and green chile with a splash of water until fairly smooth, then cook that sauce in a small saucepan over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes until slightly reduced and vibrant green.

Assemble the tamales by spreading about 70–80 g masa on each soaked husk, leaving a border, then adding a spoonful of chicken-corn filling and folding to enclose. Tie loosely with a strip of husk if needed. Arrange seam-side down in a steamer, and steam over simmering water for 60 to 75 minutes until the masa lifts cleanly from the husk and feels set. Serve hot with the tomatillo-chile sauce spooned over or on the side.

title: Oven-Steamed Chicken & Poblano Tamales with Tomatillo Salsa Verde
ingredients_json: ["300 g masa harina (corn flour)", "360 ml chicken stock, low sodium", "60 g lard", "1 tsp fine sea salt", "1 tsp ground cumin", "420 g chicken breast, raw, diced", "1 piece onion, yellow, diced", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "200 g poblano pepper, roasted, peeled, chopped", "1 tbsp olive oil", "250 g tomatillo, raw", "150 g water", "1 dl fresh coriander", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp chili powder", "2 pieces bay leaves", "20 g banana leaves (or corn husks), soaked", "10 g corn husks, for steaming"]
instructions: Soak the corn husks in warm water for 20 minutes so they become flexible. In a bowl, combine the masa harina, salt, cumin, and chicken stock, then mix until you get a soft dough; if needed, add a small splash of water so the dough holds together. In another pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and sauté the onion until translucent, then stir in the garlic, poblano, cumin, and chili powder. Add the diced chicken and cook until no longer pink. Stir in the oregano, bay leaves, and 100 ml of water, then simmer for 10–12 minutes until the chicken is tender and the mixture is juicy but not watery. Meanwhile, blend the tomatillos with 150 g water and coriander, then pour the sauce into a small saucepan and simmer for 8–10 minutes until slightly thickened. For each tamale, spread about 2 tablespoons of masa on a soaked husk, add a spoonful of chicken filling, fold, and tie lightly with a strip if desired. Arrange the tamales upright in a steamer and steam over gentle heat for 45–55 minutes. They are ready when the masa looks set and firm and pulls cleanly from the husk. Serve hot with the tomatillo salsa verde spooned over the top.

title: Chicken & Corn Tamales with Tomatillo Salsa Verde
ingredients_json: ["250 g masa harina (corn dough flour)", "1.6 L water", "200 g chicken breast, cooked and shredded", "120 g tomatillo, fresh", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "30 g cilantro, fresh", "1 piece jalapeño pepper", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp fine salt", "30 g vegetable oil", "40 g queso fresco, crumbled", "8 pieces corn husks, dried"]
instructions: Soak the corn husks in warm water for 30 minutes until pliable. In a blender, combine tomatillo, onion, garlic, cilantro, jalapeño, cumin, oregano, and 1 dl of water; blend until mostly smooth. Heat vegetable oil in a saucepan over medium heat, pour in the tomatillo mixture, and simmer for 10 minutes until slightly thickened and fragrant. Stir the shredded chicken into the salsa and cook for 5 more minutes. In a large bowl, mix masa harina with 1.2 L water and 1 tsp salt until you get a soft dough; if it feels dry, add a little more water a few tablespoons at a time until it spreads easily. Spread a thin layer of masa on each soaked husk, add a spoonful of chicken-tomatillo filling, then add a small pinch of crumbled queso fresco. Fold and tie lightly with kitchen string or secure with the husk. Arrange the tamales upright in a steamer and steam over simmering water for about 50–60 minutes, checking that the steam stays steady. They’re done when the masa pulls away slightly from the husk and feels firm and not sticky.

title: Lean Chicken & Veggie Tater Tot Casserole with Cheddar and Creamy Mustard
ingredients_json: ["450 g tater tots, frozen", "300 g chicken mince, lean", "250 g frozen mixed vegetables, no sauce", "1 medium onion", "2 cloves garlic", "500 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "250 g reduced-fat cheddar cheese", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain 2% fat", "2 tbsp wholegrain mustard", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp black pepper", "1.5 tsp fine salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat, then sauté the chopped onion for 5 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the chicken mince, thyme, smoked paprika, and black pepper, and cook for 8–10 minutes until browned and cooked through. Stir in the frozen mixed vegetables and cook for 3 minutes, then pour in the chicken stock and simmer for 2–3 minutes until the mixture looks slightly thick. In a bowl, mix the Greek yogurt with the wholegrain mustard. Spread the chicken-vegetable mixture into a baking dish, dollop over the yogurt-mustard mixture, and spread gently to combine. Cover with the frozen tater tots in an even layer and sprinkle over the grated reduced-fat cheddar. Bake for 25 minutes, then switch to grill/broil for 2–3 minutes to brown the top until crisp. Let the casserole rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Turkey and Veggie Tater Tot Casserole with Cheddar
ingredients_json: ["450 g frozen tater tots", "500 g turkey mince, 5% fat", "300 g mixed vegetables, frozen (carrots, peas, corn)", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes", "200 ml chicken stock, low sodium", "2 tbsp olive oil", "60 g cheddar cheese, reduced fat", "200 g light sour cream", "20 g plain wheat flour", "10 g tomato paste", "10 g paprika, smoked", "2 g dried thyme", "2 g black pepper", "3 g salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. In a large oven-safe skillet, warm the olive oil over medium heat and sauté the diced onion for 4–5 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and turkey mince and cook for 8–10 minutes, breaking up the meat, until browned. Stir in the flour, smoked paprika, thyme, black pepper, tomato paste, chopped tomatoes, and chicken stock, then bring to a simmer. Cook for 5 minutes, then fold in the mixed vegetables and let the mixture thicken slightly. Spread the turkey-vegetable sauce evenly in the dish, spoon dollops of light sour cream over the top, and sprinkle the reduced-fat cheddar. Arrange the frozen tater tots in an even layer over everything. Bake for 25 minutes, then switch to the grill/broil for 3–5 minutes to crisp the tops until golden and bubbling. Let the casserole stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Lean Turkey Tater Tot Casserole with Cheddar, Spinach, and Sweet Corn
ingredients_json: ["450 g lean turkey mince (5–10% fat)", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion, diced", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "400 g crushed tomatoes, no added sugar", "150 g sweet corn kernels (frozen)", "200 g baby spinach", "2 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp table salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper", "300 g reduced-fat cheddar cheese, grated", "600 g frozen potato tater tots (baked style)", "60 ml low-sodium chicken stock"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. In a large skillet, warm the olive oil over medium heat and cook the onion for 5–6 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then stir in the turkey mince and cook for 8–10 minutes until browned and no longer pink. Add the crushed tomatoes, corn, oregano, smoked paprika, salt, pepper, and chicken stock, then simmer for 5 minutes. Stir in the baby spinach until just wilted. Spread the turkey mixture evenly into a baking dish, sprinkle over the grated reduced-fat cheddar, and cover with a single even layer of tater tots. Bake for 35–40 minutes until the tots are crisp and golden. Let the casserole rest for 5 minutes before serving so the filling thickens slightly.

title: Smoky Turkey & Veggie Tater Tot Casserole with Cheddar
ingredients_json: ["450 g tater tots, frozen", "300 g turkey mince, lean", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion, diced", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "400 g mixed vegetables, frozen (carrot peas corn)", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp dried oregano", "200 g passata", "150 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "150 g reduced-fat cheddar cheese, grated", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. Grease a 25 x 30 cm baking dish with a little olive oil. Heat the remaining olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat, then cook the turkey mince with the onion for 6–8 minutes until browned and no pink remains. Stir in the garlic, smoked paprika, cumin, and oregano for 30 seconds, then add the mixed vegetables, passata, and chicken stock. Simmer for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens slightly. Spread the turkey and vegetable mixture into the baking dish, cover evenly with the frozen tater tots, and sprinkle the cheddar over the top. Bake for 25–30 minutes until the tots are golden and crisp and the casserole is bubbling at the edges. Rest for 5 minutes before serving so it sets.

title: Crispy Pan-Fried Tempeh with Ginger-Lime Veggie Stir-Fry and Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["250 g tempeh, plain", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 clove garlic", "20 g fresh ginger", "1 piece red bell pepper", "250 g broccoli florets", "150 g canned chickpeas, drained and rinsed", "2 tbsp soy sauce, reduced salt", "1 tbsp lime juice", "1 tbsp rice vinegar", "200 g cooked brown rice", "1 tsp sesame seeds"]
instructions: Cut the tempeh into thin rectangles and lightly pan-dry with a towel. Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the tempeh and cook for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and slightly crisp. While the tempeh cooks, thinly slice the onion, mince the garlic, grate the ginger, and slice the bell pepper into strips. Add onion, garlic, ginger, and bell pepper to the skillet and stir-fry for 3 minutes, then add the broccoli and cook for another 3–4 minutes until the broccoli is bright green and just tender. Stir in the chickpeas, soy sauce, lime juice, and rice vinegar, and simmer for 2 minutes to coat everything. Serve the ginger-lime tempeh stir-fry over the cooked brown rice and finish with sesame seeds.

title: Crispy Tempeh with Miso-Lime Glaze, Sesame Broccoli and Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["200 g Tempeh, plain", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tbsp Soy sauce, reduced salt", "2 tbsp White miso paste", "1 tbsp Lime juice", "1 tsp Maple syrup", "2 cloves Garlic", "1 tbsp Sesame seeds", "350 g Broccoli florets", "200 g Cooked brown rice", "1 g Black pepper"]
instructions: Cut the tempeh into 1 cm thick rectangles. In a bowl, mix the soy sauce, miso paste, lime juice, maple syrup, finely grated garlic, and black pepper until smooth. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add the tempeh and cook for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and crisp, then reduce the heat to medium and pour in the miso-lime glaze. Stir to coat and cook for 1–2 minutes, until the sauce clings to the tempeh and looks slightly glossy. While the tempeh cooks, steam the broccoli for 4–5 minutes until bright green and tender-crisp. Toast the sesame seeds in a dry pan for 1 minute, shaking the pan, then set aside. Assemble the bowls with cooked brown rice, broccoli, and the glazed tempeh. Sprinkle over toasted sesame seeds and serve immediately while warm.

title: Crispy Pan-Fried Tempeh with Sesame-Lime Veg and Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["300 g tempeh", "200 g cooked brown rice", "250 g broccoli florets", "150 g red bell pepper", "120 g carrot", "1 tbsp olive oil", "20 g soy sauce", "2 tsp toasted sesame oil", "1 tbsp maple syrup", "2 tsp rice vinegar", "1 clove garlic", "10 g fresh ginger", "1 tbsp sesame seeds", "0.5 dl water", "1 lime"]
instructions: Cut the tempeh into bite-sized cubes. Pat the pieces dry, then fry them in the olive oil in a hot pan until they turn golden and crisp on all sides, about 6–8 minutes. While the tempeh crisps, slice the bell pepper and cut the carrot into thin matchsticks, and chop the broccoli into small florets. Sauté the garlic and ginger in the pan for 30 seconds, then add the carrot, bell pepper, and broccoli with the water and cook for 4–6 minutes until the vegetables are tender-crisp. Stir in the soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, maple syrup, and the juice from the lime, then simmer for 1 minute so the sauce lightly coats everything. Add the cooked brown rice to the pan and toss until hot, then finish with sesame seeds and a little extra lime zest if you like. Serve immediately while the tempeh is still crisp and the vegetables are bright green.

title: Ginger-Lime Tempeh Bowl with Roasted Bell Pepper and Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["200 g tempeh", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tbsp soy sauce, reduced-salt", "1 tbsp lime juice", "1 tbsp rice vinegar", "1 tbsp maple syrup", "1 tsp fresh ginger, grated", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "1 medium red bell pepper, diced", "120 g mushrooms, sliced", "200 g cooked brown rice", "1 tbsp sesame seeds", "100 g cucumber, diced", "10 g fresh coriander, chopped"]
instructions:
Cut the tempeh into 1 cm cubes and pat it dry. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the tempeh and fry for 6–8 minutes, stirring often, until it turns golden and lightly crisp on the edges. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, lime juice, rice vinegar, maple syrup, grated ginger, and minced garlic. Pour the sauce into the pan and simmer for 2–3 minutes until it becomes glossy and clings to the tempeh.

In the same pan (or a second pan), add the bell pepper and mushrooms and cook for 6–7 minutes, until the vegetables soften but still have some bite. Build bowls with the cooked brown rice, top with the ginger-lime tempeh and vegetables, and finish with cucumber, sesame seeds, and chopped coriander. Serve warm.

title: Turkey & Mushroom Tetrazzini with Light Cream and Wholewheat Pasta
ingredients_json: ["250 g turkey breast, cooked and diced", "200 g mushrooms, sliced", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion, diced", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "200 ml reduced-fat milk, 2%", "200 ml chicken stock, low sodium", "150 g wholewheat pasta, dry", "40 g all-purpose flour", "30 g parmesan cheese, grated", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "2.0 g salt"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the mushrooms and cook for 6–8 minutes until they release their water and start to brown. Sprinkle in the flour and stir well for 1 minute to cook out the raw flour. Gradually whisk in the milk and chicken stock, keeping the heat at a gentle simmer; cook for 3–4 minutes until the sauce thickens. Stir in the thyme, oregano, black pepper, and salt. Cook the wholewheat pasta in a pot of boiling water until just al dente, then drain and add the pasta to the sauce along with the cooked diced turkey. Mix everything thoroughly so the pasta is evenly coated. Transfer to an ovenproof dish, top with the grated parmesan, and bake at 190°C for 15–20 minutes until bubbling and lightly golden. Rest for 5 minutes before serving so it sets up and slices cleanly.

title: Light Turkey & Mushroom Tetrazzini with Wholewheat Pasta
ingredients_json: ["300 g turkey breast, raw", "250 g mushrooms, sliced", "200 g wholewheat pasta, dry (penne or spaghetti)", "300 ml semi-skimmed milk", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "30 g all-purpose flour", "2 tbsp olive oil", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "10 g fresh parsley, chopped", "1 tsp dried thyme", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "2 g salt"]
instructions:
Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the turkey breast and cook for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up, until no longer pink. Add the mushrooms, thyme, and black pepper, and cook for 8–10 minutes until the mushrooms release their moisture and it begins to reduce.

Meanwhile, cook the wholewheat pasta in salted water according to the package instructions until al dente, then drain. In a small bowl, whisk the flour with a splash of the semi-skimmed milk until smooth. Lower the heat to medium-low and pour in the remaining milk, stirring continuously until the sauce thickens, then simmer for 2 minutes. Turn off the heat and stir in the Greek yogurt and lemon juice to keep the sauce creamy (do not boil). Fold in the pasta and the turkey-mushroom mixture, then transfer to a baking dish. Sprinkle over the Parmesan and bake at 200°C for 15–18 minutes until golden on top. Rest for 5 minutes before serving, and finish with chopped parsley.

title: Light Chicken & Mushroom Tetrazzini with Wholewheat Pasta and Low-Fat Cheese
ingredients_json: ["450 g chicken breast, raw", "250 g mushrooms, button, sliced", "180 g wholewheat pasta, dry (penne or spaghetti)", "300 ml semi-skimmed milk", "200 g low-fat Greek yogurt", "40 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "30 g wheat flour, all-purpose", "1.5 dl chicken stock, low sodium", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 piece lemon, zest only", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp dried parsley", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "1.5 g salt"]
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces. Cook the wholewheat pasta in salted boiling water until just tender, then drain and set aside. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat, add the sliced mushrooms and cook for 5–7 minutes until they release their moisture and start to brown. Add the diced onion and cook for another 3–4 minutes, then stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Sprinkle in the flour and cook for 1 minute, then slowly whisk in the chicken stock and semi-skimmed milk, scraping up any browned bits. Simmer gently for 3–4 minutes until the sauce thickens. Lower the heat, stir in the Greek yogurt, Parmesan, thyme, parsley, lemon zest, and black pepper, and keep the mixture warm without boiling. Add the chicken to the sauce and cook for 8–10 minutes until the chicken is cooked through. Fold in the drained pasta and simmer for 2 minutes to coat everything. Transfer to an ovenproof dish and bake at 190°C for 15–18 minutes until bubbling at the edges and lightly golden on top.

title: Turkey Mushroom Tetrazzini with Whole-Wheat Pasta and Herby Cream
ingredients_json: ["250 g chicken breast, boneless, skinless", "200 g mushrooms, brown, sliced", "200 g spring onions, trimmed, chopped", "250 g cherry tomatoes, halved", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 cloves garlic, fresh, minced", "60 g whole-wheat pasta, dry (penne or spaghetti)", "40 g wheat flour, plain", "750 ml semi-skimmed milk", "150 g plain Greek yogurt", "30 g Parmesan, hard, finely grated", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat and cook the spring onions for 2–3 minutes until softened. Add the mushrooms and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring, until they release their juices and start to brown.
