Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the chicken breast cut into small bite-size pieces and cook for 6–8 minutes until no longer pink. Sprinkle over the flour and cook for 1 minute to remove the raw flour taste. Gradually whisk in the semi-skimmed milk and bring to a gentle simmer, stirring until the sauce thickens, about 3–5 minutes. Turn off the heat and stir in the Greek yogurt, Parmesan, thyme, oregano, black pepper, and salt. Fold in the cherry tomatoes and cooked whole-wheat pasta, then transfer everything to a baking dish. Bake at 200°C for 18–22 minutes until bubbling around the edges and lightly golden on top. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Chicken & Mushroom Turkey Tetrazzini with Whole-Wheat Pasta and Light Cream Sauce
ingredients_json: ["300 g chicken breast, raw", "200 g turkey mince, lean", "250 g mushrooms, cremini, sliced", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "250 g whole-wheat pasta, dry (penne or spaghetti)", "3 dl semi-skimmed milk", "200 ml chicken stock, low-salt", "2 tbsp olive oil", "50 g plain flour", "50 g parmesan cheese, grated", "100 g mozzarella, part-skim, shredded", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "2 g salt", "10 g fresh parsley, chopped"]
instructions:
Heat the olive oil in a large nonstick pan over medium heat. Add the onion and mushrooms and cook for about 8 minutes, stirring, until the mushrooms have released their moisture and begin to brown. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the chicken breast pieces and the turkey mince. Cook for 8–10 minutes until the meat is cooked through and no pink remains. Sprinkle over the flour and stir well so there are no dry pockets. Slowly pour in the milk and chicken stock while stirring, then add the tomato paste, thyme, oregano, black pepper, and salt. Simmer for 4–5 minutes until the sauce thickens to a creamy consistency.

Meanwhile, cook the whole-wheat pasta in a large pot of salted boiling water until al dente, then drain. Fold the pasta into the sauce with half the parmesan and half the mozzarella. Tip everything into a baking dish and top with the remaining parmesan and mozzarella. Bake at 190°C for 20–25 minutes until bubbling at the edges and lightly golden on top. Rest for 5 minutes, scatter with parsley, and serve hot.

title: Crispy Ginger- Sesame Tofu with Broccoli and Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["300 g firm tofu", "15 ml soy sauce, reduced-salt", "10 ml sesame oil", "20 g cornflour", "20 ml rice vinegar", "15 g fresh ginger", "2 cloves garlic", "400 g broccoli florets", "180 g brown rice, dry", "500 ml vegetable stock", "10 g sesame seeds", "1 ml chili flakes"]
instructions: Cook the brown rice in vegetable stock. Bring it to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 30–35 minutes until tender and the liquid is absorbed. While the rice cooks, press the tofu gently with paper towels, then cube it. Toss the tofu cubes with the cornflour until lightly coated. Heat sesame oil in a large nonstick frying pan over medium-high heat and add the tofu in a single layer; cook for 8–10 minutes, turning often, until crisp and golden on all sides. Meanwhile, mix soy sauce, rice vinegar, grated ginger, finely chopped garlic, chili flakes, and half of the sesame seeds in a bowl. Add broccoli to a steamer basket over boiling water and steam for 4–5 minutes until bright green and just tender. Pour the sauce into the pan with the tofu and simmer for 1–2 minutes, stirring until the tofu is glossy and the sauce lightly clings. Serve the crispy tofu and broccoli over the warm brown rice and finish with the remaining sesame seeds.

title: Crispy Pan-Seared Tofu with Ginger-Lime Veggie Stir-Fry and Sesame
ingredients_json: ["300 g firm tofu", "20 ml sesame oil", "15 ml soy sauce", "10 ml rice vinegar", "10 ml honey", "20 g fresh ginger, grated", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "300 g broccoli florets", "150 g carrot, cut into sticks", "200 g bell pepper, sliced", "200 g cooked brown rice", "10 g sesame seeds", "1 g chili flakes"]
instructions: Press the tofu between paper towels for 10 minutes, then cut it into 1.5–2 cm cubes. Heat 10 ml of the sesame oil in a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat and add the tofu cubes in a single layer. Cook for about 8–10 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden and crisp on most sides. In a small bowl, mix soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, grated ginger, garlic, and chili flakes. Add the remaining 10 ml sesame oil to the pan, then toss in the broccoli, carrots, and bell pepper. Stir-fry for 6–8 minutes until the vegetables are crisp-tender. Pour the sauce over the stir-fry and simmer for 1–2 minutes until glossy and lightly thickened. Serve the ginger-lime tofu and vegetables over the cooked brown rice and finish with sesame seeds.

title: Crispy Pan-Seared Tofu with Ginger-Lime Vegetables and Sesame
ingredients_json: ["300 g firm tofu", "20 ml soy sauce, reduced-salt", "15 ml sesame oil", "15 ml olive oil", "1 tbsp cornflour", "2 cloves garlic", "20 g fresh ginger", "300 g broccoli florets", "200 g carrot", "150 g bell pepper", "200 g cooked brown rice", "20 ml lime juice", "5 g sesame seeds"]
instructions: Pat the tofu dry with kitchen paper, then cut into 2 cm cubes. Toss the tofu with the cornflour until lightly coated. Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat and sear the tofu for 8–10 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden and crisp on multiple sides. In the last 2 minutes, add the minced garlic and grated ginger and stir to coat the tofu. Add the broccoli florets, sliced carrot, and bell pepper strips with 60 ml water, cover, and steam-sauté for 5–7 minutes until the vegetables are bright and crisp-tender. Stir in the reduced-salt soy sauce, sesame oil, and lime juice, then simmer uncovered for 1–2 minutes to thicken slightly. Serve the sesame ginger tofu and vegetables over the cooked brown rice and finish with sesame seeds.

title: Ginger-Soy Baked Tofu with Sesame Broccoli and Quinoa
ingredients_json: ["400 g firm tofu", "250 g broccoli florets", "150 g cooked quinoa", "1 tbsp olive oil", "20 g sesame seeds", "2 cloves garlic", "30 g low-sodium soy sauce", "20 ml rice vinegar", "10 g fresh ginger", "1 tsp toasted sesame oil", "1 g red chili flakes", "300 ml vegetable stock"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°C. Pat the tofu dry, then cut it into 2 cm cubes. In a bowl, mix the soy sauce, rice vinegar, grated ginger, minced garlic, chili flakes, and the sesame oil. Toss the tofu cubes in the marinade, then place them on a lined baking tray. Drizzle with the olive oil and bake for 20–25 minutes, turning once halfway, until the edges are golden and slightly crisp. While the tofu bakes, steam the broccoli for 4–5 minutes until bright green and tender-crisp. Warm the cooked quinoa in a small pan with the vegetable stock over medium heat for 3–4 minutes. Stir in the sesame seeds and toss until fragrant. Serve the quinoa with the baked ginger-soy tofu and broccoli, and spoon any tray juices over the top.

title: Spinach & Turkey Tortellini in Creamy Tomato-Garlic Sauce
ingredients_json: ["350 g cheese tortellini, refrigerated", "250 g turkey mince, lean", "300 g crushed tomatoes, passata style", "200 g spinach, fresh", "15 g olive oil", "2 cloves garlic", "1 medium onion", "1 tsp dried oregano", "120 g low-fat Greek yogurt (2%)", "40 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper"]
instructions: Finely chop the onion and mince the garlic. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat, then cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Add the garlic and turkey mince, season with salt and black pepper, and cook for 8–10 minutes until the turkey is browned and cooked through. Stir in the crushed tomatoes and oregano, bring to a gentle simmer, and let it cook for 10 minutes to thicken. Meanwhile, wilt the spinach in the microwave or in a small pan until just soft, then stir it through the sauce. Cook the tortellini according to the package instructions until tender, then drain and add them to the sauce. Turn the heat to low and stir in the low-fat Greek yogurt and half the Parmesan until the sauce is creamy and smooth; do not boil. Serve immediately with the remaining Parmesan on top.

title: Spinach & Turkey Tortellini in Tomato-Garlic Sauce
ingredients_json: ["250 g dried cheese tortellini", "250 g turkey mince, lean", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes", "200 g fresh spinach", "120 g grated Parmesan cheese", "200 ml low-sodium vegetable stock", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp fine salt", "0.25 tsp black pepper"]
instructions: Cook the tortellini in a large pot of salted boiling water according to the package instructions until just tender, then drain and set aside. Heat the olive oil in a deep pan over medium heat and sauté the finely chopped onion for 5 minutes until soft. Add the turkey mince and cook for 7–9 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and cooked through. Stir in the minced garlic and oregano for 30 seconds, then pour in the chopped tomatoes and vegetable stock. Simmer on low for 8 minutes to thicken slightly. Add the spinach and stir until wilted, then fold in the drained tortellini. Sprinkle over the Parmesan and toss for 1–2 minutes until everything is hot and glossy. Taste and adjust with black pepper before serving.

title: Creamy Spinach & Turkey Tortellini in Garlic Tomato Sauce
ingredients_json: ["250 g Cheese tortellini", "250 g Turkey mince, lean", "300 g Passata di pomodoro", "150 g Baby spinach, fresh", "1 medium Onion, yellow", "2 cloves Garlic", "15 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "150 g Low-fat ricotta", "50 g Parmesan, grated", "200 ml Vegetable stock, low-salt", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1 tsp Dried basil", "1/2 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 tsp Salt, table", "10 ml Balsamic vinegar"]
instructions: Finely chop the onion and mince the garlic. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat, then cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft. Add the turkey mince and cook for 7–9 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and cooked through. Stir in the garlic, oregano, basil, and black pepper, and cook for 30 seconds. Pour in the passata and vegetable stock, add the balsamic vinegar, and simmer for 8 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly. Add the spinach and stir until wilted, then reduce the heat to low and mix in the ricotta. Cook the tortellini according to the package instructions in lightly salted boiling water, drain, and add to the sauce. Toss well for 1–2 minutes so the tortellini is coated and warmed through. Serve hot with the grated parmesan on top.

title: Chicken and Black Bean Tostadas with Avocado-Lime Salsa
ingredients_json: ["180 g chicken breast, raw", "1 dl water", "200 g black beans, canned, drained", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp salt", "0.25 tsp black pepper, ground", "250 g tomato, chopped", "120 g red onion, finely chopped", "1 clove garlic", "30 g corn tortillas, baked style", "1 piece avocado, raw", "1 tbsp lime juice", "20 g Greek yogurt, plain 2% fat", "40 g lettuce, shredded", "15 g fresh cilantro, chopped"]
instructions: Warm the oven to 200°C. Slice the chicken breast into thin strips, then heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for about 6–8 minutes until no longer pink. Stir in the cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, salt and black pepper, then add the beans and water and simmer for 3–4 minutes so the mixture thickens slightly. For the salsa, combine the chopped tomato, red onion, grated garlic, lime juice and half of the cilantro in a bowl. Bake or crisp the corn tortillas in the oven for 3–5 minutes until lightly golden and crisp. Mash the avocado with the Greek yogurt until creamy. Assemble the tostadas by spreading the avocado-yogurt on the tortillas, topping with the hot chicken-bean mixture, then finishing with shredded lettuce, salsa and the remaining cilantro. Serve immediately while the tortillas are still crunchy.

title: Chicken and Black Bean Tostadas with Avocado-Lime Crema
ingredients_json: ["120 g corn tostada shells (baked/low-oil)", "250 g chicken breast, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "200 g canned black beans, drained and rinsed", "120 g canned chopped tomatoes", "120 g red onion", "1 clove garlic", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 lime, juice", "80 g Greek yogurt, plain 2%", "1 tbsp cilantro, fresh", "100 g avocado", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the diced red onion and cook for 3–4 minutes until softened. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the chicken breast cut into small cubes, cumin, and smoked paprika. Cook for about 8–10 minutes until the chicken is no longer pink. Add black beans, chopped tomatoes, and 1 tsp salt, then simmer for 6–8 minutes so the mixture thickens slightly. Stir in the lime juice and black pepper and let it cool for 3 minutes. In a bowl, mash the avocado with Greek yogurt and chopped cilantro until creamy, then taste and adjust with a little extra lime if needed. Warm the tostada shells in the oven at 200°C for 3 minutes to crisp. Spoon the chicken-bean mixture over the shells and finish with a generous dollop of avocado-lime crema. Serve immediately while the tostadas stay crisp.

title: Black Bean and Chicken Tostadas with Avocado-Lime Salsa
ingredients_json: ["4 tbsp 7 g tortillas, corn, baked (tostada shells)", "200 g cooked chicken breast, diced", "150 g black beans, cooked and drained", "200 g passata (tomato purée)", "1 tbsp 15 ml olive oil", "1 piece 120 g onion, yellow, diced", "2 cloves 10 g garlic, minced", "1 tsp 3 g ground cumin", "1 tsp 2 g smoked paprika", "1/2 tsp 2 g salt", "1/4 tsp 1 g black pepper", "150 g avocado, peeled and sliced", "100 g Greek yogurt, plain 2% (for crema)", "1 piece 40 g lime juice", "60 g shredded lettuce", "40 g cherry tomatoes, halved", "20 g fresh coriander, chopped"]
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for about 5 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic, cumin, and smoked paprika and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the passata and black beans, then simmer for 8–10 minutes until the mixture thickens slightly. Stir in the diced chicken and cook for 3–4 minutes, seasoning with salt and black pepper until the filling is hot and well coated. Meanwhile, warm the baked corn tostada shells in the oven at 200°C for 3–4 minutes so they crisp up. Mix the Greek yogurt with half the lime juice and a small spoon of the warm tomato-bean mixture to create a light crema. Assemble the tostadas by spooning the hot chicken-bean filling onto each shell, topping with lettuce, avocado slices, halved cherry tomatoes, and chopped coriander, then finish with the yogurt crema and the remaining lime juice. Serve immediately while the shells are crisp.

title: Chicken and Black Bean Tostadas with Avocado-Lime Slaw
ingredients_json: ["240 g cooked chicken breast, diced", "200 g canned black beans, drained and rinsed", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion, diced (150 g)", "2 cloves garlic, minced (6 g)", "200 g tomato passata", "1 tsp ground cumin (2 g)", "1 tsp smoked paprika (2 g)", "0.5 tsp dried oregano (1 g)", "1 tsp salt (5 g)", "8 corn tostada shells", "120 g low-fat Greek yogurt (2%)", "1 medium avocado (150 g)", "30 ml lime juice", "250 g shredded red cabbage", "1 medium carrot, grated (80 g)", "15 g fresh coriander, chopped", "1 tbsp apple cider vinegar (15 ml)"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5–6 minutes until softened and lightly golden. Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the cooked chicken, black beans, passata, cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, and salt. Simmer for 8–10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the mixture is thick and saucy. Meanwhile, prepare the slaw by mixing the shredded red cabbage and grated carrot with the apple cider vinegar and half of the coriander, then set aside. In a bowl, mash the avocado with the lime juice and the remaining coriander, and stir in the Greek yogurt until smooth. Assemble the tostadas by spooning a generous layer of the chicken-bean mixture onto each tostada shell, topping with avocado-lime yogurt, and finishing with the cabbage slaw. Serve immediately while the tostadas are crisp.

title: Chicken & Black Bean Tostadas with Avocado-Cilantro Lime Crema
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces Corn tortillas", "250 g Chicken breast, raw", "200 g Black beans, cooked and drained", "1 piece Red bell pepper", "120 g Onion", "2 cloves Garlic", "200 g Crushed tomatoes", "15 g Olive oil", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1 g Smoked paprika", "5 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper", "1 piece Lime", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain 2% fat", "1 piece Avocado, ripe", "10 g Fresh coriander (cilantro)"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Lightly brush the corn tortillas with 5 g of the olive oil and place them on a baking tray. Bake for about 8–10 minutes until crisp and lightly golden, then set aside. While the tortillas bake, dice the onion and bell pepper and mince the garlic. Heat the remaining 10 g olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the onion and bell pepper for 5–6 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the ground cumin, oregano, smoked paprika, and black pepper. Stir in the crushed tomatoes and black beans, and simmer for 10 minutes. Season the chicken breast with 1 g salt, then cut it into bite-size pieces and cook in a separate pan over medium-high heat for 6–8 minutes until no longer pink in the centre. Stir the cooked chicken into the bean-tomato mixture and simmer for 2 minutes. Meanwhile, make the crema by mashing the avocado with the Greek yogurt, the zest and juice of the lime, and the chopped coriander, adding 1 g salt to balance the flavour. Assemble the tostadas by topping each crisp tortilla with the hot chicken-black bean mixture and finishing with a generous spoonful of avocado-lime crema. Serve immediately while the tortillas are still crisp.

title: Creamy Tuna and Sweetcorn Casseroles with Wholewheat Topping
ingredients_json: ["1 can 200 g Tuna, canned in spring water, drained", "250 g Potatoes, raw, diced", "1 tbsp 15 g Olive oil", "1 piece 80 g Onion, yellow, diced", "2 cloves 10 g Garlic, fresh, minced", "200 g Courgette, grated", "150 g Sweetcorn, canned, drained", "200 g Greek yogurt, low-fat (2%), plain", "150 ml Vegetable stock, low-salt", "1 tbsp 8 g Wholewheat flour", "1 tsp 5 g Dijon mustard", "1 tsp 3 g Dried thyme", "1/2 tsp 1 g Black pepper, ground", "1 tsp 6 g Salt", "60 g Cheddar cheese, reduced fat, grated", "50 g Wholemeal breadcrumbs"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C and lightly oil a small casserole dish or 2 individual baking dishes. Cook the diced potatoes in a pan of boiling water for 8 minutes, then drain well. Heat the olive oil in a skillet and sauté the onion for 3 to 4 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then stir in the grated courgette and cook for 5 minutes to remove excess moisture. Reduce the heat slightly and stir in the sweetcorn, thyme, Dijon mustard, black pepper, and wholewheat flour. Pour in the vegetable stock and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes until the mixture thickens. Remove the pan from the heat and mix in the drained tuna and the low-fat Greek yogurt to create a creamy filling. Spoon the filling into the dish, top with grated reduced-fat cheddar and wholemeal breadcrumbs, then bake for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling and golden on top. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving for cleaner portions.

title: Creamy Tuna Casseroles with Spinach, Mushrooms and Whole-Grain Topping
ingredients_json: ["320 g canned tuna in water, drained", "300 g cooked brown rice", "200 g mushrooms, sliced", "180 g canned chopped tomatoes", "200 g light crème fraîche", "120 g spinach, fresh", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "0.5 tsp salt", "60 g whole-grain breadcrumbs", "80 g low-fat cheddar cheese, grated"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Heat the olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat, then cook the onion for 5 minutes until softened. Add the mushrooms and cook for another 6–8 minutes until they release their moisture and start to brown. Stir in the garlic, oregano, and black pepper for 30 seconds, then add the canned tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes. In a bowl, mix the tuna with the cooked brown rice and light crème fraîche, then fold in the spinach until wilted. Stir in the tomato-mushroom mixture and season with salt. Spoon the mixture into a small casserole dish (or individual ramekins) and top with breadcrumbs and grated low-fat cheddar. Bake for 20–25 minutes until bubbling and golden on top. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Creamy Light Tuna Casseroles with Wholegrain Breadcrumbs and Peas
ingredients_json: ["2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 small Onion", "2 cloves Garlic", "450 g Tuna, canned in water, drained", "300 g Frozen peas", "250 g Low-fat Greek yogurt", "200 ml Skimmed milk", "60 g Wholegrain breadcrumbs", "60 g Cheddar cheese, reduced-fat", "2 tbsp Tomato paste", "1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce", "1 tsp Dijon mustard", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "1 tsp Paprika, smoked", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 tsp Salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Finely chop the onion and mince the garlic, then heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Cook the onion for 5–6 minutes until soft, then stir in the garlic for 30 seconds. Add the tomato paste, thyme, smoked paprika, Dijon mustard, black pepper, and Worcestershire sauce, and cook for 1 minute. Stir in the milk and bring to a gentle simmer. Add the tuna and peas and cook for 3–4 minutes until hot and the mixture is glossy. Off the heat, fold in the Greek yogurt. Spoon the mixture into a suitable baking dish or 2–3 smaller casserole dishes, then top evenly with breadcrumbs and sprinkle over the reduced-fat cheddar. Bake for 20–25 minutes until bubbling at the edges and lightly golden on top. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Creamy Light Tuna Casserole with Spinach, Wholewheat Pasta and Cheddar
ingredients_json: ["300 g tuna, canned in water, drained", "200 g wholewheat pasta, dry", "250 g cottage cheese, low-fat", "150 g spinach, fresh", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "250 g tomato passata", "120 g cheddar cheese, reduced-fat", "20 g olive oil", "200 ml vegetable stock, low-salt", "10 g cornflour", "8 g Dijon mustard", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C. Cook the wholewheat pasta in boiling low-salt water until just tender, then drain and set aside. While the pasta cooks, finely chop the onion and mince the garlic. Heat the olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat and sauté the onion for 5–6 minutes until soft. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then stir in the passata, vegetable stock, Dijon mustard, and black pepper. In a small cup, mix the cornflour with 2 tablespoons of cold water, then pour it into the sauce while stirring; simmer for 2 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly. Stir in the spinach until wilted. Fold in the tuna and the cooked pasta, then stir through the low-fat cottage cheese to make the mixture creamy. Transfer everything to a baking dish, top evenly with the reduced-fat cheddar, and bake for 15–18 minutes until hot through and lightly bubbling. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving, so it sets properly and slices cleanly.

title: Creamy Tuna and Sweetcorn Casserole with Cheddar & Wholewheat
ingredients_json: ["2 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion, diced", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "300 g canned tuna in water, drained", "200 g sweetcorn, canned, drained", "250 g cooked wholewheat pasta", "250 g low-fat plain Greek yogurt", "2 tbsp wholemeal flour", "150 ml low-sodium vegetable stock", "150 g carrots, grated", "80 g Cheddar cheese, reduced-fat, grated", "10 g fresh parsley, chopped", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "0.5 tsp salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat, then cook the onion for about 5 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, stirring so it doesn’t burn. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute, then gradually whisk in the vegetable stock and bring to a gentle simmer until the sauce thickens. Add the Greek yogurt, oregano, black pepper, salt, carrots, tuna, and sweetcorn, then warm through for 2–3 minutes. Fold in the cooked wholewheat pasta and parsley, and spread the mixture into a baking dish. Sprinkle over the reduced-fat cheddar and bake for 20 minutes until bubbling and lightly golden on top. Rest for 5 minutes before serving so the casserole sets slightly.

title: Lemon-Dijon Tuna & White Bean Salad with Crunchy Cucumber
ingredients_json: ["240 g canned tuna in water, drained", "200 g canned cannellini beans, drained and rinsed", "150 g cucumber, diced", "120 g cherry tomatoes, halved", "80 g red onion, finely chopped", "70 g carrot, grated", "20 g Greek yogurt, 2% fat", "25 g mayonnaise, light", "20 ml extra virgin olive oil", "15 ml lemon juice", "10 g Dijon mustard", "8 g fresh parsley, chopped", "2 g garlic, minced", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the drained tuna, cannellini beans, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, red onion, and grated carrot. In a separate small bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt, light mayonnaise, extra virgin olive oil, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper until smooth. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss well so everything is evenly coated. Let the salad rest in the refrigerator for 10 minutes to let the flavors meld, then fold in the chopped parsley and serve cold or slightly chilled.

title: Lemon-Dijon Tuna Salad with Crunchy Cucumber and Chickpeas
ingredients_json: ["200 g tuna, canned in water, drained", "150 g chickpeas, cooked", "150 g cucumber, raw", "120 g cherry tomatoes", "60 g red onion", "40 g celery, raw", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, non-fat", "15 g Dijon mustard", "10 ml extra virgin olive oil", "15 ml lemon juice", "5 g fresh parsley", "3 g sea salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Drain the tuna well and flake it into a large bowl. Rinse the chickpeas under cold water and drain thoroughly, then add them to the bowl with the tuna. Dice the cucumber, halve the cherry tomatoes, finely slice the red onion, and chop the celery; add all vegetables to the bowl. In a separate small bowl, mix the Greek yogurt with Dijon mustard, olive oil, and lemon juice, then stir in the chopped parsley, black pepper, and sea salt. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently until everything is evenly coated. Chill in the refrigerator for 15 minutes so the flavors meld, then serve cold.

title: Greek-Style Lemon Tuna Salad with Chickpeas and Cucumber
ingredients_json: ["240 g canned tuna in water, drained", "150 g cooked chickpeas, drained and rinsed", "150 g cucumber, diced", "100 g cherry tomatoes, halved", "80 g red onion, finely chopped", "60 g bell pepper, diced", "80 g low-fat plain Greek yogurt", "20 g extra virgin olive oil", "15 ml lemon juice", "10 g Dijon mustard", "4 g dried oregano", "3 g sea salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the drained tuna, chickpeas, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, red onion, and bell pepper. In a separate small bowl, mix the Greek yogurt, olive oil, lemon juice, and Dijon mustard until smooth, then stir in oregano, black pepper, and the sea salt. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently until everything is evenly coated. Let the salad sit in the fridge for 10 minutes so the flavors blend, then serve chilled.

title: Lemon-Dijon Tuna Salad with Chickpeas and Crunchy Cucumber
ingredients_json: ["240 g canned tuna in water, drained", "200 g chickpeas, cooked and drained", "150 g cucumber, diced", "120 g cherry tomatoes, halved", "70 g red onion, finely sliced", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tbsp plain Greek yogurt 2%", "1 tbsp Dijon mustard", "2 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tsp honey", "10 g fresh parsley, chopped", "6 g capers, drained", "1 g sea salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Drain the tuna well and flake it into a large bowl. Add the chickpeas, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, and red onion. In a separate small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, Greek yogurt, Dijon mustard, lemon juice, honey, parsley, capers, sea salt, and black pepper until smooth. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently so everything is coated, but the chickpeas stay intact. Let the salad sit for 10 minutes in the fridge to let the flavors meld, then serve chilled.

title: Oven-Baked Turkey Meatballs with Tomato Basil Sauce and Courgette
ingredients_json: ["500 g turkey mince, 5% fat", "1 piece egg, raw", "80 g wholemeal breadcrumbs", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 clove garlic", "1 tbsp olive oil", "600 g passata (tomato purée), no added salt", "200 g courgette", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp dried basil", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "10 g parmesan cheese, hard"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Finely chop the onion and garlic, then mix them in a bowl with the turkey mince, egg, wholemeal breadcrumbs, oregano, basil, smoked paprika, and the parmesan. Shape the mixture into evenly sized meatballs and place them on a lightly oiled baking tray. Bake for 18 minutes until browned and cooked through. While the meatballs cook, grate the courgette and simmer the passata in a saucepan with the dried herbs until hot and slightly thickened, then stir in the courgette and simmer for 5 minutes. Add the baked meatballs to the sauce and simmer for 3 minutes so the flavours meld. Serve hot, with the sauce spooned over the meatballs.

title: Herb Roasted Turkey Meatballs with Tomato-Lentil Sauce
ingredients_json: ["500 g turkey mince, 5% fat", "1 piece egg, raw", "60 g rolled oats", "1 piece onion", "2 cloves garlic", "250 g canned tomatoes, chopped, no added salt", "200 g canned lentils, cooked, no added salt", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 dl low-sodium chicken stock", "10 g fresh parsley", "1 g salt", "0.5 g black pepper"]
instructions:
Preheat the oven to 220°C. Line a baking tray with baking paper. In a bowl, mix the turkey mince, egg, rolled oats, finely chopped onion, minced garlic, oregano, cumin, chopped parsley, salt, and black pepper until evenly combined. Shape the mixture into meatballs about 30–35 g each and place them on the tray. Drizzle with the olive oil and roast for 15 minutes, until the meatballs are cooked through and browned at the edges.

Meanwhile, heat the chicken stock and canned tomatoes in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir in the lentils and simmer for 8–10 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly. Add the roasted meatballs to the sauce and simmer gently for 3 minutes so the flavours come together. Serve hot with the tomato-lentil sauce spooned over the meatballs.

title: Herby Turkey Mince Skillet with Spinach, Tomatoes & Quinoa
ingredients_json: ["500 g Turkey mince, lean 5% fat", "200 g quinoa, dry", "400 g canned tomatoes, chopped (no added salt)", "200 g onion, diced", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "200 g spinach, fresh", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp ground cumin", "300 ml chicken stock, low-salt", "5 g salt, reduced salt", "2 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Rinse the quinoa under cold water, then add it to a pot with the low-salt chicken stock and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer for about 15 minutes, or until the quinoa is tender and the liquid is absorbed. While the quinoa cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the onion for 4–5 minutes until softened and lightly golden. Add the turkey mince, breaking it up with a spoon, and cook for 7–9 minutes until browned and cooked through. Stir in the garlic, oregano, and cumin for 30 seconds, then add the chopped tomatoes and let it simmer for 5 minutes to thicken slightly. Fold in the fresh spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes until wilted. Season with the reduced-salt and black pepper, then combine the turkey-tomato mixture with the cooked quinoa and heat through for 1 minute so everything is evenly hot.

title: Herb Roasted Turkey Meatballs with Tomato Spinach Sauce
ingredients_json: ["500 g Turkey mince, 5% fat", "1 piece Egg, raw", "80 g Rolled oats", "1 pc Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "400 g Chopped tomatoes, canned", "200 g Spinach, fresh", "150 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "1 tsp Paprika, smoked", "0.5 tsp Fine salt", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°C. Line a baking tray with baking paper and set aside. In a bowl, combine the turkey mince, egg, rolled oats, finely grated onion, minced garlic, oregano, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. Mix well until the mixture holds together. Shape into meatballs (about 20–22 g each) and place them on the tray, leaving space between them. Roast for 14 minutes, until browned and cooked through. Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat and add the chopped tomatoes; simmer for 8 minutes. Stir in the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted. Fold in the low-fat Greek yogurt to make the sauce creamy, then season lightly with pepper if needed. Serve the turkey meatballs with the tomato-spinach sauce, spooning extra sauce over the top.

title: Whole-Wheat Ziti with Lean Turkey Marinara, Spinach and Low-Fat Mozzarella
ingredients_json: ["200 g ziti pasta, whole-wheat, dry", "300 g turkey mince, lean (5% fat)", "15 ml olive oil", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "400 g crushed tomatoes, no added sugar", "170 g marinara sauce, reduced-sodium", "200 g spinach, fresh", "120 g mozzarella cheese, part-skim", "40 g parmesan cheese, grated", "10 g dried oregano", "5 g dried basil", "3 g table salt", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the whole-wheat ziti until al dente, then drain and reserve a small splash of pasta water. Heat the olive oil in a deep pan over medium heat and sauté the onion for about 5 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the turkey mince and cook for 8–10 minutes until browned and cooked through. Stir in the crushed tomatoes, reduced-sodium marinara sauce, dried oregano, dried basil, salt and black pepper, and simmer for 10 minutes so the sauce thickens slightly. Stir the spinach into the sauce and cook for 2–3 minutes until wilted. Add the drained ziti to the sauce and toss well, loosening with a little reserved pasta water if needed. Turn off the heat and fold in half the mozzarella and parmesan. Transfer to a baking dish, top with the remaining mozzarella and parmesan, and bake at 200°C for 12–15 minutes until bubbling and lightly golden.

title: Whole-Wheat Ziti with Turkey Ragù, Spinach, and Ricotta
ingredients_json: ["300 g ziti pasta, whole-wheat, dry", "1 tbsp  olive oil", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic", "450 g turkey mince, lean (5–10% fat)", "400 g crushed tomatoes", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "200 g spinach, fresh", "150 g ricotta cheese, part-skim", "60 g parmesan cheese, grated", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp dried basil", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper", "250 ml water"]
instructions: Cook the whole-wheat ziti in a large pot of boiling water until al dente, then drain and reserve a small splash of pasta water. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a deep pan over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion and cook for 6–8 minutes until soft and translucent, then stir in the minced garlic for 30–45 seconds until fragrant. Add the turkey mince and cook for 8–10 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and cooked through. Stir in the crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, oregano, basil, salt, pepper, and 250 ml water, then simmer gently for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Fold the spinach into the sauce and cook for 2–3 minutes until wilted. In a baking dish, combine the drained ziti with the turkey ragù and ricotta, stirring until the pasta is coated. Sprinkle with parmesan and bake at 200°C for 12–15 minutes until bubbling and lightly golden on top. Rest for 3 minutes before serving.

title: Wholewheat Ziti with Lean Turkey Bolognese and Spinach Parmesan
ingredients_json: ["300 g ziti pasta, wholewheat, dry", "400 g turkey mince, lean (5-10% fat)", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 medium carrot, raw", "200 g button mushrooms, raw", "500 g passata, no added sugar", "2 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp dried basil", "1 tsp table salt", "1/2 tsp black pepper, ground", "120 g spinach, raw", "80 g Parmesan cheese, reduced-fat", "200 ml water"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil and cook the wholewheat ziti according to the package instructions until al dente, then drain and reserve a small splash of cooking water. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a deep pan over medium heat and sauté the finely chopped onion and grated carrot for 6–8 minutes until softened. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook for another 5 minutes until they release their liquid and start to brown lightly. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the turkey mince, break it up with a spoon, and cook for 8–10 minutes until no longer pink. Pour in the passata, add oregano and basil, then season with salt and pepper. Simmer gently for 12–15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens; add the water if it becomes too thick. Fold the spinach into the sauce and cook for 1–2 minutes until wilted. Combine the drained ziti with the turkey sauce, loosening with a little reserved pasta water if needed, then grate in the reduced-fat Parmesan and mix well. Serve hot, making sure the pasta is evenly coated with sauce.

title: Lemon-Blueberry Angel Food Cake with Greek Yogurt Berries
ingredients_json: ["180 g Egg white", "140 g Sugar, white", "60 g Flour, wheat, plain", "1 tbsp Cornstarch", "2 g Cream of tartar", "2 g Salt", "1 tbsp Lemon zest", "60 ml Lemon juice", "300 g Blueberries, fresh", "170 g Greek yogurt, low-fat, plain (2%)", "20 g Honey", "1 tsp Vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175°C. In a clean, dry bowl, whisk the egg whites until they form soft foam. Add the cream of tartar and salt, then gradually whisk in the sugar until the mixture is glossy and holds stiff peaks. Sift the flour and cornstarch over the meringue in two additions, folding gently with a spatula to keep the air in. Fold in the lemon zest and lemon juice just until combined. Spoon the batter into an ungreased 20 cm angel food cake tube pan and smooth the top. Bake for 30–35 minutes until the cake is lightly golden and springs back when touched. Immediately invert the pan and cool completely, at least 60 minutes, to prevent collapse. While the cake cools, gently warm the blueberries in a small pan for 3–4 minutes until they burst slightly, then cool. Mix the Greek yogurt with honey and vanilla. Serve slices with the lemon-blueberry topping and a spoon of yogurt.

title: Lemon Blueberry Angel Food Cakes with Greek Yogurt Berry Sauce
ingredients_json: ["180 g egg whites", "120 g caster sugar", "30 g powdered sugar", "150 g wheat flour, plain", "1 tsp cornstarch", "1 tbsp lemon zest", "2 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1/2 tsp cream of tartar", "200 g blueberries", "200 g plain low-fat Greek yogurt", "60 g honey", "1 g fine salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175°C. Line a cupcake tin or angel food cake moulds with parchment liners, making sure the liners do not touch the sides of the mould if using a tall shape. In a large, perfectly clean bowl, beat the egg whites with the cream of tartar until foamy, then gradually add the caster sugar while continuing to beat until the mixture becomes glossy and forms stiff peaks. Sift together the plain flour and cornstarch, then gently fold the dry ingredients into the egg whites in three additions, being careful not to deflate. Fold in the lemon zest, lemon juice, and vanilla extract until just combined. Spoon the batter into the prepared moulds, filling each about two-thirds full, then sprinkle a few blueberries on top of each cake. Bake for 18–22 minutes, until the tops are set and spring back lightly when touched. Let the cakes cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely. For the sauce, stir the Greek yogurt with honey and fold in the remaining blueberries. Serve the angel food cakes with the yogurt berry sauce once the cakes are cool so the texture stays airy.

title: Lemon-Raspberry Angel Food Cake with Greek Yogurt Berry Sauce
ingredients_json: ["120 g egg white, pasteurized", "150 g icing sugar", "90 g wheat flour, plain (all-purpose)", "30 g granulated sugar", "1 g cream of tartar", "2 g salt", "15 g lemon zest", "30 ml lemon juice", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "150 g fresh raspberries", "200 g Greek yogurt, low-fat (2%)", "20 g honey", "5 g cornstarch"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175°C. Grease an angel food cake tube pan very lightly, then line the base with baking paper if your pan tends to stick. Sift the flour and icing sugar together, then set aside. In a clean bowl, whisk the egg whites with the cream of tartar and salt until foamy, then gradually add the granulated sugar while whisking until you reach stiff, glossy peaks. Gently fold in the sifted flour and icing sugar mixture in three additions, taking care not to deflate the meringue. Fold in the lemon zest, lemon juice, and vanilla extract until just combined. Spoon the batter into the pan and smooth the top. Bake for 28–32 minutes until the cake is golden and springs back when lightly touched, with the sides pulling slightly away from the pan. Cool the cake inverted for at least 45 minutes, then remove from the pan. While the cake cools, heat the Greek yogurt with honey in a small saucepan over low heat and whisk cornstarch with 1 tablespoon of water until smooth, then stir into the yogurt. Cook for 2–3 minutes until slightly thickened. Warm the raspberries for 1 minute in a separate small pan just until juicy, then swirl them through the yogurt sauce. Slice the cake and serve with the lemon-berry yogurt sauce.

title: Cinnamon Apple Pie with Oat Crumble and Light Butter
ingredients_json: ["800 g apples, firm, peeled and sliced", "30 g whole wheat flour", "120 g rolled oats", "40 g light butter, unsalted", "60 g brown sugar", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 g ground nutmeg", "2 g salt", "1 piece egg, raw"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 190°C and grease a 22 cm pie dish. Toss the sliced apples with the lemon juice, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt, and the whole wheat flour until the slices look lightly coated. In a bowl, mix the oats and brown sugar, then rub in the light butter with your fingertips until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Spread the apples into the prepared dish and cover with the oat crumble. Beat the egg and drizzle it lightly over the crumble for a golden finish. Bake for 35–40 minutes, until the apples are tender and the topping is deep golden. Let the pie cool for at least 15 minutes before slicing so the juices thicken.

title: Wholemeal Apple Pie with Cinnamon-Oat Crumble
ingredients_json: ["450 g apples, sweet (e.g., Gala or Honeycrisp), peeled and sliced", "60 g rolled oats, whole", "90 g wholemeal wheat flour", "40 g unsalted butter", "70 g light brown sugar", "120 ml low-fat milk (1.5%)", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "5 g lemon juice", "2 g fine salt", "8 g baking powder", "10 g cornstarch"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C. Grease a pie dish (about 22–24 cm) lightly. In a bowl, mix the sliced apples with lemon juice, cinnamon, and cornstarch so the fruit thickens as it bakes. In another bowl, rub the butter into the rolled oats and wholemeal flour until it looks like coarse crumbs. Stir in the light brown sugar, baking powder, and the salt, then add the egg and milk and mix just until a thick, slightly sticky dough forms. Spread about two-thirds of the dough into the bottom of the dish, then layer the apples on top. Crumble the remaining dough over the apples to form an even top. Bake for 40–45 minutes, until the top is golden and the apple juices are visibly bubbling. Let the pie cool for at least 15 minutes before slicing, so it sets and holds together.

title: Whole-Wheat Apple Pie with Oat Crumble and Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["500 g apples, firm, peeled and diced", "70 g whole wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "60 g unsalted butter, cold", "50 g brown sugar", "1 tbsp ground cinnamon", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 g ground nutmeg", "1 g salt", "1 piece egg, raw", "30 ml milk, skimmed"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C. In a bowl, mix the diced apples with lemon juice, cinnamon, nutmeg, and the salt, then set aside. In another bowl, rub the cold butter into the oats and whole wheat flour until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Stir in the brown sugar, then lightly press about two-thirds of the crumble into the bottom of a lightly greased pie dish. Add the spiced apples, then cover with the remaining crumble. Whisk the egg with the skimmed milk and drizzle it over the top for a golden finish. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until the apples are tender and the top is deeply golden. Let the pie cool for at least 15 minutes before slicing so the filling sets.

title: Oat and Apple Cinnamon Bar Cookies with Greek Yogurt Glaze
ingredients_json: ["200 g rolled oats", "120 g whole wheat flour", "120 g grated apple", "120 g plain Greek yogurt, low-fat", "80 g honey", "60 g unsalted butter", "2 pieces eggs, raw", "2 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp fine sea salt", "2 tsp vanilla extract", "60 ml milk, low-fat", "150 g powdered sugar", "1 tbsp lemon juice"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C and line a 20×20 cm baking pan with parchment paper, leaving a little overhang for lifting. In a large bowl, mix the rolled oats, whole wheat flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs, honey, melted butter, Greek yogurt, vanilla extract, and milk until smooth. title: Oatmeal Date-Walnut Bar Cookies with Dark Chocolate

title: Healthy Oat and Dark Chocolate Cranberry Bar Cookies
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "120 g whole wheat flour", "100 g rolled oat flour", "120 g dark chocolate chips (70%)", "160 g plain Greek yogurt (2%)", "140 g unsweetened applesauce", "120 g honey", "2 piece eggs, raw", "120 ml olive oil", "2 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp baking soda", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp fine salt", "100 g dried cranberries, unsweetened"]

title: Oat Almond Biscotti with Orange Zest (Lightly Sweetened)

title: Orange-Almond Oatmeal Biscotti with Dark Chocolate Drizzle
ingredients_json: ["180 g whole_rolled_oats", "90 g whole_wheat_flour", "30 g ground_almonds", "20 g chia_seeds", "10 g baking_powder", "2 g fine_sea_salt", "2 g ground_cinnamon", "2 piece egg, raw", "80 g honey", "40 g olive_oil", "1 pc orange, zest only", "40 g dark_chocolate, 70% cocoa", "30 ml orange_juice"]

title: Cinnamon Oat Almond Biscotti with Orange Zest
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "60 g whole wheat flour", "60 g ground almonds", "120 g plain Greek yogurt, 2%", "2 large eggs", "40 g honey", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 g fine salt", "10 g orange zest", "30 g dark chocolate chips (70%), chopped"]

title: Cranberry-Almond Oat Biscotti with Orange Zest (Baked Twice)
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "120 g whole wheat flour", "60 g ground almonds", "80 g unsweetened dried cranberries", "120 g plain low-fat Greek yogurt", "2 piece egg", "80 g honey", "60 ml olive oil", "12 g baking powder", "3 g fine sea salt", "8 g orange zest", "5 ml vanilla extract"]

title: Almond Oat Biscotti with Dark Chocolate and Orange Zest
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal spelt flour", "90 g rolled oats", "60 g ground almonds", "80 g maple syrup", "2 large eggs, raw", "80 ml olive oil, extra virgin", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 orange, zest only", "80 g dark chocolate chips (70% cocoa)", "2 g fine salt"]

title: Wholegrain Oat Blondies with Apple and Cinnamon

title: Wholegrain Oat & Banana Blondies with Dark Chocolate Chunks

title: Cinnamon-Oat Blondies with Banana and Dark Chocolate Chunks

title: Oatmeal Banana Blondies with Dark Chocolate Swirls

title: Whole-Grain Blueberry Pie with Oat Crumble and Lemon
ingredients_json: ["300 g blueberries, fresh", "200 g blueberries, fresh", "60 g rolled oats", "120 g whole wheat flour", "80 g unsalted butter", "30 g honey", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tsp lemon zest", "1 g ground cinnamon", "10 g cornstarch", "1 g fine salt"]

title: Whole-Grain Blueberry Pie with Oat Crust and Vanilla Chia Filling
ingredients_json: ["300 g blueberries, fresh or frozen", "80 g whole-wheat flour", "60 g rolled oats", "40 g unsalted butter, chilled", "30 g Greek yogurt, plain 2%", "50 g honey", "10 g chia seeds", "1 pc egg, whole, raw", "1 g vanilla extract", "10 ml lemon juice", "1 g ground cinnamon", "2 g salt"]

Let the pie cool for at least 20 minutes before slicing, so the filling firms up.

title: Light Blueberry Pie with Oat & Almond Crust
ingredients_json: ["250 g blueberries, fresh or frozen", "40 g rolled oats", "40 g whole wheat flour", "30 g ground almonds", "35 g unsalted butter, cold", "60 g plain Greek yogurt, 2%", "1 pc egg, raw", "25 g honey", "10 g lemon juice", "5 g lemon zest", "5 g cornstarch", "2 g vanilla extract", "2 g ground cinnamon", "2 g fine salt"]

Press about 2/3 of the dough into a greased 20–23 cm pie dish and shape a slightly raised edge. In another bowl, toss the blueberries with honey, lemon juice, lemon zest, and cornstarch, then spread the filling over the crust. Crumble the remaining dough on top, leaving some spots for the filling to bubble. Bake for 35–40 minutes, until the crust is golden and the blueberry filling is visibly thickened. Let the pie cool for at least 20 minutes before slicing so the filling sets.

title: Whole-Grain Blueberry Pie with Oat Crust and Vanilla
ingredients_json: ["250 g blueberries, fresh", "120 g blueberries, fresh", "60 g oats, rolled", "60 g whole wheat flour", "50 g unsalted butter", "60 g honey", "1 piece egg, raw", "120 ml milk, low-fat 2%", "15 g cornstarch", "40 g brown sugar", "5 g lemon juice", "2 g vanilla extract", "2 g salt"]

Sprinkle the remaining crumb mixture over the top. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until the crust is golden and the filling is bubbling around the edges. Let the pie cool for at least 20 minutes before slicing so the filling firms up.

title: Whole-Grain Blueberry Pie with Oat Crust and Vanilla
ingredients_json: ["250 g blueberries, fresh", "30 g blueberries, dried", "30 g rolled oats", "120 g whole wheat flour", "70 g unsalted butter", "60 g Greek yogurt, plain 2%", "1 piece egg", "20 g maple syrup", "40 g brown sugar", "10 g lemon juice", "6 g lemon zest", "8 g corn starch", "5 g ground cinnamon", "2 g salt", "2 ml vanilla extract"]

Pour the blueberry filling into the crust and crumble the remaining dough over the top. Bake for 35–40 minutes, until the crust is golden and the filling is bubbling at the edges. title: Black Bean and Dark Chocolate Fudge Brownies

title: Walnut-Oat Cocoa Brownies with Dark Chocolate Swirl

Spread the batter evenly in the pan and bake for 20–24 minutes, until the edges look set and the center is slightly soft but not raw. Cool in the pan for at least 20 minutes before slicing into brownies, so they hold together.

title: Cocoa-Oat Banana Brownies with Dark Chocolate Chunks

Let the brownies cool in the pan for at least 20 minutes before lifting out and cutting into squares.

title: Black Bean Cocoa Brownies with Dark Chocolate and Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["200 g canned black beans, drained and rinsed", "160 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa, chopped", "30 g unsalted butter", "80 g maple syrup", "2 piece egg", "50 g cocoa powder, unsweetened", "50 g whole wheat flour", "80 g walnuts, chopped", "10 g baking powder", "1 g fine salt", "10 ml vanilla extract", "60 ml milk, low-fat (1.5%)"]

title: Wholewheat Carrot Cakes with Greek Yogurt Cream

title: Wholegrain Carrot Cakes with Cinnamon and Greek Yogurt Glaze
ingredients_json: ["200 g carrots, grated", "180 g whole wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "2 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp ground nutmeg", "3 large eggs, raw", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, non-fat", "60 ml rapeseed oil", "120 g honey", "60 g raisins", "40 g walnuts, chopped", "1 tbsp vanilla extract", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, non-fat", "30 g powdered sugar", "1 tsp lemon zest"]

title: Wholegrain Carrot Cakes with Greek Yogurt Honey Glaze
ingredients_json: ["200 g carrots, raw, grated", "120 g plain wheat flour, wholemeal", "60 g rolled oats, quick-cooking", "120 g Greek yogurt, low-fat (2%), plain", "2 pieces eggs, raw", "80 g brown sugar", "60 ml rapeseed oil", "10 g baking powder", "5 g ground cinnamon", "2 g ground nutmeg", "60 g raisins", "1 g fine salt", "60 g walnuts, chopped", "80 g cream cheese, light (reduced-fat)", "40 g honey"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a muffin tray or small cake moulds with paper cases. In a large bowl, whisk the eggs with the brown sugar until slightly lighter. Whisk in the Greek yogurt and rapeseed oil, then fold in the grated carrots, raisins, cinnamon, nutmeg, and chopped walnuts. In a separate bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, oats, baking powder, and salt, then add the dry mixture to the wet mixture and stir until just combined; the batter should look thick and moist. Divide the batter into the moulds and bake for 18–22 minutes, until the tops are set and a toothpick comes out clean. Let the cakes cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely. For the glaze, stir the light cream cheese with the honey until smooth. Spread a thin layer over the cooled carrot cakes and serve.

title: Wholegrain Carrot Cakes with Cinnamon and Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["180 g carrots, raw, grated", "160 g wholemeal wheat flour", "120 g rolled oats", "2 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tsp baking powder", "0.5 tsp baking soda", "3 g fine salt", "120 g Greek yogurt, non-fat", "2 pieces eggs, whole, raw", "70 g rapeseed oil", "100 g honey", "80 g walnuts, chopped", "20 g raisins"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a muffin or small cake tin with paper liners. In a large bowl, mix the grated carrots, Greek yogurt, eggs, rapeseed oil, and honey until well combined. In another bowl, whisk together the wholemeal flour, rolled oats, cinnamon, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Add the dry mixture to the wet ingredients and stir until no dry flour remains; fold in the walnuts and raisins. Divide the batter into the lined tin and bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until the tops are set and a skewer inserted in the center comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs. Let the carrot cakes cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely before serving.

title: Wholewheat Carrot Cakes with Greek Yogurt Honey Glaze
ingredients_json: ["250 g carrots, grated", "120 g rolled oats, finely ground", "90 g whole wheat flour", "80 g Greek yogurt, low-fat, plain", "60 g eggs, whole, raw", "40 g maple syrup", "50 g rapeseed oil", "50 g raisins", "10 g baking powder", "5 g ground cinnamon", "3 g fine salt", "1 g ground nutmeg", "150 g Greek yogurt, low-fat, plain (for glaze)", "30 g honey (for glaze)", "10 g lemon juice"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a muffin tin (or small cake molds) with paper liners. In a mixing bowl, combine the grated carrots, ground oats, whole wheat flour, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt. In another bowl, whisk the eggs with maple syrup, rapeseed oil, and low-fat Greek yogurt until smooth, then pour into the dry ingredients and mix until you have a thick, cohesive batter. Fold in the raisins. Divide the batter evenly and bake for 18–22 minutes, until the tops are lightly golden and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean or with just a few moist crumbs. Let the cakes cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely. For the glaze, stir the low-fat Greek yogurt with honey and lemon juice until smooth. Drizzle over the cooled carrot cakes and let it set for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Lemon Blueberry Greek Yogurt Cheesecakes (No-Bake)
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "60 g walnuts", "60 g dried blueberries", "80 g unsalted butter", "500 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2% fat", "200 g cream cheese", "70 g honey", "3 g gelatin, powdered", "60 ml water", "1 pc lemon, zest", "60 ml lemon juice", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 g fine salt"]
instructions: Line a 6-cup muffin tin with paper liners. Blend the oats and walnuts into fine crumbs, then mix in the dried blueberries. Melt the butter and stir it into the crumb mixture until evenly moistened. Press the crust firmly into the bottom of each cup and chill while you make the filling. In a small bowl, sprinkle the gelatin over the water and let it bloom for 5 minutes. Warm the gelatin mixture gently until it turns fully liquid, then let it cool slightly. In a large bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt, cream cheese, honey, lemon zest, lemon juice, vanilla extract, and salt until smooth. Whisk in the melted gelatin, then divide the filling among the cups. Chill for at least 4 hours, or until set. Serve cold, topping with extra lemon zest or a few fresh berries if desired.

title: Greek Yogurt Blueberry Cheesecake Cups (No-Bake)
ingredients_json: ["200 g digestive biscuits, wholegrain", "60 g unsalted butter", "500 g Greek yogurt, 2% fat", "250 g cottage cheese, low-fat", "120 g honey", "15 g lemon juice, fresh", "1 g lemon zest", "8 g gelatin, powder", "200 g blueberries, fresh", "2 g vanilla extract"]
instructions: Crush the wholegrain digestive biscuits into fine crumbs and melt the butter until just liquid. Stir the butter into the crumbs, then divide the mixture among 6 small serving cups and press firmly with the back of a spoon. Chill the cups in the fridge for 15 minutes. In a bowl, whisk the Greek yogurt and cottage cheese until smooth. Warm the gelatin with the lemon juice for about 20–30 seconds just until it dissolves completely, then whisk it into the yogurt mixture. Stir in the honey, vanilla extract, and lemon zest. Fold in half of the blueberries. Spoon the filling over the chilled crusts, add the remaining blueberries on top, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or until set. Serve cold straight from the fridge.

title: Greek Yogurt Cheesecake with Blueberries and Oat Crust (No-Bake)
ingredients_json: ["140 g rolled oats", "60 g walnuts", "80 g honey", "120 g unsalted butter", "500 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "400 g cottage cheese, low-fat", "50 g chia seeds", "10 g vanilla sugar", "30 g lemon juice", "120 g blueberries, fresh", "6 g powdered gelatin", "40 ml cold water"]
instructions: In a food processor, pulse the oats and walnuts until they look like fine crumbs. Melt the butter and mix it with the honey, then stir this into the crumb mixture until everything is evenly coated. Press the crust firmly into the bottom of a 20 cm springform pan, then chill it while you make the filling. In a bowl, whisk the Greek yogurt and cottage cheese until smooth. Stir in the chia seeds, vanilla sugar, and lemon juice, then let the mixture sit for 10 minutes to thicken slightly. Bloom the gelatin by sprinkling it over 40 ml cold water and waiting 5 minutes, then warm it gently until fully dissolved (do not boil). Whisk the dissolved gelatin into the yogurt mixture, fold in half of the blueberries, and pour the filling over the chilled crust. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight until set. Before serving, top with the remaining blueberries and slice cleanly with a warm knife.

title: No-Bake Greek Yogurt Cheesecakes with Berry Swirl
ingredients_json: ["140 g oat biscuits, wholegrain", "60 g butter, unsalted", "400 g Greek yogurt, non-fat", "500 g quark, low-fat", "70 g honey", "12 g gelatin powder", "60 ml water", "250 g mixed berries, frozen", "20 g chia seeds", "1 tbsp lemon zest"]
instructions: Crush the oat biscuits finely and mix them with the melted unsalted butter until the mixture feels like wet sand. Divide the crust mixture evenly among 6 small serving glasses or ramekins and press it down firmly. Chill while you make the filling. Sprinkle the gelatin powder over the 60 ml water and let it bloom for 5 minutes, then warm gently over low heat or in short microwave bursts until fully dissolved, without boiling. In a bowl, stir together the non-fat Greek yogurt, low-fat quark, and honey until smooth. Add the dissolved gelatin and mix well, then fold in the chia seeds and lemon zest. In a small saucepan, heat the frozen berries on medium heat for about 5–7 minutes until they release their juices and thicken slightly. Cool the berry sauce to room temperature. Spoon a little filling into each glass, add a spoonful of berry swirl, and top with the remaining filling. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours, until set, then serve cold.

title: Greek Yogurt Cheesecake with Blueberry Swirl (No-Bake)
ingredients_json: ["200 g digestive biscuits, wholegrain", "80 g butter, unsalted", "500 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "200 g quark, low-fat", "120 g honey", "12 g gelatin powder, unflavoured", "60 ml water, cold", "300 g blueberries, fresh or frozen", "30 g lemon juice, fresh", "1 tsp vanilla extract"]
instructions: Crush the wholegrain digestive biscuits into fine crumbs, then melt the unsalted butter and stir it into the crumbs until evenly moistened. Press the mixture firmly into the bottom of a lined 20 cm springform tin and refrigerate while you prepare the filling. In a small bowl, sprinkle the unflavoured gelatin powder over the cold water and let it stand for 5 minutes to bloom. Warm the mixture gently for 20–30 seconds until it becomes liquid, then stir in the honey, vanilla extract, lemon juice, and remove from heat. In a large bowl, whisk the low-fat Greek yogurt and low-fat quark until smooth, then pour in the honey-gelatin mixture slowly while whisking to prevent lumps. Reserve a few spoonfuls of blueberries, then simmer the rest with a splash of water for 5 minutes until they burst and thicken slightly; let it cool to room temperature. Pour the cheesecake filling over the crust, drop spoonfuls of blueberry mixture on top, and swirl with a knife for a marbled effect. Cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours, preferably overnight, until set. When ready, loosen the ring, slice with a warm knife, and garnish with the reserved blueberries.

title: Whole-Grain Cherry Pie with Vanilla Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["500 g cherries, pitted, fresh or frozen", "80 g whole wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "60 g unsalted butter, cold", "50 g honey", "2 g ground cinnamon", "15 g lemon juice", "10 g cornstarch", "2 g vanilla extract", "1 g fine salt", "40 ml water"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C. In a mixing bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, cinnamon, and salt. Rub in the cold butter with your fingertips until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Stir in the honey and then add the lemon juice and water to bring the dough together; it should feel slightly tacky but moldable. Spread about two thirds of the mixture into the bottom of a 20–22 cm pie dish and press it down firmly to form the crust. In a saucepan, warm the cherries over medium heat until they start releasing juice, then stir in the cornstarch and cook for 2–3 minutes until the filling thickens and looks glossy. Cool the filling for 5 minutes so it doesn’t melt the crust. Spoon the cherry filling into the crust and crumble the remaining oat mixture evenly on top. Bake for 35–40 minutes, until the top is golden and the filling is bubbling at the edges. Let the pie cool for at least 20 minutes before slicing so the filling sets.

title: Oven-Baked Wholegrain Cherry Pie with Oat Crumble
ingredients_json: ["350 g frozen sour cherries, pitted", "60 g whole wheat flour", "60 g rolled oats", "40 g chopped almonds", "45 g coconut sugar", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "20 g chia seeds", "30 g unsalted butter", "1 pc egg, raw", "80 ml milk, low-fat (1.5%)", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tbsp cornstarch", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C. Thaw the frozen sour cherries and place them in a saucepan with the lemon juice, cornstarch, and half of the cinnamon. Cook over medium heat for 6–8 minutes, stirring, until the juices thicken and look glossy; then remove from the heat and let the filling cool slightly. In a bowl, mix the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, chopped almonds, coconut sugar, chia seeds, the remaining cinnamon, and the salt. Cut the butter into small pieces and rub it into the dry mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs. Whisk the egg with the milk, then stir it into the crumb mixture until you can press some clumps together. Press about two-thirds of the crumble into a greased pie dish, spoon in the cherry filling, and spread the remaining crumble over the top. Bake for 35–40 minutes until the crust is golden and the cherry filling is bubbling at the edges. Let the pie cool for at least 20 minutes before slicing so the filling sets.

title: Wholegrain Cherry Pie with Oat Crumble and Vanilla
ingredients_json: ["450 g cherries, pitted (fresh or frozen)", "80 g wholemeal spelt flour", "70 g rolled oats", "40 g cold butter", "60 g low-fat plain yogurt", "15 g maple syrup", "1 pc egg, raw", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "10 g cornstarch", "5 g ground cinnamon", "2 g fine salt", "1 g vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C. In a bowl, mix the cherries with lemon juice, cornstarch, and half of the cinnamon, then set aside. In another bowl, rub the cold butter into the wholemeal spelt flour and rolled oats until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Whisk the egg with the yogurt, maple syrup, the remaining cinnamon, the salt, and the vanilla extract, then stir until you get a thick, pourable dough. Press about two-thirds of the crumble mixture into the bottom of a lightly greased pie dish, then spoon the cherry filling over it. Crumble the remaining mixture on top and bake for 35–40 minutes, until the top is golden and the cherry juices are bubbling at the edges. Let the pie cool for at least 15 minutes before slicing so the filling sets.

title: Whole-Wheat Cherry Pie with Oat Crust and Vanilla
ingredients_json: ["350 g frozen sweet cherries, pitted", "50 g whole wheat flour", "60 g rolled oats", "80 g low-fat Greek yogurt, 2%", "60 g unsalted butter", "1 piece egg, raw", "40 g honey", "10 g cornstarch", "30 g lemon juice", "5 g ground cinnamon", "2 g fine salt", "1 g vanilla extract"]
instructions: Thaw the cherries and drain any excess liquid, then set them in a saucepan with the lemon juice, cinnamon, honey, and cornstarch. Cook on medium heat for 5–7 minutes, stirring often, until the mixture looks glossy and thick like pie filling. Let it cool while you prepare the crust. In a bowl, mix the whole wheat flour and rolled oats with the salt, then cut in the butter until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Whisk the egg with the Greek yogurt and vanilla, then stir it into the crumb mixture until a soft dough forms. Press about two-thirds of the dough into a greased 20 cm pie dish, smoothing it evenly up the sides. Spoon in the cherry filling, then crumble the remaining dough over the top. Bake at 180°C for 35–40 minutes, until the crust is golden and the filling is bubbling at the edges. Let the pie cool for at least 20 minutes before slicing so the filling sets.

title: Wholegrain Cherry Pie with Oat Crumble Crust
ingredients_json: ["600 g cherries, pitted (fresh or frozen)", "70 g whole wheat flour", "40 g rolled oats", "30 g almond flour", "90 g Greek yogurt, nonfat", "60 g honey", "50 g butter, unsalted", "1 pc egg, raw", "30 g cornstarch", "10 g lemon juice", "5 g ground cinnamon", "2 g salt", "3 g vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C. In a bowl, combine the cherries, lemon juice, cornstarch, cinnamon, and 40 g of the honey, then mix until the cherries look glossy and lightly thickened. For the crust and crumble, mix the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, almond flour, remaining honey, salt, and vanilla, then cut in the butter until you get an even crumb. Stir in the egg and Greek yogurt until the mixture holds together and can be pressed. Press about two-thirds of the crumb mixture into a 22–24 cm pie dish, then pour in the cherry filling and spread evenly. Sprinkle the remaining crumble over the top. Bake for 35–40 minutes, until the crust is golden and the filling is bubbling around the edges. Let the pie cool for at least 20 minutes before slicing so the filling sets.

title: Lemon-Chia Chess Pie with Greek Yogurt and Wholegrain Crust
ingredients_json: ["120 g whole wheat pastry flour", "60 g unsalted butter", "80 g caster sugar", "1 piece egg, large, raw", "30 ml olive oil", "15 g chia seeds, dried", "250 g Greek yogurt, nonfat", "2 pieces egg yolk, raw", "180 ml milk, 1% reduced-fat", "10 ml lemon juice", "5 g lemon zest", "1 g fine salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 170°C. Mix the whole wheat pastry flour, fine salt, and 40 g of the sugar in a bowl, then work in the butter until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Press the crumb mixture firmly into a greased 20 cm pie dish and bake for 10 minutes, just until set and lightly golden. Whisk the remaining 40 g sugar with the egg and egg yolks, then stir in the Greek yogurt, milk, lemon juice, and lemon zest. Grind half of the chia seeds briefly in a spice grinder (or crush with a mortar) so they disperse evenly, then mix in both crushed and whole chia seeds and let the filling stand for 5 minutes to thicken. Pour the filling into the warm crust and bake for 28–33 minutes, until the edges are set and the center has a slight wobble like set custard. Cool at room temperature for at least 1 hour, then chill for 2 hours before slicing for clean pieces.

title: Light Lemon-Lime Chess Pie with Greek Yogurt and Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["200 g wholemeal wheat flour", "50 g rolled oats", "60 g unsalted butter", "1 tbsp honey", "1 pinch salt", "2 piece egg, raw", "250 g 0% Greek yogurt", "150 g light brown sugar", "60 ml fresh lime juice", "30 ml fresh lemon juice", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "20 g cornstarch", "1 piece lemon zest", "60 ml milk, semi-skimmed"]
instructions: Heat your oven to 175°C and line a 20 cm pie dish. In a bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, rolled oats, and salt, then rub in the butter until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Stir in the honey and press the dough firmly into the base and a little up the sides of the dish. Bake the crust for 10 minutes, until lightly set and just starting to smell toasty. In another bowl, whisk the eggs with the Greek yogurt, light brown sugar, lime juice, lemon juice, vanilla extract, and milk until smooth. Whisk in the cornstarch last so there are no lumps. Pour the filling into the pre-baked crust, add the lemon zest on top, and bake for 28–35 minutes until the center is mostly set with a slight wobble. Let the chess pie cool at room temperature for at least 30 minutes, then chill for 1 hour to get the classic firm slice. Slice and serve once fully cooled.

title: Light Vanilla Yogurt Chess Pie with Lemon Zest
ingredients_json: ["180 g whole-wheat pastry flour", "40 g unsalted butter", "30 g rapeseed oil", "1 g fine salt", "60 ml cold water", "3 piece egg, whole", "250 g low-fat plain Greek yogurt", "120 g light brown sugar", "30 g cornstarch", "1 piece lemon, zest and juice", "5 ml vanilla extract", "30 g pecans, chopped"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 175°C and lightly grease a 20 cm pie dish. Mix the whole-wheat pastry flour, salt, butter, and rapeseed oil until the mixture looks like fine crumbs. Add the cold water and work just until the dough comes together, then press it into the pie dish and chill it for 10 minutes. In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the Greek yogurt, light brown sugar, cornstarch, lemon zest and juice, and vanilla until smooth. Stir in the chopped pecans. Pour the filling into the chilled crust and bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until the edges are set and the center jiggles slightly like set custard. Let the pie cool for at least 20 minutes before slicing, so the filling firms up.

title: Whole-Wheat Banana Cocoa Cakes with Dark Chocolate Chunks
ingredients_json: ["150 g ripe banana, mashed", "120 g plain low-fat Greek yogurt", "60 g egg, whole, raw", "80 g whole-wheat spelt flour", "25 g unsweetened cocoa powder", "10 g baking powder", "3 g fine salt", "35 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa, chopped", "30 g honey", "30 ml rapeseed oil"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C and line a 6-cup muffin tin (or a small cake pan) with paper cases. In a bowl, whisk together the mashed banana, Greek yogurt, egg, honey, and rapeseed oil until smooth. In a second bowl, mix the whole-wheat spelt flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and stir just until the batter comes together; fold in the chopped dark chocolate. Divide the batter evenly into the cups and bake for 16–20 minutes, until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out with a few moist crumbs but no wet batter. Let the cakes cool for 10 minutes in the tin before moving them to a rack to cool fully.

title: Whole-Wheat Cocoa Yogurt Chocolate Cakes with Dark Chocolate Chunks
ingredients_json: ["180 g plain Greek yogurt, low-fat", "120 g whole wheat flour", "50 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "30 g unsweetened cocoa powder", "60 g honey", "2 piece eggs, whole", "40 ml olive oil", "8 g baking powder", "3 g baking soda", "3 g fine sea salt", "10 ml vanilla extract"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 175°C and lightly grease a 6-cup muffin tray (or line with paper cases). Melt the dark chocolate gently in a microwave or over a very low heat, then let it cool for a couple of minutes. In a large bowl, whisk the eggs and honey until the mixture looks slightly lighter. Whisk in the Greek yogurt, olive oil, and vanilla extract, then stir in the melted chocolate. In another bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Add the dry mixture to the wet ingredients and fold until just combined, avoiding overmixing so the cakes stay tender. Divide the batter between the cups and bake for 14–18 minutes, until a toothpick comes out mostly clean with a few moist crumbs. Cool in the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool slightly before eating.

title: Zucchini-Boosted Dark Chocolate Cakes with Greek Yogurt Frosting
ingredients_json: ["180 g zucchini, grated, squeezed dry", "150 g plain low-fat Greek yogurt", "100 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa, chopped", "60 g whole wheat flour", "30 g unsweetened cocoa powder", "80 g rolled oats, ground to a flour", "2 piece eggs, raw", "80 ml rapeseed oil", "40 g honey", "10 g baking powder", "3 g fine sea salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C and line a muffin tin or small cake molds with paper liners. In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the honey until glossy, then whisk in the Greek yogurt and rapeseed oil. Stir in the grated zucchini and the chopped dark chocolate. In a separate bowl, mix the whole wheat flour, ground oats, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt, then fold the dry mixture into the wet mixture until just combined. Divide the batter evenly and bake for 18–22 minutes, until the tops spring back lightly and a skewer inserted into the center comes out with a few moist crumbs. Let the cakes cool in the pan for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely before serving.

title: Whole-Wheat Greek Yogurt Chocolate Cakes with Dark Cocoa
ingredients_json: ["120 g whole wheat flour, wholegrain", "30 g unsweetened cocoa powder, Dutch-process", "10 g baking powder", "2 g fine salt", "150 g plain low-fat Greek yogurt", "120 g egg, whole", "80 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa, chopped", "100 g maple syrup", "40 g sunflower oil", "1 g vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C and line a 6-cup muffin tin with paper cases. In a bowl, whisk together the whole-wheat flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt until evenly combined. In a second bowl, whisk the Greek yogurt, eggs, maple syrup, sunflower oil, and vanilla extract until smooth. Fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients just until no dry pockets remain, then fold in the chopped dark chocolate. Divide the batter evenly into the cups and bake for 16–19 minutes, until the tops spring back lightly and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out mostly clean with a few moist crumbs. Let the cakes cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then move them to a wire rack to cool completely before serving.

title: Whole Wheat Chocolate Chip Cookies with Dark Chocolate
ingredients_json: ["170 g whole wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "1 tsp baking powder", "1/2 tsp baking soda", "1/2 tsp fine salt", "120 g unsalted butter", "120 g light brown sugar", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 piece egg, raw", "200 g greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "180 g dark chocolate chips"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 175°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. In a separate bowl, cream the butter and light brown sugar until the mixture looks lighter and a bit fluffy, then beat in the vanilla extract and the egg. Stir in the low-fat plain Greek yogurt until the dough becomes thick and cohesive. Fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture just until no dry flour remains, then mix in the dark chocolate chips. Scoop even portions of dough onto the baking sheet, leaving space between cookies. Bake for 10 to 13 minutes until the edges look set and lightly golden while the centers still look soft. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely and set.

title: Whole-Grain Chocolate Chip Cookies with Greek Yogurt and Dark Chocolate
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats, fine", "180 g whole wheat flour", "2 g baking powder", "4 g ground cinnamon", "3 g fine salt", "160 g plain Greek yogurt, non-fat", "80 g honey", "80 g unsalted butter, softened", "1 piece egg, raw, large", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "120 g dark chocolate chips, 70% cocoa"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 175°C and line two baking trays with parchment paper. In a large bowl, mix the fine rolled oats, whole wheat flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. In another bowl, whisk the Greek yogurt, honey, softened butter, egg, and vanilla extract until smooth and slightly glossy. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir until you get a thick dough with no dry flour pockets. Fold in the dark chocolate chips. Scoop about 25 g portions onto the trays, leaving space between each cookie. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges look set and lightly golden while the centers still look soft. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely so they firm up.

title: Oat-and-Wholegrain Chocolate Chip Cookies with Dark Chocolate
