ingredients_json: ["170 g rolled oats", "80 g whole wheat flour", "60 g unsalted butter", "100 g brown sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "7 g baking powder", "2 g fine salt", "120 g dark chocolate chips (70% cocoa)", "40 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2%", "60 ml milk, low-fat"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a blender or food processor, pulse the rolled oats until they resemble a coarse flour, then mix them with the whole wheat flour, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl. In a second bowl, cream the butter with the brown sugar until it looks lighter and slightly fluffy. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract, then stir in the Greek yogurt. Add half the dry ingredients, then pour in the milk and mix, followed by the remaining dry mixture until a thick cookie dough forms. Fold in the dark chocolate chips. Scoop dough portions (about 35 g each) onto the baking sheet and flatten slightly. Bake for 10–12 minutes, until the edges look set and lightly golden while the centers still look soft. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes before transferring to a rack to cool completely.

title: Whole-Grain Dark Chocolate Chip Cookies with Sea Salt
ingredients_json: ["180 g whole-wheat flour, whole-grain", "60 g oat flour", "120 g dark chocolate chips (70% cocoa)", "120 g unsalted butter", "90 g light brown sugar", "1 piece egg, raw (large)", "60 ml milk, semi-skimmed (2%)", "60 g Greek yogurt, plain, non-fat", "7 g baking powder", "3 g fine sea salt", "5 g vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a bowl, cream the unsalted butter with the light brown sugar until the mixture looks paler and slightly fluffy. Beat in the egg, then mix in the vanilla extract. Stir in the Greek yogurt and semi-skimmed milk until smooth. In a separate bowl, whisk together the whole-wheat flour, oat flour, baking powder, and fine sea salt. Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture and mix just until no dry flour remains, then fold in the dark chocolate chips. Scoop portions of dough onto the tray, spacing them well, and bake for 10–12 minutes until the edges are set and lightly golden while the centers still look soft. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely.

title: Healthy Black Bean Chocolate Fudge with Dark Cocoa and Vanilla
ingredients_json: ["200 g canned black beans, drained and rinsed", "60 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "30 g cocoa powder, unsweetened", "60 ml maple syrup", "20 g almond butter", "1 tbsp water", "1 g vanilla extract", "1 g fine sea salt"]
instructions: Drain and rinse the black beans well, then add them to a blender. Melt the dark chocolate gently in short microwave bursts or over a very low heat, stirring until smooth. Add the melted chocolate, cocoa powder, maple syrup, almond butter, water, vanilla extract, and sea salt to the blender. Blend until the mixture is completely smooth and glossy, scraping down the sides once. Transfer the mixture to a parchment-lined small loaf pan (or an 18–20 cm square dish), smooth the top, and chill for at least 2 hours, until firm enough to cut. Slice into portions and serve chilled.

title: Black Bean Chocolate Fudge with Dark Cocoa and Maple
ingredients_json: ["200 g canned black beans, drained and rinsed", "80 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa, chopped", "40 g cocoa powder, unsweetened", "60 g maple syrup", "40 g coconut oil, refined", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 g fine salt"]
instructions: Add the drained black beans, cocoa powder, maple syrup, vanilla extract, salt, and coconut oil to a blender. Blend until the mixture looks completely smooth, scraping down the sides as needed. Gently melt the chopped dark chocolate using a microwave in 20-second bursts or over a very low heat, stirring until glossy and fully melted. Pour the melted chocolate into the blender and blend again for 20 to 30 seconds until thick and uniform. Spoon the fudge mixture into a small parchment-lined dish, smooth the top, and chill for at least 2 hours until set. Cut into squares and serve chilled for a dense, fudge-like texture.

title: Avocado Cocoa Chocolate Fudge Bites (No-Bake)
ingredients_json: ["2 medium avocado, ripe", "120 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "40 g unsweetened cocoa powder", "80 ml maple syrup", "30 g almond butter", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "2 g fine sea salt"]
instructions: Cut the avocados in half, remove the stones, and scoop the flesh into a blender. Melt the dark chocolate gently in a microwave in 20-second bursts, stirring each time, until smooth and fully melted. Add the melted chocolate, cocoa powder, maple syrup, almond butter, vanilla extract, and fine sea salt to the blender. Blend on high for 1 to 2 minutes, scraping down the sides as needed, until the mixture is completely smooth and glossy. Line a small container or loaf pan with baking paper and spread the fudge mixture evenly. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours, until firm enough to scoop. Slice or portion into small bites with a sharp knife, then serve chilled.

title: Greek Yogurt Chocolate Fudge with Dark Cocoa and Cherries
ingredients_json: ["250 g 0% Greek yogurt", "120 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa, chopped", "30 g cocoa powder, Dutch-processed", "80 g dates, pitted", "30 g cherry jam, no added sugar", "10 g chia seeds, ground"]
instructions: Line a small loaf tin with baking paper. Heat the dates with 60 g of water in a saucepan over medium heat until they soften, then blend until smooth. Melt the chopped dark chocolate gently in a heatproof bowl set over barely simmering water, stirring until glossy and smooth, then remove from the heat and let it cool for 3 minutes. In a bowl, mix the Greek yogurt, cocoa powder, chia (ground) and cherry jam until fully combined. Stir in the date paste, then slowly fold in the melted chocolate until the mixture is thick and uniform. Spoon into the prepared tin, press level, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours until set. Slice into portions and serve chilled.

title: Whole-Grain Oat Christmas Cookies with Dark Chocolate and Orange Zest
ingredients_json: ["160 g rolled oats", "120 g whole-wheat spelt flour", "140 g unsalted butter, softened", "120 g light brown sugar", "1 piece egg", "2 tsp vanilla extract", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp baking powder", "0.5 tsp baking soda", "0.25 tsp fine salt", "80 g dark chocolate, 70% chopped", "1 piece orange, zest"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 175°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a bowl, mix the rolled oats, whole-wheat spelt flour, cinnamon, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. In a second bowl, beat the softened butter with the light brown sugar until smooth and slightly fluffy, then beat in the egg and vanilla extract. Stir the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients until a thick dough forms. Fold in the chopped dark chocolate and the orange zest. Scoop dough portions onto the tray and press them into thick cookie shapes. Bake for 10–12 minutes, until the edges look set and lightly golden but the centers still look slightly soft. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely so the chocolate firms up.

title: Whole-Grain Oat & Almond Christmas Cookies with Dark Chocolate Chunks
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "120 g whole-wheat flour", "70 g almond flour", "8 g baking powder", "2 g fine sea salt", "120 g unsalted butter", "80 g brown sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 tbsp vanilla extract", "40 g dried cranberries", "120 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "60 ml milk, semi-skimmed"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C and line two baking trays with baking paper. In a large bowl, mix the rolled oats, whole-wheat flour, almond flour, baking powder, and sea salt. In another bowl, cream the butter and brown sugar together until the mixture looks lighter and smoother. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract, then stir in the milk. Fold the wet ingredients into the dry mixture until you get a thick dough. Stir in the dried cranberries and chop the dark chocolate into small chunks, then mix them through the dough. Scoop the dough into portions and place them on the trays, leaving space between cookies. Bake for 10–12 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden and the centers look set but still slightly soft. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes before transferring to a rack to cool completely.

title: Oatmeal Cranberry-Walnut Christmas Cookies with Dark Chocolate
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "60 g whole wheat flour", "1 tsp baking powder", "0.5 tsp ground cinnamon", "0.25 tsp salt", "120 g unsalted butter, cold", "80 g brown sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "120 ml unsweetened applesauce", "100 g dried cranberries, unsweetened", "60 g walnuts, chopped", "60 g dark chocolate chips (70%), vegan or regular"]
instructions: Heat your oven to 175°C. Line two baking trays with baking paper. Pulse the oats briefly in a blender or food processor until they resemble coarse flour, then tip into a bowl and stir in the whole wheat flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. In another bowl, rub the cold butter into the oat mixture until it looks like coarse crumbs, then mix in the brown sugar. Beat the egg, then stir in the applesauce and pour into the dry ingredients. Mix until you have a thick dough, then fold through the dried cranberries, walnuts, and dark chocolate chips. Scoop small portions (about 25–30 g each), roll into balls, and place them on the trays, flattening slightly to help them bake evenly. Bake for 10–12 minutes until the edges are lightly golden and the centers still look soft. Let the cookies cool on the trays for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely so they set.

title: Cinnamon-Oat Christmas Cookies with Dark Chocolate and Pecans
ingredients_json: ["170 g rolled oats", "140 g whole-wheat spelt flour", "90 g unsalted butter, softened", "80 g light brown sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "60 ml maple syrup", "5 g baking powder", "3 g ground cinnamon", "1 g fine salt", "120 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa, chopped", "60 g pecans, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175°C and line two baking trays with baking paper. Grind 120 g of the rolled oats into a coarse flour using a blender, then stir it together in a bowl with the spelt flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. In a second bowl, cream the softened butter with the light brown sugar until the mixture looks slightly paler and fluffy, then beat in the egg and maple syrup. Add the dry ingredients to the wet and mix until a thick cookie dough forms. Fold in the chopped dark chocolate and pecans, then let the dough rest for 10 minutes so it firms up. Scoop about 1 tablespoon portions onto the trays and flatten slightly, leaving space between them. Bake for 10–12 minutes, until the edges are set and lightly golden but the centers still look soft. Cool on the trays for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely before storing or serving.

title: Whole-Wheat Gingerbread Oat Christmas Cookies with Orange Zest
ingredients_json: ["150 g whole-wheat spelt flour", "80 g rolled oats", "2 tsp ground ginger", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp baking soda", "1 g fine sea salt", "90 g light brown sugar", "60 g unsalted butter, softened", "1 piece egg, raw", "80 ml unsweetened applesauce", "2 tbsp orange zest", "2 tsp vanilla extract"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 175°C (160°C fan). Line two baking trays with parchment paper. In a bowl, whisk together the spelt flour, oats, ginger, cinnamon, baking powder, baking soda and sea salt until evenly combined. In a second bowl, cream the softened butter with the light brown sugar until the mixture looks lighter. Beat in the egg, then mix in the applesauce, orange zest and vanilla extract. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and stir until a thick cookie dough forms; if it feels too soft to shape, rest it for 5–10 minutes in the fridge. Scoop portions of dough, about 1 tablespoon each, and roll into small balls, then flatten slightly and space them on the trays. Bake for 10–12 minutes, until the edges look set and lightly browned while the centers remain soft. Let the cookies cool on the trays for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely for the best texture.

title: Berry Oat Cobbler with Greek Yogurt Crumble
ingredients_json: ["400 g mixed berries, fresh or frozen", "50 g rolled oats", "60 g wholewheat flour", "30 g almond flour", "30 g honey", "120 ml low-fat Greek yogurt", "60 ml unsweetened applesauce", "1 tbsp ground flaxseed", "2 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 pinch salt", "1 tsp vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C. In a bowl, mix the mixed berries with the cinnamon and a small amount of salt, then spread them into a baking dish. In another bowl, stir together the oats, wholewheat flour, almond flour, ground flaxseed, baking powder, and vanilla extract. Add the Greek yogurt, applesauce, and honey, and mix until the batter becomes thick and crumbly. Spoon the crumble mixture over the berries and spread it gently so most of the fruit is covered. Bake for 30–35 minutes, until the top is golden and the berries are bubbling around the edges. Let the cobbler cool for 10 minutes before serving so the juices thicken slightly.

title: Oat and Apple Cinnamon Cobbler with Greek Yogurt Crumble
ingredients_json: ["700 g apple, cored, sliced", "40 g rolled oats", "120 g whole wheat flour", "30 g ground almonds", "80 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat (2%)", "60 g unsalted butter", "80 g honey", "200 ml milk, semi-skimmed (1.5% fat)", "1 piece egg, raw", "10 g baking powder", "5 g ground cinnamon", "2 g fine salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C. In a bowl, toss the sliced apples with half of the cinnamon and a small portion of the honey, then spread them evenly in a 23 cm baking dish. In another bowl, stir together the oats, whole wheat flour, ground almonds, baking powder, remaining cinnamon, and the salt. Add the melted butter, honey, milk, Greek yogurt, and the egg, then mix until you have a thick, scoopable batter. Spoon the batter over the apples, making sure the top is fairly even. Bake for 35–40 minutes, until the cobbler topping is golden and the apple juices are bubbling around the edges. Let it cool for 10 minutes before serving so the filling thickens.

title: Oat and Apple Cinnamon Cobbler with Greek Yogurt Crumble
ingredients_json: ["500 g apples, cored and diced", "60 g rolled oats", "80 g Greek yogurt, plain, non-fat", "1 tbsp honey", "30 g almond flour", "1 egg", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "5 g baking powder", "2 g vanilla extract", "1 g fine salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 190°C. Toss the diced apples with lemon juice, half the cinnamon, and the honey in a baking dish. In a bowl, mix the rolled oats, almond flour, remaining cinnamon, baking powder, and salt. Stir in the egg and Greek yogurt until you get a thick, spoonable crumble mixture, then spread it evenly over the apples. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until the top is golden and the apples are bubbling around the edges. Let it cool for 10 minutes before serving so the juices thicken slightly and the cobbler sets.

title: Whole-Grain Apple Cinnamon Cobbler with Oat Streusel
ingredients_json: ["500 g apples, peeled and diced", "60 g rolled oats", "80 g whole-wheat flour", "30 g brown sugar", "60 g Greek yogurt, plain, non-fat", "2 large eggs, raw", "120 ml milk, low-fat", "60 g unsalted butter", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tsp baking powder", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 190°C. Lightly grease a baking dish. Toss the diced apples with half of the cinnamon and the baking powder, then spread them evenly in the dish. In a bowl, mix the rolled oats, whole-wheat flour, brown sugar, remaining cinnamon, and salt. Add the milk, Greek yogurt, melted butter, and eggs, then stir just until a thick batter forms; avoid overmixing so the cobbler stays tender. Pour the batter over the apples and smooth the top. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until the edges are bubbling and the surface is golden. Let it cool for 10 minutes before serving so the filling thickens.

title: Warm Apple-Raspberry Oat Cobbler with Cinnamon and Chia
ingredients_json: ["500 g apples, peeled and diced", "200 g raspberries, fresh or frozen", "60 g rolled oats", "80 g whole-wheat flour", "30 g chia seeds", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain 2%", "60 ml rapeseed oil", "120 ml semi-skimmed milk", "100 g honey", "10 g baking powder", "5 g ground cinnamon", "2 g fine salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C. Grease a medium baking dish and set it aside. In a large bowl, toss the diced apples with half of the cinnamon and the honey, then add the raspberries and mix gently so the fruit starts to release juices. Spread the fruit mixture evenly in the dish. In another bowl, combine the oats, whole-wheat flour, chia seeds, baking powder, remaining cinnamon, and salt. Stir in the Greek yogurt, rapeseed oil, and semi-skimmed milk until you have a thick, spoonable cobbler batter. Dollop the batter over the fruit and bake for 35–40 minutes, until the top is golden and set and you can see bubbling fruit around the edges. Let it rest for 10 minutes before serving so the juices thicken slightly.

title: Vanilla Bean Greek Yogurt Crème Brûlée (Light & Creamy)
ingredients_json: ["450 g Greek yogurt, plain, non-fat", "200 ml milk, semi-skimmed (2% fat)", "3 piece egg yolk", "2 piece egg", "1 piece vanilla bean", "70 g honey", "15 g cornstarch", "1 g fine salt", "12 g brown sugar"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 150°C. Lightly oil four small ramekins (about 150–200 ml each). In a bowl, whisk the egg yolks and the whole eggs until smooth. In a saucepan, warm the milk and honey over low heat until the honey dissolves, then split the vanilla bean and scrape the seeds into the warm mixture. Remove from heat and whisk in the cornstarch until fully dissolved. Slowly pour the warm vanilla milk into the eggs while whisking constantly, then whisk in the non-fat Greek yogurt and salt until the mixture looks silky and lump-free. Divide the custard between the ramekins and place them in a roasting tray. Add hot water to the tray until it reaches about halfway up the sides of the ramekins. Bake for 25–30 minutes, until the edges are set but the centers still wobble slightly when nudged. Remove the ramekins from the water bath and cool to room temperature, then refrigerate at least 3 hours. Just before serving, sprinkle about 3 g brown sugar over each surface and caramelize with a kitchen torch until deeply golden and crisp, then let stand 1 minute for the crust to set.

title: Vanilla Greek Yogurt Crème Brûlée with Citrus Zest
ingredients_json: ["500 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "3 piece Egg yolk, raw", "2 whole egg, raw", "80 g honey", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 g lemon zest", "500 ml milk, low-fat (1.5% fat)", "8 g cornstarch"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 160°C. In a bowl, whisk the egg yolks and whole eggs with the honey until smooth. Whisk in the low-fat milk, low-fat Greek yogurt, cornstarch, vanilla extract, and lemon zest until fully combined and lump-free. Pour the mixture into 4–6 ramekins and place them in a deep baking dish. Add hot water to the baking dish until it comes halfway up the sides of the ramekins, then bake for 25–30 minutes, until the custards are set around the edges but still slightly jiggly in the center. Remove the ramekins from the water bath and cool to room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 3 hours. Just before serving, sprinkle a thin, even layer of granulated sugar on top of each custard and torch until the surface is caramelized and crisp, then let it rest for 2 minutes to harden.

title: Vanilla Greek Yogurt Crème Brûlée with Almond Crunch
ingredients_json: ["400 g Greek yogurt, nonfat", "300 ml milk, skimmed", "3 piece egg yolk, raw", "2 piece egg, raw", "60 g sugar, caster", "1 g vanilla extract", "40 g almond flour", "10 g butter, unsalted", "6 g cornstarch", "2 g salt, table salt", "18 g sugar, for brûlée topping"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160°C. Whisk the egg yolks and whole egg with the caster sugar until the mixture turns slightly lighter. In a saucepan over low heat, warm the skimmed milk until steaming but not boiling, then whisk in the cornstarch until smooth. Remove from heat and whisk in the nonfat Greek yogurt, vanilla extract, salt, and the warmed milk mixture to form a silky custard. Divide the custard among four ramekins. Place the ramekins in a deep baking dish and pour hot water into the dish until it reaches about halfway up the sides. Bake for 28 to 33 minutes, until the edges look set but the centers still wobble slightly when gently shaken. While the custards bake, melt the butter in a small pan and toast the almond flour for 3 to 4 minutes until lightly golden, then cool. Cool the ramekins to room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 4 hours. Just before serving, sprinkle 4 to 5 g sugar over the top of each ramekin and brûlée with a kitchen torch until the sugar forms a crisp caramel layer. Let stand for 1 minute, then finish with a little toasted almond crunch and serve immediately.

title: Light Vanilla Bean Crème Brûlée with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["500 ml milk, skimmed", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "3 g vanilla bean paste", "120 g egg yolk", "45 g honey", "30 g sugar, caster", "1 g salt, fine"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 150°C. In a saucepan over low heat, warm the skimmed milk just until steaming and small bubbles appear around the edges; do not let it boil. In a bowl, whisk the egg yolks with the honey, vanilla bean paste, and salt until smooth. Slowly pour the warm milk into the egg mixture while whisking to temper the eggs. Whisk in the low-fat Greek yogurt until the custard looks silky and uniform. Divide the custard between 6 ramekins and place them in a deep baking dish. Pour hot water into the baking dish until it comes halfway up the sides of the ramekins. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until the centers are just slightly jiggly but not liquid. Remove from the water bath and cool to room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 3 hours. Right before serving, sprinkle 5 g caster sugar over the top of each ramekin and torch until evenly caramelized and golden, then let stand for 1 minute so the brûlée sets.

title: Vanilla Bean Greek Yogurt Crème Brûlée with Light Caramelized Top
ingredients_json: ["350 g Greek yogurt, plain, nonfat", "300 ml milk, 1% fat", "3 piece egg yolk, raw", "30 g sugar, white", "15 g honey", "1 piece vanilla pod", "20 g corn starch", "1 g salt, fine"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 160°C and set out 4 ramekins. In a saucepan over medium heat, warm the milk until steaming but not boiling. In a bowl, whisk the egg yolks with 20 g of the sugar, then whisk in the corn starch and the salt until smooth. Slowly pour in the hot milk while whisking, then return the mixture to the saucepan and cook for 2–3 minutes, stirring constantly, until slightly thickened. Remove from heat, stir in the Greek yogurt, and scrape in the vanilla seeds from the vanilla pod, then mix until fully combined. Divide the custard among the ramekins and place them in a roasting tray. Pour hot water into the tray until it comes halfway up the sides of the ramekins, then bake for 20–25 minutes until the edges look set and the centers still jiggle slightly. Let cool, then refrigerate for at least 3 hours. Just before serving, sprinkle a thin, even layer of the remaining sugar (or a little of the honey-sugar mix) over each custard and brûlée with a kitchen torch until deep golden and crisp, letting it sit 1 minute to firm up.

title: Berry Oat Crumble with Greek Yogurt & Chia Crunch
ingredients_json: ["400 g mixed berries, frozen", "50 g rolled oats", "80 g whole wheat flour", "60 g unsalted butter", "60 g light brown sugar", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "2 tbsp chia seeds", "200 g Greek yogurt, low fat", "1 tbsp honey", "1 tsp lemon juice"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Tip the mixed berries into a baking dish and stir in the lemon juice and half of the honey. In a bowl, combine the oats, whole wheat flour, ground cinnamon, chia seeds, and the light brown sugar. Melt the butter, then pour it in and rub everything together with your fingertips until it looks like coarse crumbs. Scatter the crumble topping evenly over the berries. Bake for 28 to 32 minutes, until the berries are bubbling around the edges and the top is golden. Let it cool for 5 minutes, then spoon the crumble into bowls and serve with the Greek yogurt mixed with the remaining honey.

title: Berry Oat Crumble with Greek Yogurt and Toasted Almonds
ingredients_json: ["400 g mixed berries, fresh or frozen", "30 g rolled oats", "60 g whole wheat flour", "40 g almonds, chopped", "30 g honey", "80 g Greek yogurt, low-fat 2%", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tsp lemon zest", "20 g coconut oil, refined", "1 g ground cinnamon", "2 g fine salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 180°C. Spread the mixed berries in a small baking dish and stir in lemon juice and lemon zest. Mix the oats, whole wheat flour, chopped almonds, cinnamon and salt in a bowl. Drizzle in the honey and coconut oil, then rub the mixture together until it forms clumps. Sprinkle the crumble over the berries and bake for 25–30 minutes, until the topping is golden and the fruit is bubbling around the edges. Let it cool for 5 minutes, then serve warm with a spoonful of low-fat Greek yogurt on top.

title: Apple and Cinnamon Oat Crumble with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["500 g apples, cored, diced", "20 g lemon juice", "10 g honey", "2 g ground cinnamon", "240 g plain low-fat Greek yogurt (2%)", "60 g rolled oats", "35 g whole wheat flour", "40 g unsalted butter", "30 g chopped almonds", "50 g brown sugar", "2 g fine salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 190°C. In a bowl, toss the diced apples with the lemon juice, honey and half of the cinnamon, then spread them evenly into a baking dish. For the crumble, rub the butter into the oats and whole wheat flour until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs, then stir in the almonds, brown sugar, the remaining cinnamon and the salt. Sprinkle the crumble mixture over the apples. Bake for 30–35 minutes, until the apples are tender and the top is deep golden. Let it cool for 10 minutes, then serve warm with the Greek yogurt spooned over each portion.

title: Blueberry Oat Greek Yogurt Cupcakes with Lemon Zest
ingredients_json: ["200 g rolled oats", "2 tsp baking powder", "1 g fine salt", "120 g plain low-fat Greek yogurt", "2 piece egg, raw", "80 g honey", "60 ml rapeseed oil", "1 piece lemon, zest", "150 g blueberries, fresh", "1 tsp vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C and line a muffin tin with 12 paper liners. Blend the rolled oats into a fine oat flour, then mix it with the baking powder and salt in a bowl. In a second bowl, whisk the Greek yogurt, eggs, honey, rapeseed oil, lemon zest, and vanilla extract until smooth. Fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture just until no dry pockets remain, then gently fold in the blueberries. Divide the batter evenly among the cups and bake for 16–20 minutes, until the tops are lightly golden and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean or with only a few moist crumbs. Let the cupcakes cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool further before serving.

title: Whole-Orange Greek Yogurt Cupcakes with Almond Flour
ingredients_json: ["180 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "2 piece Egg, whole", "80 ml Honey", "80 ml Olive oil", "1 piece Orange, whole (zest and juice)", "160 g Almond flour", "80 g Oat flour", "8 g Baking powder", "2 g Vanilla extract", "2 g Fine sea salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C and line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners. In a large bowl, whisk the eggs with the honey until glossy. Whisk in the Greek yogurt, olive oil, vanilla extract, and the orange zest and juice. In a separate bowl, mix the almond flour, oat flour, baking powder, and fine sea salt. Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture and stir just until no dry pockets remain, being careful not to overmix. Divide the batter evenly among the cups, filling each about two-thirds full. Bake for 16–20 minutes, until the tops are set and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs. Let the cupcakes cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely before serving.

title: Whole-Grain Carrot Cupcakes with Greek Yogurt Cream Cheese Frosting
ingredients_json: ["200 g carrots, grated", "2 pieces eggs, raw", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "80 g rapeseed oil", "120 g whole wheat flour", "50 g rolled oats, finely ground", "80 g light brown sugar", "6 g baking powder", "2 g ground cinnamon", "1 g fine salt", "120 g cream cheese, light", "40 g icing sugar", "5 g lemon zest"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper cases. In a mixing bowl, whisk the eggs with the Greek yogurt and rapeseed oil until smooth. Stir in the grated carrots and lemon zest. In a separate bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, ground oats, light brown sugar, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt, then add the dry mixture to the wet mixture and stir just until no dry flour remains. Divide the batter evenly among the cases and bake for 18–22 minutes, until the cupcakes are risen and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs. Let the cupcakes cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely. For the frosting, beat the light cream cheese with the icing sugar until creamy, then spread or pipe over the cooled cupcakes.

title: Lemon Yogurt Cupcakes with Blueberry Swirl
ingredients_json: ["200 g plain low-fat Greek yogurt", "180 g whole wheat pastry flour", "60 g maple syrup", "2 piece eggs, whole, raw", "80 g unsalted butter, melted", "180 g blueberries, fresh", "30 g lemon juice, fresh", "10 g lemon zest", "10 g baking powder", "2 g salt, fine"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 180°C and line a 12-cup muffin tray with paper liners. In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the Greek yogurt, melted butter, maple syrup, lemon juice, and lemon zest until smooth. In another bowl, mix the whole wheat pastry flour, baking powder, and salt. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and stir just until no dry flour remains, being careful not to overmix. Fold in about half of the blueberries, then spoon the batter into the lined cups, filling each about two-thirds full. Scatter the remaining blueberries on top and bake for 16 to 20 minutes, until the cupcakes are lightly golden and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Let them cool in the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool fully before serving.

title: Greek Yogurt–Lemon Blueberry Cupcakes (Wholegrain & Light)
ingredients_json: ["180 g whole wheat flour", "120 g rolled oats", "150 g plain Greek yogurt, low fat", "2 pieces eggs, raw", "120 g maple syrup", "80 g unsalted butter", "2 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp baking soda", "1 g fine salt", "2 tbsp lemon juice, fresh", "2 tbsp lemon zest", "150 g blueberries, fresh", "1 tsp vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners. In a mixing bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking powder, baking soda, and salt until evenly combined. In another bowl, whisk the eggs with the maple syrup until smooth, then whisk in the Greek yogurt, melted (cooled) butter, lemon juice, lemon zest, and vanilla extract. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and stir just until the batter comes together; it should look thick and slightly textured from the oats. Fold in the blueberries gently so they don’t burst. Divide the batter evenly between the cups and bake for 16–20 minutes, until the tops are lightly golden and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs. Let the cupcakes cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely before eating.

title: Oat & Banana Drop Cookies with Dark Chocolate Chunks
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "180 g banana, ripe, mashed", "80 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "70 g honey", "2 piece egg, raw", "120 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa, chopped", "6 g baking powder", "3 g ground cinnamon", "2 g fine salt", "10 ml vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a blender or food processor, pulse the rolled oats into a coarse oat flour. In a mixing bowl, combine the mashed banana, low-fat Greek yogurt, honey, eggs, and vanilla extract, and whisk until smooth. Stir in the oat flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt, then fold in the chopped dark chocolate. Let the dough rest for 5 minutes so it thickens slightly. Scoop heaped tablespoons of dough onto the tray, spaced apart, and bake for 12–15 minutes until the edges look set and lightly golden while the centers stay soft. Cool the cookies on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely; they will firm up as they cool.

title: Oatmeal-Cinnamon Drop Cookies with Greek Yogurt and Blueberries
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "120 g plain Greek yogurt, low-fat (2%)", "80 g unsalted butter", "60 g maple syrup", "1 piece egg, raw", "120 g blueberries, fresh", "8 g baking powder", "5 g ground cinnamon", "2 g fine salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Blend the oats briefly in a food processor until they resemble a coarse flour. In a bowl, whisk the melted butter with the maple syrup, then mix in the egg and Greek yogurt until smooth. Stir the oat mixture, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt into the wet ingredients until a thick dough forms. Fold in the blueberries gently so they don’t burst. Drop heaped tablespoons of dough onto the tray, leaving space between them. Bake for 11 to 13 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden and the centers look set but still soft. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely for the best texture.

title: Oat and Banana Drop Cookies with Dark Chocolate Chunks
ingredients_json: ["150 g rolled oats", "120 g ripe banana, mashed", "80 g plain low-fat Greek yogurt", "60 g unsalted butter, softened", "1 large egg", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "30 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa, chopped", "2 g fine salt", "40 g honey"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 180°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a bowl, mix the mashed banana, Greek yogurt, melted butter, egg, honey, cinnamon, and salt until smooth. Stir in the rolled oats and baking powder, then fold in the chopped dark chocolate. Let the dough sit for 5 minutes so the oats hydrate slightly, which helps the cookies hold their shape. Scoop heaped tablespoon-sized mounds onto the tray, leaving space between them, and bake for 12–14 minutes until the edges look set and lightly golden. Cool the cookies on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely before eating.

title: Oatmeal Banana Chocolate Drop Cookies with Dark Chocolate Chips
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "60 g whole wheat flour", "60 g light brown sugar", "2 tsp baking powder", "1 g ground cinnamon", "80 g unsalted butter, softened", "1 piece egg", "180 g ripe banana, mashed", "80 g plain low-fat Greek yogurt", "70 g dark chocolate chips"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 175°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a bowl, mix the rolled oats, whole wheat flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and light brown sugar. In another bowl, mash the banana and stir in the softened butter, egg, and low-fat Greek yogurt until smooth. Add the wet mixture to the dry ingredients and mix just until you get a thick cookie dough; fold in the dark chocolate chips. Spoon small mounds of dough onto the tray, spacing them a little apart, then bake for 10–12 minutes until the edges are lightly golden and the centers look set but still soft. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes before transferring to a rack to cool completely.

title: Oat and Banana Drop Cookies with Dark Chocolate Chunks
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "120 g ripe banana, mashed", "80 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "1 piece egg, whole", "60 g honey", "30 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa, chopped", "1 tsp baking powder, gluten-free", "1 g ground cinnamon", "2 g fine sea salt", "10 ml vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a bowl, combine the rolled oats, cinnamon, baking powder, and salt. In a second bowl, whisk together the mashed banana, Greek yogurt, egg, honey, and vanilla extract until smooth. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir until you get a thick batter that holds together; let it rest for 5 minutes so the oats soften. Fold in the chopped dark chocolate. Spoon tablespoon-sized mounds of batter onto the tray, leaving space between them, then bake for 11–14 minutes until the edges look set and lightly golden. Cool the cookies on the tray for 5 minutes before transferring to a rack to cool completely.

title: Cinnamon-Vanilla Greek Yogurt Flan with a Light Caramel
ingredients_json: ["2 tbsp  sugar, granulated", "350 g  low-fat milk, 1.5%", "250 g  Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "3  egg, whole, raw", "30 g  cornstarch", "1 tsp  vanilla extract", "1 tsp  ground cinnamon", "1 pinch  salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 160°C. Heat 2 tablespoons of granulated sugar in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring until it melts and turns a light amber caramel, then immediately pour it into the bottom of a 20–22 cm flan dish and swirl to coat. In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the remaining sugar until smooth, then whisk in the cornstarch, cinnamon, vanilla extract, milk, and Greek yogurt until no lumps remain. Pour the mixture into the prepared dish and place it in a roasting tray. Add hot water to the tray until it comes about halfway up the sides of the flan dish, then bake for 40–50 minutes, until the edges are set and the center still has a slight wobble. Remove from the water bath and cool at room temperature for about 30 minutes, then chill in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours before unmolding and serving.

title: Vanilla Yogurt Flan with Cinnamon and Berries
ingredients_json: ["500 ml low-fat milk", "300 g plain Greek yogurt, low-fat", "3 piece egg, whole, raw", "120 g maple syrup", "1 tbsp cornstarch", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "200 g fresh mixed berries", "0.5 tsp salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 160°C. Lightly grease a 20–24 cm baking dish and set it in a larger roasting tray. In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the maple syrup until smooth, then whisk in the milk, yogurt, cornstarch, vanilla extract, cinnamon, and salt until the mixture looks glossy and fully combined. Pour the custard into the dish and scatter the berries evenly over the top. Carefully add hot water to the roasting tray until it comes about halfway up the sides of the flan dish, then bake for 35 to 45 minutes, until the edges are set but the center still jiggles slightly when you gently shake the dish. Remove from the water bath and cool to room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 4 hours (overnight is best) before serving.

title: Vanilla Bean Greek Yogurt Flan with Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["350 ml Milk, semi-skimmed (1.5% fat)", "250 g Greek yogurt, plain 2% fat", "3 piece Egg, whole", "2 piece Egg yolk", "80 g Sugar, caster", "20 g Cornstarch", "1 piece Vanilla bean, seeds scraped", "2 g Ground cinnamon", "2 g Salt, table salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 160°C and place a roasting tray with hot water on the lower rack for a bain-marie. In a saucepan, gently warm the milk and sugar over low heat until the sugar dissolves, then remove from the heat. Whisk the eggs, egg yolks, cornstarch, vanilla seeds, cinnamon, and salt in a bowl until smooth, then slowly whisk in the warm milk mixture. Stir in the Greek yogurt until fully combined, then pour the custard into a lightly greased flan dish or 4 small ramekins. Bake in the water bath for 35–45 minutes, until the edges look set but the center still jiggles slightly. Let it cool to room temperature, then chill in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours before serving.

title: Vanilla Bean Greek Yogurt Flan with Orange Zest (Baked Custard)
ingredients_json: ["500 g Greek yogurt, plain 2%", "200 ml milk, semi-skimmed (1.5%)", "150 g eggs, whole", "80 g honey", "2 tsp vanilla extract", "1 pc orange, zest", "20 g corn starch", "1 pinch salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 160°C (fan 140°C). In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the honey until smooth. Whisk in the vanilla extract, orange zest, milk, and Greek yogurt. Sift in the corn starch and whisk again until there are no lumps and the custard looks silky. Lightly grease a flan dish (about 18–20 cm) and pour in the mixture. Place the dish in a roasting tray and add hot water to come halfway up the sides to create a gentle bain-marie. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes, until the edges are set and the center still jiggles slightly like soft jelly. Remove from the water bath and let it cool, then refrigerate for at least 4 hours before slicing. Serve chilled.

title: Light Vanilla Bean Flan with Almond Milk and Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["500 ml almond milk, unsweetened", "200 g eggs, whole", "150 g plain Greek yogurt, nonfat", "80 g erythritol", "1 tbsp vanilla bean paste", "20 g corn starch", "1 g fine salt", "1 tsp ground cinnamon"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 160°C (fan 140°C). Grease a 20 cm flan dish or baking pan lightly. In a bowl, whisk the eggs until smooth, then whisk in the almond milk, Greek yogurt, erythritol, vanilla bean paste, corn starch, and salt until no starch lumps remain. Stir in half of the cinnamon for a subtle flavor. Pour the mixture into the dish and set it on a deeper roasting tray. Add hot water to the tray until it comes about halfway up the sides of the flan dish to help it bake gently. Bake for 40–50 minutes, until the edges look set but the center still has a slight wobble when you gently shake the pan. Turn off the oven, crack the door, and let it sit for 10 minutes. Remove from the water bath, cool to room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 3 hours. Serve chilled with a light dusting of the remaining cinnamon.

title: Spiced Apple-Raisin Yogurt Fruitcake Loaf (Wholemeal & Almond)
ingredients_json: ["220 g plain yogurt, low-fat (2-3% fat)", "120 g egg, whole, raw", "140 g apples, raw, grated (with skin)", "90 g raisins", "60 g almonds, ground (almond meal)", "140 g whole wheat flour", "30 g rolled oats", "50 g honey", "70 g butter, unsalted, melted", "8 g baking powder", "4 g ground cinnamon", "2 g fine sea salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 170°C (conventional) and line a 1-litre loaf tin with baking paper. In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the honey and melted butter until smooth. Stir in the yogurt, then fold in the grated apple, raisins, ground almonds, whole wheat flour, oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and sea salt. Mix just until the batter looks evenly combined and thick, without over-stirring. Scrape the batter into the tin and smooth the top. Bake for 45–55 minutes, until the loaf is deep golden and a skewer inserted in the center comes out mostly clean with a few moist crumbs. Let it cool in the tin for 10 minutes before lifting out to cool completely on a rack; slice only once fully cool for the best texture.

title: Oat-and-Applesauce Fruitcake with Cranberries and Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["220 g rolled oats", "180 g low-fat plain Greek yogurt", "120 g unsweetened applesauce", "3 piece egg, raw", "120 g dried cranberries", "80 g walnuts, chopped", "2 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp baking soda", "1 pinch salt", "20 ml lemon juice"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C and line a loaf tin (about 20 cm) with baking paper. In a bowl, combine the oats, cinnamon, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. In a second bowl, whisk the eggs, yogurt, applesauce, and lemon juice until smooth. Add the wet mixture to the dry ingredients and stir until you have a thick batter. Fold in the cranberries and chopped walnuts. Transfer the batter to the tin, smooth the top, and bake for 45–55 minutes, until the center is set and a skewer comes out mostly clean with only a few moist crumbs. Let the fruitcake cool in the tin for 15 minutes, then lift out and cool fully before slicing so it holds together.

title: Wholegrain Apple-Cinnamon Fruitcake with Raisins and Toasted Nuts
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal spelt flour", "120 g rolled oats", "120 g raisins", "160 g apple, grated", "80 g walnuts, chopped", "2 piece egg", "180 ml plain low-fat yogurt", "100 g unsalted butter, melted", "80 g honey", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp baking soda", "1 tbsp ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp fine salt", "2 tsp vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 170°C (conventional) and line a loaf tin (about 20 cm) with baking paper. In a large bowl, mix the wholemeal spelt flour, rolled oats, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt. Stir in the raisins and chopped walnuts so they’re coated with the dry mixture. In a second bowl, whisk the eggs with honey and vanilla extract, then mix in the yogurt and melted butter. Fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, then fold through the grated apple until the batter looks thick and evenly combined. Spoon the batter into the tin and smooth the top. Bake for 45–55 minutes, until the top is deep golden and a skewer inserted in the center comes out mostly clean with a few moist crumbs. Let the fruitcake cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool fully before slicing.

title: Whole-Grain Apple Cinnamon Fruitcake Bites with Raisins and Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "120 g raisins", "220 g apple, grated", "80 g whole-wheat flour", "40 g walnut halves, chopped", "2 whole eggs, raw", "120 g plain Greek yogurt, low-fat", "80 ml rapeseed oil", "80 ml orange juice", "10 g baking powder", "5 g ground cinnamon", "2 g fine salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C and line a loaf tin or small cake tin with baking paper. In a large bowl, mix the rolled oats, whole-wheat flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. Stir in the raisins and chopped walnuts. In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs, then add the low-fat Greek yogurt, rapeseed oil, and orange juice; mix until smooth. Fold the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients, then stir in the grated apple until the batter looks thick and evenly combined. Spread the batter into the tin and bake for 40–50 minutes, until the top is golden and a skewer inserted into the center comes out clean or with only a few moist crumbs. Let the fruitcake cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely before slicing.

title: Wholegrain Banana-Oat Fruitcakes with Dried Apricot and Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["160 g rolled oats", "120 g wholemeal spelt flour", "100 g dried apricots, chopped", "80 g walnuts, chopped", "200 g ripe bananas, mashed", "2 piece eggs, raw", "120 g plain low-fat Greek yogurt", "80 ml rapeseed oil", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 g ground nutmeg", "8 g baking powder", "4 g fine salt", "60 g honey", "80 ml orange juice"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a loaf tin (or line a small cake tin) with baking paper. In a large bowl, stir together the oats, wholemeal spelt flour, chopped dried apricots, walnuts, cinnamon, nutmeg, baking powder, and salt. In another bowl, whisk the eggs with the mashed bananas, Greek yogurt, honey, rapeseed oil, and orange juice until smooth. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and mix well until you have a thick batter and no dry flour pockets remain. Let the batter rest for 5 minutes so the oats hydrate and the dried fruit softens. Bake for 35–45 minutes, until the top is golden and a skewer inserted in the center comes out mostly clean with a few moist crumbs. Cool the fruitcake in the tin for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely before slicing so it holds together.

title: Dark Cocoa Avocado Fudge with Coconut and Sea Salt
ingredients_json: ["200 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "150 g avocado, ripe, flesh", "60 g coconut sugar", "80 ml coconut milk, full-fat", "20 g cocoa powder, Dutch-process", "10 g chia seeds, ground", "3 g sea salt"]
instructions: Melt the dark chocolate gently using a microwave in 20-second bursts or a bowl over barely simmering water, stirring until smooth and glossy. In a blender, combine the avocado flesh, coconut milk, coconut sugar, and cocoa powder, then blend until completely smooth. Add the melted chocolate and ground chia seeds and blend again until the mixture is thick and uniform. Line a small loaf tin with baking paper, pour in the fudge mixture, and spread it into an even layer. Chill for at least 2 hours until firm, then slice into portions and serve straight from the fridge, with a light dusting of extra cocoa if you like.

title: Dark Chocolate Avocado Fudge with Cocoa and Almond Butter
ingredients_json: ["200 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa, chopped", "120 g ripe avocado, flesh only", "60 g almond butter, unsweetened", "30 g cocoa powder, unsweetened", "40 g maple syrup", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "4 g sea salt flakes", "30 g almonds, chopped"]
instructions: Melt the dark chocolate gently using a microwave in 20–30 second bursts, stirring each time, until smooth. In a blender, combine the melted chocolate, avocado flesh, almond butter, cocoa powder, maple syrup, vanilla extract, and sea salt flakes. Blend until the mixture is completely smooth and glossy, scraping down the sides as needed. Fold in the chopped almonds, then transfer the fudge mixture into a parchment-lined small loaf tin. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours, until firm, then slice into portions. Serve chilled for a dense, fudgy texture.

title: Dark Chocolate Oat Fudge with Almond Butter and Sea Salt
ingredients_json: ["200 g dark chocolate, 70% cacao, chopped", "120 g rolled oats, finely ground", "80 g almond butter, unsweetened", "60 ml low-fat milk, 1% fat", "30 g maple syrup", "20 g cocoa powder, unsweetened", "2 g fine sea salt", "5 g vanilla extract"]
instructions: Line a small baking tin with baking paper (about 18–20 cm). Add the low-fat milk to a saucepan and warm it over low heat until steaming, not boiling. Stir in the chopped dark chocolate and keep stirring until completely melted and smooth. Remove from the heat and whisk in the almond butter, maple syrup, cocoa powder, vanilla extract, oats, and sea salt. Mix until the mixture is thick and glossy, then pour it into the prepared tin. Let it cool at room temperature for 30 minutes, then chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours until firm. Slice into portions and serve once fully set.

title: Dark Chocolate Avocado Fudge with Toasted Walnuts and Sea Salt
ingredients_json: ["200 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa, chopped", "240 g avocado, ripe, peeled and pitted", "60 g honey", "80 g walnuts", "30 g cocoa powder, unsweetened", "10 g butter, unsalted", "2 g sea salt"]
instructions: Melt the chopped dark chocolate and unsalted butter together using a low heat method: place them in a heatproof bowl over barely simmering water and stir until smooth and glossy, then remove from the heat and let it cool for 5 minutes. In a blender, add the avocado, honey, cocoa powder, and sea salt and blend until completely smooth, scraping down the sides as needed. Stir the cooled melted chocolate into the avocado mixture until evenly combined. Pulse the walnuts a few times so they stay chunky, then fold them into the fudge mixture. Spoon the mixture into a small parchment-lined loaf tin (about 18–20 cm) and spread into an even layer. Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours, until firm enough to cut. Slice into portions and serve straight from the fridge for the best fudge texture.

title: Wholemeal Gingerbread Cookies with Molasses and Orange Zest
ingredients_json: ["170 g whole wheat flour", "60 g light molasses", "80 g unsalted butter", "60 g dark brown sugar", "1 pc egg", "30 ml milk, 2%", "5 g ground ginger", "3 g ground cinnamon", "1 g ground cloves", "2 g baking powder", "4 g baking soda", "2 g salt", "5 ml vanilla extract", "3 g orange zest"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 175°C and line two baking trays with baking paper. In a bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, ground ginger, ground cinnamon, ground cloves, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. In a second bowl, cream the butter and dark brown sugar until smoother, then beat in the egg, followed by the molasses, milk, vanilla extract, and orange zest. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until a thick cookie dough forms; if it feels too soft, rest it for 10 minutes in the fridge. Roll the dough to about 6–8 mm thickness, cut into gingerbread shapes, and place them on the trays with space between. Bake for 9–11 minutes, until the edges look set and slightly darker but the centers still feel soft. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely before serving.

title: Wholemeal Gingerbread Cookies with Molasses and Warm Spices
ingredients_json: ["160 g wholemeal spelt flour", "60 g rolled oats", "60 g unsalted butter", "80 g light brown sugar", "60 g molasses", "1 piece egg", "1 tbsp milk, skimmed", "2 tsp ground ginger", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp ground cloves", "1 g ground nutmeg", "2 tsp baking powder", "1 g fine salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C and line two baking trays with parchment paper. In a bowl, whisk together the wholemeal spelt flour, rolled oats, baking powder, ginger, cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg, and salt. In a second bowl, beat the butter with the brown sugar until creamy, then mix in the molasses and the egg, followed by the skimmed milk. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until you have a thick dough. Wrap and chill the dough for 15 minutes so it firms up. Roll the dough to about 5 mm thickness and cut gingerbread shapes, then place them on the trays with a little space between each cookie. Bake for 9–11 minutes, until the edges look set and lightly darkened, not wet or underbaked. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely before serving.

title: Wholegrain Gingerbread Cookies with Molasses and Warm Spices
ingredients_json: ["200 g whole wheat flour", "80 g wholemeal spelt flour", "120 g unsalted butter", "100 g light brown sugar", "80 g molasses", "1 large egg", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain 2%", "2 tsp ground ginger", "1.5 tsp ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp ground cloves", "1 tsp baking soda", "0.5 tsp salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 175°C and line two baking trays with baking paper. Cream the butter and brown sugar until the mixture looks lighter and fluffy, then beat in the molasses and the egg until smooth. Stir in the Greek yogurt and mix until fully combined. In a separate bowl, whisk together the flours, ginger, cinnamon, cloves, baking soda, and salt, then add the dry mixture to the wet mixture and mix just until a thick dough forms. Shape the dough into a flat disk, wrap it, and chill for 20 minutes so it’s easier to roll. Roll the dough to about 5 mm thickness on a lightly floured surface and cut into gingerbread cookie shapes. Bake for 8–10 minutes, until the edges look set and slightly darker but the centers are not wet. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely before storing.

title: Wholegrain Gingerbread Cookies with Molasses and Warm Spices
ingredients_json: ["150 g wholemeal spelt flour", "50 g rolled oats, finely ground", "100 g reduced-fat butter, softened", "60 g molasses", "80 g light brown sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "2 tsp ground ginger", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp ground cloves", "1 tsp baking soda", "0.5 tsp salt", "2 tbsp milk, semi-skimmed"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 175°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a bowl, mix the wholemeal spelt flour, ground oats, ground ginger, cinnamon, cloves, baking soda, and salt. In a second bowl, beat the softened reduced-fat butter with the brown sugar until smoother, then beat in the molasses and the egg. Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture and mix until a thick dough forms; if it looks too stiff, mix in the semi-skimmed milk. Wrap the dough and chill for 20 minutes so it firms up and is easier to roll. Roll the dough to about 4 mm thick and cut out cookie shapes. Place them on the tray with space between. Bake for 8–10 minutes until the edges look set and slightly darker, but the centers still feel tender. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes before transferring to a rack to cool completely.

title: Greek Yogurt Vanilla Ice Cream with Roasted Berry Swirl
ingredients_json: ["500 g Greek yogurt, low-fat (2%)", "200 g mixed berries, frozen", "120 g honey", "20 g corn starch", "2 tsp vanilla extract", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 pinch salt", "120 ml milk, skimmed"]
instructions: In a bowl, whisk the corn starch with the milk until smooth, then set aside. In a saucepan, warm the honey over medium heat until it loosens and starts to lightly bubble. Add the berry mixture and lemon juice, and simmer for 6–8 minutes, stirring often, until the berries break down and the sauce thickens slightly. Reduce the heat and slowly whisk in the milk-corn starch mixture, cooking for 1–2 minutes until glossy and thicker than before. Remove from the heat and cool completely. In a separate bowl, stir the Greek yogurt with the vanilla extract and salt until evenly combined. Fold the cooled berry swirl into the yogurt mixture, then transfer to an ice-cream maker and churn according to the manufacturer’s instructions until the texture is soft-serve. Spoon into a freezer-safe container and freeze for at least 3 hours to firm up before serving.

title: Greek Yogurt Mango Ice Cream with Lime and Chia
ingredients_json: ["400 g Greek yogurt, low-fat (2%)", "300 g mango, ripe, diced", "150 g skimmed milk", "60 g honey", "20 g chia seeds", "20 ml fresh lime juice", "1 g vanilla extract", "2 g lemon zest"]
instructions: Blend the diced mango with the lime juice until smooth, then stir in the Greek yogurt, skimmed milk, honey, chia seeds, vanilla extract, and lemon zest. Let the mixture rest in the refrigerator for 30 minutes so the chia seeds thicken the base. Pour the chilled mixture into an ice cream maker and churn according to the manufacturer’s instructions until it becomes soft-serve consistency, usually 20 to 30 minutes. Transfer to a freezer-safe container and freeze for at least 2 hours until firm, then scoop and serve.

title: Vanilla Greek Yogurt Ice Cream with Fresh Berries
ingredients_json: ["500 g Greek yogurt, plain 2% fat", "150 g frozen mixed berries, unsweetened", "80 g honey", "2 dl milk, low-fat 1% fat", "1 tbsp vanilla extract", "30 g cornflour", "2 g fine salt"]
instructions: In a small saucepan, whisk the milk and cornflour until smooth, then add the honey and salt. Heat over medium-low heat, stirring constantly until the mixture thickens slightly and coats the back of a spoon, about 3–5 minutes; it should not boil aggressively. Remove from the heat and stir in the vanilla extract. Let the base cool to room temperature, then mix it with the Greek yogurt. Blend the berries briefly if you like a more uniform texture, or leave them mostly whole for fruit streaks, and fold them through the mixture. Pour everything into a shallow container and chill for at least 4 hours, then churn in an ice-cream maker according to the manufacturer’s instructions, or freeze until scoopable, about 4–6 hours. Serve when firm but not rock hard; you want a creamy texture.

title: Strawberry Yogurt Ice Cream with Chia and Vanilla
ingredients_json: ["250 g strawberries, fresh, hulled", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "300 ml unsweetened almond milk", "60 g honey", "1 piece egg yolk, raw", "20 g chia seeds", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "5 g vanilla extract"]
instructions: Blend the strawberries until smooth, then heat the strawberry purée with the almond milk and honey over medium heat until it starts to steam, about 4–6 minutes. In a bowl, whisk the egg yolk with the lemon juice and slowly drizzle in a ladle of the hot strawberry mixture to temper it. Pour the tempered yolk back into the pot and cook on low heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens slightly and coats the back of a spoon, about 3–5 minutes; do not let it boil. Remove from the heat, stir in the chia seeds and vanilla extract, and let it cool to room temperature. Fold in the Greek yogurt, then chill the base in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours. Churn in an ice cream maker according to the manufacturer’s instructions, then freeze for 2–3 hours until scoopable.

title: Vanilla Greek Yogurt Ice Cream with Honeyed Berries
ingredients_json: ["400 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat (2%)", "200 ml milk, low-fat (1%)", "120 g berries, mixed (blueberries, strawberries, raspberries), fresh or frozen", "60 g honey", "2 tbsp lemon juice", "1.5 tsp vanilla extract", "2 g gelatin, powdered", "1 g salt"]
instructions: In a small bowl, stir the gelatin into 2 tablespoons of cold milk from the 1% milk and let it bloom for 5 minutes. In a saucepan, warm the remaining milk with the honey over low heat, stirring until the honey dissolves and the mixture is steaming but not boiling. Take the pan off the heat, add the bloomed gelatin, and stir until completely melted and smooth. Let the mixture cool to lukewarm, then whisk it into the Greek yogurt with the vanilla extract and lemon juice. Blend about half of the mixed berries into a rough purée, then fold the purée and the remaining whole berries into the yogurt base. Pour the mixture into a shallow freezer-safe container, cover, and freeze for 3 hours, stirring vigorously every 45 minutes to break up ice crystals. After 3 hours, scoop and serve soft-set, or freeze 1 more hour for a firmer texture.

title: No-Bake Greek Yogurt Key Lime Pie with Zesty Lime and Crunchy Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "60 g almonds, chopped", "40 g honey", "80 g unsalted butter", "300 g low-fat Greek yogurt", "300 g quark", "150 g mascarpone", "180 g granulated sugar", "120 ml lime juice", "15 g lime zest", "4 g gelatin powder", "60 ml cold water, to bloom gelatin", "1 g vanilla extract", "1 g fine salt"]
instructions: In a food processor, pulse the oats and chopped almonds until they look like coarse crumbs. Warm the honey and butter together until the butter melts, then pour it into the crumb mixture and pulse briefly until everything is evenly coated. Press the crust firmly into the bottom of a 22 cm pie dish and chill while you make the filling. Sprinkle the gelatin over the cold water and let it bloom for 5 minutes, then warm it gently just until dissolved, without boiling. In a bowl, whisk the Greek yogurt, quark, and mascarpone with the sugar, lime juice, lime zest, vanilla extract, and fine salt until smooth. Stir in the dissolved gelatin, mix well, then pour the filling into the chilled crust. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or until set and sliceable, and serve cold for the best key lime tang.

title: Greek Yogurt Key Lime Pie with Almond-Crumb Base
ingredients_json: ["200 g digestive biscuits, whole grain", "60 g almonds, ground", "50 g butter, unsalted", "500 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2% fat", "200 g condensed milk, reduced-fat", "120 ml lime juice", "25 g lime zest", "3 g gelatin powder", "40 ml water, cold", "1 g salt", "1 tsp vanilla extract"]
instructions: Lightly grease a 20 cm pie dish. Crush the whole grain digestive biscuits and mix them with the ground almonds. Melt the butter and stir it into the crumb mixture until evenly coated, then press the crust firmly into the base and chill it while you make the filling. In a small bowl, bloom the gelatin by sprinkling it over the cold water and letting it stand for 5 minutes. Heat the gelatin mixture gently (about 30–40 seconds in a microwave or over very low heat) until it fully dissolves, then cool it slightly. In a large bowl, whisk the Greek yogurt and reduced-fat condensed milk until smooth, then whisk in the lime juice, lime zest, salt, and vanilla. Whisk in the dissolved gelatin last, and pour the filling into the chilled crust. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or until the filling is set and no longer wobbles in the center. Slice with a sharp knife and serve cold.

title: Zesty Greek Yogurt Key Lime Pie with Almond-Coconut Crust
ingredients_json: ["200 g digestive biscuits, wholegrain", "60 g almonds, ground", "70 g coconut oil", "30 g lime zest", "200 ml fresh lime juice", "400 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "250 g skim milk ricotta", "120 g honey", "20 g corn starch", "3 g gelatin powder, unflavored", "1 g fine salt"]
instructions: Grease a 20 cm pie dish lightly. Crush the wholegrain digestive biscuits and mix them with the ground almonds. Melt the coconut oil and stir it into the crumb mixture until evenly moistened, then press firmly into the base and slightly up the sides of the pie dish. Chill the crust in the fridge for 30 minutes. In a bowl, whisk the lime juice, lime zest, honey, corn starch, and salt until smooth. In a small cup, sprinkle the gelatin over 30 ml cold water and let it bloom for 5 minutes, then warm it gently until fully dissolved. Pour the lime mixture into a saucepan and cook over medium heat, whisking continuously for 3 to 5 minutes until the mixture thickens to a custard-like consistency. Remove from the heat and whisk in the dissolved gelatin. Let the filling cool for about 10 minutes, then fold in the Greek yogurt and ricotta until smooth. Pour the filling into the chilled crust and level the top. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or until set, before slicing and serving.

title: Light Lemon Bars with Greek Yogurt Shortbread
ingredients_json: ["170 g whole-wheat flour", "90 g rolled oats", "70 g unsalted butter", "2 tbsp honey", "1 pinch fine salt", "2 piece egg", "200 g plain Greek yogurt, 2% fat", "220 g granulated sugar", "2 tbsp lemon zest", "120 ml lemon juice", "40 g cornstarch"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C and line an 20×20 cm baking tin with baking paper. For the crust, stir together the whole-wheat flour, rolled oats, fine salt, and honey, then rub in the unsalted butter until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Press the crust firmly into the tin and bake for 12 minutes until lightly golden at the edges. While the crust bakes, whisk the eggs with the granulated sugar until smooth, then whisk in the Greek yogurt, lemon zest, lemon juice, and cornstarch until there are no lumps. Pour the lemon filling over the hot crust and bake for 18 to 22 minutes, until the filling is set around the edges but still has a slight wobble in the center. Let the lemon bars cool completely in the tin, then chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours before slicing into squares and serving.

title: Whole-Wheat Lemon Bars with Greek Yogurt Shortbread
ingredients_json: ["160 g whole wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "120 g low-fat Greek yogurt (2% milk fat)", "70 g honey", "120 g unsalted butter", "1 g fine salt", "2 piece eggs, raw", "200 ml lemon juice, fresh", "80 g granulated sugar", "10 g lemon zest", "25 g cornstarch"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 175°C. Line an 20×20 cm baking tin with parchment paper. In a bowl, mix the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, and salt, then rub in the unsalted butter until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Press about 2/3 of the mixture firmly into the bottom of the tin, then bake for 12 minutes until lightly golden. Whisk the eggs, honey, granulated sugar, lemon juice, lemon zest, and cornstarch until smooth, then pour over the baked crust. Sprinkle the remaining crumb mixture on top and bake for 18–22 minutes, until the filling is set around the edges but still slightly soft in the center. Let the bars cool completely at room temperature, then chill for at least 2 hours before slicing into squares.

title: Whole-Wheat Lemon Bars with Greek Yogurt and Zesty Lemon Curd
ingredients_json: ["180 g plain whole-wheat flour", "60 g rolled oats", "120 g unsalted butter, cold and cubed", "40 g erythritol", "1 g fine salt", "2 whole eggs, raw", "200 g Greek yogurt, nonfat", "200 ml lemon juice, fresh", "120 g erythritol", "20 g cornstarch", "2 g lemon zest", "1 tsp vanilla extract"]
instructions:
Preheat your oven to 175°C and line an 20x20 cm baking pan with parchment paper, leaving overhang for lifting. In a food processor, pulse the whole-wheat flour, oats, erythritol, and salt until evenly mixed, then add the cold cubed butter and pulse until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Press about two-thirds of the crumb mixture firmly into the bottom of the pan. Bake for 12 minutes, until lightly golden at the edges.
Meanwhile, whisk the eggs with the remaining erythritol until smooth. Whisk in the Greek yogurt, lemon juice, lemon zest, cornstarch, and vanilla extract until the mixture is fully combined and no streaks of cornstarch remain. Pour the lemon filling over the warm crust, sprinkle the remaining crumb mixture on top, and bake for 22–26 minutes, until the center is set but still slightly soft and the surface looks matte rather than glossy.
Let the bars cool to room temperature, then chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours before cutting into squares with a sharp knife. For clean slices, wipe the knife between cuts.

title: Whole-Wheat Lemon Bars with Greek Yogurt and Zesty Lemon Curd
ingredients_json: ["120 g whole wheat flour", "60 g rolled oats", "100 g plain Greek yogurt, 2%", "70 g unsalted butter", "80 g maple syrup", "2 g baking powder", "1 g fine salt", "3 piece eggs, whole", "200 ml fresh lemon juice", "30 g lemon zest", "50 g cornflour"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line an 20x20 cm baking pan with parchment paper so the edges overhang. In a bowl, mix the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking powder, and salt. Add the Greek yogurt and melted butter, then stir until a thick, crumbly dough forms. Press the dough firmly into the pan and bake for 12 minutes, until lightly golden. Meanwhile, whisk the eggs with maple syrup until smooth, then whisk in lemon juice and lemon zest. Stir in the cornflour until no lumps remain, then pour the lemon mixture over the warm crust. Bake for 18–22 minutes, until the filling is set around the edges but still has a slight wobble in the center. Let the lemon bars cool completely in the pan, then chill for at least 2 hours before cutting into squares for clean slices.

title: Whole-Grain Lemon Bars with Greek Yogurt and Fresh Citrus Zest
ingredients_json: ["180 g whole wheat flour", "60 g rolled oats", "120 g plain Greek yogurt, low-fat", "60 g unsalted butter", "70 g xylitol", "40 g fresh lemon juice", "2 whole eggs, raw", "2 whole lemons, zest only", "300 ml skim milk", "15 g cornstarch", "1 g fine salt"]
instructions:
Preheat your oven to 175°C. Line an 20 x 20 cm baking pan with parchment paper and lightly grease the sides. In a bowl, mix the whole wheat flour and rolled oats. Add the butter and work it in until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs, then press it evenly into the lined pan. Bake the crust for 12 minutes, until it turns lightly golden at the edges.

While the crust bakes, whisk the eggs with xylitol until smooth, then whisk in the Greek yogurt, skim milk, cornstarch, lemon juice, lemon zest, and salt. Pour the lemon filling over the hot crust and bake for 18 to 22 minutes, until the edges are set and the center still jiggles slightly when you gently shake the pan. Let the bars cool completely at room temperature, then chill for at least 2 hours before slicing into neat squares for clean edges.

title: Coconut-Chia Macaroons with Dark Chocolate Swirl
ingredients_json: ["120 g desiccated coconut, unsweetened", "60 g canned chickpeas, drained and rinsed", "2 tbsp ground chia seeds", "1 piece egg, raw", "80 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "40 g honey", "1 g vanilla extract", "50 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a food processor, blend the chickpeas with the egg, Greek yogurt, honey and vanilla until smooth. Stir in the desiccated coconut and the ground chia seeds, then let the mixture rest for 5 minutes so the chia can thicken it. Scoop heaped tablespoon-size portions onto the tray and press them lightly into small nests. Bake for 12–15 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden and the centers look set. Let the macaroons cool on the tray for 10 minutes. Melt the dark chocolate gently (either in a microwave in short bursts or over a low heat) and drizzle a thin swirl over the cooled macaroons before serving.

title: Almond-Chocolate Coconut Macaroons with Dark Cocoa
ingredients_json: ["200 g unsweetened shredded coconut", "150 g egg whites, pasteurized", "60 g honey", "40 g almond butter", "20 g unsweetened cocoa powder", "30 g dark chocolate chips (70% cocoa), chopped", "1 g fine salt", "1 ml vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 170°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a mixing bowl, whisk the pasteurized egg whites until lightly foamy, then fold in the shredded coconut, honey, almond butter, cocoa powder, salt, vanilla extract, and the chopped dark chocolate. Mix until the mixture is thick and evenly coated. Scoop level tablespoons of the mixture and shape into small mounds. Bake for 14–16 minutes, until the tops look set and feel slightly firm. Let the macaroons cool on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely so they hold their shape.

title: Coconut-Lime Greek Yogurt Macaroons (Baked, Light)
ingredients_json: ["150 g unsweetened shredded coconut", "200 g nonfat Greek yogurt", "2 piece egg whites, raw", "60 g honey", "1 piece lime, zest only", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 g fine sea salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 160°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a mixing bowl, whisk the egg whites until slightly foamy, then fold in the Greek yogurt, honey, lime zest, vanilla extract, and sea salt. Add the shredded coconut and mix until everything is evenly combined and the mixture looks thick enough to scoop. Let the mixture rest for 5 minutes so the coconut hydrates. Using a spoon, portion small mounds onto the tray, spacing them apart. Bake for 14–16 minutes until the edges are lightly golden. Cool on the tray for 10 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely so they set.

title: Toasted Coconut & Dark Chocolate Macaroons with Almonds
ingredients_json: ["220 g unsweetened shredded coconut", "160 g egg whites, raw", "80 g raw honey", "60 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "20 g almond butter", "20 g coconut flour", "1 g sea salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a bowl, whisk the egg whites until they look foamy, then whisk in the honey until smooth and glossy. Stir in the shredded coconut, almond butter, coconut flour, and sea salt, mixing until the mixture holds together like a thick batter. Spoon 18 small mounds onto the tray and press each lightly so it forms a neat macaroon. Bake for 14–16 minutes until the edges are lightly golden and the tops look set. Let them cool on the tray for 10 minutes. Melt the dark chocolate gently in a microwave in 20-second bursts or over a very low heat, then drizzle or dip the bottoms of the cooled macaroons and allow the chocolate to set before serving.

title: Greek Yogurt Mousse with Berry Compote and Vanilla
ingredients_json: ["400 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat 2%", "200 ml unsweetened almond milk", "120 g mixed berries, frozen", "80 g honey", "10 g gelatine powder", "60 ml water, cold", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tsp vanilla extract"]
instructions: Bloom the gelatine by sprinkling it over the 60 ml cold water and letting it sit for 5 minutes. Warm the almond milk in a small saucepan over low heat until steaming and hot but not boiling, then stir in the bloomed gelatine until fully dissolved and smooth. Remove from the heat and let the mixture cool for 10 minutes. In a bowl, whisk the Greek yogurt with honey, lemon juice, and vanilla extract until creamy. Pour in the cooled gelatine mixture and whisk gently until well combined, then divide into 4 serving glasses. For the berry compote, simmer the frozen mixed berries over medium heat with a splash of water for 6–8 minutes until they break down and thicken slightly, then let it cool to room temperature. Spoon the compote over the set mousse and chill for at least 3 hours until firm. Serve cold.

title: Greek Yogurt Mousse with Lemon and Berries
ingredients_json: ["400 g Greek yogurt, low-fat (2%)", "250 g strawberries, fresh", "200 ml whipping cream, 30% fat", "40 g honey", "2 g vanilla bean paste", "10 g lemon juice", "1 pc gelatin leaves", "25 ml water"]
instructions: Soak the gelatin leaf in 25 ml cold water for 5 minutes until softened. Warm the lemon juice very gently and dissolve the soaked gelatin in it, then cool for about 5 minutes so it’s not hot. In a bowl, whisk the honey and vanilla bean paste into the Greek yogurt until smooth. Whip the cream until it holds soft peaks, then fold it into the yogurt mixture in two additions. Hull and slice the strawberries, then fold most of them into the mousse, reserving a few slices for topping. Spoon into 4 glasses and refrigerate for at least 3 hours until set. Serve chilled with the reserved strawberries on top.

title: Greek Yogurt–Berry Mousse with Vanilla and Chia
ingredients_json: ["300 g Greek yogurt, low-fat (2%)", "200 g mixed berries, frozen", "2 tsp chia seeds", "30 g honey", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "2 tbsp lemon juice", "2 g gelatin powder", "60 ml water"]
instructions: Warm the water until steaming, then whisk in the gelatin powder and stir for about 30 seconds until fully dissolved. In a blender, purée the frozen berries with the lemon juice until smooth, then strain if you prefer a silkier texture. In a bowl, mix the low-fat Greek yogurt with the honey and vanilla extract. Stir the dissolved gelatin into the yogurt mixture, then fold in the berry purée. Whisk in the chia seeds and let the mixture rest for 5 minutes so the chia starts to thicken. Divide into 4 small serving glasses and refrigerate for at least 3 hours, until set. Serve chilled, optionally with a few extra berries on top.

title: Greek Yogurt–Berry Mousse with Vanilla and Chia
ingredients_json: ["300 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "200 g mixed berries, fresh or frozen", "60 ml honey", "2 g gelatin, powdered", "30 ml water", "1 g vanilla extract", "10 g chia seeds", "1 g lemon zest", "1 g lemon juice", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Bloom the powdered gelatin by sprinkling it over 30 ml water in a small bowl, then let it sit for 5 minutes. Warm the bowl gently over low heat just until the gelatin dissolves completely; it should turn fully liquid and look clear, but do not boil. In a blender, puree the mixed berries until mostly smooth, then stir in the honey, lemon zest, and lemon juice. In a mixing bowl, combine the low-fat Greek yogurt with the chia seeds and vanilla extract, then whisk until evenly distributed. Pour the warm dissolved gelatin into the yogurt mixture while whisking, then fold in the berry puree.
