Divide the mousse into 4 serving glasses and refrigerate for at least 4 hours until set and thick. Serve chilled, with the top slightly firm and spoonable.

title: Greek Yogurt-Lemon Mousse with Blueberries
ingredients_json: ["300 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat (2%)", "200 ml cream, light (10% fat)", "90 g honey", "3 tbsp lemon juice", "5 g gelatin powder", "60 ml cold water", "250 g blueberries, fresh"]
instructions: Sprinkle the gelatin powder over the cold water in a small bowl and let it bloom for 5 minutes. Warm the honey in a small saucepan over low heat just until it becomes pourable, then stir in the bloomed gelatin and keep heating until completely dissolved and smooth, without boiling. Remove from the heat and whisk in the lemon juice. In a larger bowl, stir the Greek yogurt with the light cream until thick and uniform, then gradually pour in the warm gelatin-lemon mixture while whisking gently so the yogurt doesn’t split. Fold in 150 g of the blueberries, reserving the rest for topping. Divide the mousse into 4 glasses and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, until set. Serve chilled with the remaining blueberries on top.

title: Cinnamon Oatmeal Cookies with Raisins and Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "80 g whole wheat flour", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 g ground cinnamon", "1 g fine salt", "80 g raisins", "60 g walnuts, chopped", "100 g unsweetened applesauce", "120 g honey", "1 piece egg, raw", "60 ml neutral vegetable oil", "5 ml vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a large bowl, mix the rolled oats, whole wheat flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. Stir in the raisins and chopped walnuts. In a second bowl, whisk the applesauce, honey, egg, vegetable oil, and vanilla extract until smooth, then pour into the dry ingredients and mix until a thick cookie dough forms. Let the dough rest for 5 minutes so the oats hydrate slightly. Scoop heaped tablespoons of dough onto the tray, spacing them a few centimeters apart, and gently flatten each one. Bake for 10–12 minutes, until the edges look set and lightly golden but the centers still look soft. Cool on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely before serving.

title: Cinnamon Apple Oatmeal Cookies with Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "60 g whole-wheat flour", "120 g unsweetened applesauce", "80 g egg", "70 g honey", "60 g unsalted butter", "80 g raisins", "80 g apple, grated", "20 g walnuts, chopped", "7 g baking powder", "5 g ground cinnamon", "2 g fine salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 175°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a large bowl, mix the rolled oats, whole-wheat flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. In a separate bowl, whisk the egg with the honey and melted butter, then stir in the applesauce and grated apple. Combine the wet ingredients with the dry ingredients and mix until a thick cookie dough forms; fold in the raisins and chopped walnuts. Let the dough stand for 5 minutes so the oats hydrate, then scoop 16 equal portions onto the tray and press them slightly flat. Bake for 12–14 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden and the centers look set. Cool on the tray for 10 minutes before transferring to a rack so they finish firming up.

title: Cinnamon Oatmeal Cookies with Apple and Dark Chocolate
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "120 g whole wheat flour", "10 g baking powder", "4 g ground cinnamon", "2 g fine salt", "80 g unsalted butter", "140 g honey", "1 piece egg, raw", "60 g plain low-fat yogurt", "150 g apple, grated", "80 g dark chocolate chips (70% cocoa),", "20 g chopped walnuts"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 175°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a bowl, mix the rolled oats, whole wheat flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt until evenly combined. In another bowl, melt the butter and whisk it with the honey, the egg, and the yogurt until smooth. Stir in the grated apple, then pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and mix just until you get a thick cookie dough; let it rest for 5 minutes so the oats hydrate slightly. Fold in the dark chocolate chips and walnuts. Scoop 12–14 even portions onto the tray, spacing them well, and bake for 12–15 minutes until the edges look set and lightly golden while the centers still look soft. Cool on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely for the best texture.

title: Cinnamon-Raisin Oatmeal Cookies with Applesauce and Dark Chocolate
ingredients_json: ["150 g rolled oats", "120 g whole wheat flour", "120 g unsweetened applesauce", "80 g dark chocolate chips", "60 g maple syrup", "70 g unsalted butter", "1 pc egg", "2 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tsp baking powder", "0.5 tsp baking soda", "3 g fine salt", "50 g raisins"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 175°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a large bowl, mix the rolled oats, whole wheat flour, cinnamon, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. In a separate bowl, whisk together the melted butter, egg, applesauce, and maple syrup until smooth. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir until a thick dough forms; fold in the raisins and dark chocolate chips. Scoop portions of dough onto the tray and flatten slightly to help them bake evenly. Bake for 12–14 minutes, until the edges look set and lightly golden while the centers remain soft. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely so they firm up.

title: Cinnamon-Raisin Oatmeal Cookies with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "120 g plain Greek yogurt, low-fat", "90 g unsweetened applesauce", "80 g egg, raw", "70 g raisins", "60 g honey", "40 g almond butter", "2 g ground cinnamon", "3 g baking powder", "2 g fine salt", "10 g vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a large bowl, combine the rolled oats, ground cinnamon, baking powder, and fine salt. In another bowl, whisk the Greek yogurt, applesauce, egg, honey, almond butter, and vanilla extract until smooth. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir until a thick cookie dough forms; fold in the raisins. Let the dough rest for 5 minutes so the oats hydrate slightly. Scoop about 1 tablespoon portions onto the tray, spacing them apart, and lightly flatten each cookie. Bake for 12–14 minutes until the edges look set and lightly golden while the centers remain soft. Cool on the tray for 10 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely; they will firm up as they cool.

title: Greek Yogurt Pavlovas with Berries and Toasted Almonds
ingredients_json: ["110 g egg whites", "220 g caster sugar", "1 tsp cornflour", "1 tsp white wine vinegar", "250 g Greek yogurt, 2% fat", "2 tbsp honey", "300 g mixed berries, fresh", "30 g almonds, sliced", "1 g vanilla extract"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 110°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Whisk the egg whites until they form stiff peaks, then gradually whisk in the caster sugar a spoonful at a time until the mixture is glossy and very thick. Gently fold in the cornflour, then add the white wine vinegar and mix just until combined. Spoon 6 small mounds onto the tray and shape them into little nests with shallow edges. Bake for 75 minutes, then turn the oven off and leave the pavlovas inside with the door slightly ajar for 30 minutes to dry out without collapsing. Toast the sliced almonds in a dry pan over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes until lightly golden, then cool. Whisk the Greek yogurt with the honey and vanilla extract. Just before serving, spoon the yogurt into each pavlova nest and top with mixed berries and toasted almonds.

title: Greek Yogurt Pavlovas with Berry Compote and Toasted Pistachios
ingredients_json: ["120 g egg whites", "240 g caster sugar", "1 g cornstarch", "2 g vanilla extract", "0.5 g white vinegar", "400 g Greek yogurt, 2% fat", "250 g mixed berries, frozen or fresh", "30 g honey", "15 g lemon juice", "20 g pistachios, shelled"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 110°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Whisk the egg whites until they form soft peaks, then gradually add the caster sugar while whisking continuously until the mixture is glossy and holds stiff peaks. Gently whisk in the cornstarch, vanilla extract, and vinegar, mixing just until smooth. Spoon 8–10 mounds onto the tray, then shape them into slightly raised nests. Bake for 60–75 minutes until the outsides feel dry and crisp, then turn the oven off and leave the pavlovas inside with the door slightly ajar for 30 minutes to cool slowly and prevent cracks. Meanwhile, simmer the mixed berries with honey and lemon juice for 6–8 minutes until thickened, then cool completely. Toast the pistachios in a dry pan for 2–3 minutes and chop lightly. Assemble by spooning a generous swirl of Greek yogurt into each pavlova nest and topping with berry compote. Finish with the toasted pistachios just before serving.

title: Berry-Lemon Greek Yogurt Pavlovas with Pistachios
ingredients_json: ["120 g egg whites", "180 g caster sugar", "2 tsp cornflour", "1 tsp white wine vinegar", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "300 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "200 g strawberries", "120 g blueberries", "1 tbsp lemon zest", "2 tbsp lemon juice", "20 g pistachios, shelled"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 120°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Whip the egg whites until they form stiff, glossy peaks, then slowly rain in the caster sugar while whisking continuously. Keep whisking until the sugar has dissolved and the meringue holds very stiff peaks. Gently fold in the cornflour, then add the white wine vinegar and vanilla, folding just until smooth. Spoon 6 meringue rounds onto the tray, leaving space between them, and bake for 75 minutes until they look dry on the outside but still slightly marshmallowy inside. Turn off the oven, crack the door open, and let the pavlovas cool completely inside to prevent collapse. Whisk the Greek yogurt with lemon zest and lemon juice. Slice the strawberries and lightly mash a few for a thicker topping, then spoon berries over the yogurt. Roughly chop the pistachios and scatter them over the assembled pavlovas right before serving.

title: Berry Greek Yogurt Pavlovas with Light Honey and Toasted Almonds
ingredients_json: ["4 large Egg white, raw", "200 g Caster sugar", "2 tsp Cornstarch", "1 tsp White vinegar", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "300 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "30 g Honey", "250 g Mixed berries, fresh", "20 g Almonds, sliced", "2 g Flaked sea salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 120°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a clean bowl, whisk the egg whites until they form soft peaks. Gradually add the caster sugar a little at a time, whisking constantly until the mixture looks glossy and forms stiff peaks that hold their shape. Whisk in the cornstarch, vinegar, vanilla extract, and a very small pinch of the flaked sea salt. Spoon six mounds onto the tray and use the back of a spoon to create shallow indentations in the center. Bake for 60 minutes, then turn off the oven and leave the meringues inside with the door slightly ajar for 30 minutes to cool slowly and prevent cracking. Meanwhile, toast the sliced almonds in a dry pan over medium heat for 2–3 minutes until lightly golden, then cool. Mix the low-fat Greek yogurt with honey. Just before serving, top each pavlova with the yogurt mixture and mixed berries, then finish with toasted almonds and a light sprinkle of remaining flaked sea salt.

title: Greek Yogurt Berry Pavlovas with Vanilla and Toasted Almonds
ingredients_json: ["120 g Egg whites", "180 g Icing sugar", "8 g Cornstarch", "2 g Vanilla extract", "300 g Greek yogurt, non-fat", "30 g Honey", "300 g Mixed berries, fresh or frozen", "20 g Almonds, chopped", "2 g Lemon juice"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 120°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a clean, dry bowl, whisk the egg whites until they form soft peaks, then gradually whisk in the icing sugar until the meringue is thick and glossy and the sugar has mostly dissolved. Fold in the cornstarch gently, then whisk in the vanilla extract. Spoon 6 mounds onto the tray, making slight indentations in the centers. Bake for 75 minutes, until the outside feels dry to the touch and the meringues lift off easily, then turn off the oven and leave them inside with the door slightly ajar for 30 minutes to cool gradually. Mix the Greek yogurt with honey and lemon juice. Lightly toast the chopped almonds in a dry pan over medium heat for 2–3 minutes until fragrant. Spoon the yogurt mixture onto the cooled meringue shells, top with mixed berries, and finish with the toasted almonds.

title: Wholegrain Peanut Butter Cookies with Banana and Dark Chocolate Chunks
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "80 g natural peanut butter", "70 g banana, mashed", "40 g honey", "1 pc egg", "60 g whole wheat flour", "2 tsp baking powder", "1 g fine salt", "40 g dark chocolate (70%), chopped", "1 tsp vanilla extract"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 175°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a blender or food processor, pulse the rolled oats into a coarse oat flour. In a mixing bowl, stir together the oat flour, whole wheat flour, baking powder, and salt. In another bowl, whisk the egg with the honey and vanilla extract, then mix in the mashed banana and peanut butter until smooth and glossy. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir until a thick dough forms. Fold in the chopped dark chocolate. Scoop 12 even portions onto the tray and lightly press each one into a cookie shape. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges look set and lightly golden but the centers still look a bit soft. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely so they firm up.

title: Whole-Grain Peanut Butter Oat Cookies (Crispy Edges, Chewy Center)
ingredients_json: ["120 g peanut butter, natural (100% peanuts), no sugar added", "80 g rolled oats, fine", "60 g whole wheat flour", "60 g dark brown sugar", "1 piece egg, whole", "40 g unsweetened applesauce", "1 tsp baking powder", "0.5 tsp baking soda", "1 g fine salt", "10 g vanilla extract", "30 g dark chocolate chips, 70% cocoa"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 175°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a mixing bowl, stir together the peanut butter, egg, applesauce and vanilla until smooth. Add the rolled oats, whole wheat flour, dark brown sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt, and mix until a thick dough forms. Fold in the dark chocolate chips. Scoop about 1 tablespoon portions onto the tray, spacing them well, then flatten each slightly with the back of a spoon. Bake for 10–12 minutes, until the edges look set and lightly golden but the centers still look a bit soft. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes before transferring to a rack to cool completely.

title: Wholegrain Peanut Butter Oat Cookies with Dark Chocolate Chunks
ingredients_json: ["120 g peanut butter, creamy", "90 g rolled oats", "60 g wholemeal flour", "50 g honey", "1 piece egg, whole", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 g fine salt", "40 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a bowl, mix the peanut butter, honey, egg, and vanilla extract until smooth. Stir in the rolled oats and wholemeal flour, then add the baking powder and salt and mix until a thick cookie dough forms. Fold in the chopped dark chocolate. Scoop dough into 12 portions and roll each into a small ball, then place them on the tray and flatten slightly with a fork or your fingers. Bake for 10–12 minutes, until the edges look set and lightly golden but the centers still look slightly soft. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely before eating.

title: Wholewheat Peanut Butter Oat Cookies with Dark Chocolate
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "150 g peanut butter, natural", "80 g whole wheat flour", "60 g honey", "1 piece egg, raw", "5 g baking powder", "3 g fine sea salt", "1 g ground cinnamon", "30 g dark chocolate chips (70%)"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 175°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. Grind the rolled oats briefly in a blender until they resemble a coarse flour. In a bowl, mix the oats, whole wheat flour, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon. In another bowl, whisk the egg with the honey until smooth, then stir in the peanut butter until the mixture is thick and glossy. Combine the wet ingredients with the dry ingredients and mix until a soft dough forms. Fold in the dark chocolate chips. Scoop 18–20 portions onto the tray and press each one slightly with a fork for a classic cookie shape. Bake for 10–12 minutes, until the edges look set and lightly golden but the centers still look a little soft. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes before transferring to a rack to cool completely.

title: Greek Yogurt Pecan Pie with Maple and Cinnamon (Whole-Grain Crust)
ingredients_json: ["120 g whole wheat pastry flour", "60 g unsalted butter", "1 g fine sea salt", "45 g maple syrup", "80 ml milk, skimmed", "150 g pecans, chopped", "1 pc egg, whole", "2 pc egg yolk, raw", "170 g Greek yogurt, plain, nonfat", "1 g ground cinnamon", "10 g vanilla extract"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 175°C. In a bowl, rub the butter into the whole wheat pastry flour and salt until it looks like coarse crumbs, then press it firmly into a greased 20 cm pie dish. Bake the crust for 10 minutes, until it looks set and slightly golden. In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg, egg yolks, Greek yogurt, milk, maple syrup, cinnamon, and vanilla until smooth. Fold in the chopped pecans, then pour the filling into the warm crust. Bake for 25–30 minutes, until the center is just set with a slight jiggle and the edges are browned. Let the pie cool for at least 1 hour before slicing so the filling firms up.

title: Whole-Wheat Pecan Pie with Maple-Like Dates and Vanilla Custard
ingredients_json: ["180 g whole-wheat flour", "60 g unsalted butter, cold", "1 piece egg, raw", "60 g water", "1 g salt", "220 g pecans, chopped", "80 g pitted dates, Medjool", "80 g evaporated milk, canned, unsweetened", "2 piece eggs, raw", "60 g unsweetened applesauce", "30 g brown sugar", "5 g vanilla extract", "2 g ground cinnamon", "0.5 g ground nutmeg"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 180°C. In a bowl, rub the cold butter into the whole-wheat flour and salt until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Whisk 1 egg with the water, pour it into the flour mixture, and stir until you can form a soft dough. Press the dough into a lightly greased 23 cm pie dish and bake for 10 minutes until set. Meanwhile, soak and blend the pitted dates with a splash of water into a thick, smooth paste. Whisk the remaining 2 eggs with the evaporated milk, applesauce, brown sugar, vanilla, cinnamon, and nutmeg, then fold in the chopped pecans and the date paste. Pour the filling into the pre-baked crust and bake for 25–30 minutes, until the filling is set at the edges but still slightly soft in the center. Let the pecan pie cool for at least 45 minutes before slicing so the custard finishes setting.

title: Wholesome Maple Pecan Pie with Whole-Grain Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "60 g pecans", "50 g whole wheat flour", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp fine salt", "2 medium eggs, raw", "200 g light maple syrup", "120 ml low-fat milk", "60 g unsalted butter, melted", "1 tsp vanilla extract"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 175°C and place a rack in the middle. Grind the rolled oats into a coarse oat flour, then stir in the whole wheat flour, ground cinnamon and salt. Mix in the melted butter until the mixture looks like damp sand, press it firmly into a 20 cm pie dish, and bake for 10 minutes until lightly golden. While the crust bakes, whisk the eggs, maple syrup, low-fat milk and vanilla extract until smooth. Toast the pecans in the oven for 6 minutes, then scatter them over the hot crust. Pour the filling into the crust and bake for 25–30 minutes, until the edges are set and the center still jiggles slightly. Let the pecan pie cool completely before slicing so the filling firms up.

title: Wholemeal Maple Pecan Pie with Flaky Almond Crust
ingredients_json: ["200 g wholemeal spelt flour", "80 g unsalted butter", "40 g honey", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "2 tbsp water", "1 g fine salt", "180 g pecans, chopped", "120 g unsweetened applesauce", "120 ml low-fat milk", "2 piece eggs, raw", "60 g maple syrup", "10 g cornstarch", "1 g ground cinnamon"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and place a baking tray on the middle rack to help the crust bake through. Rub the butter into the wholemeal spelt flour and salt until the mixture looks like coarse sand. Add the honey, the 1 egg, vanilla extract, and 2 tbsp water, then mix until a firm dough forms. Press the dough into a 22–24 cm pie dish, then prick the base with a fork and bake for 10 minutes until it looks lightly set and fragrant. Meanwhile, whisk the milk, applesauce, maple syrup, the 2 eggs, cornstarch, and cinnamon until smooth, then stir in the chopped pecans. Pour the pecan filling into the pre-baked crust and bake for 25–30 minutes, until the center is slightly wobbly but not liquid. Let the pie cool for at least 1 hour before slicing so the filling thickens fully.

title: Lemon Yogurt Pound Cake with Blueberry Swirl
ingredients_json: ["200 g all-purpose wheat flour", "10 g baking powder", "2 g fine salt", "180 g plain Greek yogurt, 2% fat", "120 g eggs", "120 g maple syrup", "80 g unsalted butter", "1 piece lemon zest, from 1 lemon", "30 ml fresh lemon juice", "200 g blueberries, fresh or frozen", "1 tsp vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C and grease a loaf pan (about 22–24 cm). Line the bottom with baking paper for easier release. In a bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt. In another bowl, whisk the Greek yogurt, eggs, maple syrup, melted butter, lemon zest, lemon juice, and vanilla extract until smooth. Fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture until just combined, and do not overmix. Toss the blueberries lightly with 1 tablespoon of the flour mixture, then gently fold them into the batter, reserving a few for the top if you like. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the surface. Bake for 45–55 minutes, until the top is golden and a skewer inserted in the center comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs. Let the cake cool in the pan for 15 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely before slicing.

title: Greek Yogurt Pound Cake with Lemon Zest and Berries
ingredients_json: ["250 g plain wheat flour", "170 g Greek yogurt, nonfat", "200 g eggs, whole", "140 g unsalted butter", "180 g granulated sugar", "1 tbsp lemon zest", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "10 g baking powder", "2 g fine salt", "150 g blueberries, fresh"]
instructions: Heat your oven to 175°C and line a loaf pan (about 22–24 cm) with baking paper. Melt the butter gently and let it cool slightly. In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the sugar until the mixture looks lighter and slightly frothy, then whisk in the Greek yogurt, lemon zest, and lemon juice. In another bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, and salt, then add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix just until smooth and no dry flour remains. Fold in the blueberries carefully so they don’t burst. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top. Bake for 50–60 minutes, until the cake is golden and a skewer comes out clean or with only a few moist crumbs. Let it cool in the pan for 15 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely before slicing.

title: Greek Yogurt Lemon Pound Cake with Blueberries
ingredients_json: ["200 g plain Greek yogurt, low-fat", "3 large eggs, whole, raw", "180 g whole wheat flour", "60 g all-purpose flour", "160 g unsalted butter", "180 g granulated sugar", "2 tbsp lemon zest", "80 ml lemon juice", "10 g baking powder", "1 g fine salt", "200 g blueberries, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C and grease a loaf pan (about 900 g) or line it with baking paper. In a bowl, cream the softened butter and sugar until lighter in color and fluffy. Whisk in the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition. Stir in the Greek yogurt, lemon zest, and lemon juice until smooth. In a separate bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, baking powder, and salt, then fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture until just combined and no dry streaks remain. Gently fold in the blueberries. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top. Bake for 55–65 minutes, until the cake is golden and a skewer inserted in the center comes out mostly clean with a few moist crumbs. Let it cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely before slicing.

title: Spiced Pumpkin Pie with Oat-Cinnamon Crust
ingredients_json: ["180 g oat flour", "60 g rolled oats", "90 g unsalted butter, cold", "40 g light brown sugar", "1 g fine salt", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "2 g ground ginger", "300 g pumpkin purée (cooked and mashed or canned), unsweetened", "200 ml low-fat milk", "2 piece eggs, whole", "80 g plain Greek yogurt, 2%", "10 g cornstarch", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "0.5 g ground nutmeg", "30 ml maple syrup"]
instructions: Heat your oven to 180°C. In a bowl, combine the oat flour, rolled oats, brown sugar, salt, cinnamon, and ginger. Add the cold butter and rub it into the dry ingredients until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Press the crumbs firmly into a 22–24 cm pie dish to form an even crust, then bake the crust for 10 minutes and let it cool slightly. In a second bowl, whisk together the pumpkin purée, milk, eggs, Greek yogurt, cornstarch, vanilla, nutmeg, and maple syrup until smooth. Pour the filling into the par-baked crust and bake for 35–45 minutes, until the edges are set and the center still has a gentle wobble. Cool the pie at room temperature for at least 1 hour, then refrigerate for 3 hours before slicing for clean pieces.

title: Whole-Wheat Crust Pumpkin Pie with Maple-Cinnamon Filling
ingredients_json: ["200 g whole wheat pastry flour", "60 g unsalted butter, cold", "30 g light brown sugar", "1 pinch salt", "1 piece egg, raw", "2 tbsp water", "400 g pumpkin purée, plain", "200 g low-fat plain Greek yogurt", "80 g light brown sugar", "2 piece eggs, raw", "2 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tsp ground ginger", "1 tsp ground nutmeg", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "150 ml evaporated milk, low-fat"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 175°C. To make the crust, combine the whole wheat pastry flour, brown sugar and salt in a bowl, then rub in the cold butter until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Beat the egg with the water and drizzle it into the bowl, mixing just until the dough comes together. Press the dough into a 22–24 cm pie dish, then chill it for 10 minutes. Bake the crust for 10 minutes, until it looks set and lightly dry at the edges. While the crust bakes, whisk the pumpkin purée, Greek yogurt, brown sugar, eggs, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, vanilla and low-fat evaporated milk until smooth and evenly orange. Pour the filling into the warm crust. Bake for 35–40 minutes, until the center is just slightly jiggly but not liquid. Let the pie cool at room temperature for at least 1 hour, then refrigerate for 2 hours before slicing so the filling firms up.

title: Whole-Wheat Pumpkin Pie with Oat Crust and Spiced Custard
ingredients_json: ["150 g whole-wheat flour", "60 g rolled oats", "50 g unsalted butter", "30 g light brown sugar", "5 g ground cinnamon", "2 g ground ginger", "2 g ground nutmeg", "1 g salt", "2 piece eggs, raw", "400 g pumpkin purée (canned or cooked, plain)", "200 ml low-fat milk", "100 g low-fat Greek yogurt, plain"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and lightly grease a 20–23 cm pie dish. In a bowl, mix the whole-wheat flour, rolled oats, 30 g light brown sugar, 2 g cinnamon, 2 g ginger, 1 g nutmeg, and salt. Rub the butter into the dry mixture until the texture looks like coarse crumbs, then press it firmly into the base and slightly up the sides of the dish. Bake the crust for 12 minutes until it is set and lightly golden, then cool for 5 minutes. In another bowl, whisk the eggs with the pumpkin purée, low-fat milk, and Greek yogurt until smooth and evenly orange, adding the remaining cinnamon (about 3 g) and any extra spice you like. Pour the filling into the warm crust and bake for 35–42 minutes, until the edges are set but the center still jiggles slightly when you gently shake the pan. Let the pie cool to room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours before slicing for clean portions.

title: Whole-Grain Crust Pumpkin Pie with Cinnamon-Oat Spice
ingredients_json: ["250 g pumpkin purée", "2 piece egg, whole, raw", "200 g plain low-fat Greek yogurt", "80 g whole wheat flour", "60 g rolled oats", "50 g unsalted butter", "80 g light brown sugar", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp ground ginger", "0.25 tsp ground nutmeg", "0.25 tsp fine salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. In a bowl, mix the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, and salt. Melt the unsalted butter and stir it into the dry mixture until it looks like damp crumbs. Press the mixture firmly into a pie dish, then bake the crust for 10 minutes until it smells toasty and starts to set. Reduce the oven to 170°C. In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs with the light brown sugar until smooth, then whisk in the pumpkin purée and the Greek yogurt until the filling is creamy and evenly orange. Pour the filling into the warm crust and bake for 35–40 minutes, until the edges are set and the center still has a slight wobble. Let the pie cool to room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours before slicing so the filling firms up cleanly.

title: Spiced Pumpkin Pie with Oat & Wholemeal Crust
ingredients_json: ["220 g pumpkin puree", "2 piece egg", "200 ml low-fat milk, 1.5%", "80 g light brown sugar", "45 g rolled oats", "60 g wholemeal flour", "40 g butter, unsalted", "1 tbsp ground flaxseed", "1.5 tsp ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp ground ginger", "0.25 tsp ground nutmeg", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1.5 g fine salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and grease a 20 cm pie dish. In a bowl, mix the rolled oats, wholemeal flour, salt, ground flaxseed, and cinnamon. Rub in the unsalted butter with your fingertips until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs, then press it firmly into the bottom and slightly up the sides of the pie dish. Bake the crust for 10 minutes, then take it out and let it cool for 5 minutes. In another bowl, whisk the eggs with the brown sugar until glossy, then whisk in the pumpkin puree, low-fat milk, vanilla extract, ginger, and nutmeg until smooth. Pour the filling into the pre-baked crust and bake for 35–40 minutes, until the filling is set around the edges but still has a gentle wobble in the center. Let the pie cool to room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours before slicing for clean cuts.

title: Rustic Rhubarb Pie with Oat-Crust and Vanilla
ingredients_json: ["450 g rhubarb, trimmed and sliced", "120 g Greek yogurt, 2%", "60 g rolled oats", "90 g wholemeal wheat flour", "70 g unsalted butter", "120 g light brown sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 dl milk, 2%", "10 g cornstarch", "8 g baking powder", "5 g vanilla extract", "2 g ground cinnamon", "1 g fine salt", "10 ml lemon juice, fresh"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 190°C. Toss the sliced rhubarb with the lemon juice, 40 g of the light brown sugar, cornstarch, and cinnamon, then spread it into a pie dish. For the crust, mix the rolled oats, wholemeal wheat flour, baking powder, salt, and the remaining sugar. Rub in the butter until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs, then stir in the egg and milk just until it holds together. Spoon the Greek yogurt over the rhubarb and carefully crumble the oat mixture on top. Bake for 35–40 minutes, until the top is lightly golden and the rhubarb juices are bubbling. Let the pie cool for at least 20 minutes before slicing so the filling sets.

title: Light Rhubarb Pie with Oat & Almond Crust
ingredients_json: ["600 g rhubarb, fresh, chopped", "120 g rolled oats", "60 g wholemeal wheat flour", "40 g ground almonds", "80 g honey", "120 ml low-fat milk", "1 piece egg, raw", "60 g unsalted butter", "20 g cornstarch", "10 g lemon juice", "1 g ground cinnamon", "1 g fine salt", "5 g vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C and lightly grease a 23 cm pie dish. In a bowl, mix the oats, wholemeal flour, ground almonds, cinnamon, and salt. Rub in the butter until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Press about two-thirds of the crumb mixture firmly into the base of the dish. Toss the chopped rhubarb with cornstarch, honey, lemon juice, and vanilla extract, then spread it over the crust. In a separate bowl, whisk the egg with the milk and pour it gently over the rhubarb. Sprinkle the remaining oat crumble over the top and bake for 40–45 minutes, until the filling is bubbling and the crust is golden. Let the pie cool for at least 20 minutes so the filling sets before slicing.

title: Lighter Rhubarb Pie with Oat-Crumble and Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["500 g rhubarb, fresh, chopped", "120 g plain Greek yogurt, 2%", "80 g wholemeal wheat flour", "60 g rolled oats", "60 g unsalted butter", "70 g light brown sugar", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 pc egg, raw", "2 tbsp water"]
instructions: Heat your oven to 190°C and lightly grease a 20–22 cm pie dish. In a bowl, toss the chopped rhubarb with the lemon juice, cinnamon, and half of the light brown sugar, then spread it evenly in the dish. In another bowl, mix the flour and oats with the remaining sugar and crumble in the butter until the mixture looks like coarse sand. Whisk the egg with the Greek yogurt and vanilla extract, then stir in 2 tbsp water to loosen slightly and pour carefully over the rhubarb. Sprinkle the oat crumble on top and press gently so it adheres. Bake for 35–40 minutes, until the filling is bubbling at the edges and the crumble is golden brown. Let the pie cool for at least 15 minutes before slicing so the filling sets.

title: Rustic Wholewheat Rhubarb Pie with Oat Crumble
ingredients_json: ["300 g rhubarb, fresh, trimmed and chopped", "120 g greek yogurt, low-fat", "70 g rolled oats", "60 g whole wheat flour", "40 g light brown sugar", "30 g butter, unsalted", "1 piece egg, raw", "2 tbsp water", "1 tsp lemon zest, fresh", "1 tbsp lemon juice, fresh", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 190°C and lightly grease a 20–22 cm pie dish. Toss the chopped rhubarb with the lemon juice, lemon zest, cinnamon, half of the brown sugar, and the salt, then spread it evenly in the dish. In a bowl, mix the oats, whole wheat flour, remaining brown sugar, and the butter until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Whisk the egg with the low-fat Greek yogurt and water until smooth, then pour it over the rhubarb. Spoon the oat crumble over the top and press it gently so it sticks. Bake for 35–40 minutes, until the rhubarb is tender and the top is golden. Let the pie cool for at least 10 minutes before slicing so the filling sets.

title: Light Rhubarb Pie with Oat Crust and Greek Yogurt Filling
ingredients_json: ["500 g rhubarb, trimmed", "70 g rolled oats", "60 g wholemeal flour", "70 g low-fat Greek yogurt, 2%", "40 g honey", "40 g light butter, unsalted", "1 piece egg", "20 g cornstarch", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "2 g fine salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C. Grease a 22–24 cm pie dish. Chop the rhubarb into 1–2 cm pieces. In a bowl, mix the rhubarb with the honey, lemon juice, cornstarch, and half of the salt, and let it stand for 5 minutes so the juices start to form. For the oat crust, combine the oats and wholemeal flour with the remaining salt, then rub in the light butter until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Press about two-thirds of the crumbs into the bottom and up the sides of the prepared dish. In a separate bowl, whisk the egg with the Greek yogurt and vanilla extract, then pour this over the rhubarb. Sprinkle the remaining oat crumbs on top. Bake for 35–40 minutes, until the filling is set and the top is golden. Let the pie cool for at least 20 minutes before slicing so the filling firms up.

title: Creamy Cinnamon Rice Pudding with Pears and Oats
ingredients_json: ["100 g pudding rice", "600 ml semi-skimmed milk", "200 ml water", "80 g rolled oats", "120 g pear, fresh, peeled and diced", "50 g honey", "20 g unsalted butter", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 g vanilla extract", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Rinse the pudding rice under cold water, then add it to a saucepan with the water and semi-skimmed milk. Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat, stirring often to prevent sticking, then reduce the heat to low. Cook for about 20 minutes, stirring every few minutes until the rice is tender and the mixture thickens. Stir in the rolled oats and cook for another 5 minutes, until the pudding becomes creamy and slightly more set. Add the diced pears, cinnamon, vanilla extract, honey, butter, and the salt, then cook for 3–4 minutes more until the pears soften but still hold their shape. Remove from the heat, let it cool for 10 minutes, and serve warm or chilled.

title: Creamy Cinnamon Vanilla Rice Pudding with Apples
ingredients_json: ["80 g long-grain white rice", "900 ml semi-skimmed milk", "200 g apples, peeled and diced", "60 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "50 g maple syrup", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 pinch salt", "10 g raisins"]
instructions: Rinse the rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear. In a medium saucepan, add the milk, rice, cinnamon, vanilla extract, and the salt. Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat, then reduce to low and cook for 25–30 minutes, stirring every few minutes so it doesn’t stick, until the rice is tender and the pudding looks thick and creamy. Stir in the diced apples and raisins, then cook for another 8–10 minutes until the apples soften. Turn off the heat and let the pudding rest for 5 minutes to thicken. Stir in the Greek yogurt and maple syrup until smooth, then serve warm or chilled.

title: Creamy Cinnamon Vanilla Rice Pudding with Berries
ingredients_json: ["80 g rice, pudding rice, uncooked (arborio/carnaroli-style)", "1.2 l milk, semi-skimmed", "50 g yogurt, plain, low fat", "25 g maple syrup", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 tbsp butter, unsalted", "1 g vanilla extract", "2 g ground cinnamon", "200 g blueberries, fresh", "1 g fine salt"]
instructions: Rinse the pudding rice briefly under cold water, then drain. In a large saucepan, warm the semi-skimmed milk with the butter and cinnamon over medium heat until it starts to steam, stirring so the milk doesn’t catch. Add the rice, reduce the heat to low, and simmer gently, stirring every few minutes, for about 35–45 minutes until the rice is very tender and the mixture has thickened to a creamy, porridge-like texture. In a small bowl, whisk the egg with the yogurt, maple syrup, vanilla extract, and salt. Take the pan off the heat, let it cool for 3–4 minutes, then slowly stir in the egg-yogurt mixture to avoid scrambling. Return to very low heat and stir for 1–2 minutes just until smooth and lightly thickened. Fold in the blueberries and spoon the pudding into 4 serving bowls. Let it cool to warm or chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours for the best set.

title: Creamy Cinnamon Vanilla Rice Pudding with Berries
ingredients_json: ["100 g rice, pudding rice (short-grain)", "900 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "1 dl water", "60 g yogurt, Greek, plain, low-fat", "20 g honey", "1 piece vanilla bean", "1 g ground cinnamon", "200 g blueberries, fresh"]
instructions: Rinse the pudding rice under cold water, then drain. In a medium saucepan, combine the rice, semi-skimmed milk, and water. Bring it to a gentle simmer over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low and cook for 35–45 minutes, stirring frequently to prevent sticking, until the rice is very tender and the pudding is creamy. Split the vanilla bean lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and stir them in (or add vanilla seeds only) along with the cinnamon. Continue to simmer for a further 2–3 minutes, then remove from the heat. Stir in the honey and the Greek yogurt until fully smooth. Fold in the blueberries and let the pudding stand for 5 minutes so it thickens slightly. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Creamy Cinnamon Vanilla Oat Milk Rice Pudding with Berries
ingredients_json: ["80 g Arborio rice", "900 ml Oat milk, unsweetened", "200 ml Water", "60 g Greek yogurt, plain, nonfat", "30 g Maple syrup", "1 piece Vanilla bean, seeds scraped", "2 g Ground cinnamon", "150 g Frozen mixed berries", "3 g Lemon zest"]
instructions: Rinse the arborio rice under cold water, then drain. In a medium saucepan, combine the oat milk, water, vanilla seeds, and rice. Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low so the pudding barely bubbles. Cook for 25–30 minutes, stirring every few minutes to prevent sticking, until the rice is tender and the mixture is thick and creamy. Stir in the ground cinnamon, lemon zest, and maple syrup, then fold in the frozen mixed berries and cook for another 5 minutes until the berries break down slightly. Turn off the heat and let the pudding stand for 2 minutes, then stir through the nonfat Greek yogurt until smooth. Serve warm or chilled; if you chill it, stir once after 10 minutes to keep the texture creamy.

title: Oat & Dark Chocolate Sandwich Cookies with Raspberry Yogurt Filling
ingredients_json: ["150 g rolled oats", "80 g whole-wheat flour", "70 g dark chocolate chips (70% cocoa)", "80 g unsalted butter, softened", "90 g maple syrup", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "6 g baking powder", "2 g fine salt", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "60 g raspberries, fresh or frozen", "10 g honey"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 180°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. Blend the rolled oats into a fine oat flour, then mix it with whole-wheat flour, baking powder, and salt. In a separate bowl, cream the softened butter with the maple syrup until smooth, then beat in the egg and vanilla extract. Fold in the dry ingredients until a thick dough forms, then mix in the dark chocolate chips. Scoop 2 tablespoons of dough per cookie, space them well, and press each mound into a flat round. Bake for 10–12 minutes until the edges look set and lightly golden. Let the cookies cool completely on the tray before filling. Mash the raspberries and warm them in a small pan for 1–2 minutes to slightly thicken, then stir into the Greek yogurt with the honey. Spread a spoonful of raspberry yogurt filling on the flat side of half the cookies and sandwich with the remaining cookies. Chill for 20 minutes so the filling firms up before serving.

title: Whole Wheat Cocoa Sandwich Cookies with Greek Yogurt Berry Filling
ingredients_json: ["140 g whole wheat flour", "40 g unsweetened cocoa powder", "90 g unsalted butter, chilled", "120 g honey", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 g fine salt", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "60 g strawberry jam, reduced sugar", "1 tsp vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a bowl, mix the whole wheat flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, and fine salt. Add the chilled butter and rub it in with your fingertips until the mixture looks like fine crumbs. Whisk the egg with the honey and vanilla extract, then pour into the dry ingredients and mix until a soft dough forms. If the dough feels too sticky, chill it for 10 minutes, then roll it between two sheets of parchment to about 4 mm thick and cut 24 small rounds. Place the cookies on the tray and bake for 9–11 minutes, until the edges look set but the centers still look slightly soft. Cool the cookies completely. Stir the Greek yogurt until smooth, then mix in the reduced-sugar strawberry jam. Spread or pipe about 1 tablespoon of filling onto 12 cookies and top with the remaining cookies to make sandwiches. Chill for 15 minutes before serving so the filling firms up.

title: Cocoa Oat Sandwich Cookies with Greek Yogurt Berry Filling
ingredients_json: ["160 g rolled oats", "60 g whole wheat flour", "30 g unsweetened cocoa powder", "8 g baking powder", "4 g fine salt", "120 g honey", "80 g unsalted butter, softened", "2 piece egg, raw", "10 ml vanilla extract", "240 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "120 g mixed berries, frozen"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. Blend the rolled oats into a coarse oat flour, then mix it in a bowl with the whole wheat flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt. In a second bowl, whisk the honey, softened butter, and eggs until smooth, then stir in the vanilla extract. Combine wet and dry ingredients and mix until you get a thick, scoopable cookie dough. Portion the dough into small rounds (about 20–22 g each) and bake for 10–12 minutes, until the cookies look set around the edges and a toothpick comes out mostly clean. Let the cookies cool completely on the tray before assembling. For the filling, thaw and drain the frozen berries, then stir them into the low-fat Greek yogurt until evenly mixed. Spread about 1 to 1.5 tablespoons of yogurt-berry filling on the flat side of half the cookies, top with the remaining cookies, and gently press to make sandwich pairs. Serve the cookies soon, or chill for 20 minutes to firm the filling.

title: Oat–Cocoa Sandwich Cookies with Vanilla Yogurt Filling
ingredients_json: ["140 g rolled oats", "60 g whole-wheat flour", "30 g unsweetened cocoa powder", "8 g baking powder", "2 g fine salt", "90 g honey", "60 g unsalted butter, softened", "1 piece egg, raw", "60 ml milk, 2% fat", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "20 g powdered sugar", "5 ml vanilla extract"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 180°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Blend the rolled oats into a coarse flour and mix it in a bowl with whole-wheat flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt. In another bowl, whisk honey with softened butter until creamy, then beat in the egg and milk. Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture and stir until a thick, cohesive dough forms. Roll the dough between two pieces of parchment to about 3–4 mm thickness and cut out 24 cookies. Place them on the baking sheet and bake for 10–12 minutes, until the edges look set but the centers still feel slightly soft. Let the cookies cool completely. Stir Greek yogurt with powdered sugar and vanilla extract until smooth, then spread filling on half of the cookies and top with the remaining cookies to make sandwiches. Chill for 20–30 minutes before serving so the filling firms up.

title: Cocoa Oat Sandwich Cookies with Greek Yogurt Berry Filling
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "80 g whole-wheat flour", "30 g unsweetened cocoa powder", "10 g baking powder", "4 g fine salt", "80 g maple syrup", "1 piece egg, raw", "90 g unsalted butter, melted", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat (2%)", "120 g mixed berries, frozen", "15 g honey", "10 g lemon juice, freshly squeezed"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line two baking trays with parchment paper. Add the oats to a blender and pulse until they become a coarse oat flour. In a bowl, mix the oat flour, whole-wheat flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt. In a second bowl, whisk together the maple syrup, egg, and melted butter until smooth. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir until a thick dough forms. Scoop and roll the dough into small balls (about 18–20 g each), place them on the trays, and flatten slightly. Bake for 10–12 minutes, until the cookies feel set and the tops look matte rather than glossy. Let them cool completely. While the cookies cool, heat the frozen berries with the honey and lemon juice in a small saucepan over medium heat for 5–7 minutes, stirring until saucy. Stir in the Greek yogurt off the heat until the filling is smooth and spoonable. If the filling seems too loose, let it cool for 10 minutes to thicken. Spread a generous spoonful of berry yogurt filling on the flat side of half the cookies and sandwich with the remaining cookies. Chill for 15 minutes before serving so the filling firms up.

title: Wholegrain Oat Shortbread with Almonds and Vanilla
ingredients_json: ["160 g rolled oats", "80 g whole wheat flour", "60 g unsalted butter, softened", "60 g honey", "1 pc egg, raw", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "0.5 tsp fine sea salt", "30 g almonds, finely chopped", "1 tsp lemon zest"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. Add the rolled oats and whole wheat flour to a food processor and pulse a few times until the oats are partly ground. Transfer the mixture to a bowl and stir in the finely chopped almonds, lemon zest, and sea salt. In a separate bowl, cream the softened butter with the honey until smooth, then mix in the egg and vanilla extract. Combine the wet mixture with the dry ingredients and mix until you have a cohesive dough. Press the dough firmly onto the lined tray to an even thickness, then chill for 10 minutes to firm up. Bake for 12–15 minutes, until the edges look lightly golden and the surface is set. Cool on the tray for 10 minutes, then slice into shortbread fingers or squares and let cool completely before serving.

title: Oat and Wholemeal Shortbread with Dark Chocolate Chips
ingredients_json: ["120 g wholemeal plain flour", "80 g rolled oats", "80 g unsalted butter", "50 g coconut sugar", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 g fine salt", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "60 g dark chocolate chips (70% cocoa)"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 170°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Pulse the rolled oats in a food processor until they resemble a coarse flour, then mix them with the wholemeal flour, baking powder, and salt. In a bowl, cream the butter with the coconut sugar and vanilla extract until the mixture looks lighter and smooth. Add the dry ingredients and mix just until a soft dough forms. Fold in the dark chocolate chips, then press the dough evenly onto the lined tray to about 1 cm thickness. Bake for 15–18 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden and the center looks set. Let it cool on the tray for 10 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely before slicing into shortbread pieces.

title: Wholegrain Oat Shortbread with Toasted Almonds and Dark Chocolate
ingredients_json: ["150 g rolled oats", "80 g whole wheat flour", "70 g unsalted butter", "60 g light brown sugar", "1 g fine salt", "8 g vanilla sugar", "1 piece egg yolk", "40 g almonds, blanched, chopped", "40 g dark chocolate (70%), chopped"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 170°C (conventional) and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a food processor, pulse the oats until they resemble coarse flour. Add the whole wheat flour and salt and pulse briefly to combine. In a bowl, cream the butter with the light brown sugar and vanilla sugar until smooth and slightly lighter in color. Beat in the egg yolk, then stir in the oat-flour mixture, chopped almonds, and dark chocolate. Bring the dough together, then press it firmly into a rectangle on the tray to an even thickness of about 1 cm. Bake for 15–18 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden and the center is set but not browned too dark. Cool on the tray for 10 minutes, then cut into shortbread fingers or squares and let cool completely before serving.

title: Oat-Wholemeal Shortbread with Lemon Zest and Vanilla
ingredients_json: ["120 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats, finely ground", "120 g unsalted butter, cold, cubed", "90 g light brown sugar", "1 tbsp lemon zest", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "0.5 tsp fine sea salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 170°C (conventional) and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, ground oats, lemon zest, and salt. Rub in the cold, cubed butter with your fingertips until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Stir in the light brown sugar and vanilla extract, then bring the dough together with your hands; it should hold together without being sticky. Roll the dough out between two sheets of baking paper to about 6–8 mm thick and cut into small shapes. Transfer to the tray and bake for 14–18 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden and the center still looks set. Cool on the tray for 5 minutes, then move to a rack to cool completely before serving.

title: Whole-Grain Berry Yogurt Shortcakes with Vanilla Chia Cream
ingredients_json: ["180 g whole-wheat pastry flour", "30 g rolled oats", "10 g baking powder", "5 g fine salt", "40 g maple syrup", "70 g plain nonfat Greek yogurt", "60 ml milk, 1% fat", "1 piece egg, raw", "250 g mixed berries, frozen", "20 ml lemon juice", "20 g chia seeds", "200 g plain low-fat Greek yogurt", "5 ml vanilla extract"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. Line a baking tray with parchment. In a bowl, mix the whole-wheat pastry flour, oats, baking powder, and salt. In a second bowl, whisk the maple syrup, Greek yogurt, milk, and the egg until smooth, then pour into the dry ingredients and stir just until a thick dough forms. Spoon the dough into 8 small mounds on the tray and flatten slightly, then bake for 12–15 minutes until lightly golden and cooked through. While they bake, simmer the mixed berries with the lemon juice in a small saucepan for 6–8 minutes until syrupy and the berries burst, then set aside to cool. Mix the chia seeds with the low-fat Greek yogurt and vanilla extract, stirring until well combined, then let it stand for 10 minutes to thicken. Let the shortcakes cool for 5 minutes, then split and top with the berry compote and a generous spoon of the vanilla chia yogurt cream.

title: Greek Yogurt Berry Shortcakes with Light Honey and Chia
ingredients_json: ["180 g whole wheat flour", "40 g rolled oats", "10 g baking powder", "5 g fine salt", "60 g unsalted butter, cold", "90 g Greek yogurt, plain 2% fat", "120 ml low-fat milk", "30 g honey", "1 piece egg, raw", "250 g mixed berries, fresh or frozen", "1 tbsp chia seeds", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tsp vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C and line a baking tray with parchment. In a bowl, mix the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking powder, and salt. Cut the cold butter into small cubes and rub it into the dry ingredients until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. In another bowl, whisk the egg, Greek yogurt, milk, honey, and vanilla, then pour into the dry mix and stir just until a thick dough forms. Fold in the chia seeds and gently portion the dough into 8 mounds on the tray, leaving space between them. Bake for 12–15 minutes until the shortcakes are golden and spring back when lightly pressed. While they bake, simmer the berries with lemon juice for 5–6 minutes until they soften and become glossy, then let cool slightly. Split the warm shortcakes, spoon over the berry mixture, and serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Lemon-Blueberry Yogurt Shortcakes with Wholemeal Biscuits
ingredients_json: ["150 g wheat flour, wholemeal", "50 g wheat flour, white", "20 g sugar, caster", "8 g baking powder", "2 g salt, iodized", "60 g butter, unsalted", "200 g Greek yoghurt, low fat", "1 piece egg, whole, raw", "1 tbsp lemon zest", "60 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "250 g blueberries, fresh", "30 ml lemon juice, fresh", "20 g honey"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C and line a baking tray with parchment. In a large bowl, whisk together the wholemeal and white flour, caster sugar, baking powder, and iodized salt. Rub the unsalted butter into the dry ingredients until the mixture looks like coarse breadcrumbs. In another bowl, whisk the Greek yoghurt, egg, lemon zest, and milk, then add to the dry mixture and stir just until a soft dough forms. Gently fold in a few tablespoons of blueberries, then portion the dough into 8 small mounds on the tray. Bake for 12–15 minutes, until the shortcakes are risen and lightly golden on top. Meanwhile, warm the remaining blueberries with lemon juice and honey in a small pan for 5–7 minutes until the berries burst and the sauce thickens slightly. Let the shortcakes cool for 5 minutes, then slice each one in half and spoon over the lemon-blueberry topping. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Berry Yogurt Shortcakes with Whole-Grain Oat Biscuits
ingredients_json: ["220 g plain low-fat Greek yogurt", "180 g wholemeal self-raising flour", "60 g rolled oats", "35 g unsalted butter", "45 g honey", "1 piece egg, raw", "2 g baking powder", "2 g fine salt", "200 g mixed berries, fresh or frozen", "1 g vanilla extract", "15 ml lemon juice"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Line a baking tray with parchment. In a bowl, mix the wholemeal self-raising flour, rolled oats, baking powder, and salt. Rub the butter into the dry ingredients until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. In a second bowl, whisk the egg with the yogurt, honey, and vanilla extract, then pour it into the dry mix and stir just until a soft dough forms. Fold in about half the berries so you get fruit pieces throughout. Scoop the dough into 8 small mounds on the tray and bake for 12–15 minutes, until risen and lightly golden. While the shortcakes bake, simmer the remaining berries with the lemon juice for 3–4 minutes until glossy and slightly thickened, then let it cool a little. Split the warm shortcakes, spoon over the berry compote, and finish with extra yogurt if desired; serve once the biscuits are no longer scorching hot.

title: Greek Yogurt Berry Shortcakes with Whole-Wheat Biscuits
ingredients_json: ["180 g plain low-fat Greek yogurt", "140 g whole-wheat flour", "60 g rolled oats", "30 g almond flour", "25 g erythritol (or sugar-free sweetener, powdered)", "10 g baking powder", "4 g fine salt", "120 ml semi-skimmed milk", "60 g unsalted butter, cold", "1 piece egg, raw", "250 g mixed berries (fresh or frozen), unsweetened", "15 ml lemon juice", "10 g chia seeds"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C and line a baking tray with parchment. In a large bowl, mix the whole-wheat flour, oats, almond flour, powdered sweetener, baking powder, and salt. Grate or chop the cold butter into the dry ingredients and rub it in until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. In another bowl, whisk the egg with the milk and Greek yogurt, then add the wet mixture to the dry ingredients and stir just until a thick dough forms. Gently fold in the chia seeds. Turn the dough onto a lightly floured surface and pat it to about 2.5 cm thick, then cut into 8 shortcake rounds. Bake for 14–16 minutes until lightly golden and cooked through. While the biscuits bake, simmer the berries with the lemon juice for 5–7 minutes until they release their juices and slightly thicken, then cool. Split the warm shortcakes, spoon on the berry topping, and serve with any extra juices for a bright, lightly sweet finish.

title: Whole-Grain Snickerdoodles with Cinnamon-Sugar Swirl
ingredients_json: ["120 g whole wheat flour", "80 g all-purpose flour", "70 g unsalted butter, softened", "60 g light brown sugar", "70 g honey", "1 piece egg, large", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 tsp baking powder", "0.5 tsp baking soda", "0.5 tsp fine salt", "2 tsp ground cinnamon", "30 g granulated sugar"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 175°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, baking powder, baking soda, and fine salt. In a second bowl, cream the softened unsalted butter with the light brown sugar and honey until the mixture looks lighter and smoother. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract, then gradually fold in the dry ingredients until a soft dough forms. Mix the granulated sugar and ground cinnamon in a small bowl. Scoop dough into portions (about 1 heaped tablespoon each), roll them into balls, and coat well in the cinnamon-sugar. Place them on the tray with space between, then bake for 10–12 minutes until the edges look set and lightly golden but the centers still look slightly soft. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool fully.

title: Whole-Wheat Snickerdoodles with Cinnamon-Sugar Crunch
ingredients_json: ["160 g whole_wheat_flour", "60 g rolled_oats, finely ground", "90 g unsalted_butter, softened", "80 g light_brown_sugar", "1 piece egg, raw, large", "80 g Greek_yogurt, plain, nonfat", "7 g baking_powder", "2 g baking_soda", "2 g salt, fine", "10 g vanilla_extract", "30 g granulated_sugar", "10 g ground_cinnamon"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 175°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a bowl, mix the whole-wheat flour, finely ground oats, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. In another bowl, cream the softened butter with the light brown sugar until smooth, then beat in the egg and vanilla extract. Add the Greek yogurt and mix until the dough looks cohesive. Stir in the dry ingredients just until you no longer see dry flour. Mix the granulated sugar with the ground cinnamon in a small bowl. Scoop the dough into 18 portions, roll each portion into a ball, and coat well in the cinnamon-sugar mixture. Place the balls on the tray with space between them and bake for 10–12 minutes, until the edges look set and lightly golden while the centers remain soft. Cool on the tray for 5 minutes, then move to a rack to cool further so they finish setting.

title: Whole-Wheat Snickerdoodles with Cinnamon-Sugar Swirl
ingredients_json: ["200 g whole wheat flour", "30 g oat flour", "100 g plain Greek yogurt, 2% fat", "80 g unsalted butter", "110 g light brown sugar", "1 large egg, raw", "5 g baking powder", "2 g baking soda", "3 g fine salt", "10 ml vanilla extract", "80 g granulated sugar", "10 g ground cinnamon"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a bowl, whisk the whole wheat flour, oat flour, baking powder, baking soda, and 2 g of the salt until evenly combined. In a separate bowl, cream the unsalted butter with the light brown sugar until the mixture looks lighter and fluffy. Beat in the egg, then mix in the Greek yogurt and vanilla extract until smooth. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and stir just until a soft, slightly sticky dough forms. In a small bowl, mix the granulated sugar with the ground cinnamon. Scoop the dough into 18 evenly sized portions and roll each portion into a ball, then coat thoroughly in the cinnamon-sugar mixture. Place the balls on the tray with space between them and bake for 10–12 minutes, until the edges look set and lightly golden but the centers still look soft. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely so they finish setting.

title: Whole-Wheat Snickerdoodles with Cinnamon Sugar Coating
ingredients_json: ["180 g whole wheat flour", "60 g rolled oats", "120 g unsalted butter", "90 g light brown sugar", "1 large egg", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 tsp baking powder", "0.5 tsp bicarbonate of soda", "1.5 g fine salt", "5 g ground cinnamon"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking powder, bicarbonate of soda, and fine salt. In a second bowl, cream the unsalted butter with the light brown sugar until light and fluffy, then beat in the egg and vanilla extract. Stir the dry ingredients into the wet mixture until you have a thick dough. Mix the cinnamon with 20 g of the reserved sugar if you want an extra even coating, then form the dough into small balls and roll them in the cinnamon sugar. Place the balls on the tray with space between them, flatten slightly, and bake for 10–12 minutes until the edges look set and the centers are still soft. Let them cool on the tray for 5 minutes before transferring to a rack to cool completely.

title: Whole-Wheat Snickerdoodles with Cinnamon-Sugar Swirl
ingredients_json: ["140 g whole-wheat flour", "60 g plain all-purpose flour", "1 tsp baking powder", "0.5 tsp baking soda", "0.25 tsp fine salt", "110 g unsalted butter, softened", "100 g light brown sugar", "1 large egg", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1.5 tbsp ground cinnamon", "40 g granulated sugar"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a bowl, whisk together the whole-wheat flour, all-purpose flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. In a second bowl, cream the softened butter with the light brown sugar until the mixture looks lighter and smoother, then beat in the egg and vanilla extract. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix just until a thick dough forms. In a small bowl, stir together the cinnamon and granulated sugar. Scoop the dough into equal portions and roll each one into a ball, then coat thoroughly in the cinnamon-sugar mixture. Place the balls on the tray with space between them and bake for 10–12 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden and the centers still look slightly soft. Let the cookies rest on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely so they set properly.

title: Wholegrain Spiced Carrot-Oat Spice Cakes with Cinnamon and Nutmeg
ingredients_json: ["180 g whole wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "120 g grated carrots", "100 g plain Greek yogurt, 2%", "80 g unsweetened applesauce", "2 piece eggs, raw", "30 g honey", "60 ml rapeseed oil", "8 g baking powder", "2 g ground cinnamon", "0.5 g ground nutmeg", "1 g fine salt", "80 g raisins", "5 g vanilla sugar"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a muffin tin with paper cases. In a large bowl, mix the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt until evenly combined. In another bowl, whisk the eggs with the honey, rapeseed oil, Greek yogurt, and applesauce until smooth. Stir the grated carrots and raisins into the wet mixture, then pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and fold until just combined; the batter should be thick and slightly lumpy. Spoon the batter into the muffin cases, filling each about two-thirds full. Bake for 18–22 minutes, until the cakes are golden and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean or with only a few moist crumbs. Let the spice cakes cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool fully before serving.

title: Whole-Grain Cinnamon Spice Cakes with Yogurt and Applesauce
ingredients_json: ["200 g whole wheat flour, wholegrain", "120 g rolled oats, finely ground", "1.5 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp baking soda", "3 g ground cinnamon", "1 g ground ginger", "0.5 g ground nutmeg", "3 g fine salt", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, nonfat", "120 g applesauce, unsweetened", "120 g honey", "2 pieces egg, whole, raw", "80 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "40 ml olive oil, extra virgin"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Line a muffin tin with paper liners or lightly grease it. In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, finely ground oats, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, and salt until evenly mixed. In a second bowl, whisk the Greek yogurt, applesauce, honey, eggs, milk, and olive oil until smooth and glossy. Add the wet mixture to the dry ingredients and stir just until no dry flour remains, being careful not to overmix. Divide the batter into the muffin tin, filling each cup about two-thirds full. Bake for 16 to 20 minutes, until the tops look set and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out mostly clean with a few moist crumbs. Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely before serving.

title: Wholemeal Cinnamon-Orange Spice Cakes with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "60 g rolled oats", "90 g brown sugar", "10 g baking powder", "4 g ground cinnamon", "2 g ground ginger", "1 g ground nutmeg", "2 g fine salt", "180 g low-fat Greek yogurt", "2 pieces eggs, whole, raw", "80 ml rapeseed oil", "80 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "20 g orange zest", "30 g raisins"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a 6-cup muffin tin or mini loaf tin with paper liners. In a large bowl, whisk together the wholemeal flour, oats, brown sugar, baking powder, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, and salt. In a separate bowl, whisk the Greek yogurt with the eggs, rapeseed oil, milk, and orange zest until smooth. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir just until the batter comes together; do not overmix. Fold in the raisins, then divide the batter evenly into the lined tin. Bake for 18–22 minutes, or until the tops are lightly golden and a skewer inserted into the center comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs. Let the spice cakes cool in the tin for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Apple-Cinnamon Oat Spice Cakes with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "120 g whole wheat flour", "2 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp ground nutmeg", "0.25 tsp ground cloves", "2 g fine salt", "200 g nonfat Greek yogurt", "120 g egg (whole)", "90 g honey", "60 ml rapeseed oil", "150 g grated apple", "1 tsp vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a muffin tin with paper cases or lightly grease it. Blend the rolled oats into a fine oat flour, then whisk it together with whole wheat flour, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves, and salt in a large bowl. In a separate bowl, whisk the Greek yogurt, whole egg, honey, rapeseed oil, and vanilla extract until smooth. Fold the grated apple into the wet mixture, then combine wet and dry ingredients and stir just until no dry pockets remain. Divide the batter evenly between the cases and bake for 18–22 minutes, until the tops spring back lightly and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Let the spice cakes cool in the tin for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Whole-Wheat Vanilla Spritz Cookies with Almond Flour
ingredients_json: ["140 g whole wheat flour", "60 g almond flour", "180 g unsalted butter, softened", "120 g powdered sugar", "1 piece egg, whole", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 g fine salt", "1 g baking powder", "30 g milk, 2% fat"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a bowl, cream the softened butter and powdered sugar until the mixture looks pale and fluffy. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract until smooth. In a separate bowl, whisk together the whole-wheat flour, almond flour, baking powder, and salt. Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture in two additions, alternating with the milk, and mix just until a thick dough forms. Fit a piping bag with a star nozzle, pipe small rosettes or short logs onto the tray, and bake for 10–12 minutes until the cookies are lightly golden at the edges and set in the center. Cool on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely before serving.

title: Light Lemon Yogurt Spritz Cookies with Vanilla
ingredients_json: ["200 g plain wheat flour", "80 g whole wheat flour", "180 g Greek yogurt, 2% fat", "100 g unsalted butter", "100 g granulated sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "2 g baking powder", "2 g fine salt", "5 g vanilla extract", "10 g lemon zest", "20 g lemon juice"]
instructions: Heat your oven to 180°C and line two baking trays with baking paper. In a bowl, whisk the egg with the granulated sugar until it looks slightly lighter. Add the Greek yogurt, melted butter, vanilla extract, lemon zest, and lemon juice, then mix until smooth. In a second bowl, combine the wheat flours, baking powder, and salt. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix just until you get a thick, pipeable dough. Spoon the dough into a piping bag fitted with a star nozzle and pipe small rosettes onto the trays, leaving a little space between each cookie. Bake for 10–12 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden and the centers look set. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely before serving.

title: Whole-Wheat Vanilla Spritz Cookies with Almonds and Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["150 g whole wheat pastry flour", "100 g plain Greek yogurt, 2%", "80 g unsalted butter", "50 g erythritol", "1 piece egg", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 g baking powder", "1 g fine salt", "30 g almond flour", "20 g sliced almonds"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175°C and line two baking trays with parchment paper. In a bowl, cream the butter with the erythritol until the mixture looks lighter and smoother. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract, then mix in the Greek yogurt. Fold in the whole-wheat pastry flour, almond flour, baking powder, and salt until you have a thick, pipeable dough. Fit a piping bag with a star nozzle and pipe small rosettes onto the trays, leaving space between them. Sprinkle the sliced almonds over the cookies. Bake for 10–12 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden and the centers look set but not browned. Cool on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely before serving.

title: Citrus-Spiced Greek Yogurt Spritz Cookies
ingredients_json: ["160 g all-purpose wheat flour", "60 g whole wheat pastry flour", "1 g baking powder", "3 g fine salt", "120 g unsalted butter", "90 g caster sugar", "1 piece egg, whole, raw", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, non-fat", "5 ml vanilla extract", "6 g orange zest", "1 g ground cinnamon"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 175°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a bowl, whisk together the all-purpose flour, whole wheat pastry flour, baking powder, fine salt, and cinnamon. In a second bowl, beat the butter and caster sugar until creamy and pale, then beat in the egg and vanilla extract. Mix in the Greek yogurt and orange zest. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix just until a thick dough forms. Transfer the dough to a piping bag fitted with a star nozzle and pipe small rosettes onto the tray, leaving space between each cookie. Bake for 10–12 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden but the centers still look soft. Cool on the tray for 5 minutes, then move to a rack to cool completely before serving.

title: Lemon-Orange Almond Spritz Cookies with Greek Yogurt Glaze
ingredients_json: ["160 g whole-wheat pastry flour", "60 g rolled oats, finely ground", "120 g unsalted butter, softened", "100 g low-fat Greek yogurt, plain", "120 g granulated sugar", "1 large piece egg, raw", "7 g baking powder", "2 g fine salt", "2 g vanilla extract", "4 g lemon zest", "4 g orange zest", "30 g powdered sugar", "20 ml lemon juice"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 175°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a bowl, cream the softened butter with the granulated sugar until light and fluffy, then beat in the egg, Greek yogurt, vanilla extract, lemon zest, and orange zest. Stir in the finely ground oats, whole-wheat pastry flour, baking powder, and salt until a soft dough forms. Fit a piping bag with a star nozzle, fill it with the dough, and pipe small rosettes about 4 cm wide onto the tray, leaving space between them. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes until the edges are lightly golden and the centers look set. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes, then move them to a rack to cool completely. Mix powdered sugar with lemon juice to make a thin glaze, drizzle lightly over the cooled cookies, and let the glaze set for about 15 minutes before serving.

title: No-Bake Greek Yogurt Strawberry Pie with Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["200 g strawberries, fresh", "300 g strawberries, frozen, unsweetened", "250 g Greek yogurt, low-fat (2%)", "120 g cottage cheese, low-fat", "80 g rolled oats", "40 g almonds, ground", "30 g honey", "60 g unsalted butter, melted", "5 g gelatin powder", "60 ml water, cold", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 g salt"]
instructions: If using frozen strawberries, thaw them for about 15 minutes so you can mash them more easily. Place the gelatin powder in a bowl with the cold water and let it bloom for 5 minutes. In a saucepan, warm half of the strawberries with the honey until they release juice and start to simmer gently, then cook for 3–4 minutes. Stir in the bloomed gelatin and keep whisking until fully dissolved and the mixture looks smooth. Remove from the heat, add the remaining strawberries, lemon juice and vanilla, and let the fruit mixture cool to lukewarm. Meanwhile, mix the oats, ground almonds and salt, then stir in the melted butter until the crumbs are evenly moistened. Press the crust mixture firmly into the bottom of a 20–22 cm pie dish and chill for 15 minutes to set. Blend the Greek yogurt and cottage cheese until creamy, then fold in the cooled strawberry mixture. Pour the filling into the crust and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, until set and sliceable. Serve chilled, with extra strawberries on top if desired.

title: Light Strawberry Chia Pie with Greek Yogurt Crust
ingredients_json: ["200 g strawberries, fresh, hulled", "120 g plain low-fat Greek yogurt", "25 g wholemeal oat flour", "15 g chia seeds", "20 g honey", "40 g unsalted butter", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "10 g cornstarch", "2 g vanilla extract"]
instructions: Crush the strawberries lightly and set aside half for topping. In a bowl, mix the yogurt, honey, cornstarch, lemon juice, and vanilla until smooth. Melt the butter gently in a small saucepan, then stir in the oat flour and chia seeds to form a thick crumb. Press the crumb into the bottom of a greased pie dish and chill for 10 minutes to firm. Pour the yogurt-strawberry mixture over the crust and scatter the reserved strawberries on top. Bake at 170°C for 25–30 minutes, until the center is set but still slightly wobbly. Let the pie cool to room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours before slicing.

title: Light Strawberry Pie with Oat Crust and Greek Yogurt Filling
ingredients_json: ["250 g strawberries, fresh", "250 g strawberries, frozen", "120 g plain Greek yogurt, nonfat", "200 g cottage cheese, low-fat", "60 g rolled oats", "40 g wholemeal flour", "25 g coconut oil, melted", "35 g honey", "25 g chia seeds", "20 g lemon juice", "15 g lemon zest", "8 g vanilla extract", "6 g cornstarch", "2 g fine salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Line a 20 cm pie dish with baking paper. In a bowl, mix the rolled oats, wholemeal flour, coconut oil, 1 g of salt, and 20 g of the honey until the mixture clumps like wet sand. Press it firmly into the pie dish and bake for 12 minutes, until lightly golden. Let the crust cool while you prepare the filling. In a saucepan, combine the frozen strawberries, lemon juice, remaining honey, chia seeds, and cornstarch. Cook over medium heat for 6–8 minutes, stirring until thickened and glossy; it should coat the back of a spoon. Remove from heat and let cool for 10 minutes. In another bowl, blend the low-fat cottage cheese, nonfat Greek yogurt, vanilla extract, lemon zest, and a pinch of salt until smooth. Fold in the cooled strawberry mixture, then spoon it into the crust. Top with fresh strawberries sliced or left whole as you like. Chill the pie for at least 3 hours until set, then slice and serve cold.

title: Light Strawberry Pie with Greek Yogurt Cream and Oat Crust
